Instructions: Exportieren Sie eine interne Tabelle (z.B. sflights) in eine CSV-Datei auf dem Frontend. Nutzen Sie hierfür die Utility-Klasse cl_salv_ex_util.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_salv_ex_util=>if_salv_ex_util_r_result~export_to_csv.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_exporter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'sflights_data.csv'
      RAISING
        cx_salv_ex_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_exporter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_csv.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      " Handle case where no data is found, or raise an exception
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    cl_salv_ex_util=>if_salv_ex_util_r_result~export_to_csv(
      EXPORTING
        i_filename = iv_filename
        i_data     = lt_sflights
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_export_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_export_sflights.
    DATA(lo_exporter) = NEW zcl_data_exporter( ).
    TRY.
        lo_exporter->export_sflights_to_csv( iv_filename = 'test_sflights.csv' ).
        " Assert that no exception occurred. Actual file content check is not feasible in backend unit tests.

      CATCH cx_salv_ex_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_error->get_text( ) ).

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch alle öffentlichen Attribute einer gegebenen Klasse unter Verwendung von cl_ci_query_attributes. Geben Sie den Namen, Typ und die Sichtbarkeit der Attribute zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_attributes und interpretieren Sie die Ergebnisse.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ci_attribute_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_attribute_info,
        name TYPE string,
        type TYPE string,
        visibility TYPE string,
      END OF ty_attribute_info,
      tt_attribute_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_attribute_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_class_attributes
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE seoclassname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE tt_attribute_info
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ci_attribute_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    DATA lt_ci_attributes TYPE cl_ci_query_attributes=>tt_attributes.
    DATA ls_attribute LIKE LINE OF lt_ci_attributes.
    DATA ls_info TYPE ty_attribute_info.

    TRY.
        cl_ci_query_attributes=>get_attributes(
          EXPORTING
            i_object_type = 'CLAS' " Class
            i_object_name = iv_class_name
          IMPORTING
            et_attributes = lt_ci_attributes
        ).

        LOOP AT lt_ci_attributes INTO ls_attribute.
          " Filter for public attributes (visibility '0')
          IF ls_attribute-visibility = '0'.
            ls_info-name = ls_attribute-attribute_name.
            ls_info-type = ls_attribute-type_name.
            ls_info-visibility = 'Public'.
            APPEND ls_info TO rt_attributes.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_ci_error INTO DATA(lx_ci_error).
        " Handle CI specific errors, e.g., class not found
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_ci_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_public_attributes FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_non_existent_class FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_public_attributes.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_ci_attribute_reader( ).
    DATA(lt_attributes) = lo_reader->get_class_attributes( 'ZCL_TEST_WITH_PUBLIC_ATTR' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_attributes
      msg = 'Should find public attributes for ZCL_TEST_WITH_PUBLIC_ATTR'
    ).

    DATA(lv_found_string_attr) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_found_int_attr) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_attributes INTO DATA(ls_attr).
      IF ls_attr-name = 'MV_PUBLIC_STRING' AND ls_attr-type = 'STRING' AND ls_attr-visibility = 'Public'.
        lv_found_string_attr = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_attr-name = 'MV_PUBLIC_INT' AND ls_attr-type = 'I' AND ls_attr-visibility = 'Public'.
        lv_found_int_attr = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_string_attr msg = 'Public string attribute not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_found_int_attr msg = 'Public integer attribute not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_attributes ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected exactly 2 public attributes' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existent_class.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_ci_attribute_reader( ).
    TRY.
        lo_reader->get_class_attributes( 'Z_NON_EXISTENT_CLASS' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected cx_sy_dyn_call_error for non-existent class' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Klasse `cl_ci_query_attributes` verwendet werden kann, um Metadaten über ABAP-Klassen zur Laufzeit abzufragen. Obwohl primär für den Code Inspector gedacht, demonstriert es die Fähigkeit zur dynamischen Code-Analyse, indem es öffentliche Attribute einer Klasse identifiziert. Die moderne Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` ist ebenfalls integriert.
keywords: cl_ci_query_attributes, RTTI, Reflection, Dynamic Programming, Attributes

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer, Abflugort und Zielort aus der sflights-Tabelle enthält, und benennen Sie die Spalten um. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR und VALUE mit der Komponenten-Syntax für die Feldzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        flight_id TYPE s_flt_id,
        departure TYPE s_from_cit,
        destination TYPE s_to_city,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fromcity, tocity
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                            ( flight_id   = ls_sflight-carrid && '-' && ls_sflight-connid,
                              departure   = ls_sflight-fromcity,
                              destination = ls_sflight-tocity ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_transformer) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_transformer->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_summaries
      msg = 'Summary table should not be empty'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_summary) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_summary-flight_id
        msg = 'Flight ID should be populated'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_summary-departure
        msg = 'Departure city should be populated'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = ls_summary-destination
        msg = 'Destination city should be populated'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `FOR` und `VALUE` ermöglichen eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht. String-Templates (`&&`) werden für die einfache Verkettung von Fluggesellschafts- und Flugnummer verwendet.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, sflights, String Templates

  PUBLIC SECTION.

      IMPORTING

  METHOD format_flight_status.
    rv_status_message = |Flug { iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid } ist { 
                          COND string(

                            ELSE 'planmäßig.'
                          )

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Das Beispiel soll eine Methode ohne Parameter und eine mit einem String-Parameter unterstützen.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI (cl_abap_classdescr) und CALL METHOD mit PARAMETER-TABLE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_invoker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS invoke_method_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL " Example for a single string parameter
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_invoker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD invoke_method_dynamically.
    DATA lo_class_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_classdescr.
    DATA lo_method_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_methdescr.
    DATA lt_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab.
    DATA ls_parameter LIKE LINE OF lt_parameters.

    TRY.
        lo_class_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ).
        lo_method_descr ?= lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ).

        IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED.
          " Assuming the first parameter is the one to be passed
          IF lines( lo_method_descr->parameters ) > 0.
            ls_parameter-name = lo_method_descr->parameters[ 1 ]-name.
            ls_parameter-kind = cl_abap_parmbind=>importing.
            ls_parameter-value = REF #( iv_param_value ).
            APPEND ls_parameter TO lt_parameters.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_parameters
          RECEIVING
            result = rv_result. " Assuming method returns a string
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_dyn_call_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_abap_class_not_found INTO DATA(lx_class_not_found).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_class_not_found->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_abap_not_a_class INTO DATA(lx_not_a_class).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_not_a_class->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flugdaten aus sflights nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie die Gesamtzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie die moderne LOOP AT ... GROUP BY Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY mit GROUP SIZE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
      tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING
                                               INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_counts.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = lo_grouper->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_flight_counts
      msg = 'Flight counts table should not be empty'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_count-flight_count > 0
        msg = 'LH should have more than 0 flights' 
      ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'LH carrier not found in grouped data' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Erweiterung für `LOOP AT` ermöglicht eine effiziente und lesbare Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen, ohne manuelle Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, was Aggregationen vereinfacht.
keywords: GROUP BY, LOOP AT, Internal Tables, sflights, Aggregation

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der belegten Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der sflights-Tabelle. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_average_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_seats) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_analyzer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupied_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT seatsocc FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_average_seats = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc
    ).

    rv_average_seats = lv_total_seats / lines( lt_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_average_seats_existing_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_average_seats_non_existing_carrier FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_average_seats_existing_carrier.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_analyzer->get_average_occupied_seats( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_average >= 0
      msg = 'Average seats should be non-negative'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_average <= 500 " Assuming max seats is around 500 for sflight
      msg = 'Average seats should be within reasonable range'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_average_seats_non_existing_carrier.
    DATA(lo_analyzer) = NEW zcl_flight_analyzer( ).
    DATA(lv_average) = lo_analyzer->get_average_occupied_seats( 'XX' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_average
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Average seats for non-existing carrier should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und funktionale Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Summe der belegten Sitze zu berechnen, gefolgt von einer einfachen Division zur Ermittlung des Durchschnitts. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit Akkumulatoren.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Math, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Interface mit zwei Klassen, die es implementieren. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Instanziierung und den Aufruf der Methoden.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface und zwei Klassen, die es implementieren. Verwenden Sie NEW für die Instanziierung.

INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log_message
    IMPORTING
      iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to console/sy-list
    " For demonstration, we just store it or simulate output.
    " cl_demo_output=>display( iv_message ). " Requires cl_demo_output
    WRITE: / 'Console Log:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_logger~log_message.
    " In a real scenario, this would write to a file
    " For demonstration, we just store it or simulate output.
    WRITE: / 'File Log:', iv_message.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_logger_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS get_logger
      IMPORTING
        iv_logger_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_logger) TYPE REF TO zif_logger
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_logger.
    CASE iv_logger_type.
      WHEN 'CONSOLE'.
        ro_logger = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie das Datum, das 30 Tage in der Zukunft liegt, ausgehend vom aktuellen Systemdatum. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode ADD_DAYS der Klasse cl_abap_tstmp.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_date_in_future
      IMPORTING
        iv_days TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_future_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_in_future.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>systemtstmp_to_utclong(
                            systemtstmp = cl_abap_tstmp=>get_system_timestamp( )
                          ).
    DATA(lv_future_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add_days(
                                  utclong = lv_timestamp
                                  days    = iv_days
                                ).
    rv_future_date = cl_abap_tstmp=>utclong_to_date(
                       utclong = lv_future_timestamp
                     ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie die sflights-Tabelle nach Flügen einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und mit einer Mindestanzahl belegter Sitze. Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_seats TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND
                                          seatsocc >= iv_min_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_filter_no_matching_data FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_existing_data.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seats = 100 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_filtered

    ).

    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-seatsocc >= 100 msg = 'Seats occupied less than minimum' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_matching_data.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_seats = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_filtered
      msg = 'Filtered table should be empty for non-existing carrier'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten Schleifen mit `CHECK` oder `DELETE` und führt zu kompakterem und besser lesbarem Code.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, sflights, Data Selection

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch den Typ eines beliebigen Datenobjekts zur Laufzeit und geben Sie dessen Typnamen zurück. Nutzen Sie RTTI.
hint: Verwenden Sie cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data.
solution:
CLASS zcl_type_inspector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        ir_data TYPE REF TO data

CLASS zcl_type_inspector IMPLEMENTATION.

        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_rtti_error

            text = lx_rtti_error->get_text( ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die von 'LH' durchgeführt werden und deren maximale Kapazität über 200 liegt. Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den Flugnummern und der maximalen Kapazität.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `WHERE` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_for_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             max_seats TYPE s_maxseats,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_for_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND seatsmax > 200 )
                          ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid, max_seats = flight-seatsmax ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_for_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

    " This test assumes there are 'LH' flights with more than 200 seats in sflights.
    " Adjust assertions based on actual data or mock sflights for robust testing.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'LH' ). " Check first entry
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_result[1]-max_seats > 200 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression ermöglicht das Filtern und Transformieren von internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. `VALUE #(...)` wird verwendet, um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren, wobei `WHERE` die Filterbedingung definiert. Dies ersetzt explizite `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit `APPEND` und `IF`.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, WHERE, Internal Tables, LOOP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der alle Flugnummern der Fluggesellschaft 'AA' aus der Tabelle `sflights` als kommaseparierte Liste enthält. Jeder Eintrag soll das Format 'Flug: [Flugnummer]' haben.
hint: Nutzen Sie `STRING_TEMPLATE` in Kombination mit einer `REDUCE`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_template_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_flight_list_string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_flight_list) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_list_string.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_flight_list = |{ REDUCE string( INIT s = ''
                                          FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = 'AA' )
                                          NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |Flug: { flight-connid }|
                                                               ELSE |{ s }, Flug: { flight-connid }| ) ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_string_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_template_for( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_list_string( ).

    " This test assumes some 'AA' flights exist in sflights.
    " For example, if 'AA' has connid '0017' and '0400', expected would be 'Flug: 0017, Flug: 0400'.
    " Adjust assertions based on actual data or mock sflights for robust testing.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Flug: ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression wird hier verwendet, um eine Liste von Flugnummern in einem `STRING_TEMPLATE` zu einer einzigen, kommaseparierten Zeichenkette zu aggregieren. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art, Schleifen für die String-Konkatenation zu vermeiden.
keywords: STRING_TEMPLATE, REDUCE, FOR, LOOP, String Processing

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der freien Sitze (seatsmax - seatsocc) für alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'DL' in der Tabelle `sflights`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Summe zu bilden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fnc_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_total_free_seats
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id DEFAULT 'DL'
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_free_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fnc_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_free_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_free_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ( flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_sum_free_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_free_seats.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_fnc_reduce_sum( ).
    " Mock data for 'AA':
    " Flight 1: seatsmax=100, seatsocc=50 (free=50)
    " Flight 2: seatsmax=200, seatsocc=100 (free=100)
    " Expected total free seats for 'AA' = 150.
    " Adjust 'exp' based on actual sflights data or mock sflights for robust testing.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_free_seats( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 150 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Expression ist ein leistungsstarkes Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Sie ersetzt explizite `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit einer Akkumulator-Variablen und ermöglicht eine funktionale Programmierung.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, LOOP, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie das Start- und Enddatum des aktuellen Geschäftsjahres für eine gegebene Buchungskreis- und Geschäftsjahresvariante. Verwenden Sie die Klasse `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `GET_PERIOD_DATES` der Klasse `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_toolset DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_dates,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_period_dates.

    METHODS get_fiscal_year_dates
      IMPORTING iv_bukrs TYPE bukrs
                iv_periv TYPE periv
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_period_dates) TYPE ty_period_dates
      RAISING   cx_bs_period_toolset.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_toolset IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_fiscal_year_dates.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_fiscal_year) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_fiscal_year(
                                  iv_date  = lv_current_date
                                  iv_bukrs = iv_bukrs
                                  iv_periv = iv_periv ).

    cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_dates(
      EXPORTING
        iv_bukrs        = iv_bukrs
        iv_periv        = iv_periv
        iv_fiscal_year  = lv_fiscal_year
        iv_period       = '001' " First period of the fiscal year
      IMPORTING
        ev_start_date   = rs_period_dates-start_date
        ev_end_date     = DATA(lv_dummy_end_date_p1) " Dummy for first period end
    ).

    " Determine the number of periods for the given fiscal year variant
    DATA(lv_num_periods) = cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_number_of_periods(
                                  iv_bukrs = iv_bukrs
                                  iv_periv = iv_periv
                                  iv_fiscal_year = lv_fiscal_year ).

    cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_period_dates(
      EXPORTING
        iv_bukrs        = iv_bukrs
        iv_periv        = iv_periv
        iv_fiscal_year  = lv_fiscal_year
        iv_period       = |{ lv_num_periods ALPHA = OUT }| " Last period of the fiscal year
      IMPORTING
        ev_start_date   = DATA(lv_dummy_start_date_pn) " Dummy for last period start
        ev_end_date     = rs_period_dates-end_date
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_fiscal_year_dates FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fiscal_year_dates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_period_toolset( ).
    DATA ls_dates TYPE zcl_period_toolset=>ty_period_dates.

    " This test depends on system configuration for fiscal year variants.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die von 'UA' durchgeführt werden und deren Flugdatum nach dem 1. Januar 2025 liegt. Geben Sie nur die Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zurück.

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,

CLASS zcl_itb_filter_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_filter_date) = '20250101'.

    DATA(lt_filtered_raw) = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = 'UA' AND flDATE > lv_filter_date ).

    " Transform to desired output structure
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_filtered_raw ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid ) ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der maximalen Sitzplätze (`seatsmax`).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count  TYPE i,
             total_max_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
                            ( carrid        = flight-carrid,
                              flight_count  = GROUP SIZE,
                              total_max_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsmax ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_group_by( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    " This test assumes specific data in sflights.
    " For example, if 'AA' has 2 flights with seatsmax 100 and 200.
    " Expected: carrid='AA', flight_count=2, total_max_seats=300.
    " Adjust 'exp' based on actual sflights data or mock sflights for robust testing.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result ).
    DATA(ls_aa_summary) = lt_result[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_summary-total_max_seats exp = 300 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression mit `GROUP BY` ist eine sehr mächtige Funktion in ABAP 7.55, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Sie ersetzt komplexe `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit `AT NEW`/`AT END OF` und temporären Variablen durch eine deklarative Syntax.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, LOOP, Aggregation

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' in der Tabelle `sflights` und erhöhen Sie die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität (`seatsmax`) um 10% direkt in der Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>)` für die In-Place-Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itb_loop_fs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS increase_lh_seats
      CHANGING ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itb_loop_fs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_lh_seats.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      <fs_flight>-seatsmax = <fs_flight>-seatsmax * '1.1'.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_increase_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    " Mock some data
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_mock>).
    <fs_mock>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_mock>-connid = '001'.
    <fs_mock>-seatsmax = 100.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_mock>.
    <fs_mock>-carrid = 'AA'.
    <fs_mock>-connid = '002'.
    <fs_mock>-seatsmax = 200.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_mock>.
    <fs_mock>-carrid = 'LH'.
    <fs_mock>-connid = '003'.
    <fs_mock>-seatsmax = 50.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itb_loop_fs( ).
    lo_cut->increase_lh_seats( CHANGING ct_sflights = lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' ]-seatsmax exp = 110 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' ]-seatsmax exp = 200 ). " Unchanged
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sflights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' ]-seatsmax exp = 55 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs>)` Syntax ist die effizienteste Methode, um interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen und deren Inhalte direkt zu modifizieren. Sie vermeidet das Kopieren von Daten in eine Workarea und das anschließende `MODIFY` der Tabelle, was zu einer besseren Performance führt.
keywords: LOOP, FIELD-SYMBOL, Internal Tables, In-place modification

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Auslastung (seatsocc / seatsmax) aller Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'SQ' und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf die nächste ganze Zahl auf (als Prozentwert).
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Summe und `CEIL` für das Aufrunden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_ceil_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_avg_occupancy_rounded
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id DEFAULT 'SQ'
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_occupancy) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_ceil_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupancy_rounded.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lv_total_occupancy_ratio) = REDUCE f( INIT sum_ratio = 0.0
                                                   FOR flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax > 0 )
                                                   NEXT sum_ratio = sum_ratio + ( CONV f( flight-seatsocc ) / flight-seatsmax ) ).

    DATA(lv_flight_count) = lines( FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax > 0 ) ) ).

    IF lv_flight_count > 0.
      rv_avg_occupancy = CEIL( lv_total_occupancy_ratio / lv_flight_count * 100 ). " Percentage and round up
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_occupancy = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_avg_occupancy FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_ceil_reduce( ).
    " Mock data for 'SQ':
    " Flight 1: seatsocc=51, seatsmax=100 (ratio=0.51)
    " Flight 2: seatsocc=70, seatsmax=100 (ratio=0.70)
    " Total ratio = 1.21, Count = 2, Avg ratio = 0.605 -> 60.5% -> CEIL(60.5) = 61.
    " Adjust 'exp' based on actual sflights data or mock sflights for robust testing.
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_occupancy_rounded( iv_carrid = 'SQ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 61 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_ceil_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_avg_occupancy_rounded( iv_carrid = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und mathematischen Funktionen wie `CEIL` ermöglicht komplexe Berechnungen in einer sehr kompakten und lesbaren Form. Die Verwendung von `CONV f` stellt sicher, dass die Division als Gleitkommaoperation durchgeführt wird, um präzise Ergebnisse zu erhalten, bevor aufgerundet wird.
keywords: REDUCE, CEIL, Math, Aggregation, LOOP

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aus der Tabelle `sflights`, die die höchste durchschnittliche Auslastung (seatsocc / seatsmax) über alle ihre Flüge hinweg hat. Geben Sie die Fluggesellschaft und ihre durchschnittliche Auslastung (gerundet auf ganze Zahl) zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR GROUPS OF` mit `REDUCE` und anschließend eine weitere `REDUCE`-Expression, um das Maximum zu finden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_max_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_avg_occupancy,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_occupancy TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_avg_occupancy.

    METHODS get_carrier_highest_avg_occ
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_result) TYPE ty_carr_avg_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_grp_reduce_max_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_highest_avg_occ.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_temp_data,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_ratio  TYPE f,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_temp_data.
    TYPES tt_carr_temp_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_temp_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = VALUE tt_carr_temp_data(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights BY flight-carrid
      ( carrid       = flight-carrid,
        total_ratio  = REDUCE f( INIT sum_ratio = 0.0
                                 FOR member IN GROUP WHERE ( member-seatsmax > 0 )
                                 NEXT sum_ratio = sum_ratio + ( CONV f( member-seatsocc ) / member-seatsmax ) ),
        flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0
                                 FOR member IN GROUP WHERE ( member-seatsmax > 0 )
                                 NEXT count = count + 1 ) ) ).

    DATA(lt_avg_occupancies) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_avg_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY (
      FOR group_data IN lt_grouped_data
      LET avg_occ_f = COND f( WHEN group_data-flight_count > 0 THEN group_data-total_ratio / group_data-flight_count * 100 ELSE 0.0 ) IN
      ( carrid = group_data-carrid,
        avg_occupancy = CEIL( avg_occ_f ) ) ).

    rs_result = REDUCE ty_carr_avg_occupancy( INIT max_carr = VALUE ty_carr_avg_occupancy( )
                                              FOR carrier_occ IN lt_avg_occupancies
                                              WHERE ( carrier_occ-avg_occupancy > max_carr-avg_occupancy )
                                              NEXT max_carr = carrier_occ ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_highest_avg_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_highest_avg_occupancy.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_grp_reduce_max_avg( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_highest_avg_occ( ).

    " This test is highly dependent on sflights data.
    " For example, if 'LH' has the highest average occupancy of 75%.
    " Adjust 'exp' based on actual sflights data or mock sflights for robust testing.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_result-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_result-avg_occupancy ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-avg_occupancy exp = 75 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `FOR GROUPS OF` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` für mehrstufige Aggregationen. Zuerst werden die Daten pro Fluggesellschaft aggregiert, um die durchschnittliche Auslastung zu berechnen. Anschließend wird eine weitere `REDUCE`-Expression verwendet, um die Fluggesellschaft mit dem höchsten Durchschnitt zu finden. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und leistungsstarke Methode zur Datenanalyse in ABAP.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Aggregation, LOOP, Functional Programming

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Datentyp des Feldes `carrid` der Struktur `sflights` zur Laufzeit und geben Sie dessen interne Länge zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie die RTTI-Klassen, insbesondere `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS get_field_length
      IMPORTING iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_length) TYPE i
      RAISING   cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_field_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_length.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_component>) WHERE name = iv_field_name.
      DATA(lo_elem_descr) = CAST cl_abap_elemdescr( <fs_component>-type ).
      rv_length = lo_elem_descr->length.
      RETURN.
    ENDLOOP.

    " If field not found, raise an error
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_struct_descr_error
      EXPORTING
        text = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found in structure SFLIGHTS.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_existing_field FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_non_existing_field FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_existing_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_type( ).
    DATA(lv_length) = lo_cut->get_field_length( 'CARRID' ).
    " S_CARR_ID is CHAR3, so length is 3
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_length exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_field_type( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_field_length( 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception was not raised.' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_error->get_text( ) exp = 'not found' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: RTTI (Run-Time Type Information) ermöglicht die Analyse von Datentypen zur Laufzeit. Die Klassen `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR` und `CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR` sind zentrale Bestandteile, um Informationen über Strukturen und deren Komponenten zu erhalten. Dies ist nützlich für generische Programme oder Frameworks, die dynamisch mit Datenstrukturen umgehen müssen. Die `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` Syntax wird hier verwendet, um effizient durch die Komponenten zu iterieren.
keywords: RTTI, CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR, CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR, CL_ABAP_ELEMDESCR, Dynamic Programming, LOOP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme `ZCX_INVALID_INPUT`. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die diese Ausnahme auslöst, wenn eine Eingabezahl negativ ist, und fangen Sie die Ausnahme in einer aufrufenden Methode ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CLASS ... INHERITING FROM CX_STATIC_CHECK` für die Ausnahme und `TRY ... CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    INTERFACES if_abap_behv_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    METHODS process_number
      IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i
      RAISING   zcx_invalid_input.

    METHODS handle_number_processing
      IMPORTING iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_number.
    IF iv_number < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_input=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    " Simulate some processing
    " ...
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_number_processing.
    TRY.
        process_number( iv_number = iv_number ).
        rv_message = |Number { iv_number } processed successfully.|.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input INTO DATA(lx_invalid_input).
        rv_message = |Error: { lx_invalid_input->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 10 (inklusive).
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT in Kombination mit einer Schleife und einer Hash-Tabelle, um Einzigartigkeit zu gewährleisten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_unique_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_random_list
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_min   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max   TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_unique_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_list.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_temp_numbers) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    IF iv_count > ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ).
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
    ENDIF.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_num) = lo_random->get_next_in_range( ip_low = iv_min ip_high = iv_max ).
      TRY.
          INSERT lv_random_num INTO TABLE lt_temp_numbers.
        CATCH cx_sy_table_line_exists.
          SY-INDEX = SY-INDEX - 1.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDDO.

    rt_unique_numbers = VALUE #( FOR num IN lt_temp_numbers ( num ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_unique_random_list FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_parameters FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_random_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_list( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_list( iv_count = 3 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 3 ).
    DATA(lt_unique_check) TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      INSERT lv_num INTO TABLE lt_unique_check.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_unique_check ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_parameters.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_unique_list( ).
    lo_cut->get_unique_random_list( iv_count = 10 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception CX_ABAP_INVALID_PARAMETER was expected.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert CL_ABAP_RANDOM_FLOAT mit einer Hash-Tabelle und einer Schleife, um eine bestimmte Anzahl eindeutiger Zufallszahlen zu generieren. hint: Generieren Sie einen Zufallsindex im Bereich der Tabellenzeilen und verwenden Sie den Tabellenindexzugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_list_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_element
      IMPORTING
        it_list TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_selected_element) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_list_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_element.
    IF it_list IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_parameter EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_invalid_parameter=>cx_abap_invalid_parameter.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_list_size) = lines( it_list ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next_in_range( ip_low = 1 ip_high = lv_list_size ).

    READ TABLE it_list INDEX lv_random_index INTO rv_selected_element.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_random_element.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_list_selection( ).
    DATA(lt_test_list) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'Cherry' ) ).
    DATA(lv_selected) = lo_cut->get_random_element( it_list = lt_test_list ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Selected element should not be initial' act = lv_selected exp = '' ).
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_test_list INTO DATA(lv_item).

      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = lv_found msg = 'Selected element must be from the list' ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_list_selection( ).
    DATA(lt_empty_list) TYPE string_table.
    lo_cut->get_random_element( it_list = lt_empty_list ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception CX_ABAP_INVALID_PARAMETER was expected.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_randoms
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i
        iv_min   TYPE i
        iv_max   TYPE i
        iv_filter_low TYPE i
        iv_filter_high TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_randoms.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lt_all_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      APPEND lo_random->get_next_in_range( ip_low = iv_min ip_high = iv_max ) TO lt_all_numbers.
    ENDDO.

    rt_filtered_numbers = FILTER #( lt_all_numbers WHERE table_line >= iv_filter_low AND table_line <= iv_filter_high ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Größe des Frontend-Fensters (Breite und Höhe) in Pixeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode CL_GUI_CFW=>GET_FRONTEND_SIZE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cfw_get_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_frontend_size
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE string OPTIONAL
      EXPORTING
        ev_width          TYPE i
        ev_height         TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_gui_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cfw_get_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_frontend_size.
    IF cl_gui_cfw=>is_gui_on( ) = abap_true.
      TRY.
          cl_gui_cfw=>get_frontend_size(
            EXPORTING
              container_name = iv_container_name
            IMPORTING
              width          = ev_width
              height         = ev_height
          ).
          cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
        CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_exception).
          RAISE EXCEPTION lx_gui_exception.
        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root_exception).
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_gui_exception EXPORTING text = lx_root_exception->get_text( ).
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " In non-GUI environment, return default or raise exception
      ev_width = 0.
      ev_height = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_frontend_size FOR TESTING RAISING cx_gui_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_frontend_size.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cfw_get_size( ).
    DATA: lv_width TYPE i, lv_height TYPE i.

    IF cl_gui_cfw=>is_gui_on( ) = abap_true.
      " This part would run in a GUI environment
      TRY.
          lo_cut->get_frontend_size( EXPORTING iv_container_name = '' IMPORTING ev_width = lv_width ev_height = lv_height ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lv_width > 0 AND lv_height > 0 ) ).
        CATCH cx_gui_exception.
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception occurred in GUI environment.' ).
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " This part runs in a non-GUI environment (like ABAP Unit)
      lo_cut->get_frontend_size( EXPORTING iv_container_name = '' IMPORTING ev_width = lv_width ev_height = lv_height ).

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen asynchronen Aufruf an das Frontend aus, ohne auf eine sofortige Antwort zu warten.

CLASS zcl_cfw_async_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cfw_async_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_async_message.
    IF cl_gui_cfw=>is_gui_on( ) = abap_true.
      TRY.
          " This is a conceptual example. In a real scenario, you'd call a method
          " of a specific GUI control (e.g., a custom control) asynchronously.
          " For simplicity, we simulate an asynchronous 'message' display.
          cl_gui_cfw=>call_method_as_procedure(
            EXPORTING
              program = sy-repid
              dynpro  = sy-dynnr
              method  = 'DISPLAY_MESSAGE_ASYNC'
              parameter_list = VALUE cl_gui_cfw=>parameters(
                ( name = 'IV_MESSAGE' value = iv_message )
              )
          ).
          cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
        CATCH cx_gui_exception INTO DATA(lx_gui_exception).
          MESSAGE lx_gui_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root_exception).
          MESSAGE lx_root_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deklarieren Sie eine SORTED TABLE vom Typ SFLIGHT und füllen Sie diese mit Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle SFLIGHT. Die Tabelle soll nach CARRID und CONNID sortiert sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TYPES` und `DATA` mit `SORTED TABLE OF` und `SELECT INTO TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_sorted_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sorted_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sorted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sorted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_demo( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sorted_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Table should not be empty' act = lines( lt_flights ) > 0 ).
    " Check if sorted property is maintained (implicitly by ABAP)
    DATA lv_prev_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA lv_prev_connid TYPE sflight-connid.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix > 1.
        IF ls_flight-carrid < lv_prev_carrid OR ( ls_flight-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_flight-connid < lv_prev_connid ).
          cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Table is not sorted correctly' ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_flight-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Deklaration einer `SORTED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` stellt sicher, dass die Tabelle immer nach den angegebenen Schlüsselfeldern sortiert ist und keine doppelten Einträge für den Schlüssel zulässt. Das Füllen mittels `SELECT INTO TABLE` ist effizient, da die Datenbank die Sortierung übernimmt, bevor die Daten in die interne Tabelle geladen werden.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, Internal Tables, Declaration, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen spezifischen Eintrag aus einer SORTED TABLE basierend auf CARRID und CONNID. Demonstrieren Sie die Effizienz durch implizite binäre Suche.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE` mit `WITH KEY` auf einer `SORTED TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS read_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flight.
    READ TABLE it_flights INTO rs_flight WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_read( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_read=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = '200' )
    ).

    DATA(ls_found_flight) = lo_cut->read_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0401' it_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Flight LH 0401 not found' act = ls_found_flight-connid exp = '0401' ).

    DATA(ls_not_found_flight) = lo_cut->read_flight( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0001' it_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Non-existent flight found' act = ls_not_found_flight-carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `READ TABLE` Statement auf einer `SORTED TABLE` mit Angabe der Schlüssel nutzt automatisch eine binäre Suche, was die Performance bei großen Tabellen erheblich verbessert, da die Zugriffszeit logarithmisch zur Tabellengröße ist (O(log n)).
keywords: SORTED TABLE, READ TABLE, Binary Search, Internal Tables

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine SORTED TABLE nach einem bestimmten Kriterium (z.B. alle Flüge eines Carriers) und erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den Ergebnissen unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck mit `WHERE` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_standard.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_filter=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = '200' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of filtered flights' act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First flight carrier incorrect' act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second flight carrier incorrect' act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR` Ausdruck in Kombination mit der `WHERE` Bedingung ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Filterung von internen Tabellen. Dies ist ein Beispiel für funktionale Programmierung in modernem ABAP, das die Notwendigkeit expliziter `LOOP`s reduziert.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Entfernen Sie direkt aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate aus einer SORTED TABLE basierend auf dem Schlüssel CARRID.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_dedup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_simple.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS remove_adjacent_duplicates
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_dedup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_adjacent_duplicates.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ct_flights COMPARING carrid.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_dedup( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_dedup=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0011' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' )
    ).

    lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of entries after deduplication' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 ).
    " Note: DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES COMPARING carrid would only remove if connid was also the same.
    " For a sorted table with UNIQUE KEY carrid connid, adjacent duplicates on CARRID alone are not possible unless CONNID also matches.
    " The example demonstrates the syntax, but for this specific table type, it might not change anything unless the key was different.
    " Let's adjust the test data to make it more meaningful for 'COMPARING carrid' if the table was not unique on connid.
    " Re-thinking: A SORTED TABLE with UNIQUE KEY carrid connid cannot have adjacent duplicates on carrid alone if connid differs.
    " To properly demonstrate, the table type should be STANDARD TABLE or SORTED TABLE with NON-UNIQUE KEY.
    " Let's change the table type to STANDARD TABLE for this example to make DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES COMPARING more effective.

    TYPES: tt_sflight_standard_non_unique TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_simple WITH NON-UNIQUE SORTED KEY carrid_key COMPONENTS carrid.
    DATA(lt_flights_non_unique) = VALUE tt_sflight_standard_non_unique(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ) " Duplicate
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' )
    ).
    SORT lt_flights_non_unique BY carrid.
    lo_cut->remove_adjacent_duplicates( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights_non_unique ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of entries after deduplication (non-unique)' act = lines( lt_flights_non_unique ) exp = 4 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Statement `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ... COMPARING ...` entfernt aufeinanderfolgende Zeilen, die in den angegebenen Feldern identisch sind. Es ist besonders effizient auf bereits sortierten Tabellen. Für `SORTED TABLE`s mit `UNIQUE KEY` ist die Anwendung auf den Schlüssel redundant, aber für `NON-UNIQUE KEY` oder `STANDARD TABLE`s nach vorheriger Sortierung sehr nützlich.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, Internal Tables, Deduplication

Instructions: Modifizieren Sie den Preis eines spezifischen Fluges in einer SORTED TABLE.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE` mit `INDEX` oder `TRANSPORTING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS modify_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_price.
    DATA ls_flight_to_modify TYPE ty_sflight.
    READ TABLE ct_flights INTO ls_flight_to_modify WITH KEY carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      ls_flight_to_modify-price = iv_new_price.
      MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM ls_flight_to_modify.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_flight_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_flight_price.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_modify=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = '200' )
    ).

    lo_cut->modify_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_new_price = '120' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    DATA(ls_modified_flight) = lt_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Price not modified correctly' act = ls_modified_flight-price exp = '120' ).

    lo_cut->modify_flight_price( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_new_price = '500' CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Table size changed for non-existent flight' act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das `MODIFY TABLE` Statement aktualisiert einen Eintrag in der internen Tabelle. In Kombination mit `READ TABLE` auf einer `SORTED TABLE` ist dies ein effizienter Weg, um gezielte Änderungen vorzunehmen, da der Lesezugriff durch die Sortierung optimiert ist.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, MODIFY TABLE, Internal Tables, Update

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie ein einfaches XML-Dokument mit einem Root-Element und einem Kind-Element unter Verwendung von `cl_sec_sxml_writer`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE` für den Writer, `OPEN_ELEMENT`, `WRITE_VALUE` und `CLOSE_ELEMENT`.

CLASS zcl_sxml_basic_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_simple_xml RETURNING VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_basic_writer IMPLEMENTATION.

      if_sxml_writer=>co_intf_ixml
    ).
    DATA(lo_sxml_string_writer) = cl_abap_sxml_string_writer=>create( ).
    lo_sxml_writer->set_output( lo_sxml_string_writer ).

    lo_sxml_writer->open_element( 'RootElement' ).
    lo_sxml_writer->open_element( 'ChildElement' ).
    lo_sxml_writer->write_value( 'Hello SXML' ).
    lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ).
    lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ).

    rv_xml_string = lo_sxml_string_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_simple_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sxml_basic_writer( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_cut->generate_simple_xml( ).

Die Verwendung von `cl_abap_sxml_string_writer` als Output-Stream ermöglicht das Schreiben des XML direkt in einen String, was für viele Anwendungsfälle praktisch ist.

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle (SFLIGHT) in ein XML-Format mit `cl_sec_sxml_writer`. Jeder Flug soll ein 'Flight'-Element mit Attributen für CARRID und CONNID sowie Kind-Elementen für FLDATE und PRICE sein.
hint: Schleife über die Tabelle und für jeden Eintrag Elemente und Attribute hinzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_table_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_standard TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS generate_flights_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_standard
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_table_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_flights_xml.
    DATA(lo_sxml_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create(
      if_sxml_writer=>co_intf_ixml
    ).
    DATA(lo_sxml_string_writer) = cl_abap_sxml_string_writer=>create( ).
    lo_sxml_writer->set_output( lo_sxml_string_writer ).

    lo_sxml_writer->open_element( 'Flights' ).
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_sxml_writer->open_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_sxml_writer->add_attribute( name = 'Carrid' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_sxml_writer->add_attribute( name = 'Connid' value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_sxml_writer->open_element( 'FlightDate' ).
      lo_sxml_writer->write_value( ls_flight-fldate ).
      lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ).
      lo_sxml_writer->open_element( 'Price' ).
      lo_sxml_writer->write_value( ls_flight-price ).
      lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ).
      lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flight
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flights

    rv_xml_string = lo_sxml_string_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS zcl_sxml_namespace_writer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_sxml_namespace_writer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_namespaced_xml.
    DATA(lo_sxml_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create(
      if_sxml_writer=>co_intf_ixml
    ).
    DATA(lo_sxml_string_writer) = cl_abap_sxml_string_writer=>create( ).
    lo_sxml_writer->set_output( lo_sxml_string_writer ).

    lo_sxml_writer->open_element( name = 'Root' namespace = 'http://example.com/root' ).
    lo_sxml_writer->add_namespace( prefix = 'ns' uri = 'http://example.com/child' ).
    lo_sxml_writer->open_element( name = 'ns:Child' ).
    lo_sxml_writer->write_value( 'Namespaced Content' ).
    lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ).
    lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ).

    rv_xml_string = lo_sxml_string_writer->get_output( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Fehlerbehandlung beim Schreiben von XML mit `cl_sec_sxml_writer`, indem Sie versuchen, ein ungültiges XML zu erzeugen (z.B. ein Element nicht schließen) und die entsprechende Ausnahme abfangen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke für Ausnahmen wie `CX_SXML_ERROR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sxml_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_error_handling RETURNING VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sxml_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_error_handling.
    DATA(lo_sxml_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create(
      if_sxml_writer=>co_intf_ixml
    ).
    DATA(lo_sxml_string_writer) = cl_abap_sxml_string_writer=>create( ).
    lo_sxml_writer->set_output( lo_sxml_string_writer ).

    TRY.
        lo_sxml_writer->open_element( 'Root' ).
        lo_sxml_writer->open_element( 'Child' ).
        " Intentionally not closing 'Child' element to provoke an error
        " lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ).
        lo_sxml_writer->close_element( ). " This will try to close 'Root' while 'Child' is still open

        lo_sxml_string_writer->get_output( ).

      CATCH cx_sxml_error INTO DATA(lx_sxml_error).
        rv_error_message = lx_sxml_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie Daten aus einer SORTED TABLE (SFLIGHT) nach CARRID und berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise für jeden Carrier unter Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `SUM`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_total,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_price TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_carrier_total.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_totals TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_total WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_totals
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_totals) TYPE tt_carrier_totals.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_totals.
    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_sum_price) = VALUE sflight-price( FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_group_key ( <fs_group_member>-price ) ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_total( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid total_price = lv_sum_price ) TO rt_carrier_totals.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_totals FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_totals.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_group( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_group=>tt_sflight_sorted(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0011' price = '250.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_totals) = lo_cut->get_carrier_totals( it_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Incorrect number of carrier totals' act = lines( lt_totals ) exp = 2 ).
    DATA(ls_lh_total) = lt_totals[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'LH total price incorrect' act = ls_lh_total-total_price exp = '250.00' ).
    DATA(ls_ua_total) = lt_totals[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'UA total price incorrect' act = ls_ua_total-total_price exp = '450.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax in ABAP 7.50 ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck für die Summenbildung können komplexe Gruppierungs- und Aggregationsaufgaben sehr kompakt gelöst werden.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation, Internal Tables, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue SORTED TABLE, indem Sie eine bestehende SORTED TABLE filtern und die Ergebnisse in eine neue Tabelle kopieren, unter Verwendung von `FILTER`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FILTER` Operator für interne Tabellen.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter_op DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_filter_op IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_date.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_flights WHERE fldate = iv_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
