      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' )
    ).

        iv_month TYPE i
      RETURNING

Instructions: Lesen Sie Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und kategorisieren Sie die Flugdauer in 'Kurz' (<= 120 Min), 'Mittel' (> 120 Min und <= 300 Min) oder 'Lang' (> 300 Min) direkt im `SELECT`-Statement.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE WHEN` innerhalb des `SELECT`-Statements für die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_duration_cat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_duration,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             fltime     TYPE s_fltime,
             deptime    TYPE s_deptime,
             arrtime    TYPE s_arrtime,
             duration_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_duration.

    METHODS get_categorized_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_duration WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_duration_cat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_categorized_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltime, deptime, arrtime,
           CASE WHEN fltime <= 120 THEN 'Kurz'
                WHEN fltime > 120 AND fltime <= 300 THEN 'Mittel'
                WHEN fltime > 300 THEN 'Lang'
                ELSE 'Unbekannt'
           END AS duration_category
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO 10 ROWS. " Limit for example
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_categorized_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_categorized_flights.
    DATA(lo_flights) = NEW zcl_flight_duration_cat( ).
    DATA(lt_categorized_flights) = lo_flights->get_categorized_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights found' act = lines( lt_categorized_flights ) ). " Check if any flights are returned

    LOOP AT lt_categorized_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-fltime <= 120.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-duration_category exp = 'Kurz' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight-fltime > 120 AND ls_flight-fltime <= 300.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-duration_category exp = 'Mittel' ).
      ELSEIF ls_flight-fltime > 300.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-duration_category exp = 'Lang' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `CASE WHEN` direkt im `SELECT`-Statement ermöglicht die bedingte Datenmanipulation und -kategorisierung auf Datenbankebene. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit von Post-Processing in ABAP und verbessert die Performance, da die Datenbank die Logik effizienter ausführen kann.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und bestimmen Sie für jede Gruppe, ob es Flüge mit einer Dauer über 300 Minuten gibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und eine `WHEN` Bedingung innerhalb der Gruppierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             fltime TYPE s_fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             has_long_flights TYPE abap_bool,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result.

    METHODS group_flights_by_duration
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_duration.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, fltime
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS. " Limit for example

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
         ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_has_long_flights) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT GROUP ls_group_key INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        IF ls_group_member-fltime > 300.
          lv_has_long_flights = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_result(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        has_long_flights = lv_has_long_flights
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_grouped_data.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_duration( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No grouped data found' act = lines( lt_result ) ).

    IF lines( lt_result ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_group) = lt_result[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_group-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_group-flight_count ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

In Kombination mit einer inneren Schleife und einer `IF` Bedingung (oder `WHEN` in einem `COND`/`SWITCH` innerhalb der Schleife) können komplexe Aggregationen und Analysen direkt im ABAP-Code durchgeführt werden, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Grouping, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitzplätze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (`LH`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer `WHEN` Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc, " Occupied seats
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax, " Maximum seats
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    METHODS calculate_total_available_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_available_seats.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                   FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( seatsmax IS NOT INITIAL AND seatsocc IS NOT INITIAL )
                                   NEXT sum = sum + ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_seats.
    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_flight_reduce( ).

    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_available_seats( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_total_lh msg = 'Total seats for LH should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_total_lh >= 0 ) msg = 'Total seats should be non-negative' ).

    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_available_seats( 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_xx exp = 0 msg = 'Total seats for non-existent carrier should be 0' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` kann er komplexe Schleifen und Berechnungen ersetzen, was zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code führt. Die `WHERE` Klausel innerhalb des `FOR` ist hier die implizite `WHEN` Bedingung.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, FOR, WHERE, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugsegmenten. Wenn die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist, setzen Sie den Preis auf 100, sonst auf 200.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator mit einer `FOR` Schleife und einer `COND` Expression für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_value_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_segment,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_segment,
           ty_flight_segments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_segment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_conditional_segments
      IMPORTING
        it_input_flights TYPE ty_flight_segments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_output_segments) TYPE ty_flight_segments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_value_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_conditional_segments.
    rt_output_segments = VALUE ty_flight_segments(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_input_flights
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_flight-connid
        price  = COND s_price( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' THEN 100
                               ELSE 200 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' ) TO lt_input.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_input.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation aus, die eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte. Fangen Sie spezifische Ausnahmen ab und reagieren Sie unterschiedlich darauf.
hint: Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` mit mehreren `CATCH` Blöcken und der `WHEN` Klausel, um auf verschiedene Ausnahmen zu reagieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_risky_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_risky_operation.
    DATA lv_divisor TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA lv_result TYPE i.

    TRY.
        IF iv_value = 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Custom error for demo
        ENDIF.
        lv_result = iv_value / lv_divisor. " This will cause CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE
        rv_result = |Operation erfolgreich: { lv_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        rv_result = |Fehler: Division durch Null - { lx_zerodivide->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_result = |Fehler: Arithmetischer Fehler - { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result = |Allgemeiner Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_exception_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_exception_handling.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_exception_handling( ).
    DATA lv_result TYPE string.

    lv_result = lo_handler->perform_risky_operation( 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Division durch Null'
      msg = 'Should catch zero divide error' ).

    lv_result = lo_handler->perform_risky_operation( 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains_string(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Arithmetischer Fehler'
      msg = 'Should catch custom arithmetic error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH` Syntax ist der Standard für die Ausnahmebehandlung in ABAP. Durch die Verwendung mehrerer `CATCH` Blöcke können spezifische Ausnahmen (z.B. `cx_sy_zerodivide`, `cx_sy_arithmetic_error`) gezielt abgefangen und unterschiedlich behandelt werden. Dies ermöglicht eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung und eine bessere Kontrolle über den Programmfluss.
keywords: TRY CATCH, Exceptions, Error Handling, WHEN

Instructions: Verifizieren Sie die digitale Signatur eines XML-Dokuments mit Hilfe der Klasse `CL_SECXML_HELPER`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `VERIFY_XML_SIGNATURE` von `CL_SECXML_HELPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_signature_verify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS verify_xml_signature
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_secxml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_signature_verify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD verify_xml_signature.
    DATA lo_secxml_helper TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_helper.
    DATA lv_signature_valid TYPE abap_bool.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_secxml_helper.

    TRY.
        lo_secxml_helper->verify_xml_signature(
          EXPORTING
            if_xml_data = iv_xml_data
          IMPORTING
            ef_signature_valid = lv_signature_valid
        ).
        rv_is_valid = lv_signature_valid.
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        MESSAGE lx_secxml_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_verify_xml_signature FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_verify_xml_signature.
    DATA(lo_verifier) = NEW zcl_xml_signature_verify( ).
    DATA lv_xml_signed TYPE xstring.
    DATA lv_xml_invalid TYPE xstring.

    lv_xml_signed = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string(
                        string = '<Root><Data>Test Data</Data><Signature>ValidSignaturePlaceholder</Signature></Root>'
                        encoding = 'UTF-8' )->read( ).

    lv_xml_invalid = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string(
                        string = '<Root><Data>Tampered Data</Data><Signature>ValidSignaturePlaceholder</Signature></Root>'
                        encoding = 'UTF-8' )->read( ).

    DATA(lv_is_valid) = lo_verifier->verify_xml_signature( lv_xml_signed ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_is_valid ).

    DATA(lv_is_invalid) = lo_verifier->verify_xml_signature( lv_xml_invalid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lv_is_invalid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `CL_SECXML_HELPER` bietet Funktionen zur Verarbeitung von XML-Signaturen und -Verschlüsselungen. Die Methode `VERIFY_XML_SIGNATURE` ist entscheidend für die Sicherstellung der Integrität und Authentizität von XML-Dokumenten, indem sie überprüft, ob ein Dokument nach der Signatur manipuliert wurde. Dies ist ein wichtiger Bestandteil moderner Sicherheitsarchitekturen.
keywords: XML, Security, Digital Signature, CL_SECXML_HELPER, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Kanonisieren Sie ein XML-Dokument, um eine konsistente Darstellung für Signatur- und Vergleichszwecke zu gewährleisten, unter Verwendung von `CL_SECXML_HELPER`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Methode `CANONICALIZE_XML` von `CL_SECXML_HELPER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xml_canonicalize DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS canonicalize_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_xml_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_canonical_xml) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_secxml_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xml_canonicalize IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD canonicalize_xml.
    DATA lo_secxml_helper TYPE REF TO cl_secxml_helper.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_secxml_helper.

    TRY.
        lo_secxml_helper->canonicalize_xml(
          EXPORTING
            if_xml_data = iv_xml_data
          IMPORTING
            ef_canonical_xml_data = rv_canonical_xml
        ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error INTO DATA(lx_secxml_error).
        MESSAGE lx_secxml_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_secxml_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_canonicalize_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_canonicalize_xml.
    DATA(lo_canonicalizer) = NEW zcl_xml_canonicalize( ).
    DATA lv_xml_input TYPE xstring.
    DATA lv_xml_expected_canonical TYPE xstring.

    lv_xml_input = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string(
                        string = '<Root attr2="val2" attr1="val1">  <Child>Text</Child> </Root>'
                        encoding = 'UTF-8' )->read( ).

    lv_xml_expected_canonical = cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_from_string(
                                        string = '<Root attr1="val1" attr2="val2"><Child>Text</Child></Root>'
                                        encoding = 'UTF-8' )->read( ).

    DATA(lv_canonical_output) = lo_canonicalizer->canonicalize_xml( lv_xml_input ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_canonical_output
      exp = lv_xml_expected_canonical
      msg = 'XML should be canonicalized correctly' ).

    DATA lv_empty_xml TYPE xstring.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_empty_canonical) = lo_canonicalizer->canonicalize_xml( lv_empty_xml ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_empty_canonical ).
      CATCH cx_secxml_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: XML-Kanonisierung ist ein Prozess, der ein XML-Dokument in eine Standardform überführt, um sicherzustellen, dass zwei logisch identische XML-Dokumente auch bitweise identisch sind. Dies ist entscheidend für digitale Signaturen, da selbst geringfügige Änderungen (z.B. Whitespace, Attributreihenfolge) die Signatur ungültig machen würden. `CL_SECXML_HELPER=>CANONICALIZE_XML` bietet diese Funktionalität.
keywords: XML, Canonicalization, Security, CL_SECXML_HELPER, ABAP 7.40

Instructions: Exportieren Sie die Daten der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in eine Excel-Datei mit einem einzigen Arbeitsblatt. Die Spaltenüberschriften sollen den Feldnamen der Struktur entsprechen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_ehfnd_xlsx` und iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle, um die Daten zeilenweise zu schreiben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_sflights_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'SFLIGHTS_Export.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_sflights_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_data.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx_handler) = cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_xlsx_document) = lo_xlsx_handler->create_doc( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx_document->get_sheet_by_id( lo_xlsx_document->get_sheets( )[ 1 ]-sheet_id ).
    lo_worksheet->change_sheet_name( 'SFLIGHTS Data' ).

    " Write header row
    DATA(lv_col) = 1.
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    DATA: ls_sflights_type TYPE sflights.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ls_sflights_type ).
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = ls_component-name ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Write data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      lv_col = 1.
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
        DATA(lv_value) = |
          { CONV string( <fs_sflight>-(ls_component-name) ) }|.
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = lv_value ).
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_export_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_export_sflights.
    DATA(lo_exporter) = NEW zcl_xlsx_sflights_export( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_exporter->export_sflights_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_xstring ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xstrlen( lv_xstring ) > 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie ausgewählte Felder der Tabelle SFLIGHTS mit benutzerdefinierten Spaltenüberschriften in eine Excel-Datei.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine Struktur für die gewünschten Felder und verwenden Sie diese für den Export. Definieren Sie die Überschriften explizit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_custom_headers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS export_custom_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'Custom_SFLIGHTS.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_custom_headers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_custom_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights
      UP TO 50 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx_handler) = cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_xlsx_document) = lo_xlsx_handler->create_doc( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx_document->get_sheet_by_id( lo_xlsx_document->get_sheets( )[ 1 ]-sheet_id ).
    lo_worksheet->change_sheet_name( 'Custom Flight Data' ).

    " Custom Headers
    DATA(lt_headers) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Airline ID' ) ( 'Connection ID' ) ( 'Flight Date' ) ( 'Price' ) ).
    DATA(lv_col) = 1.
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    LOOP AT lt_headers INTO DATA(lv_header).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = lv_header ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Write data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_col = 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = ls_flight-fldate ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = ls_flight-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie nur Flüge der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die einen Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert haben, in eine Excel-Datei. Nutzen Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator, um die interne Tabelle vor dem Export zu filtern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_filtered_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_filtered_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price DEFAULT '500'
        iv_filename  TYPE string DEFAULT 'Filtered_SFLIGHTS.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_filtered_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_filtered_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = FILTER sflights_table FROM lt_sflights WHERE price > iv_min_price.

    DATA(lo_xlsx_handler) = cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_xlsx_document) = lo_xlsx_handler->create_doc( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx_document->get_sheet_by_id( lo_xlsx_document->get_sheets( )[ 1 ]-sheet_id ).
    lo_worksheet->change_sheet_name( 'High Price Flights' ).

    " Write header row (dynamic from original structure)
    DATA(lv_col) = 1.
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    DATA: ls_sflights_type TYPE sflights.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ls_sflights_type ).
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = ls_component-name ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Write data rows
    LOOP AT lt_filtered_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      lv_col = 1.
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
        DATA(lv_value) = |
          { CONV string( <fs_sflight>-(ls_component-name) ) }|.
        lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = lv_value ).
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie aggregierte Daten der Tabelle SFLIGHTS (z.B. die Summe der Passagierkapazität pro Fluggesellschaft) in eine Excel-Datei. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GROUP BY` in einem `LOOP` oder `REDUCE` mit `GROUP BY` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_aggregated_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_agg_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_agg_data.

    METHODS export_aggregated_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'Aggregated_SFLIGHTS.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_aggregated_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_aggregated_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS.

    DATA(lt_aggregated_data) = REDUCE ty_agg_data_tab(
      INIT result = VALUE ty_agg_data_tab( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid
      LET lv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_flight_in_group> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight_in_group>-seatsocc + <fs_flight_in_group>-seatsmax
      ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE ty_agg_data_tab( BASE result ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid total_capacity = lv_total_capacity ) )
    ).

    DATA(lo_xlsx_handler) = cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_xlsx_document) = lo_xlsx_handler->create_doc( ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx_document->get_sheet_by_id( lo_xlsx_document->get_sheets( )[ 1 ]-sheet_id ).
    lo_worksheet->change_sheet_name( 'Aggregated Capacity' ).

    " Headers
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 1 iv_value = 'Airline ID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = 1 iv_column = 2 iv_value = 'Total Capacity' ).

    " Write data
    DATA(lv_row) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_aggregated_data INTO DATA(ls_agg_data).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 1 iv_value = ls_agg_data-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = 2 iv_value = ls_agg_data-total_capacity ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie Daten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS für zwei verschiedene Fluggesellschaften in zwei separate Arbeitsblätter innerhalb derselben Excel-Datei.
hint: Erstellen Sie mehrere Arbeitsblätter im selben `cl_xlsx_document` und schreiben Sie die gefilterten Daten in jedes Blatt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_multi_sheet_sflights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid1  TYPE s_carr_id DEFAULT 'AA'
        iv_carrid2  TYPE s_carr_id DEFAULT 'LH'
        iv_filename TYPE string DEFAULT 'MultiSheet_SFLIGHTS.xlsx'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_multi_sheet_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 200 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_xlsx_handler) = cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>get_instance( ).
    DATA(lo_xlsx_document) = lo_xlsx_handler->create_doc( ).

    " Sheet 1 for Carrier 1
    DATA(lt_sflights_carr1) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid1 ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet1) = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = |Flights { iv_carrid1 }| ).
    ME->write_sflights_to_sheet( EXPORTING it_sflights = lt_sflights_carr1 io_worksheet = lo_worksheet1 ).

    " Sheet 2 for Carrier 2
    DATA(lt_sflights_carr2) = FILTER #( lt_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid2 ).
    DATA(lo_worksheet2) = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( iv_sheet_name = |Flights { iv_carrid2 }| ).
    ME->write_sflights_to_sheet( EXPORTING it_sflights = lt_sflights_carr2 io_worksheet = lo_worksheet2 ).

    rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD write_sflights_to_sheet.
    " Helper method to write sflights data to a given worksheet
    DATA(lv_col) = 1.
    DATA(lv_row) = 1.
    DATA: ls_sflights_type TYPE sflights.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ls_sflights_type ).

    " Write header row
    LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
      io_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = ls_component-name ).
      lv_col = lv_col + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Write data rows
    LOOP AT it_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      lv_col = 1.
      LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
        DATA(lv_value) = |
          { CONV string( <fs_sflight>-(ls_component-name) ) }|.
        io_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = lv_value ).
        lv_col = lv_col + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      lv_col = lv_col + 1.

    lv_row = lv_row + 1;

    " Write data rows (same as previous examples)
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).

      ENDLOOP.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_xlsx_handler) = cl_ehfnd_xlsx=>get_instance( ).
        IF lo_xlsx_handler IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_value EXPORTING textid = cx_abap_invalid_value=>default text = 'Failed to get CL_EHFND_XLSX instance.'.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lo_xlsx_document) = lo_xlsx_handler->create_doc( ).
        DATA(lo_worksheet) = lo_xlsx_document->get_sheet_by_id( lo_xlsx_document->get_sheets( )[ 1 ]-sheet_id ).
        lo_worksheet->change_sheet_name( 'SFLIGHTS Error Handling' ).

        " Write header row
        DATA(lv_col) = 1.
        DATA(lv_row) = 1.
        DATA: ls_sflights_type TYPE sflights.
        DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ls_sflights_type ).
        LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component).
          lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = ls_component-name ).
          lv_col = lv_col + 1.
        ENDLOOP.
        lv_row = lv_row + 1.

        " Write data rows
        LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
          lv_col = 1.
          LOOP AT lo_struct_descr->get_components( ) INTO ls_component.
            DATA(lv_value) = |
              { CONV string( <fs_sflight>-(ls_component-name) ) }|.
            lo_worksheet->set_cell_content( iv_row = lv_row iv_column = lv_col iv_value = lv_value ).
            lv_col = lv_col + 1.
          ENDLOOP.
          lv_row = lv_row + 1.
        ENDLOOP.

        rv_xstring = lo_xlsx_document->save( ).

      CATCH cx_openxml_format INTO DATA(lx_openxml_format).
        " Handle specific OpenXML format errors
        MESSAGE lx_openxml_format->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " Log error, send notification, etc.
      CATCH cx_openxml_not_found INTO DATA(lx_openxml_not_found).
        " Handle file not found errors (e.g., template not found)
        MESSAGE lx_openxml_not_found->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_abap_invalid_value INTO DATA(lx_invalid_value).
        " Handle custom errors or invalid value errors
        MESSAGE lx_invalid_value->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Catch all other exceptions
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Schreiben Sie eine interne Tabelle in eine CSV-Datei, die als XSTRING zurückgegeben wird. Nutzen Sie moderne String-Operationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und String-Templates, um die CSV-Zeilen zu erstellen, und `cl_abap_codepage` für die Konvertierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_sflights_to_csv
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 50
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_csv.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO iv_max_rows ROWS.

    DATA: ls_sflights_type TYPE sflights.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( ls_sflights_type ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Create header row
    DATA(lv_csv_header) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_comp-name ELSE s && ',' && ls_comp-name )
    ).

    " Create data rows
    DATA(lv_csv_data) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = lv_csv_header
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      LET lv_row_string = REDUCE string(
        INIT r = ''
        FOR ls_comp IN lt_components
        LET lv_field_value = CONV string( ls_flight-(ls_comp-name) ) IN
        NEXT r = COND string( WHEN r IS INITIAL THEN lv_field_value ELSE r && ',' && lv_field_value )
      ) IN
      NEXT s = s && cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf && lv_row_string
    ).

    " Convert string to XSTRING (UTF-8)
    rv_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
      iv_string = lv_csv_data
      iv_code_page = 'UTF-8'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie alle Flugnummern (z.B. 'LH400', 'UA123') aus einem Text, der mehrere Flugdetails enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit der `RESULTS` Option.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_extract_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_flight_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_flight_numbers.
    DATA: lt_matches TYPE match_result_tab.

    " Regex für Flugnummern: Zwei Großbuchstaben gefolgt von 1-4 Ziffern
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '[A-Z]{2}\d{1,4}' IN iv_text
      RESULTS lt_matches.

    LOOP AT lt_matches INTO DATA(ls_match).
      APPEND iv_text+ls_match-offset(ls_match-length) TO rt_flight_numbers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matches FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_success.
    DATA(lv_text) = `Der Flug LH400 nach New York und UA123 nach Chicago sind verspätet. Auch BA249 ist betroffen.`.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_extract_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->extract_flight_numbers( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3 msg = 'Should find 3 flight numbers' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ] exp = 'LH400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ] exp = 'UA123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ] exp = 'BA249' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_matches.
    DATA(lv_text) = `Keine Flugnummern hier.`.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_extract_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->extract_flight_numbers( lv_text ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Should find no flight numbers' ).

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen JSON-String, der ein Array von Flugobjekten enthält, in eine interne Tabelle von ABAP-Strukturen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_clb_parse_json=>parse` und iterieren Sie über das JSON-Array mit `get_array`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parse_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city_id,
             cityto   TYPE s_city_id,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_flights_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_flights_json.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = cl_clb_parse_json=>parse( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(lo_json_array) = lo_json_parser->get_array( ).

    LOOP AT lo_json_array->get_elements( ) INTO DATA(lo_element).
      DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE ty_flight(
        carrid   = lo_element->get_object( )->get_value( 'carrid' )->get_string( )
        connid   = lo_element->get_object( )->get_value( 'connid' )->get_integer( )
        cityfrom = lo_element->get_object( )->get_value( 'cityfrom' )->get_string( )
        cityto   = lo_element->get_object( )->get_value( 'cityto' )->get_string( )
      ).
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights`, deren Fluggesellschaftscode ein bestimmtes Muster enthält, und geben Sie deren Flugnummern zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `FILTER` und `FIND` im `WHERE`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key,
           tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier_pattern
      IMPORTING
        iv_pattern TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier_pattern.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_keys = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                               WHERE ( FIND iv_pattern IN flight-carrid ) " FIND returns 0 if not found, >0 if found
                               ( carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie den Text zwischen zwei spezifischen Markern in einem String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND` um die Start- und Endpositionen zu finden, dann `substring` oder Offset-Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_extract_between DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS extract_text_between_markers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text    TYPE string
        iv_marker1 TYPE string
        iv_marker2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_extracted_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_extract_between IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_text_between_markers.
    DATA: lv_offset1 TYPE i,
          lv_offset2 TYPE i,
          lv_length  TYPE i.

    FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_marker1 IN iv_text MATCH OFFSET lv_offset1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      lv_offset1 = lv_offset1 + STRLEN( iv_marker1 ).
      FIND FIRST OCCURRENCE OF iv_marker2 IN iv_text STARTING AT lv_offset1 MATCH OFFSET lv_offset2.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        lv_length = lv_offset2 - lv_offset1.
        rv_extracted_text = iv_text+lv_offset1(lv_length).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Basierend auf dem Vorhandensein bestimmter Schlüsselwörter in einem Text, geben Sie eine Kategorie zurück. Verwenden Sie `SWITCH` oder `COND`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_categorize_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_category TYPE string.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_category,
                 flight TYPE ty_category VALUE 'Flight Information',
                 hotel  TYPE ty_category VALUE 'Hotel Booking',
                 other  TYPE ty_category VALUE 'Other',
               END OF gc_category.

    METHODS categorize_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE ty_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_categorize_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_text.
    rv_category = SWITCH ty_category(
      WHEN FIND 'Flug' IN iv_text OR FIND 'Airline' IN iv_text THEN gc_category-flight
      WHEN FIND 'Hotel' IN iv_text OR FIND 'Übernachtung' IN iv_text THEN gc_category-hotel
      ELSE gc_category-other

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie eine Liste von Werten aus einem JSON-Array, das nur primitive Werte (z.B. Strings) enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_clb_parse_json=>parse`, `get_array` und iterieren Sie über die Elemente, um `get_string` aufzurufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_parse_primitive_array DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS parse_string_array_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_strings) TYPE string_table
      RAISING
        cx_clb_json_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_parse_primitive_array IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_string_array_json.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = cl_clb_parse_json=>parse( iv_json_string ).
    DATA(lo_json_array) = lo_json_parser->get_array( ).

    LOOP AT lo_json_array->get_elements( ) INTO DATA(lo_element).
      APPEND lo_element->get_string( ) TO rt_strings.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String mit einem bestimmten Präfix beginnt oder mit einem Suffix endet, unter Verwendung von `STARTS WITH` und `ENDS WITH`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Operatoren `CP` oder `CS` für einfache Muster, oder die dedizierten `STARTS WITH` und `ENDS WITH` Ausdrücke für moderne Syntax.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_prefix_suffix DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_prefix
      IMPORTING
        iv_text   TYPE string
        iv_prefix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_starts_with) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS check_suffix
      IMPORTING
        iv_text   TYPE string
        iv_suffix TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_ends_with) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_prefix_suffix IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_prefix.
    IF iv_text STARTS WITH iv_prefix THEN
      rv_starts_with = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_starts_with = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_suffix.
    IF iv_text ENDS WITH iv_suffix THEN
      rv_ends_with = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_ends_with = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie String-Templates, um einen komplexen String dynamisch zu erstellen, der Daten aus einer ABAP-Struktur und das Ergebnis einer `FIND`-Operation enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie String-Templates mit Inline-Deklarationen und dem `FIND`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_template_find DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city_id,
             cityto   TYPE s_city_id,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS create_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        is_flight TYPE ty_flight_info
        iv_search_term TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_template_find IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_summary.
    DATA(lv_text_to_search) = |Flug { is_flight-carrid }{ is_flight-connid } von { is_flight-cityfrom } nach { is_flight-cityto } ist geplant.|.
    DATA(lv_found) = COND string(
      WHEN FIND iv_search_term IN lv_text_to_search THEN |'{ iv_search_term }' gefunden|
      ELSE |'{ iv_search_term }' nicht gefunden|
    ).

    rv_summary = |Zusammenfassung für Flug { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid }:
                  Abflug: { is_flight-cityfrom }
                  Ankunft: { is_flight-cityto }
                  Suchergebnis: { lv_found }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Wochentag (Montag, Dienstag, etc.) basierend auf einer Zahl (1 für Montag, 7 für Sonntag) mit einem modernen Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_switch_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_switch_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekday_name.
    rv_weekday_name = SWITCH #( iv_day_number
                                WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'

                                WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
                                WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
                                WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
                                WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
                                WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
                                ELSE 'Ungültiger Tag' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_case_type_of IMPLEMENTATION.

    CASE TYPE OF io_object.
      WHEN TYPE cl_abap_unit_assert INTO DATA(lo_assert).
        rv_message = 'Object is cl_abap_unit_assert'.
        " Example: Create an action object and execute
        DATA(lo_assert_action) = NEW lcl_assert_action( lo_assert ).
        lo_assert_action->lif_action~execute( ).

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights`. Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug die Fluggesellschaft, die Flugnummer und einen 'Service Level' enthält. Der 'Service Level' soll basierend auf dem Preis des Fluges (z.B. < 200 'Economy', < 500 'Business', >= 500 'First Class') mit einem `CASE` Ausdruck innerhalb eines `FOR` Ausdrucks bestimmt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Ausdruck, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren, und `SWITCH` oder `COND` für die Preisklassifizierung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_service,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid      TYPE sflight-connid,
             service_lvl TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_service.
    TYPES tt_flight_service TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_service WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_for_case_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_flight_service_levels
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_flight_services) TYPE tt_flight_service.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_for_case_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_flight_service_levels.
        SELECT carrid, connid, price FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

        rt_flight_services = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                      ( carrid      = flight-carrid
                                        connid      = flight-connid
                                        service_lvl = SWITCH #( WHEN flight-price < 200 THEN 'Economy'
                                                                WHEN flight-price < 500 THEN 'Business'
                                                                ELSE 'First Class' ) ) ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die einen String und eine Ziel-Codepage als Eingabe erhält. Basierend auf der Ziel-Codepage soll der String entsprechend konvertiert werden. Nutzen Sie einen `CASE` Ausdruck, um die richtige Konvertierungslogik mit `cl_abap_codepage` auszuwählen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` auf den `iv_target_codepage` Parameter und rufen Sie `cl_abap_codepage` Methoden auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_codepage_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_string_by_codepage
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string    TYPE string
        iv_target_codepage TYPE abap_codepage
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_case_codepage_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_by_codepage.
    DATA(lv_utf8_xstring) = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                              iv_string = iv_input_string
                              iv_codepage = 'UTF-8' ). "Assume input is always UTF-8 for simplicity

    CASE iv_target_codepage.
      WHEN '1100'. "ISO-8859-1
        rv_converted_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                                 iv_xstring = lv_utf8_xstring
                                 iv_codepage = '1100' ).
      WHEN '4103'. "UTF-16BE
        rv_converted_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                                 iv_xstring = lv_utf8_xstring
                                 iv_codepage = '4103' ).
      WHEN '4104'. "UTF-16LE
        rv_converted_xstring = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from(
                                 iv_xstring = lv_utf8_xstring
                                 iv_codepage = '4104' ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Default to UTF-8 if target codepage is unknown or not handled
        rv_converted_xstring = lv_utf8_xstring.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften und geben Sie für jede an, ob sie 'Star Alliance', 'OneWorld' oder 'SkyTeam' angehört. Wenn die Allianz unbekannt ist, soll 'Independent' ausgegeben werden. Nutzen Sie eine klassische `CASE` Anweisung mit modernen Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CASE` mit `WHEN` und `WHEN OTHERS`. Inline-Deklarationen für die Schleifenvariable.
solution:
CLASS zcl_case_airlines DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_airline_alliance
      IMPORTING
        it_airlines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_alliances) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_case_airlines IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airline_alliance.
    LOOP AT it_airlines INTO DATA(lv_airline).
      DATA(lv_alliance) = ''.
      CASE lv_airline.
        WHEN 'LH' OR 'UA' OR 'SQ'. "Lufthansa, United, Singapore Airlines
          lv_alliance = 'Star Alliance'.
        WHEN 'BA' OR 'AA' OR 'CX'. "British Airways, American Airlines, Cathay Pacific
          lv_alliance = 'OneWorld'.
        WHEN 'DL' OR 'AF' OR 'KL'. "Delta, Air France, KLM
          lv_alliance = 'SkyTeam'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          lv_alliance = 'Independent'.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND lv_alliance TO rt_alliances.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine XSTRING empfängt, deren Codepage unbekannt ist. Versuchen Sie, die Codepage zu erkennen. Basierend auf der erkannten Codepage (z.B. UTF-8, ISO-8859-1) soll der Inhalt in einen ABAP String konvertiert und ein spezifischer Präfix hinzugefügt werden. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>detect_codepage` und einen `CASE` Ausdruck.
hint: Die `detect_codepage` Methode gibt eine Liste zurück. Wählen Sie die erste plausible Codepage und verwenden Sie `CASE` für die weitere Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_detect_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_unknown_xstring
      IMPORTING
        ix_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_detect_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_unknown_xstring.
    DATA(lv_detected_codepage) = ''.
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_codepages) = cl_abap_codepage=>detect_codepage( ix_data ).
        IF lt_codepages IS NOT INITIAL.
          " Take the first detected codepage as the most likely one
          lv_detected_codepage = lt_codepages[ 1 ]-codepage.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
        " No codepage detected, default to something or handle error
        lv_detected_codepage = 'UNKNOWN'.
    ENDTRY.

    DATA(lv_converted_string) = ''.
    CASE lv_detected_codepage.
      WHEN 'UTF-8'.
        lv_converted_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( iv_xstring = ix_data iv_codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
        rv_processed_string = 'UTF-8 Detected: ' && lv_converted_string.
      WHEN '1100'. "ISO-8859-1
        lv_converted_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( iv_xstring = ix_data iv_codepage = '1100' ).
        rv_processed_string = 'ISO-8859-1 Detected: ' && lv_converted_string.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Fallback: try to convert as UTF-8 or just return a message
        TRY.
            lv_converted_string = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_from( iv_xstring = ix_data iv_codepage = 'UTF-8' ).
            rv_processed_string = 'Fallback UTF-8: ' && lv_converted_string.
          CATCH cx_sy_codepage_conversion.
            rv_processed_string = 'Could not process data (unknown/invalid codepage)'.
        ENDTRY.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften (z.B. 'AA', 'LH', 'SQ') erhält und eine neue interne Tabelle zurückgibt. Diese Tabelle soll für jede Fluggesellschaft einen Eintrag enthalten, der die Fluggesellschaft und eine 'Region' (z.B. 'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia') basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft zuweist. Nutzen Sie den `VALUE` Operator in Kombination mit einem `CASE` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... ( ... ) )` und `SWITCH` für die Regionenzuweisung.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_region,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             region TYPE string,
           END OF ty_airline_region.
    TYPES tt_airline_region TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_region WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_value_case_region DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_airline_regions
          IMPORTING
            it_airlines TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_airline_regions) TYPE tt_airline_region.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_value_case_region IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_airline_regions.
        rt_airline_regions = VALUE #( FOR lv_airline IN it_airlines
                                      ( carrid = lv_airline
                                        region = SWITCH #( lv_airline
                                                           WHEN 'AA' OR 'UA' THEN 'North America'
                                                           WHEN 'LH' OR 'BA' THEN 'Europe'
                                                           WHEN 'SQ' OR 'CX' THEN 'Asia'
                                                           ELSE 'Other' ) ) ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_airline_regions FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_airline_regions.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_case_region( ).
    DATA(lt_airlines) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH EMPTY KEY
                        ( ( 'AA' ) ( 'LH' ) ( 'SQ' ) ( 'QF' ) ).
    DATA(lt_expected_regions) = VALUE tt_airline_region
                                     ( ( carrid = 'AA' region = 'North America' )
                                       ( carrid = 'LH' region = 'Europe' )
                                       ( carrid = 'SQ' region = 'Asia' )
                                       ( carrid = 'QF' region = 'Other' ) ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_airline_regions( lt_airlines ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lines( lt_expected_regions ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected_regions ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Art, Daten zu transformieren und zu aggregieren, ohne explizite Schleifen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie eine Liste aller im System verfügbaren Codepages. Filtern Sie diese Liste, um nur die Codepages anzuzeigen, die 'UTF' im Namen enthalten. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>get_codepages` und den `FILTER` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_codepage=>get_codepages` und anschließend `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_codepage_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_utf_codepages
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_utf_codepages) TYPE cl_abap_codepage=>tt_codepage_list.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codepage_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_utf_codepages.
    DATA(lt_all_codepages) = cl_abap_codepage=>get_codepages( ).

    rt_utf_codepages = FILTER #( lt_all_codepages USING KEY primary_key WHERE codepage CP '*UTF*' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_utf_codepages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_utf_codepages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_codepage_list( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_utf_codepages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Check if all entries contain 'UTF'
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_codepage).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = ls_codepage-codepage exp = 'UTF' msg = 'Codepage does not contain UTF' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check for specific common UTF codepages
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = VALUE #( lt_result[ codepage = 'UTF-8' ] OPTIONAL ) msg = 'UTF-8 not found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( act = VALUE #( lt_result[ codepage = 'UTF-16BE' ] OPTIONAL ) msg = 'UTF-16BE not found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Dauer in Sekunden zwischen zwei XCO-Zeitstempeln.
hint: Nutze `XCO_CP_TIME=>timestamp` und die Methode `diff` gefolgt von `get_seconds`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_time_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_duration
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_seconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_duration.
    DATA(lo_timestamp1) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp( iv_timestamp = iv_timestamp1 ).
    DATA(lo_timestamp2) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp( iv_timestamp = iv_timestamp2 ).

    DATA(lo_duration) = lo_timestamp1->diff( lo_timestamp2 ).
    rv_seconds = lo_duration->get_seconds( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_duration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_duration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_time_duration( ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp1) = '20231209100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_timestamp2) = '20231209100100.0000000'. " 60 seconds later

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->calculate_duration( iv_timestamp1 = lv_timestamp1, iv_timestamp2 = lv_timestamp2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 60 ).

    lv_timestamp1 = '20231209100000.0000000'.
    lv_timestamp2 = '20231209100000.0000000'.
    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_duration( iv_timestamp1 = lv_timestamp1, iv_timestamp2 = lv_timestamp2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 0 ).

    lv_timestamp1 = '20231209100100.0000000'.
    lv_timestamp2 = '20231209100000.0000000'.
    lv_result = lo_cut->calculate_duration( iv_timestamp1 = lv_timestamp1, iv_timestamp2 = lv_timestamp2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = -60 ). " diff can be negative
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die moderne, objektorientierte Zeitstempel-Manipulation mit der XCO Time API. Durch die Verwendung von Objekten für Zeitstempel und Dauern wird der Code lesbarer und robuster. Die `diff`-Methode liefert ein Dauer-Objekt, aus dem die Sekunden extrahiert werden können.
keywords: XCO, Time API, Timestamp, Duration, diff, get_seconds

Instructions: Addiere eine bestimmte Dauer (z.B. 3 Stunden) zu einem gegebenen XCO-Zeitstempel.
hint: Nutze `XCO_CP_TIME=>timestamp` und die Methode `add` mit einem `XCO_CP_TIME=>duration` Objekt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_time_add_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_duration_to_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_hours     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_add_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_duration_to_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_timestamp) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp( iv_timestamp = iv_timestamp ).
    DATA(lo_duration) = xco_cp_time=>duration( iv_seconds = iv_hours * 3600 ). " Convert hours to seconds

    DATA(lo_new_timestamp) = lo_timestamp->add( lo_duration ).
    rv_new_timestamp = lo_new_timestamp->get_iv_timestamp( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_duration FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_duration.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_time_add_duration( ).
    DATA(lv_start_timestamp) = '20231209100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_hours_to_add) = 3.
    DATA(lv_expected_timestamp) = '20231209130000.0000000'.

    DATA(lv_result_timestamp) = lo_cut->add_duration_to_timestamp( iv_timestamp = lv_start_timestamp, iv_hours = lv_hours_to_add ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_timestamp exp = lv_expected_timestamp ).

    lv_start_timestamp = '20231231230000.0000000'.
    lv_hours_to_add = 2.
    lv_expected_timestamp = '20240101010000.0000000'. " Test跨年
    lv_result_timestamp = lo_cut->add_duration_to_timestamp( iv_timestamp = lv_start_timestamp, iv_hours = lv_hours_to_add ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_timestamp exp = lv_expected_timestamp ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit der XCO Time API eine Dauer zu einem Zeitstempel addiert. Die Dauer wird als `XCO_CP_TIME=>duration` Objekt erstellt und dann mit der `add`-Methode auf das Zeitstempel-Objekt angewendet. Dies ermöglicht eine intuitive und typsichere Zeitberechnung.
keywords: XCO, Time API, Timestamp, Duration, add, get_iv_timestamp

Instructions: Formatiere einen XCO-Zeitstempel in einen benutzerdefinierten String (z.B. 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS').

CLASS zcl_xco_time_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp TYPE timestampl

CLASS zcl_xco_time_format IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_timestamp) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp( iv_timestamp = iv_timestamp ).
    IF iv_format IS INITIAL.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_time_format( ).
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = '20231209103045.1234567'.

    DATA(lv_result_default) = lo_cut->format_timestamp_to_string( iv_timestamp = lv_timestamp ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result_default exp = '2023-12-09 10:30:45' ). " XCO default format

Instructions: Aggregiere simulierte Flugdaten (Flugdatum und Passagieranzahl) pro Monat aus der Tabelle `sflights` und berechne die Summe der Passagiere pro Monat. Dies ist eine typische Vorbereitung für ein Zeitdiagramm.
hint: Nutze `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_data_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_monthly_agg,
             month TYPE c LENGTH 6, " YYYYMM
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_monthly_agg.
    TYPES: tt_monthly_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_monthly_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_flights_by_month
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_data TYPE tt_flight_data OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_monthly_agg) TYPE tt_monthly_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_data_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_flights_by_month.
    DATA lt_flights_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    IF it_flight_data IS INITIAL.
      " Use actual sflights data if no input provided
      SELECT fldate, seatsocc
        FROM sflights
        INTO TABLE @lt_flights_raw
        UP TO 100 ROWS.
    ELSE.
      lt_flights_raw = CORRESPONDING #( it_flight_data ).
    ENDIF.

    rt_monthly_agg = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_flights_raw
                               GROUP BY ( month = flight-fldate(6) )
                               ( month = flight-fldate(6),
                                 total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                               FOR <member> IN GROUP flight
                                                                 NEXT sum = sum + <member>-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_aggregate_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aggregate_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chart_data_agg( ).

    DATA lt_test_data TYPE zcl_chart_data_agg=>tt_flight_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( fldate = '20230101' seatsocc = 10 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( fldate = '20230115' seatsocc = 20 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( fldate = '20230201' seatsocc = 5 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( fldate = '20230210' seatsocc = 15 ) TO lt_test_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( fldate = '20230120' seatsocc = 30 ) TO lt_test_data.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->aggregate_flights_by_month( lt_test_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY month = '202301' INTO DATA(ls_jan_agg).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_jan_agg-total_passengers exp = 60 ).

    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY month = '202302' INTO DATA(ls_feb_agg).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_feb_agg-total_passengers exp = 20 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt moderne ABAP-Features wie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und den `REDUCE`-Operator, um Daten effizient nach Monaten zu aggregieren. Dies ist eine gängige Vorbereitung für die Visualisierung von Zeitreihendaten in Diagrammen. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...)` und `FOR GROUPS OF` macht den Code kompakt und lesbar.

CLASS zcl_filter_events_by_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_event,
             event_id   TYPE i,
             event_date TYPE d,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_event.
    TYPES: tt_events TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_event WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_events
      IMPORTING
        it_all_events TYPE tt_events
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_events) TYPE tt_events.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_events_by_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_events.
    rt_filtered_events = FILTER #( it_all_events WHERE event_date BETWEEN iv_start_date AND iv_end_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( event_id = 2 event_date = '20230115' description = 'Event B' ) TO lt_events.

        VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_working_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_working_days.
    DATA lv_current_date TYPE d.
    DATA lv_day_of_week TYPE i.

    lv_current_date = iv_start_date.

    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      lv_day_of_week = cl_abap_date_time_utilities=>get_day_of_week( lv_current_date ).
      " 1 = Monday, ..., 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
      IF lv_day_of_week >= 1 AND lv_day_of_week <= 5.
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_quarter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_quarter_from_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_quarter) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_date_quarter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_quarter_from_date.
    DATA(lv_month) = iv_date+4(2). " Extract month as string
    DATA(lv_month_num) = CONV i( lv_month ). " Convert to integer

    rv_quarter = SWITCH #( lv_month_num
      WHEN 1 THRU 3 THEN 1
      WHEN 4 THRU 6 THEN 2
      WHEN 7 THRU 9 THEN 3
      WHEN 10 THRU 12 THEN 4
      ELSE 0 " Should not happen for valid dates
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Vergleiche zwei XCO-Zeitstempel, um festzustellen, welcher früher oder später ist.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_compare DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_timestamps
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_comparison_result) TYPE string. " 'EQUAL', 'TS1_BEFORE_TS2', 'TS1_AFTER_TS2'
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_time_compare IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_timestamps.
    DATA(lo_ts1) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp( iv_timestamp = iv_timestamp1 ).
    DATA(lo_ts2) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp( iv_timestamp = iv_timestamp2 ).

    IF lo_ts1 = lo_ts2.
      rv_comparison_result = 'EQUAL'.
    ELSE IF lo_ts1 < lo_ts2.
      rv_comparison_result = 'TS1_BEFORE_TS2'.
    ELSE.
      rv_comparison_result = 'TS1_AFTER_TS2'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine sortierte Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und ein bestimmtes Datum, gefüllt mit dem `VALUE` Operator und einer `FOR` Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( SORTED TABLE ... )` und `FOR ... IN ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_date    TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier AND fldate = @iv_date
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight
                          FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                          ( carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid
                            connid    = ls_sflight-connid
                            fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate
                            planetype = ls_sflight-planetype ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_value_for( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'.

    " Insert dummy data for testing if needed, or ensure sflight has data
    " For simplicity, assuming sflight has data for LH and current date.

    " INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A321' ) ).
    " COMMIT WORK.

Insbesondere für sortierte Tabellen ist dies effizient, da die Sortierung und die Einhaltung des eindeutigen Schlüssels automatisch beim Befüllen gewährleistet werden. CLASS zcl_srt_read_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,

             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,

        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data.

CLASS zcl_srt_read_table IMPLEMENTATION.

    READ TABLE it_flights INTO rs_flight WITH KEY carrid = is_key-carrid
                                                connid = is_key-connid
                                                fldate = is_key-fldate
                                                BINARY SEARCH.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_srt_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                                  INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazität aller Flüge in einer sortierten Tabelle für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS calculate_total_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE sflight-seatsmax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-seatsmax
                               FOR ls_flight IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum_no_match FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_srt_reduce=>tt_flights_sorted(
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 150 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 200 )
                              ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 300 ) ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = lv_carrier ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = 350 ). " 150 + 200
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_sum_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_srt_reduce=>tt_flights_sorted(
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 150 ) ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'UA'. " No flights for UA

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = lv_carrier ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_sum_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_srt_reduce=>tt_flights_sorted( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_seats( it_flights = lt_flights iv_carrier = lv_carrier ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer funktionalen und sehr prägnanten Weise. Er ist ideal für Szenarien, in denen ein einzelner Wert (z.B. eine Summe, ein Maximum) aus einer Tabelle berechnet werden soll. Die `WHERE` Klausel innerhalb des `FOR` Ausdrucks erlaubt eine direkte Filterung.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die Flugdaten aus `sflights` enthält, aber nur für Fluggesellschaften, die in einer separaten sortierten Tabelle von bevorzugten Fluggesellschaften aufgeführt sind.

CLASS zcl_srt_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_preferred_carrier,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
           END OF ty_preferred_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_preferred_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_preferred_carrier WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flights_for_preferred
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights      TYPE tt_flights_sorted
        it_preferred_carriers TYPE tt_preferred_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_for_preferred.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight
                                   FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                   WHERE ( carrid IN it_preferred_carriers )
                                   ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... WHERE ... )` ermöglicht eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und effiziente Erstellung neuer Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen, die auf anderen Tabellen basieren. Die `WHERE ( carrid IN it_preferred_carriers )` Syntax ist hier besonders mächtig, da sie die sortierte Tabelle `it_preferred_carriers` als effizienten Lookup-Mechanismus nutzt.
