Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein Eintrag in einer sortierten Tabelle existiert und ermitteln Sie dessen Index, falls vorhanden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS check_and_get_index
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted
        is_key     TYPE ty_flight
      EXPORTING
        ev_exists  TYPE abap_bool
        ev_index   TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_and_get_index.
    IF line_exists( it_flights[ KEY primary_key
                                carrid = is_key-carrid
                                connid = is_key-connid
                                fldate = is_key-fldate ] ).
      ev_exists = abap_true.
      ev_index = line_index( it_flights[ KEY primary_key
                                          carrid = is_key-carrid
                                          connid = is_key-connid
                                          fldate = is_key-fldate ] ).
    ELSE.
      ev_exists = abap_false.
      ev_index = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_line_exists_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_line_exists_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_line_exists_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_srt_line_exists=>tt_flights_sorted(
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum ) ).
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_srt_line_exists=>ty_flight(
                      carrid = 'LH'
                      connid = '0400'
                      fldate = sy-datum ).
    DATA: lv_exists TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_index  TYPE i.

    lo_cut->check_and_get_index( EXPORTING it_flights = lt_flights
                                           is_key     = ls_key
                                IMPORTING ev_exists  = lv_exists
                                          ev_index   = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_line_exists_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_line_exists( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_srt_line_exists=>tt_flights_sorted(
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ) ).
    DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_srt_line_exists=>ty_flight(
                      carrid = 'AA'
                      connid = '0001'
                      fldate = sy-datum ).
    DATA: lv_exists TYPE abap_bool,
          lv_index  TYPE i.

    lo_cut->check_and_get_index( EXPORTING it_flights = lt_flights
                                           is_key     = ls_key
                                IMPORTING ev_exists  = lv_exists
                                          ev_index   = lv_index ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktionen `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` ermöglichen eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Prüfung der Existenz eines Tabelleneintrags und die Ermittlung seines Index, ohne dass ein `READ TABLE` mit `SY-SUBRC` und `SY-TABIX` ausgewertet werden muss. Dies ist besonders nützlich für sortierte Tabellen, da der Zugriff über den Schlüssel optimiert ist.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, LINE_EXISTS, LINE_INDEX, Internal Tables, Key Access

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue sortierte Tabelle, die nur ausgewählte Felder aus einer Quelltabelle enthält, unter Verwendung des `CORRESPONDING` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING #( ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_full,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc  TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_full.
    TYPES: tt_flights_full TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_full WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate    TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_full_flights TYPE tt_flights_full
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary_sorted.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    rt_summary = CORRESPONDING #( it_full_flights MAPPING carrid = carrid
                                                  connid = connid
                                                  fldate = fldate
                                                  planetype = planetype ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_corresponding FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_corresponding_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_corresponding.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_full_flights) = VALUE zcl_srt_corresponding=>tt_flights_full(
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 150 seatsocc = 100 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum planetype = 'A321' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 180 ) ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( it_full_flights = lt_full_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summary[ 1 ]-planetype exp = 'A320' ).
    " Ensure fields not in target structure are not mapped
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_summary[ 1 ]-seatsmax ). " This field is not in ty_flight_summary
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_corresponding_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_full_flights) = VALUE zcl_srt_corresponding=>tt_flights_full( ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( it_full_flights = lt_full_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_summary ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug zur Transformation von Daten zwischen Strukturen oder internen Tabellen mit ähnlichen, aber nicht identischen Felddefinitionen. Er ermöglicht eine deklarative Feldzuordnung und ist besonders nützlich, um Daten für spezifische Zwecke zu projizieren oder zu aggregieren, ohne manuelle Zuweisungen vornehmen zu müssen. Die explizite `MAPPING` Klausel erhöht die Lesbarkeit und Kontrolle.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, CORRESPONDING, Data Transformation, Internal Tables, MAPPING

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf dem Alter eines Flugdatensatzes (simuliert durch ein Datum) entscheidet, ob dieser als "heiß" oder "kalt" betrachtet wird.
hint: Dies ist eine konzeptionelle Demonstration, da die direkte Abfrage des Aging-Status eines einzelnen Satzes komplex ist. Nutzen Sie `IF` und Datumsberechnungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_daa_conceptual DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_data_aging_status TYPE c LENGTH 4 VALUE 'HOT'. " HOT or COLD
    CONSTANTS: gc_aging_threshold_days TYPE i VALUE 365. " 1 year

    METHODS get_data_aging_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE ty_data_aging_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_daa_conceptual IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data_aging_status.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_days_old) = lv_current_date - iv_fldate.

    IF lv_days_old > gc_aging_threshold_days.
      rv_status = 'COLD'.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = 'HOT'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hot_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_cold_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_threshold_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hot_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_daa_conceptual( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum - 100. " 100 days old, should be hot

    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_data_aging_status( iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'HOT' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cold_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_daa_conceptual( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum - 400. " 400 days old, should be cold

    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_data_aging_status( iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'COLD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_threshold_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_daa_conceptual( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum - zcl_daa_conceptual=>gc_aging_threshold_days. " Exactly at threshold

    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_data_aging_status( iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'HOT' ). " Should still be hot (not > threshold)
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert konzeptionell die Logik hinter Data Aging, indem es ein Datum mit einem Schwellenwert vergleicht, um den "Aging-Status" zu bestimmen. Obwohl es nicht direkt die `FOR DATA AGING` Klausel verwendet, zeigt es, wie man in ABAP Datumsberechnungen für solche Zwecke durchführt. Die Verwendung von Konstanten für Schwellenwerte und aussagekräftige Typen verbessert die Wartbarkeit.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die maximale Sitzplatzkapazität für einen spezifischen Flug in einer sortierten Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `MODIFY TABLE itab FROM wa`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_srt_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights_sorted TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flight_seats
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flights_sorted
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_srt_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_seats.
    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM is_flight_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_existing FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_modify_non_existing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_existing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_srt_modify=>tt_flights_sorted(
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 150 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 200 ) ).
    DATA(ls_updated_flight) = VALUE zcl_srt_modify=>ty_flight(
                                 carrid   = 'LH'
                                 connid   = '0400'
                                 fldate   = sy-datum
                                 seatsmax = 180 ). " New seatsmax

    lo_cut->update_flight_seats( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights
                                IMPORTING is_flight_data = ls_updated_flight ).

    DATA(ls_result) = lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-seatsmax exp = 180 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ). " Count should remain same
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_modify_non_existing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_srt_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_srt_modify=>tt_flights_sorted(
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum seatsmax = 150 ) ).
    DATA(ls_new_flight) = VALUE zcl_srt_modify=>ty_flight(
                             carrid   = 'AA' " Non-existing
                             connid   = '0001'
                             fldate   = sy-datum
                             seatsmax = 250 ).

    lo_cut->update_flight_seats( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights
                                IMPORTING is_flight_data = ls_new_flight ).

    " For sorted tables, MODIFY TABLE inserts if key does not exist.
    " This is a key behavior difference from standard tables.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-seatsmax exp = 250 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `MODIFY TABLE` Anweisung ist der Standardweg, um Einträge in internen Tabellen zu aktualisieren. Für sortierte Tabellen ist sie besonders effizient, da sie den Primärschlüssel für die schnelle Lokalisierung des zu aktualisierenden Eintrags nutzt. Wenn der Schlüssel nicht existiert, wird der Eintrag eingefügt, wobei die Sortierreihenfolge beibehalten wird.
keywords: SORTED TABLE, MODIFY TABLE, Internal Tables, Update

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie "heiße" und "kalte" Flugdaten aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einer einzigen internen Tabelle, um einen vollständigen Überblick zu erhalten.
hint: Führen Sie zwei separate `SELECT` Anweisungen mit `FOR DATA AGING` und `FOR DATA AGING OLD` aus und fügen Sie die Ergebnisse zusammen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_daa_combine_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             aging_status TYPE c LENGTH 4, " HOT or COLD
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES: tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_flights_with_aging_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_daa_combine_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights_with_aging_status.
    DATA: lt_hot_flights  TYPE tt_flights,
          lt_cold_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    " Get hot data
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      FOR DATA AGING
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_hot_flights.

    " Assign aging status to hot data
    LOOP AT lt_hot_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_hot_flight>).
      <fs_hot_flight>-aging_status = 'HOT'.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Get cold data
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      FOR DATA AGING OLD
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_cold_flights.

    " Assign aging status to cold data
    LOOP AT lt_cold_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_cold_flight>).
      <fs_cold_flight>-aging_status = 'COLD'.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Combine both tables
    APPEND LINES OF lt_hot_flights TO rt_all_flights.
    APPEND LINES OF lt_cold_flights TO rt_all_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_combine_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_combine_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_daa_combine_data( ).

    " Similar to DAA_001/DAA_002, this test is highly dependent on
    " the system's data aging configuration and actual data in sflight.
    " For a real test, you'd need to ensure sflight has both hot and cold data
    " and that data aging is active.
    " Here, we'll just ensure the method runs and returns a table.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->get_all_flights_with_aging_status( ).

    " Assert that some data is returned (if expected in the test system)
    " and check the aging_status field.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_all_flights ).
    " IF lines( lt_all_flights ) > 0.
    "   cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lt_all_flights[ 1 ]-aging_status = 'HOT' OR
    "                                             lt_all_flights[ 1 ]-aging_status = 'COLD' ) ).
    " ENDIF.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_all_flights ). " Placeholder, adjust based on expected test data
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man Daten, die durch Data Aging in "heiße" und "kalte" Kategorien unterteilt sind, wieder zusammenführen kann. Durch separate `SELECT` Anweisungen mit `FOR DATA AGING` und `FOR DATA AGING OLD` und anschließendes Zusammenführen der Ergebnisse erhält man einen vollständigen Datensatz. Die Zuweisung des `aging_status` Feldes während der Verarbeitung hilft, die Herkunft der Daten zu kennzeichnen.
keywords: DATA AGING, Open SQL, SELECT, Hot Data, Cold Data, Internal Tables, Data Combination

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen Anwendungslog mit einem Header und zwei Nachrichten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_logobj` und die Methoden `create_log`, `add_message`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_creator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_simple_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_object    TYPE balobj_d
        iv_subobject TYPE balsubobj_d
        iv_extnumber TYPE balnrext_d OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_creator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_simple_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).

    lo_log->create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_object    = iv_object
        i_subobject = iv_subobject
        i_extnumber = iv_extnumber
    ).

    lo_log->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msgty = 'I'
        i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' " Example message class
        i_msgno = '001'     " Example message number
        i_msgv1 = 'Log created successfully'
    ).

    lo_log->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msgty = 'W'
        i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
        i_msgno = '002'
        i_msgv1 = 'Warning: Something happened'
    ).

    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    lo_log->save_log( ). " Save the log
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_log.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_app_log_creator( ).
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_creator->create_simple_log(
      iv_object    = 'ZTEST'
      iv_subobject = 'LOG'
      iv_extnumber = '001'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_log_handle ).

    " Optionally, read the log to verify content (more advanced)
    DATA(lo_log_reader) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).
    lo_log_reader->set_log_handle( lv_log_handle ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_log_reader->get_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_bal_logobj` wird zur Erstellung und Verwaltung von Anwendungslogs verwendet. Die Methoden `create_log` und `add_message` sind selbsterklärend. `get_log_handle` liefert den eindeutigen Identifikator des Logs, und `save_log` speichert ihn persistent. Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_log)`) sind ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: Application Log, BAL, CL_BAL_LOGOBJ, Logging, Message, 7.40

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Warnmeldungen (Typ 'W') aus einem gegebenen Anwendungslog-Handle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_logobj` und die Methode `get_messages` mit einem Filterausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_warning_messages
      IMPORTING
        iv_log_handle TYPE balloghndl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_warning_messages) TYPE bal_t_msg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_warning_messages.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).
    lo_log->set_log_handle( iv_log_handle ).

    " Use FILTER expression to get only warning messages
    rt_warning_messages = FILTER #( lo_log->get_messages( ) WHERE msgty = 'W' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_warning_messages FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_warning_messages.
    " First, create a log with mixed messages
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_app_log_creator( ). " Re-use creator from LOG_001
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_creator->create_simple_log(
      iv_object    = 'ZTEST'
      iv_subobject = 'LOG'
      iv_extnumber = '002'

    " Add an error message for good measure

Instructions: Lesen Sie die Details eines Termins, gegeben dessen GUID.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_appointment=>get_instance_by_guid` und die Getter-Methoden des Objekts.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_appointment_details,
        subject TYPE string,
        start_ts TYPE timestamp,
        end_ts   TYPE timestamp,
      END OF ty_appointment_details.

    METHODS get_appointment_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_guid TYPE guid_32
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_details) TYPE ty_appointment_details
      RAISING
        cx_appointment_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_appointment_details.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_appointment) = cl_appointment=>get_instance_by_guid( iv_guid ).
        rs_details = VALUE #( 
          subject  = lo_appointment->get_subject( )
          start_ts = lo_appointment->get_start_timestamp( )
          end_ts   = lo_appointment->get_end_timestamp( )
        ).
      CATCH cx_appointment_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_appointment_not_found( previous = lx_not_found ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_appointment_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_appointment_not_found.
    DATA(lo_reader) = NEW zcl_appointment_reader( ).
    DATA(lv_non_existent_guid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).

    " Expecting an exception for a non-existent GUID
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      class_name = 'CX_APPOINTMENT_NOT_FOUND'
      act = || lo_reader->get_appointment_details( lv_non_existent_guid )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `get_instance_by_guid` ist eine statische Fabrikmethode, die eine Instanz von `cl_appointment` basierend auf einer GUID zurückgibt. `VALUE`-Ausdrücke werden verwendet, um eine Struktur mit den extrahierten Details zu füllen. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` und das Auslösen einer spezifischen Ausnahme (`cx_appointment_not_found`) sind Best Practices.
keywords: Appointment, CL_APPOINTMENT, GUID, Object Orientation, Exception Handling, 7.40

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Anwendungslog mit einem Hauptobjekt und einem Unterobjekt. Fügen Sie Nachrichten hinzu, die sich auf das Unterobjekt beziehen, und verwenden Sie `bal_s_msg` für detailliertere Nachrichteninformationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_logobj` und die Struktur `bal_s_msg` für `add_message`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_subobj DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_log_with_subobj
      IMPORTING
        iv_object    TYPE balobj_d
        iv_subobject TYPE balsubobj_d
        iv_extnumber TYPE balnrext_d OPTIONAL
        iv_flight_id TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL " Example context
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_subobj IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_log_with_subobj.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).

    lo_log->create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_object    = iv_object
        i_subobject = iv_subobject
        i_extnumber = iv_extnumber
    ).

    " Add a message related to the main object
    lo_log->add_message(
      EXPORTING
        i_msgty = 'I'
        i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
        i_msgno = '001'
        i_msgv1 = 'Main log entry created'
    ).

    " Add a message related to the sub-object with context
    DATA(ls_msg) = VALUE bal_s_msg(
      msgty = 'I'
      msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
      msgno = '004'
      msgv1 = |Flight { iv_flight_id } processed.|
      detlevel = 1 " Detail level
    ).
    lo_log->add_message( EXPORTING i_s_msg = ls_msg ).

    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    lo_log->save_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_creator->create_log_with_subobj(
      iv_object    = 'ZTEST'
      iv_subobject = 'FLIGHT'
      iv_extnumber = 'F001'

    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_log_reader->get_messages( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 2 ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Anwendungslog und fügen Sie Nachrichten mit unterschiedlichen Detailstufen hinzu. Lesen Sie dann nur Nachrichten bis zu einer bestimmten Detailstufe aus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_logobj` und die Methoden `add_message` mit `detlevel` sowie `get_messages` mit `i_detlevel`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_detlevel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_read_log
      IMPORTING
        iv_object    TYPE balobj_d
        iv_subobject TYPE balsubobj_d
        iv_extnumber TYPE balnrext_d OPTIONAL
        iv_read_detlevel TYPE baldetlevl OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_messages) TYPE bal_t_msg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_detlevel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_log.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).

    lo_log->create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_object    = iv_object
        i_subobject = iv_subobject
        i_extnumber = iv_extnumber
    ).

    lo_log->add_message( EXPORTING i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '001' i_msgv1 = 'Level 1: High-level info' detlevel = 1 ).
    lo_log->add_message( EXPORTING i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '002' i_msgv1 = 'Level 2: Medium detail' detlevel = 2 ).
    lo_log->add_message( EXPORTING i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '003' i_msgv1 = 'Level 3: Fine detail' detlevel = 3 ).

    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    lo_log->save_log( ).

    " Read messages with specified detail level
    DATA(lo_log_reader) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).
    lo_log_reader->set_log_handle( lv_log_handle ).
    rt_filtered_messages = lo_log_reader->get_messages( i_detlevel = iv_read_detlevel ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_detlevel FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_detlevel.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_app_log_detlevel( ).

    " Test reading up to detail level 2
    DATA(lt_messages_level2) = lo_handler->create_and_read_log(
      iv_object        = 'ZTEST'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages_level2 ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages_level2[ 1 ]-detlevel exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages_level2[ 2 ]-detlevel exp = 2 ).

    DATA(lt_messages_level1) = lo_handler->create_and_read_log(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages_level1 ) exp = 1 ).

Beim Auslesen können dann nur Nachrichten bis zu einer bestimmten Detailstufe abgerufen werden, was eine flexible Steuerung der Log-Ausgabe ermöglicht. Instructions: Suchen Sie nach Terminen innerhalb eines bestimmten Zeitraums und filtern Sie diese nach einem Betreff-Muster. Verwenden Sie die Tabelle `SFLIGHT` als Kontext für die Termine.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_appointment=>get_appointments_by_selection` und `FILTER` für die Nachbearbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_search DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_appointment,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        subject  TYPE string,
        start_ts TYPE timestamp,
        end_ts   TYPE timestamp,
      END OF ty_flight_appointment,
      tt_flight_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS search_flight_appointments
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_ts TYPE timestamp
        iv_end_ts   TYPE timestamp
        iv_subject_pattern TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_found_appointments) TYPE tt_flight_appointments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_search IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD search_flight_appointments.
    " In a real scenario, cl_appointment would be linked to business objects.
    " For this example, we simulate appointments related to SFLIGHT.
    " cl_appointment=>get_appointments_by_selection is a conceptual method for search.
    " A direct search on SFLIGHT is used here for demonstration.

    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_t(
      FOR ls_flight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).

    DATA(lt_all_appointments) = VALUE tt_flight_appointments(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      LET lv_subject = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } on { ls_flight-fldate }|
          lv_start_ts = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = sy-tstmp iv_secs = ( ls_flight-connid * 100 ) ) " Simulate different times
          lv_end_ts = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_start_ts iv_secs = 3600 )
      IN
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        subject  = lv_subject
        start_ts = lv_start_ts
        end_ts   = lv_end_ts )
    ).

    rt_found_appointments = FILTER #( lt_all_appointments WHERE
      ( start_ts >= iv_start_ts AND end_ts <= iv_end_ts )
      AND ( iv_subject_pattern IS INITIAL OR subject CP iv_subject_pattern ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_search_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_search_appointments.
    DATA(lo_searcher) = NEW zcl_appointment_search( ).

    DATA(lv_search_start) = sy-tstmp.
    DATA(lv_search_end) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = sy-tstmp iv_secs = 10000 ).

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_searcher->search_flight_appointments(
      iv_start_ts        = lv_search_start
      iv_end_ts          = lv_search_end
      iv_subject_pattern = '*LH*'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_results ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_results ) > 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_results[ 1 ]-subject CP '*LH*' ).

    DATA(lt_all_results) = lo_searcher->search_flight_appointments(
      iv_start_ts        = lv_search_start
      iv_end_ts          = lv_search_end
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_all_results ) >= lines( lt_results ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Suche nach Terminen in einem bestimmten Zeitraum und das Filtern nach einem Betreff-Muster. Es verwendet `FOR`-Ausdrücke mit `LET` für die Inline-Berechnung von Werten und `FILTER` für die effiziente Selektion von Einträgen aus internen Tabellen. Die Integration mit der `SFLIGHT`-Tabelle zeigt, wie Termine mit Geschäftsdaten verknüpft werden können. `CP` für Mustervergleiche ist hier ebenfalls nützlich.

CLASS zcl_appointment_deleter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

        iv_guid TYPE guid_32
      RAISING
        cx_appointment_not_found
        cx_appointment_delete_failed.

CLASS zcl_appointment_deleter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_appointment.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_appointment) = cl_appointment=>get_instance_by_guid( iv_guid ).
        " In a real system, this would trigger the deletion from the database.
        " cl_appointment does not have a public 'delete' method directly; 
        " deletion is typically handled by a dedicated manager or transaction.
        " For this example, we assume a conceptual delete operation.
        " If cl_appointment had a 'delete' method, it would be called here.
        " Since it doesn't, we'll just let the object be 'marked' for deletion conceptually.

    CATCH cx_appointment_not_found INTO DATA(lx_not_found).
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_appointment_not_found( previous = lx_not_found ).
    CATCH cx_appointment_error INTO DATA(lx_error). " Generic error for appointment operations
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_appointment_delete_failed( previous = lx_error ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " This test simulates the deletion by creating a dummy appointment object
    " and conceptually 'deleting' it, as cl_appointment=>get_instance_by_guid
    " cannot be easily mocked for return values in standard ABAP Unit.
    DATA(lv_guid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_c32( ).
    DATA(lo_mock_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( ).
    lo_mock_appointment->set_guid( lv_guid ).
    lo_mock_appointment->set_subject( 'Appointment to be deleted' ).

    " Simulate the behavior of get_instance_by_guid returning our mock
    " For this example, we'll assume the 'delete' operation would succeed
    " if the object is found. The actual deletion logic is in the backend.
    " We assert that no exception is raised for a found appointment.
    DATA(lo_deleter) = NEW zcl_appointment_deleter( ).
    TRY.
        " In a real test, you'd mock cl_appointment=>get_instance_by_guid
        " to return lo_mock_appointment for lv_guid.
        " Here, we just call the method and expect no exception if the GUID was 'found'.
        " This test primarily covers the exception handling for 'not found'.
        " The 'mocked' part is more about the expectation of the method call.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_deleter ). " Just to use the object

      CATCH cx_appointment_not_found.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Anwendungslog und fügen Sie mehrere Nachrichten hinzu. Verwenden Sie dann `REDUCE` und `FOR` um eine Zusammenfassung der Nachrichten nach Typ zu erstellen (z.B. 'I: 2, W: 1, E: 0').
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bal_logobj`, `get_messages` und die Konstruktoren `REDUCE` und `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_message_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_object    TYPE balobj_d
        iv_subobject TYPE balsubobj_d
        iv_extnumber TYPE balnrext_d OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_message_summary.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).

    lo_log->create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_object    = iv_object
        i_subobject = iv_subobject
        i_extnumber = iv_extnumber
    ).

    lo_log->add_message( EXPORTING i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '001' i_msgv1 = 'Info 1' ).
    lo_log->add_message( EXPORTING i_msgty = 'I' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '002' i_msgv1 = 'Info 2' ).
    lo_log->add_message( EXPORTING i_msgty = 'W' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '003' i_msgv1 = 'Warning 1' ).
    lo_log->add_message( EXPORTING i_msgty = 'E' i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT' i_msgno = '004' i_msgv1 = 'Error 1' ).

    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    lo_log->save_log( ).

    DATA(lo_log_reader) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).
    lo_log_reader->set_log_handle( lv_log_handle ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_log_reader->get_messages( ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = REDUCE bal_t_msg_summary(
      INIT l_summary = VALUE bal_t_msg_summary( )
      FOR ls_msg IN lt_messages
      LET lv_index = line_index( l_summary[ msgty = ls_msg-msgty ] ) IN
      (
        COND #( WHEN lv_index IS NOT INITIAL
                THEN VALUE bal_t_msg_summary( FOR ls_sum IN l_summary INDEX lv_index
                                              ( msgty = ls_sum-msgty count = ls_sum-count + 1 ) )
                ELSE VALUE bal_t_msg_summary( BASE l_summary ( msgty = ls_msg-msgty count = 1 ) ) )
      )
    ).

    rv_summary = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ''
      FOR ls_sum IN lt_summary
      NEXT s = COND string(
        WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN |{ ls_sum-msgty }: { ls_sum-count }|
        ELSE |{ s }, { ls_sum-msgty }: { ls_sum-count }| )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_message_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_message_summary.
    DATA(lo_summarizer) = NEW zcl_app_log_summary( ).
    DATA(lv_summary) = lo_summarizer->get_message_summary(
      iv_object    = 'ZTEST'
      iv_subobject = 'SUM'
      iv_extnumber = 'S001'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_summary exp = 'I: 2, W: 1, E: 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_future DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_appointment,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate   TYPE s_date,
        subject  TYPE string,
        start_ts TYPE timestamp,
        end_ts   TYPE timestamp,
      END OF ty_flight_appointment,
      tt_flight_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flight_appointments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_appointments) TYPE tt_flight_appointments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_future IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flight_appointments.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_t(
      FOR ls_flight IN ( SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( ls_flight )
    ).

    DATA(lv_current_ts) = sy-tstmp.

    rt_future_appointments = VALUE tt_flight_appointments(
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      LET lv_subject = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } on { ls_flight-fldate }|
          lv_start_ts = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_current_ts iv_secs = ( ls_flight-connid * 100 ) ) " Simulate future times
          lv_end_ts = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_start_ts iv_secs = 3600 )
      WHERE lv_start_ts > lv_current_ts " Only include future appointments
      IN
      ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
        connid   = ls_flight-connid
        fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
        subject  = lv_subject
        start_ts = lv_start_ts
        end_ts   = lv_end_ts )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_future_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_future_appointments.
    DATA(lo_generator) = NEW zcl_appointment_future( ).
    DATA(lt_future_apps) = lo_generator->get_future_flight_appointments( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_future_apps ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_future_apps ) > 0 ).

    DATA(lv_current_ts) = sy-tstmp.
    LOOP AT lt_future_apps INTO DATA(ls_app).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_app-start_ts > lv_current_ts ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt `FOR`- und `VALUE`-Ausdrücke, um dynamisch Termine basierend auf Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHT` zu generieren. Die `LET`-Anweisung wird für lokale Variablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks verwendet, und die `WHERE`-Klausel filtert direkt die generierten Termine, sodass nur zukünftige Termine zurückgegeben werden. Dies ist ein sehr kompakter und effizienter Weg, Daten zu transformieren und zu filtern.
keywords: Appointment, CL_APPOINTMENT, SFLIGHT, For, Value, Internal Tables, Date/Time, 7.55

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Anwendungslog und fügen Sie Nachrichten aus einer internen Tabelle hinzu. Verwenden Sie `FOR` um die Nachrichten zu transformieren, bevor sie hinzugefügt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_bal_logobj`, `add_message` und den `FOR`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_for_messages DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_raw_message,
        type TYPE msgty,
        text TYPE string,
      END OF ty_raw_message,
      tt_raw_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_raw_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS log_transformed_messages
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_messages TYPE tt_raw_messages
        iv_object       TYPE balobj_d
        iv_subobject    TYPE balsubobj_d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_log_handle) TYPE balloghndl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_for_messages IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_transformed_messages.
    DATA(lo_log) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).

    lo_log->create_log(
      EXPORTING
        i_object    = iv_object
        i_subobject = iv_subobject
    ).

    " Use FOR expression to transform and add messages
    FOR ls_raw_msg IN it_raw_messages.
      lo_log->add_message(
        EXPORTING
          i_msgty = ls_raw_msg-type
          i_msgid = 'SFLIGHT'
          i_msgno = '000'
          i_msgv1 = |Transformed: { ls_raw_msg-text }|
      ).
    ENDFOR.

    rv_log_handle = lo_log->get_log_handle( ).
    lo_log->save_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_log_transformed_messages FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_log_transformed_messages.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_app_log_for_messages( ).
    DATA(lt_raw_messages) = VALUE zcl_app_log_for_messages=>tt_raw_messages(
      ( type = 'I' text = 'Initial message' )
      ( type = 'W' text = 'Another message' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_log_handle) = lo_logger->log_transformed_messages(
      it_raw_messages = lt_raw_messages
      iv_object       = 'ZTEST'
      iv_subobject    = 'TRANS'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_log_handle ).

    DATA(lo_log_reader) = NEW cl_bal_logobj( ).
    lo_log_reader->set_log_handle( lv_log_handle ).
    DATA(lt_logged_messages) = lo_log_reader->get_messages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_logged_messages ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_logged_messages[ 1 ]-msgv1 exp = 'Transformed: Initial message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie Nachrichten aus einer internen Tabelle mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck iteriert und transformiert werden können, bevor sie dem Anwendungslog hinzugefügt werden. Dies ist nützlich, um Nachrichten vor dem Protokollieren zu standardisieren oder anzureichern. Die Verwendung von `FOR` für die Iteration ist ein modernes und lesbares ABAP-Feature.
keywords: Application Log, BAL, CL_BAL_LOGOBJ, For, Internal Tables, Transformation, 7.50

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Termin und weisen Sie ihm einen externen Schlüssel zu, der auf eine Flugverbindung in `SFLIGHT` verweist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_appointment` und die Methode `set_external_key`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_extkey DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_flight_appointment
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_appointment) TYPE REF TO cl_appointment.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_extkey IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flight_appointment.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( ).

    DATA(lv_subject) = |Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } on { iv_fldate }|.
    lo_appointment->set_subject( lv_subject ).

    " Simulate start/end times
    DATA(lv_start_ts) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = sy-tstmp iv_secs = 3600 ).
    DATA(lv_end_ts) = cl_abap_tstmp=>add( iv_tstmp = lv_start_ts iv_secs = 3600 ).
    lo_appointment->set_start_timestamp( lv_start_ts ).
    lo_appointment->set_end_timestamp( lv_end_ts ).

    " Set external key referencing SFLIGHT
    DATA(lv_external_key) = |{ iv_carrid }-{ iv_connid }-{ iv_fldate }|.
    lo_appointment->set_external_key( lv_external_key ).

    ro_appointment = lo_appointment.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_flight_appointment FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_flight_appointment.
    DATA(lo_creator) = NEW zcl_appointment_extkey( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lo_appointment) = lo_creator->create_flight_appointment(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lo_appointment ).
    DATA(lv_expected_ext_key) = |{ lv_carrid }-{ lv_connid }-{ lv_fldate }|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_appointment->get_external_key( ) exp = lv_expected_ext_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `set_external_key` von `cl_appointment` ermöglicht das Verknüpfen eines Termins mit einem externen Geschäftsbeleg (hier: einer Flugverbindung). Dies ist entscheidend für die Integration von Terminen in Geschäftsprozesse. String-Templates werden verwendet, um den externen Schlüssel und den Betreff dynamisch zu erstellen.
keywords: Appointment, CL_APPOINTMENT, External Key, SFLIGHT, Object Orientation, 7.50

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Namen und Typen aller Komponenten einer gegebenen Struktur zur Laufzeit.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info,
           ty_component_info_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        is_structure TYPE any STRUCTURE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE ty_component_info_tab.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ) ).
    rt_components = VALUE #( FOR comp IN lo_struct_descr->get_components( )
                             ( name = comp-name
                               type = comp-type->get_name( ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_structure_components FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_structure_components.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_test_struct,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_test_struct.
    DATA: ls_test TYPE ty_test_struct.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_struct_comp( ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_cut->get_structure_components( ls_test ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_components )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Incorrect number of components'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'FIELD1' INTO DATA(ls_comp1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp1-type exp = 'STRING' ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = 'FIELD2' INTO DATA(ls_comp2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_comp2-type exp = 'I' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `describe_by_data` liefert eine generische Typbeschreibung, die dann mittels `CAST` in `cl_abap_structdescr` umgewandelt wird, um auf strukturspezifische Informationen zugreifen zu können. `get_components` liefert eine Tabelle mit den Komponentendetails. Die `VALUE #( FOR ... )` Syntax ist ein modernes Feature (ABAP 7.40) zur kompakten Initialisierung und Transformation von internen Tabellen.
keywords: RTTI, cl_abap_structdescr, get_components, Struktur, Komponenten, VALUE, FOR

CLASS zcl_http_parse_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle existiert, ohne `sy-subrc` explizit nach `READ TABLE` zu prüfen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax.

CLASS zcl_itab_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.

CLASS zcl_itab_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    IF line_exists( it_flights[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ).

    ELSE.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flugdatensatz aus der `SFLIGHT` Tabelle. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass kein Datensatz gefunden wird, indem Sie prüfen, ob die Zielstruktur initial ist, und dann eine Ausnahme auslösen, anstatt `sy-subrc` explizit zu prüfen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(...)` und prüfen Sie anschließend, ob die Struktur initial ist, um dann eine Ausnahme zu werfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_select_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight_data) TYPE ty_sflight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_no_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_select_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate, planetype
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(ls_flight_from_db).

    IF ls_flight_from_db IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_no_data.
    ENDIF.
    rs_flight_data = ls_flight_from_db.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_flight_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_no_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_select_single( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details(
      iv_carrid = 'AA'
      iv_connid = '0017'
      iv_fldate = '20250101'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_flight_not_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_select_single( ).
    lo_cut->get_flight_details(
      iv_carrid = 'XX'
      iv_connid = '9999'
      iv_fldate = '19000101'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception CX_SY_NO_DATA was not raised.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.40 kann `SELECT SINGLE` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @DATA(...)` verwendet werden. Wenn kein Datensatz gefunden wird, bleibt die inline deklarierte Struktur `ls_flight_from_db` initial. Durch die Prüfung auf `IS INITIAL` und das anschließende Auslösen einer Ausnahme wird eine explizite `sy-subrc`-Prüfung vermieden und eine saubere, objektorientierte Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: sy-subrc, SELECT SINGLE, Database, Exception Handling, IS INITIAL, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie einen Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle. Prüfen Sie den Erfolg der Operation mit einem `COND` Ausdruck anstelle einer `IF sy-subrc` Anweisung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_modify DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_entry
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE i
        iv_new_value TYPE string
      CHANGING
        ct_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_modify IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_entry.
    DATA(ls_entry) = VALUE ty_data( id = iv_id value = iv_new_value ).
    MODIFY TABLE ct_data FROM ls_entry INDEX iv_id.
    rv_success = COND abap_bool( WHEN sy-subrc = 0 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_failure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_itab_modify=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Old Value 1' )
      ( id = 2 value = 'Old Value 2' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_entry(
      iv_id = 1
      iv_new_value = 'New Value 1'
      CHANGING ct_data = lt_data
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-value exp = 'New Value 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_modify( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_itab_modify=>tt_data(
      ( id = 1 value = 'Old Value 1' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_entry(
      iv_id = 99
      iv_new_value = 'New Value'
      CHANGING ct_data = lt_data
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-value exp = 'Old Value 1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare Zuweisung eines booleschen Wertes basierend auf dem `sy-subrc` nach einer Operation. Dies ist eine moderne Art, bedingte Logik auszudrücken, die oft eine `IF`-Anweisung ersetzen kann.
keywords: sy-subrc, Internal Tables, MODIFY TABLE, COND, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Rufen Sie einen Funktionsbaustein auf, der Ausnahmen auslösen kann. Behandeln Sie die Ausnahmen mit `TRY...CATCH` anstelle der traditionellen `sy-subrc` Prüfung nach `CALL FUNCTION`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `EXCEPTIONS` Klausel im `CALL FUNCTION` und fangen Sie die entsprechenden Ausnahmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_func_exception_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_function_with_exceptions
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest_error.

    PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_function_module
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE i
      EXPORTING
        ev_output TYPE i
      EXCEPTIONS
        input_too_high
        input_is_zero.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_func_exception_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_function_with_exceptions.
    DATA(lv_output) = 0.
    TRY.
        simulate_function_module(
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_input
          IMPORTING
            ev_output = lv_output
          EXCEPTIONS
            input_too_high = 1
            input_is_zero  = 2
            OTHERS         = 3
        ).
        rv_result = lv_output.
      CATCH cx_abap_message_digest_error. 
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest_error.
      CATCH cx_root.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD simulate_function_module.
    IF iv_input > 100.
      RAISE input_too_high.
    ELSEIF iv_input = 0.
      RAISE input_is_zero.
    ELSE.
      ev_output = iv_input * 2.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_function_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_function_input_too_high FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_message_digest_error.
    METHODS test_function_input_is_zero FOR TESTING RAISING cx_abap_message_digest_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_function_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_func_exception_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_function_with_exceptions( iv_input = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_function_input_too_high.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_func_exception_handling( ).
    lo_cut->call_function_with_exceptions( iv_input = 150 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception was not raised.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_function_input_is_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_func_exception_handling( ).
    lo_cut->call_function_with_exceptions( iv_input = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception was not raised.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `EXCEPTIONS` in der `CALL FUNCTION` Anweisung in Kombination mit `TRY...CATCH` Blöcken ist der moderne Weg, Fehler von Funktionsbausteinen zu behandeln. Dies führt zu robusterem und besser strukturiertem Code im Vergleich zur Prüfung von `sy-subrc`.
keywords: sy-subrc, CALL FUNCTION, Exception Handling, TRY...CATCH

Instructions: Anstatt eine Fehlermeldung direkt mit `MESSAGE` auszugeben, lösen Sie eine Ausnahme aus, die eine Meldung aus einer Nachrichtenklasse verwendet. Dies ermöglicht eine zentralisierte Fehlerbehandlung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest_error.

  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS check_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    check_value( iv_value = iv_value ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_value.
    IF iv_value <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest_error
        MESSAGE E001(ZMSG_DEMO) WITH iv_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Es trennt die Fehlererkennung von der Fehlerbehandlung und ermöglicht es dem aufrufenden Programm, auf den Fehler zu reagieren, anstatt die Programmausführung direkt zu unterbrechen. Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen Text von einem Quell-Zeichensatz in einen Ziel-Zeichensatz unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_I18N_UTILS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `CL_I18N_UTILS=>CONVERT_TEXT_TO_CHARSET`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_i18n_charset_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
        iv_source_charset TYPE string
        iv_target_charset TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_converted_text) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_i18n_charset_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_text.
    TRY.
        rv_converted_text = cl_i18n_utils=>convert_text_to_charset(
          i_text          = iv_text
          i_source_charset = iv_source_charset
          i_target_charset = iv_target_charset
        ).
      CATCH cx_sy_codepage_converter_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_conversion_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_charset_conv( ).
    DATA(lv_original_text) = 'Hello, World! ÄÖÜäöüß'.
    DATA(lv_converted_text) = lo_cut->convert_text(
      iv_text = lv_original_text
      iv_source_charset = 'UTF-8'
      iv_target_charset = 'UTF-8'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_converted_text exp = lv_original_text ).

    DATA(lv_iso_text) = lo_cut->convert_text(
      iv_text = 'Grüße'
      iv_source_charset = 'UTF-8'
      iv_target_charset = 'ISO-8859-1'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_iso_text exp = 'Grüße' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_conversion_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_i18n_charset_conv( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->convert_text(
          iv_text = 'Test'
          iv_source_charset = 'INVALID-CHARSET'
          iv_target_charset = 'UTF-8'
        ).

Instructions: Wählen Sie einen zufälligen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`).
hint: Bestimmen Sie die Anzahl der Zeilen, generieren Sie einen zufälligen Index und verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... INDEX ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_entry DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_flight
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_entry IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_flight.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_flights ).
    IF lv_table_size = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = lv_table_size
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE it_flights INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_random_flight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_entry( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_random_table_entry=>tt_sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_flights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    IF lines( lt_flights ) = 0.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(ls_random_flight) = lo_cut->get_random_flight( it_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

      exp = abap_false

    ).
    DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight = ls_random_flight.
        lv_found = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_found
      msg = 'Selected flight must be from the input table'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Einträge einer internen Tabelle (z.B. `sflights`) zufällig.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, indem Sie zufällige Elemente aus der Quelltabelle auswählen und entfernen, bis diese leer ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_table.
    DATA(lt_temp_table) = it_source_table.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( lt_temp_table ).

    IF lv_table_size = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = lv_table_size
    ).

    DO lv_table_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_current_size) = lines( lt_temp_table ).
      IF lv_current_size = 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lo_random_index->set_high( lv_current_size ).
      DATA(lv_index_to_pick) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).

      READ TABLE lt_temp_table INDEX lv_index_to_pick INTO DATA(ls_picked_entry).
      APPEND ls_picked_entry TO rt_shuffled_table.
      DELETE TABLE lt_temp_table INDEX lv_index_to_pick.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_shuffle_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230102' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '1000' fldate = '20230103' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'DL' connid = '2000' fldate = '20230104' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_shuffled_flights) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( it_source_table = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_shuffled_flights )
      exp = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'Shuffled table must have same number of lines'
    ).

    DATA(lt_sorted_original) = lt_flights.
    SORT lt_sorted_original BY carrid connid fldate.
    DATA(lt_sorted_shuffled) = lt_shuffled_flights.
    SORT lt_sorted_shuffled BY carrid connid fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_sorted_shuffled
      exp = lt_sorted_original
      msg = 'Shuffled table must contain the same elements as original'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_shuffle_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA: lt_empty_flights TYPE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lt_shuffled_empty) = lo_cut->shuffle_table( it_source_table = lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_shuffled_empty
      msg = 'Shuffling an empty table should result in an empty table'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Mischen einer internen Tabelle. Es verwendet `cl_abap_random_int` um zufällige Indizes zu generieren und Elemente aus einer temporären Tabelle zu entnehmen und in die Ergebnistabelle einzufügen. Die `DO ... TIMES` Schleife und Inline-Deklarationen sind moderne ABAP-Features.

Instructions: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen alphanumerischen String von 10 Zeichen Länge.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_string_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_string.
    CONSTANTS: lc_charset TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_charset_length) = strlen( lc_charset ).

    IF iv_length <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_char_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 0
      high = lv_charset_length - 1
    ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random_char_index->get_next( ).
      DATA(lv_random_char) = lc_charset+lv_random_index(1).
      rv_random_string = rv_random_string && lv_random_char.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine eindeutige ID, die einen Zeitstempel und eine zufällige Komponente kombiniert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `GET TIME STAMP` und `cl_abap_random_int`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_id_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_unique_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_unique_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_id_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_id.
    DATA(lv_timestamp) = cl_abap_tstmp=>utclong_current( ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 10000 high = 99999 ).
    DATA(lv_random_part) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    rv_unique_id = |{ lv_timestamp WIDTH = 21 ALIGN = RIGHT PAD = '0' }{ lv_random_part WIDTH = 5 ALIGN = RIGHT PAD = '0' }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_unique_id_format FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unique_id_uniqueness FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unique_id_format.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_id_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_id) = lo_cut->get_unique_id( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = strlen( lv_id )
      exp = 26
      msg = 'Unique ID should have length 26 (21 for timestamp + 5 for random)'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_id
      msg = 'Unique ID should not be initial'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unique_id_uniqueness.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_id_generator( ).
    DATA: lt_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DO 100 TIMES.
      APPEND lo_cut->get_unique_id( ) TO lt_ids.
    ENDDO.
    DATA(lv_distinct_ids) = lines( lt_ids ).
    SORT lt_ids ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_ids.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_distinct_ids
      exp = 100
      msg = 'All generated IDs should be unique'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert den aktuellen UTC-Zeitstempel mit einer zufälligen Zahl, um eine hochgradig eindeutige ID zu generieren. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die Formatierung verwendet, was eine moderne und lesbare Syntax darstellt.
keywords: RANDOM, UNIQUE ID, TIMESTAMP, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, DATA, STRING_TEMPLATES

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die mit 70% Wahrscheinlichkeit 'Success' und mit 30% Wahrscheinlichkeit 'Failure' zurückgibt.
hint: Generieren Sie eine Zufallszahl zwischen 1 und 100 und prüfen Sie, ob sie kleiner oder gleich 70 ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_probability_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_outcome
      IMPORTING
        iv_success_probability TYPE i DEFAULT 70
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_outcome) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_probability_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_outcome.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = 100 ).
    DATA(lv_random_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    IF lv_random_number <= iv_success_probability.
      rv_outcome = 'Success'.
    ELSE.
      rv_outcome = 'Failure'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_outcome_distribution FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_outcome_distribution.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_probability_checker( ).
    DATA(lv_success_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_failure_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 1000.

    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lv_outcome) = lo_cut->get_random_outcome( iv_success_probability = 70 ).
      IF lv_outcome = 'Success'.
        lv_success_count = lv_success_count + 1.
      ELSE.
        lv_failure_count = lv_failure_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lv_expected_success_min) = lv_iterations * 0.6.
    DATA(lv_expected_success_max) = lv_iterations * 0.8.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_success_count >= lv_expected_success_min AND lv_success_count <= lv_expected_success_max )
      msg = 'Success count should be approximately 70%'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_success_count + lv_failure_count = lv_iterations )
      msg = 'Total count should match iterations'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mit `cl_abap_random_int` eine zufällige Entscheidung basierend auf einer Wahrscheinlichkeit trifft. Die Verwendung von `IF ... ELSE` und Inline-Deklarationen ist Standard in modernem ABAP.
keywords: RANDOM, PROBABILITY, CONDITIONAL, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, DATA

Instructions: Wählen Sie eine zufällige Stichprobe von 10% der Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Berechnen Sie die Stichprobengröße, verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` und `FOR` mit `COND` oder `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_sampler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_sample
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_percentage   TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 0 DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sample_table) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_sampler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sample.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_source_table ).
    IF lv_table_size = 0 OR iv_percentage <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_sample_size) = ceil( lv_table_size * iv_percentage / 100 ).
    IF lv_sample_size > lv_table_size.
      lv_sample_size = lv_table_size.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_temp_table) = it_source_table.
    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = lv_table_size ).

    DO lv_sample_size TIMES.
      DATA(lv_current_size) = lines( lt_temp_table ).
      IF lv_current_size = 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      lo_random_index->set_high( lv_current_size ).
      DATA(lv_index_to_pick) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).

      READ TABLE lt_temp_table INDEX lv_index_to_pick INTO DATA(ls_picked_entry).
      APPEND ls_picked_entry TO rt_sample_table.
      DELETE TABLE lt_temp_table INDEX lv_index_to_pick.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_sample_size FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_sample_content FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table_sample FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_sample_size.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_sampler( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_table_sampler=>tt_sflight.

    DO 100 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lt_sample) = lo_cut->get_random_sample( it_source_table = lt_flights iv_percentage = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_sample )
      exp = 10
      msg = 'Sample size should be 10% of 100, i.e., 10'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_sample_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_sampler( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_table_sampler=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230102' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '1000' fldate = '20230103' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'DL' connid = '2000' fldate = '20230104' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_sample) = lo_cut->get_random_sample( it_source_table = lt_flights iv_percentage = 50 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_sample )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Sample size should be 50% of 4, i.e., 2'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_sample INTO DATA(ls_sample_entry).
      DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
      LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        IF ls_flight = ls_sample_entry.
          lv_found = abap_true.
          EXIT.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = lv_found
        msg = 'Sampled entry must exist in original table'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table_sample.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_sampler( ).
    DATA: lt_empty_flights TYPE zcl_table_sampler=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lt_sample) = lo_cut->get_random_sample( it_source_table = lt_empty_flights iv_percentage = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_sample
      msg = 'Sampling an empty table should result in an empty table'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es berechnet die Stichprobengröße und wählt dann zufällige Elemente aus der Quelltabelle aus, wobei die bereits ausgewählten Elemente entfernt werden, um Duplikate zu vermeiden. CLASS zcl_random_date_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d DEFAULT '20200101'
        iv_end_date   TYPE d DEFAULT '20251231'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_random_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_date_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_date.
    DATA(lv_start_days) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_since_00010101( iv_start_date ).
    DATA(lv_end_days) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_days_since_00010101( iv_end_date ).

    DATA(lo_random_days) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = lv_start_days
      high = lv_end_days
    ).
    DATA(lv_random_days) = lo_random_days->get_next( ).

    rv_random_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_date_from_days_since_00010101( lv_random_days ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Passwort einer bestimmten Länge, das Großbuchstaben, Kleinbuchstaben, Ziffern und Sonderzeichen enthält.
hint: Definieren Sie verschiedene Zeichensätze und wählen Sie zufällig Zeichen daraus aus, um das Passwort zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_password_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 12
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_password_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_password.
    CONSTANTS: lc_upper    TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ',
               lc_lower    TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz',
               lc_digits   TYPE string VALUE '0123456789',
               lc_special  TYPE string VALUE '!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:,.<>?'.
    DATA(lc_all_chars) = lc_upper && lc_lower && lc_digits && lc_special.
    DATA(lv_all_chars_length) = strlen( lc_all_chars ).

    IF iv_length <= 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_char_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 0
      high = lv_all_chars_length - 1
    ).

    DO iv_length TIMES.
      DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random_char_index->get_next( ).
      DATA(lv_random_char) = lc_all_chars+lv_random_index(1).
      rv_password = rv_password && lv_random_char.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
