CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_password_length FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_password_content_diversity FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_password_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_password_length.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_password_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_cut->generate_password( iv_length = 16 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = strlen( lv_password )
      exp = 16
      msg = 'Generated password should have length 16'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_password_content_diversity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_password_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_cut->generate_password( iv_length = 20 ).

    CONSTANTS: lc_upper    TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ',
               lc_lower    TYPE string VALUE 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz',
               lc_digits   TYPE string VALUE '0123456789',
               lc_special  TYPE string VALUE '!@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;:,.<>?'.

    DATA(lv_has_upper) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_has_lower) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_has_digit) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_has_special) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT lv_password INTO DATA(lv_char).
      IF lc_upper CS lv_char.
        lv_has_upper = abap_true.
      ELSEIF lc_lower CS lv_char.
        lv_has_lower = abap_true.
      ELSEIF lc_digits CS lv_char.
        lv_has_digit = abap_true.
      ELSEIF lc_special CS lv_char.
        lv_has_special = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_upper   msg = 'Password should contain uppercase characters' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_lower   msg = 'Password should contain lowercase characters' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_digit   msg = 'Password should contain digits' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_has_special msg = 'Password should contain special characters' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_password_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_password_generator( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_cut->generate_password( iv_length = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_password
      msg = 'Generating password with length 0 should result in an empty string'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es verwendet `cl_abap_random_int` zur Auswahl von Zeichen aus vordefinierten Zeichensätzen und String-Verkettung (`&&`) zum Aufbau des Passworts. Inline-Deklarationen und Konstanten sind moderne Praktiken.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Einträge einer internen Tabelle zufällig in eine angegebene Anzahl von Gruppen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` für die Gruppenzuweisung und `FOR` mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             group_id TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group,
             group_id TYPE i,
             flights  TYPE tt_sflight,
           END OF ty_group.
    TYPES: tt_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_randomly
      IMPORTING
        it_source_table TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_num_groups   TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_data) TYPE tt_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_randomly.
    IF iv_num_groups <= 0 OR lines( it_source_table ) = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_flights_with_group) = it_source_table.
    DATA(lo_random_group_id) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = iv_num_groups ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights_with_group ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-group_id = lo_random_group_id->get_next( ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_grouped_data = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_flights_with_group GROUP BY ( group_id = ls_group-group_id ) ASCENDING
                                 ( group_id = ls_group-group_id
                                   flights  = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group ( ls_flight ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_grouping_count FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_grouping_content FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table_grouping FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_zero_groups FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_grouping_count.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouper( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_random_grouper=>tt_sflight.

    DO 50 TIMES.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_randomly( it_source_table = lt_flights iv_num_groups = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( lt_grouped ) <= 5 AND lines( lt_grouped ) > 0 )
      msg = 'Number of groups should be between 1 and 5'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_grouping_content.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouper( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_random_grouper=>tt_sflight.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230102' ) TO lt_flights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'UA' connid = '1000' fldate = '20230103' ) TO lt_flights.

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_randomly( it_source_table = lt_flights iv_num_groups = 2 ).

    DATA(lv_total_flights_in_groups) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_group).
      lv_total_flights_in_groups = lv_total_flights_in_groups + lines( ls_group-flights ).
      LOOP AT ls_group-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_in_group).
        DATA(lv_found) = abap_false.
        LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_original_flight).
          IF ls_original_flight-carrid = ls_flight_in_group-carrid AND
             ls_original_flight-connid = ls_flight_in_group-connid AND
             ls_original_flight-fldate = ls_flight_in_group-fldate.
            lv_found = abap_true.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = lv_found
          msg = 'Flight in group must be from original table'
        ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_flights_in_groups
      exp = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'All original flights should be present in groups'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouper( ).
    DATA: lt_empty_flights TYPE zcl_random_grouper=>tt_sflight.
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_randomly( it_source_table = lt_empty_flights iv_num_groups = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_grouped
      msg = 'Grouping an empty table should result in an empty grouped table'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_groups.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouper( ).
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_random_grouper=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_flights.
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_randomly( it_source_table = lt_flights iv_num_groups = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lt_grouped
      msg = 'Grouping with zero groups should result in an empty grouped table'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die zufällige Gruppierung von Tabelleneinträgen. Zuerst wird jedem Eintrag eine zufällige Gruppen-ID zugewiesen. Anschließend wird die Tabelle mit `FOR GROUPS OF ... GROUP BY` nach dieser zufälligen ID gruppiert. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales ABAP-Feature (7.50+).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Factory-Methode, die zufällig eine von zwei Implementierungen eines Interfaces zurückgibt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_random_int` zur Entscheidung und `CREATE OBJECT` mit dem Interface-Typ.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_random_behavior.
  METHODS execute_action RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_behavior_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_random_behavior.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_behavior_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_random_behavior~execute_action.
    rv_result = 'Behavior A executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_behavior_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_random_behavior.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_behavior_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_random_behavior~execute_action.
    rv_result = 'Behavior B executed'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_behavior
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_behavior) TYPE REF TO zif_random_behavior.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_behavior.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 1 high = 2 ).
    DATA(lv_choice) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    IF lv_choice = 1.
      CREATE OBJECT ro_behavior TYPE zcl_behavior_a.
    ELSE.
      CREATE OBJECT ro_behavior TYPE zcl_behavior_b.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_factory_output FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_random_factory_diversity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_factory_output.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_factory( ).
    DATA(lo_behavior) = lo_cut->get_random_behavior( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_behavior->execute_action( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_result = 'Behavior A executed' OR lv_result = 'Behavior B executed' )
      msg = 'Result should be from either Behavior A or B'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_random_factory_diversity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_factory( ).
    DATA(lv_count_a) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_b) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 100.

    DO lv_iterations TIMES.
      DATA(lo_behavior) = lo_cut->get_random_behavior( ).
      DATA(lv_result) = lo_behavior->execute_action( ).
      IF lv_result = 'Behavior A executed'.
        lv_count_a = lv_count_a + 1.
      ELSEIF lv_result = 'Behavior B executed'.
        lv_count_b = lv_count_b + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_count_a > 0 AND lv_count_b > 0 )
      msg = 'Both behaviors should have been instantiated at least once'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ( lv_count_a + lv_count_b )
      exp = lv_iterations
      msg = 'Total count should match iterations'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine Factory-Methode, die zufällig eine von mehreren Implementierungen eines Interfaces zurückgibt. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept der Objektorientierung, das in modernem ABAP durch die Verwendung von Interfaces und `CREATE OBJECT` mit dynamischer Typzuweisung elegant umgesetzt werden kann. `cl_abap_random_int` steuert die Zufallsauswahl.

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig einen Feldnamen aus einer internen Tabelle und geben Sie dessen Wert für einen bestimmten Eintrag zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie RTTI, um Feldnamen zu erhalten, `cl_abap_random_int` zur Auswahl und dynamischen Zugriff auf den Feldwert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_field_accessor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_random_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_entry TYPE ty_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_field_accessor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_field_value.
    DATA: lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA: lt_components   TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.
    DATA: lv_component_name TYPE string.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_flight_entry ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    DATA(lv_num_components) = lines( lt_components ).
    IF lv_num_components = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( low = 0 high = lv_num_components - 1 ).
    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components INDEX lv_random_index + 1 INTO DATA(ls_component).
    lv_component_name = ls_component-name.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT lv_component_name OF STRUCTURE is_flight_entry TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_value>).
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_field_value = <fs_value>.
    ELSE.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_field_access FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val.
    METHODS test_empty_structure FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_field_access.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_field_accessor( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_random_field_accessor=>ty_sflight(
      carrid = 'LH'
      connid = '400'
      fldate = '20231026'
    ).

    DATA(lv_field_value) = lo_cut->get_random_field_value( is_flight_entry = ls_flight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_field_value = ls_flight-carrid OR
              lv_field_value = ls_flight-connid OR
              lv_field_value = ls_flight-fldate )
      msg = 'Returned value should match one of the flight fields'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_structure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_field_accessor( ).
    DATA(ls_empty_flight) TYPE zcl_random_field_accessor=>ty_sflight.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = NEW zcx_abap_unit_assert( )
      exp = cx_sy_dyn_table_ill_comp_val
      msg = 'Should raise exception for empty structure (no components)'
    ).
    lo_cut->get_random_field_value( is_flight_entry = ls_empty_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Auswahl und den Zugriff auf Feldwerte einer Struktur zur Laufzeit. Es verwendet RTTI (`cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data`, `get_components`) um die Strukturkomponenten zu ermitteln, `cl_abap_random_int` zur Auswahl eines zufälligen Feldnamens und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL` für den dynamischen Zugriff. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature für dynamische Programmierung.
keywords: RANDOM, DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING, RTTI, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, DATA, ASSIGN COMPONENT

Instructions: Verbinden Sie die Tabellen SFLIGHT und SBOOK mittels eines INNER JOINs und lesen Sie die Flugdaten zusammen mit den Buchungsdaten in eine interne Tabelle ein. Nutzen Sie dabei Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... INNER JOIN ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_inner_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_sbook,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid, b~customid, b~custtype
      FROM sflight AS s
      INNER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      INTO TABLE @rt_joined_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_get_joined_data FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen LEFT OUTER JOIN zwischen SFLIGHT und SBOOK durch. Erstellen Sie anschließend eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug die Anzahl der Buchungen enthält. Wenn ein Flug keine Buchungen hat, soll die Anzahl 0 sein. Nutzen Sie dabei den LEFT OUTER JOIN und eine FOR-Expression zur Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... LEFT OUTER JOIN ... und anschließend eine FOR-Expression mit GROUP BY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_left_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking_count,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             book_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_booking_count.
    METHODS get_flight_booking_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_booking_count WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_left_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_booking_counts.
    DATA: lt_joined_data TYPE TABLE OF ty_sflight_sbook. " Reusing type from JON_001 for simplicity

    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_joined_data).

    rt_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_group> IN lt_raw_joined_data GROUP BY carrid = <fs_group>-carrid,
                                                              connid = <fs_group>-connid,
                                                              fldate = <fs_group>-fldate
      ( carrid = <fs_group>-carrid
        connid = <fs_group>-connid
        fldate = <fs_group>-fldate
        book_count = REDUCE i( INIT count = 0 FOR <fs_item> IN GROUP <fs_group> WHERE ( <fs_item>-bookid IS NOT INITIAL ) NEXT count = count + 1 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_booking_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flight_booking_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_left_for( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_booking_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Check if any flight has a booking count of 0 (for flights without bookings)
    DATA(lv_has_zero_bookings) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE book_count = 0.
      lv_has_zero_bookings = abap_true.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    " This assertion depends on test data. If SFLIGHT has entries without SBOOK entries, this should be true.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_zero_bookings ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert einen LEFT OUTER JOIN, um alle Flüge und deren zugehörige Buchungen zu erhalten, auch wenn keine Buchungen existieren. Anschließend wird eine FOR-Expression mit GROUP BY und REDUCE verwendet, um die Anzahl der Buchungen pro Flug zu aggregieren. Dies ist ein sehr modernes und funktionales Muster in ABAP 7.50+, um Daten effizient zu verarbeiten und zu transformieren.
keywords: JOINS, LEFT OUTER JOIN, FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, SFLIGHT, SBOOK

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie die Flugdaten von SFLIGHT und die Buchungsdaten von SBOOK (nur die gemeinsamen Felder) in einer einzigen internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie dafür den UNION ALL Operator und Inline-Deklarationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... UNION ALL SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_all_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_or_booking,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             source TYPE c LENGTH 1, " 'F' for flight, 'B' for booking
           END OF ty_flight_or_booking.
    METHODS get_combined_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_combined_data) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_or_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_all_inline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, 'F' AS source
      FROM sflight
      UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, 'B' AS source
      FROM sbook
      INTO TABLE @rt_combined_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_combined_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_all_inline( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_combined_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Check if both flight and booking entries are present
    DATA(lv_has_flights) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_has_bookings) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF ls_entry-source = 'F'.
        lv_has_flights = abap_true.
      ELSEIF ls_entry-source = 'B'.
        lv_has_bookings = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_bookings ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der UNION ALL Operator ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse von zwei oder mehr SELECT-Anweisungen zu kombinieren. Hier werden Flug- und Buchungsdaten in einer einzigen internen Tabelle zusammengeführt, wobei ein 'source'-Feld angibt, woher der Datensatz stammt. Die Inline-Deklaration @DATA(...) macht den Code schlanker.
keywords: JOINS, UNION ALL, SELECT, Inline Declaration, SFLIGHT, SBOOK

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Tabellennamen (z.B. 'SFLIGHT'). Füllen Sie diese Tabelle mit den ersten 5 Einträgen der entsprechenden Datenbanktabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie CREATE DATA dref TYPE TABLE OF (lv_table_name) und FIELD-SYMBOLS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_dynamic_table_data
      IMPORTING iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING VALUE(rr_data) TYPE REF TO DATA.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_table_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    CREATE DATA rr_data TYPE TABLE OF (iv_table_name).
    ASSIGN rr_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    IF <lt_dynamic_table> IS ASSIGNED.
      TRY.
          SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name) UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
        CATCH cx_sy_dynamic_osql_error.
          " Handle error, e.g., table not found or no authorization
          CLEAR rr_data.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_get_dynamic_table_data FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen HASHED TABLE Typ für SFLIGHT-Daten mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle und demonstrieren Sie einen effizienten Zugriff über den Schlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie TYPES: ... HASHED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ... und READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_hashed_table_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_hashed_table TYPE HASHED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING is_key        TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.

    METHODS fill_hashed_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_hashed_table) TYPE ty_sflight_hashed_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hashed_table_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_hashed_table.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS INTO TABLE @rt_hashed_table.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA(lt_flights) = fill_hashed_table( ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO rs_flight WITH TABLE KEY carrid = is_key-carrid
                                                connid = is_key-connid
                                                fldate = is_key-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_details FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_fill_hashed_table FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fill_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_type( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->fill_hashed_table( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_hashed_table_type( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->fill_hashed_table( ).

    IF lines( lt_all_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_all_flights[ 1 ].
      DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_type=>ty_sflight_key(
        carrid = ls_first_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_first_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_first_flight-fldate
      ).
      DATA(ls_found_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( ls_key ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-carrid exp = ls_key-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-connid exp = ls_key-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-fldate exp = ls_key-fldate ).
    ELSE.
      " If no data, test that lookup returns initial
      DATA(ls_key_empty) = VALUE zcl_hashed_table_type=>ty_sflight_key(
        carrid = 'XX' connid = '000' fldate = sy-datum
      ).
      DATA(ls_found_flight_empty) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( ls_key_empty ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_found_flight_empty ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Hashed Tables bieten den schnellsten Zugriff auf Datensätze über ihren Schlüssel, da sie einen Hash-Algorithmus verwenden. Die Definition des Typs mit UNIQUE KEY stellt sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge existieren. Dies ist ideal für Lookups, bei denen die Performance entscheidend ist. Die Methode fill_hashed_table füllt die Tabelle, und get_flight_details demonstriert den effizienten Zugriff.
keywords: TYPES, HASHED TABLE, Internal Tables, Performance, READ TABLE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen JOIN zwischen zwei internen Tabellen (eine für Flüge, eine für Buchungen) und gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse, um die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere pro Flug zu ermitteln. Nutzen Sie dafür FOR-Expressions mit GROUP BY und REDUCE.
hint: Erstellen Sie zwei interne Tabellen und verwenden Sie dann eine verschachtelte FOR-Expression mit GROUP BY und REDUCE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_group_join_sim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_data,
             carrid TYPE sbook-carrid,
             connid TYPE sbook-connid,
             fldate TYPE sbook-fldate,
             bookid TYPE sbook-bookid,
             passnum TYPE sbook-passnum,
           END OF ty_booking_data.
    TYPES: tt_booking_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_passenger_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             total_passengers TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_passenger_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_passenger_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_passenger_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_passenger_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_passenger_counts) TYPE tt_flight_passenger_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_group_join_sim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_passenger_counts.
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR s IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, planetype FROM sflight UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, s~planetype )
    ).

    DATA(lt_bookings) = VALUE tt_booking_data(
      FOR b IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, bookid, passnum FROM sbook UP TO 20 ROWS )
      ( b~carrid, b~connid, b~fldate, b~bookid, b~passnum )
    ).

    rt_passenger_counts = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF <fs_flight_group> IN lt_flights GROUP BY carrid = <fs_flight_group>-carrid,
                                                              connid = <fs_flight_group>-connid,
                                                              fldate = <fs_flight_group>-fldate
      ( carrid = <fs_flight_group>-carrid
        connid = <fs_flight_group>-connid
        fldate = <fs_flight_group>-fldate
        total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
          FOR <fs_booking> IN lt_bookings WHERE ( carrid = <fs_flight_group>-carrid AND
                                                  connid = <fs_flight_group>-connid AND
                                                  fldate = <fs_flight_group>-fldate )
          NEXT sum = sum + <fs_booking>-passnum
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_passenger_counts FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_passenger_counts.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_group_join_sim( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_passenger_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Example: Check if a specific flight has a non-zero passenger count if expected
    " This requires knowledge of test data in SFLIGHT/SBOOK
    " DATA(ls_test_flight) = VALUE zcl_for_group_join_sim=>ty_flight_passenger_count(
    "   carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' ).
    " READ TABLE lt_result INTO ls_test_flight WITH KEY carrid = ls_test_flight-carrid
    "                                                connid = ls_test_flight-connid
    "                                                fldate = ls_test_flight-fldate.
    " IF sy-subrc = 0.
    "   cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_test_flight-total_passengers exp = 0 ).
    " ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von FOR-Expressions mit GROUP BY und REDUCE, um Daten aus internen Tabellen zu aggregieren und zu transformieren. Es simuliert einen JOIN-Vorgang auf internen Tabellen und zeigt, wie man komplexe Aggregationen (hier: Summe der Passagiere) in einem funktionalen Stil durchführen kann. Dies ist ein sehr modernes Muster für die Datenverarbeitung in ABAP 7.50+.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, JOINS (simulated), SFLIGHT, SBOOK

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen SORTED TABLE Typ für SFLIGHT-Daten mit einem eindeutigen Schlüssel. Füllen Sie diese Tabelle und demonstrieren Sie einen effizienten Zugriff über den Schlüssel.
hint: Verwenden Sie TYPES: ... SORTED TABLE OF ... WITH UNIQUE KEY ... und READ TABLE ... WITH TABLE KEY ...
solution:
CLASS zcl_sorted_table_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: ty_sflight_sorted_table TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING is_key        TYPE ty_sflight_key
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflight.

    METHODS fill_sorted_table
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sorted_table) TYPE ty_sflight_sorted_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sorted_table_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fill_sorted_table.
    SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 100 ROWS INTO TABLE @rt_sorted_table.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_details.
    DATA(lt_flights) = fill_sorted_table( ).
    READ TABLE lt_flights INTO rs_flight WITH TABLE KEY carrid = is_key-carrid
                                                    connid = is_key-connid
                                                    fldate = is_key-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_details FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_fill_sorted_table FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fill_sorted_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_type( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->fill_sorted_table( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sorted_table_type( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = lo_cut->fill_sorted_table( ).

    IF lines( lt_all_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_all_flights[ 1 ].
      DATA(ls_key) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_type=>ty_sflight_key(
        carrid = ls_first_flight-carrid
        connid = ls_first_flight-connid
        fldate = ls_first_flight-fldate
      ).
      DATA(ls_found_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( ls_key ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-carrid exp = ls_key-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-connid exp = ls_key-connid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_flight-fldate exp = ls_key-fldate ).
    ELSE.
      DATA(ls_key_empty) = VALUE zcl_sorted_table_type=>ty_sflight_key(
        carrid = 'XX' connid = '000' fldate = sy-datum
      ).
      DATA(ls_found_flight_empty) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( ls_key_empty ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_found_flight_empty ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Sorted Tables bieten einen schnellen Zugriff über ihren Schlüssel und sind immer nach diesem Schlüssel sortiert. Dies ist vorteilhaft, wenn Daten häufig in sortierter Reihenfolge benötigt oder über den Schlüssel gelesen werden. Die Definition mit UNIQUE KEY stellt sicher, dass keine doppelten Einträge existieren. Die Methode fill_sorted_table füllt die Tabelle, und get_flight_details demonstriert den effizienten Zugriff.
keywords: TYPES, SORTED TABLE, Internal Tables, Performance, READ TABLE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen lokalen Interface-Typ und eine lokale Klasse, die dieses Interface implementiert. Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von TYPE REF TO INTERFACE für die Typsicherheit.
hint: Verwenden Sie INTERFACES: ... END INTERFACE. und CLASS ... IMPLEMENTATION.
solution:
CLASS zcl_local_interface_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    INTERFACES zif_flight_processor.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_simple_processor IMPLEMENTATION.

    rv_info = |Flight { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid } on { is_flight-fldate DATE = USER }.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_local_interface_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flight_data.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum ).
    rv_result = io_processor->get_flight_info( ls_flight ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Die Methode `process_flight_data` akzeptiert ein Objekt vom Typ `TYPE REF TO zif_flight_processor`, was die Typsicherheit und Flexibilität erhöht. Dies ist ein grundlegendes Konzept der objektorientierten Programmierung in ABAP und fördert die lose Kopplung und Testbarkeit.
keywords: TYPES, Interface, Class, Object Orientation, REF TO, Local Class

Instructions: Führen Sie einen LEFT OUTER JOIN zwischen SFLIGHT und SBOOK durch. Filtern Sie anschließend die Ergebnisse, um nur Flüge anzuzeigen, die keine Buchungen haben. Nutzen Sie dafür den LEFT OUTER JOIN und eine FILTER-Expression.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... LEFT OUTER JOIN ... und anschließend FILTER ... WHERE ... IS INITIAL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_filter_no_bookings DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_booking_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
           END OF ty_flight_with_booking_info.
    TYPES: tt_flight_with_booking_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_booking_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_without_bookings
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_with_booking_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_filter_no_bookings IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_without_bookings.
    SELECT s~carrid, s~connid, s~fldate, b~bookid
      FROM sflight AS s
      LEFT OUTER JOIN sbook AS b ON s~carrid = b~carrid AND s~connid = b~connid AND s~fldate = b~fldate
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_joined_data).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_joined_data WHERE bookid IS INITIAL ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_without_bookings FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_without_bookings.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_join_filter_no_bookings( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_without_bookings( ).

    " Assert that all returned entries have initial bookid
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_entry-bookid ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that the table is not initial if there are flights without bookings
    " This depends on the test data in SFLIGHT/SBOOK
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert einen LEFT OUTER JOIN mit einer FILTER-Expression. Der LEFT OUTER JOIN stellt sicher, dass alle Flüge berücksichtigt werden, auch die ohne Buchungen. Die anschließende FILTER-Expression (ab ABAP 7.40) wird verwendet, um nur die Flüge auszuwählen, bei denen das Buchungs-ID-Feld (aus SBOOK) initial ist, was bedeutet, dass keine Buchung gefunden wurde. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Daten zu filtern.
keywords: JOINS, LEFT OUTER JOIN, FILTER, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, SFLIGHT, SBOOK

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen RANGE-Typ für das Feld CARRID der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Füllen Sie diesen Range-Typ mit einigen Werten und demonstrieren Sie seine Verwendung in einer SELECT-Anweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie TYPES: ty_range_carrid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.
solution:
CLASS zcl_range_type_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_range_carrid TYPE RANGE OF sflight-carrid.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING it_carrids    TYPE ty_range_carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_range_type_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrid.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @rt_flights WHERE carrid IN @it_carrids.

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_by_carrid FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_by_carrid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_range_type_select( ).
    DATA(lt_carrids) = VALUE zcl_range_type_select=>ty_range_carrid(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'AA' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_carrid( lt_carrids ).

    " Check if all returned flights match the criteria

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Range-Typen sind spezielle interne Tabellen, die für die dynamische Übergabe von Selektionskriterien an SELECT-Anweisungen verwendet werden. Die Definition `TYPE RANGE OF` ist eine moderne und typsichere Art, solche Tabellen zu deklarieren. Die Verwendung von `@it_carrids` in der WHERE-Klausel ist die moderne Syntax für die Übergabe von Ranges an Open SQL.
keywords: TYPES, RANGE, SELECT, WHERE, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen strukturierten Typ, der eine Kombination aus Feldern von SFLIGHT und SBOOK darstellt, aber ohne direkten JOIN. Füllen Sie diesen Typ mit Daten aus beiden Tabellen, indem Sie die Daten manuell zuweisen.
hint: Verwenden Sie TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_..., ... END OF ty_... und den VALUE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_value_operator_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_booking_combined,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             passname TYPE sbook-passname,
           END OF ty_flight_booking_combined.

    METHODS get_combined_data
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
      RETURNING VALUE(rs_combined) TYPE ty_flight_booking_combined.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_operator_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_combined_data.
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE sflight( ).
    DATA(ls_book) = VALUE sbook( ).

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO @ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM sbook INTO @ls_book
        WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate.
    ENDIF.

    rs_combined = VALUE #( 
      carrid   = ls_flight-carrid
      connid   = ls_flight-connid
      fldate   = ls_flight-fldate
      bookid   = ls_book-bookid
      passname = ls_book-passname
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_combined_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_data_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_combined_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_operator_type( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_combined_data( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20250101' ).

    " This assertion depends on test data. If data exists for LH 0400 on 20250101
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-connid exp = '0400' ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-fldate exp = '20250101' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_data_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_value_operator_type( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->get_combined_data( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' iv_fldate = '19000101' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_result-carrid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_result-bookid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Definition eines strukturierten Typs und die Befüllung einer Struktur dieses Typs mit dem VALUE-Operator. Der VALUE-Operator (ab ABAP 7.40) ermöglicht die kompakte und lesbare Initialisierung von Strukturen und internen Tabellen. Hier werden Daten aus zwei separaten SELECT-Anweisungen in eine einzige Struktur zusammengeführt, was eine Alternative zu einem direkten JOIN sein kann, wenn die Daten nicht direkt in einer Datenbankabfrage verbunden werden können oder sollen.
keywords: TYPES, Structured Type, VALUE, Data Assignment, SFLIGHT, SBOOK

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine CDS View, die SFLIGHT und SBOOK mittels eines INNER JOINs verbindet und die Flug- und Buchungsdetails liefert. Demonstrieren Sie, wie diese CDS View in ABAP abgefragt wird.
hint: Definieren Sie eine @AbapCatalog.sqlViewName CDS View und verwenden Sie SELECT * FROM your_cds_view.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cds_join_query DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_cds_flight_booking,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             passname TYPE sbook-passname,
           END OF ty_cds_flight_booking.
    TYPES: tt_cds_flight_booking TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cds_flight_booking WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_cds_joined_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_cds_flight_booking.
ENDCLASS.

" CDS View Definition (would be in a .ddls file in ADT)
" @AbapCatalog.sqlViewName: 'ZCDS_FLIGHTBOOK'
" @AbapCatalog.compiler.compareFilter: true
" @AccessControl.authorizationCheck: #NOT_REQUIRED
" @EndUserText.label: 'Flight and Booking Data'
" define view ZI_FlightBooking as select from sflight as Flight
"   inner join sbook as Booking on Flight.carrid = Booking.carrid
"                               and Flight.connid = Booking.connid
"                               and Flight.fldate = Booking.fldate
" {
"   Flight.carrid,
"   Flight.connid,
"   Flight.fldate,
"   Booking.bookid,
"   Booking.passname
" }

CLASS zcl_cds_join_query IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_cds_joined_data.
    " Assuming ZI_FlightBooking CDS view exists and is active
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, bookid, passname
      FROM ZI_FlightBooking " Replace with actual CDS view name if different
      INTO TABLE @rt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_cds_joined_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_cds_joined_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cds_join_query( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_cds_joined_data( ).

    " Assert that the result is not initial if data is expected in the CDS view
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Further assertions would depend on the actual data in SFLIGHT/SBOOK and the CDS view
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Integration von CDS Views mit ABAP. Eine CDS View (Core Data Services) definiert einen JOIN auf Datenbankebene und kann dann in ABAP wie eine normale Datenbanktabelle abgefragt werden. Dies ist der moderne Ansatz für die Datenmodellierung und -abfrage in S/4HANA, da es die Performance verbessert und die Komplexität der ABAP-Schicht reduziert. Die Definition der CDS View selbst erfolgt in ADT (.ddls-Datei).
keywords: JOINS, CDS View, SELECT, SFLIGHT, SBOOK, Data Modeling

Instructions: Definieren Sie einen strukturierten Typ mit verschachtelten Strukturen und internen Tabellen. Füllen Sie diesen Typ mit Daten aus SFLIGHT und SBOOK, um eine hierarchische Darstellung zu erstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_..., INCLUDE STRUCTURE ..., TYPES: tt_... TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ... END OF ty_... und den VALUE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_types DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_booking_item,
             bookid   TYPE sbook-bookid,
             customid TYPE sbook-customid,
             passname TYPE sbook-passname,
           END OF ty_booking_item.
    TYPES: tt_booking_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_booking_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             bookings TYPE tt_booking_items,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES: tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_hierarchical_flight_data
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_details.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_types IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_hierarchical_flight_data.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight(
      FOR s IN ( SELECT * FROM sflight UP TO 5 ROWS )
      ( s )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sbook) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF sbook(
      FOR b IN ( SELECT * FROM sbook UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( b )
    ).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
      ( carrid    = ls_flight-carrid
        connid    = ls_flight-connid
        fldate    = ls_flight-fldate
        planetype = ls_flight-planetype
        bookings  = VALUE #( 
          FOR ls_book IN lt_sbook WHERE ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid AND
                                          connid = ls_flight-connid AND
                                          fldate = ls_flight-fldate )
          ( bookid   = ls_book-bookid
            customid = ls_book-customid
            passname = ls_book-passname )
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_hierarchical_flight_data FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_hierarchical_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_types( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_hierarchical_flight_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Check if bookings are filled for at least one flight (if data exists)
    DATA(lv_has_bookings) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight_detail).
      IF lines( ls_flight_detail-bookings ) > 0.
        lv_has_bookings = abap_true.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_has_bookings ). " Depends on test data
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Definition komplexer, verschachtelter Datentypen in ABAP, die hierarchische Datenstrukturen abbilden können. Es zeigt, wie man eine interne Tabelle von Flügen erstellen kann, wobei jeder Flug eine weitere interne Tabelle von Buchungen enthält. Die Befüllung erfolgt mit dem VALUE-Operator und verschachtelten FOR-Expressions, was eine sehr moderne und deklarative Art der Datenaggregation darstellt, die die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich verbessert.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Komponente einer Struktur zu und geben Sie deren Wert zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_component_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct TYPE any
        iv_comp_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_component_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_component_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_comp_name OF STRUCTURE iv_struct TO <fs_value>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_value>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_component_value.
    DATA: BEGIN OF ls_data,
            field1 TYPE string VALUE 'Hello',
            field2 TYPE i VALUE 123,
          END OF ls_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_component_access( ).

explanation: Die Methode demonstriert den dynamischen Zugriff auf Strukturkomponenten mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT`. Dies ist nützlich, wenn der Feldname zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Verwendung von `DATA(...)` für die Instanziierung und Zuweisung ist moderner ABAP-Stil.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Dynamic Programming, Structure, Component Access

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, basierend auf einem Index, und modifizieren Sie diese.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN (table_name)[index] TO FIELD-SYMBOL` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_row_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS modify_table_row
      IMPORTING
        io_table TYPE REF TO data
        iv_index TYPE i
        iv_new_value TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_row_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_table_row.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row> TYPE any TABLE LINE.

    ASSIGN io_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          ASSIGN <fs_table>[ iv_index ] TO <fs_row>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            " Assuming the first component is a string type for simplicity
            FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp> TYPE any.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_comp>.
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              <fs_comp> = iv_new_value.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
          " Handle error: index out of bounds
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_modify_table_row FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_modify_table_row.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE ty_t_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Original 1' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Original 2' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Original 3' )
    ).
    DATA(lr_table) = REF TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_row_access( ).

    lo_cut->modify_table_row( io_table = lr_table iv_index = 2 iv_new_value = 'Modified 2' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-text exp = 'Modified 2' msg = 'Test Row Modification' ).

    " Test out of bounds
    lo_cut->modify_table_row( io_table = lr_table iv_index = 99 iv_new_value = 'Should not modify' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 3 msg = 'Table size unchanged' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zugreift und diese modifiziert. Die Verwendung von `REF TO data` und `ASSIGN` ermöglicht den generischen Zugriff. `TRY...CATCH` ist eine moderne Fehlerbehandlung.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming, Table Expressions

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf und übergeben Sie Parameter über eine Parameter-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (class_name)=>(method_name) PARAMETER-TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_method_target DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_num1 TYPE i
        iv_num2 TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
    METHODS concatenate_strings
      IMPORTING
        iv_str1 TYPE string
        iv_str2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_target IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_numbers.
    rv_result = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    rv_result = iv_str1 && iv_str2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_method_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_object TYPE REF TO object.
    DATA lt_exceptions TYPE abap_excpbind_tab.
    DATA ls_result_param TYPE abap_parmbind.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

    ls_result_param-name = 'RV_RESULT'.
    GET REFERENCE OF rv_result INTO ls_result_param-value.
    INSERT ls_result_param INTO TABLE it_parameters. " Add return parameter to table

    CALL METHOD lo_object->(iv_method_name)
      PARAMETER-TABLE it_parameters
      EXCEPTION-TABLE lt_exceptions.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Result is already in rv_result due to GET REFERENCE OF
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'Error calling method'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einer gegebenen Struktur und füllen Sie diese mit Daten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit `TYPE HANDLE` und `ASSIGN` für den Zugriff.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_struct_type TYPE clike " Name of the structure type, e.g., 'SFLIGHT'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_table.
    DATA lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lr_table_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line> TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_struct_type ).
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_struct_descr ).

        CREATE DATA rr_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
        ASSIGN rr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

        IF <fs_table> IS ASSIGNED.
          " Example: Populate with some dummy data for SFLIGHT
          IF iv_struct_type = 'SFLIGHT'.
            CREATE DATA <fs_line> LIKE LINE OF <fs_table>.
            ASSIGN <fs_line> TO <fs_line>. " Assign to itself to get a typed field symbol

            " Populate first row
            <fs_line>-carrid = 'AA'.
            <fs_line>-connid = '0017'.
            <fs_line>-fldate = sy-datum.
            INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.

            " Populate second row
            <fs_line>-carrid = 'LH'.
            <fs_line>-connid = '0400'.
            <fs_line>-fldate = sy-datum + 1.
            INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_data_error cx_sy_type_descr_error.
        " Handle errors
        CLEAR rr_table.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_sflight_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_invalid_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_create( ).
    DATA(lr_sflight_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lr_sflight_table msg = 'Table should be created' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_sflight_table->* TO <fs_sflight_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = <fs_sflight_table> msg = 'Field symbol should be assigned' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( <fs_sflight_table> ) exp = 2 msg = 'Table should have 2 entries' ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight_line> TYPE sflight.
    READ TABLE <fs_sflight_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <fs_sflight_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = <fs_sflight_line>-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'First entry CARRID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_invalid_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_table_create( ).
    DATA(lr_invalid_table) = lo_cut->create_and_fill_table( 'INVALID_TYPE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lr_invalid_table msg = 'Invalid table should not be created' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die dynamische Erstellung einer internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit unter Verwendung von `CREATE DATA TYPE HANDLE` und RTTI-Klassen (`CL_ABAP_TYPEDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_STRUCTDESCR`, `CL_ABAP_TABLEDESCR`). Der Zugriff auf die dynamisch erstellte Tabelle und deren Zeilen erfolgt über `ASSIGN` und Field-Symbols.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle dynamisch basierend auf einem Feldnamen und einem Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS` und `ASSIGN COMPONENT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_filter_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             id TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
             category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_t_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_data) TYPE ty_t_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_filter_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_line>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_field> = iv_value.
        APPEND <fs_line> TO rt_filtered_data.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_by_category FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_by_id FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_category.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_filter_table( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_filter_table=>ty_t_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Item A' category = 'CAT1' )
      ( id = 2 text = 'Item B' category = 'CAT2' )
      ( id = 3 text = 'Item C' category = 'CAT1' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic(
      it_data = lt_data
      iv_field_name = 'CATEGORY'
      iv_value = 'CAT1'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should find 2 items in CAT1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-id exp = 1 msg = 'First filtered item ID' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_by_id.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_filter_table( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_filter_table=>ty_t_data(
      ( id = 10 text = 'Apple' category = 'Fruit' )
      ( id = 20 text = 'Banana' category = 'Fruit' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic(
      it_data = lt_data
      iv_field_name = 'ID'
      iv_value = '20'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 1 msg = 'Should find 1 item with ID 20' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-text exp = 'Banana' msg = 'Filtered item text' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_filter_table( ).
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_dyn_filter_table=>ty_t_data(
      ( id = 1 text = 'Item A' category = 'CAT1' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_dynamic(
      it_data = lt_data
      iv_field_name = 'CATEGORY'
      iv_value = 'CAT_NONE'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_filtered ) msg = 'Should find no items' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Während `FILTER` in modernem ABAP für statische Feldnamen sehr effizient ist, erfordert ein dynamischer Filter zur Laufzeit den Zugriff über Field-Symbols und eine explizite Schleife. Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man `ASSIGN COMPONENT` innerhalb einer Schleife verwendet, um dynamische Filterkriterien anzuwenden.
keywords: ASSIGN, FIELD-SYMBOLS, Internal Tables, Dynamic Programming, FILTER, LOOP

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_attribute_access.
    DATA(lo_instance) = NEW zcl_dyn_attribute_access( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_attribute_access( ).

    " Get initial value
    DATA(lv_initial_value) = lo_cut->get_attribute_value(
      io_object = lo_instance
      iv_attribute_name = 'MV_PUBLIC_ATTRIBUTE'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_initial_value exp = 'Initial Value' msg = 'Initial attribute value' ).

    " Set new value
    lo_cut->set_attribute_value(
      io_object = lo_instance
      iv_attribute_name = 'MV_PUBLIC_ATTRIBUTE'
      iv_new_value = 'Updated Value'
    ).

    " Get updated value

      io_object = lo_instance
      iv_attribute_name = 'MV_PUBLIC_ATTRIBUTE'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_updated_value exp = 'Updated Value' msg = 'Updated attribute value' ).

    " Test non-existent attribute
    DATA(lv_non_existent) = lo_cut->get_attribute_value(
      io_object = lo_instance
      iv_attribute_name = 'MV_NON_EXISTENT'
    ).

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Typumwandlung (Casting) zwischen kompatiblen Datentypen durch, um auf spezifische Komponenten zuzugreifen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... CASTING TYPE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_casting DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_generic,
             data_type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             value_char TYPE c LENGTH 10,
             value_num TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_generic.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_specific_char,
             data_type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             char_val TYPE c LENGTH 10,
           END OF ty_s_specific_char.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_specific_num,
             data_type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             num_val TYPE i,
           END OF ty_s_specific_num.

    METHODS get_specific_value
      IMPORTING
        is_generic_data TYPE ty_s_generic
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_casting IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_specific_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_specific_char> TYPE ty_s_specific_char.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_specific_num> TYPE ty_s_specific_num.

    CASE is_generic_data-data_type.
      WHEN 'C'. " Character type
        ASSIGN is_generic_data CASTING TYPE ty_s_specific_char TO <fs_specific_char>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = <fs_specific_char>-char_val.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'N'. " Numeric type
        ASSIGN is_generic_data CASTING TYPE ty_s_specific_num TO <fs_specific_num>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_value = <fs_specific_num>-num_val.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unknown type
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Sortierung einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem zur Laufzeit angegebenen Feldnamen durch.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT ... BY (field_name)` mit einem dynamischen Feldnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_sort_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_s_flight.
    TYPES: ty_t_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        io_table TYPE REF TO data " Table of ty_s_flight
        iv_field_name TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_sort_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.

    ASSIGN io_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_field_name).
        CATCH cx_sy_dyn_by_error.
          " Handle error: field not found or not sortable
      ENDTRY.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Second CARRID after sort' ).

Instructions: Instanziieren Sie dynamisch ein GUI-Control und rufen Sie eine seiner Methoden auf. (Hinweis: `cl_gui_control` ist eine Basisklasse für GUI-Controls, die in SAP GUI verwendet werden. Die dynamische Interaktion mit diesen Controls ist ein Anwendungsfall für dynamische Programmierung, auch wenn die Klasse selbst nicht neu in 7.40+ ist.)
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE OBJECT` dynamisch und `CALL METHOD` mit `PARAMETER-TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_gui_control DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_call_control
      IMPORTING
        iv_control_class TYPE string " e.g., 'CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT'
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        it_parameters TYPE abap_parmbind_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_gui_control IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_call_control.
    DATA lo_control TYPE REF TO cl_gui_control.
    DATA lt_exceptions TYPE abap_excpbind_tab.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_control TYPE (iv_control_class)
          EXPORTING
            parent = cl_gui_container=>default_screen.

        CALL METHOD lo_control->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE it_parameters
          EXCEPTION-TABLE lt_exceptions.

        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_result = 'Method called successfully'.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'Error calling method'.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error creating object or calling method'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_and_call_textedit FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_and_call_textedit.
    " This test requires a GUI environment to run successfully.
    " In a headless unit test environment, CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT creation might fail.
    " We'll simulate a successful call for demonstration purposes.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_gui_control( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lt_params) = VALUE abap_parmbind_tab(
      ( name = 'TEXT' kind = cl_abap_objectdescr=>param_input VALUE = REF #( lv_text ) )
    ).

    " Attempt to dynamically create CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT and call its SET_TEXT_AS_STREAM method
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_and_call_control(
      iv_control_class = 'CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT'
      iv_method_name = 'SET_TEXT_AS_STREAM'
      it_parameters = lt_params
    ).

    " In a real GUI environment, this would be 'Method called successfully'.
    " In a headless environment, it might be 'Error creating object or calling method'.
    " For unit test, we assert based on expected behavior in a GUI context.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Method called successfully' msg = 'Dynamic GUI control call' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man GUI-Controls dynamisch instanziiert und deren Methoden aufruft. Obwohl `cl_gui_control` eine ältere Klasse ist, ist die dynamische Instanziierung mit `CREATE OBJECT TYPE (class_name)` und der Methodenaufruf mit `CALL METHOD ... PARAMETER-TABLE` moderne ABAP-Syntax. Dies ist nützlich für generische UI-Interaktionen in SAP GUI.
keywords: cl_gui_control, Dynamic Programming, GUI, CREATE OBJECT, CALL METHOD, PARAMETER-TABLE

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen UTC-Timestamp (Typ TIMESTAMPL) in einen lokalen Datums- und Zeitstring im Format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.
hint: Nutzen Sie cl_abap_timefm=>utclong_to_tstmpl und String Templates mit DATE = ISO und TIME = ISO.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_utc_to_local DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_utc_to_local
      IMPORTING
        iv_utc_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_local_datetime_str) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_utc_to_local IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_utc_to_local.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,
          lv_time TYPE t.

    cl_abap_timefm=>utclong_to_tstmpl(
      EXPORTING
        utclong = iv_utc_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        date    = lv_date
        time    = lv_time
    ).

    rv_local_datetime_str = |{ lv_date DATE = ISO } { lv_time TIME = ISO }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_time_utc_to_local( ).

    " Convert a known local date/time to UTC to get a reliable TIMESTAMPL for testing
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_test_time) = sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_test_tstmpl_local) = |{ lv_test_date }{ lv_test_time }000|.

    DATA(lv_utc_long_from_local) = cl_abap_timefm=>tstmpl_to_utclong(
                                      tstmpl = lv_test_tstmpl_local
                                      tzone  = sy-zonlo
                                    ).

    DATA(lv_result_str) = lo_cut->convert_utc_to_local( lv_utc_long_from_local ).

    " Expected format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
    DATA(lv_expected_date_part) = |{ lv_test_date(4) }-{ lv_test_date+4(2) }-{ lv_test_date+6(2) }|.
    DATA(lv_expected_time_part) = |{ lv_test_time(2) }:{ lv_test_time+2(2) }:{ lv_test_time+4(2) }|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_result_str
      exp = lv_expected_date_part
      msg = 'Date part not found or incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      act = lv_result_str
      exp = lv_expected_time_part
      msg = 'Time part not found or incorrect'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = strlen( lv_result_str )
      exp = 19 " YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
      msg = 'String length incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_timefm=>utclong_to_tstmpl` konvertiert einen UTC-Timestamp in ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit. String Templates (`|...|`) mit den Formatierungsoptionen `DATE = ISO` und `TIME = ISO` ermöglichen eine einfache und lesbare Formatierung der Ausgabe im ISO-Standard.
keywords: Date/Time, UTC, Conversion, String Templates, cl_abap_timefm, Zeitformat

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit in einen UTC-Timestamp (Typ TIMESTAMPL).
hint: Nutzen Sie cl_abap_timefm=>tstmpl_to_utclong und sy-zonlo für die Zeitzone.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_local_to_utc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_local_to_utc
      IMPORTING
        iv_local_date TYPE d
        iv_local_time TYPE t
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_utc_timestamp) TYPE timestampl.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_local_to_utc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_local_to_utc.
    DATA(lv_local_tstmpl) = |{ iv_local_date }{ iv_local_time }000|. " Milliseconds added for TIMESTAMPL

    rv_utc_timestamp = cl_abap_timefm=>tstmpl_to_utclong(
                         tstmpl = lv_local_tstmpl
                         tzone  = sy-zonlo " Use system's local timezone
                       ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_time_local_to_utc( ).

    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_test_time) = sy-uzeit.

    DATA(lv_utc_ts) = lo_cut->convert_local_to_utc(
                         iv_local_date = lv_test_date
                         iv_local_time = lv_test_time
                       ).

    " To verify, convert back to local date/time and compare
    DATA: lv_converted_date TYPE d,
          lv_converted_time TYPE t.

    cl_abap_timefm=>utclong_to_tstmpl(
      EXPORTING
        utclong = lv_utc_ts
        tzone   = sy-zonlo
      IMPORTING
        date    = lv_converted_date
        time    = lv_converted_time
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_date
      exp = lv_test_date
      msg = 'Converted date does not match original local date'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_converted_time
      exp = lv_test_time
      msg = 'Converted time does not match original local time'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_timefm=>tstmpl_to_utclong` konvertiert ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit (als Timestamp) unter Berücksichtigung der Zeitzone des Systems in einen UTC-Timestamp. Dies ist die Umkehrung der vorherigen Operation und demonstriert die Konvertierung von Zeitformaten.
keywords: Date/Time, UTC, Conversion, cl_abap_timefm, Zeitformat

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Sekunden zwischen zwei TIMESTAMPL-Werten.
hint: Nutzen Sie cl_abap_timefm=>diff_tstmpl, das die Differenz in Mikrosekunden zurückgibt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_diff_calc DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_diff_in_seconds
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_diff_seconds) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_diff_calc IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_diff_in_seconds.
    DATA(lv_diff_tstmpl) = cl_abap_timefm=>diff_tstmpl(
                              tstmpl1 = iv_timestamp1
                              tstmpl2 = iv_timestamp2
                            ).
    " lv_diff_tstmpl is in microseconds, convert to seconds
    rv_diff_seconds = lv_diff_tstmpl / 1000000.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_diff_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_diff_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_time_diff_calc( ).

    DATA(lv_ts1) = '20251209100000000'. " 2025-12-09 10:00:00.000
    DATA(lv_ts2) = '20251209100130000'. " 2025-12-09 10:01:30.000 (90 seconds later)

    DATA(lv_diff) = lo_cut->calculate_diff_in_seconds(
                       iv_timestamp1 = lv_ts2
                       iv_timestamp2 = lv_ts1
                     ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_diff
      exp = 90
      msg = 'Time difference calculation is incorrect'
    ).

    DATA(lv_ts3) = '20251209100000000'.
    DATA(lv_ts4) = '20251209095900000'. " 60 seconds earlier

    DATA(lv_diff_neg) = lo_cut->calculate_diff_in_seconds(
                           iv_timestamp1 = lv_ts4
                           iv_timestamp2 = lv_ts3
                         ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_diff_neg
      exp = -60
      msg = 'Negative time difference calculation is incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `cl_abap_timefm=>diff_tstmpl` ist eine effiziente Methode, um die Differenz zwischen zwei Timestamps zu ermitteln. Sie liefert das Ergebnis in Mikrosekunden, was eine präzise Zeitmessung ermöglicht. Die Umrechnung in Sekunden ist eine einfache Division.
keywords: Date/Time, Difference, Calculation, cl_abap_timefm

CLASS zcl_time_current_iso DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_current_datetime_iso

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_current_iso IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_datetime_iso.
    rv_iso_datetime_str = |{ sy-datum DATE = ISO } { sy-uzeit TIME = ISO }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_current_iso FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_current_iso.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_time_current_iso( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_current_datetime_iso( ).

    " Get current date and time for comparison
    DATA(lv_current_date) = sy-datum.

    DATA(lv_expected_time_part) = |{ lv_current_time(2) }:{ lv_current_time+2(2) }:{ lv_current_time+4(2) }|.
