explanation: Die globalen Systemfelder `sy-datum` und `sy-uzeit` liefern das aktuelle Datum und die aktuelle Uhrzeit. Mit String Templates und den Formatierungsoptionen `DATE = ISO` und `TIME = ISO` können diese direkt in das standardisierte ISO-Format gebracht werden, was eine moderne und prägnante Art der Zeitformatierung darstellt.
keywords: Date/Time, Current Date, Current Time, ISO Format, String Templates, Zeitformat

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung der FRIENDS-Addition in einer Klassendefinition, um einer anderen Klasse Zugriff auf eine private Methode zu gewähren.
hint: Verwenden Sie CLASS ... DEFINITION FRIENDS zcl_friend_class, um den Zugriff zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_main_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC
  FRIENDS zcl_friend_class. " Grant access to zcl_friend_class
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_public_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _get_secret_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_secret) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_main_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_data.
    rv_data = 'Public Data'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _get_secret_data.
    rv_secret = 'Secret Data from Main Class'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_class DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS access_secret_data
      IMPORTING
        io_main_instance TYPE REF TO zcl_main_class
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_secret_data) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_friend_class IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD access_secret_data.
    " This call is only possible because zcl_friend_class is a FRIEND of zcl_main_class
    rv_secret_data = io_main_instance->_get_secret_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_friends_access FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_friends_access.
    DATA(lo_main) = NEW zcl_main_class( ).
    DATA(lo_friend) = NEW zcl_friend_class( ).

    DATA(lv_secret) = lo_friend->access_secret_data( lo_main ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_secret
      exp = 'Secret Data from Main Class'
      msg = 'Friend class could not access private method correctly'
    ).

    " Verify public method still works
    DATA(lv_public) = lo_main->get_public_data( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_public
      exp = 'Public Data'
      msg = 'Public method access failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FRIENDS`-Addition in der Klassendefinition ermöglicht es, ausgewählten Klassen oder Interfaces Zugriff auf die privaten und geschützten Komponenten einer Klasse zu gewähren. Dies ist ein modernes Feature zur feingranularen Steuerung der Kapselung und verbessert die Modularität und Testbarkeit von ABAP-Objekten.
keywords: FRIENDS, Object Orientation, Encapsulation, Access Control

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck, um eine interne Tabelle zu transformieren, indem Sie nur bestimmte Felder auswählen und umbenennen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... IN ... ( field1 = ... field2 = ... ) )`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_orig,
         carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
         connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
         fldate   TYPE s_date,
         price    TYPE s_price,
       END OF ty_sflight_orig.
TYPES: tt_sflight_orig TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_orig WITH EMPTY KEY.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
         airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
         flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
         flight_date TYPE s_date,
       END OF ty_flight_info.
TYPES: tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_it_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS transform_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_orig
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_info) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_sflights.
    rt_flight_info = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
                               ( airline_id  = <fs_flight>-carrid
                                 flight_num  = <fs_flight>-connid
                                 flight_date = <fs_flight>-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transformation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transformation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_for_transform( ).

    DATA(lt_sflights_orig) = VALUE tt_sflight_orig(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' price = '200.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_flight_info) = lo_cut->transform_sflights( lt_sflights_orig ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flight_info )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Incorrect number of entries in transformed table'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_flight_info INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight_1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_1-airline_id exp = 'LH' msg = 'Entry 1 airline_id incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_1-flight_num exp = '0400' msg = 'Entry 1 flight_num incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_1-flight_date exp = '20251201' msg = 'Entry 1 flight_date incorrect' ).

    READ TABLE lt_flight_info INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_flight_2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_2-airline_id exp = 'AA' msg = 'Entry 2 airline_id incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_2-flight_num exp = '0017' msg = 'Entry 2 flight_num incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_2-flight_date exp = '20251202' msg = 'Entry 2 flight_date incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR`-Ausdruck in Verbindung mit `VALUE #(` ermöglicht eine deklarative und kompakte Transformation von internen Tabellen. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu schreiben, wird die neue Tabelle direkt aus den Elementen der Quelltabelle konstruiert, was den Code lesbarer und wartbarer macht.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, VALUE, Transformation, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle zu berechnen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 FOR ... IN ... NEXT sum = sum + ... )`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_price,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         price  TYPE s_price,
       END OF ty_sflight_price.
TYPES: tt_sflight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
                       INIT sum = 0
                       FOR <fs_flight> IN it_sflights
                       NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_reduction FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_reduction.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_reduce_sum( ).

    DATA(lt_sflights_prices) = VALUE tt_sflight_price(
      ( carrid = 'LH' price = '100.50' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' price = '200.25' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' price = '50.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights_prices ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total
      exp = '350.75'
      msg = 'Total price calculation with REDUCE is incorrect'
    ).

    DATA(lt_empty_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_price( ).
    DATA(lv_total_empty) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_empty_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_empty
      exp = '0.00'
      msg = 'Total price for empty table should be 0'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Schleife mit einer Akkumulatorvariablen (`sum`) in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung zu ersetzen, was den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, Sum, Modern ABAP, Math

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen `FILTER`-Ausdruck, um alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle zu filtern.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #( ... WHERE carrid = ... )`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filter,
         carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
         connid TYPE s_conn_id,
         fldate TYPE s_date,
       END OF ty_sflight_filter.
TYPES: tt_sflight_filter TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filter WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight_filter
        iv_carrier_id  TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_filter.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrier_id ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtering FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtering.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_filter_flights( ).

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_filter(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251202' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251203' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251204' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_lh) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier(
                              it_all_flights = lt_all_flights
                              iv_carrier_id  = 'LH'
                            ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered_lh )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Incorrect number of LH flights filtered'
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_filtered_lh INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_lh_1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_1-connid exp = '0400' msg = 'First LH flight incorrect' ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_aa) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier(
                              it_all_flights = lt_all_flights
                              iv_carrier_id  = 'AA'
                            ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered_aa )
      exp = 1
      msg = 'Incorrect number of AA flights filtered'
    ).
    READ TABLE lt_filtered_aa INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_aa_1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_1-connid exp = '0017' msg = 'AA flight incorrect' ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_xx) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_carrier(
                              it_all_flights = lt_all_flights
                              iv_carrier_id  = 'XX'
                            ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_filtered_xx )
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Incorrect number of XX flights filtered'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Ausdruck bietet eine moderne und prägnante Syntax, um interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Er ersetzt explizite Schleifen mit `IF`-Bedingungen und `APPEND`-Anweisungen durch eine einzige, gut lesbare Zeile, was die Codequalität und -wartbarkeit erheblich verbessert.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, Filtering, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHT` mit der neuen Open SQL Syntax und füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT ... FROM ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
         carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
         connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
         fldate   TYPE s_date,
         price    TYPE s_price,
         currency TYPE s_currcode,
       END OF ty_flight_data.
TYPES: tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_db_open_sql DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflight_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_rows TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_open_sql IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflight_raw)
      UP TO @iv_max_rows ROWS.

    rt_sflight = lt_sflight_raw.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_open_sql( ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sflight_data( iv_max_rows = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = sy-subrc
      msg = 'SELECT statement failed'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'No data read from SFLIGHT'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'More than 5 rows read'
    ).

    " Check if at least one entry has expected data (assuming SFLIGHT is not empty)
    READ TABLE lt_flights INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_flight).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-carrid msg = 'CARRIER ID is initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_flight-connid msg = 'CONNECTION ID is initial' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die neue Open SQL Syntax mit `INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` ermöglicht eine inline-Deklaration der internen Tabelle und eine direkte Zuweisung der Selektionsergebnisse. Dies reduziert den Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit von Datenbankzugriffen erheblich. Die Verwendung von `@` für Hostvariablen ist ebenfalls ein Merkmal des modernen Open SQL.
keywords: Database Access, Open SQL, SFLIGHT, DATA, Inline Declaration, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere Strings und Variablenwerte mit String Templates zu einem einzigen Ausgabestring.
hint: Nutzen Sie String Templates mit `|...|` und eingebetteten Variablen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_templates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_name TYPE string
        iv_age  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_templates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_message.
    rv_message = |Hallo { iv_name }, du bist { iv_age } Jahre alt.|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_string_template FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_string_template.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_templates( ).

    DATA(lv_name) = 'Max Mustermann'.
    DATA(lv_age)  = 30.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->create_message(
                         iv_name = lv_name
                         iv_age  = lv_age
                       ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Hallo Max Mustermann, du bist 30 Jahre alt.'
      msg = 'String template message is incorrect'
    ).

    DATA(lv_name2) = 'Anna'.
    DATA(lv_age2)  = 25.
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->create_message(
                          iv_name = lv_name2
                          iv_age  = lv_age2
                        ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result2
      exp = 'Hallo Anna, du bist 25 Jahre alt.'
      msg = 'String template message with different values is incorrect'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String Templates (`|...|`) sind die moderne Art, Strings in ABAP zu verketten und zu formatieren. Sie sind wesentlich lesbarer und flexibler als die traditionelle `CONCATENATE`-Anweisung oder der `&`-Operator, da Variablen und Ausdrücke direkt eingebettet werden können.
keywords: String Processing, String Templates, Concatenation, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Verwenden Sie die Funktion `CONDENSE` mit der Option `NO-GAPS` innerhalb eines String Templates, um Leerzeichen zu entfernen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CONDENSE( ... NO-GAPS )` direkt im String Template.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_condense_nogaps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS condense_string_nogaps
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_condense_nogaps IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD condense_string_nogaps.
    rv_output = |{ CONDENSE( iv_input NO-GAPS ) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_condense_nogaps FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_condense_nogaps.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_condense_nogaps( ).

    DATA(lv_input1) = '  Hello   World  '.
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->condense_string_nogaps( lv_input1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result1
      exp = 'HelloWorld'
      msg = 'Condense NO-GAPS failed for multiple spaces'
    ).

    DATA(lv_input2) = 'SingleWord'.
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->condense_string_nogaps( lv_input2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result2
      exp = 'SingleWord'
      msg = 'Condense NO-GAPS failed for single word'
    ).

    DATA(lv_input3) = '   '.
    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->condense_string_nogaps( lv_input3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result3
      exp = ''
      msg = 'Condense NO-GAPS failed for only spaces'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion `CONDENSE` mit der Option `NO-GAPS` ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um alle Leerzeichen aus einem String zu entfernen. Die direkte Einbettung in ein String Template macht den Code sehr kompakt und lesbar, da keine temporären Variablen benötigt werden.
keywords: String Processing, CONDENSE, NO-GAPS, String Templates, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines Substrings in einem String durch einen anderen Substring unter Verwendung der Funktion `REPLACE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REPLACE( val = ... sub = ... with = ... occ = 0 )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_all_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_input      TYPE string
        iv_old_sub    TYPE string
        iv_new_sub    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_all_occurrences.
    rv_output = REPLACE( val = iv_input sub = iv_old_sub with = iv_new_sub occ = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_replace_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_replace_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_replace_all( ).

    DATA(lv_input1) = 'Hello World, Hello ABAP'.
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->replace_all_occurrences(
                         iv_input   = lv_input1
                         iv_old_sub = 'Hello'
                         iv_new_sub = 'Hi'
                       ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result1
      exp = 'Hi World, Hi ABAP'
      msg = 'Replace all occurrences failed'
    ).

    DATA(lv_input2) = 'No match here'.
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->replace_all_occurrences(
                         iv_input   = lv_input2
                         iv_old_sub = 'xyz'
                         iv_new_sub = 'abc'
                       ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result2
      exp = 'No match here'
      msg = 'Replace all occurrences failed for no match'
    ).

    DATA(lv_input3) = 'aaaaa'.
    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->replace_all_occurrences(
                         iv_input   = lv_input3
                         iv_old_sub = 'a'
                         iv_new_sub = 'b'
                       ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result3
      exp = 'bbbbb'
      msg = 'Replace all occurrences failed for single character'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die eingebaute Funktion `REPLACE` mit `occ = 0` ist die moderne und effiziente Methode, um alle Vorkommen eines Substrings in einem String zu ersetzen. Sie ist prägnanter und leistungsfähiger als ältere Ansätze mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` oder manuellen Schleifen.
keywords: String Processing, REPLACE, Substring, Modern ABAP

Instructions: Führen Sie einen einfachen HTTP GET-Request an eine öffentliche API (z.B. JSONPlaceholder) durch und geben Sie den Antworttext zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT=>CREATE_BY_URL` und die Methoden `SEND` gefolgt von `RECEIVE`. Der Antworttext kann mit `RESPONSE->GET_CDATA()` oder `RESPONSE->GET_DATA()` abgerufen werden.
solution:

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    lo_http_client->receive(

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET-Request durch und prüfen Sie den HTTP-Statuscode der Antwort. Geben Sie eine entsprechende Meldung basierend auf dem Statuscode zurück.
hint: Nach `RECEIVE` können Sie `RESPONSE->GET_STATUS_CODE` verwenden, um den numerischen Statuscode zu erhalten, und `RESPONSE->GET_STATUS_TEXT` für die Beschreibung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_status_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_http_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status_info) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_http_dest_error
        cx_http_client_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_status_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_http_status.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
    DATA: lv_status_code TYPE i.
    DATA: lv_status_text TYPE string.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        url    = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_dest_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_http_client_error.
    ENDIF.

    lv_status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status_code( ).
    lv_status_text = lo_http_client->response->get_status_text( ).

    CASE lv_status_code.
      WHEN 200.
        rv_status_info = |Success: { lv_status_code } { lv_status_text }|.
      WHEN 404.
        rv_status_info = |Not Found: { lv_status_code } { lv_status_text }|.
      WHEN 500.
        rv_status_info = |Server Error: { lv_status_code } { lv_status_text }|.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_status_info = |Unexpected Status: { lv_status_code } { lv_status_text }|.
    ENDCASE.

    lo_http_client->close_connection( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_current_temp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_system_data_temperature
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_temperature) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_current_temp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_system_data_temperature.
    DATA(lv_temp_enum) = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_current_temperature( ).

    CASE lv_temp_enum.
      WHEN cl_abap_stack_temperature=>co_temperature_hot.
        rv_temperature = 'HOT'.
      WHEN cl_abap_stack_temperature=>co_temperature_cold.
        rv_temperature = 'COLD'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_temperature = 'UNDEFINED'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_current_temperature FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_current_temperature.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_da_current_temp( ).
    DATA(lv_temperature) = lo_cut->get_system_data_temperature( ).

    " The actual temperature depends on the system's data aging configuration and current context.
    " We assert that it returns one of the expected values.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      msg = 'Current temperature should be HOT, COLD, or UNDEFINED'
      act = ( lv_temperature = 'HOT' OR lv_temperature = 'COLD' OR lv_temperature = 'UNDEFINED' )
      exp = abap_true
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GET_CURRENT_TEMPERATURE`-Methode liefert den aktuellen Data-Aging-Kontext des Systems. Dies ist besonders relevant für Anwendungen, die ihre Logik dynamisch anpassen müssen, je nachdem, ob sie gerade auf 'heiße' (häufig genutzte) oder 'kalte' (historische) Daten zugreifen.
keywords: Data Aging, CL_ABAP_STACK_TEMPERATURE, Temperature, HOT, COLD, System Context

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Logik, die sich unterschiedlich verhält, je nachdem, ob Data Aging für eine Tabelle aktiv ist oder nicht. Simulieren Sie unterschiedliche Datenzugriffe.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `CL_ABAP_STACK_TEMPERATURE=>GET_DATA_AGING_STATUS_FOR_TABLE` mit einer `IF`-Anweisung, um bedingte Logik zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_da_conditional_logic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data_based_on_aging
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_name TYPE tabname
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processing_info) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_da_conditional_logic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data_based_on_aging.
    DATA(lb_is_aging_active) = cl_abap_stack_temperature=>get_data_aging_status_for_table( iv_table_name ).

    IF lb_is_aging_active = abap_true.
      rv_processing_info = |Processing for table '{ iv_table_name }': Data Aging is ACTIVE. Using optimized cold data access logic.|.
      " Simulate cold data access (e.g., read from archive, specific views)
      " SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name) INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_data) WHERE ... WITH HINT( ACCESS_COLD ).
    ELSE.
      rv_processing_info = |Processing for table '{ iv_table_name }': Data Aging is INACTIVE. Using standard hot data access logic.|.
      " Simulate hot data access (e.g., standard SELECT)
      " SELECT * FROM (iv_table_name) INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_data) WHERE ... .
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_aging_active_scenario FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_aging_inactive_scenario FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_aging_active_scenario.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_da_conditional_logic( ).
    DATA(lv_table) = 'SFLIGHT'. " Assuming SFLIGHT is NOT aging-enabled for this test
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_cut->process_data_based_on_aging( lv_table ).

    " Since SFLIGHT is typically not aging-enabled, we expect the 'inactive' path.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      msg = 'Expected inactive data aging message for SFLIGHT'
      substring = 'Data Aging is INACTIVE'
      text = lv_info
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_aging_inactive_scenario.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_da_conditional_logic( ).
    DATA(lv_table) = 'T000'. " Another table typically not aging-enabled
    DATA(lv_info) = lo_cut->process_data_based_on_aging( lv_table ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains(
      msg = 'Expected inactive data aging message for T000'
      substring = 'Data Aging is INACTIVE'
      text = lv_info
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie die Data-Aging-Statusinformation genutzt werden kann, um bedingte Logik in Anwendungen zu implementieren. Je nachdem, ob eine Tabelle für Data Aging konfiguriert ist, kann die Anwendung unterschiedliche Datenzugriffsstrategien wählen, um die Performance zu optimieren oder spezifische Archivierungslogiken zu berücksichtigen. Die Kommentare im Code deuten auf mögliche 'Hot'- und 'Cold'-Datenzugriffe hin.
keywords: Data Aging, Conditional Logic, CL_ABAP_STACK_TEMPERATURE, IF, Table Access, SFLIGHT

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flugdaten in eine interne Tabelle ein, indem Sie die `VALUE` und `FOR` Ausdrücke verwenden, um eine neue Zeile zu konstruieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `INSERT` in Kombination mit `VALUE #( FOR ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_flights.
    DATA(lv_date) = sy-datum.

    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = 'LH'
                    connid = '0400'
                    fldate = lv_date
                    planetype = 'A320' ) INTO TABLE rt_flights.

    INSERT VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UNTIL 3
                     ( carrid = 'AA'
                       connid = |000{ i }|
                       fldate = lv_date + i
                       planetype = 'B747' ) ) INTO TABLE rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_value_for( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->create_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 4 ]-connid exp = '0003' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE` und `FOR` Ausdrücke ermöglichen die kompakte Initialisierung und Befüllung interner Tabellen. `INSERT VALUE #( ... ) INTO TABLE ...` ist die moderne Art, einzelne Zeilen hinzuzufügen, während `INSERT VALUE #( FOR ... ) INTO TABLE ...` das Hinzufügen mehrerer generierter Zeilen in einer Anweisung erlaubt.
keywords: INSERT, VALUE, FOR, Internal Tables, Table Expressions

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flugbuchungen in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` ein, wobei Sie die Daten aus einer internen Tabelle beziehen und dabei eine `CASE WHEN` Expression verwenden, um den Flugzeugtyp basierend auf der Fluggesellschaft zu bestimmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( ... )` und eine `CASE WHEN` Expression innerhalb der `SELECT` Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_case_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_flights_cond IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                          iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                                          iv_fldate TYPE sflight-fldate
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_case_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights_cond.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE sflights.

    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid
                         connid = iv_connid
                         fldate = iv_fldate
                         planetype = SWITCH #( iv_carrid
                                               WHEN 'LH' THEN 'A380'
                                               WHEN 'AA' THEN 'B777'
                                               WHEN 'UA' THEN 'A350'
                                               WHEN OTHERS THEN 'UNKNOWN' ) ).

    INSERT sflights FROM @ls_flight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_failure FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_planetype_determination FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_case_when( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '1234'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flights_cond( iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                                    iv_connid = lv_connid
                                                    iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success ).

    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_check)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_check-planetype exp = 'UNKNOWN' ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_case_when( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    " Ensure record exists to cause primary key violation
    INSERT sflights FROM VALUE #( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
                                  planetype = 'A320' ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flights_cond( iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                                    iv_connid = lv_connid
                                                    iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_planetype_determination.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_case_when( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    lo_cut->insert_flights_cond( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0001' iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).
    SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_planetype_lh)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_planetype_lh exp = 'A380' ).
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = lv_fldate.

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0002' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    lo_cut->insert_flights_cond( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0002' iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).
    SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_planetype_aa)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0002' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_planetype_aa exp = 'B777' ).
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0002' AND fldate = lv_fldate.

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0003' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    lo_cut->insert_flights_cond( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '0003' iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).
    SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_planetype_xx)
      WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0003' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_planetype_xx exp = 'UNKNOWN' ).
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX' AND connid = '0003' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Verwendung von `INSERT FROM @ls_flight` für das Einfügen einer einzelnen Zeile in eine Datenbanktabelle. Der Flugzeugtyp wird dynamisch mit dem `SWITCH` Ausdruck bestimmt, der eine kompakte Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF` Anweisungen darstellt und hier die `WHEN OTHERS` Klausel nutzt, um einen Standardwert zu setzen. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen (`DATA(lo_cut)`) und Hostvariablen (`@ls_flight`) sind weitere moderne ABAP-Features.
keywords: INSERT, SWITCH, WHEN, Database Access, SFLIGHTS, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Fügen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei Sie nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Mindestkapazität berücksichtigen. Nutzen Sie `LINES OF` und `FILTER`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT LINES OF` in Kombination mit einem `FILTER` Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                           iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_flight_data.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    INSERT LINES OF FILTER tt_flight_data( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                           WHERE seatsmax >= iv_min_capacity )
      INTO TABLE rt_filtered_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_insert FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_flights_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_insert.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_min_capacity) = 200.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                                    iv_min_capacity = lv_min_capacity ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = lv_carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_flight-seatsmax >= lv_min_capacity ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_found.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_filter( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'. "Non-existent airline
    DATA(lv_min_capacity) = 100.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                                    iv_min_capacity = lv_min_capacity ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT LINES OF` Anweisung in Kombination mit dem `FILTER` Ausdruck ermöglicht das effiziente Kopieren und Filtern von Zeilen zwischen internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung. Dies ist wesentlich kompakter und performanter als eine explizite Schleife mit `IF`-Bedingungen.
keywords: INSERT, LINES OF, FILTER, Internal Tables, Table Expressions

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist, soll der Status 'Active' sein, ansonsten 'Inactive'. Nutzen Sie den `COND` Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND type( WHEN condition THEN value WHEN OTHERS THEN other_value )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_status IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
                                RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    rv_status = COND string( WHEN iv_carrid = 'LH' THEN 'Active'
                              WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Inactive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_active_status FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_inactive_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_active_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Active' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_inactive_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_expression( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Inactive' ).
    lv_status = lo_cut->get_flight_status( 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_status exp = 'Inactive' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND` Ausdruck ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung. Anstatt einer `IF...ELSE...ENDIF` Struktur kann der Wert direkt zugewiesen werden, was den Code kürzer und funktionaler macht. Die `WHEN OTHERS` Klausel fängt alle nicht explizit genannten Bedingungen ab.
keywords: COND, WHEN, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Selektieren Sie Flugdaten aus `SFLIGHTS` und fügen Sie eine neue Spalte 'FlightCategory' hinzu, deren Wert basierend auf der Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`SEATSOCC`) und der maximalen Sitze (`SEATSMAX`) mit einer `CASE WHEN` Expression in der `SELECT` Anweisung bestimmt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SELECT ... CASE WHEN ... END AS ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_case_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_category,
             carrid        TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid        TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate        TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc      TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax      TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             flight_category TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_category,
           tt_flight_category TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_category WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_category RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_category.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_case_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_category.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax,
           CASE WHEN seatsocc / seatsmax >= 0.9 THEN 'Full'
                WHEN seatsocc / seatsmax >= 0.7 THEN 'High'
                WHEN seatsocc / seatsmax >= 0.5 THEN 'Medium'
                WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Low'
           END AS flight_category
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_categories FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_categories.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_case_when( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_category( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      DATA(lv_occupancy_rate) = COND decfloat34( WHEN ls_flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ls_flight-seatsocc / ls_flight-seatsmax ELSE 0 ).
      IF lv_occupancy_rate >= 0.9.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_category exp = 'Full' ).
      ELSEIF lv_occupancy_rate >= 0.7.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_category exp = 'High' ).
      ELSEIF lv_occupancy_rate >= 0.5.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_category exp = 'Medium' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-flight_category exp = 'Low' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CASE WHEN` Expression direkt in der `SELECT` Anweisung ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature von Open SQL, das es ermöglicht, bedingte Logik auf Datenbankebene auszuführen. Dies reduziert die Notwendigkeit, Daten in die Anwendungsschicht zu übertragen und dort zu verarbeiten, was die Performance verbessert und den Code vereinfacht. Die `WHEN OTHERS` Klausel stellt sicher, dass immer ein Wert zugewiesen wird.
keywords: SELECT, CASE WHEN, SQL, Database Access, SFLIGHTS, Open SQL

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer. Für jede Gruppe sollen die ersten 3 Flüge separat verarbeitet werden, alle weiteren Flüge sollen in einer 'OTHERS'-Gruppe zusammengefasst werden. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ... WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY ( ... ) INTO DATA(group) ... WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_when_others DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key,
           BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info,
           tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_grouped_result,
             group_key TYPE ty_flight_key,
             first_three_flights TYPE tt_flight_info,
             other_flights_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_result,
           tt_grouped_result TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_when_others IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_flight_info.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid connid fldate.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight_entry) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight_entry-carrid
                                                               connid = ls_flight_entry-connid )
                                                    INTO DATA(group_key).

      DATA(ls_grouped_item) = VALUE ty_grouped_result( group_key = group_key ).
      DATA(lv_count) = 0.

      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_member) WHERE ( lv_count < 3 ).
        INSERT ls_member INTO TABLE ls_grouped_item-first_three_flights.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.
      ENDLOOP.

      LOOP AT GROUP group_key INTO DATA(ls_other_member) WHERE ( lv_count >= 3 ).
        ls_grouped_item-other_flights_count = ls_grouped_item-other_flights_count + 1.
        lv_count = lv_count + 1.

CLASS zcl_nested_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_price_range IMPORTING iv_price    TYPE sflight-price
                                      iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_range) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_nested_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_price_range.
    rv_range = COND string(
      WHEN iv_currency = 'EUR' THEN
        COND string(
          WHEN iv_price < 100 THEN 'Low EUR'
          WHEN iv_price < 500 THEN 'Medium EUR'
          WHEN OTHERS THEN 'High EUR'
        )
      WHEN iv_currency = 'USD' THEN
        COND string(
          WHEN iv_price < 120 THEN 'Low USD'
          WHEN iv_price < 600 THEN 'Medium USD'
          WHEN OTHERS THEN 'High USD'
        )
      WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Unknown Currency'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie eine neue Zeile in eine sortierte interne Tabelle ein, wobei die Sortierreihenfolge beibehalten wird. Nutzen Sie `INSERT` mit `INDEX` und `WHEN` um die Position zu bestimmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... INDEX ...` und finden Sie den Index mit `LINE_INDEX` oder einer manuellen Suche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_sorted DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE i,
             value_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY key_field.

    METHODS insert_into_sorted IMPORTING is_new_data TYPE ty_data
                               CHANGING ct_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_sorted IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_into_sorted.
    DATA(lv_index) = 0.

    LOOP AT ct_data INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      IF is_new_data-key_field < ls_entry-key_field.
        lv_index = sy-tabix.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lv_index > 0.
      INSERT is_new_data INTO TABLE ct_data INDEX lv_index.
    ELSE.
      INSERT is_new_data INTO TABLE ct_data.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_middle.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_insert_sorted=>tt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( key_field = 1 value_field = 'One' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( key_field = 3 value_field = 'Three' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA(ls_new) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted=>ty_data( key_field = 2 value_field = 'Two' ).
    NEW zcl_insert_sorted( )->insert_into_sorted( EXPORTING is_new_data = ls_new CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-key_field exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 2 ]-value_field exp = 'Two' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_end.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_insert_sorted=>tt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( key_field = 1 value_field = 'One' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( key_field = 2 value_field = 'Two' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA(ls_new) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted=>ty_data( key_field = 3 value_field = 'Three' ).
    NEW zcl_insert_sorted( )->insert_into_sorted( EXPORTING is_new_data = ls_new CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 3 ]-key_field exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_beginning.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_insert_sorted=>tt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( key_field = 2 value_field = 'Two' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( key_field = 3 value_field = 'Three' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA(ls_new) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted=>ty_data( key_field = 1 value_field = 'One' ).
    NEW zcl_insert_sorted( )->insert_into_sorted( EXPORTING is_new_data = ls_new CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-key_field exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_duplicate_key.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_insert_sorted=>tt_data.
    INSERT VALUE #( key_field = 1 value_field = 'One' ) INTO TABLE lt_data.

    DATA(ls_new) = VALUE zcl_insert_sorted=>ty_data( key_field = 1 value_field = 'One Duplicate' ).
    NEW zcl_insert_sorted( )->insert_into_sorted( EXPORTING is_new_data = ls_new CHANGING ct_data = lt_data ).

    " For unique sorted tables, INSERT with duplicate key results in sy-subrc = 4 and no insertion
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_data ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_data[ 1 ]-value_field exp = 'One' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl ABAP sortierte Tabellen automatisch die Sortierreihenfolge beim `INSERT` beibehalten, zeigt dieses Beispiel, wie man manuell einen Index bestimmen und `INSERT ... INDEX` verwenden könnte, was in anderen Kontexten nützlich sein kann (z.B. bei Standardtabellen, die sortiert gehalten werden sollen). Die `LOOP AT ... WHEN` Logik (hier als `IF` innerhalb der Schleife) wird verwendet, um den Einfügepunkt zu finden. Für sortierte Tabellen ist `INSERT` ohne `INDEX` oft ausreichend, aber das Beispiel demonstriert die explizite Index-Steuerung.
keywords: INSERT, INDEX, WHEN, Sorted Table, Internal Tables

Instructions: Fügen Sie dynamisch Zeilen in eine interne Tabelle ein, deren Struktur zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Nutzen Sie `INSERT` mit dynamischer Typisierung und `WHEN` für die Feldzuweisung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` für die dynamische Tabelle und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` für die Feldzuweisung, kombiniert mit `INSERT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_field,
             name TYPE fieldname,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_dynamic_field,
           tt_dynamic_fields TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_field WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_dynamic_row IMPORTING it_field_values TYPE tt_dynamic_fields
                               CHANGING cr_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_dynamic_row.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <ls_dynamic_row>   TYPE ANY,
                   <lv_field>         TYPE ANY.

    ASSIGN cr_dynamic_table->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Handle error: dynamic table not assigned
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE DATA <ls_dynamic_row> LIKE LINE OF <lt_dynamic_table>.

    LOOP AT it_field_values INTO DATA(ls_field_value).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_field_value-name OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_row> TO <lv_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        <lv_field> = ls_field_value-value.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    INSERT <ls_dynamic_row> INTO TABLE <lt_dynamic_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `IF sy-subrc = 0` Prüfung nach `ASSIGN COMPONENT` dient als `WHEN` Bedingung, um sicherzustellen, dass das Feld existiert, bevor ein Wert zugewiesen wird. CLASS zcl_insert_from_table_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_insert_from_table_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_selected_flights.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER tt_new_flights( it_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @lt_filtered_flights.

    rv_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen in eine interne Tabelle ein, die aus einer anderen Tabelle stammen, aber nur, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist, und transformieren Sie dabei die Daten. Nutzen Sie `INSERT` mit `VALUE`, `FOR` und `WHEN`.

CLASS zcl_insert_for_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_source_flight,
           tt_source_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_target_flight,
             airline_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_nr  TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occupancy_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target_flight,
           tt_target_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_and_insert IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_source_flights
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_target_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_for_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_insert.
    rt_target = VALUE #( FOR ls_source IN it_source
                           WHEN ls_source-seatsocc > 0 " Only insert if seats are occupied
                           ( airline_id = ls_source-carrid,
                             flight_nr  = ls_source-connid,
                             flight_date = ls_source-fldate,
                             occupancy_status = COND string( WHEN ls_source-seatsocc > 100 THEN 'High' WHEN OTHERS THEN 'Low' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `WHEN` Klausel innerhalb des `FOR` Ausdrucks ermöglicht eine sehr präzise Kontrolle darüber, welche Zeilen in die neue Tabelle aufgenommen werden. Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flugbuchungen in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` ein, aber nur, wenn die Fluggesellschaft 'LH' ist und der Flug noch nicht existiert. Nutzen Sie `INSERT` mit `FROM TABLE` und `ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` in Kombination mit einem `FILTER` Ausdruck.

CLASS zcl_insert_accepting_dup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight_data,

                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_accepting_dup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_unique_lh_flights.
    DATA(lt_lh_flights) = FILTER tt_flight_data( it_flights WHERE carrid = 'LH' ).

    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @lt_lh_flights ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` Anweisung ist eine effiziente Methode, um Masseneinfügungen in Datenbanktabellen durchzuführen, wobei Primärschlüsselverletzungen ignoriert werden. In Kombination mit dem `FILTER` Ausdruck, der hier als `WHEN` Bedingung dient, können wir nicht nur Duplikate vermeiden, sondern auch nur spezifische Zeilen aus der Quelltabelle für das Einfügen auswählen. `sy-dbcnt` liefert die Anzahl der tatsächlich eingefügten Zeilen.

CLASS zcl_insert_if_when DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_simple,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_simple,

                                          iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
                                CHANGING ct_flights TYPE tt_flight_simple.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_if_when IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight_if_valid.
    IF iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL.
      INSERT VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ) INTO TABLE ct_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Obwohl es keine direkte `WHEN` Klausel im `INSERT` Statement gibt, ist die `IF` Bedingung die klassische Art, eine 'wenn-dann'-Logik zu implementieren. In modernen ABAP-Versionen wird dies oft durch Ausdrücke wie `COND` oder `FILTER` ersetzt, aber für einfache, imperative Kontrollflüsse ist die `IF` Anweisung weiterhin relevant und klar verständlich.

Instructions: Fügen Sie Zeilen in eine interne Tabelle ein, die aus einer anderen Tabelle stammen, aber nur, wenn die Zeile noch nicht existiert (verhindern Sie Duplikate), und verwenden Sie dabei eine `REDUCE` Expression mit `INSERT`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine neue Tabelle zu konstruieren und Duplikate zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_insert_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key,
           tt_flight_key TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS get_unique_flights IMPORTING it_source_flights TYPE tt_flight_key
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rt_unique_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_insert_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_flights.
    rt_unique_flights = REDUCE tt_flight_key(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_key( )
      FOR ls_source IN it_source_flights
      LET lv_dummy = INSERT ls_source INTO TABLE result
      IN result
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die `REDUCE` Expression ist ein sehr mächtiges Werkzeug für die funktionale Programmierung in ABAP, das es ermöglicht, eine einzelne Ergebnisvariable (hier eine interne Tabelle) durch Iteration über eine Quelltabelle zu konstruieren. Durch die Verwendung von `INSERT ... INTO TABLE result` innerhalb des `REDUCE` Ausdrucks und der Eigenschaft von HASHED TABLES, Duplikate zu verhindern, können wir eine eindeutige Zieltabelle effizient aufbauen. Die `LET` Klausel wird verwendet, um den Rückgabewert von `INSERT` zu ignorieren.

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flugbuchungen in die Datenbanktabelle `SFLIGHTS` ein, wobei die Daten aus einer internen Tabelle stammen und eine `CASE WHEN` Expression verwendet wird, um den Flugzeugtyp zu bestimmen, aber nur, wenn der Flugpreis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @( ... )` mit einem `FILTER` Ausdruck, der eine `CASE WHEN` Logik enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_filter_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data,
           tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_high_value_flights IMPORTING it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
                                              iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_filter_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_high_value_flights.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data(
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      WHEN ls_flight-price > iv_min_price
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        connid = ls_flight-connid,
        fldate = ls_flight-fldate,
        price = ls_flight-price,
        currency = ls_flight-currency,
        planetype = SWITCH #( ls_flight-carrid
                              WHEN 'LH' THEN 'A380'
                              WHEN 'AA' THEN 'B777'
                              WHEN OTHERS THEN 'UNKNOWN' ) ) ).

    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @lt_filtered_flights ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.

    rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_high_value FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_low_value FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_high_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_filter_case( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_min_price) = 500.

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = 'HV1' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = 'HV2' AND fldate = lv_fldate.

    DATA(lt_flights_to_insert) = VALUE zcl_insert_filter_case=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = 'HV1' fldate = lv_fldate price = 600 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = 'HV2' fldate = lv_fldate price = 700 currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = 'LV1' fldate = lv_fldate price = 400 currency = 'USD' ) " Below min price
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->insert_high_value_flights( it_flights = lt_flights_to_insert
                                                        iv_min_price = lv_min_price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ).

    SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_planetype_lh)
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = 'HV1' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_planetype_lh exp = 'A380' ).

    SELECT SINGLE planetype FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_planetype_aa)
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = 'HV2' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_planetype_aa exp = 'B777' ).

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = 'HV1' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = 'HV2' AND fldate = lv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_low_value.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_filter_case( ).
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_min_price) = 1000.

    DATA(lt_flights_to_insert) = VALUE zcl_insert_filter_case=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = 'LV2' fldate = lv_fldate price = 800 currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_count) = lo_cut->insert_high_value_flights( it_flights = lt_flights_to_insert
                                                        iv_min_price = lv_min_price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine fortgeschrittene Kombination von modernen ABAP-Features: `INSERT ... FROM TABLE` für Datenbankeinfügungen, `VALUE #( FOR ... WHEN ... ( ... ) )` für die Filterung und Transformation der Quelldaten und `SWITCH` für die bedingte Zuweisung des Flugzeugtyps. Die `WHEN` Klausel im `FOR` Ausdruck filtert die Zeilen basierend auf dem Preis, bevor sie in die Zieltabelle transformiert und dann in die Datenbank eingefügt werden. Dies ist ein sehr leistungsfähiges Muster für komplexe Datenintegrationen.
keywords: INSERT, FROM TABLE, VALUE, FOR, WHEN, SWITCH, Database Access, SFLIGHTS, Filter, Transformation

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_reduce_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    rv_concatenated = REDUCE string(

Instructions: Finden Sie den größten Wert in einer internen Tabelle von Ganzzahlen.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit einer INIT-Variable und einer Kondition, um den Maximalwert zu verfolgen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_max_value
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide. "Placeholder for custom exception if table is empty
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_value.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      " In a real scenario, raise a custom exception or return a default value.
      " For this example, we'll raise a standard exception for simplicity.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide. "Example: table empty, cannot find max
    ENDIF.

    rv_max = REDUCE i(
      INIT m = it_numbers[ 1 ] " Initialize with the first element
      FOR num IN it_numbers
      NEXT m = COND i( WHEN num > m THEN num ELSE m )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_get_max_value_negative FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_max_value_exception FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_zerodivide.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_max( ).

    DATA(lv_max) = lo_cut->get_max_value( lt_numbers ).

  METHOD test_get_max_value_single.

  METHOD test_get_max_value_negative.

Instructions: Zählen Sie, wie oft ein bestimmter Wert in einer internen Tabelle vorkommt.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit einem Zähler, der bei jedem Treffer inkrementiert wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_count DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        it_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string
        iv_search TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_reduce_count IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_occurrences.
    rv_count = REDUCE i(
      INIT c = 0
      FOR val IN it_values
      NEXT c = COND i( WHEN val = iv_search THEN c + 1 ELSE c )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Standardtabelle von Flugdaten (sflights) in eine Hash-Tabelle, wobei der Fluggesellschaftscode (CARRID) der Schlüssel ist und die gesamte Zeile der Wert.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE, um eine neue Hash-Tabelle zu konstruieren und Elemente hinzuzufügen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_to_hashed DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      ty_sflight_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
      ty_sflight_h_tab TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS transform_to_hashed
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE ty_sflight_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashed_sflights) TYPE ty_sflight_h_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_to_hashed IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_to_hashed.
    rt_hashed_sflights = REDUCE ty_sflight_h_tab(
      INIT h_tab = VALUE ty_sflight_h_tab( )
      FOR flight IN it_sflights
      NEXT h_tab = VALUE ty_sflight_h_tab( BASE h_tab ( flight ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_to_hashed FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_to_hashed_duplicate FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_to_hashed_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_to_hashed.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_to_hashed( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_to_hashed=>ty_sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250103' price = '150.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_hashed) = lo_cut->transform_to_hashed( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_hashed ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_hashed[ carrid = 'LH' ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_hashed[ carrid = 'AA' ]-price exp = '200.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transform_to_hashed_duplicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_to_hashed( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_to_hashed=>ty_sflight_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '120.00' currency = 'EUR' ) " Duplicate key
    ).
    " When inserting duplicate keys into a HASHED TABLE, the first entry wins.
    " Or, if using INSERT, it would raise CX_SY_ITAB_DUPLICATE_KEY.
    " REDUCE with BASE h_tab ( flight ) will overwrite if key exists.
    DATA(lt_hashed) = lo_cut->transform_to_hashed( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_hashed ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_hashed[ carrid = 'LH' ]-connid exp = '0401' ). " Last one wins with BASE
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transform_to_hashed_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_to_hashed( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_reduce_to_hashed=>ty_sflight_tab( ).
    DATA(lt_hashed) = lo_cut->transform_to_hashed( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_hashed ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `REDUCE` kann verwendet werden, um eine neue interne Tabelle (hier eine Hash-Tabelle) aufzubauen, indem Elemente aus einer Quelltabelle iterativ hinzugefügt werden. `BASE h_tab ( flight )` ist eine moderne Syntax, um Elemente zu einer bestehenden Tabelle hinzuzufügen.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Hashed Table, Data Transformation, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein Eingabeparameter einen ungültigen Wert hat (z.B. eine negative Zahl, wo nur positive erwartet werden).
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von CX_STATIC_CHECK erbt, und verwenden Sie RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_input_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE if_abap_exception=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_input_value TYPE i OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_input_value = iv_input_value.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = zcx_invalid_input.default.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_positive_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_input_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_positive_number.
    IF iv_number <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_invalid_input( iv_input_value = iv_number ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_input FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_input_validator( ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Definition einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt, ermöglicht eine typsichere Fehlerbehandlung. Das Auslösen mit `RAISE EXCEPTION NEW` ist die moderne Art, Ausnahmen zu instanziieren und zu werfen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Divisionsmethode, die eine Ausnahme auslöst, wenn der Divisor Null ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die vordefinierte Ausnahme CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE i
        iv_divisor  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = cl_abap_unit_assert=>create_exception_object( 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE' )
      exp = cl_abap_unit_assert=>create_exception_object( 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE' )

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung einer wiederaufnehmbaren Ausnahme (resumable exception) in einer Methode, die versucht, eine Liste von Elementen zu verarbeiten. Wenn ein Element fehlerhaft ist, soll eine wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahme ausgelöst werden, die es dem Aufrufer ermöglicht, den Fehler zu protokollieren und die Verarbeitung fortzusetzen.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Ausnahme, die von CX_STATIC_CHECK erbt und das Interface IF_ABAP_RESUMABLE implementiert. Verwenden Sie RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION.
solution:
CLASS zcx_processing_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.

    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        id    TYPE string,
        value TYPE i,
      END OF ty_item,
      ty_item_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_items
      IMPORTING
        it_items TYPE ty_item_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_items) TYPE ty_item_tab
      RAISING
        zcx_processing_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_resumable_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_items.
    LOOP AT it_items INTO DATA(ls_item).
      IF ls_item-value < 0. " Simulate an error condition
        RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_processing_error( iv_item_id = ls_item-id ).
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_item TO rt_processed_items.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
