CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_resumable_exception FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_exception FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_resumable_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resumable_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_resumable_processor=>ty_item_tab(
      ( id = 'ITEM1' value = 10 )
      ( id = 'ITEM2' value = -5 ) " Error here
      ( id = 'ITEM3' value = 20 )
      ( id = 'ITEM4' value = -1 ) " Another error
      ( id = 'ITEM5' value = 30 )
    ).
    DATA lt_processed TYPE zcl_resumable_processor=>ty_item_tab.
    DATA lt_errors TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcx_processing_error.

    TRY.
        lt_processed = lo_cut->process_items( lt_items ).
      CATCH zcx_processing_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        APPEND lx_error TO lt_errors.
        RESUME. " Continue processing
    ENDTRY.

    " After processing, check the results
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 3 ). " ITEM1, ITEM3, ITEM5
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 1 ]->mv_item_id exp = 'ITEM2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 2 ]->mv_item_id exp = 'ITEM4' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_exception.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_resumable_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = VALUE zcl_resumable_processor=>ty_item_tab(
      ( id = 'ITEM1' value = 10 )
      ( id = 'ITEM2' value = 5 )
      ( id = 'ITEM3' value = 20 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_processed) = lo_cut->process_items( lt_items ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_processed ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Wiederaufnehmbare Ausnahmen (`RAISE RESUMABLE EXCEPTION`) sind nützlich, wenn Fehler in einer Schleife auftreten, die es dem Programm ermöglichen, die Verarbeitung fortzusetzen, nachdem der Fehler behandelt oder protokolliert wurde. Dies wird durch das Interface `IF_ABAP_RESUMABLE` und das `RESUME`-Statement im `CATCH`-Block ermöglicht.
keywords: RAISE EXCEPTION, Resumable Exception, IF_ABAP_RESUMABLE, Error Handling, TRY...CATCH...RESUME

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Ausnahme mit einer Nachricht aus einer Nachrichtenklasse auslöst. Die Nachricht soll Platzhalter für dynamische Werte enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme, die IF_T100_MESSAGE implementiert, und übergeben Sie die Nachrichten-ID und Parameter im Konstruktor.
solution:
" Assuming message class ZMSG_DEMO exists with message 001: 'Input value &1 is invalid. Expected: &2'
" (Nachrichtenklasse ZMSG_DEMO mit Nachricht 001: 'Eingabewert &1 ist ungültig. Erwartet: &2')

CLASS zcx_message_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    DATA mv_actual_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    DATA mv_expected_value TYPE string READ-ONLY.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE if_abap_exception=>previous OPTIONAL
        iv_actual_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_expected_value TYPE string OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_message_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->mv_actual_value = iv_actual_value.
    me->mv_expected_value = iv_expected_value.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = zcx_message_exception.default.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_raiser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
        iv_expected TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_message_exception.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_raiser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_value.
    IF iv_input <> iv_expected.
      RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_message_exception(
        textid = VALUE scx_t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG_DEMO' msgno = '001' attr1 = 'MV_ACTUAL_VALUE' attr2 = 'MV_EXPECTED_VALUE' )
        iv_actual_value = iv_input
        iv_expected_value = iv_expected
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_check_value_valid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_raiser( ).
    lo_cut->check_value( iv_input = 'ABC' iv_expected = 'ABC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( 'No exception expected' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_check_value_invalid.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_raiser( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->check_value( iv_input = 'XYZ' iv_expected = 'ABC' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception ZCX_MESSAGE_EXCEPTION expected' ).
      CATCH zcx_message_exception INTO DATA(lx_msg_exc).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_msg_exc->get_text( ) exp = 'Input value XYZ is invalid. Expected: ABC' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_msg_exc->mv_actual_value exp = 'XYZ' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lx_msg_exc->mv_expected_value exp = 'ABC' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Durch die Implementierung von `IF_T100_MESSAGE` in einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme kann eine Ausnahme mit einer dynamischen Nachricht aus einer Nachrichtenklasse ausgelöst werden. Die Platzhalter (`&1`, `&2`) werden automatisch durch die Werte der Attribute ersetzt, die in `attr1`, `attr2` usw. des `scx_t100key`-Struktur angegeben sind.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.

        RAISE EXCEPTION NEW zcx_flight_not_found( iv_carrid = iv_carrid iv_connid = iv_connid ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Wandeln Sie einen numerischen Monat (1-12) in seinen deutschen Namen um. Nutzen Sie eine moderne bedingte Zuweisung mit dem SWITCH-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den SWITCH-Operator für eine kompakte Fallunterscheidung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_month_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_month_name
      IMPORTING
        iv_month TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_month_name) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_month_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_month_name.
    rv_month_name = SWITCH #( iv_month
                              WHEN 1 THEN 'Januar'
                              WHEN 2 THEN 'Februar'
                              WHEN 3 THEN 'März'
                              WHEN 4 THEN 'April'
                              WHEN 5 THEN 'Mai'
                              WHEN 6 THEN 'Juni'
                              WHEN 7 THEN 'Juli'
                              WHEN 8 THEN 'August'
                              WHEN 9 THEN 'September'
                              WHEN 10 THEN 'Oktober'
                              WHEN 11 THEN 'November'
                              WHEN 12 THEN 'Dezember'
                              ELSE 'Ungültiger Monat' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Fluges (SFlight-Tabelle) basierend auf der Auslastung und dem Datum. Nutzen Sie COND für die Zuweisung mit mehreren WHEN-Bedingungen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den COND-Operator mit verschachtelten WHEN-Bedingungen für komplexe Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_data.

    METHODS get_flight_status
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_data TYPE ty_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status.
    DATA(lv_occupancy_rate) = COND f( WHEN is_flight_data-seatsmax > 0
                                      THEN ( is_flight_data-seatsocc * 100 ) / is_flight_data-seatsmax
                                      ELSE 0 ).

    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN is_flight_data-fldate < sy-datum THEN 'Vergangen'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 90 THEN 'Ausgebucht'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 70 THEN 'Stark gebucht'
      WHEN lv_occupancy_rate >= 30 THEN 'Normal gebucht'
      ELSE 'Gering gebucht'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_flight_status_checker( ).
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE zcl_flight_status_checker=>ty_flight_data.

    " Test case: Past flight
    ls_flight = VALUE #( fldate = sy-datum - 1 seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status( ls_flight ) exp = 'Vergangen' ).

    " Test case: Booked out
    ls_flight = VALUE #( fldate = sy-datum + 1 seatsocc = 95 seatsmax = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status( ls_flight ) exp = 'Ausgebucht' ).

    " Test case: Heavily booked
    ls_flight = VALUE #( fldate = sy-datum + 1 seatsocc = 75 seatsmax = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status( ls_flight ) exp = 'Stark gebucht' ).

    " Test case: Low booked
    ls_flight = VALUE #( fldate = sy-datum + 1 seatsocc = 20 seatsmax = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status( ls_flight ) exp = 'Gering gebucht' ).

    " Test case: Zero seats
    ls_flight = VALUE #( fldate = sy-datum + 1 seatsocc = 0 seatsmax = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_checker->get_flight_status( ls_flight ) exp = 'Gering gebucht' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der COND-Operator ermöglicht komplexe bedingte Zuweisungen in einem einzigen Ausdruck, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht als verschachtelte IF-Anweisungen. Er ist besonders nützlich, wenn ein Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Kriterien bestimmt werden muss.
keywords: COND, WHEN, Conditional Logic, SFlight, Functional Programming

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten (SFlight) und geben Sie nur Flüge zurück, die in der Zukunft liegen und eine Auslastung von über 50% haben. Nutzen Sie FOR mit einer bedingten Logik.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR ... IN ... WHERE und COND im WHERE-Teil oder als Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             occupancy TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_booked_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_booked_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_all_flights
                                   LET lv_occupancy = COND p( WHEN <fs_flight>-seatsmax > 0
                                                              THEN ( <fs_flight>-seatsocc * 100 ) / <fs_flight>-seatsmax
                                                              ELSE 0 ) IN
                                   WHERE ( <fs_flight>-fldate > sy-datum AND lv_occupancy >= 50 )
                                   ( carrid    = <fs_flight>-carrid

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge, die in der Zukunft liegen und eine Auslastung von über 70% haben. Nutzen Sie REDUCE mit bedingter Logik.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und COND für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_sum_booked_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sum_booked_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR <fs_flight> IN it_all_flights
                               LET lv_occupancy = COND p( WHEN <fs_flight>-seatsmax > 0
                                                          THEN ( <fs_flight>-seatsocc * 100 ) / <fs_flight>-seatsmax
                                                          ELSE 0 ) IN
                               WHERE ( <fs_flight>-fldate > sy-datum AND lv_occupancy >= 70 )
                               NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum + 1 seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflight. " Future, 80% -> Included (80)
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum - 1 seatsocc = 90 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflight. " Past -> Excluded
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = sy-datum + 1 seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflight. " Future, 60% -> Excluded
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = sy-datum + 2 seatsocc = 75 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflight. " Future, 75% -> Included (75)
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' fldate = sy-datum + 1 seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_sflight. " Future, 100% -> Included (100)

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_aggregator->get_sum_booked_seats( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_seats exp = 80 + 75 + 100 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ist ideal für Aggregationen über interne Tabellen. In Kombination mit FOR und COND ermöglicht er eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und funktionale Art, Daten basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu summieren oder zu verarbeiten, ohne explizite Schleifen.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Objekten unterschiedlicher Typen polymorph. Nutzen Sie CASE TYPE OF, um typspezifische Aktionen durchzuführen.
hint: Verwenden Sie CASE TYPE OF für die dynamische Typunterscheidung und typspezifische Logik.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shape.
  METHODS get_area RETURNING VALUE(rv_area) TYPE f.
  METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_desc) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_circle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_radius TYPE f.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_radius TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_circle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_radius = iv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = cl_abap_math=>pi * mv_radius * mv_radius.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
    rv_desc = |Kreis mit Radius { mv_radius }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shape.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_width TYPE f iv_height TYPE f.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_width TYPE f.
    DATA mv_height TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rectangle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_width = iv_width.
    mv_height = iv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_area.
    rv_area = mv_width * mv_height.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_shape~get_description.
    rv_desc = |Rechteck mit Breite { mv_width } und Höhe { mv_height }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_shapes
      IMPORTING
        it_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_descriptions) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shape_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_shapes.
    LOOP AT it_shapes INTO DATA(lo_shape).
      DATA(lv_description) = CASE TYPE OF lo_shape
                              WHEN TYPE zcl_circle THEN
                                " Specific logic for circle
                                lo_shape->get_description( ) && ' (Kreis)'
                              WHEN TYPE zcl_rectangle THEN
                                " Specific logic for rectangle
                                lo_shape->get_description( ) && ' (Rechteck)'
                              WHEN OTHERS THEN
                                'Unbekannte Form'
                            END.
      APPEND lv_description TO rt_descriptions.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_shapes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_shapes.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_shape_processor( ).
    DATA: lt_shapes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_shape.

    APPEND NEW zcl_circle( iv_radius = 5 ) TO lt_shapes.
    APPEND NEW zcl_rectangle( iv_width = 4 iv_height = 6 ) TO lt_shapes.

    DATA(lt_descriptions) = lo_processor->process_shapes( lt_shapes ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_descriptions ) exp = 2 ).

explanation: CASE TYPE OF ermöglicht eine elegante und typsichere Implementierung von polymorpher Logik. Anstatt manuelle Typprüfungen mit IS INSTANCE OF und CAST durchzuführen, kann man direkt auf den spezifischen Typ reagieren und typspezifische Methoden aufrufen oder Daten verarbeiten.
keywords: CASE TYPE OF, WHEN TYPE, Polymorphism, RTTI, Object Orientation

Instructions: Registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für ein Dummy-ECL-Viewer-Ereignis (z.B. VIEWER_CLICK). Da keine echte UI-Interaktion möglich ist, simulieren Sie die Registrierung und den Aufruf des Handlers.

CLASS zcl_ecl_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    mo_ecl_viewer = io_ecl_viewer.

    " Example: SET HANDLER me->handle_viewer_click FOR mo_ecl_viewer.
    " Since cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox events are not directly testable without a GUI,
    " we use an internal event for demonstration of the handler method.
    SET HANDLER me->handle_viewer_click FOR me. " Register handler for internal event
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_viewer_click.
    mv_click_count = mv_click_count + 1.
    " In a real scenario, i_event_data would contain actual event parameters.
    " Here, we just increment a counter.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Liste von Flugdaten (SFlight) nach komplexen Kriterien: Flüge, die entweder von 'FRA' abfliegen und eine hohe Auslastung haben, oder Flüge, die nach 'JFK' fliegen und in der Business Class noch Plätze frei haben. Nutzen Sie FILTER mit COND.
hint: Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator mit einer komplexen COND-Bedingung, die mehrere WHEN-Klauseln enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_complex_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_special_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_special_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE (
                                      COND abap_bool(
                                        WHEN airpfrom = 'FRA' AND ( seatsocc * 100 ) / seatsmax >= 80 THEN abap_true
                                        WHEN airpto = 'JFK' AND seatsbmax - seatsbocc > 0 THEN abap_true
                                        ELSE abap_false
                                      ) = abap_true
                                    ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_complex_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_complex_filter.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_complex_filter( ).
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Dummy data for sflight
    " Case 1: FRA, high occupancy (80%) -> Included
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' airpfrom = 'FRA' airpto = 'MUC'
                          seatsocc = 80 seatsmax = 100 seatsbocc = 10 seatsbmax = 20 ) TO lt_sflight.
    " Case 2: FRA, low occupancy (50%) -> Excluded
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' airpfrom = 'FRA' airpto = 'MUC'
                          seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 100 seatsbocc = 10 seatsbmax = 20 ) TO lt_sflight.
    " Case 3: JFK, business seats available -> Included
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' airpfrom = 'LAX' airpto = 'JFK'
                          seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 100 seatsbocc = 10 seatsbmax = 20 ) TO lt_sflight.
    " Case 4: JFK, no business seats available -> Excluded
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0011' airpfrom = 'LAX' airpto = 'JFK'
                          seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 100 seatsbocc = 20 seatsbmax = 20 ) TO lt_sflight.
    " Case 5: Neither FRA high occ nor JFK business -> Excluded
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' airpfrom = 'MUC' airpto = 'LAX'
                          seatsocc = 70 seatsmax = 100 seatsbocc = 5 seatsbmax = 10 ) TO lt_sflight.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_filter->get_special_flights( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-connid exp = '0010' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf komplexen Bedingungen zu filtern. Die Integration von COND innerhalb der WHERE-Klausel ermöglicht die Definition mehrstufiger oder alternativer Filterkriterien in einem einzigen, gut lesbaren Ausdruck.
keywords: FILTER, WHERE, COND, WHEN, Internal Tables, SFlight, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (SFlight) nach Fluggesellschaft und bestimmen Sie für jede Gruppe einen Status basierend auf der Anzahl der Flüge. Nutzen Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY mit COND.
hint: Verwenden Sie LOOP AT ... GROUP BY und COND für die bedingte Statuszuweisung innerhalb der Gruppen. GROUP SIZE liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             group_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_status
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_status.
    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
                                                  INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = GROUP SIZE.
      DATA(lv_group_status) = COND string(
                                WHEN lv_flight_count >= 3 THEN 'Hohes Volumen'
                                WHEN lv_flight_count = 2 THEN 'Mittleres Volumen'
                                ELSE 'Geringes Volumen'
                              ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid       = ls_group_key-carrid
                      flight_count = lv_flight_count
                      group_status = lv_group_status ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    " Dummy data for sflight
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' ) TO lt_sflight. " LH: 3 flights -> Hohes Volumen
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' ) TO lt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0011' ) TO lt_sflight. " UA: 2 flights -> Mittleres Volumen
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0020' ) TO lt_sflight. " AA: 1 flight -> Geringes Volumen

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_status( lt_sflight ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_lh_group) = lt_result[ carrid = 'LH' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-flight_count exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_group-group_status exp = 'Hohes Volumen' ).

    DATA(ls_ua_group) = lt_result[ carrid = 'UA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_group-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_ua_group-group_status exp = 'Mittleres Volumen' ).

    DATA(ls_aa_group) = lt_result[ carrid = 'AA' ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-flight_count exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa_group-group_status exp = 'Geringes Volumen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion in modernem ABAP, um Daten in internen Tabellen zu gruppieren und aggregierte Informationen zu verarbeiten. Die Verwendung von COND innerhalb der Schleife ermöglicht die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten oder Status basierend auf den Eigenschaften der Gruppe, wie z.B. der GROUP SIZE.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, GROUP SIZE, COND, WHEN, Internal Tables, Grouping, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine URL-Query-String aus einer Map von Parametern. Die Parameterwerte sollen dabei URL-kodiert werden. Nutzen Sie `CL_HTTP_UTILITY` und den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_UTILITY=>URL_ENCODE` für die Werte und `REDUCE` zum Aufbau des Strings.
solution:
CLASS zcl_url_query_builder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_param.
    TYPES: tt_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS build_query_string
      IMPORTING
        it_params TYPE tt_params
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_query_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_url_query_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_query_string.
    rv_query_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR <fs_param> IN it_params
      LET encoded_value = cl_http_utility=>url_encode( <fs_param>-value )
      IN
        COND string(
          WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN

CLASS zcl_cookie_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_cookie_parser IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_parsed_cookies) = cl_http_utility=>parse_cookie_string( iv_cookie_string ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_cookies) = FILTER #( lt_parsed_cookies USING KEY name_key WHERE name CP 'SAP*' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Prozess mit mehreren Schritten und geben Sie den Fortschritt und die Ergebnisse jedes Schrittes mit `CL_DEMO_OUTPUT` aus. Nutzen Sie dabei den `SWITCH`-Operator für die Statusanzeige.

CLASS zcl_demo_process_output DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_process.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_demo_process_output IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_process.
    DATA: lv_step TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_status TYPE string.

    cl_demo_output=>begin_section( 'Prozesssimulation' ).

    DO 3 TIMES.
      lv_status = SWITCH string(
        lv_step
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Initialisierung'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Verarbeitung'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Finalisierung'
        ELSE 'Unbekannt'
      ).
      cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Schritt { lv_step }: { lv_status }...| ).
      " Simulieren einer Arbeitslast
      WAIT UP TO 1 SECONDS.
      cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Schritt { lv_step }: { lv_status } abgeschlossen.| ).
      ADD 1 TO lv_step.
      cl_demo_output=>new_line( ).
    ENDDO.

    cl_demo_output=>end_section( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        iv_base_url   TYPE string
        it_path_segments TYPE string_table
        it_query_params  TYPE tt_query_params OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_full_url) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_url_builder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD build_rest_url.
    DATA(lv_path) = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR segment IN it_path_segments
      IN |{ result }/{ cl_http_utility=>url_encode( segment ) }|
    ).

    DATA(lv_query_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT result = ``
      FOR param IN it_query_params
      LET encoded_value = cl_http_utility=>url_encode( param-value )
      IN
        COND string(
          WHEN result IS INITIAL THEN
            |{ param-name }={ encoded_value }|
          ELSE
            |{ result }&{ param-name }={ encoded_value }|
        )
    ).

    rv_full_url = |{ iv_base_url }{ lv_path }|.
    IF lv_query_string IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_full_url = |{ rv_full_url }?{ lv_query_string }|.
    ENDIF.

    cl_demo_output=>begin_section( 'RESTful URL Konstruktion' ).
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Basis URL: { iv_base_url }| ).
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Pfadsegmente: { REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR seg IN it_path_segments IN |{ s }, { seg }| )+2 }| ).
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Query Parameter: { REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR p IN it_query_params IN |{ s }, { p-name }={ p-value }| )+2 }| ).
    cl_demo_output=>write_text( |Resultierende URL: { rv_full_url }| ).
    cl_demo_output=>end_section( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_email_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject   TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_email_safe.
    rv_success = abap_false.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_message=>create_persistent( ).

        DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
          i_type    = 'RAW'
          i_text    = cl_bcs_message=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
          i_subject = iv_subject
        ).

        lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document ).

        DATA(lo_recipient) = cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient ).
        lo_bcs->add_recipient( lo_recipient ).

        lo_bcs->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_false ). " Set to false for background processing
        COMMIT WORK.
        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        " Log the error, e.g., using CL_ABAP_LOGGER or a custom logging mechanism
        " For simplicity, we'll just write to SY-MSGTY.
        MESSAGE lx_bcs->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        " In a real scenario, you would log this to a proper application log (SLG1)
        " or send an alert.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_send_email_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_error_handling( ).
    " Mocking CL_BCS_MESSAGE for a true unit test would be ideal.
    " Here, we assume a valid recipient will lead to success (or no exception).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->send_email_safe(
      iv_recipient = 'safe_test@example.com'
      iv_subject   = 'Safe Email Test'
      iv_body      = 'This email should be sent successfully.'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_true msg = 'Email should be sent successfully' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_send_email_failure.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_error_handling( ).
    " To simulate a failure, we could pass an invalid recipient format
    " or rely on a mocked BCS class to raise an exception.
    " For this example, we'll use a known invalid format that BCS might reject.
    " Note: BCS might not always raise an exception for syntactically invalid addresses
    " until actual sending. This is a simplified test.
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->send_email_safe(
      iv_recipient = 'invalid-email' " This format is likely to cause issues or be rejected by BCS
      iv_subject   = 'Failed Email Test'
      iv_body      = 'This email should fail to send.'
    ).
    " Depending on BCS internal validation, this might still return true if the error
    " occurs asynchronously. A robust test would require mocking.
    " For now, we assert it's not successful if an exception is caught.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_success exp = abap_false msg = 'Email should fail or be handled' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

             total_revenue TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_airline_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airline_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = REDUCE tt_flight_summary(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_flight_summary( )
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
      LET total_seats_group = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN GROUP flight NEXT s = s + member-seatsocc )
          total_revenue_group = REDUCE s_price( INIT r = 0 FOR member IN GROUP flight NEXT r = r + member-price ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                           total_seats = total_seats_group
                                           total_revenue = total_revenue_group ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und ein bestimmtes Reisedatum haben. Verwenden Sie den FILTER-Operator.
hint: Nutzen Sie den FILTER-Operator, um eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf Bedingungen zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND fldate = iv_fldate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_sflights( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '20251209'. " Assuming some data exists for this date

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
    ).

    " Assert that all entries in the filtered table match the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = lv_carrid msg = 'Carrier ID mismatch' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-fldate exp = lv_fldate msg = 'Flight date mismatch' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert that if there are entries, they are not initial
    IF lines( lt_filtered ) > 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_filtered msg = 'Filtered table should not be empty if data exists' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der FILTER-Operator bietet eine elegante und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf bestimmten Kriterien zu filtern. Anstatt eine explizite LOOP-Anweisung zu verwenden, wird hier eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Einträgen direkt zugewiesen. Die Verwendung von USING KEY primary_key ist effizient, wenn die Filterkriterien dem Primärschlüssel entsprechen.
keywords: FILTER, Interne Tabelle, SFLIGHTS, Selektion, WHERE

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die basierend auf einem Typ-Parameter Instanzen verschiedener konkreter Nachrichtensender (E-Mail, Konsole) zurückgibt. Nutzen Sie die abstrakte Basisklasse aus Beispiel 3.
hint: Verwenden Sie den NEW-Operator mit einem Typ-Parameter und die abstrakte Basisklasse als Rückgabetyp der Factory-Methode.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_sender_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_message_data,
             type      TYPE string, " 'EMAIL' or 'CONSOLE'
             recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr,
             subject   TYPE string,
             body      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_message_data.

    CLASS-METHODS create_sender
      IMPORTING
        is_message_data TYPE ty_message_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_sender) TYPE REF TO zcl_abstract_message_sender
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_sender_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_sender.
    CASE is_message_data-type.
      WHEN 'EMAIL'.
        ro_sender = NEW zcl_concrete_email_sender(
          iv_recipient = is_message_data-recipient
          iv_subject   = is_message_data-subject
          iv_body      = is_message_data-body
        ).
      WHEN 'CONSOLE'.
        ro_sender = NEW zcl_concrete_console_sender(
          iv_subject = is_message_data-subject
          iv_body    = is_message_data-body
        ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_object_error
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unbekannter Nachrichtentyp: { is_message_data-type }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_email_sender FOR TESTING RAISING cx_bcs cx_sy_create_object_error.
    METHODS test_create_console_sender FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_create_object_error.
    METHODS test_create_unknown_sender FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_email_sender.
    DATA(ls_email_data) = VALUE zcl_message_sender_factory=>ty_message_data(
      type      = 'EMAIL'
      recipient = 'factory_email@example.com'
      subject   = 'Factory Email'
      body      = 'This email was created by a factory.'
    ).
    DATA(lo_sender) = zcl_message_sender_factory=>create_sender( ls_email_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_sender msg = 'Sender object should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_sender IS INSTANCE OF zcl_concrete_email_sender msg = 'Should be an email sender instance' ).
    TRY.
        lo_sender->send_message( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Email sender via factory should not raise exception' ).
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_bcs->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_console_sender.
    DATA(ls_console_data) = VALUE zcl_message_sender_factory=>ty_message_data(
      type    = 'CONSOLE'
      subject = 'Factory Console'
      body    = 'This console message was created by a factory.'
    ).
    DATA(lo_sender) = zcl_message_sender_factory=>create_sender( ls_console_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lo_sender msg = 'Sender object should be created' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_sender IS INSTANCE OF zcl_concrete_console_sender msg = 'Should be a console sender instance' ).
    lo_sender->send_message( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Console sender via factory should complete without error' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_unknown_sender.
    DATA(ls_unknown_data) = VALUE zcl_message_sender_factory=>ty_message_data(
      type    = 'UNKNOWN'
      subject = 'Unknown Type'
      body    = 'This should fail.'
    ).
    TRY.
        zcl_message_sender_factory=>create_sender( ls_unknown_data ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected CX_SY_CREATE_OBJECT_ERROR for unknown type' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lx_error->get_text( ) msg = 'Error message should not be initial' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert das Factory-Muster, um Instanzen von Nachrichtensendern dynamisch zu erstellen. Die Factory-Methode create_sender gibt eine Referenz auf die abstrakte Basisklasse zurück, was die Polymorphie nutzt. Der NEW-Operator wird hier verwendet, um Instanzen der konkreten Klassen basierend auf dem Eingabetyp zu erzeugen. Dies entkoppelt die Client-Logik von der konkreten Implementierung der Sender.
keywords: Factory-Muster, Objektorientierung, Polymorphie, NEW, ABSTRACT, CL_BCS_MESSAGE, SBCS_SEND

solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_short,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,

        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_short.

      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 10 msg = 'Too many rows selected' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Senden Sie eine E-Mail unter Verwendung von Methodenverkettung (Method Chaining) für CL_BCS_MESSAGE, um den Code kompakter zu gestalten.
hint: Verketten Sie Methodenaufrufe, die eine Referenz auf das Objekt zurückgeben, um den Code flüssiger zu schreiben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bcs_method_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS send_chained_email
      IMPORTING
        iv_recipient TYPE ad_smtpadr
        iv_subject   TYPE bcs_subject
        iv_body      TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_bcs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bcs_method_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD send_chained_email.
    DATA(lo_bcs) = cl_bcs_message=>create_persistent( ).

    DATA(lo_document) = cl_document_bcs=>create_document(
      i_type    = 'RAW'
      i_text    = cl_bcs_message=>string_to_soli( iv_body )
      i_subject = iv_subject
    ).

    lo_bcs->set_document( lo_document
      )->add_recipient( cl_cam_address_bcs=>create_internet_address( iv_recipient )
      )->send( i_with_error_screen = abap_true ).
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_send_chained_email.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bcs_method_chain( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->send_chained_email(
          iv_recipient = 'chained@example.com'
          iv_subject   = 'Chained Email Test'
          iv_body      = 'This email was sent using method chaining.'
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Chained email send method should not raise an exception' ).
      CATCH cx_bcs INTO DATA(lx_bcs).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_bcs->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenverkettung) ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf demselben Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten, was den Code kompakter und flüssiger macht. Dies ist möglich, wenn die aufgerufenen Methoden eine Referenz auf das Objekt selbst zurückgeben (z.B. 'ME->').
keywords: Method Chaining, Methodenverkettung, CL_BCS_MESSAGE, Kompakter Code, SBCS_SEND

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf der Struktur einer vorhandenen Tabelle (z.B. `SFLIGHTS`).
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` und `CREATE DATA`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_table_type TYPE string " e.g., 'SFLIGHTS'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rr_dynamic_table) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    TRY.
        lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_table_type ).
        lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                            p_line_type  = lr_struct_descr
                            p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                            p_unique     = abap_false ).
        CREATE DATA rr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.
      CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_invalid_name.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_dynamic_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    DATA(lr_table_ref) = lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( 'SFLIGHTS' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lr_table_ref ).

    DATA(lr_table_descr) = CAST cl_abap_tabledescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data_ref( lr_table_ref ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_table_descr->table_kind_str exp = 'STANDARD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lr_table_descr->get_table_line_type( )->get_name( ) exp = 'SFLIGHTS' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_table( ).
    lo_cut->create_dynamic_table( 'NON_EXISTENT_TYPE' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die ersten 3 Zeilen einer Quelltabelle enthält, und fügen Sie die Zeilennummer (Index) als neues Feld hinzu.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR` Schleife mit `sy-tabix` und `VALUE #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tabix_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_with_index,
             index TYPE i,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_with_index.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_with_index TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_with_index WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_flights_with_index
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_count    TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_sflight_with_index.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tabix_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights_with_index.
    rt_result = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                         WHERE ( sy-tabix <= iv_count )
                         ( index  = sy-tabix
                           carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                           connid = ls_sflight-connid
                           fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_first_n_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_first_n_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '001'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20250101'.
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'BB'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '002'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20250102'.
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'CC'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '003'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20250103'.
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'DD'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '004'. <fs_sflight>-fldate = '20250104'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tabix_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_first_n_flights_with_index( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_count = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-index exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-index exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'BB' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt eine `FOR`-Expression in Verbindung mit `sy-tabix` und `VALUE #`, um eine neue interne Tabelle zu konstruieren. `sy-tabix` wird hier verwendet, um die Zeilennummer der aktuell verarbeiteten Zeile zu ermitteln und in die neue Struktur zu übernehmen, während gleichzeitig eine Filterung auf die ersten `N` Zeilen erfolgt. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und lesbare Art, Tabellen zu transformieren und zu filtern.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie zur Laufzeit alle Komponenten (Felder) einer gegebenen Struktur und deren Typen.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
             length TYPE i,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_component_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_components IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.

    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data_ref( ir_data ).

    rt_components = VALUE #( FOR ls_component IN lr_struct_descr->get_components( )
                             ( name   = ls_component-name
                               type   = ls_component-type_descr->get_name( )
                               length = ls_component-type_descr->length ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und protokollieren Sie jede Zeile zusammen mit ihrem Index.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO ... INDEX INTO ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tabix_loop_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_entry,
             index TYPE i,
             content TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_entry.
    TYPES: tt_log_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_with_index
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log) TYPE tt_log_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tabix_loop_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_with_index.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) INDEX INTO DATA(lv_index).
      APPEND VALUE #( index = lv_index
                      content = |Flight { ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } at index { lv_index }| ) TO rt_log.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights_with_index FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights_with_index.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '400'.
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_sflight>-connid = '100'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tabix_loop_index( ).
    DATA(lt_log) = lo_cut->process_flights_with_index( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_log ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 1 ]-index exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 1 ]-content exp = 'Flight LH 400 at index 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 2 ]-index exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_log[ 2 ]-content exp = 'Flight UA 100 at index 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die moderne Art, über eine interne Tabelle zu iterieren und gleichzeitig den Index der aktuellen Zeile zu erhalten, ohne explizit `sy-tabix` innerhalb der Schleife zu verwenden. Die `INDEX INTO DATA(lv_index)`-Syntax ist klarer und vermeidet potenzielle Fehler durch die direkte Verwendung von `sy-tabix` in verschachtelten Schleifen oder Funktionsaufrufen.
keywords: LOOP AT ... INDEX INTO, sy-tabix, Internal Tables, String Templates

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole und `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value
      IMPORTING
        is_data    TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_structure> TYPE any,
                   <fs_field>     TYPE any.

    ASSIGN is_data->* TO <fs_structure>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_structure> TO <fs_field>.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_value = <fs_field>.
    ELSE.
      " Handle error: Field not found
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine dynamisch erstellte interne Tabelle. Lesen Sie die ersten 2 Zeilen und geben Sie den Wert eines bestimmten Feldes (z.B. 'CARRID') zusammen mit dem Zeilenindex aus.
hint: Kombinieren Sie RTTI für die Tabellenerstellung, Feld-Symbole für den dynamischen Zugriff und `LOOP AT ... INDEX INTO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_process DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_processed_data,
             index TYPE i,
             field_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_processed_data.
    TYPES: tt_processed_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        ir_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data
        iv_field_name    TYPE string
        iv_max_lines     TYPE i DEFAULT 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_processed_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_process IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_table>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line> INDEX INTO DATA(lv_index) UP TO iv_max_lines.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_field>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND VALUE #( index = lv_index field_value = <fs_field> ) TO rt_result.
      ELSE.
        APPEND VALUE #( index = lv_index field_value = 'FIELD_NOT_FOUND' ) TO rt_result.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_dynamic_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lr_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    lr_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( 'SFLIGHTS' ).
    lr_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create(
                        p_line_type  = lr_struct_descr
                        p_table_kind = cl_abap_tabledescr=>tablekind_std
                        p_unique     = abap_false ).
    DATA lr_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data.
    CREATE DATA lr_dynamic_table TYPE HANDLE lr_table_descr.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflights> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_table->* TO <fs_sflights>.

    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO <fs_sflights> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight_line>).
    <fs_sflight_line>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_sflight_line>-connid = '001'.
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO <fs_sflights> ASSIGNING <fs_sflight_line>.
    <fs_sflight_line>-carrid = 'BB'. <fs_sflight_line>-connid = '002'.
    INSERT INITIAL LINE INTO <fs_sflights> ASSIGNING <fs_sflight_line>.
    <fs_sflight_line>-carrid = 'CC'. <fs_sflight_line>-connid = '003'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_dynamic_process( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_dynamic_table(

CLASS zcl_tabix_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sum_first_n_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_count    TYPE i DEFAULT 5

CLASS zcl_tabix_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_first_n_prices.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0
                              FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                              WHERE ( sy-tabix <= iv_count )
                              NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und eine Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen (SEATSMAX - SEATSOCC) haben.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_free_seats TYPE i

        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
                                    AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) >= iv_min_free_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und den Status der freien Sitze ('Available', 'Limited', 'Full') enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR` Operator in Kombination mit `VALUE` und `COND` oder `SWITCH` für die Transformation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_flights) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_transformed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                      LET lv_free_seats = ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc IN
                                      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                        connid = ls_flight-connid
                                        status = COND string( WHEN lv_free_seats >= 20 THEN 'Available'
                                                             WHEN lv_free_seats > 0 THEN 'Limited'
                                                             ELSE 'Full' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_transform_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_transform_empty_table FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA lt_input_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 10 seatsmax = 30 ) TO lt_input_flights. " 20 free -> Available
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 55 ) TO lt_input_flights. " 5 free -> Limited
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0002' seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_input_flights. " 0 free -> Full
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 25 seatsmax = 40 ) TO lt_input_flights. " 15 free -> Limited

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_input_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Available' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-status exp = 'Limited' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-status exp = 'Full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 4 ]-status exp = 'Limited' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_transform_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_transformer( ).
    DATA lt_input_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_flights( lt_input_flights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `LET` Expression verbessert die Lesbarkeit durch die Definition lokaler Variablen. `COND` wird für die bedingte Zuweisung des Status verwendet, was eine kompakte Alternative zu `IF`-Blöcken darstellt.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, COND, LET, Internal Tables, LOOP (implicit)

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus einer Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_occupied_seats.
    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                               FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                               WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                               NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Summe der belegten Sitze.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit der `GROUP` Referenz.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             total_occupied_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flight.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid_connid
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid_connid.
    DATA lt_temp_grouped TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid.
      DATA(lv_sum_seats) = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT s = s + <fs_member>-seatsocc ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      connid = ls_flight-connid
                      total_occupied_seats = lv_sum_seats ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften enthält, die mehr als eine bestimmte Anzahl von Flügen haben, und geben Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft an.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `LOOP AT GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` und `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_airline_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_airline_summary.
    TYPES tt_airline_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_airlines_with_min_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
        iv_min_flights TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_airline_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airlines_with_min_flights.
    DATA lt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_airline_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_flight_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT c = c + 1 ).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      flight_count = lv_flight_count ) TO lt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_summary = FILTER #( lt_grouped_flights USING KEY primary_key
                           WHERE flight_count >= iv_min_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bereiten Sie eine hierarchische Datenstruktur vor, die für die Anzeige in einem `cl_gui_column_tree` geeignet ist. Die Daten sollen Fluggesellschaften und deren Flüge darstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie interne Tabellen und die Methoden `add_node` und `add_item` des `cl_gui_column_tree` (oder simulieren Sie deren Eingabestruktur).

CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_node_data,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             text     TYPE string,
             parent_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             is_folder TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_node_data.
    TYPES tt_node_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_node_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_data,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             fieldname TYPE lvc_fname,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item_data.
    TYPES tt_item_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_tree_data
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_tree_data) TYPE REF TO zcl_tree_data_prep.

    METHODS get_nodes RETURNING VALUE(rt_nodes) TYPE tt_node_data.
    METHODS get_items RETURNING VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_item_data.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_nodes TYPE tt_node_data.
    DATA mt_items TYPE tt_item_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_tree_data.
    ro_tree_data = me.

    DATA(lv_node_key_counter) = 0.
    DATA(lv_parent_key) = ''.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid ASCENDING.
      lv_node_key_counter = lv_node_key_counter + 1.
      lv_parent_key = |CARR_{ lv_node_key_counter ALPHA = OUT }|.
      APPEND VALUE #( node_key = lv_parent_key
                      text = |Airline: { ls_sflight-carrid }|
                      is_folder = abap_true ) TO mt_nodes.

      LOOP AT GROUP ls_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight_in_group).
        lv_node_key_counter = lv_node_key_counter + 1.
        DATA(lv_child_key) = |FLT_{ lv_node_key_counter ALPHA = OUT }|.
        APPEND VALUE #( node_key = lv_child_key
                        text = |Flight { ls_flight_in_group-connid } on { ls_flight_in_group-fldate }|
                        parent_key = lv_parent_key
                        is_folder = abap_false ) TO mt_nodes.

        APPEND VALUE #( node_key = lv_child_key fieldname = 'CONNID' value = ls_flight_in_group-connid ) TO mt_items.
        APPEND VALUE #( node_key = lv_child_key fieldname = 'FLDATE' value = |{ ls_flight_in_group-fldate DATE = USER }| ) TO mt_items.
        APPEND VALUE #( node_key = lv_child_key fieldname = 'SEATSOCC' value = |{ ls_flight_in_group-seatsocc }| ) TO mt_items.
        APPEND VALUE #( node_key = lv_child_key fieldname = 'SEATSMAX' value = |{ ls_flight_in_group-seatsmax }| ) TO mt_items.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_nodes.
    rt_nodes = mt_nodes.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_items.
    rt_items = mt_items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_prepare_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_data_prep( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 10 seatsmax = 30 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 50 seatsmax = 55 ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum seatsocc = 100 seatsmax = 105 ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_tree_data) = lo_cut->prepare_flight_tree_data( it_sflights ).

    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_tree_data->get_nodes( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = lo_tree_data->get_items( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_nodes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_items ).

    DATA(lv_parent_nodes) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node) WHERE is_folder = abap_true.
      lv_parent_nodes = lv_parent_nodes + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_parent_nodes exp = 2 ). " LH and AA

    DATA(lv_child_nodes_with_items) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO ls_node WHERE is_folder = abap_false.
      IF line_exists( lt_items[ node_key = ls_node-node_key ] ).
        lv_child_nodes_with_items = lv_child_nodes_with_items + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_child_nodes_with_items exp = 3 ). " All 3 flights
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_prepare_empty_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tree_data_prep( ).
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lo_tree_data) = lo_cut->prepare_flight_tree_data( lt_sflights ).

    DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_tree_data->get_nodes( ).
    DATA(lt_items) = lo_tree_data->get_items( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_nodes ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_items ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaften und `String Templates` für die dynamische Erstellung von Texten und Node-Keys. Die Logik zur Datenstrukturierung ist hier der Fokus, da die UI-Komponente selbst nicht direkt im Unit-Test geprüft werden kann.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_data,
             node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
             fieldname TYPE lvc_fname,

             fieldname TYPE lvc_fname,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_processed_item.
    TYPES tt_processed_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_processed_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_selected_node
      IMPORTING

        VALUE(rt_node_details) TYPE tt_processed_items.

CLASS zcl_tree_node_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_selected_node.
    rt_node_details = VALUE #( FOR ls_item IN it_all_items
                                WHERE ( node_key = iv_selected_node_key )
                                ( fieldname = ls_item-fieldname
                                  value = ls_item-value ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_counter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_flight_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS count_flights_per_airline
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE ty_flight_count_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_counter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_per_airline.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_count) = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR <fs_member> IN GROUP ls_flight NEXT c = c + 1 ).
      rt_flight_counts[ ls_flight-carrid ] = lv_count.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie einen Prozess, der Flugdaten aus `sflights` iterativ auf 'Alterung' prüft, bis eine bestimmte Anzahl von 'gealterten' Flügen gefunden wurde oder eine maximale Iteration erreicht ist. Verwenden Sie eine `WHILE`-Schleife.
hint: Nutzen Sie `WHILE` für die Iteration und `cl_abap_session_temperature` (konzeptionell) für die Schwellenwertbestimmung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_aging_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             aged     TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_aged_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_iterations TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_aging_threshold_days TYPE i DEFAULT 365 " Flights older than this are 'aged'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aged_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_aging_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_aged_flights.
    DATA: lv_current_iteration TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_aged_count      TYPE i VALUE 0,
          lv_max_aged_to_find TYPE i VALUE 3. " Find up to 3 aged flights for demo

    DATA(lv_today) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights)
      UP TO 100 ROWS.

    WHILE lv_current_iteration < iv_max_iterations AND lv_aged_count < lv_max_aged_to_find.
      lv_current_iteration = lv_current_iteration + 1.

      LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        DATA(lv_days_old) = lv_today - ls_flight-fldate.
        IF lv_days_old > iv_aging_threshold_days.
          ls_flight-aged = abap_true.
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_aged_flights.
          lv_aged_count = lv_aged_count + 1.
          IF lv_aged_count >= lv_max_aged_to_find.
            EXIT. " Found enough aged flights
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      " In a real scenario, cl_abap_session_temperature might influence
      " how aggressively we search or what data is considered 'aged'
      " based on session-specific data aging policies.
      " For this example, we simulate a simple check.
      IF lv_aged_count < lv_max_aged_to_find.
        " Simulate fetching more data or waiting
        " (e.g., if data comes from a slow source or needs time to age)
        " For this demo, we just exit if not enough found in one pass.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle `sflights` alle Flüge heraus, die älter als ein bestimmtes Datum sind und somit als 'gealtert' gelten könnten. Nutzen Sie dabei Tabellenausdrücke mit `FILTER`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER` in einem Tabellenausdruck, um die gewünschten Zeilen effizient zu selektieren. Dies könnte Teil einer `DB-Zugriffssteuerung für Data Aging` sein.

CLASS zcl_filter_aged_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aged_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_aging_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aged_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_aged_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aged_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_aged_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE fldate < iv_aging_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft und ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der 'gealterten' Flüge (älter als ein bestimmtes Datum). Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit `GROUP BY`.
hint: Die `FOR`-Schleife mit `GROUP BY` ist ideal für Aggregationen und Gruppierungen direkt in ABAP.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_aged_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aged_carrier_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             aged_count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_aged_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_aged_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aged_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aged_flight_counts
      IMPORTING
        iv_aging_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_result) TYPE tt_aged_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_aged_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aged_flight_counts.
    SELECT carrid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    rt_result = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      (
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        aged_count = REDUCE i(
          INIT count = 0
          FOR ls_grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
          WHERE ( fldate < iv_aging_date )
          NEXT count = count + 1
        )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Utility-Klasse, die eine 'Datenalterungs-Policy' konfiguriert und anwendet. Nutzen Sie den `NEW`-Operator für die Instanziierung und Methodenverkettung für eine flüssige API.
hint: Der `NEW`-Operator und Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, ermöglichen Methodenverkettung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_aging_policy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_policy_config,
             aging_threshold_days TYPE i,
             retention_period_years TYPE i,
             is_active            TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_policy_config.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_default_threshold TYPE i DEFAULT 365.

    METHODS set_retention_period
      IMPORTING
        iv_years TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_aging_policy.

    METHODS activate
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_aging_policy.

    METHODS get_config
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_config) TYPE ty_policy_config.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_config TYPE ty_policy_config.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_aging_policy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_config-aging_threshold_days = iv_default_threshold.
    ms_config-is_active = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_retention_period.
    ms_config-retention_period_years = iv_years.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD activate.
    ms_config-is_active = abap_true.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_config.
    rs_config = ms_config.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
