CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_filter) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).

    " Test data (assuming SFLIGHTS has entries)
    " For a robust unit test, you might want to mock SFLIGHTS or use a local test table.
    " Here, we rely on existing SFLIGHTS data.

    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'. "Lufthansa
    DATA(lv_min_free_seats) = 50.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_filter->get_available_flights(
                           iv_carrier        = lv_carrier
                           iv_min_free_seats = lv_min_free_seats ).

    " Assert that all returned flights match the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_filtered INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_flight-carrid
        exp = lv_carrier
        msg = 'Carrier ID should match filter criteria' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax - ls_flight-seatsocc ) >= lv_min_free_seats
        msg = 'Free seats should meet minimum criteria' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Assert a known case (e.g., if 'AA' has no flights with 100 free seats)
    DATA(lt_no_flights) = lo_filter->get_available_flights(
                             iv_carrier        = 'AA'
                             iv_min_free_seats = 1000 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_no_flights )
      msg = 'Should return no flights for impossible criteria' ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist eine moderne und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern. Er ersetzt explizite `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Konstrukte und führt zu kompakterem und besser lesbarem Code. Die `USING KEY primary_key` Klausel ist optional, kann aber die Performance bei großen Tabellen verbessern, wenn ein passender Schlüssel definiert ist.
keywords: Internal Tables, FILTER, WHERE, SFLIGHTS, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von Constructor Injection und Method Chaining in einer ABAP-Klasse. Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Konfiguration über den Konstruktor erhält und mehrere Operationen über Method Chaining ausführt.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `NEW`-Operator für die Instanziierung und geben Sie den Rückgabewert von Methoden als `ME` zurück, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_config_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_config,
             setting1 TYPE string,
             setting2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_config.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        is_config TYPE ty_config.

    METHODS set_value1
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_processor.

    METHODS set_value2
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_config_processor.

    METHODS process
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA ms_config TYPE ty_config.
    DATA mv_internal_value1 TYPE string.
    DATA mv_internal_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_config_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    ms_config = is_config.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_internal_value1 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_internal_value2 = iv_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process.
    rv_result = |Config: { ms_config-setting1 }, { ms_config-setting2 } |
                && |Values: { mv_internal_value1 }, { mv_internal_value2 }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(ls_initial_config) = VALUE zcl_config_processor=>ty_config(
      setting1 = 'Initial Setting'
      setting2 = 100 ).

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_config_processor( ls_initial_config ).

    " Demonstrate method chaining
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_processor->set_value1( 'New Value A' )
                                 ->set_value2( 200 )
                                 ->process( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_result) = |Config: Initial Setting, 100 Values: New Value A, 200|.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = lv_expected_result
      msg = 'Method chaining should correctly set values and process' ).

    " Test without chaining (direct calls)
    DATA(lo_processor_2) = NEW zcl_config_processor( ls_initial_config ).
    lo_processor_2->set_value1( 'Another Value' ).
    lo_processor_2->set_value2( 300 ).
    DATA(lv_result_2) = lo_processor_2->process( ).

    DATA(lv_expected_result_2) = |Config: Initial Setting, 100 Values: Another Value, 300|.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_2
      exp = lv_expected_result_2
      msg = 'Direct method calls should also work' ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Constructor Injection (`IMPORTING is_config` im Konstruktor) ist ein Designmuster, um Abhängigkeiten in eine Klasse zu übergeben, was die Testbarkeit und Flexibilität verbessert. Method Chaining wird durch das Zurückgeben der eigenen Instanz (`me`) in den Methoden ermöglicht. Dies erlaubt es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe in einer einzigen Zeile zu verketten, was den Code flüssiger und lesbarer macht.
keywords: Object Orientation, Constructor Injection, Method Chaining, NEW Operator

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_occupied_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrier
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_reduce_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum_seats.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'LH'. "Lufthansa

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_aggregator->get_total_occupied_seats( lv_carrier ).

    " Manually calculate expected sum for 'LH' (or mock SFLIGHTS data)
    DATA: lt_sflights_test TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT seatsocc FROM sflight WHERE carrid = lv_carrier INTO TABLE lt_sflights_test.
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_test INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lv_expected_sum = lv_expected_sum + ls_flight-seatsocc.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_seats
      exp = lv_expected_sum
      msg = 'Total occupied seats should match sum calculated by REDUCE' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_reduce_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_aggregator) = NEW zcl_flight_aggregator( ).
    DATA(lv_carrier) = 'XX'. "Non-existent carrier

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_aggregator->get_total_occupied_seats( lv_carrier ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_seats
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Total occupied seats should be 0 for non-existent carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er eine Initialisierung (`INIT`) und eine Iterationslogik (`FOR ... NEXT`) definiert. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code für Summierungen, Zählungen oder andere Aggregationen.
keywords: Internal Tables, REDUCE, Aggregation, SFLIGHTS, Functional Programming

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaften und Flugnummern aus SFLIGHTS enthält, deren Flugdatum in der Zukunft liegt. Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `VALUE #`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE #` in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Expression und einer `WHERE`-Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_future_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key,
           ty_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flight_keys
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_future_flights) TYPE ty_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_future_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flight_keys.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_future_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
                                   ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                     connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle führenden und nachfolgenden Leerzeichen sowie doppelte Leerzeichen innerhalb eines Strings. Nutzen Sie moderne String-Funktionen und den `REPLACE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CONDENSE`, `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF` mit `REGEX` oder `FIND/REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_cleaner DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS clean_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_dirty_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_clean_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_cleaner IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD clean_string.
    DATA(lv_temp_string) = iv_dirty_string.

    " Remove leading/trailing spaces and condense multiple spaces to single space
    CONDENSE lv_temp_string.

    " Alternatively, using REPLACE with REGEX for more control (ABAP 7.50+)
    " rv_clean_string = REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN lv_temp_string WITH ' '.
    " rv_clean_string = |{ rv_clean_string ALPHA = OUT }|.

    rv_clean_string = lv_temp_string.

    " If CONDENSE is not sufficient (e.g., for non-breaking spaces or specific regex needs)
    " rv_clean_string = replace( val = iv_dirty_string regex = '\s+' with = ' ' occ = 0 ).
    " rv_clean_string = condense( rv_clean_string ). " Still need condense for leading/trailing

    " A more robust approach for all whitespace and leading/trailing:
    rv_clean_string = replace( val = iv_dirty_string regex = '^\s+|\s+$' with = '' occ = 0 ). " Trim
    rv_clean_string = replace( val = rv_clean_string regex = '\s{2,}' with = ' ' occ = 0 ). " Condense multiple spaces

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_clean_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_clean_string.
    DATA(lo_cleaner) = NEW zcl_string_cleaner( ).

    DATA(lv_dirty_1) = `  Hello   World   `.
    DATA(lv_clean_1) = lo_cleaner->clean_string( lv_dirty_1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_clean_1
      exp = `Hello World`
      msg = 'Should remove leading/trailing and condense multiple spaces' ).

    DATA(lv_dirty_2) = `SingleWord`.
    DATA(lv_clean_2) = lo_cleaner->clean_string( lv_dirty_2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_clean_2
      exp = `SingleWord`
      msg = 'Should not alter already clean string' ).

    DATA(lv_dirty_3) = `   `.
    DATA(lv_clean_3) = lo_cleaner->clean_string( lv_dirty_3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_clean_3
      exp = ``
      msg = 'Should return empty string for all spaces' ).

    DATA(lv_dirty_4) = `  A  B   C  `.
    DATA(lv_clean_4) = lo_cleaner->clean_string( lv_dirty_4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_clean_4
      exp = `A B C`
      msg = 'Should handle multiple words with varying spaces' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Funktion `CONDENSE` ist ein klassisches ABAP-Statement, das in modernen Kontexten oft durch String-Funktionen ersetzt oder ergänzt wird. Die Verwendung von `REPLACE` mit regulären Ausdrücken (`REGEX`) ist ab ABAP 7.50 eine sehr flexible und leistungsstarke Methode, um komplexe String-Manipulationen durchzuführen, wie das Entfernen von führenden/nachfolgenden Leerzeichen (`^\s+|\s+$`) und das Kondensieren mehrerer Leerzeichen (`\s{2,}`).
keywords: String Processing, CONDENSE, REPLACE, REGEX, String Functions

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Factory-Methode, die Instanzen verschiedener Klassen basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter erzeugt. Nutzen Sie dabei den `NEW`-Operator und `CASE`-Ausdrücke.
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für die zu erzeugenden Objekte und lassen Sie die Factory-Methode dieses Interface zurückgeben.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product DEFINITION PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_description RETURNING VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS get_description.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_description.
    rv_description = 'Dies ist Produkt A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_description.
    rv_description = zif_product~get_description( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
    METHODS get_description.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_description.
    rv_description = 'Dies ist Produkt B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD get_description.
    rv_description = zif_product~get_description( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product
      RAISING
        cx_sy_create_object_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    ro_product = CASE iv_product_type.
                   WHEN 'A' THEN NEW zcl_product_a( ).
                   WHEN 'B' THEN NEW zcl_product_b( ).
                   WHEN OTHERS THEN
                     RAISE EXCEPTION NEW cx_sy_create_object_error(
                       text = |Unbekannter Produkttyp: { iv_product_type }| ).
                 END CASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_factory_invalid_type FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.

    DATA(lo_product_a) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_product_a->get_description( )
      exp = 'Dies ist Produkt A'

    DATA(lo_product_b) = zcl_product_factory=>create_product( 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

Das Zurückgeben eines Interfaces (`zif_product`) fördert die Polymorphie und Flexibilität.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Sitze. Nutzen Sie den `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_seatsocc TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           ty_flight_summaries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_occupied_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE ty_flight_summaries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_occupied_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

    SELECT carrid, seatsocc
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_sum_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_group_member>-seatsocc ).

      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP ls_flight ).

      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      avg_seatsocc = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum_seats / lv_count ELSE 0 ) )
        TO rt_summaries.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by_avg_seats FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_by_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_avg_seats.
    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).

    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_grouper->get_avg_occupied_seats_by_carrier( ).

    " Assert that the result table is not empty (assuming SFLIGHTS has data)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lines( lt_summaries )
      msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    " Verify a specific carrier's average (requires knowledge of SFLIGHTS data)
    " Example: If 'LH' has flights with 100, 150, 200 seatsocc, avg should be 150.
    READ TABLE lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_summary_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " This assertion depends on actual SFLIGHTS data. For a real test, mock SFLIGHTS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Quadratwert einer Zahl und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen. Nutzen Sie moderne mathematische Funktionen und String Templates für die Ausgabe.

CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_square_root
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_square_root.
    DATA(lv_sqrt_raw) = sqrt( iv_number ).
    rv_result = round( val = lv_sqrt_raw dec = 2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_square_root_rounding FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_square_root_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_square_root_negative FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_square_root_rounding.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).

    DATA(lv_input_1) = '16.00'.
    DATA(lv_result_1) = lo_math->calculate_square_root( lv_input_1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_1
      exp = '4.00'
      msg = 'Square root of 16 should be 4.00' ).

    DATA(lv_input_2) = '10.00'.
    DATA(lv_result_2) = lo_math->calculate_square_root( lv_input_2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_2
      exp = '3.16'
      msg = 'Square root of 10 should be 3.16 (rounded)' ).

    DATA(lv_input_3) = '2.00'.
    DATA(lv_result_3) = lo_math->calculate_square_root( lv_input_3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result_3
      exp = '1.41'
      msg = 'Square root of 2 should be 1.41 (rounded)' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_square_root_zero.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_math->calculate_square_root( '0.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = '0.00'
      msg = 'Square root of 0 should be 0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_square_root_negative.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    " SQRT of negative number results in a runtime error (CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act_class = 'CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW'
      act       = cl_abap_unit_assert=>get_exception_instance(
                    lo_math->calculate_square_root( '-4.00' ) )
      msg       = 'Square root of negative number should raise an exception' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `DECFLOAT` für mathematische Berechnungen gewährleistet eine hohe Präzision und vermeidet Rundungsfehler, die bei `P` oder `F` Typen auftreten können. Die eingebaute Funktion `SQRT` berechnet die Quadratwurzel, und `ROUND` ermöglicht das präzise Runden auf eine bestimmte Anzahl von Dezimalstellen. Dies sind moderne und robuste Ansätze für numerische Operationen.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Zeiten und füllen Sie diese mit konvertierten Zeiten aus einer Liste von internen ABAP-Zeiten unter Verwendung von `APPEND` mit `VALUE #`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #` in Kombination mit `APPEND` und `cl_abap_timefm`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_table_append DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_time_entry,
             raw_time TYPE t,
             iso_time TYPE string,
           END OF ty_time_entry.
    TYPES: tt_time_entries TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_time_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_times
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_times TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_processed_times) TYPE tt_time_entries.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_table_append IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_times.
    LOOP AT it_raw_times INTO DATA(lv_raw_time).
      DATA(lv_iso_time) = COND string(
        WHEN lv_raw_time IS NOT INITIAL THEN
          cl_abap_timefm=>conv_time_int_to_ext(
            time_int            = lv_raw_time
            format_according_to = cl_abap_timefm=>iso
            without_seconds     = abap_false
          )
        ELSE
          '00:00:00'
      ).

      APPEND VALUE #( raw_time = lv_raw_time iso_time = lv_iso_time ) TO rt_processed_times.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Addieren Sie eine bestimmte Anzahl von Minuten zu einer gegebenen Zeit und formatieren Sie das Ergebnis im ISO-Format. Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_tstmp` für die Zeitberechnung.
hint: Konvertieren Sie die Zeit in einen Timestamp, addieren Sie Minuten und konvertieren Sie zurück zur Zeit, dann formatieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_add_minutes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_minutes_and_format
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_time TYPE t
        iv_minutes    TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_time_iso) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_add_minutes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_minutes_and_format.
    DATA: lv_timestamp TYPE timestampl,
          lv_end_time  TYPE t.

    TRY.
        " Convert time to timestamp
        cl_abap_tstmp=>move_t_to_tstmpl(
          EXPORTING
            idate    = sy-datum
            itime    = iv_start_time
          IMPORTING
            tstmpl   = lv_timestamp
        ).

        " Add minutes (60 seconds per minute)
        lv_timestamp = lv_timestamp + ( iv_minutes * 60 ).

        " Convert timestamp back to time
        cl_abap_tstmp=>move_tstmpl_to_t(
          EXPORTING
            tstmpl   = lv_timestamp
          IMPORTING
            idate    = DATA(lv_dummy_date) " Date is not relevant for time calculation
            itime    = lv_end_time
        ).

        " Format the resulting time
        cl_abap_timefm=>conv_time_int_to_ext(
          EXPORTING
            time_int            = lv_end_time
            format_according_to = cl_abap_timefm=>iso
            without_seconds     = abap_false
          IMPORTING
            time_ext            = rv_result_time_iso
        ).

      CATCH cx_abap_tstmp_invalid cx_parameter_invalid_range.
        rv_result_time_iso = 'Error in calculation'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_add_minutes FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_minutes.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_time_add_minutes( ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_calculator->add_minutes_and_format( iv_start_time = '100000' iv_minutes = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '10:30:00' msg = 'Adding 30 minutes failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_calculator->add_minutes_and_format( iv_start_time = '234500' iv_minutes = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '00:05:00' msg = 'Adding minutes over midnight failed' ).

    lv_result = lo_calculator->add_minutes_and_format( iv_start_time = '000000' iv_minutes = 1440 ). " 24 hours
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '00:00:00' msg = 'Adding 24 hours failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Verwendung von `DATA(lv_dummy_date)` zeigt die Inline-Deklaration für nicht benötigte Exportparameter.

CLASS zcl_time_list_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Rohzeiten in eine neue Tabelle, die sowohl die Rohzeit als auch die im Benutzerformat (ohne Sekunden) formatierte Zeit enthält, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE #` und `cl_abap_timefm`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_table_for_exp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_time_pair,
             raw_time TYPE t,
             user_time TYPE string,
           END OF ty_time_pair.
    TYPES: tt_time_pairs TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_time_pair WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_times
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_times TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF t WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_times) TYPE tt_time_pairs.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_table_for_exp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_times.
    rt_transformed_times = VALUE #( FOR lv_raw_time IN it_raw_times
                                    LET lv_user_time = COND string(
                                      WHEN lv_raw_time IS NOT INITIAL THEN
                                        cl_abap_timefm=>conv_time_int_to_ext(
                                          time_int            = lv_raw_time
                                          format_according_to = cl_abap_timefm=>user
                                          without_seconds     = abap_true
                                        )
                                      ELSE
                                        '00:00'
                                    ) IN
                                    ( raw_time = lv_raw_time, user_time = lv_user_time ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_raw_times) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF t WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( '070000' )
      ( '114530' )

    ).

    DATA(lt_transformed) = lo_transformer->transform_times( lt_raw_times ).

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Zeiten, die als Strings im ISO-Format gegeben sind, um festzustellen, welche früher liegt. Konvertieren Sie sie dazu in interne ABAP-Zeiten.
hint: Konvertieren Sie beide Zeiten mit `cl_abap_timefm=>conv_time_ext_to_int` und vergleichen Sie dann die internen Zeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_comparator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_time_earlier
      IMPORTING
        iv_time1_iso TYPE string
        iv_time2_iso TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_earlier) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_comparator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_time_earlier.
    DATA: lv_time1_t TYPE t,
          lv_time2_t TYPE t.

    TRY.
        lv_time1_t = cl_abap_timefm=>conv_time_ext_to_int( time_ext = iv_time1_iso ).
        lv_time2_t = cl_abap_timefm=>conv_time_ext_to_int( time_ext = iv_time2_iso ).

        IF lv_time1_t < lv_time2_t.
          rv_is_earlier = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rv_is_earlier = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_abap_timefm_invalid.
        " Handle invalid time strings, e.g., by returning false or raising an exception
        rv_is_earlier = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine dynamische Zeitformatierung, bei der das Ausgabeformat (ISO, Benutzer, Umgebung) zur Laufzeit über einen Parameter gesteuert wird.
hint: Nutzen Sie einen `CASE`-Ausdruck oder eine `COND`-Expression, um das `format_according_to`-Parameter von `cl_abap_timefm` dynamisch zu setzen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_time_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_format_option,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE i,
           END OF ty_format_option.
    TYPES: tt_format_options TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_format_option WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_format,
                 iso  TYPE string VALUE 'ISO',
                 user TYPE string VALUE 'USER',
                 env  TYPE string VALUE 'ENVIRONMENT',
               END OF gc_format.

    METHODS format_time_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_time_t    TYPE t
        iv_format_key TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_time) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_time_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_time_dynamically.
    DATA(lv_format_constant) = COND i(
      WHEN iv_format_key = gc_format-iso  THEN cl_abap_timefm=>iso
      WHEN iv_format_key = gc_format-user THEN cl_abap_timefm=>user
      WHEN iv_format_key = gc_format-env  THEN cl_abap_timefm=>environment
      ELSE cl_abap_timefm=>iso " Default to ISO
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_abap_timefm=>conv_time_int_to_ext(
          EXPORTING
            time_int            = iv_time_t
            format_according_to = lv_format_constant
            without_seconds     = abap_false
          IMPORTING
            time_ext            = rv_formatted_time
        ).
      CATCH cx_parameter_invalid_range.
        rv_formatted_time = 'Dynamic Format Error'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_format FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_format.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_dynamic_time_format( ).
    DATA(lv_time) = '173000'.

    DATA(lv_iso_formatted) = lo_formatter->format_time_dynamically( iv_time_t = lv_time iv_format_key = zcl_dynamic_time_format=>gc_format-iso ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_iso_formatted exp = '17:30:00' msg = 'Dynamic ISO format failed' ).

    DATA(lv_user_formatted) = lo_formatter->format_time_dynamically( iv_time_t = lv_time iv_format_key = zcl_dynamic_time_format=>gc_format-user ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_user_formatted msg = 'Dynamic USER format should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_user_formatted ) exp = 8 msg = 'Dynamic USER format length incorrect (HH:MM:SS)' ).

    DATA(lv_env_formatted) = lo_formatter->format_time_dynamically( iv_time_t = lv_time iv_format_key = zcl_dynamic_time_format=>gc_format-env ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_env_formatted msg = 'Dynamic ENVIRONMENT format should not be initial' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_env_formatted ) exp = 8 msg = 'Dynamic ENVIRONMENT format length incorrect (HH:MM:SS)' ).

    DATA(lv_default_formatted) = lo_formatter->format_time_dynamically( iv_time_t = lv_time iv_format_key = 'UNKNOWN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_default_formatted exp = '17:30:00' msg = 'Dynamic default format (ISO) failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine elegante und moderne Art, bedingte Logik kompakt auszudrücken und die Flexibilität der Anwendung zu erhöhen, ohne viele `IF`-Anweisungen zu verwenden. Instructions: Füllen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT, wobei Sie die Abflug- und Ankunftszeiten in das ISO-Format konvertieren und als neue Felder hinzufügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` mit `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` und anschließend `LOOP` mit `cl_abap_timefm` und `MODIFY` oder `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_time_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_ext,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             deptime  TYPE sflight-deptime,
             arrtime  TYPE sflight-arrtime,
             deptime_iso TYPE string,
             arrtime_iso TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_ext.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_iso_times
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_ext.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_time_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_iso_times.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, deptime, arrtime
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE lt_sflight
      UP TO 10 ROWS.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight
                          LET lv_deptime_iso = COND string(
                                WHEN ls_sflight-deptime IS NOT INITIAL THEN
                                  cl_abap_timefm=>conv_time_int_to_ext(
                                    time_int            = ls_sflight-deptime
                                    format_according_to = cl_abap_timefm=>iso
                                    without_seconds     = abap_false
                                  )
                                ELSE
                                  '00:00:00'
                              ),
                              lv_arrtime_iso = COND string(
                                WHEN ls_sflight-arrtime IS NOT INITIAL THEN
                                  cl_abap_timefm=>conv_time_int_to_ext(
                                    time_int            = ls_sflight-arrtime
                                    format_according_to = cl_abap_timefm=>iso
                                    without_seconds     = abap_false
                                  )
                                ELSE
                                  '00:00:00'
                              ) IN
                          ( carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid,
                            connid      = ls_sflight-connid,
                            fldate      = ls_sflight-fldate,
                            deptime     = ls_sflight-deptime,
                            arrtime     = ls_sflight-arrtime,
                            deptime_iso = lv_deptime_iso,
                            arrtime_iso = lv_arrtime_iso ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_flight_data) = NEW zcl_sflight_time_conv( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_flight_data->get_flights_with_iso_times( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_flights ) msg = 'No flight data retrieved' ).
    IF lines( lt_flights ) > 0.
      DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_flights[ 1 ].
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-deptime_iso msg = 'Departure time ISO should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_first_flight-arrtime_iso msg = 'Arrival time ISO should not be initial' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( ls_first_flight-deptime_iso ) exp = 8 msg = 'Departure time ISO length incorrect' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert das Lesen von Datenbanktabellen (`SFLIGHT`) mit der Transformation der Daten in eine neue interne Tabelle unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks. Die Abflug- und Ankunftszeiten werden direkt im `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `cl_abap_timefm` in das ISO-Format konvertiert. `LET` wird verwendet, um die konvertierten Zeiten zwischenzuspeichern, bevor sie der Zielstruktur zugewiesen werden. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und deklarative Methode zur Datenverarbeitung.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie die Differenz in Minuten zwischen zwei internen ABAP-Zeiten. Das Ergebnis soll eine positive Zahl sein.
hint: Konvertieren Sie die Zeiten in Timestamps und berechnen Sie die Differenz in Sekunden, dann teilen Sie durch 60.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_minute_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_time1 TYPE t
        iv_time2 TYPE t
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_minutes) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_minute_difference.
    DATA: lv_tstmp1 TYPE timestampl,
          lv_tstmp2 TYPE timestampl,
          lv_seconds TYPE i.

    TRY.
        cl_abap_tstmp=>move_t_to_tstmpl( idate = sy-datum itime = iv_time1 IMPORTING tstmpl = lv_tstmp1 ).
        cl_abap_tstmp=>move_t_to_tstmpl( idate = sy-datum itime = iv_time2 IMPORTING tstmpl = lv_tstmp2 ).

        lv_seconds = ABS( lv_tstmp1 - lv_tstmp2 ).
        rv_minutes = lv_seconds / 60.

      CATCH cx_abap_tstmp_invalid.
        rv_minutes = 0. " Return 0 on error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_minute_difference FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_minute_difference.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_time_difference( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->get_minute_difference( iv_time1 = '100000' iv_time2 = '103000' ) exp = 30 msg = 'Difference 10:00 to 10:30 failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->get_minute_difference( iv_time1 = '103000' iv_time2 = '100000' ) exp = 30 msg = 'Difference 10:30 to 10:00 failed (absolute)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->get_minute_difference( iv_time1 = '090000' iv_time2 = '100000' ) exp = 60 msg = 'Difference 09:00 to 10:00 failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->get_minute_difference( iv_time1 = '235000' iv_time2 = '001000' ) exp = 20 msg = 'Difference over midnight failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_calculator->get_minute_difference( iv_time1 = '100000' iv_time2 = '100000' ) exp = 0 msg = 'Difference for same time failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Berechnung der Zeitdifferenz erfolgt am besten über Timestamps (`TIMESTAMPL`), da diese direkt subtrahiert werden können, um die Differenz in Sekunden zu erhalten. Die Funktion `ABS` stellt sicher, dass das Ergebnis immer positiv ist. Die Konvertierung von Sekunden in Minuten ist ein einfacher Divisionsschritt. Die Verwendung von `sy-datum` ist hier notwendig, da `move_t_to_tstmpl` ein Datum benötigt, auch wenn es für die reine Zeitdifferenz irrelevant ist.
keywords: cl_abap_tstmp, Zeitdifferenz, Minuten, ABS, Timestamp, T

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die eine interne ABAP-Zeit in ein 'HH:MM AM/PM'-Format konvertiert. Nutzen Sie String-Templates und `cl_abap_timefm`.
hint: Konvertieren Sie die Zeit in Stunden und Minuten, bestimmen Sie AM/PM und nutzen Sie dann String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_time_ampm_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_to_ampm
      IMPORTING
        iv_time_t TYPE t
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_ampm_time) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_time_ampm_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_to_ampm.
    DATA: lv_hour   TYPE i,
          lv_minute TYPE i,
          lv_ampm   TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " Extract hour and minute (assuming T is HHMMSS)
        lv_hour   = iv_time_t(2).
        lv_minute = iv_time_t+2(2).

        IF lv_hour >= 12.
          lv_ampm = 'PM'.
          IF lv_hour > 12.
            lv_hour = lv_hour - 12.
          ENDIF.
        ELSE.
          lv_ampm = 'AM'.
          IF lv_hour = 0.
            lv_hour = 12. " 00:xx becomes 12:xx AM
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        rv_ampm_time = |{ lv_hour ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 2 PAD = '0' }:{ lv_minute ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 2 PAD = '0' } { lv_ampm }|.

      CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error.
        rv_ampm_time = 'Invalid Time'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_ampm_format.
    DATA(lo_formatter) = NEW zcl_time_ampm_format( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_formatter->format_to_ampm( '103000' ) exp = '10:30 AM' msg = '10:30 AM failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_formatter->format_to_ampm( '141500' ) exp = '02:15 PM' msg = '02:15 PM failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_formatter->format_to_ampm( '000000' ) exp = '12:00 AM' msg = 'Midnight failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_formatter->format_to_ampm( '120000' ) exp = '12:00 PM' msg = 'Noon failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_formatter->format_to_ampm( '235959' ) exp = '11:59 PM' msg = '11:59 PM failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_conv IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data ).
    IF lo_descr->get_kind( ) = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_int OR
       lo_descr->get_kind( ) = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_packed OR
       lo_descr->get_kind( ) = cl_abap_typedescr=>kind_float.
      rv_integer = CONV i( iv_data ).
    ELSE.
      rv_integer = 0. " Default value
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_rtti_tech_info DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ). " Simulate first run
    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ). " Simulate second run

CLASS zcl_timer_dynamic_interval DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_timer_dynamic_interval IMPLEMENTATION.

    mo_timer->interval = iv_initial_interval.
    mo_timer->runs_once = abap_false.
    mo_timer->activate( ).

    mv_run_count = mv_run_count + 1.

    mo_timer->interval = mo_timer->interval * 2.
    " Optional: Stop after a few runs
    IF mv_run_count GE 3.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen Timer, um eine 'Lade'-Animation oder einen Status-Update zu simulieren, der nach einer bestimmten Anzahl von Schritten endet.

CLASS zcl_timer_status_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_status_timer IMPORTING iv_max_steps TYPE i.
    METHODS get_status_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_current_step TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA mv_max_steps TYPE i.
    DATA mv_status_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_status_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_status_timer.
    mv_max_steps = iv_max_steps.
    mv_current_step = 0.
    mv_status_message = |Starting...|.
    mo_timer->interval = 500. " 0.5 seconds
    mo_timer->runs_once = abap_false.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    mv_current_step = mv_current_step + 1.
    IF mv_current_step LE mv_max_steps.
      mv_status_message = |Processing step { mv_current_step } of { mv_max_steps }...|.
    ELSE.
      mv_status_message = |Finished after { mv_max_steps } steps.|.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status_message.
    rv_message = mv_status_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen Timeout-Mechanismus: Starten Sie einen Timer, der nach 10 Sekunden einen Timeout-Status setzt, es sei denn, eine 'Erfolgs'-Methode wird vorher aufgerufen.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Flag-Variable, die sowohl vom Timer-Handler als auch von der Erfolgsmethode geprüft/gesetzt wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_timeout DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_timeout_timer IMPORTING iv_timeout_ms TYPE i.
    METHODS signal_success.
    METHODS get_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_timed_out TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    DATA mv_success TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_timeout IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timeout_timer.
    mv_timed_out = abap_false.
    mv_success = abap_false.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_timeout_ms.
    mo_timer->runs_once = abap_true.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD signal_success.
    IF mv_timed_out = abap_false.
      mv_success = abap_true.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ). " Stop timer if success before timeout
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    IF mv_success = abap_false.
      mv_timed_out = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_status.
    IF mv_success = abap_true.
      rv_status = 'Operation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.'.
    ELSEIF mv_timed_out = abap_true.
      rv_status = 'Timeout erreicht.'.
    ELSE.
      rv_status = 'Warten auf Abschluss...'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_timeout_reached FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_success_before_timeout FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timeout_reached.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_timeout( ).
    lo_cut->start_timeout_timer( 10000 ). " 10 seconds timeout

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status( ) exp = 'Warten auf Abschluss...' ).

    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ). " Simulate timeout event
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status( ) exp = 'Timeout erreicht.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_success_before_timeout.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_timeout( ).
    lo_cut->start_timeout_timer( 10000 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status( ) exp = 'Warten auf Abschluss...' ).

    lo_cut->signal_success( ). " Signal success before timeout
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status( ) exp = 'Operation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.' ).

    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ). " Simulate timeout event (should have no effect)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_status( ) exp = 'Operation erfolgreich abgeschlossen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert einen Timeout-Mechanismus. Der Timer wird gestartet und setzt einen Timeout-Status, es sei denn, eine externe Operation signalisiert vorher ihren Erfolg. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster für asynchrone Operationen. Der Unit-Test deckt beide Szenarien ab: Timeout und Erfolg vor Timeout.

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen Timer, um eine Liste von 'Aufgaben' nacheinander zu verarbeiten, wobei jede Aufgabe eine feste Verzögerung hat.
hint: Der Timer-Handler verarbeitet eine Aufgabe und startet den Timer neu für die nächste, bis die Liste leer ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_task_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_task,
             id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_task.
    TYPES tt_tasks TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_task WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS process_tasks IMPORTING it_tasks TYPE tt_tasks.
    METHODS get_processed_tasks RETURNING VALUE(rt_processed_tasks) TYPE tt_tasks.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mt_pending_tasks TYPE tt_tasks.
    DATA mt_processed_tasks TYPE tt_tasks.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_task_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_tasks.
    mt_pending_tasks = it_tasks.
    mt_processed_tasks = VALUE #( ).
    IF mt_pending_tasks IS NOT INITIAL.
      mo_timer->interval = 100. " 100ms delay per task
      mo_timer->runs_once = abap_true.
      mo_timer->activate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    IF mt_pending_tasks IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(ls_task) = mt_pending_tasks[ 1 ].
      APPEND ls_task TO mt_processed_tasks.
      DELETE mt_pending_tasks INDEX 1.
      " Restart timer for next task
      mo_timer->activate( ).
    ELSE.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_processed_tasks.
    rt_processed_tasks = mt_processed_tasks.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_task_processing FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_task_processing.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_task_processor( ).
    DATA(lt_tasks) = VALUE zcl_timer_task_processor=>tt_tasks(
      ( id = 1 description = 'Task A' )
      ( id = 2 description = 'Task B' )
      ( id = 3 description = 'Task C' )
    ).

    lo_cut->process_tasks( lt_tasks ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_processed_tasks( ) ) exp = 0 ).

    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ). " Process Task A
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_processed_tasks( ) ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_processed_tasks( )[1]-id exp = 1 ).

    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ). " Process Task B
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_processed_tasks( ) ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_processed_tasks( )[2]-id exp = 2 ).

    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ). " Process Task C
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_processed_tasks( ) ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_processed_tasks( )[3]-id exp = 3 ).

    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ). " No more tasks, timer should deactivate
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_cut->get_processed_tasks( ) ) exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die sequenzielle Verarbeitung einer Liste von Aufgaben mit einer Verzögerung zwischen den einzelnen Schritten. Der Timer wird nach jeder verarbeiteten Aufgabe neu gestartet, bis alle Aufgaben abgearbeitet sind. Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `VALUE #()` für die Initialisierung von Tabellen wird verwendet.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, Aufgabenverarbeitung, Sequenziell, Verzögerung, VALUE #()

Instructions: Implementieren Sie einen 'Debounce'-Mechanismus für eine Aktion: Eine Aktion soll nur ausgelöst werden, wenn seit der letzten Anforderung eine bestimmte Zeit (z.B. 500ms) verstrichen ist.
hint: Starten Sie den Timer bei jeder Anforderung neu. Die Aktion wird nur ausgeführt, wenn der Timer tatsächlich abläuft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_debounce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS trigger_action.
    METHODS get_action_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_action_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    CONSTANTS gc_debounce_interval TYPE i VALUE 500. " 500ms
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_debounce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->runs_once = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trigger_action.
    " Restart timer on each trigger
    mo_timer->interval = gc_debounce_interval.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    " This method only runs if the timer finishes without being reset
    mv_action_count = mv_action_count + 1.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_action_count.
    rv_count = mv_action_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_debounce_single_trigger FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_debounce_multiple_triggers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_debounce_single_trigger.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_debounce( ).
    lo_cut->trigger_action( ).
    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ). " Simulate timer finishing
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_action_count( ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_debounce_multiple_triggers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_debounce( ).
    lo_cut->trigger_action( ). " Start timer 1
    lo_cut->trigger_action( ). " Reset timer (start timer 2)
    lo_cut->trigger_action( ). " Reset timer (start timer 3)

    " Only the last timer should fire
    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_action_count( ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert einen Debounce-Mechanismus, der sicherstellt, dass eine Aktion nur einmal nach einer Serie von schnellen Auslösern ausgeführt wird. Der Timer wird bei jedem 'Trigger' neu gestartet, und die eigentliche Aktion wird nur ausgeführt, wenn der Timer ungestört abläuft. Dies ist nützlich für UI-Eingaben wie Suchfelder.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, Debounce, UI, Event-Handling, Verzögerung

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen Timer, um eine 'Throttling'-Funktion zu implementieren: Eine Aktion soll maximal einmal pro festgelegtem Intervall (z.B. 1 Sekunde) ausgeführt werden.
hint: Der Timer wird gestartet, wenn die Aktion das erste Mal angefordert wird, und verhindert weitere Ausführungen, bis er abgelaufen ist.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_throttle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS request_action.
    METHODS get_action_count RETURNING VALUE(rv_count) TYPE i.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_action_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA mv_is_throttled TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.
    CONSTANTS gc_throttle_interval TYPE i VALUE 1000. " 1 second
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_throttle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->runs_once = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD request_action.
    IF mv_is_throttled = abap_false.
      mv_action_count = mv_action_count + 1.
      mv_is_throttled = abap_true.
      mo_timer->interval = gc_throttle_interval.
      mo_timer->activate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    mv_is_throttled = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_action_count.
    rv_count = mv_action_count.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_throttle_single_request FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_throttle_multiple_requests FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_throttle_single_request.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_throttle( ).
    lo_cut->request_action( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_action_count( ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    lo_cut->request_action( ). " First request, action executed, throttled
    lo_cut->request_action( ). " Second request, throttled, action not executed
    lo_cut->request_action( ). " Third request, throttled, action not executed
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_action_count( ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_throttle( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_action_count( ) exp = 1 ).

Instructions: Verwenden Sie einen Timer, um eine 'Polling'-Funktion zu implementieren, die eine externe Ressource (simuliert) alle 5 Sekunden abfragt und die Abfrage stoppt, sobald ein bestimmter Zustand erreicht ist. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenverarbeitung im Handler.
hint: Der Event-Handler prüft den Zustand und verwendet `FILTER` oder `REDUCE` für die Datenverarbeitung, falls zutreffend.
solution:
CLASS zcl_timer_polling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_resource_status,
             id TYPE i,
             is_ready TYPE abap_bool,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_resource_status.
    TYPES tt_resource_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_resource_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_polling IMPORTING it_initial_status TYPE tt_resource_status.
    METHODS get_final_status RETURNING VALUE(rt_final_status) TYPE tt_resource_status.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mt_current_status TYPE tt_resource_status.
    DATA mv_polling_count TYPE i VALUE 0.
    CONSTANTS gc_polling_interval TYPE i VALUE 5000. " 5 seconds
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_timer_polling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mo_timer->runs_once = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_polling.
    mt_current_status = it_initial_status.
    mv_polling_count = 0.
    mo_timer->interval = gc_polling_interval.
    mo_timer->activate( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    mv_polling_count = mv_polling_count + 1.

    " Simulate external resource update (e.g., after 2 polls, resource 1 is ready)
    IF mv_polling_count = 2.
      LOOP AT mt_current_status ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_status>) WHERE id = 1.
        <fs_status>-is_ready = abap_true.
        <fs_status>-value = 'Data A Ready'.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if all resources are ready using modern ABAP (REDUCE)
    DATA(lv_all_ready) = REDUCE abap_bool(
      INIT r = abap_true
      FOR status IN mt_current_status
      NEXT r = COND abap_bool( WHEN status-is_ready = abap_false THEN abap_false ELSE r ) ).

    IF lv_all_ready = abap_true.
      mo_timer->deactivate( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_final_status.
    rt_final_status = mt_current_status.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_polling_until_ready FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polling_until_ready.
    DATA(lt_initial_status) = VALUE zcl_timer_polling=>tt_resource_status(
      ( id = 1 is_ready = abap_false value = 'Pending' )
      ( id = 2 is_ready = abap_false value = 'Pending' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_timer_polling( ).
    lo_cut->start_polling( lt_initial_status ).

    " First poll - not ready yet
    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ).
    DATA(lt_status1) = lo_cut->get_final_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status1[ id = 1 ]-is_ready exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status1[ id = 2 ]-is_ready exp = abap_false ).

    " Second poll - resource 1 becomes ready
    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ).
    DATA(lt_status2) = lo_cut->get_final_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status2[ id = 1 ]-is_ready exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status2[ id = 2 ]-is_ready exp = abap_false ).

    " Third poll - still not all ready
    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ).
    DATA(lt_status3) = lo_cut->get_final_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status3[ id = 1 ]-is_ready exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status3[ id = 2 ]-is_ready exp = abap_false ).

    " Manually make resource 2 ready for the next poll to stop the timer
    LOOP AT lo_cut->mt_current_status ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_status>) WHERE id = 2.
      <fs_status>-is_ready = abap_true.
      <fs_status>-value = 'Data B Ready'.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_cut->handle_timer_finished( ). " Fourth poll - all ready, timer should deactivate
    DATA(lt_status4) = lo_cut->get_final_status( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status4[ id = 1 ]-is_ready exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_status4[ id = 2 ]-is_ready exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert eine Polling-Funktion, die periodisch den Status einer simulierten externen Ressource abfragt. Es nutzt moderne ABAP-Syntax wie `REDUCE` zur Überprüfung, ob alle Ressourcen bereit sind, und stoppt den Timer, sobald der gewünschte Zustand erreicht ist. Dies ist effizienter als traditionelle Schleifen.
keywords: cl_gui_timer, Polling, REDUCE, Moderne ABAP, Statusabfrage

Instructions: Zeige SFLIGHTS-Daten im ALV an. Die anzuzeigenden Spalten sollen dynamisch basierend auf einer externen Konfiguration (hier simuliert durch einen Parameter) ausgewählt werden. Nutze COND für die dynamische Feldkatalogerstellung.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_cols DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflights_display,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planetye,
           END OF ty_sflights_display.
    TYPES: tt_sflights_display TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflights_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_sflights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_show_price TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_true
        iv_show_plane TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflights_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflights_display.
    METHODS create_field_catalog
      IMPORTING
        iv_show_price TYPE abap_bool
        iv_show_plane TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_field_catalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_cols IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_dynamic.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflights_data( ).
    DATA(lt_field_catalog) = create_field_catalog(
                               iv_show_price = iv_show_price
                               iv_show_plane = iv_show_plane ).

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_alv) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0 ).
      lo_alv->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          it_fieldcat      = lt_field_catalog
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = lt_sflights
      ).
      cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflights_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_field_catalog
    IMPORTING
      iv_show_price TYPE abap_bool
      iv_show_plane TYPE abap_bool
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_field_catalog) TYPE lvc_t_fcat.

    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CARRID' text = 'Airline' ) TO rt_field_catalog.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CONNID' text = 'Flight No.' ) TO rt_field_catalog.
    APPEND VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'FLDATE' text = 'Flight Date' ) TO rt_field_catalog.

    APPEND COND #( WHEN iv_show_price = abap_true
                   THEN VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'PRICE' text = 'Price' ) ) TO rt_field_catalog.
    APPEND COND #( WHEN iv_show_price = abap_true
                   THEN VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'CURRENCY' text = 'Currency' ) ) TO rt_field_catalog.
    APPEND COND #( WHEN iv_show_plane = abap_true
                   THEN VALUE lvc_s_fcat( fieldname = 'PLANETYPE' text = 'Plane Type' ) ) TO rt_field_catalog.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeige SFLIGHTS-Daten im ALV an. Flüge, deren Auslastung (SEATSOCC / SEATSMAX) unter 50% liegt, sollen in einer bestimmten Farbe (z.B. Rot) hervorgehoben werden. Nutze FOR-Expressions, um die Styling-Tabelle zu erstellen.
hint: Erstelle eine interne Tabelle für das Cell-Styling (LVC_T_SCOL) mit Hilfe einer FOR-Expression, die die Bedingung für die Auslastung prüft.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_cell_styling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_styled.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflights_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    METHODS create_cell_styling
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_cell_colors) TYPE lvc_t_scol.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_cell_styling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_styled.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflights_data( ).
    DATA(lt_cell_colors) = create_cell_styling( lt_sflights ).

    IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_alv) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0 ).
      lo_alv->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
          it_special_groups = VALUE lvc_t_sgrp( ) " Required for cell coloring
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = lt_sflights
          it_color         = lt_cell_colors
      ).
      cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflights_data.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_cell_styling
    IMPORTING
      it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_cell_colors) TYPE lvc_t_scol.

    rt_cell_colors = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      WHERE ( ls_sflight-seatsmax > 0 AND ( ls_sflight-seatsocc * 100 / ls_sflight-seatsmax ) < 50 )
      ( 
        fname = 'SEATSOCC'
        row_id = sy-tabix
        color = 'C610' " Red color
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_cell_styling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_cell_styling.
    DATA: lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' seatsocc = 10 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_test_sflights. " 10% - should be red
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0002' seatsocc = 60 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_test_sflights. " 60% - should not be red
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0003' seatsocc = 49 seatsmax = 100 ) TO lt_test_sflights. " 49% - should be red
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'DL' connid = '0004' seatsocc = 0 seatsmax = 0 ) TO lt_test_sflights. " Division by zero, WHERE clause handles it

    DATA(lo_alv_handler) = NEW zcl_alv_cell_styling( ).
    DATA(lt_cell_colors) = lo_alv_handler->create_cell_styling( lt_test_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_cell_colors ) exp = 2 ). " Two entries should be red
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_cell_colors[ 1 ]-row_id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_cell_colors[ 1 ]-fname exp = 'SEATSOCC' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_cell_colors[ 2 ]-row_id exp = 3 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die FOR-Expression, um eine interne Tabelle für das Cell-Styling (LVC_T_SCOL) basierend auf einer Bedingung (Auslastung unter 50%) zu erstellen. Instructions: Erstelle eine Kette von Methoden, die SFLIGHTS-Daten filtern und transformieren. Zeige das Endergebnis dieser Kette in einem ALV Grid an. Die Methoden sollen dabei das Objekt selbst zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
hint: Implementiere Methoden, die ME (SELF) zurückgeben, um eine Fluent Interface zu ermöglichen. Nutze FILTER-Expressions für die Datenfilterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_method_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_filtered,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_sflight_filtered.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_filtered TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_filtered WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_filtered READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS filter_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_alv_method_chain.
    METHODS add_flight_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_alv_method_chain.
    METHODS display_alv.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_initial_sflights RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_filtered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_method_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mt_sflights = get_initial_sflights( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_initial_sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                           ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ) status = '' ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD filter_by_carrid.
    mt_sflights = FILTER #( mt_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_flight_status.
    mt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN mt_sflights
                           ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_sflight ) 
                             status = COND string( WHEN ls_sflight-price > 500 THEN 'Expensive' ELSE 'Standard' ) ) ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_alv.
    IF mt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_alv) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0 ).
      lo_alv->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_METHOD_CHAIN=>TY_SFLIGHT_FILTERED'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = mt_sflights
      ).
      cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chain FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chain.
    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_alv_method_chain( ).

    lo_processor->filter_by_carrid( 'AA' )->add_flight_status( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_processor->mt_sflights.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-status = 'Expensive' OR ls_flight-status = 'Standard' ) ).

CLASS zcl_period_list_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_detail,
             fiscper    TYPE bsp_period,
             start_date TYPE d,
             end_date   TYPE d,
           END OF ty_period_detail.

      IMPORTING
        iv_fiscvar TYPE fisc_variant
        iv_fiscyea TYPE gjahr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_period_list) TYPE tt_period_detail.

CLASS zcl_period_list_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_periods_for_year.
    DATA: ls_range TYPE zcl_period_list_for=>ty_period_detail.

    rt_period_list = VALUE #( 
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= 12 " Assuming 12 periods for simplicity, adjust for other variants
      LET lv_fiscper = |{ i ALPHA = OUT WIDTH = 3 }| IN
      ( 
        fiscper = lv_fiscper
        start_date = VALUE d( cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_date_range_for_period(
                                 iv_fiscvar = iv_fiscvar
                                 iv_fiscper = lv_fiscper
                                 iv_fiscyea = iv_fiscyea
                               )->ev_start_date ) " Direct access to return value
        end_date = VALUE d( cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_date_range_for_period(
                               iv_fiscvar = iv_fiscvar
                               iv_fiscper = lv_fiscper
                               iv_fiscyea = iv_fiscyea
                             )->ev_end_date ) " Direct access to return value
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Perioden zwischen zwei gegebenen Geschäftsperioden (Start- und Endperiode) für eine bestimmte Geschäftsjahresvariante. Die Start- und Endperiode sind inklusive.
hint: Nutze `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_next_period` in einer Schleife oder berechne die Differenz basierend auf den Perioden-Indizes.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_period_difference
      IMPORTING
        iv_fiscvar TYPE fisc_variant
        iv_start_fiscper TYPE bsp_period
        iv_start_fiscyea TYPE gjahr
        iv_end_fiscper TYPE bsp_period
        iv_end_fiscyea TYPE gjahr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_diff) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_period_difference.
    DATA: lv_current_fiscper TYPE bsp_period,
          lv_current_fiscyea TYPE gjahr,
          lv_count           TYPE i VALUE 0.

    lv_current_fiscper = iv_start_fiscper.
    lv_current_fiscyea = iv_start_fiscyea.

    TRY.
        WHILE lv_current_fiscyea < iv_end_fiscyea OR
              ( lv_current_fiscyea = iv_end_fiscyea AND lv_current_fiscper <= iv_end_fiscper ).

          lv_count = lv_count + 1.
          cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_next_period(
            EXPORTING
              iv_fiscvar = iv_fiscvar
              iv_fiscper = lv_current_fiscper
              iv_fiscyea = lv_current_fiscyea
            IMPORTING
              ev_next_fiscper = lv_current_fiscper
              ev_next_fiscyea = lv_current_fiscyea
          ).
        ENDWHILE.
        rv_diff = lv_count.
      CATCH cx_bs_period_toolset_error.
        rv_diff = -1. " Error indicator
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_workdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_workdays_in_period
      IMPORTING
        iv_fiscvar TYPE fisc_variant
        iv_fiscper TYPE bsp_period
        iv_fiscyea TYPE gjahr
        iv_factory_calendar TYPE scals_id OPTIONAL " Example: 'DE' for Germany
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_workdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_workdays_in_period.
    DATA: lv_start_date TYPE d,
          lv_end_date   TYPE d,
          lv_current_date TYPE d.

    TRY.
        cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_date_range_for_period(
          EXPORTING
            iv_fiscvar = iv_fiscvar
            iv_fiscper = iv_fiscper
            iv_fiscyea = iv_fiscyea
          IMPORTING
            ev_start_date = lv_start_date
            ev_end_date   = lv_end_date
        ).

        IF lv_start_date IS INITIAL OR lv_end_date IS INITIAL.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        DATA(lo_factory_calendar) = COND #( 
          WHEN iv_factory_calendar IS NOT INITIAL
          THEN cl_calendar_factory=>get_calendar_instance( iv_factory_calendar ) 
          ELSE THROW cx_bs_period_toolset_error( textid = cx_bs_period_toolset_error=>no_factory_calendar ) ).

        lv_current_date = lv_start_date.
        WHILE lv_current_date <= lv_end_date.
          IF lo_factory_calendar->is_workingday( lv_current_date ) = abap_true.
            rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
          ENDIF.
          lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
        ENDWHILE.

      CATCH cx_bs_period_toolset_error cx_calendar_error.
        rv_workdays = -1. " Error indicator
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lese SFLIGHTS-Daten und transformiere sie, indem du ein neues Feld 'FLIGHT_ID' (CARRID + CONNID) hinzufügst. Zeige die transformierten Daten in einem ALV Grid an. Nutze dabei eine VALUE-Expression mit FOR-Schleife.
hint: Verwende eine VALUE-Expression mit einer FOR-Schleife, um die neue interne Tabelle mit dem zusätzlichen Feld zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_value_for_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_transformed,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_id TYPE string,
             fldate    TYPE s_date,
             price     TYPE s_price,
             currency  TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_transformed.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_transformed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_transformed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS display_transformed_sflights.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS get_sflights_data RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    METHODS transform_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_value_for_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_transformed_sflights.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = get_sflights_data( ).
    DATA(lt_transformed) = transform_sflights( lt_sflights ).

    IF lt_transformed IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lo_alv) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid( i_parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0 ).
      lo_alv->set_table_for_first_display(
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'ZCL_ALV_VALUE_FOR_TRANSFORM=>TY_SFLIGHT_TRANSFORMED'
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = lt_transformed
      ).
      cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sflights_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD transform_sflights
    IMPORTING
      it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rt_transformed) TYPE tt_sflight_transformed.

    rt_transformed = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
      ( 
        carrid    = ls_sflight-carrid,
        connid    = ls_sflight-connid,
        flight_id = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }|,
        fldate    = ls_sflight-fldate,
        price     = ls_sflight-price,
        currency  = ls_sflight-currency
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
