Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Tage in einer Liste von Geschäftsperioden. Nutze dabei `cl_bs_period_toolset_basics` und eine REDUCE-Expression.
hint: Verwende `get_date_range_for_period` für jede Periode und aggregiere die Tagesdifferenzen mit einer REDUCE-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_period_reduce_days DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_period_input,
             fiscper TYPE bsp_period,
             fiscyea TYPE gjahr,
           END OF ty_period_input.
    TYPES: tt_period_input TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_period_input WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sum_days_in_periods
      IMPORTING
        iv_fiscvar TYPE fisc_variant
        it_periods TYPE tt_period_input
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_period_reduce_days IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sum_days_in_periods.
    rv_total_days = REDUCE i(
      INIT total_days = 0
      FOR ls_period IN it_periods
      LET ls_range = VALUE zcl_period_get_range=>ty_period_range(
                       cl_bs_period_toolset_basics=>get_date_range_for_period(
                         iv_fiscvar = iv_fiscvar
                         iv_fiscper = ls_period-fiscper
                         iv_fiscyea = ls_period-fiscyea
                       ) ) IN
      NEXT total_days = total_days + ( ls_range-end_date - ls_range-start_date + 1 )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        iv_airline TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_flight_passenger_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` angibt, ob er überbucht ist (passengers > max_passengers). Die neue Tabelle soll Flugnummer, Verbindungs-ID und einen Booleschen Wert für Überbuchung enthalten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ...` mit einer `COND` Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_overbooking DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             is_overbooked TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_overbooking_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_overbooking IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_overbooking_status.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                         ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                           connid = ls_flight-connid,
                           is_overbooked = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_flight-passengers > ls_flight-max_pass THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_overbooking_status FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_overbooking_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_overbooking( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_overbooking_status( ).

    " Assuming some flights exist, check if the structure is filled
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Check a specific entry if known, or just the logic
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_status) WHERE is_overbooked = abap_true.
      " At least one overbooked flight found (if any exist in sflight test data)
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_status-is_overbooked ).
      RETURN.
    ENDLOOP.
    " If no overbooked flights, assert that no true values were found
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( xsdbool( line_exists( lt_result[ is_overbooked = abap_true ] ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Auslastung (passengers / max_passengers).
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN GROUP ...` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_occupancy,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_occupancy TYPE f,
           END OF ty_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_occupancy
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_occupancy) TYPE tt_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_avg_occupancy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_average_occupancy.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_occupancy = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                            ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                              avg_occupancy = REDUCE f( INIT total_pass = 0.0 total_max_pass = 0.0
                                                        FOR member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                                        NEXT total_pass = total_pass + member-passengers,
                                                             total_max_pass = total_max_pass + member-max_pass
                                                        FINALLY = COND f( WHEN total_max_pass > 0 THEN total_pass / total_max_pass ELSE 0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_average_occupancy( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Example: Check if 'AA' has an entry (assuming it exists in sflight)
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_occupancy) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_occupancy-avg_occupancy >= 0 AND ls_aa_occupancy-avg_occupancy <= 1 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR GROUPS OF ... IN ... GROUP BY ...` Syntax ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Datenaggregation und -gruppierung direkt in ABAP. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppen können komplexe Aggregationen wie Durchschnittswerte sehr elegant und performant berechnet werden.
keywords: Internal Tables, FOR, GROUP, REDUCE, Aggregation, ABAP 7.50

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flüge aus `sflights` nach einer Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'DL'), sortieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Abflugdatum (FLDATE) aufsteigend und geben Sie die ersten 3 Flugnummern (CARRID) und Verbindungs-IDs (CONNID) zurück.
hint: Verketten Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` mit `SORT` und `UP TO`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_airline TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_top_n   TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_flights) TYPE tt_flight_key.

CLASS zcl_flight_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_top_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_airline )
                              SORT BY fldate ASCENDING
                              UP TO iv_top_n ROWS
                              ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Map (geordnete Tabelle mit eindeutigem Schlüssel) aus `sflights`, wobei der Schlüssel die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und der Wert die Anzahl der Flüge dieser Gesellschaft ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE HASHED TABLE` mit `FOR ... IN GROUP ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_count_map DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_flight_counts
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_count_map IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    rt_flight_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) WITHOUT MEMBERS
                                ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                  flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_result ).

    " Check if 'AA' exists and has a count (assuming it exists in sflight)
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_aa_count) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_aa_count-flight_count >= 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

GROUP BY ...` und `GROUP SIZE` ermöglicht die direkte Erstellung einer Hash-Map, die die Anzahl der Elemente pro Gruppe enthält. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen und Datenstrukturen zu füllen.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus einer SFLIGHTS-Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit einem `INIT`-Wert und einer `NEXT`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '250.50' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' price = '50.00' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '400.50' msg = 'Total price incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Klasse, die einen `CL_GUI_TIMER` erstellt und startet, um ein Ereignis nach einer bestimmten Zeitspanne auszulösen. Die Klasse soll einen Event-Handler für das `EVENT_FIRED`-Ereignis registrieren.
hint: Instanziieren Sie `CL_GUI_TIMER`, setzen Sie `INTERVAL`, registrieren Sie einen Event-Handler für `EVENT_FIRED` und rufen Sie `RUN` auf. Beachten Sie, dass die tatsächliche GUI-Interaktion in einem Dynpro-Kontext stattfindet.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_basic IMPLEMENTATION.

    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).

Instructions: Erweitern Sie das vorherige Timer-Beispiel. Der Timer soll nach 3 Auslösungen automatisch stoppen. Implementieren Sie dies im Event-Handler.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Zählvariable im Event-Handler und rufen Sie `mo_timer->stop()` auf, wenn der Zähler einen bestimmten Wert erreicht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_timer_auto_stop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS timer_fired EXPORTING VALUE(e_count) TYPE i.

    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_timer.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_fire_count TYPE i.
    CONSTANTS gc_max_fires TYPE i VALUE 3.

    METHODS handle_timer_fired FOR EVENT event_fired OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_auto_stop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_fired FOR mo_timer.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_timer.
    mv_fire_count = 0.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_fired.
    mv_fire_count = mv_fire_count + 1.
    RAISE EVENT timer_fired EXPORTING e_count = mv_fire_count.

    IF mv_fire_count >= gc_max_fires.
      mo_timer->stop( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_timer_auto_stop FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_timer_auto_stop.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_auto_stop( ).
    lo_cut->start_timer( 1 ). " Start with 1-second interval
    " In a real GUI scenario, you'd wait for the timer to fire.
    " For unit test, we simulate the event firing.
    " This is a simplified test as actual timer events are hard to simulate in unit tests.
    DATA(lo_timer_mock) = NEW cl_gui_timer( ). " Create a dummy timer for event triggering
    SET HANDLER lo_cut->handle_timer_fired FOR lo_timer_mock.

    " Simulate 3 timer fires
    CALL METHOD lo_timer_mock->event_fired.
    CALL METHOD lo_timer_mock->event_fired.
    CALL METHOD lo_timer_mock->event_fired.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->mv_fire_count exp = 3 msg = 'Fire count incorrect' ).
    " Assert that the timer would have been stopped if it were the actual timer object
    " (cannot directly assert mo_timer->is_running() here as we used a mock for event triggering)
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel erweitert die Nutzung von `CL_GUI_TIMER` um eine automatische Stopp-Logik. Im Event-Handler wird ein Zähler verwendet, um die Anzahl der Auslösungen zu verfolgen. Sobald ein vordefinierter Schwellenwert erreicht ist, wird der Timer mit `mo_timer->stop()` beendet. Dies demonstriert die Kontrolle über den Timer-Lebenszyklus.
keywords: CL_GUI_TIMER, Event Handling, Stop, GUI, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Gruppierung von SFLIGHTS-Daten nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) durch und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie die moderne `GROUP BY` Syntax für interne Tabellen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab INTO DATA(wa) GROUP BY ( key_field = wa-field )` und den `GROUP SIZE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid ) ASCENDING
                                             INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_count( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                                    flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) TO rt_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Erweiterung für `LOOP AT` ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Mit `GROUP SIZE` kann direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in jeder Gruppe ermittelt werden, was Aggregationen stark vereinfacht und den Code lesbarer macht.

Instructions: Verketten Sie alle Flugnummern einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'LH') aus der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle zu einem einzigen String, getrennt durch Kommas. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator mit `FOR` und String-Templates.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um über die gefilterten Elemente zu iterieren und Strings zu verketten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_flight_numbers IMPORTING iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
                                           it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_concatenated_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_string_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_flight_numbers.
    rv_concatenated_string = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN ls_flight-connid ELSE |{ s }, { ls_flight-connid }| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_concatenate_flight_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_concatenate_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_concatenate_flight_numbers.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0500' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_flight_numbers( iv_carrid = 'LH' it_sflights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '0400, 0500' msg = 'Concatenated string incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_concatenate_empty.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_string_concat( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->concatenate_flight_numbers( iv_carrid = 'XX' it_sflights = lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' msg = 'Empty concatenation incorrect' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Nutzung des `REDUCE`-Operators in Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` für die String-Verkettung. Es filtert die Daten und baut den Ergebnisstring iterativ auf, wobei `COND` verwendet wird, um das führende Komma zu vermeiden. Dies ist eine sehr funktionale und kompakte Art, solche Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: REDUCE, FOR, String Template, Internal Table, String Processing, COND, SFLIGHT

CLASS zcl_bar_multi_gen DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erzeugen Sie einen Barcode, dessen Typ dynamisch basierend auf einer Eingabe bestimmt wird, unter Verwendung eines `SWITCH`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck, um den passenden Barcode-Typ-Konstanten zuzuweisen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bar_dynamic_type DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_dynamic_barcode
      IMPORTING
        iv_type_name TYPE string
        iv_data      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_bmp_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_rstx_barcode_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bar_dynamic_type IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_dynamic_barcode.
    DATA(lv_barcode_type) = SWITCH i(
      iv_type_name
      WHEN 'EAN13' THEN cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_ean13
      WHEN 'CODE128' THEN cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_code128
      WHEN 'QRCODE' THEN cl_rstx_barcode_renderer=>c_qrcode
      ELSE THROW cx_rstx_barcode_error( textid = cx_rstx_barcode_error=>barcode_type_not_supported )
    ).

    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer(
      i_barcode_type = lv_barcode_type
    ).

    lo_barcode_renderer->set_barcode_data( iv_data ).
    rv_bmp_xstring = lo_barcode_renderer->get_bmp_xstring( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature ab ABAP 7.50, das eine kompakte und lesbare Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`- oder `CASE`-Anweisungen bietet. Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String mit Sonderzeichen (z.B. deutschen Umlauten) zwischen Codepages und stellen Sie die Datenintegrität sicher.
hint: Führen Sie eine Hin- und Rückkonvertierung durch und vergleichen Sie das Ergebnis mit dem Original. Nutzen Sie String-Templates für die Ausgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cpg_special_chars DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_and_verify
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_string TYPE string
        iv_target_codepage TYPE cpact
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_intact) TYPE abap_bool
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cpg_special_chars IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_and_verify.
    DATA(lo_converter_target) = NEW cl_abap_codepage( codepage = iv_target_codepage ).
    DATA(lo_converter_utf8) = NEW cl_abap_codepage( codepage = '4103' ). " UTF-8

    " Original String (UTF-8 internal) -> Target Codepage (XSTRING)
    DATA(lv_target_xstring) = lo_converter_target->convert_from_unicode(
      source = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( iv_original_string, 'UTF-8' )
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).

    " Target Codepage (XSTRING) -> Back to UTF-8 (STRING)
    DATA(lv_converted_string) = lo_converter_target->convert_to_unicode(
      source = lv_target_xstring
      encoding = 'UTF-8'
    ).

    rv_is_intact = COND abap_bool( WHEN lv_converted_string = iv_original_string THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_is_intact exp = abap_true msg = 'Umlauts should be intact after round-trip to ISO-8859-1' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unsupported_chars.

    " Converting Chinese to ISO-8859-1 will likely result in data loss/replacement

Durch eine Hin- und Rückkonvertierung wird überprüft, ob die Zeichen korrekt übertragen wurden. Der `COND`-Operator wird für eine kompakte bedingte Zuweisung verwendet.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings von einer Quell-Codepage in eine Ziel-Codepage.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife mit dem `VALUE`-Operator, um die neue Tabelle zu erstellen und dabei die Konvertierung für jeden Eintrag durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cpg_mass_convert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_string_table
      IMPORTING
        it_source_strings TYPE tt_strings
        iv_source_codepage TYPE cpact
        iv_target_codepage TYPE cpact
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_strings) TYPE tt_strings
      RAISING
        cx_sy_codepage_converter_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cpg_mass_convert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_string_table.
    DATA(lo_converter_source) = NEW cl_abap_codepage( codepage = iv_source_codepage ).
    DATA(lo_converter_target) = NEW cl_abap_codepage( codepage = iv_target_codepage ).

    rt_target_strings = VALUE #( FOR lv_source_string IN it_source_strings
                                 LET lv_source_xstring = lo_converter_source->convert_from_unicode(
                                                           source = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( lv_source_string, 'UTF-8' )
                                                           encoding = 'UTF-8' )
                                 IN lo_converter_target->convert_to_unicode(
                                      source = lv_source_xstring
                                      encoding = 'UTF-8' )
                               ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mass_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cpg_mass_convert( ).
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_cpg_mass_convert=>tt_strings(
      ( 'Zeile 1 mit Umlauten ÄÖÜ' )
      ( 'Line 2 with special chars €£' )
      ( 'Dritte Zeile' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->convert_string_table(
      it_source_strings = lt_source
      iv_source_codepage = '4103' " UTF-8
      iv_target_codepage = '1100' " ISO-8859-1
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 converted lines' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ] exp = 'Zeile 1 mit Umlauten ÄÖÜ' msg = 'First line should be correctly converted' ).
    " Note: Euro/Pound might not convert correctly to ISO-8859-1, so we check for expected behavior or replacement
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_target[ 2 ] msg = 'Second line should not be empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine effiziente Massenkonvertierung von Strings in einer internen Tabelle. Die Kombination aus `FOR`-Schleife, `VALUE`-Operator und `LET`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine deklarative und leistungsstarke Transformation, die den modernen ABAP-Programmierstil widerspiegelt. Es ist eine elegante Lösung für die Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Komponenten (Feldnamen und Typen) einer beliebigen Struktur zur Laufzeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data` und `get_components`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component.
    TYPES tt_components TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_structure_components IMPORTING is_data TYPE any
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_components) TYPE tt_components.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_typedescr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_data ).
    IF lo_typedescr->type_kind <> cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_struct.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lo_typedescr ).
    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->get_components( ) INTO DATA(ls_component_descr).

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode eines Objekts dynamisch zur Laufzeit auf, deren Name als String übergeben wird. Prüfen Sie vorher mit RTTI, ob die Methode existiert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit dynamischem Methodennamen und `cl_abap_classdescr=>get_methods` zur Validierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS: get_value RETURNING VALUE(rv_value) TYPE string,
             call_dynamic_method IMPORTING io_object TYPE REF TO object
                                           iv_method_name TYPE string
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE string VALUE 'Initial'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_method IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value.
    rv_value = mv_value.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_classdescr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_object_ref( io_object ) ).
        DATA(lt_methods) = lo_classdescr->get_methods( ).
        READ TABLE lt_methods WITH KEY name = iv_method_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_call_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_dyn_call_error=>method_not_found.
        ENDIF.

        CALL METHOD (io_object)->(iv_method_name)
          RECEIVING
            result = rv_result.
    CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_dyn_error).
        rv_result = lx_dyn_error->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Initial' ).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Demonstriert den dynamischen Aufruf einer Methode, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Verwendung von RTTI zur Vorabprüfung der Methodenexistenz erhöht die Robustheit und verhindert Laufzeitfehler.

Instructions: Extrahieren Sie benannte Gruppen aus einem String, der einem regulären Ausdruck entspricht.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_matcher` mit `find` und `get_group` sowie `cl_abap_regex=>get_group_names`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_extract_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_group_match,
             group_name TYPE string,
             group_value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_group_match.
    TYPES tt_group_matches TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_group_match WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS extract_named_groups IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
                                             iv_pattern TYPE string
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_groups) TYPE tt_group_matches.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_extract_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD extract_named_groups.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = iv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_text ).

    IF lo_matcher->find( ).
      DATA(lt_group_names) = lo_regex->get_group_names( ).
      LOOP AT lt_group_names INTO DATA(lv_group_name).
        IF lv_group_name IS NOT INITIAL. " Skip unnamed group 0
          APPEND INITIAL LINE TO rt_groups ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_group>).
          <fs_group>-group_name = lv_group_name.
          <fs_group>-group_value = lo_matcher->get_group( lv_group_name ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_extract_groups FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_extract_groups.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_extract_groups( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'Name: John Doe, Age: 30'.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = 'Name: (?<name>\w+ \w+), Age: (?<age>\d+)'.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->extract_named_groups( iv_text = lv_text iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY group_name = 'NAME' INTO DATA(ls_name_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_name_group-group_value exp = 'John Doe' ).
    READ TABLE lt_result WITH KEY group_name = 'AGE' INTO DATA(ls_age_group).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_age_group-group_value exp = '30' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Zeigt, wie man spezifische Teile eines Strings, die durch benannte Gruppen in einem regulären Ausdruck definiert sind, extrahiert. Dies ist sehr mächtig für das Parsen strukturierter Daten aus unstrukturierten Texten.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Regex-Suche durch und extrahieren Sie alle Matches zusammen mit ihren Offsets und Längen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` mit der `RESULTS`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_find_results DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_match_result,
             offset TYPE i,
             length TYPE i,
             substring TYPE string,
           END OF ty_match_result.
    TYPES tt_match_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_match_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_all_with_details IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string
                                            iv_pattern TYPE string
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_match_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_find_results IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_all_with_details.
    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX iv_pattern IN iv_text
      RESULTS DATA(lt_raw_results).

    rt_results = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw_result IN lt_raw_results
                           ( offset = ls_raw_result-offset
                             length = ls_raw_result-length
                             substring = substring( val = iv_text off = ls_raw_result-offset len = ls_raw_result-length ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_results FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_results.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_find_results( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = 'ABAP 7.40, ABAP 7.50, ABAP 7.55'.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = 'ABAP\s+(\d\.\d{2})'.
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->find_all_with_details( iv_text = lv_text iv_pattern = lv_pattern ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_results INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_res1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res1-offset exp = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res1-length exp = 8 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res1-substring exp = 'ABAP 7.40' ).

    READ TABLE lt_results INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_res2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res2-offset exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res2-length exp = 8 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_res2-substring exp = 'ABAP 7.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX ... RESULTS`-Anweisung ist eine moderne und effiziente Möglichkeit, alle Vorkommen eines regulären Ausdrucks zu finden und detaillierte Informationen (Offset, Länge) zu jedem Match zu erhalten. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...) FOR` ist ein modernes Sprachkonstrukt zur Tabellenkonstruktion.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein String ein gültiges Datum im Format YYYY-MM-DD ist, unter Verwendung eines regulären Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_regex` und `cl_abap_matcher` mit einem präzisen Regex-Muster für Datumsformate.
solution:
CLASS zcl_regex_validate_date DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_valid_date_format IMPORTING iv_date_string TYPE string
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_regex_validate_date IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_valid_date_format.
    " Regex for YYYY-MM-DD format, considering leap years and month days is complex.
    " This regex checks for basic YYYY-MM-DD structure.
    " For full date validation, use CL_ABAP_DATE_TIME_UTILITIES.
    DATA(lv_pattern) = '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$'.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = lv_pattern ).
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_date_string ).
    rb_is_valid = lo_matcher->match( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_date_format.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_regex_validate_date( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_valid_date_format( '2023-12-31' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_cut->is_valid_date_format( '1999-01-01' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_date_format( '2023/12/31' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_date_format( '2023-1-1' ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lo_cut->is_valid_date_format( '2023-12-3' ) ).

  ENDMETHOD.

Schaltjahre) abdecken kann, ist es hervorragend geeignet, um das Format schnell zu überprüfen. Für eine vollständige Datumsvalidierung sollte `CL_ABAP_DATE_TIME_UTILITIES` verwendet werden.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) haben und deren maximale Kapazität (MAX_SEAT) größer als ein gegebener Wert ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FILTER` Operator, um eine neue Tabelle zu erstellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_filter_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_filter_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate data from SFLIGHTS
    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 )
                              ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 180 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 90 )
                              ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250104' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 200 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250105' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 250 ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax > iv_min_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer (CONNID) und die Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle enthält, aber nur für Flüge, die in der Zukunft liegen.

CLASS zcl_map_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_future_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_map_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_future_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate data from SFLIGHTS
    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 )
                              ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20240102' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 180 ) " Past flight
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 90 )
                              ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250104' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 200 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20240105' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 250 ) ). " Past flight

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                          WHERE ( fldate > sy-datum )
                          ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                            connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der verfügbaren Sitze für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der SFLIGHTS-Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um Werte zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_for_carrier.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate data from SFLIGHTS
    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 )
                              ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 180 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 90 )
                              ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250104' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 200 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250105' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 250 ) ).

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, die nur Flüge von 'LH' (Lufthansa) enthält und für jeden Eintrag ein neues Feld 'IS_FULL' hinzufügt, das 'X' ist, wenn `SEATSOCC` gleich `SEATSMAX` ist, ansonsten leer.
hint: Verwenden Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR` und `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             is_full  TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_lh_flight_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_lh_flight_status.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Simulate data from SFLIGHTS
    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 )
                              ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 180 ) " Full flight
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 100 ) " Full flight
                              ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250104' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 200 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250105' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 250 ) ).

    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
                                WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' )
                                ( carrid   = ls_flight-carrid,
                                  connid   = ls_flight-connid,
                                  fldate   = ls_flight-fldate,
                                  seatsmax = ls_flight-seatsmax,
                                  seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc,
                                  is_full  = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_flight-seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsmax THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_lh_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_lh_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_sflights( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_lh_flight_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3
                                        msg = 'Expected 3 LH flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-is_full
                                        msg = 'Flight 0400 should not be full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-is_full
                                       msg = 'Flight 0401 should be full' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-is_full
                                        msg = 'Flight 0402 should not be full' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von `VALUE`, `FOR` und `COND` ermöglicht die Erstellung und Transformation von internen Tabellen mit bedingter Logik in einem einzigen, ausdrucksstarken Statement. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und effiziente Methode, um Daten zu manipulieren und neue Strukturen zu erzeugen.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, VALUE, FOR, COND, ASSERT, SFLIGHTS, Conditional Logic

CLASS zcl_modify_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_occupied_seats
      IMPORTING

        iv_increase_by TYPE i
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_modify_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_occupied_seats.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
         WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-seatsocc = <fs_flight>-seatsocc + iv_increase_by.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche maximale Sitzplatzkapazität.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_seats,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_seatsmax TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_avg_seats.
    TYPES tt_carrier_avg_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_avg_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 )
                              ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 180 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 90 )
                              ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250104' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 200 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250105' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 250 ) ).

    rt_avg_seats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
                            ( carrid       = ls_group-carrid
                              avg_seatsmax = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum = 0 count = 0
                                                                FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
                                                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsmax
                                                                     count = count + 1
                                                                FINAL = COND decfloat16( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum / count ELSE 0 ) ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_count_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_statistics.
    DATA: lt_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight.

    lt_all_flights = VALUE #( ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 150 )
                              ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' seatsmax = 180 seatsocc = 180 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250103' seatsmax = 100 seatsocc = 90 )
                              ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250104' seatsmax = 250 seatsocc = 200 )
                              ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250105' seatsmax = 300 seatsocc = 250 ) ).

    rt_stats = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_group IN lt_all_flights GROUP BY ls_group-carrid
                        ( carrid             = ls_group-carrid
                          flight_count       = GROUP SIZE
                          total_occupied_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                                           FOR ls_flight IN GROUP ls_group
                                                           NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_conditionally DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS append_flights_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_min_seatsmax   TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      CHANGING
        ct_target_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_append_conditionally IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD append_flights_conditionally.
    ct_target_flights = VALUE #( BASE ct_target_flights
                                 FOR ls_flight IN it_source_flights
                                 WHERE ( seatsmax > iv_min_seatsmax )
                                 ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_carrier_in_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_old_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_new_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_replace_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_carrier_in_flights.
    LOOP AT ct_flights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>)
         WHERE carrid = iv_old_carrid.
      <fs_flight>-carrid = iv_new_carrid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_check_contains_carrier DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_gos_attachment_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      io_gos_manager = lo_gos_manager

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazität (`SEATSMAX`) für jede Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` und geben Sie das Ergebnis gruppiert zurück. Verwenden Sie hierfür `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `REDUCE`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab GROUP BY` für die Gruppierung und `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppenschleife zur Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_capacity,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_capacity.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_capacity_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_capacity) TYPE tt_carrier_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_seats) = REDUCE i(
        INIT sum = 0
        FOR <fs_sflight> IN GROUP ls_sflight
        NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-seatsmax
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_carrier_capacity(
        carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
        total_seats = lv_total_seats
      ) TO rt_capacity.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse mit einer Methode, die eine Kette von Operationen auf einem String ausführt (z.B. Trimmen, Großschreiben, Ersetzen). Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining und den `NEW`-Operator.
hint: Designen Sie die Methoden so, dass sie `ME` zurückgeben, um Method Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS trim RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.
    METHODS replace_char
      IMPORTING
        iv_old_char TYPE char1
        iv_new_char TYPE char1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_string_processor.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_processed_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_processed_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim.
    mv_processed_string = |{ mv_processed_string ALPHA = IN }|.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_processed_string = to_upper( mv_processed_string ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_char.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old_char IN mv_processed_string WITH iv_new_char.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_processed_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer enthält, und filtern Sie dabei nur Flüge mit einer bestimmten Mindestkapazität. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `WHERE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `VALUE #(...)` und einer `WHERE`-Klausel für die Transformation und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                            WHERE ( seatsmax >= iv_min_seats )
                            ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                              connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Division durch Null simuliert und eine klassenbasierte Ausnahme auslöst und abfängt. Die Ausnahme soll eine benutzerdefinierte Fehlermeldung enthalten.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_division_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
      RAISING
        zcx_division_by_zero.

    METHODS safe_divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_denominator = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_division_by_zero
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_division_by_zero=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD safe_divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = divide( iv_numerator = iv_numerator iv_denominator = iv_denominator ).
      CATCH zcx_division_by_zero INTO DATA(lx_div_by_zero).
        MESSAGE lx_div_by_zero TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'. " Nur für Demo, in Tests nicht ideal
        rv_result = 0. " Oder ein anderer Fehlerwert
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Methode dynamisch aufruft, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Methode soll einen String verarbeiten (z.B. umkehren oder in Großbuchstaben umwandeln).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD` mit einem dynamischen Methodennamen in Klammern `(lv_method_name)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_string_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_method_name  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output_string) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS reverse_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS uppercase_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_string_dynamically.
    DATA lv_method_name TYPE string VALUE iv_method_name.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(lv_method_name)
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_input_string
          RECEIVING
            rv_output = rv_output_string.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_output_string = |ERROR: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD reverse_string.
    DATA lv_length TYPE i.
    lv_length = strlen( iv_input ).
    DO lv_length TIMES.
      rv_output = rv_output && iv_input+((lv_length - sy-index)*1)(1).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD uppercase_string.
    rv_output = to_upper( iv_input ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`SFLIGHT`) nach Flügen, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität haben und zu einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft gehören. Verwenden Sie die `FILTER`-Expression.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FILTER #(...)` mit mehreren Bedingungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_min_seats TYPE sflight-seatsmax
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflight USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = iv_carrid AND seatsmax >= iv_min_seats ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_filter_no_match FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_min_seats = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should not be empty' ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Carrier should be LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( ls_flight-seatsmax >= 200 ) msg = 'Seats should be >= 200' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_filter_no_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_flights( iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_min_seats = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_result msg = 'Result table should be empty for non-existent carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FILTER`-Expression bietet eine deklarative und effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern. Sie ist deutlich lesbarer und oft performanter als manuelle `LOOP`-Schleifen mit `IF`-Anweisungen, insbesondere wenn ein Tabellenschlüssel verwendet wird. Dies ist ein Kernstück des modernen ABAP für die Datenmanipulation.
keywords: `FILTER`, Internal Tables, `WHERE`, `sflight`, `CLASS`

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die eine Liste von Objekten eines bestimmten Typs verwaltet (z.B. Flugobjekte). hint: Nutzen Sie `NEW` für die Objekterstellung und `INSERT` oder `APPEND` mit `VALUE #(...)` für die Tabellenmanipulation.

CLASS zcl_flight_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA carrid TYPE sflight-carrid READ-ONLY.
    DATA connid TYPE sflight-connid READ-ONLY.
    DATA fldate TYPE sflight-fldate READ-ONLY.
    DATA seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax READ-ONLY.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    me->carrid = iv_carrid.
    me->connid = iv_connid.
    me->fldate = iv_fldate.
    me->seatsmax = iv_seatsmax.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_flight_objects TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_flight_object WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax.

    METHODS get_all_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_objects.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flight_objects.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight.
    APPEND NEW zcl_flight_object(
      iv_carrid   = iv_carrid
      iv_connid   = iv_connid
      iv_fldate   = iv_fldate
      iv_seatsmax = iv_seatsmax
    ) TO mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Lesen Sie die nächsten 10 Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und speichern Sie diese in einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie dabei die Inline-Deklaration.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...) und FETCH NEXT ... ROWS ONLY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_fetch_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-curr,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_next_n_flights_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_count   TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_fetch_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_n_flights_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr AS currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights)
      FETCH NEXT @iv_count ROWS ONLY.

    " Using VALUE operator for modern internal table population (optional, but good practice)
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_flights ( 
                            carrid   = ls_raw-carrid,
                            connid   = ls_raw-connid,
                            fldate   = ls_raw-fldate,
                            price    = ls_raw-price,
                            currency = ls_raw-currency
                          ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_next_n_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_next_n_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_fetch_value( ).
    " Assuming 'LH' (Lufthansa) has at least 10 flights in SFLIGHTS
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_next_n_flights_for_carrier( iv_carrier = 'LH' iv_count = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 10 ).
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Inline-Deklaration @DATA(...) in Kombination mit SELECT ... INTO TABLE und FETCH NEXT N ROWS ONLY ermöglicht eine kompakte und effiziente Datenbeschaffung. Der VALUE-Operator wird hier verwendet, um die Daten in eine interne Tabelle mit einer spezifischen Struktur zu mappen, was die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen Betrag und ein Datum basierend auf einer dynamisch übergebenen Ländereinstellung (Locale).
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_FORMAT mit einem expliziten Locale-Objekt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_format_locale DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_formatted_output,
             amount_str TYPE string,
             date_str   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_formatted_output.
    METHODS format_data_by_locale_str
      IMPORTING
        iv_amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
        iv_date   TYPE d
        iv_locale TYPE sy-langu " e.g., 'DE', 'EN', 'ES'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_formatted_data) TYPE ty_formatted_output.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_format_locale IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_data_by_locale_str.
    DATA(lo_locale) = cl_abap_locale_srv=>get_instance( iv_locale ).

    rs_formatted_data-amount_str = cl_abap_format=>amount_alpha(
                                       amount   = iv_amount
                                       currency = 'EUR' " Assuming EUR for demo
                                       mask     = cl_abap_format=>mask_sign_and_currency
                                       locale   = lo_locale ).

    rs_formatted_data-date_str = cl_abap_format=>date_alpha(
                                     date   = iv_date
                                     locale = lo_locale ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_data_by_locale FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_data_by_locale.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_format_locale( ).
    DATA(ls_formatted_de) = lo_cut->format_data_by_locale_str( iv_amount = '1234.56' iv_date = '20231209' iv_locale = 'DE' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = ls_formatted_de-amount_str exp = '1.234,56 EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = ls_formatted_de-date_str exp = '09.12.2023' ).

    DATA(ls_formatted_en) = lo_cut->format_data_by_locale_str( iv_amount = '1234.56' iv_date = '20231209' iv_locale = 'EN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = ls_formatted_en-amount_str exp = '1,234.56 EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = ls_formatted_en-date_str exp = '12/09/2023' ). " Or similar, depends on EN variant
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Verwendung von CL_ABAP_LOCALE_SRV und die Übergabe eines Locale-Objekts an CL_ABAP_FORMAT-Methoden kann die Formatierung von Daten und Beträgen dynamisch an die gewünschte Ländereinstellung angepasst werden, was für internationale Anwendungen unerlässlich ist.
keywords: cl_abap_format, Locale, Internationalization, Dynamic Formatting, Object Orientation

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in Blöcken von 100 Zeilen, um große Datenmengen effizient zu verarbeiten.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... PACKAGE SIZE ... und FETCH NEXT ... ROWS ONLY in einer Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_chunked_fetch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_flights_in_chunks
      IMPORTING
        iv_chunk_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_processed_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_chunked_fetch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_flights_in_chunks.
    DATA: lt_flights_chunk TYPE tt_sflight.
    DATA(lv_total_processed) = 0.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_flights_chunk
      PACKAGE SIZE @iv_chunk_size.

      " Process each chunk
      LOOP AT lt_flights_chunk INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        " Simulate processing, e.g., logging or aggregation
        " cl_demo_output=>display( |Processing flight: { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid }| ).
        lv_total_processed = lv_total_processed + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      CLEAR lt_flights_chunk. " Clear chunk for next iteration
    ENDSELECT.

    rv_processed_count = lv_total_processed.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_flights_in_chunks FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_flights_in_chunks.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_chunked_fetch( ).
    DATA(lv_processed_count) = lo_cut->process_flights_in_chunks( 10 ). " Process in chunks of 10

    " To make this test robust, we need to know the total number of entries in SFLIGHTS
    " or at least assert that some records were processed.
    " For a real test, you'd mock SFLIGHTS or ensure it has data.
    " Here, we assume SFLIGHTS has at least some data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'No flights processed, check SFLIGHTS data'
                                          act = lv_processed_count
                                          exp = 0
                                          _operator = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_operator-not_equal ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von SELECT ... PACKAGE SIZE und der impliziten Schleife ermöglicht das zeilenweise oder blockweise Verarbeiten großer Datenmengen direkt aus der Datenbank. Dies reduziert den Speicherverbrauch und verbessert die Performance, da nicht alle Daten auf einmal in den Arbeitsspeicher geladen werden müssen.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, SELECT, PACKAGE SIZE, Database Access, Chunked Processing, Loop

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine formatierte Ausgabe, die einen Flug (Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer, Datum, Preis) in einem String-Template darstellt, wobei Datum und Preis mit CL_ABAP_FORMAT formatiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates und rufen Sie CL_ABAP_FORMAT-Methoden direkt darin auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_format_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

CLASS zcl_str_format_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_flight_details.
    rv_formatted_string = |Flug: { is_flight-carrid } { is_flight-connid }, | &&
                          |Datum: { cl_abap_format=>date_alpha( is_flight-fldate ) }, | &&
                          |Preis: { cl_abap_format=>amount_alpha( amount = is_flight-price currency = is_flight-currency ) }|.

ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_flight_details FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_flight_details.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_format_template( ).
    DATA(ls_flight) = VALUE zcl_str_format_template=>ty_flight_data(
                            carrid   = 'LH'
                            connid   = '0400'
                            fldate   = '20231209'
                            price    = '1234.56'
                            currency = 'EUR' ).
    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_cut->format_flight_details( ls_flight ).
