    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_formatted exp = 'Datum: 09.12.2023' ). " Assuming DE locale
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_formatted exp = 'Preis: 1.234,56 EUR' ). " Assuming DE locale
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates bieten eine moderne und lesbare Syntax zur Erstellung von Strings. Die Möglichkeit, Methoden wie die von CL_ABAP_FORMAT direkt innerhalb der geschweiften Klammern aufzurufen, macht die Code-Erstellung noch kompakter und effizienter für formatierte Ausgaben.
keywords: cl_abap_format, String Templates, Formatting, Output, Concatenation

Instructions: Lesen Sie die ersten 5 Flüge für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und transformieren Sie die Daten direkt in eine neue interne Tabelle mit einem FOR-Ausdruck.
hint: Kombinieren Sie SELECT ... FETCH NEXT ... mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und der Inline-Deklaration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_id  TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             formatted_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_formatted_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_count   TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, curr
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrier
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_raw_flights)
      FETCH NEXT @iv_count ROWS ONLY.

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_raw_flights (
                               carrier_id      = ls_raw-carrid,
                               flight_id       = ls_raw-connid,
                               flight_date     = ls_raw-fldate,
                               formatted_price = cl_abap_format=>amount_alpha( amount = ls_raw-price currency = ls_raw-curr )
                             ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_formatted_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_formatted_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_fetch_for( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_formatted_flights( iv_carrier = 'AA' iv_count = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summaries ) exp = 2 ).
    IF lines( lt_summaries ) = 2.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_summaries[ 1 ]-carrier_id exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_summaries[ 1 ]-formatted_price ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von SELECT ... FETCH NEXT ... mit einem FOR-Ausdruck und dem VALUE-Operator ermöglicht eine hochfunktionale und kompakte Datenbeschaffung und -transformation. Daten können direkt aus der Datenbank gelesen und gleichzeitig in eine gewünschte Struktur umgewandelt werden, was die Notwendigkeit separater Schleifen reduziert.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, SELECT, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Data Transformation, Database Access

Instructions: Formatieren Sie eine generische Statusmeldung, die Platzhalter enthält, unter Verwendung von CL_ABAP_FORMAT.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_ABAP_FORMAT.add_parameter und CL_ABAP_FORMAT.get_text_message.
solution:
CLASS zcl_format_message DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_status_message
      IMPORTING
        iv_template TYPE string " e.g., 'Der Flug {0} von {1} wurde {2}.'
        it_parameters TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_format_message IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_status_message.
    DATA(lo_message_formatter) = NEW cl_abap_format( ).
    lo_message_formatter->set_text_message( iv_template ).

    LOOP AT it_parameters INTO DATA(lv_param).
      lo_message_formatter->add_parameter( lv_param ).
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_formatted_message = lo_message_formatter->get_text_message( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_status_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_status_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_format_message( ).
    DATA(lt_params) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LH' ) ( '0400' ) ( 'storniert' ) ).
    DATA(lv_formatted) = lo_cut->format_status_message(
                               iv_template = 'Der Flug {0} {1} wurde {2}.'
                               it_parameters = lt_params ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted exp = 'Der Flug LH 0400 wurde storniert.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: CL_ABAP_FORMAT kann nicht nur für Standardformatierungen, sondern auch für die dynamische Erstellung von Textnachrichten mit Platzhaltern verwendet werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich für die Konsistenz von Meldungen und die einfache Anpassung an verschiedene Sprachen.
keywords: cl_abap_format, Message Formatting, Placeholders, String Processing, Object Orientation

Instructions: Lesen Sie die ersten 10 Flüge aus SFLIGHTS, die nach einem bestimmten Datum liegen, und geben Sie nur die Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie SELECT ... WHERE ... FETCH NEXT ... ROWS ONLY und geben Sie nur die benötigten Felder an.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_after_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date  TYPE d
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_after_date.
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      WHERE fldate > @iv_date
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_keys
      FETCH NEXT @iv_count ROWS ONLY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights_after_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights_after_date.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_fetch_filter( ).
    " Assuming there are flights after '20230101'
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->get_flights_after_date( iv_date = '20230101' iv_count = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flight_keys ) exp = 5 ).
    IF lines( lt_flight_keys ) = 5.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_keys[ 1 ]-carrid ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flight_keys[ 1 ]-connid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von WHERE-Klausel und FETCH NEXT N ROWS ONLY im SELECT-Statement ermöglicht es, sowohl nach Kriterien zu filtern als auch die Anzahl der Ergebnisse direkt auf der Datenbank zu begrenzen. Dies ist eine performante Methode, um gezielt eine Teilmenge von Daten zu erhalten.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, SELECT, WHERE, Database Access, Filtering, Pagination

Instructions: Formatieren Sie einen Zeitstempel (UTC) in ein lokales Datum und eine lokale Uhrzeit, unter Berücksichtigung der Zeitzone des Benutzers.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_TSTMP und CL_ABAP_FORMAT.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dt_tstmp_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_local_datetime,
             local_date TYPE d,
             local_time TYPE t,
           END OF ty_local_datetime.

    METHODS get_local_datetime
      IMPORTING
        iv_utc_timestamp TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_local_dt) TYPE ty_local_datetime.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dt_tstmp_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_local_datetime.
    DATA(lv_tzone) = sy-zonlo. " User's time zone

    cl_abap_tstmp=>convert_tstmp_to_syst( 
      EXPORTING
        tstmp = iv_utc_timestamp
        tzone = lv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        date  = rs_local_dt-local_date
        time  = rs_local_dt-local_time
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_local_datetime FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_local_datetime.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dt_tstmp_format( ).
    " Example UTC timestamp: 2023-12-09 14:00:00 UTC
    DATA(lv_utc_tstmp) = '20231209140000'.

    " Assuming user's time zone is CET (UTC+1) for this test
    " Expected local time: 2023-12-09 15:00:00
    DATA(ls_local_dt) = lo_cut->get_local_datetime( lv_utc_tstmp ).

    " The exact expected values depend on SY-ZONLO and system settings.
    " For a robust test, one might mock SY-ZONLO or use a fixed time zone.
    " Here, we assert that the conversion happened and the values are not initial.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_local_dt-local_date ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_local_dt-local_time ).

    " More specific check if we assume a fixed time zone for the test environment
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_dt-local_date exp = '20231209' ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_local_dt-local_time exp = '150000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse CL_ABAP_TSTMP bietet Methoden zur Umwandlung von Zeitstempeln in lokale Datum/Uhrzeit-Werte unter Berücksichtigung der Zeitzone. Dies ist entscheidend für die korrekte Anzeige von Zeitinformationen in globalen Anwendungen.
keywords: cl_abap_tstmp, Time Stamp, Time Zone, Date, Time, Conversion

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in Großbuchstaben und dann wieder in Kleinbuchstaben.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden von CL_ABAP_FORMAT für die Groß-/Kleinschreibung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_case_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_case
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_converted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_case_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_case.
    DATA(lv_upper) = cl_abap_format=>to_upper( iv_input ).
    DATA(lv_lower) = cl_abap_format=>to_lower( iv_input ).

    APPEND lv_upper TO rs_converted_strings.
    APPEND lv_lower TO rs_converted_strings.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_convert_case FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_convert_case.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_case_format( ).
    DATA(lt_converted) = lo_cut->convert_case( 'Hello World' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_converted ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted[ 1 ] exp = 'HELLO WORLD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_converted[ 2 ] exp = 'hello world' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: CL_ABAP_FORMAT bietet einfache und direkte Methoden wie TO_UPPER und TO_LOWER zur Konvertierung der Groß-/Kleinschreibung von Strings. Dies ist eine saubere und standardisierte Alternative zu älteren ABAP-Befehlen.
keywords: cl_abap_format, String, Case Conversion, TO_UPPER, TO_LOWER

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Zahlen in einer internen Tabelle. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sum_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sum_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sum.
    rv_sum = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR num IN it_numbers NEXT s = s + num ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_sum FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_table( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ( 1 ) ( 2 ) ( 3 ) ( 4 ) ( 5 ) ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 15.
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Summe sollte 15 sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sum_table( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_sum( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_sum exp = lv_expected_sum msg = 'Summe sollte 0 sein für leere Tabelle' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen, lesbaren Anweisung, was den traditionellen `LOOP AT ... SUM` oder `LOOP AT ... ADD` ersetzt.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Sum, Aggregation, Functional

Instructions: Addieren Sie eine bestimmte Anzahl von Tagen zu einem gegebenen Datum.
hint: Verwenden Sie die funktionale Syntax für Datumsobjekte mit direkter Addition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
        iv_days TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_new_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_days.
    rv_new_date = iv_date + iv_days.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_days FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_zero_days FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_negative_days FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_add( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20231026'.
    DATA(lv_days_to_add) = 5.
    DATA(lv_expected_date) = '20231031'.
    DATA(lv_actual_date) = lo_cut->add_days( iv_date = lv_start_date iv_days = lv_days_to_add ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_date exp = lv_expected_date msg = 'Datum sollte 5 Tage später sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_zero_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_add( ).
    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20240101'.
    DATA(lv_days_to_add) = 0.
    DATA(lv_expected_date) = '20240101'.
    DATA(lv_actual_date) = lo_cut->add_days( iv_date = lv_start_date iv_days = lv_days_to_add ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_date exp = lv_expected_date msg = 'Datum sollte unverändert sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_negative_days.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_date_add( ).

CLASS zcl_sum_even_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,

             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,

CLASS zcl_sflight_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE ty_total_summary.

CLASS zcl_sflight_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    rs_summary = REDUCE ty_total_summary(
      INIT s = VALUE ty_total_summary( total_flights = 0 total_price = '0.00' )
      FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
      NEXT
        s-total_flights = s-total_flights + 1,
        s-total_price   = s-total_price + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.

      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20230101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20230101' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20230102' price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0001' fldate = '20230101' price = '300.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE sflight-price(
      INIT s = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrier )
      NEXT s = s + ls_flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-val2 exp = ls_expected-val2 msg = 'val2 sollte 0 sein' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_actual-text exp = ls_expected-text msg = 'text sollte StartEnd sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `ADD-CORRESPONDING` ist eine ältere, aber effiziente Anweisung, um numerische Felder gleichnamiger Strukturen oder interner Tabellen zu addieren. In modernem ABAP wird für feinere Kontrolle oft `FOR` oder `REDUCE` bevorzugt, aber für einfache Massenoperationen ist es immer noch relevant.
keywords: ADD-CORRESPONDING, Structures, Math, Legacy, Functional (contextual)

CLASS zcl_gui_props_demo IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_barcode_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_barcode_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_barcode_renderer) = NEW cl_rstx_barcode_renderer( ).

            i_barcode_content = iv_text
          IMPORTING
            e_bmp_data = rv_bmp_data
        ).
      CATCH cx_rstx_barcode_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

unit_test:

Moderne ABAP-Features wie `DATA()` für Inline-Deklarationen und `NEW` für die Objekterzeugung machen den Code prägnanter.
keywords: Barcode, cl_rstx_barcode_renderer, graphic, BMP, xstring

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einer `RANGES`-Tabelle für die Fluggesellschaft (Carrier ID). Verwenden Sie den `FILTER`-Operator.
hint: Der `FILTER`-Operator in Kombination mit dem `IN`-Ausdruck ist ideal für diese Aufgabe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ranges_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_sflights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        it_carrid_ranges TYPE RANGE OF s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ranges_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_sflights_by_carrid.
    rt_filtered_sflights = FILTER #( it_sflights USING KEY primary_key WHERE carrid IN it_carrid_ranges ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS test_filter_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ranges_filter( ).

    DATA(lt_all_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '200' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251202' price = '150' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251203' price = '300' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_carrid_ranges) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id(
      ( sign = 'I' option = 'EQ' low = 'LH' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered_sflights) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_by_carrid(
      it_sflights = lt_all_sflights
      it_carrid_ranges = lt_carrid_ranges
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered table should have 2 entries' act = lines( lt_filtered_sflights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry carrid should be LH' act = lt_filtered_sflights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry carrid should be LH' act = lt_filtered_sflights[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

    DATA(lt_empty_ranges) = VALUE RANGE OF s_carr_id( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered_empty) = lo_cut->filter_sflights_by_carrid(
      it_sflights = lt_all_sflights
      it_carrid_ranges = lt_empty_ranges
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Filtered table with empty ranges should be empty' act = lines( lt_filtered_empty ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature in modernem ABAP (ab 7.40, hier 7.50 für `IN` mit `RANGES`), um interne Tabellen deklarativ zu filtern. In Kombination mit dem `IN`-Ausdruck kann eine `RANGES`-Tabelle direkt als Filterkriterium verwendet werden, was den Code sehr kompakt, lesbar und effizient macht, da keine expliziten Schleifen oder `CHECK`-Anweisungen erforderlich sind.
keywords: RANGES, FILTER, internal table, data selection, IN expression, functional programming

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`), indem Sie für jede Zeile den Preis verdoppeln und nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 200 zurückgeben. Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `VALUE`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung und dem `VALUE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_and_filter_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_transformed_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_filter_sflights.
    rt_transformed_sflights = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                       WHERE ( price * 2 > 200 )
                                       ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                         connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                         fldate = ls_sflight-fldate
                                         price  = ls_sflight-price * 2 ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS test_transform_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_transform_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_transform( ).

    DATA(lt_input_sflights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '100' ) " 200 -> filtered out
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251201' price = '150' ) " 300 -> included
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = '20251202' price = '101' ) " 202 -> included
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251203' price = '50'  ) " 100 -> filtered out
    ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_and_filter_sflights( lt_input_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Result table should have 2 entries' act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'First entry price should be 300' act = lt_result[ 1 ]-price exp = '300' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Second entry price should be 202' act = lt_result[ 2 ]-price exp = '202' ).

explanation: Die Kombination von `FOR` und `VALUE` ermöglicht eine funktionale Transformation und Filterung von internen Tabellen in einem einzigen, deklarativen Ausdruck. Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein ungültiger Parameter übergeben wird. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme in einer aufrufenden Methode ab.
hint: Definieren Sie eine Klasse, die von `CX_STATIC_CHECK` erbt, und verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_parameter DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_parameter IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_parameter_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_positive_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_parameter.

    METHODS process_number
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_parameter_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_positive_number.
    IF iv_number <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_parameter=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_number.
    TRY.
        validate_positive_number( iv_number ).
        rv_result = |Number { iv_number } is valid and processed.|.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_parameter INTO DATA(lx_invalid_param).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_invalid_param->get_text( ) } - Invalid number { iv_number }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Modernes ABAP setzt auf klassenbasierte Ausnahmen (`CX_STATIC_CHECK`, `CX_DYNAMIC_CHECK`) anstelle von `MESSAGE ... RAISING`. Die Verwendung von `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` ermöglicht eine klare Trennung von Fehlererkennung und Fehlerbehandlung. `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke sind der Standard für die Ausnahmebehandlung und verbessern die Robustheit und Lesbarkeit des Codes erheblich.
keywords: Exception Handling, RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE, TRY CATCH, custom exception, CX_STATIC_CHECK

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in einer internen Tabelle (`sflights`) und runden Sie das Ergebnis auf zwei Dezimalstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe zu aggregieren.

CLASS zcl_flight_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE p LENGTH 10 DECIMALS 2 ) " Explicitly define type for sum
                                FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflights
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die explizite Typisierung des `INIT`-Wertes stellt sicher, dass die Dezimalstellen korrekt behandelt werden.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten, unter Berücksichtigung von Wochenenden (Samstag und Sonntag).
hint: Iterieren Sie durch die Tage und verwenden Sie die Methoden der Klasse `CL_ABAP_TSTMP` oder `CL_ABAP_DATE` zur Datumsberechnung und Wochentagsermittlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_workday_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_workdays
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_workday_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_workdays.
    DATA: lv_current_date TYPE d,
          lv_weekday      TYPE i.

    IF iv_start_date > iv_end_date.
      " Swap dates if start is after end
      DATA(lv_temp_date) = iv_start_date.
      lv_start_date = iv_end_date.
      iv_end_date = lv_temp_date.
    ENDIF.

    lv_current_date = iv_start_date.
    WHILE lv_current_date <= iv_end_date.
      lv_weekday = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      " 1 = Monday, ..., 5 = Friday, 6 = Saturday, 7 = Sunday
      IF lv_weekday >= 1 AND lv_weekday <= 5.
        rv_workdays = rv_workdays + 1.
      ENDIF.
      lv_current_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_days( iv_date = lv_current_date, iv_days = 1 ).
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '5 workdays expected' act = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_start_date = '20251201' iv_end_date = '20251205' ) exp = 5 ).
    " 2025-12-01 (Mon) to 2025-12-07 (Sun) -> 5 workdays
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '5 workdays expected (including weekend)' act = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_start_date = '20251201' iv_end_date = '20251207' ) exp = 5 ).
    " 2025-12-08 (Mon) to 2025-12-12 (Fri) -> 5 workdays

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_weekend_only.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_workday_calculator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '0 workdays expected for weekend' act = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_start_date = '20251206' iv_end_date = '20251207' ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_day.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_workday_calculator( ).
    " 2025-12-01 (Mon) -> 1 workday
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '1 workday expected for Monday' act = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_start_date = '20251201' iv_end_date = '20251201' ) exp = 1 ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_workday_calculator( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = '5 workdays expected after date swap' act = lo_cut->calculate_workdays( iv_start_date = '20251205' iv_end_date = '20251201' ) exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Klasse `CL_ABAP_DATE_HELPER` (oder `CL_ABAP_TSTMP`) bietet moderne und robuste Methoden für Datumsberechnungen und die Ermittlung von Wochentagen. Dies ist der bevorzugte Weg gegenüber manuellen Datumsarithmetiken. Die Verwendung von `WHILE` und `DATA()` für Inline-Deklarationen ist ebenfalls Teil des modernen ABAP-Stils.

Instructions: Lesen Sie dynamisch den Wert eines Feldes aus einer Struktur, dessen Name zur Laufzeit bekannt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie Field-Symbols und die `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS get_field_value_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        is_data     TYPE ty_data
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value_dynamic.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE is_data TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_field_value = |{ <fs_field> }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_field_value = |Field '{ iv_field_name }' not found.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

             field3 TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data.

    METHODS test_non_existing_field FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_different_types FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_existing_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 field3 = '20251209' ).

    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value of FIELD1 should be Hello' act = lv_value exp = 'Hello' ).

    lv_value = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Value of FIELD2 should be 123' act = lv_value exp = '123' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_non_existing_field.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'Test' ).

    DATA(lv_value) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'NON_EXISTENT_FIELD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should indicate field not found' act = lv_value exp = 'Field ''NON_EXISTENT_FIELD'' not found.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_different_types.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_reader( ).
    DATA(ls_test_data) = VALUE ty_data( field1 = 'Dynamic' field2 = 456 field3 = '20240115' ).

    DATA(lv_value_str) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'String field value' act = lv_value_str exp = 'Dynamic' ).

    DATA(lv_value_int) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Integer field value' act = lv_value_int exp = '456' ).

    DATA(lv_value_date) = lo_cut->get_field_value_dynamic( is_data = ls_test_data iv_field_name = 'FIELD3' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Date field value' act = lv_value_date exp = '20240115' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamische Programmierung mit Field-Symbols und `ASSIGN COMPONENT` ist ein mächtiges Feature in ABAP, um zur Laufzeit auf Strukturkomponenten zuzugreifen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in generischen Routinen oder bei der Verarbeitung von Daten, deren Struktur erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Verwendung von String-Templates zur Formatierung des Ergebnisses ist eine moderne Ergänzung.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, Field-Symbols, ASSIGN COMPONENT, runtime, structure

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (Carrier ID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `GROUP BY` und `VALUE`.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count_by_carrid,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count_by_carrid.
    TYPES tt_flight_count_by_carrid TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count_by_carrid WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrid
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count_by_carrid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrid.
    rt_grouped_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF ls_sflight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid
                                 ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Status-Code einen beschreibenden Text zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator.
hint: Der `COND`-Operator ist eine moderne Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-Anweisungen oder `CASE`-Anweisungen für einfache bedingte Zuweisungen.

CLASS zcl_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_status_description
      IMPORTING
        iv_status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_description) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_status_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_status_description.
    rv_description = COND string(
                       WHEN iv_status_code = 'A' THEN 'Aktiv'
                       WHEN iv_status_code = 'I' THEN 'Inaktiv'
                       WHEN iv_status_code = 'P' THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
                       ELSE 'Unbekannter Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die eindeutigen Fluggesellschaften (Carrier ID) aus einer gegebenen Flugtabelle (`sflights`) enthält, sortiert nach der Carrier ID.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `DISTINCT` und `SORTED BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_carriers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_unique_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_unique_carrier.
    TYPES tt_unique_carrier TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_unique_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_sorted_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_carriers) TYPE tt_unique_carrier.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_carriers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_sorted_carriers.
    rt_unique_carriers = VALUE #( FOR DISTINCT carrid IN it_sflights SORTED BY carrid
                                 ( carrid = carrid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die dynamische Anpassung einer Liste von Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einer GUI-Eigenschaft, die die maximale Anzahl anzuzeigender Zeilen steuert.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_props_consumer` und den `SELECT ... UP TO` sowie den `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_reduced,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_reduced.
    TYPES tt_sflight_reduced TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_reduced WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_sflights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE tt_sflight_reduced.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_dynamic_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_sflights.
    DATA(lo_props_consumer) = NEW cl_gui_props_consumer( ).
    DATA(lv_max_rows_str) = lo_props_consumer->get_property_value( iv_property_name = 'MAX_FLIGHT_ROWS' ).
    DATA(lv_max_rows) = CONV i( lv_max_rows_str DEFAULT '5' ). " Default to 5 if property not set or invalid

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_sflights)
      UP TO @lv_max_rows ROWS.

    rt_sflights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_all_sflights ( <fs_sflight> ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_list FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_list.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_dynamic_list( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_sflights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_less_equal( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 5 msg = 'Sollte standardmäßig maximal 5 Zeilen zurückgeben' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Sollte einige Flüge zurückgeben' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Lösung verwendet `DATA()` für die Inline-Deklaration und `CONV` für die Typkonvertierung mit einem Standardwert. Der `SELECT ... UP TO @lv_max_rows ROWS` ist eine moderne Art, die Anzahl der gelesenen Zeilen zu begrenzen. Der `VALUE` Operator mit `FOR` ist eine kompakte Art, eine interne Tabelle zu füllen.
keywords: GUI, Dynamic, sflight, SELECT UP TO, CONV, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flugdaten (`sflights`) basierend auf einer GUI-Eigenschaft, die die bevorzugte Sprache für Textfelder (z.B. Beschreibungen, die hier simuliert werden) angibt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_gui_props_consumer` und den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_lang_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_lang,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             description TYPE string, " Simulated language-dependent description
             language TYPE sy-langu,
           END OF ty_sflight_lang.
    TYPES tt_sflight_lang TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_lang WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_gui_language
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_lang.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_lang_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_gui_language.
    DATA(lo_props_consumer) = NEW cl_gui_props_consumer( ).
    DATA(lv_gui_language) = lo_props_consumer->get_property_value( iv_property_name = 'LANGUAGE' ).
    IF lv_gui_language IS INITIAL.
      lv_gui_language = sy-langu. " Fallback to system language
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_lang(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' description = 'Flight to New York' language = 'E' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' description = 'Flug nach New York' language = 'D' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' description = 'Flight to London' language = 'E' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250102' description = 'Flug nach London' language = 'D' )
    ).

    rt_flights = FILTER #( lt_all_flights WHERE language = lv_gui_language ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_by_gui_language FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_by_gui_language.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gui_lang_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_by_gui_language( ).

    IF sy-langu = 'D'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 deutsche Flüge zurückgeben' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-description exp = 'Flug nach New York' ).
    ELSEIF sy-langu = 'E'.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2 msg = 'Sollte 2 englische Flüge zurückgeben' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-description exp = 'Flight to New York' ).
    ELSE.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights msg = 'Sollte einige Flüge zurückgeben' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator bietet eine sehr prägnante Syntax zum Filtern interner Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen. Hier wird er verwendet, um Flugdaten nach der vom GUI gemeldeten Sprache zu filtern, was die Datenaufbereitung vereinfacht.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen String in Großbuchstaben, wobei die sprachspezifischen Regeln der aktuellen System-Sprache berücksichtigt werden.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` mit einem Cursor und geben Sie die Flugnummern zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cur_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_all_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE ty_flight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_flight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

CLASS zcl_cur_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_flight TYPE ty_flight.
    DATA: lv_where_clause TYPE string.

    lv_where_clause = |carrid = '{ iv_carrier }'|.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflights
        WHERE (lv_where_clause).

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_flight.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND ls_flight TO rt_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_package_size DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight.

CLASS zcl_cur_package_size IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_flights.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_all_flights.
      CLEAR lt_package. " Clear package table for next fetch
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

hint: Kombinieren Sie `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife über die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cur_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_with_for_loop RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cur_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_for_loop.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_flights.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE 100.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      " Process package directly with FOR loop
      rt_flights = VALUE #( BASE rt_flights ( FOR ls_flight IN lt_package ( ls_flight ) ) ).
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen Zufallszahlen zwischen 1 und 10.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` in einer Schleife und prüfen Sie auf Duplikate oder mischen Sie eine Liste.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_unique_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_unique_random_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
        iv_min   TYPE i DEFAULT 1
        iv_max   TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE tt_numbers.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_unique_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_random_numbers.
    IF iv_count > ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ).
      " Cannot generate more unique numbers than available range
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lt_pool) = VALUE tt_numbers( FOR i = iv_min TO iv_max ( i ) ).
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random=>create( ). " General random for shuffling

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_pool_size) = lines( lt_pool ).
      IF lv_pool_size = 0.
        EXIT. " No more unique numbers to pick
      ENDIF.
      DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 1 max = lv_pool_size ).
      DATA(lv_index) = lo_random_index->get_next( ).

      APPEND lt_pool[ lv_index ] TO rt_unique_numbers.
      DELETE lt_pool INDEX lv_index.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_unique_random_numbers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_unique_random_numbers_fail FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_random_numbers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_unique_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 5 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 ).
    DATA(lt_unique_check) = lt_numbers.
    SORT lt_unique_check ASCENDING.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_unique_check.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = lines( lt_unique_check ) ).
    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_num).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_num GE 1 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_num LE 10 ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_unique_random_numbers_fail.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_unique_numbers( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->get_unique_random_numbers( iv_count = 10 iv_min = 1 iv_max = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_numbers ) exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie ein zufälliges Passwort fester Länge, bestehend aus Großbuchstaben und Ziffern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rnd_password DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_random_password
      IMPORTING
        iv_length TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_password) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rnd_password IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_random_password.
    CONSTANTS: lc_chars TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    DATA(lv_char_count) = strlen( lc_chars ).
    DATA(lo_random_index) = cl_abap_random_int=>create( min = 0 max = lv_char_count - 1 ).

    rv_password = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE i <= iv_length
      NEXT s = s && lc_chars+lo_random_index->get_next( )(1) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_generate_random_password FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_generate_random_password.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rnd_password( ).
    DATA(lv_password) = lo_cut->generate_random_password( 12 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = strlen( lv_password ) exp = 12 ).
    DATA(lv_is_valid) = abap_true.
    DATA(lc_allowed_chars) TYPE string VALUE 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'.
    LOOP AT lv_password INTO DATA(lc_char).
      IF NOT ( lc_allowed_chars CS lc_char ).
        lv_is_valid = abap_false.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_is_valid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen CSV-String mit Kopfzeile in eine interne Tabelle unter Verwendung von `CL_ICF_CSV`. Die interne Tabelle soll die Felder `CARRID`, `CONNID` und `FLDATE` enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ICF_CSV=>CREATE_FROM_STRING` und die Methode `PARSE` mit der Option für eine Kopfzeile.
solution:
CLASS zcl_csv_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_csv_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_csv_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflight_data) TYPE tt_sflight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_csv_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_csv_string.
    DATA: lo_csv_parser TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv,
          lt_csv_table  TYPE cl_icf_csv=>tt_csv_table.

    TRY.
        lo_csv_parser = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_string( iv_csv_string ).
        lo_csv_parser->parse( IMPORTING et_csv_table = lt_csv_table ).

        LOOP AT lt_csv_table ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_row>).
          IF sy-tabix = 1. " Skip header row
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.

          DATA(ls_sflight_data) = VALUE ty_sflight_data(
            carrid = <fs_row>[1]
            connid = <fs_row>[2]
            fldate = <fs_row>[3]
          ).
          APPEND ls_sflight_data TO rt_sflight_data.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        " Fehlerbehandlung, z.B. Loggen oder Exception weiterleiten
        MESSAGE lx_root->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP GET Request an eine öffentliche API (z.B. 'https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1') durch und geben Sie den empfangenen JSON-Response zurück. Behandeln Sie mögliche Fehler.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT=>CREATE_BY_URL`, `SEND`, `RECEIVE` und `GET_CDATA` für den Response-Body. Nutzen Sie `TRY...CATCH` für die Fehlerbehandlung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_get_client DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_json_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json_response) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_get_client IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_json_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            argument_not_found = 1
            plugin_not_active  = 2
            internal_error     = 3
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Client creation failed'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Send failed'.
        ENDIF.

        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            http_communication_failure = 1
            http_invalid_state         = 2
            http_processing_error      = 3
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Receive failed'.
        ENDIF.

        rv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error cx_http_communication_error cx_http_sys_error INTO DATA(lx_http_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_http_error->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          cl_http_client=>release( lo_http_client ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_json_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_json_failure FOR TESTING.

    DATA(lo_client) = NEW zcl_http_get_client( ).

    TRY.

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_response exp = '"id": 1' ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_json_failure.

    DATA(lv_response) = ''_.

Die Erstellung des Clients über `CREATE_BY_URL` und die Methoden `SEND` und `RECEIVE` sind die Kernschritte. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` und spezifischen HTTP-Exceptions (`cx_http_communication_error`, `cx_http_dest_state_error`, `cx_http_sys_error`) sowie `cx_root` für allgemeine Fehler ist entscheidend für robuste Anwendungen, die mit externen Systemen kommunizieren. `SHTTP` ist die zugrundeliegende Technologie für diese HTTP-Kommunikation.

           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS post_csv_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_url          TYPE string
        it_sflight_data TYPE tt_sflight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_response_text) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_csv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD post_csv_data.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_csv_payload TYPE string,
          lo_csv_generator TYPE REF TO cl_icf_csv.

    TRY.
        " 1. CSV-Payload generieren
        lo_csv_generator = cl_icf_csv=>create_from_table( it_sflight_data ).
        lv_csv_payload = lo_csv_generator->get_string( i_add_header = abap_true ).

        " 2. HTTP Client erstellen
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            url                = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            client             = lo_http_client
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS             = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Client creation failed'.
        ENDIF.

        " 3. Request konfigurieren (POST, Content-Type, Body)
        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_request_method_post ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_header_field( name = 'Content-Type' value = 'text/csv' ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_csv_payload ).

        " 4. Request senden
        lo_http_client->send(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Send failed'.
        ENDIF.

        " 5. Response empfangen
        lo_http_client->receive(
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS                     = 4
        ).
        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = 'HTTP Receive failed'.
        ENDIF.

        rv_response_text = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " WHEN OTHERS für alle anderen Exceptions
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = lx_root->get_text( ).
    FINALLY.
        IF lo_http_client IS BOUND.
          cl_http_client=>release( lo_http_client ).
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie eine robuste Fehlerbehandlung mit `TRY...CATCH` und `WHEN OTHERS` für unerwartete Ausnahmen. Die Methode soll eine Division durch Null simulieren und die Ausnahme abfangen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith) WHEN OTHERS INTO DATA(lx_root)`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arithmetic_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Arithmetischer Fehler: { lx_arithmetic_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " WHEN OTHERS
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check
          EXPORTING
            text = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_division_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_other_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = 0.

    TRY.
        lv_result = lo_handler->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_static->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.

    TRY.
        lo_handler->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static).
        lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lx_static->get_text( ) exp = 'Arithmetischer Fehler' ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exception_caught exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_other_error.
    " Simulieren eines anderen Fehlers ist hier schwierig ohne Mocking.
    " Der Test prüft, ob der WHEN OTHERS-Block prinzipiell existiert und eine cx_root fängt.
    " Für diesen Test wird angenommen, dass der CATCH cx_root-Block korrekt funktioniert.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_error_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_exception_caught) = abap_false.

    TRY.
        " Hier könnte man eine Methode aufrufen, die eine andere cx_root-Exception auslöst.
        " Für die Demonstration reicht es, den Pfad zu zeigen.
        " Beispiel: Eine Methode, die versucht, auf ein nicht-existierendes Objekt zuzugreifen.
        " Da dies nicht direkt in divide_numbers simuliert werden kann, ist dieser Test eher konzeptionell.
        " Für einen echten Test müsste man die Abhängigkeiten mocken oder eine andere Methode testen.
        lo_handler->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 1 ). " Sollte keine Exception werfen
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static).
        " Wenn hier eine Exception gefangen wird, die nicht cx_sy_arithmetic_error ist,
        " dann wurde sie vom WHEN OTHERS-Block gefangen.
        IF lx_static->get_text( ) CP 'Unerwarteter Fehler*'.
          lv_exception_caught = abap_true.
        ENDIF.
    ENDTRY.

    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exception_caught exp = abap_false ). " Sollte false sein, da kein anderer Fehler simuliert wurde
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` mit spezifischen Ausnahmen wie `cx_sy_arithmetic_error` und einem generischen `CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root)` (was dem `WHEN OTHERS` in älteren Syntaxen entspricht) ist der moderne Standard für die Fehlerbehandlung. Dies ermöglicht es, spezifische Fehler gezielt zu behandeln und alle anderen unerwarteten Fehler generisch abzufangen, um die Anwendung stabil zu halten. Die Ausnahmeobjekte bieten detaillierte Informationen über den Fehler.
keywords: WHEN OTHERS, TRY CATCH, Exceptions, Error Handling, cx_root

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Die Methode soll einen String verketten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object) EXPORTING ... RECEIVING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA: lo_object TYPE REF TO object,
          lv_result TYPE string.

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_object TYPE (iv_class_name).

        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF lo_object
          EXPORTING
            iv_input = iv_input_string
          RECEIVING
            rv_output = lv_result.

        rv_result = lv_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_create_object_error INTO DATA(lx_create_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Fehler beim Erstellen des Objekts: { lx_create_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_call_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Fehler beim dynamischen Aufruf: { lx_call_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check EXPORTING text = |Unerwarteter Fehler: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Hilfsklasse für den dynamischen Aufruf
CLASS zcl_helper_concat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_helper_concat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_string.
    rv_output = iv_input && ' - Concatenated!'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es erlaubt, den Namen der aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Frameworks oder bei der Implementierung von Plugins. Die Fehlerbehandlung mit spezifischen Ausnahmen wie `cx_sy_create_object_error` und `cx_sy_dyn_call_error` ist hier unerlässlich.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der `PRICE`-Spalte einer internen Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`sflights`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit `INIT` für den Akkumulator und `NEXT` für die Iteration.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Er ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit expliziten Akkumulatoren. `INIT` setzt den Startwert, und `NEXT` definiert die Logik für jede Iteration.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation, sflights

CLASS zcl_data_initializer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Absolutwert einer Zahl und runden Sie eine Dezimalzahl auf die nächste ganze Zahl. Verwenden Sie moderne ABAP-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ABS` für den Absolutwert und `CEIL`, `FLOOR` oder `TRUNC` für das Runden, je nach gewünschtem Verhalten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_absolute_and_round
      IMPORTING
        iv_number_int TYPE i
        iv_number_dec TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_results) TYPE STRUCTURE  " Anonymous structure for return
          BEGIN OF ty_math_results,
            absolute_value TYPE i,
            rounded_value  TYPE i,
          END OF ty_math_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_absolute_and_round.
    rs_results-absolute_value = ABS( iv_number_int ).
    rs_results-rounded_value  = ROUND( val = iv_number_dec dec = 0 mode = cl_abap_math=>round_half_up ). " Modern rounding
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_math_ops FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_math_ops_negative FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_math_ops_rounding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_math_ops.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(ls_results) = lo_math->calculate_absolute_and_round( iv_number_int = 5 iv_number_dec = '5.4' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-absolute_value exp = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-rounded_value exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_math_ops_negative.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(ls_results) = lo_math->calculate_absolute_and_round( iv_number_int = -10 iv_number_dec = '-10.6' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-absolute_value exp = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results-rounded_value exp = -11 ). " ROUND_HALF_UP rundet -10.6 auf -11
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_math_ops_rounding.
    DATA(lo_math) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(ls_results_up) = lo_math->calculate_absolute_and_round( iv_number_int = 0 iv_number_dec = '5.5' ).
    DATA(ls_results_down) = lo_math->calculate_absolute_and_round( iv_number_int = 0 iv_number_dec = '5.49' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results_up-rounded_value exp = 6 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_results_down-rounded_value exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne ABAP-Funktionen wie `ABS` und `ROUND` (mit `cl_abap_math=>round_half_up` für präzise Rundungsmodi) bieten eine klare und effiziente Möglichkeit, mathematische Operationen durchzuführen. Die Verwendung von `decfloat34` für Dezimalzahlen ist ebenfalls eine moderne Empfehlung, um Rundungsfehler zu minimieren. Die Rückgabe einer anonymen Struktur ist eine kompakte Art, mehrere Ergebnisse zurückzugeben.
keywords: Math, ABS, ROUND, DECFLOAT34, cl_abap_math

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`CARRID`) und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `COUNT` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    LOOP AT it_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(ls_carrier_count) = VALUE ty_carrier_count(
        carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ).
      APPEND ls_carrier_count TO rt_carrier_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_by_carrier FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_by_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by_carrier.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251209' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251210' price = '250.50' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251211' price = '150.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20251212' price = '200.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0020' fldate = '20251213' price = '300.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_it_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-flight_count exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[3]-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_by_empty_table.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight( ).

    DATA(lo_grouper) = NEW zcl_it_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_grouper->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax ist ein sehr mächtiges und modernes Feature für die Aggregation und Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Es ersetzt komplexe `SORT`- und `AT NEW`/`AT END OF`-Konstrukte durch eine einzige, lesbare Anweisung. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe, was die Aggregation weiter vereinfacht.
keywords: Grouping, Internal Tables, LOOP AT GROUP BY, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die basierend auf einem Eingabewert (`i_value`) einen Status (`'HIGH'`, `'MEDIUM'`, `'LOW'`) zurückgibt. Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Operator.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle Flüge der Fluggesellschaft 'LH' (Lufthansa) aus der internen Tabelle `sflights_tab` und geben Sie die Flugnummern aus. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne Schleifenkonstrukte.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... INTO` mit einer `WHERE`-Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_lufthansa_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight-connid WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_lufthansa_flights.
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      APPEND ls_flight-connid TO rt_connids.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_filter_lufthansa FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_lufthansa.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_flight_filter=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->filter_lufthansa_flights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result[ 1 ]-table_line = '0400' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE ...` ist eine moderne und lesbare Art, interne Tabellen zu iterieren und gleichzeitig zu filtern. `DATA(ls_flight)` deklariert die Arbeitszeile implizit.
keywords: LOOP AT, WHERE, Internal Table, FETCH NEXT

Instructions: Fügen Sie einen neuen Flugdatensatz in eine interne Tabelle vom Typ `sflights` ein. Nutzen Sie dabei den `VALUE`-Operator für die Initialisierung des Datensatzes.

CLASS zcl_flight_insert DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

    METHODS add_new_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflight-connid
        iv_fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate
        iv_price    TYPE sflight-price
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_flight_insert IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_new_flight.
    INSERT VALUE #( carrid = iv_carrid
                    connid = iv_connid
                    fldate = iv_fldate
                    price = iv_price
                    currency = iv_currency ) INTO TABLE ct_sflights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Der `VALUE`-Operator ermöglicht die kompakte Initialisierung von Strukturen und internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `INSERT ... INTO TABLE` wird das Hinzufügen neuer Zeilen sehr prägnant und lesbar.

solution:
CLASS zcl_db_cursor_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.

      IMPORTING

      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.

CLASS zcl_db_cursor_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package TYPE tt_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
        FROM sflights.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      " Hier könnte die Verarbeitung des Pakets lt_package erfolgen
      APPEND LINES OF lt_package TO rt_all_flights.
      CLEAR lt_package.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
