Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Preise aller Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer internen Tabelle. Nutzen Sie dabei den `REDUCE`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Expression, um die Summe zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE sflight-price( ) )
                                FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).

    DATA(lv_total_aa) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_carrid = 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_lh exp = '250' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_aa exp = '200' ).

    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_filter_operator( ).
    DATA(lt_eur_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_currency( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_currency = 'EUR' ).
    DATA(lt_usd_flights) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_currency( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_currency = 'USD' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_eur_flights ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_eur_flights[ 1 ]-currency exp = 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_usd_flights ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_usd_flights[ 1 ]-currency exp = 'USD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator bietet eine deklarative und sehr effiziente Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf Bedingungen zu filtern und eine neue Tabelle mit den gefilterten Zeilen zu erstellen. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE` mit `APPEND` und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Performance.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Table, Conditional Logic, FETCH NEXT

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Nutzen Sie dabei `FOR ... IN GROUP`.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_group_by_flights IMPLEMENTATION.

                                  GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge enthält, deren Flugnummern mit '0' beginnen. Nutzen Sie dabei eine `FOR`-Expression mit einem String-Vergleich.

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flugdatensätze in die Datenbanktabelle `sflights` ein, aber nur, wenn der Datensatz noch nicht existiert (Vermeidung von Duplikaten). Nutzen Sie dabei `INSERT ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` und prüfen Sie den `sy-subrc`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` und werten Sie `sy-subrc` aus.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_no_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS insert_unique_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_new_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_no_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_unique_flights.
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @it_new_flights ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_insert_unique_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_unique_flights.
    DATA: lt_initial_flights TYPE zcl_insert_no_duplicates=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_initial_flights.
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @lt_initial_flights.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA: lt_new_flights TYPE zcl_insert_no_duplicates=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0001' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_new_flights. " Duplicate
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'XX' connid = '0002' fldate = '20250102' price = '200' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_new_flights. " New

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_no_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lv_inserted) = lo_cut->insert_unique_flights( lt_new_flights ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_inserted exp = 1 ). " Only one new record should be inserted

    DATA: lv_count TYPE i.
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_count WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count exp = 2 ). " Total records should be 2

    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XX'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INSERT ... ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS` ist eine sehr nützliche Erweiterung für das Einfügen von Daten in Datenbanktabellen, wenn Sie Duplikate auf Primärschlüsselebene ignorieren möchten, anstatt einen Laufzeitfehler zu erhalten. `sy-dbcnt` gibt dabei die Anzahl der tatsächlich eingefügten Zeilen zurück, was eine präzise Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: INSERT, ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS, Database Table, Duplicate Handling

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle nach einem bestimmten Feld sortieren und dann die ersten N Einträge 'fetchen'. Nutzen Sie dabei `SORT` und `FOR ... UP TO`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SORT` gefolgt von einer `FOR`-Expression mit `UP TO n ROWS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sort_fetch_topn DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_top_n_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_n        TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_top_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sort_fetch_topn IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_n_expensive_flights.
    DATA(lt_sorted_flights) = it_sflights.
    SORT lt_sorted_flights BY price DESCENDING.

    rt_top_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sorted_flights UP TO iv_n ROWS
                               ( ls_flight ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_top_n_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_top_n_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE zcl_sort_fetch_topn=>tt_sflight.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '500' currency = 'USD' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150' currency = 'EUR' ) TO lt_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE #( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0100' fldate = '20250103' price = '300' currency = 'GBP' ) TO lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sort_fetch_topn( ).
    DATA(lt_top_2) = lo_cut->get_top_n_expensive_flights( it_sflights = lt_sflights iv_n = 2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_top_2 ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_top_2[ 1 ]-price exp = '500' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_top_2[ 2 ]-price exp = '300' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `SORT` und einer `FOR`-Expression mit `UP TO n ROWS` ist eine elegante und effiziente Methode, um die 'Top N' Einträge aus einer internen Tabelle zu extrahieren. Dies simuliert das 'FETCH NEXT' für eine begrenzte Anzahl von Zeilen nach einer Sortierung und ist eine moderne Alternative zu manuellen Schleifen mit Zählern.
keywords: SORT, FOR, UP TO, Internal Table, Top N, FETCH NEXT

Instructions: Wähle Daten aus der Tabelle `sflights` und mappe sie automatisch in eine interne Tabelle, deren Feldnamen teilweise von den Datenbankfeldnamen abweichen.

CLASS zcl_select_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid_key TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid_num TYPE s_conn_id,

                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_select_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights.
    SELECT carrid AS carrid_key, connid AS connid_num, fldate AS fldate_val, cityfrom AS cityfrom_txt, cityto AS cityto_txt
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_select_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_flights ).

Dies reduziert manuellen Zuweisungsaufwand und macht den Code lesbarer.

Instructions: Kopiere Daten von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur, wobei nur Felder mit identischen Namen übertragen werden sollen.

CLASS zcl_move_corr_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Erstelle eine neue interne Tabelle aus einer bestehenden, wobei nur bestimmte Felder übernommen und umbenannt werden sollen, unter Verwendung des `VALUE` Operators und `CORRESPONDING`.

solution:
CLASS zcl_value_corr_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_source,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_source,
           BEGIN OF ty_flight_target,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             ticket_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_target.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_source WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_flight_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights IMPORTING it_source TYPE tt_sflight_source
                              RETURNING VALUE(rt_target) TYPE tt_flight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_value_corr_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_target = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_source IN it_source
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_source MAPPING carrid = airline_id connid = flight_num fldate = flight_date price = ticket_price ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_value_corr_itab=>tt_sflight_source(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251209' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251210' price = '250.50' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-ticket_price exp = '100.00' ).

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die einen String in Kleinbuchstaben umwandelt und eine weitere, die den ersten Buchstaben großschreibt. Nutze funktionale Methodenaufrufe, um diese Operationen zu verketten.
hint: Methoden, die einen Wert zurückgeben, können direkt in Ausdrücken verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_utils DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS to_lower IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS capitalize_first IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS process_string IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_processed_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_utils IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD to_lower.
    rv_text = to_lower( iv_text ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD capitalize_first.
    IF iv_text IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_text = |{ to_upper( iv_text(1) ) }{ iv_text+1 }|.
    ELSE.
      rv_text = iv_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_string.
    rv_processed_text = capitalize_first( to_lower( iv_text ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_string.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_string_utils( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_string( 'hELLo wORLd' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello world' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->process_string( 'single' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Single' ).

    lv_result = lo_cut->process_string( '' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Funktionale Methodenaufrufe ermöglichen es, den Rückgabewert einer Methode direkt als Eingabe für eine andere Methode zu verwenden, was den Code kompakter und lesbarer macht. Dies fördert einen funktionalen Programmierstil.
keywords: METHOD, Functional Call, String Processing, Chaining, Object Orientation

Instructions: Filtere Flüge aus `sflights` basierend auf einer Fluggesellschaft und transformiere die Ergebnisse in eine neue interne Tabelle, wobei nur relevante Felder mit `FOR` und `CORRESPONDING` übernommen werden.
hint: Kombiniere `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` mit `CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_corr_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             cityfrom TYPE s_city,
             cityto TYPE s_city,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw,
           BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             airline TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_number TYPE s_conn_id,
             departure_city TYPE s_city,
             arrival_city TYPE s_city,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_summary IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_corr_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights_db TYPE tt_sflight_raw.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto, planetype
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_db.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( 
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_db WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( CORRESPONDING #( ls_flight MAPPING carrid = airline connid = flight_number cityfrom = departure_city cityto = arrival_city ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_filtered_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_filtered_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_corr_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->get_filtered_summary( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).
    LOOP AT lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_entry).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_entry-airline exp = 'AA' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_entry-flight_number ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_entry-departure_city ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lt_summary = lo_cut->get_filtered_summary( 'XX' ). " Nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_summary ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `CORRESPONDING` innerhalb des `VALUE` Operators bietet eine deklarative und leistungsstarke Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern und gleichzeitig in eine neue Struktur zu transformieren. Dies ist eine sehr effiziente und moderne Syntax.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, CORRESPONDING, VALUE, Internal Table, Filter, Transformation, Method

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere und den Gesamtumsatz für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` und speichere das Ergebnis in einer Struktur.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator mit `CORRESPONDING` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_corr_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             paymentsum TYPE s_price,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight_data,
           BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrier_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_revenue TYPE s_price,
             total_passengers TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                                    RETURNING VALUE(rs_summary) TYPE ty_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_corr_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    DATA lt_sflights_db TYPE tt_sflight_data.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, paymentsum, seatsocc
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_db.

    rs_summary = REDUCE ty_carrier_summary(
      INIT r = VALUE ty_carrier_summary( carrier_id = iv_carrid )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights_db
      NEXT r = CORRESPONDING ty_carrier_summary( r MAPPING
                                                    total_revenue = total_revenue + ls_flight-paymentsum
                                                    total_passengers = total_passengers + ls_flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_carrier_summary FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_carrier_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_corr_agg( ).
    DATA(ls_summary) = lo_cut->get_carrier_summary( 'AA' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-carrier_id exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_summary-total_revenue ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_summary-total_passengers ).

    ls_summary = lo_cut->get_carrier_summary( 'XX' ). " Nicht existierende Fluggesellschaft
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary-carrier_id exp = 'XX' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_summary-total_revenue ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_summary-total_passengers ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht komplexe Aggregationen in einer einzigen Anweisung. In Kombination mit `CORRESPONDING` kann man die Ergebnisse direkt in eine Zielstruktur mappen und dabei Berechnungen durchführen. Dies ist eine sehr ausdrucksstarke und moderne Syntax für Datenaggregation.
keywords: REDUCE, CORRESPONDING, Aggregation, Internal Table, Math, Method

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse mit Methoden, die jeweils eine String-Operation durchführen (z.B. Trimmen, Ersetzen, Großschreiben) und den modifizierten String zurückgeben. Demonstriere die Verkettung dieser Methoden.
hint: Methoden, die `ME` zurückgeben, ermöglichen das Chaining.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fluent_string DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_initial_string TYPE string.
    METHODS trim RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_string.
    METHODS replace_char IMPORTING iv_old TYPE c LENGTH 1 iv_new TYPE c LENGTH 1 RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_string.
    METHODS to_upper RETURNING VALUE(ro_self) TYPE REF TO zcl_fluent_string.
    METHODS get_result RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_string TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fluent_string IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_string = iv_initial_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trim.
    CONDENSE mv_string.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_char.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF iv_old IN mv_string WITH iv_new.
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD to_upper.
    mv_string = to_upper( mv_string ).
    ro_self = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_result.
    rv_result = mv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fluent_string FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fluent_string.
    DATA(lo_fluent_string) = NEW zcl_fluent_string( '  hello world  ' ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_fluent_string->trim( )->replace_char( iv_old = 'o' iv_new = '0' )->to_upper( )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'HELL0 W0RLD' ).

    lv_result = NEW zcl_fluent_string( '  test  ' )->trim( )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'test' ).

    lv_result = NEW zcl_fluent_string( 'abc' )->to_upper( )->get_result( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ABC' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch das Zurückgeben einer Referenz auf die eigene Instanz (`ME`) in jeder Methode kann man Methodenaufrufe verketten (Fluent Interface), was den Code flüssiger und oft lesbarer macht. Dies ist ein gängiges Designmuster in der objektorientierten Programmierung.
keywords: METHOD, Chaining, Fluent Interface, Object Orientation, String Processing

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine Nachricht formatiert. Die Methode soll optionale Parameter für Präfix und Suffix haben.
hint: Verwende `OPTIONAL` in der Methodendefinition.
solution:
CLASS zcl_message_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string
                                     iv_prefix  TYPE string OPTIONAL
                                     iv_suffix  TYPE string OPTIONAL
                           RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_message_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_message.
    rv_formatted_message = iv_message.
    IF iv_prefix IS SUPPLIED.
      rv_formatted_message = |{ iv_prefix }{ rv_formatted_message }|.
    ENDIF.
    IF iv_suffix IS SUPPLIED.
      rv_formatted_message = |{ rv_formatted_message }{ iv_suffix }|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_message FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_message.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_message_formatter( ).

    " Nur Nachricht
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->format_message( iv_message = 'Test' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = 'Test' ).

    " Nachricht mit Präfix
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->format_message( iv_message = 'Test' iv_prefix = 'PRE: ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = 'PRE: Test' ).

    " Nachricht mit Suffix
    DATA(lv_result3) = lo_cut->format_message( iv_message = 'Test' iv_suffix = ' :SUF' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result3 exp = 'Test :SUF' ).

    " Nachricht mit Präfix und Suffix
    DATA(lv_result4) = lo_cut->format_message( iv_message = 'Test' iv_prefix = 'PRE: ' iv_suffix = ' :SUF' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result4 exp = 'PRE: Test :SUF' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `OPTIONAL` Zusatz in der Methodendefinition erlaubt es, Parameter wegzulassen. Innerhalb der Methode kann mit `IS SUPPLIED` geprüft werden, ob ein optionaler Parameter übergeben wurde, was die Flexibilität der Methode erhöht und die Anzahl der benötigten Überladungen reduziert.
keywords: METHOD, OPTIONAL, IS SUPPLIED, Parameters, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die eine Division durchführt und eine Ausnahme auslöst, wenn der Divisor Null ist. Fange diese Ausnahme im Unit Test ab.
hint: Verwende `RAISING` in der Methodendefinition und `TRY ... CATCH` beim Aufruf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_math_operations DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide IMPORTING iv_dividend TYPE i
                             iv_divisor  TYPE i
                   RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE f
                   RAISING   cx_sy_zerodivide.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_math_operations IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    IF iv_divisor = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDIF.
    rv_result = iv_dividend / iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_divide_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_divide_by_zero RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_divide_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_math_operations( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->divide( iv_dividend = 10 iv_divisor = 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE exception' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE exception caught as expected' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `RAISING` in der Methodendefinition deklariert, welche Ausnahmen eine Methode auslösen kann. Dies verbessert die Code-Qualität, da Aufrufer gezwungen sind, diese Ausnahmen zu behandeln (`TRY ... CATCH`), was zu robusteren Anwendungen führt.
keywords: METHOD, RAISING, Exception Handling, TRY CATCH, Object Orientation

Instructions: Erstelle eine Klasse mit einer statischen Methode, die zwei Zahlen addiert. Rufe diese Methode direkt über den Klassennamen auf.
hint: Verwende `CLASS-METHODS` für statische Methoden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS add IMPORTING iv_num1 TYPE i
                                iv_num2 TYPE i
                      RETURNING VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add.
    rv_sum = iv_num1 + iv_num2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add.
    DATA(lv_result) = zcl_calculator=>add( iv_num1 = 5 iv_num2 = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 8 ).

    lv_result = zcl_calculator=>add( iv_num1 = -10 iv_num2 = 20 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 10 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Statische Methoden (`CLASS-METHODS`) können direkt über den Klassennamen aufgerufen werden, ohne dass eine Instanz der Klasse erstellt werden muss. Sie eignen sich hervorragend für Utility-Funktionen oder Operationen, die keinen Zugriff auf Instanzattribute benötigen.
keywords: CLASS-METHODS, Static Method, Object Orientation, Utility, Method

Instructions: Kopiere eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten in eine andere, wobei nur Felder mit identischen Namen übernommen werden sollen. Die Quelltabelle enthält zusätzliche Felder, die in der Zieltabelle nicht benötigt werden.
hint: Verwende `MOVE-CORRESPONDING` mit `TABLES`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_move_corr_itabs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_full,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
           END OF ty_sflight_full,
           BEGIN OF ty_sflight_basic,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_basic.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_full TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_full WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_sflight_basic TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_basic WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS copy_basic_data IMPORTING it_full TYPE tt_sflight_full
                               RETURNING VALUE(rt_basic) TYPE tt_sflight_basic.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_move_corr_itabs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD copy_basic_data.
    MOVE-CORRESPONDING it_full TO rt_basic.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_copy_basic_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_copy_basic_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_move_corr_itabs( ).
    DATA(lt_full) = VALUE zcl_move_corr_itabs=>tt_sflight_full(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251209' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = '747' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251210' price = '250.50' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A380' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_basic) = lo_cut->copy_basic_data( lt_full ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_basic ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_basic[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_basic[ 1 ]-price exp = '100.00' ).
    " Überprüfen, ob nicht-korrespondierende Felder nicht kopiert wurden (implizit durch Typdefinition)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_basic[ 1 ]-fldate ). " fldate ist hier ein Beispiel, da es in beiden ist, aber currency/planetype nicht in lt_basic existieren
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `MOVE-CORRESPONDING TABLES` ist eine effiziente Möglichkeit, Daten zwischen internen Tabellen zu kopieren, wobei nur Felder mit identischen Namen übertragen werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um eine Teilmenge von Daten aus einer größeren Tabelle zu extrahieren oder Daten für eine spezifische Verarbeitung vorzubereiten.
keywords: MOVE-CORRESPONDING, TABLES, Internal Table, Data Transfer, Mapping, Method

Instructions: Erstelle eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle aus der `sflights`-Tabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen füllt. Nutze `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE` mit einem dynamisch erzeugten Feldkatalog.
hint: Verwende `cl_abap_structdescr=>create` und `cl_abap_tabledescr=>create` für dynamische Typen und `INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_field_names TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF fieldname WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_dynamic_flights IMPORTING it_field_names TYPE tt_field_names
                                  RETURNING VALUE(ro_data) TYPE REF TO data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_flights.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_data> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    DATA: lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          ls_component  TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table_line,
          lo_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lo_table_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.

    LOOP AT it_field_names INTO DATA(lv_field_name).
      ls_component-name = lv_field_name.
      " Annahme: Alle Felder sind vom Typ STRING für Einfachheit. In realen Szenarien müsste der Typ dynamisch ermittelt werden.
      ls_component-type = cl_abap_elemdescr=>get_string( ).
      APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        lo_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
        lo_table_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( lo_struct_descr ).
        CREATE DATA ro_data TYPE HANDLE lo_table_descr.
        ASSIGN ro_data->* TO <lt_data>.

        DATA(lv_fields_string) = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = '' FOR field IN it_field_names NEXT s = COND #( s IS INITIAL THEN field ELSE s && ',' && field ) ).

        IF <lt_data> IS ASSIGNED.
          SELECT (lv_fields_string) FROM sflights INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE <lt_data>.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_abap_typedescr_error.
        " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_dynamic_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_dynamic_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_select( ).
    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE zcl_dynamic_select=>tt_field_names( ( 'CARRID' ) ( 'CONNID' ) ( 'FLDATE' ) ).
    DATA(lo_data) = lo_cut->get_dynamic_flights( lt_field_names ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lt_dynamic_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lo_data->* TO <lt_dynamic_table>.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lt_dynamic_table> ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lines( <lt_dynamic_table> ) ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <ls_dynamic_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <lt_dynamic_table> INDEX 1 ASSIGNING <ls_dynamic_line>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <ls_dynamic_line> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <lv_carrid> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <ls_dynamic_line> TO <lv_carrid>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( <lv_carrid> ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung dynamischer interner Tabellen zur Laufzeit und deren Befüllung mittels `SELECT ... INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE`. Dies ist eine fortgeschrittene Technik für flexible Datenzugriffe, bei denen die Struktur der Zieltabelle erst zur Laufzeit bekannt ist. Die Kombination mit `REDUCE` für die Feldliste ist ein modernes ABAP-Feature.
keywords: Dynamic Programming, RTTI, SELECT, INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Method, Data

Instructions: Füge neue Einträge in eine interne Tabelle ein, indem du Daten aus einer Quelltabelle verwendest und dabei nur korrespondierende Felder übernimmst. Die Zieltabelle soll dabei bereits bestehende Einträge behalten.
hint: Nutze `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ... CORRESPONDING FIELDS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_insert_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_source_flight,
           BEGIN OF ty_target_flight,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price TYPE s_price,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_target_flight.
    TYPES: tt_source_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_flight WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_target_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_flights IMPORTING it_new_flights TYPE tt_source_flight
                                 CHANGING ct_existing_flights TYPE tt_target_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_insert_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flights.
    INSERT LINES OF it_new_flights INTO TABLE ct_existing_flights CORRESPONDING FIELDS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_insert_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_existing) = VALUE zcl_insert_corr_fields=>tt_target_flight(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' price = '150.00' seatsocc = 100 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_new) = VALUE zcl_insert_corr_fields=>tt_source_flight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251209' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '0200' fldate = '20251215' price = '300.00' currency = 'GBP' )
    ).

    lo_cut->add_flights( EXPORTING it_new_flights = lt_new CHANGING ct_existing_flights = lt_existing ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_existing ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing[ 2 ]-price exp = '100.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_existing[ 2 ]-seatsocc ). " seatsocc sollte initial sein, da es nicht in der Quelltabelle ist
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `INSERT LINES OF ... INTO TABLE ... CORRESPONDING FIELDS` ermöglicht das Einfügen von Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle, wobei nur Felder mit übereinstimmenden Namen übertragen werden. Dies ist eine flexible Methode, um Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen in eine konsolidierte Tabelle zu integrieren, ohne manuell Felder zuordnen zu müssen.
keywords: INSERT, CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Internal Table, Data Transfer, Method

Instructions: Aktualisiere bestehende Einträge in einer internen Tabelle mit Daten aus einer Quelltabelle, wobei nur korrespondierende Felder aktualisiert werden. Die Aktualisierung soll basierend auf einem Schlüssel erfolgen.

solution:
CLASS zcl_update_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_update,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,

Instructions: Filtern Sie Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`) nach einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft und geben Sie die Flugnummern aus.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... WHERE ...` mit Inline-Deklaration.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      APPEND ls_sflight-connid TO rt_flight_numbers.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (Tabelle `sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Gesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` für moderne Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ts_carrier_flight_count,
        carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
      END OF ts_carrier_flight_count,
      tt_carrier_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_group IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight) GROUP BY ls_sflight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #(
        carrid      = ls_sflight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_flight_counts.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_by FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_by.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_at_group( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_counts_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Result should not be empty'
    ).

    " Check for a specific carrier, e.g., LH
    DATA(lv_lh_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      lv_lh_count = ls_entry-flight_count.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_lh_count
      exp = 10 " Assuming 10 flights for LH in SFLIGHTS for a basic test
    ).
    " Check for another carrier, e.g., AZ
    DATA(lv_az_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO ls_entry WHERE carrid = 'AZ'.
      lv_az_count = ls_entry-flight_count.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_az_count
      exp = 10 " Assuming 10 flights for AZ in SFLIGHTS for a basic test
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert direkt die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe. `VALUE #(...)` ist ein Konstruktorausdruck für die Erstellung neuer Strukturen.
keywords: LOOP AT, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, GROUP SIZE, VALUE #

Instructions: Kodieren Sie einen String für die Verwendung in einer URL, um Sonderzeichen sicher zu übertragen.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_url_encode FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_url_encode.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_url_encode( ).

    " Test case 1: String with spaces and special characters
    DATA(lv_raw1) = 'Hello World! This is a test with special chars: & = ?'.
    DATA(lv_expected1) = 'Hello%20World%21%20This%20is%20a%20test%20with%20special%20chars%3A%20%26%20%3D%20%3F'.
    DATA(lv_encoded1) = lo_cut->encode_url_string( lv_raw1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_encoded1
      exp = lv_expected1
      msg = 'Test case 1 failed: spaces and special chars'
    ).

    " Test case 2: Empty string
    DATA(lv_raw2) = ''.
    DATA(lv_expected2) = ''.
    DATA(lv_encoded2) = lo_cut->encode_url_string( lv_raw2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_encoded2
      exp = lv_expected2
      msg = 'Test case 2 failed: empty string'
    ).

    " Test case 3: String with percent sign (should be encoded)
    DATA(lv_raw3) = 'percent%sign'.
    DATA(lv_expected3) = 'percent%25sign'.
    DATA(lv_encoded3) = lo_cut->encode_url_string( lv_raw3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = lv_expected3
      msg = 'Test case 3 failed: percent sign encoding'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Methode `cl_http_utility=>url_encode` ist die Standardmethode in ABAP, um Strings gemäß RFC 3986 (Uniform Resource Identifier (URI): Generic Syntax) für die Verwendung in URLs zu kodieren. Dies stellt sicher, dass Sonderzeichen korrekt übertragen werden und nicht als Teil der URL-Struktur interpretiert werden.
keywords: cl_http_utility, URL, Encoding, String Processing, HTTP

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle mit Flugnummern von `sflights`, die nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft enthalten, unter Verwendung eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `VALUE` für eine funktionale Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_filtered_flight_connids
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_connids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flight_connids.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_connids = VALUE string_table(
                   FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                   ( ls_sflight-connid )
                 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_expression( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flight_connids( 'AA' ). " American Airlines

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result

    ).
    " Check if a known flight connection ID for AA exists in the result

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus `sflights` unter Verwendung eines `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` für eine kompakte Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_total_passengers_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i(
                            INIT sum = 0
                            FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                            NEXT sum = sum + ls_sflight-seatsocc
                          ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    " Test case 1: LH flights
    DATA(lv_total_lh) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers_by_carrier( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_total_lh
      exp = 1000 " Assuming 10 flights * 100 seatsocc each for LH in SFLIGHTS for a basic test
    ).

    " Test case 2: Non-existent carrier
    DATA(lv_total_xx) = lo_cut->get_total_passengers_by_carrier( 'XX' ).

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Aggregationen und Transformationen von internen Tabellen. Er ersetzt eine explizite `LOOP AT`-Schleife mit einer Akkumulator-Variable und macht den Code deutlich kompakter und funktionaler.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming, INIT, NEXT

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine interne Tabelle (`sflights`) und erhöhen Sie die Anzahl der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um einen gegebenen Wert.
hint: `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <field_symbol>` ermöglicht die direkte Bearbeitung von Tabellenzeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_assigning DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS update_seats_occupied
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_increase TYPE i
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_assigning IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_seats_occupied.
    LOOP AT ct_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>) WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.
      <fs_sflight>-seatsocc = <fs_sflight>-seatsocc + iv_increase.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_seats FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_seats.
    DATA: lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    " Prepare test data
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' seatsocc = 150 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 200 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_at_assigning( ).
    lo_cut->update_seats_occupied(
      EXPORTING
        iv_carrid   = 'LH'
        iv_increase = 10
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights = lt_test_flights
    ).

    " Verify changes for LH flights
    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh1) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_flight_lh1-seatsocc
      exp = 110
      msg = 'LH 0400 seatsocc should be 110'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh2) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_flight_lh2-seatsocc
      exp = 160
      msg = 'LH 0401 seatsocc should be 160'
    ).

    " Verify no changes for AA flights
    READ TABLE lt_test_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_flight_aa-seatsocc
      exp = 200
      msg = 'AA 0017 seatsocc should remain 200'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>)` ist die performanteste Methode, um interne Tabellen zu durchlaufen und deren Zeilen direkt zu modifizieren. Der Feldsymbol `<fs_sflight>` zeigt direkt auf die aktuelle Zeile im Speicher, wodurch keine unnötigen Datenkopien entstehen.
keywords: LOOP AT, ASSIGNING, Field Symbols, Internal Tables, Modification

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über Flugdaten (`sflights`) und ermitteln Sie für jeden Flug, ob er in der Vergangenheit liegt, unter Verwendung moderner Datumsfunktionen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT` und vergleichen Sie das Flugdatum mit dem aktuellen Datum (`sy-datum`).
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_past_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ts_flight_status,
        carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate      TYPE s_date,
        is_in_past  TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ts_flight_status,
      tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_past_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_past_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_past_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND VALUE #(
        carrid     = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid     = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate     = ls_sflight-fldate
        is_in_past = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_sflight-fldate < sy-datum THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
      ) TO rt_flight_statuses.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_past_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_past_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_past_check( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->check_past_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Result should not be empty'
    ).

    " Check that all statuses are valid based on the logic
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_status).
      IF ls_status-fldate < sy-datum.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
          act = ls_status-is_in_past
          msg = |Flight { ls_status-carrid } { ls_status-connid } on { ls_status-fldate } should be in past|
        ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
          act = ls_status-is_in_past
          msg = |Flight { ls_status-carrid } { ls_status-connid } on { ls_status-fldate } should not be in past|
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT`-Schleife wird hier verwendet, um jede Zeile der Flugtabelle zu verarbeiten. Die moderne `COND`-Expression ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung des `is_in_past`-Status, basierend auf dem Vergleich des Flugdatums mit dem aktuellen Systemdatum (`sy-datum`).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus `sflights` die Fluggesellschaft, Flugnummer und einen Status ('Full', 'Almost Full', 'Available') basierend auf der Auslastung (`seatsocc` vs `seatsmax`) enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie einen `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `COND` für die bedingte Statuszuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_for_cond_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ts_flight_summary,
        carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
        status      TYPE string,
      END OF ts_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_status_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_for_cond_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_status_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #(
                   FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                   (
                     carrid = ls_sflight-carrid,
                     connid = ls_sflight-connid,
                     status = COND string(
                                WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc = ls_sflight-seatsmax THEN 'Full'
                                WHEN ls_sflight-seatsocc >= ls_sflight-seatsmax * 0.8 THEN 'Almost Full'
                                ELSE 'Available'
                              )
                   )
                 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`) für jede Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung der Control-Break-Verarbeitung mit `LOOP AT ... AT END OF`.
hint: Sortieren Sie die Tabelle zuerst nach der Gruppierungskriterium und nutzen Sie dann `AT END OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_at_at_end DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ts_carrier_seats,
        carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
        total_seats TYPE i,
      END OF ts_carrier_seats,
      tt_carrier_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ts_carrier_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_seats_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_seats) TYPE tt_carrier_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_at_at_end IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_seats_by_carrier.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid. " Essential for AT END OF

    DATA(lv_current_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.
    DATA(lv_sum_seats) TYPE i.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      AT NEW carrid.
        lv_current_carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
        lv_sum_seats = 0.
      ENDAT.

      lv_sum_seats = lv_sum_seats + ls_sflight-seatsocc.

      AT END OF carrid.
        APPEND VALUE #(
          carrid      = lv_current_carrid
          total_seats = lv_sum_seats
        ) TO rt_carrier_seats.
      ENDAT.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_at_end_of FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_at_end_of.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_loop_at_at_end( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_total_seats_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lt_result
      msg = 'Result should not be empty'
    ).

    " Check for a specific carrier, e.g., LH
    DATA(lv_lh_total_seats) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_entry) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
      lv_lh_total_seats = ls_entry-total_seats.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_lh_total_seats
      exp = 1000 " Assuming 10 flights * 100 seatsocc each for LH in SFLIGHTS for a basic test
    ).

    " Check for another carrier, e.g., AA
    DATA(lv_aa_total_seats) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_result INTO ls_entry WHERE carrid = 'AA'.
      lv_aa_total_seats = ls_entry-total_seats.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_aa_total_seats
      exp = 1000 " Assuming 10 flights * 100 seatsocc each for AA in SFLIGHTS for a basic test
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Control-Break-Verarbeitung mit `LOOP AT ... AT NEW/END OF` ist eine klassische, aber immer noch gültige und effiziente Methode zur Gruppierung und Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Es erfordert eine vorherige Sortierung der Tabelle nach den Gruppierungskriterien.
keywords: LOOP AT, AT NEW, AT END OF, Control Break, Grouping, Internal Tables, SORT

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen eines bestimmten Carriers und einer bestimmten Connection ID, die noch freie Plätze haben. Geben Sie eine neue Tabelle mit den Flugnummern und verfügbaren Plätzen zurück.

CLASS zcl_flights_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seats_free TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_info.

    METHODS get_available_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE ty_flight_info_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flights_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_flights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                           WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid AND seatsocc < seatsmax )
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                             connid = flight-connid,
                             fldate = flight-fldate,
                             seats_free = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entwickeln Sie ein abstraktes Framework für die Berechnung von Preisen, das verschiedene Rabattstrategien unterstützt. Implementieren Sie eine konkrete Strategie für einen festen Rabatt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS` und `ABSTRACT METHOD` für die Basisstrategie und `REDEFINE` in der konkreten Implementierung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_discount_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate_discount
    IMPORTING
      iv_price TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDINTERFACE.

ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_discount_strategy_base DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_discount_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_discount_strategy_base IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fixed_discount_strategy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_discount_strategy_base CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_fixed_amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
    METHODS zif_discount_strategy~calculate_discount REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_fixed_amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fixed_discount_strategy IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_fixed_amount = iv_fixed_amount.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_discount_strategy~calculate_discount.
    rv_discounted_price = iv_price - mv_fixed_amount.
    IF rv_discounted_price < 0.
      rv_discounted_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fixed_discount.
    DATA(lo_fixed_discount) = NEW zcl_fixed_discount_strategy( iv_fixed_amount = '10.00' ).
    DATA(lv_price) = '100.00'.
    DATA(lv_discounted_price) = lo_fixed_discount->zif_discount_strategy~calculate_discount( lv_price ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_discounted_price exp = '90.00' ).

    lv_price = '5.00'.

Dies ist ein Kernprinzip des Strategie-Design-Patterns, das Flexibilität und Erweiterbarkeit fördert, indem Algorithmen zur Laufzeit ausgetauscht werden können. Die Implementierung erfolgt über `REDEFINE`.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise für einen bestimmten Carrier aus der Tabelle `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = ( VALUE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2 )0
                                FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein Factory-Muster für die Erstellung verschiedener Logger-Typen (z.B. Console-Logger, File-Logger) unter Verwendung einer abstrakten Basisklasse für Logger.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `ABSTRACT CLASS` als Basis für Logger und eine separate Factory-Klasse mit einer Methode, die konkrete Logger-Instanzen zurückgibt.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_logger PUBLIC.
  METHODS log IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_logger_base DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_logger.

ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_logger_base IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_logger_base CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_logger_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_logger_type,
             console TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'CONSOLE',
             file    TYPE c LENGTH 10 VALUE 'FILE',
           END OF ty_logger_type.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_logger_type,
                 console TYPE ty_logger_type-console VALUE 'CONSOLE',
                 file    TYPE ty_logger_type-file    VALUE 'FILE',
               END OF gc_logger_type.

    CLASS-METHODS create_logger
      IMPORTING
        iv_logger_type TYPE ty_logger_type-console
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_logger) TYPE REF TO zif_logger.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_logger.
    CASE iv_logger_type.
      WHEN gc_logger_type-console.
        ro_logger = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Fallback or error handling
        ro_logger = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = zcl_logger_factory=>create_logger( zcl_logger_factory=>gc_logger_type-console ).
    " Since WRITE is used, direct assertion on output is difficult.
    " We assert that the object is created and can be called.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_logger ).
    lo_logger->log( 'Test message for console logger' ).
    " In a real test, you might redirect WRITE output or use a test double for the logger.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Factory-Muster, kombiniert mit einer `ABSTRACT CLASS` als Basis für die Logger, ermöglicht die Entkopplung der Objekterzeugung von der Verwendung. Die Factory-Methode `create_logger` entscheidet, welche konkrete Logger-Implementierung instanziiert wird, während der Client nur mit der abstrakten Schnittstelle `zif_logger` interagiert. Dies fördert Flexibilität und erleichtert das Hinzufügen neuer Logger-Typen, ohne bestehenden Client-Code ändern zu müssen.
keywords: ABSTRACT, CLASS, Factory Pattern, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Interface

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` nach Carrier und zählen Sie, wie viele Flüge jeder Carrier anbietet.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einem `REDUCE`-Ausdruck für die Zählung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flight_count,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_flight_count.
    TYPES: ty_carrier_flight_count_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_flight_count_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights
                           GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid )
                           ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                             flight_count = REDUCE i( INIT c = 0 FOR member IN GROUP NEXT c = c + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anstatt manuelle Schleifen und Hash-Tabellen zu verwenden, wird die Gruppierung deklarativ beschrieben, was den Code kürzer, lesbarer und weniger fehleranfällig macht.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine Liste von Flügen und weisen Sie jedem Flug einen Status ('On Time', 'Delayed', 'Unknown') basierend auf dem Flugdatum zu. Flüge vor dem heutigen Datum sind 'Delayed', andere 'On Time'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND`-Ausdruck innerhalb einer `LOOP`-Schleife für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES: ty_flight_status_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE ty_flight_status_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                    connid = flight-connid,
                                    fldate = flight-fldate,
                                    status = COND string( WHEN flight-fldate < sy-datum THEN 'Delayed'
                                                         WHEN flight-fldate = sy-datum THEN 'On Time Today'
                                                         WHEN flight-fldate > sy-datum THEN 'On Time Future'
                                                         ELSE 'Unknown' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_statuses FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_statuses.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_checker( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flight_statuses( ).

    " Assuming some test data for sflights
    " In a real scenario, you'd mock the SELECT or insert into a test table.
    " For this example, let's check if the result is not initial.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Adjust based on test data

    " Example with dummy data (requires mocking DB or test table)
    DATA lt_sflights_dummy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum - 1 ) TO lt_sflights_dummy.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum ) TO lt_sflights_dummy.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = sy-datum + 1 ) TO lt_sflights_dummy.

    " If we could mock the DB, the assertion would be:
    " DATA(ls_flight_delayed) = lt_result[ KEY connid = '0400' ].
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_delayed-status exp = 'Delayed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `COND`-Ausdruck ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Anstatt eine `IF`-`ELSE IF`-Struktur zu verwenden, kann der Wert basierend auf verschiedenen Bedingungen in einer einzigen Zeile bestimmt werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich in Kombination mit `FOR`-Ausdrücken zur Transformation von Tabellen.
keywords: LOOP, COND, Conditional Logic, sflights, VALUE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummer und den Preis von Flügen enthält, deren Preis einen bestimmten Mindestwert überschreitet.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `WHERE` und `VALUE` für die Strukturierung der neuen Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_projection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES: ty_flight_summary_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_expensive_flight_summaries
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE ty_flight_summary_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_projection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expensive_flight_summaries.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_summaries = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                            WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                            ( connid = flight-connid,
                              price = flight-price ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_expensive_flight_summaries( iv_min_price = '300.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Adjust based on test data

    DATA lt_sflights_dummy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' price = '450.00' ) TO lt_sflights_dummy.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' price = '250.00' ) TO lt_sflights_dummy.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' price = '500.00' ) TO lt_sflights_dummy.

    " If we could mock the DB, the assertion would be:
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-connid exp = '0400' ).
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-connid exp = '0017' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieser Ansatz nutzt den `FOR`-Ausdruck in Kombination mit `VALUE` nicht nur zum Filtern, sondern auch zur Projektion von Daten. Es wird eine neue interne Tabelle erstellt, die nur die benötigten Felder enthält, was die Datenmenge reduziert und die Lesbarkeit des Codes erhöht. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP`-Schleifen mit `APPEND` und Feldzuweisungen.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategie-Muster, um verschiedene Versandkostenberechnungen zu ermöglichen. Definieren Sie eine abstrakte Basisklasse für Versandstrategien und konkrete Implementierungen für 'Standardversand' und 'Expressversand'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ABSTRACT CLASS` für die Basisstrategie und `REDEFINE` in den konkreten Strategien. Eine Kontextklasse kann die Strategie zur Laufzeit austauschen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_shipping_strategy PUBLIC.
  METHODS calculate_cost
    IMPORTING
      iv_weight TYPE p LENGTH 7 DECIMALS 2
    RETURNING
      VALUE(rv_shipping_cost) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDINTERFACE.

ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_shipping_strategy_base DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_shipping_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

ABSTRACT CLASS zcl_shipping_strategy_base IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_standard_shipping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_shipping_strategy_base CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_shipping_strategy~calculate_cost REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_standard_shipping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_shipping_strategy~calculate_cost.
    rv_shipping_cost = iv_weight * '5.00'. " 5 EUR per kg
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_express_shipping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL INHERITING FROM zcl_shipping_strategy_base CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS zif_shipping_strategy~calculate_cost REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_express_shipping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_shipping_strategy~calculate_cost.
    rv_shipping_cost = iv_weight * '15.00' + '10.00'. " 15 EUR per kg + 10 EUR base fee
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shipping_context DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_shipping_strategy.
    METHODS set_strategy IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_shipping_strategy.
    METHODS get_shipping_cost
      IMPORTING
        iv_weight TYPE p LENGTH 7 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cost) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_shipping_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_shipping_context IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_strategy.
    mo_strategy = io_strategy.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_shipping_cost.
    IF mo_strategy IS BOUND.
      rv_cost = mo_strategy->calculate_cost( iv_weight ).
    ELSE.
      rv_cost = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_shipping_strategies FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shipping_strategies.
    DATA(lv_weight) = '2.50'.

    " Test Standard Shipping
    DATA(lo_standard_strategy) = NEW zcl_standard_shipping( ).
    DATA(lo_context) = NEW zcl_shipping_context( lo_standard_strategy ).
    DATA(lv_cost_standard) = lo_context->get_shipping_cost( lv_weight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cost_standard exp = '12.50' ).

    " Test Express Shipping
    DATA(lo_express_strategy) = NEW zcl_express_shipping( ).
    lo_context->set_strategy( lo_express_strategy ).
    DATA(lv_cost_express) = lo_context->get_shipping_cost( lv_weight ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_cost_express exp = '47.50' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Strategie-Muster, implementiert mit einer `ABSTRACT CLASS` (`zcl_shipping_strategy_base`) und einer Schnittstelle (`zif_shipping_strategy`), ermöglicht es, Algorithmen (Versandkostenberechnungen) zur Laufzeit auszutauschen. Die Kontextklasse (`zcl_shipping_context`) hält eine Referenz auf die aktuelle Strategie und delegiert die Berechnung an diese. Dies fördert die Flexibilität und die Einhaltung des Open/Closed-Prinzips, da neue Strategien hinzugefügt werden können, ohne den Kontext ändern zu müssen.
keywords: ABSTRACT, CLASS, Strategy Pattern, Object Orientation, Design Patterns, Interface

Instructions: Wandeln Sie interne Flugstatuscodes (z.B. 'A' für Active, 'C' für Cancelled) in eine benutzerfreundliche Textbeschreibung um. Verwenden Sie eine Liste von Flügen und geben Sie eine neue Liste mit den Beschreibungen zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `SWITCH`-Ausdruck innerhalb einer `FOR`-Schleife für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_display,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             status_code TYPE sflight-status,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_display.
    TYPES: ty_flight_display_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_display WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flight_statuses
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_display_flights) TYPE ty_flight_display_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_mapper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flight_statuses.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_display_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                  ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                    connid = flight-connid,
                                    status_code = flight-status,
                                    status_text = SWITCH string( flight-status
                                                                WHEN 'A' THEN 'Active'
                                                                WHEN 'C' THEN 'Cancelled'
                                                                WHEN 'X' THEN 'Delayed'
                                                                ELSE 'Unknown Status' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_mapper( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->map_flight_statuses( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ). " Adjust based on test data

    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' status = 'A' ) TO lt_sflights_dummy.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' status = 'C' ) TO lt_sflights_dummy.
    APPEND VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' status = 'Z' ) TO lt_sflights_dummy.

    " If we could mock the DB, the assertion would be:
    " DATA(ls_flight_active) = lt_result[ KEY connid = '0400' ].
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_active-status_text exp = 'Active' ).
    " DATA(ls_flight_unknown) = lt_result[ KEY connid = '0017' ].
    " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_unknown-status_text exp = 'Unknown Status' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `SWITCH`-Ausdruck bietet eine moderne und sehr lesbare Alternative zu verschachtelten `IF`-`ELSE IF`-Anweisungen oder `CASE`-Strukturen, insbesondere wenn ein Wert basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen zugewiesen werden soll. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `VALUE` ermöglicht er eine effiziente Transformation von Tabellendaten.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die dynamisch eine interne Tabelle basierend auf einem übergebenen Feldnamen sortiert. Die Sortierreihenfolge (aufsteigend/absteigend) soll ebenfalls dynamisch sein.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SORT` mit dynamischen Feldnamen und Sortierrichtung.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_table_sorter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS sort_sflights_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE fieldname
        iv_descending TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      CHANGING
        ct_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
