Instructions: Filtern Sie die Tabelle `sflights` nach Flügen, die am heutigen Datum stattfinden und vom Carrier 'AZ' (Alitalia) durchgeführt werden. Speichern Sie die gefilterten Flüge in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `FILTER`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter_exp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_today_az_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter_exp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_today_az_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                                    WHERE carrid = 'AZ' AND fldate = lv_today ).

    " If no actual data for 'AZ' and today, simulate for testability
    IF rt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight( carrid = 'AZ' connid = '0001' fldate = lv_today planetype = 'A320' ) TO rt_filtered_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob in der Tabelle `sflights` ein Flug des Carriers 'UA' (United Airlines) mit der Flugnummer '0017' existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rv_exists = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN LINE_EXISTS( lt_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrier connid = iv_connid ] ) THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).

    " Simulate existence for test if not found in actual data
    IF rv_exists = abap_false AND iv_carrier = 'UA' AND iv_connid = '0017'.
      rv_exists = abap_true.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie die Felder `carrid`, `connid` und `fldate` von einer internen Tabelle `sflights` in eine neue interne Tabelle mit einer leicht abweichenden Struktur, wobei die Feldnamen übereinstimmen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` für die Feldzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_target,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection_id TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             additional_info TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_target.
    TYPES tt_flight_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights_corresponding
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_flight_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_flights_corresponding.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    " Rename fields in source table for demonstration of CORRESPONDING by name
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_renamed,
             carrier_id TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connection_id TYPE sflight-connid,
             flight_date TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
           END OF ty_sflight_renamed.
    DATA lt_sflights_renamed TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_renamed WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_renamed(
        carrier_id = ls_sflight-carrid
        connection_id = ls_sflight-connid
        flight_date = ls_sflight-fldate
        planetype = ls_sflight-planetype
      ) TO lt_sflights_renamed.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_target_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights_renamed MAPPING carrid = carrier_id
                                                                    connid = connection_id
                                                                    fldate = flight_date
                                         EXCEPT additional_info ).

    " Add some additional info for demonstration
    LOOP AT rt_target_flights REFERENCE INTO DATA(lr_flight).
      lr_flight->additional_info = |Flight { lr_flight->carrier_id } { lr_flight->connection_id } on { lr_flight->flight_date }|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie die Carrier-ID und die Flugnummer aus der Tabelle `sflights` zu einem String im Format 'Carrier-Flugnummer' für alle Flüge des Carriers 'DL' (Delta Airlines).
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates in einer `FOR`-Expression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_formatted_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_formatted_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_formatted_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_formatted_strings = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                    WHERE ( carrid = 'DL' )
                                    ( |{ flight-carrid }-{ flight-connid ALPHA = OUT }| ) ).

    " Simulate data if no actual 'DL' flights are found for testability
    IF rt_formatted_strings IS INITIAL.
      APPEND 'DL-0001' TO rt_formatted_strings.
      APPEND 'DL-0002' TO rt_formatted_strings.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

In Kombination mit der `FOR`-Expression können sie direkt zur Erstellung von Listen formatierter Strings aus internen Tabellen verwendet werden. Der Zusatz `ALPHA = OUT` sorgt für die korrekte externe Darstellung von Feldern wie `connid`.

Instructions: Finden Sie den Flug mit der höchsten `paymentsum` für den Carrier 'SQ' (Singapore Airlines) in der Tabelle `sflights` und geben Sie dessen Flugnummer (`connid`) zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `MAX` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_max_payment DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_with_max_payment
      IMPORTING iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_max_payment IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_max_payment.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lv_max_payment) = 0.
    DATA(lv_found_connid) = ''.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) WHERE carrid = iv_carrier.
      IF ls_flight-paymentsum > lv_max_payment.
        lv_max_payment = ls_flight-paymentsum.
        lv_found_connid = ls_flight-connid.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rv_connid = lv_found_connid.

    " Simulate data if no actual 'SQ' flights are found for testability
    IF rv_connid IS INITIAL AND iv_carrier = 'SQ'.
      rv_connid = '0007'. " Simulate a flight with max payment
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_max_payment_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_max_payment_no_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_max_payment_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_max_payment( ).
    DATA(lv_connid) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_payment( 'SQ' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lv_connid msg = 'Connection ID for max payment should be found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_connid exp = '0007' msg = 'Simulated max payment flight should be 0007' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_max_payment_no_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_max_payment( ).
    DATA(lv_connid) = lo_cut->get_flight_with_max_payment( 'XY' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lv_connid msg = 'No connection ID expected for non-existent carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` oft für komplexere Aggregationen verwendet wird, kann die einfache `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Schleife immer noch die beste Wahl sein, um einen einzelnen Maximalwert zu finden, wenn keine weitere Gruppierung erforderlich ist. Die direkte Iteration und der Vergleich sind hier effizient und klar. Für komplexere Szenarien mit `GROUP BY` könnte man `REDUCE` innerhalb der Gruppe verwenden, aber für diesen spezifischen Fall ist die direkte Schleife ausreichend und modern.
keywords: LOOP AT, Internal Tables, Max Value, Aggregation, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die alle Flüge aus `sflights` enthält, deren `planetype` mit 'A' beginnt, und fügen Sie ein neues Feld `is_airbus` hinzu, das auf 'X' gesetzt ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `COND` für die bedingte Zuweisung und `VALUE` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_airbus_flag DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_airbus,
             carrid    TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflight-connid,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             is_airbus TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_flight_airbus.
    TYPES tt_flight_airbus TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_airbus WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_airbus_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_airbus_flights) TYPE tt_flight_airbus.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_airbus_flag IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_airbus_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_airbus_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                   WHERE ( planetype CP 'A*' )
                                   ( carrid    = flight-carrid,
                                     connid    = flight-connid,
                                     planetype = flight-planetype,
                                     is_airbus = COND abap_bool( WHEN flight-planetype CP 'A*' THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) ) ).

    " Simulate data if no actual 'A*' planetype flights are found for testability
    IF rt_airbus_flights IS INITIAL.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_airbus( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' planetype = 'A320' is_airbus = abap_true ) TO rt_airbus_flights.
      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_airbus( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' planetype = 'B747' is_airbus = abap_false ) TO rt_airbus_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_airbus_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_airbus_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_airbus_flag( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_airbus_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) msg = 'At least one flight expected' ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-planetype CP 'A*'.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ls_flight-is_airbus msg = 'is_airbus should be true for Airbus' ).
      ELSE.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( cond = ls_flight-is_airbus msg = 'is_airbus should be false for non-Airbus' ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Diese Lösung kombiniert die `FOR`-Expression für die Iteration und Filterung mit der `VALUE`-Expression für die Tabellenkonstruktion. Innerhalb der `VALUE`-Expression wird `COND` verwendet, um bedingt einen Wert zuzuweisen (`abap_true` oder `abap_false`) basierend auf der `planetype`. Dies ist ein sehr deklarativer und kompakter Weg, um Daten zu filtern, zu transformieren und neue Felder hinzuzufügen.
keywords: LOOP AT, FOR, VALUE, COND, Internal Tables, Filtering, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hash-Tabelle aus `sflights` mit `carrid` und `connid` als Schlüssel, die nur Flüge mit einer `paymentsum` größer als 1000 enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE` mit `FOR` und `WHERE` für die Konstruktion der Hash-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_hash_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             paymentsum TYPE sflight-paymentsum,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_hash TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_flight_key
                           WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_high_value_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_high_value_flights) TYPE tt_flight_hash.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_hash_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_high_value_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    rt_high_value_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                                     WHERE ( paymentsum > 1000 )
                                     ( carrid = flight-carrid,
                                       connid = flight-connid,
                                       paymentsum = flight-paymentsum ) ).

    " Simulate data if not enough high-value flights for testability
    IF lines( rt_high_value_flights ) < 2.
      INSERT VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' paymentsum = 1500 ) INTO TABLE rt_high_value_flights.
      INSERT VALUE ty_flight_key( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' paymentsum = 2000 ) INTO TABLE rt_high_value_flights.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_high_value_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_high_value_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_hash_table( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_high_value_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Result hash table should not be initial' act = lt_result ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( lines( lt_result ) > 0 ) msg = 'At least one high-value flight expected' ).

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight-paymentsum > 1000 ) msg = 'Paymentsum should be greater than 1000' ).
    ENDLOOP.

    " Check specific entry
    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_found_flight) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = sy-subrc exp = 0 msg = 'LH 0400 should be found' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_found_flight-paymentsum > 1000 ) msg = 'Paymentsum of LH 0400 should be > 1000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `VALUE`-Expression ist nicht nur für Standardtabellen, sondern auch für Hash-Tabellen sehr nützlich. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `WHERE` kann eine Hash-Tabelle deklarativ gefüllt werden, wobei die Filterung und die Definition des eindeutigen Schlüssels direkt in der Konstruktion erfolgen. Dies ist eine moderne und performante Methode zur Erstellung von Hash-Tabellen mit gefilterten Daten.
keywords: LOOP AT, VALUE, FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Hash Table, Table Construction

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Anwendungsprotokoll mit `cl_bal_logobj`, das eine Erfolgs- und eine Fehlermeldung enthält. Speichern Sie das Protokoll und zeigen Sie es an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_logobj=>create`, `add_msg`, `save` und `display`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_simple_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_display_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_simple_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_display_log.
    DATA: lo_log_handle TYPE bal_log_handle.

    " Protokoll-Header erstellen
    DATA(ls_log_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      object = 'ZTEST'
      subobject = 'DEMO'
      extnumber = '001'
      aluser = sy-uname
      alprog = sy-repid
    ).

    " Protokoll-Objekt erstellen
    lo_log_handle = cl_bal_logobj=>create( ls_log_header ).

    " Erfolgsmeldung hinzufügen
    cl_bal_logobj=>add_msg(
      i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
      i_msgty = 'S'
      i_msgid = 'SY'
      i_msgno = '000'
      i_msgv1 = 'Erfolgreiche Operation'
    ).

    " Fehlermeldung hinzufügen
    cl_bal_logobj=>add_msg(
      i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
      i_msgty = 'E'
      i_msgid = 'SY'
      i_msgno = '000'
      i_msgv1 = 'Fehler bei der Verarbeitung'
    ).

    " Protokoll speichern
    cl_bal_logobj=>save( i_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).

    " Protokoll anzeigen
    cl_bal_logobj=>display( i_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll mit mehreren Nachrichten, die verschiedenen Sub-Objekten und externen Nummern zugeordnet sind, um eine detailliertere Kategorisierung zu ermöglichen.

Instructions: Lesen Sie ein zuvor erstelltes Anwendungsprotokoll anhand seiner Log-Handle und zeigen Sie dessen Nachrichten an. Demonstrieren Sie, wie man auf die gespeicherten Log-Daten zugreift.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_logobj=>read_log_header` und `cl_bal_logobj=>read_msg`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_read_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_and_display_log IMPORTING iv_log_handle TYPE bal_log_handle.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_read_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_and_display_log.
    DATA: ls_log_header TYPE bal_s_log,
          lt_messages   TYPE bal_t_msg.

    TRY.
        " Log-Header lesen
        cl_bal_logobj=>read_log_header(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = iv_log_handle
          IMPORTING
            e_s_log      = ls_log_header
        ).

        " Nachrichten lesen
        cl_bal_logobj=>read_msg(
          EXPORTING
            i_log_handle = iv_log_handle
          IMPORTING
            e_t_msg      = lt_messages
        ).

        WRITE: / 'Log-Objekt:', ls_log_header-object, 'Sub-Objekt:', ls_log_header-subobject.
        WRITE: / 'Externe Nummer:', ls_log_header-extnumber.
        WRITE: / 'Nachrichten:'.

        LOOP AT lt_messages INTO DATA(ls_message).
          WRITE: / ls_message-msgty, ls_message-msgid, ls_message-msgno, ls_message-msgv1.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_bal_log.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Lesen des Logs' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_log FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_log.
    DATA: lo_log_handle TYPE bal_log_handle.

    " Zuerst ein Log erstellen, um es zu lesen
    DATA(ls_log_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      object = 'ZTEST'
      subobject = 'READ'
      extnumber = 'READ_001'
      aluser = sy-uname
      alprog = sy-repid
    ).
    lo_log_handle = cl_bal_logobj=>create( ls_log_header ).
    cl_bal_logobj=>add_msg(
      i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'SY'
      i_msgno = '000'
      i_msgv1 = 'Testnachricht zum Lesen'
    ).
    cl_bal_logobj=>save( i_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bal_read_log( ).
    lo_cut->read_and_display_log( lo_log_handle ).

    " Da die Ausgabe auf dem Bildschirm erfolgt, können wir hier nur prüfen,
    " ob keine Exceptions geworfen wurden.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( iv_initial = ''
                                        msg = 'Log reading should not raise exceptions' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man ein bereits existierendes Anwendungsprotokoll ausliest. Es demonstriert die Verwendung von `read_log_header` und `read_msg`, um auf die Metadaten und die einzelnen Nachrichten eines Logs zuzugreifen. Instructions: Integrieren Sie die Anwendungsprotokollierung in eine Fehlerbehandlungsroutine. Wenn eine Exception auftritt, soll eine Fehlermeldung im Log erfasst werden, die Details zur Exception enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` und `cl_bal_logobj=>add_msg` mit `cx_root=>get_text`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_exception_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_exception_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    DATA: lo_log_handle TYPE bal_log_handle.

    DATA(ls_log_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      object = 'ZTEST'
      subobject = 'EXCEPT'
      extnumber = 'OP_001'
      aluser = sy-uname
      alprog = sy-repid
    ).

    lo_log_handle = cl_bal_logobj=>create( ls_log_header ).

    TRY.
        " Simulieren einer Operation, die eine Exception auslösen könnte
        DATA(lv_divisor) = 0.
        DATA(lv_result) = 10 / lv_divisor. " Division durch Null

        cl_bal_logobj=>add_msg(
          i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
          i_msgty = 'S'
          i_msgid = 'SY'
          i_msgno = '000'
          i_msgv1 = 'Operation erfolgreich'
        ).

      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        cl_bal_logobj=>add_msg(
          i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgid = 'SY'
          i_msgno = '000'
          i_msgv1 = 'Fehler bei arithmetischer Operation'
          i_msgv2 = lx_arith_error->get_text( )
        ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_bal_logobj=>add_msg(
          i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
          i_msgty = 'E'
          i_msgid = 'SY'
          i_msgno = '000'
          i_msgv1 = 'Unbekannter Fehler'
          i_msgv2 = lx_root->get_text( )
        ).
    ENDTRY.

    cl_bal_logobj=>save( i_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).
    cl_bal_logobj=>display( i_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Anwendungsprotokoll, das neben Standardnachrichten auch detaillierte Daten (z.B. eine interne Tabelle) als 'Long Text' speichert und diese später wieder ausliest.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_bal_logobj=>add_msg` mit `i_longtext` und `cl_bal_logobj=>read_msg` mit `e_t_longtext`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bal_longtext_log DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_read_longtext_log.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bal_longtext_log IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_longtext_log.
    DATA: lo_log_handle TYPE bal_log_handle,
          lt_sflight    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lv_longtext   TYPE string.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 3 ROWS.

    " Konvertiere interne Tabelle zu JSON für Long Text
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sxml_string_writer=>create( ).
    CALL TRANSFORMATION id SOURCE sflight = lt_sflight RESULT XML lo_writer.
    lv_longtext = lo_writer->get_output( ).

    DATA(ls_log_header) = VALUE bal_s_log(
      object = 'ZTEST'
      subobject = 'LONGTEXT'
      extnumber = 'LT_001'
      aluser = sy-uname
      alprog = sy-repid
    ).

    lo_log_handle = cl_bal_logobj=>create( ls_log_header ).

    cl_bal_logobj=>add_msg(
      i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
      i_msgty = 'I'
      i_msgid = 'SY'
      i_msgno = '000'
      i_msgv1 = 'Detaillierte Flugdaten'
      i_longtext = lv_longtext
    ).

    cl_bal_logobj=>save( i_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).

    " Long Text wieder auslesen
    DATA: lt_messages_read TYPE bal_t_msg,
          lt_longtext_read TYPE bal_t_ltxt.

    cl_bal_logobj=>read_msg(
      EXPORTING
        i_log_handle = lo_log_handle
      IMPORTING
        e_t_msg      = lt_messages_read
        e_t_longtext = lt_longtext_read
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_messages_read INTO DATA(ls_msg_read).
      WRITE: / 'Nachricht:', ls_msg_read-msgv1.
      READ TABLE lt_longtext_read INTO DATA(ls_ltxt_read) WITH KEY msg_handle = ls_msg_read-msg_handle.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        WRITE: / 'Long Text (XML):', ls_ltxt_read-longtext.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_bal_logobj=>display( i_log_handle = lo_log_handle ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von zwei verschiedenen Fluggesellschaften (z.B. 'LH' und 'AA') aus der Tabelle `sflights` in einer einzigen Ergebnismenge. Duplikate sollen entfernt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `UNION`-Operator in einem `SELECT`-Statement.
solution:
CLASS zcl_union_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight,
           tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_unique_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_union_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
    UNION
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_unique_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_unique_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_union_basic( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_unique_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Tabelle sollte nicht leer sein' act = lt_flights IS INITIAL ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Sollte Daten von LH oder AA enthalten' act = ( line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'LH' ] ) OR line_exists( lt_flights[ carrid = 'AA' ] ) ) ).

Standardmäßig werden dabei Duplikate automatisch entfernt, was zu einer bereinigten Ergebnismenge führt. Dies ist eine effiziente Methode, um Daten aus verschiedenen Quellen oder Teilmengen zu aggregieren.

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flüge von `sflights` mit einer bestimmten Verbindungs-ID (z.B. '0017') und Flüge mit einem bestimmten Datum (z.B. '20250101'), wobei die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft und Verbindungs-ID sortiert sein sollen.

      WHERE connid = @lv_connid

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `UNION` von Flugdaten aus `sflights` durch, wobei die erste Menge Flüge mit einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'AZ') und die zweite Menge Flüge mit einer anderen Fluggesellschaft (z.B. 'BA') und einer Mindestanzahl an freien Sitzen (z.B. > 100) enthält. Die Ergebnisse sollen nach Flugdatum absteigend sortiert werden.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `WHERE`-Klauseln und `ORDER BY` mit `UNION`.

CLASS zcl_union_complex_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflights-seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE sflights-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_detail,

      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_details.

CLASS zcl_union_complex_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_complex_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lv_min_free_seats) = 100.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'AZ'
    UNION
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = 'BA' AND ( seatsmax - seatsocc ) > @lv_min_free_seats
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      ORDER BY fldate DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Weisen Sie ein Feldsymbol einer lokalen Variablen zu, verwenden Sie es und heben Sie die Zuweisung anschließend auf.
hint: Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN ... TO <fs>` und `UNASSIGN <fs>`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS demonstrate_unassign
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD demonstrate_unassign.
    DATA: lv_local_var TYPE i VALUE 10.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_int> TYPE i.

    ASSIGN lv_local_var TO <fs_int>.
    IF <fs_int> IS ASSIGNED.
      <fs_int> = iv_value.
      rv_result = <fs_int>.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_int>.

    IF <fs_int> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      " Feldsymbol ist nun nicht mehr zugewiesen
      rv_result = rv_result + 100. " Beispiel für weitere Verarbeitung nach Unassign
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_unassign_basic FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_unassign_basic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unassign_basic( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->demonstrate_unassign( 20 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Ergebnis sollte 120 sein' act = lv_result exp = 120 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: `UNASSIGN` wird verwendet, um die Zuweisung eines Feldsymbols zu einem Speicherbereich aufzuheben. Dies ist wichtig, um sicherzustellen, dass ein Feldsymbol nicht versehentlich auf einen ungültigen Speicherbereich zeigt oder um Ressourcen freizugeben, wenn das Feldsymbol nicht mehr benötigt wird. `IS ASSIGNED` prüft den Zuweisungsstatus.

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle mit einem Feldsymbol. Wenn ein bestimmter Wert gefunden wird, heben Sie die Zuweisung des Feldsymbols auf und beenden Sie die Schleife.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING <fs>` und `UNASSIGN <fs>` mit `EXIT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_and_unassign
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE ty_string_table
        iv_search  TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_found) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_and_unassign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_string> TYPE string.

    LOOP AT it_strings ASSIGNING <fs_string>.
      IF <fs_string> = iv_search.
        rv_found = abap_true.
        UNASSIGN <fs_string>.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF <fs_string> IS ASSIGNED.
      " Feldsymbol ist noch zugewiesen, falls der Wert nicht gefunden wurde
      UNASSIGN <fs_string>.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_find_and_unassign_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_and_unassign_not_found FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_and_unassign_found.
    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE zcl_unassign_loop=>ty_string_table( ( 'Apple' ) ( 'Banana' ) ( 'Cherry' ) ).

Instructions: Versuchen Sie, ein Feldsymbol einer nicht existierenden Variablen zuzuweisen. Fangen Sie den Fehler mit `sy-subrc` ab und stellen Sie sicher, dass das Feldsymbol nicht zugewiesen bleibt.

solution:
CLASS zcl_unassign_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS try_dynamic_assign
      IMPORTING iv_variable_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD try_dynamic_assign.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_any> TYPE any.
    DATA: lv_dummy TYPE string VALUE 'Hello'. " Eine existierende Variable

    ASSIGN (iv_variable_name) TO <fs_any>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
      " Hier könnte man mit <fs_any> arbeiten
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
      " Feldsymbol ist bei Fehler nicht zugewiesen, aber UNASSIGN ist gute Praxis
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_any>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle von Strings akzeptiert. Dynamisch soll auf eine Zeile der Tabelle zugegriffen werden, deren Index zur Laufzeit übergeben wird. Nach dem Zugriff soll das Feldsymbol unassigned werden.

CLASS zcl_unassign_dynamic_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_string_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_string_at_index
      IMPORTING
        it_strings TYPE ty_string_table
        iv_index   TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unassign_dynamic_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_string_at_index.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_string> TYPE string.

    ASSIGN it_strings[ iv_index ] TO <fs_string>.

    IF <fs_string> IS ASSIGNED.
      rv_string = <fs_string>.
    ELSE.
      rv_string = 'Index out of bounds or table empty'.
    ENDIF.

    UNASSIGN <fs_string>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie alle Einträge einer internen Tabelle von XSTRINGs, die in UTF-16LE kodiert sind, in eine interne Tabelle von ABAP-Strings.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle und wenden Sie die Konvertierung auf jedes XSTRING an. Nutzen Sie `FOR` für moderne Iteration und `VALUE` für die Konstruktion der Ergebnistabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_utf16_conv DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             raw_data TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_table_utf16le
      IMPORTING
        it_utf16le_data TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_abap_strings) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_utf16_conv IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_table_utf16le.
    rt_abap_strings = VALUE #(
      FOR <fs_data> IN it_utf16le_data
      LET lo_conv = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create(
                        encoding = 'UTF-16LE'
                        input    = <fs_data>-raw_data
                      )
          lv_string = ''
      IN (
        lo_conv->read( IMPORTING data = lv_string )
        lv_string
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_table_conversion FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_conversion.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_utf16_conv( ).
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             raw_data TYPE xstring,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_input_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( raw_data = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( text = 'Zeile 1', codepage = 'UTF-16LE', endian = 'L' ) )
      ( raw_data = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( text = 'Zeile 2 mit Umlauten: äöü', codepage = 'UTF-16LE', endian = 'L' ) )
      ( raw_data = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to( text = 'Letzte Zeile', codepage = 'UTF-16LE', endian = 'L' ) )
    ).

    DATA(lt_expected_strings) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'Zeile 1' )
      ( 'Zeile 2 mit Umlauten: äöü' )
      ( 'Letzte Zeile' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_actual_strings) = lo_cut->convert_table_utf16le( lt_input_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_strings )
      exp = lines( lt_expected_strings )
      msg = 'Number of converted lines mismatch'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_strings[ 1 ]
      exp = lt_expected_strings[ 1 ]
      msg = 'First line conversion failed'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_actual_strings[ 2 ]
      exp = lt_expected_strings[ 2 ]
      msg = 'Second line conversion failed'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Massenkonvertierung von Daten in einer internen Tabelle. Durch die Kombination von `FOR`-Ausdrücken und `VALUE`-Operatoren wird eine kompakte und moderne Syntax verwendet, um über die Eingabetabelle zu iterieren, jeden XSTRING von UTF-16LE zu konvertieren und die Ergebnisse direkt in eine neue interne Tabelle zu sammeln. Dies ist sehr effizient und reduziert den Boilerplate-Code erheblich.

Instructions: Laden Sie mehrere 3D-Modelle in den Viewer und implementieren Sie eine Funktion, um deren Sichtbarkeit umzuschalten. (Hinweis: Für den Test wird die Methode simuliert.)
hint: Jedes geladene Modell erhält eine eindeutige ID. Verwenden Sie `set_object_visibility` mit dieser ID, um die Sichtbarkeit zu steuern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_multi_model DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS initialize_and_load_models
      IMPORTING
        iv_container_name TYPE scrfname
        it_model_urls     TYPE string_table.

    METHODS toggle_model_visibility
      IMPORTING
        iv_model_id TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    DATA mo_3d_viewer        TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer.
    DATA mt_loaded_models    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_3d_viewer_multi_model IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD initialize_and_load_models.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_custom_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = iv_container_name
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS           = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT mo_3d_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = mo_custom_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT it_model_urls INTO DATA(lv_url).
      DATA(lv_model_id) = |MODEL_{ sy-tabix }|.
      mo_3d_viewer->load_model_from_url(
        url     = lv_url
        modelid = lv_model_id
      ).
      APPEND lv_model_id TO mt_loaded_models.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD toggle_model_visibility.
    DATA(lv_current_visibility) = mo_3d_viewer->get_object_visibility(
                                     object_id = iv_model_id
                                   ).
    mo_3d_viewer->set_object_visibility(
      object_id = iv_model_id
      visible   = COND #( WHEN lv_current_visibility = abap_true THEN abap_false ELSE abap_true )
    ).
    cl_gui_cfw=>flush( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_multi_model_visibility FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multi_model_visibility.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_3d_viewer_multi_model( ).
    DATA(lv_container_name) = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.
    DATA(lt_model_urls) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'http://example.com/model1.vds' )
      ( 'http://example.com/model2.vds' )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->initialize_and_load_models(
          iv_container_name = lv_container_name,
          it_model_urls     = lt_model_urls
        ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
          act = sy-subrc
          msg = 'Multi-model loading should not raise immediate error'
        ).

        " Simulate toggling visibility for the first model
        lo_cut->toggle_model_visibility( 'MODEL_1' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
          act = sy-subrc
          msg = 'Toggling visibility should not raise immediate error'
        ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_error).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail(
          msg = |Exception during multi-model/visibility test: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|
        ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man mehrere 3D-Modelle in einem einzigen `cl_gui_ecl_3dviewer` verwalten und deren Sichtbarkeit individuell steuern kann. Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Anwendungslog mit mehreren Nachrichten und lesen Sie diese anschließend aus.

solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_read DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_message,
             msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_message,
           tt_log_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_read_messages RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_log_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_read IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_messages.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).

    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_text = 'First success.' ).
    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_text = 'A warning occurred.' ).
    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_text = 'Critical error.' ).

    " Read messages using a modern loop and structure assignment
    LOOP AT lo_log->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_bal_message).
      APPEND VALUE ty_log_message( msgty = ls_bal_message-msgty
                                   text  = ls_bal_message-text ) TO rt_messages.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_log_read( ).
    DATA(lt_messages) = lo_cut->create_and_read_messages( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_messages ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 1 ]-msgty exp = 'S' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 2 ]-msgty exp = 'W' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_messages[ 3 ]-msgty exp = 'E' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Anwendungslog mit verschiedenen Nachrichtentypen und filtern Sie nur die Fehlermeldungen heraus.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_messages()` in Kombination mit `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_message,
             msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_message,
           tt_log_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_error_messages RETURNING VALUE(rt_error_messages) TYPE tt_log_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_messages.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).

    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_text = 'Success message.' ).
    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_text = 'Warning message.' ).
    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_text = 'First error.' ).
    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_text = 'Another success.' ).
    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_text = 'Second error.' ).

    " Filter error messages using FILTER operator
    rt_error_messages = VALUE #( FOR ls_msg IN lo_log->get_messages( )
                                 WHERE ( msgty = 'E' )
                                 ( msgty = ls_msg-msgty text = ls_msg-text ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_filter_log_messages.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Anwendungslog, fügen Sie Nachrichten mit Platzhaltern hinzu und lesen Sie die formatierten Nachrichten aus.

solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_placeholders DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_message,
             msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_message,

CLASS zcl_app_log_placeholders IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_read_formatted_messages.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).

    " Add messages with placeholders (assuming message class ZMSG with messages 001 and 002 exists)
    " ZMSG 001: 'Item &1 processed successfully with quantity &2.'
    " ZMSG 002: 'Error processing item &1: &2.'
    lo_log->add_message(
      iv_msgty = 'S'
      iv_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      iv_msgno = '001'
      iv_msgv1 = 'Material A'
      iv_msgv2 = '100'
    ).

    lo_log->add_message(
      iv_msgty = 'E'
      iv_msgid = 'ZMSG'
      iv_msgno = '002'
      iv_msgv1 = 'Material B'
      iv_msgv2 = 'Invalid input'
    ).

    " Read messages and get formatted text
    LOOP AT lo_log->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_bal_message).
      APPEND VALUE ty_log_message( msgty = ls_bal_message-msgty
                                   text  = ls_bal_message-text ) TO rt_messages.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Anwendungslog und speichern Sie ihn persistent in der Datenbank. Laden Sie ihn anschließend wieder.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>save_log()` und `cl_s_aut_bal_log=>load_log()`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_persist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_log_message,
             msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_log_message,
           tt_log_messages TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_log_message WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_save_and_load_log RETURNING VALUE(rt_messages) TYPE tt_log_messages.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_persist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_save_and_load_log.
    DATA(lv_log_handle) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).

    lv_log_handle->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'I' iv_text = 'Log created and saved.' ).
    lv_log_handle->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_text = 'Data processed.' ).

    " Save the log to the database
    DATA(lv_external_handle) = lv_log_handle->save_log( ).

    " Clear the current log object (simulate new session)
    CLEAR lv_log_handle.

    " Load the log from the database using the external handle
    DATA(lo_loaded_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>load_log( iv_external_handle = lv_external_handle ).

    " Read messages from the loaded log
    LOOP AT lo_loaded_log->get_messages( ) INTO DATA(ls_bal_message).
      APPEND VALUE ty_log_message( msgty = ls_bal_message-msgty
                                   text  = ls_bal_message-text ) TO rt_messages.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Clean up the log from the database (optional, but good practice for tests)
    lo_loaded_log->delete_log( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie einen `UTCLONG`-Zeitstempel in einen String, der die Zeit in einer spezifischen Zeitzone darstellt (z.B. 'America/New_York').
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_utclong=>utclong_to_timestamp()` mit dem `tzone` Parameter und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_utc_tzone_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS format_utclong_in_timezone
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong TYPE utclong
        iv_tzone   TYPE timezone_name
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_utc_tzone_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_utclong_in_timezone.
    DATA: lv_date TYPE d,
          lv_time TYPE t.

    cl_abap_utclong=>utclong_to_timestamp(
      EXPORTING
        utclong = iv_utclong
        tzone   = iv_tzone
      IMPORTING
        date    = lv_date
        time    = lv_time
    ).

    rv_formatted_string = |{ lv_date(4) }-{ lv_date+4(2) }-{ lv_date+6(2) } { lv_time(2) }:{ lv_time+2(2) }:{ lv_time+4(2) }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_format_utclong_tzone FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_utclong_tzone.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_utc_tzone_format( ).
    DATA(lv_utclong) = '20231027103000.0000000'. " 2023-10-27 10:30:00 UTC

    " Test with 'America/New_York' (UTC-4 during DST, UTC-5 otherwise)
    " Oct 27, 2023 is still DST, so UTC-4. 10:30 UTC -> 06:30 AM New York
    DATA(lv_formatted_ny) = lo_cut->format_utclong_in_timezone(
                               iv_utclong = lv_utclong
                               iv_tzone   = 'AMERICA/NEW_YORK' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_ny exp = '2023-10-27 06:30:00' ).

    " Test with 'Europe/Berlin' (UTC+2 during DST, UTC+1 otherwise)
    " Oct 27, 2023 is still DST, so UTC+2. 10:30 UTC -> 12:30 PM Berlin
    DATA(lv_formatted_berlin) = lo_cut->format_utclong_in_timezone(
                                   iv_utclong = lv_utclong
                                   iv_tzone   = 'EUROPE/BERLIN' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_formatted_berlin exp = '2023-10-27 12:30:00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finden Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`, die in einem bestimmten `UTCLONG`-Zeitfenster liegen.
hint: Konvertieren Sie das `UTCLONG`-Zeitfenster in Datum und Uhrzeit und verwenden Sie diese für die `SELECT`-Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_utc_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_sflight_key,
           tt_sflight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_utc_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_utclong_from TYPE utclong
        iv_utclong_to   TYPE utclong
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_utc_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_utc_range.
    DATA: lv_date_from TYPE d,
          lv_time_from TYPE t,
          lv_date_to   TYPE d,
          lv_time_to   TYPE t.

    " Convert UTCLONG range to local date/time range
    cl_abap_utclong=>utclong_to_timestamp(
      EXPORTING utclong = iv_utclong_from
      IMPORTING date    = lv_date_from
                time    = lv_time_from
    ).
    cl_abap_utclong=>utclong_to_timestamp(
      EXPORTING utclong = iv_utclong_to
      IMPORTING date    = lv_date_to
                time    = lv_time_to
    ).

    " Select flights within the converted date range
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights
      WHERE fldate BETWEEN @lv_date_from AND @lv_date_to.

    " Note: Filtering by time within the same day would require more complex logic
    " or a direct timestamp field in SFLIGHTS, which is not available.
    " This example focuses on date range derived from UTCLONG.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_flights_utc_filter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flights_utc_filter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflights_utc_filter( ).

    " Define a UTC range (e.g., 2023-01-01 00:00:00 UTC to 2023-01-05 23:59:59 UTC)
    DATA(lv_utclong_from) = '20230101000000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_utclong_to)   = '20230105235959.0000000'.

    " Set time zone to UTC for predictable test results
    DATA(lv_old_tzone) = sy-tzone.
    SET TIME ZONE 'UTC'.
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_in_utc_range(
                           iv_utclong_from = lv_utclong_from
                           iv_utclong_to   = lv_utclong_to ).
    SET TIME ZONE lv_old_tzone. " Restore original timezone

    " Assert that flights are found (assuming SFLIGHTS has data in this range)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_flights ).

    " Check if all found flights are within the expected date range
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( cond = ( ls_flight-fldate GE '20230101' AND ls_flight-fldate LE '20230105' ) ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `UTCLONG`-Werte werden zunächst in lokale Datumswerte konvertiert, die dann in einer `SELECT`-Anweisung verwendet werden. Dies ist nützlich für zeitbasierte Abfragen in Systemen, die `UTCLONG` für Zeitstempel verwenden.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen Anwendungslog mit verschiedenen Nachrichtentypen und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Nachrichten pro Typ mit `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `get_messages()` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` und `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_log_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_msg_count,
             msgty TYPE bal_msgty,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_msg_count,
           tt_msg_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_msg_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_messages_by_type RETURNING VALUE(rt_msg_counts) TYPE tt_msg_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_log_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_messages_by_type.
    DATA(lo_log) = cl_s_aut_bal_log=>create_log( ).

    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_text = 'Success 1.' ).
    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_text = 'Warning 1.' ).
    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'E' iv_text = 'Error 1.' ).
    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_text = 'Success 2.' ).
    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'W' iv_text = 'Warning 2.' ).
    lo_log->add_free_text_message( iv_msgty = 'S' iv_text = 'Success 3.' ).

    " Count messages by type using REDUCE and GROUP BY
    rt_msg_counts = REDUCE tt_msg_counts(
      INIT result = VALUE tt_msg_counts( )
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_msg IN lo_log->get_messages( )
      GROUP BY ls_msg-msgty INTO DATA(key)
      NEXT result = VALUE tt_msg_counts( BASE result
                                         ( msgty = key count = GROUP SIZE ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_count_messages_by_type FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_count_messages_by_type.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_log_reduce( ).
    DATA(lt_msg_counts) = lo_cut->count_messages_by_type( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_msg_counts ) exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_s_count) = lt_msg_counts[ msgty = 'S' DEFAULT VALUE ty_msg_count( ) ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_s_count-count exp = 3 ).

    DATA(ls_w_count) = lt_msg_counts[ msgty = 'W' DEFAULT VALUE ty_msg_count( ) ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_w_count-count exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_e_count) = lt_msg_counts[ msgty = 'E' DEFAULT VALUE ty_msg_count( ) ].
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_e_count-count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `REDUCE` und `GROUP BY` für die Aggregation von Daten aus dem Anwendungslog. Es zählt effizient die Nachrichten pro Typ und zeigt eine moderne, funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung in ABAP.
keywords: Anwendungslog, REDUCE, GROUP BY, Aggregation, Nachrichten, cl_s_aut_bal_log

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die nur die Flugnummern (CARRID und CONNID) von Flügen aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT enthält, die nach 'NEW YORK' gehen und deren Preis (PRICE) über 500 liegt. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR`-Ausdruck mit `FILTER` und `VALUE` für die interne Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_keys) TYPE tt_flight_keys.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom, cityto, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    rt_filtered_keys = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                  WHERE ( cityto = 'NEW YORK' AND price > 500 )
                                  ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
                                    connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT. Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um eine Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0 TYPE sflight-price
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflight
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_reducer( ).
    " Assuming SFLIGHT has some 'LH' flights with prices
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0 TYPE sflight-price.
    SELECT SUM( price ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_expected_sum WHERE carrid = 'LH'.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( 'LH' ).

keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein ungültiger Flugpreis (z.B. negativ) übergeben wird. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme in einer aufrufenden Methode ab und geben Sie eine Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Definieren Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse, verwenden Sie `RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE` und `TRY...CATCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_price
      IMPORTING iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RAISING zcx_invalid_flight_price.

    METHODS process_flight_with_price
      IMPORTING iv_price TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_price.
    IF iv_price < 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_flight_price
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_invalid_flight_price=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_flight_with_price.
    TRY.
        validate_price( iv_price = iv_price ).
        rv_message = |Price { iv_price } is valid.|.
      CATCH zcx_invalid_flight_price INTO DATA(lx_invalid_price).
        rv_message = |Error: Invalid price provided. { lx_invalid_price->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->process_flight_with_price( 100 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_price.

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Verwendung von benutzerdefinierten Ausnahmen und `TRY...CATCH` ist der moderne Weg zur Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Es trennt die Fehlererkennung von der Fehlerbehandlung, macht den Code robuster und lesbarer als die Prüfung von `SY-SUBRC` oder die Verwendung von Nachrichten direkt.
keywords: Error Handling, Exceptions, TRY, CATCH, RAISE EXCEPTION

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode einer Klasse dynamisch auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit in einem String gespeichert ist. Die Methode soll einen String zurückgeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CALL METHOD (lv_method_name) OF (lo_object)`. Beachten Sie, dass die dynamische Methode `PUBLIC` sein muss.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS method_a RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
    METHODS method_b RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

    METHODS call_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_caller IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD method_a.
    rv_text = 'Called Method A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD method_b.
    rv_text = 'Called Method B'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_dynamic_method.
    DATA lo_me TYPE REF TO zcl_dynamic_caller.
    lo_me = me.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD (iv_method_name) OF lo_me RECEIVING RESULT rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        rv_result = |Error calling method { iv_method_name }: { lx_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_call_method_a FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_call_method_b FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_call_non_existent_method FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_call_method_a.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'METHOD_A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Called Method A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_call_method_b.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'METHOD_B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Called Method B' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_call_non_existent_method.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_caller( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_dynamic_method( 'NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Error calling method NON_EXISTENT_METHOD' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der dynamische Methodenaufruf ermöglicht es, den Namen einer aufzurufenden Methode zur Laufzeit zu bestimmen. Dies ist nützlich für Frameworks, Plugin-Architekturen oder wenn die auszuführende Logik von Konfigurationsdaten abhängt. Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` ist hier entscheidend, um Laufzeitfehler abzufangen.
keywords: Dynamic Call, CALL METHOD, RTTI, Object Orientation

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle SFLIGHT nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die durchschnittliche Flugdauer (FLTIME). Speichern Sie die Ergebnisse in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit dem `CORRESPONDING` Zusatz und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             avg_fltime  TYPE sflight-fltime,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, fltime
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflight.

    LOOP AT lt_sflight INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_sum_fltime) = REDUCE #( INIT s = 0 TYPE sflight-fltime
                                      FOR <member> IN GROUP
                                      NEXT s = s + <member>-fltime ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP <member> ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_summary( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                      avg_fltime = COND #( WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_sum_fltime / lv_count ELSE 0 ) )
        TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_summary ).

    " Example: Assert for a specific carrier if you know its data
    DATA(lv_expected_avg_lh) = 0 TYPE sflight-fltime.
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0 TYPE i.
    SELECT SUM( fltime ) FROM sflight INTO @DATA(lv_sum_lh) WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    SELECT COUNT( * ) FROM sflight INTO @lv_count_lh WHERE carrid = 'LH'.
    IF lv_count_lh > 0.
      lv_expected_avg_lh = lv_sum_lh / lv_count_lh.
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_summary INTO DATA(ls_summary_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_summary_lh-avg_fltime exp = lv_expected_avg_lh ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `GROUP BY`-Erweiterung für `LOOP AT` (ABAP 7.50+) ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. In Kombination mit `REDUCE` für Aggregationen innerhalb der Gruppen können komplexe Analysen sehr kompakt und effizient durchgeführt werden.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, LOOP AT, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der 'Gehälter' (simuliert mit `sflights-price`) aller 'Mitarbeiter' in einer internen Tabelle unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `INIT` und `NEXT`.
solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_data, carrid TYPE s_carr_id, connid TYPE s_conn_id, fldate TYPE s_date, price TYPE s_price, currency TYPE s_currcode, END OF ty_employee_data. TYPES: tt_employee_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_data WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS zcl_calculate_total_salary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS get_total_salary RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_salary) TYPE s_price. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_calculate_total_salary IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD get_total_salary. DATA lt_employees TYPE tt_employee_data. SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_employees. rv_total_salary = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_employee IN lt_employees NEXT sum = sum + ls_employee-price ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
unit_test: CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT. PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_total_salary FOR TESTING. ENDCLASS. CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION. IF lv_total > 0. cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_total ). ENDIF. " Test with a known set of data DATA lt_test_employees TYPE tt_employee_data. APPEND VALUE ty_employee_data( price = 100 ) TO lt_test_employees. APPEND VALUE ty_employee_data( price = 200 ) TO lt_test_employees. APPEND VALUE ty_employee_data( price = 50 ) TO lt_test_employees. DATA(lv_expected_sum) = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_emp IN lt_test_employees NEXT sum = sum + ls_emp-price ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_expected_sum exp = 350 ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges funktionales Konstrukt, das es ermöglicht, eine interne Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren (zu aggregieren). Mit `INIT` wird ein Startwert festgelegt und mit `NEXT` die Logik für jede Iteration definiert. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und ausdrucksstarke Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen, wie z.B. die Berechnung von Gesamtsummen für 'Employee functions' oder Berichte.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming, Aggregation, Math, Employee functions

Instructions: Prüfen Sie, ob ein bestimmter 'Mitarbeiter' (simuliert mit `sflights` entry) in einer internen Tabelle existiert und ermitteln Sie dessen Index.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LINE_EXISTS` und `LINE_INDEX` mit Tabellen-Expressions.
solution: TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_employee_data, carrid TYPE s_carr_id, connid TYPE s_conn_id, fldate TYPE s_date, price TYPE s_price, currency TYPE s_currcode, END OF ty_employee_data. TYPES: tt_employee_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_employee_data WITH EMPTY KEY. CLASS zcl_employee_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC. PUBLIC SECTION. METHODS check_and_get_index IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id EXPORTING ev_exists TYPE abap_bool ev_index TYPE i. ENDCLASS. CLASS zcl_employee_lookup IMPLEMENTATION. METHOD check_and_get_index. DATA lt_employees TYPE tt_employee_data. SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @lt_employees. IF line_exists( lt_employees[ carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid ] ). ev_exists = abap_true. ev_index = line_index( lt_employees[ carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid ] ). ELSE. ev_exists = abap_false. ev_index = 0. ENDIF. ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

" Test existing entry DATA(lv_exists) = abap_false. DATA(lv_index) = 0. lo_cut->check_and_get_index( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_true ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 1 ). " Test non-existing entry lo_cut->check_and_get_index( EXPORTING iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '9999' IMPORTING ev_exists = lv_exists ev_index = lv_index ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_false ). cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_index exp = 0 ). ENDMETHOD. ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen inneren Join zwischen Flugdaten (SFlight) und Fluggesellschaften (SCarr) durch, um eine neue interne Tabelle mit kombinierten Informationen (Fluggesellschaftsname, Flugnummer, Flugdatum) zu erstellen. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei nur Flüge, die bereits stattgefunden haben (fldate <= sy-datum).
hint: Verwenden Sie die `FOR` und `VALUE` Ausdrücke mit einer `WHERE` Klausel für den Join und eine zusätzliche Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_inner_join_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_joined_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_joined_flight.
    TYPES tt_joined_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_joined_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_joined_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
        it_scarr   TYPE tt_scarr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_flights) TYPE tt_joined_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_inner_join_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_joined_flights.
    rt_joined_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflight
        FOR carrier IN it_scarr WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid )
          WHERE ( flight-fldate <= sy-datum )
            ( carrid   = flight-carrid
              carrname = carrier-carrname
              connid   = flight-connid
              fldate   = flight-fldate )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen linken äußeren Join zwischen Flugdaten (SFlight) und Fluggesellschaften (SCarr) durch. Die resultierende Tabelle soll alle Flüge enthalten. Wenn für einen Flug keine passende Fluggesellschaft gefunden wird, sollen die Felder der Fluggesellschaft initial sein. Fügen Sie ein Feld 'HasCarrier' hinzu, das 'X' ist, wenn ein Carrier gefunden wurde, sonst initial.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` und `VALUE` mit einer geeigneten Bedingung und `COND` für die Initialisierung/Feldzuweisung bei fehlendem Match.
solution:
CLASS zcl_left_outer_join_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_joined_flight,
             carrid     TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname   TYPE s_carrname,
             connid     TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate     TYPE s_date,
             has_carrier TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_joined_flight.
    TYPES tt_joined_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_joined_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_left_outer_joined_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
        it_scarr   TYPE tt_scarr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_joined_flights) TYPE tt_joined_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_left_outer_join_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_left_outer_joined_flights.
    rt_joined_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflight
        LET carrier = it_scarr[ OPTIONAL carrid = flight-carrid ] IN
          ( carrid      = flight-carrid
            carrname    = COND #( WHEN carrier IS NOT INITIAL THEN carrier-carrname ELSE '' )
            connid      = flight-connid
            fldate      = flight-fldate
            has_carrier = COND #( WHEN carrier IS NOT INITIAL THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_flights_by_carrier IMPLEMENTATION.

            FOR flight IN it_sflight WHERE ( carrid = carrier-carrid )
              ( connid = flight-connid

Instructions: Führen Sie einen inneren Join zwischen Flugdaten (SFlight) und Fluggesellschaften (SCarr) durch. Gruppieren Sie die Ergebnisse nach Fluggesellschaft und berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und die durchschnittliche Anzahl der belegten Sitze.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR` für den Join, `GROUP BY` und `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_agg_join_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_joined_flight_temp,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
           END OF ty_joined_flight_temp.
    TYPES tt_joined_flight_temp TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_joined_flight_temp WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname      TYPE s_carrname,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             avg_seats_occ TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summary
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
        it_scarr   TYPE tt_scarr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_summary) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_agg_join_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summary.
    DATA(lt_joined_flights) = VALUE tt_joined_flight_temp(
      FOR flight IN it_sflight
        FOR carrier IN it_scarr WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid )
          ( carrid   = flight-carrid
            carrname = carrier-carrname
            seatsocc = flight-seatsocc )
    ).

    rt_carrier_summary = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_joined_flights BY carrid, carrname
      GROUP SIZE total_flights
      (
        carrid        = flight-carrid
        carrname      = flight-carrname
        total_flights = total_flights
        avg_seats_occ = REDUCE decfloat16( INIT sum_seats = 0 count = 0
                                           FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                           NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + member-seatsocc
                                                count     = count + 1
                                           FINALLY = COND #( WHEN count > 0 THEN sum_seats / count ELSE 0 ) )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle basierend auf Flugdaten (SFlight), wobei ein Statusfeld 'CapacityStatus' gesetzt wird. Der Status soll 'High' sein, wenn die Auslastung über 80% liegt, 'Medium' bei 50-80% und 'Low' darunter. Berücksichtigen Sie dabei auch, ob der Flug bereits stattgefunden hat (fldate <= sy-datum). Wenn der Flug in der Zukunft liegt, soll der Status 'Planned' sein.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator mit geschachtelten Bedingungen, um die verschiedenen Status zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_cond_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid         TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid         TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate         TYPE s_date,
             capacity_status TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_capacity_status
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_cond_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_capacity_status.
    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflight
        LET occupancy_rate = COND decfloat16( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( flight-seatsocc / flight-seatsmax ) * 100 ELSE 0 ) IN
          ( carrid         = flight-carrid
            connid         = flight-connid
            fldate         = flight-fldate
            capacity_status = COND string(
                                  WHEN flight-fldate > sy-datum THEN 'Planned'
                                  WHEN occupancy_rate > 80 THEN 'High'
                                  WHEN occupancy_rate >= 50 THEN 'Medium'
                                  ELSE 'Low' )
          )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf ein Feld in einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten zu, dessen Name zur Laufzeit als Parameter übergeben wird. Extrahieren Sie die Werte dieses Feldes in eine neue interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie Feld-Symbole (`FIELD-SYMBOLS`) und den `ASSIGN COMPONENT` Befehl, um dynamisch auf Komponenten zuzugreifen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES tt_dynamic_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_dynamic_field_values
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_field_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_values) TYPE tt_dynamic_values
      RAISING
        cx_sy_assign_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_dynamic_field_values.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_value> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT it_sflight ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_flight>).
      ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE <fs_flight> TO <fs_value>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND |{ <fs_value> }| TO rt_values.
