Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft (SCarr) die Gesamtzahl der gebuchten Sitze für alle Flüge, die in einem bestimmten Zeitraum (z.B. im Jahr 2023) liegen. Die Ausgabe soll den Fluggesellschaftsnamen und die aggregierte Summe der Sitze enthalten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REDUCE` mit einem geschachtelten `FOR` Ausdruck und einer Filterung nach Datum.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_nested_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_seats_sum,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname    TYPE s_carrname,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_seats_sum.
    TYPES tt_carrier_seats_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_seats_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_seats_sum
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
        it_scarr   TYPE tt_scarr
        iv_year    TYPE sy-year
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_seats_sum) TYPE tt_carrier_seats_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_nested_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_seats_sum.
    rt_carrier_seats_sum = VALUE #( 
      FOR carrier IN it_scarr
        ( carrid   = carrier-carrid
          carrname = carrier-carrname
          total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum_seats = 0
                                  FOR flight IN it_sflight WHERE ( carrid = carrier-carrid AND
                                                                   fldate CP |{ iv_year }*| )
                                  NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + flight-seatsocc )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen (SFlight), und weisen Sie jedem Flug einen 'Service Level' zu: 'Premium' für Langstreckenflüge (z.B. Flugnummern > '0500') mit hoher Auslastung (> 80%), 'Standard' für andere Langstreckenflüge und 'Economy' für Kurzstreckenflüge (Flugnummern <= '0500').
hint: Verwenden Sie den `SWITCH` Operator mit geschachtelten Bedingungen, um den Service Level zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_switch_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_service_level,
             carrid       TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid       TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate       TYPE s_date,
             service_level TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_service_level.
    TYPES tt_flight_service_level TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_service_level WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_service_level
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_service_level) TYPE tt_flight_service_level.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_switch_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_service_level.
    rt_service_level = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN it_sflight
        LET occupancy_rate = COND decfloat16( WHEN flight-seatsmax > 0 THEN ( flight-seatsocc / flight-seatsmax ) * 100 ELSE 0 ) IN
          ( carrid        = flight-carrid
            connid        = flight-connid
            fldate        = flight-fldate
            service_level = SWITCH string(
                                WHEN flight-connid > '0500' THEN " Long-haul
                                  SWITCH string(
                                    WHEN occupancy_rate > 80 THEN 'Premium'
                                    ELSE 'Standard' )
                                ELSE " Short-haul
                                  'Economy' )
          )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen inneren Join zwischen Flugdaten (SFlight) und Fluggesellschaften (SCarr) durch. Mappen Sie die gejointen Daten in eine neue interne Tabelle, wobei das Feld 'carrid' in 'AirlineID' und 'carrname' in 'AirlineName' umbenannt wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` für den Join und `CORRESPONDING` mit `MAPPING` für die Feldzuweisung und Umbenennung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_join_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_mapped_flight,
             airline_id   TYPE s_carr_id,
             airline_name TYPE s_carrname,
             flight_num   TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date  TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_mapped_flight.
    TYPES tt_mapped_flight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapped_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_mapped_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
        it_scarr   TYPE tt_scarr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_mapped_flights) TYPE tt_mapped_flight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_join_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_mapped_flights.
    DATA(lt_joined_temp) = VALUE tt_joined_temp(
      FOR flight IN it_sflight
        FOR carrier IN it_scarr WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid )
          ( carrid   = flight-carrid
            carrname = carrier-carrname
            connid   = flight-connid
            fldate   = flight-fldate )
    ).

    rt_mapped_flights = CORRESPONDING #(
      lt_joined_temp MAPPING airline_id   = carrid
                             airline_name = carrname
                             flight_num   = connid
                             flight_date  = fldate
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft (SCarr) die Gesamtzahl der Flüge und die Gesamtzahl der belegten Sitze, gruppiert nach Flugdatum. Die Ausgabe soll eine geschachtelte Struktur sein: Fluggesellschaft -> (Datum -> (Anzahl Flüge, Summe Sitze)).
hint: Verwenden Sie geschachtelte `REDUCE` und `FOR` Ausdrücke mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_reduce_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_scarr,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
           END OF ty_scarr.
    TYPES tt_scarr TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_daily_summary,
             fldate        TYPE s_date,
             total_flights TYPE i,
             total_seats   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_daily_summary.
    TYPES tt_daily_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_daily_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_daily_agg,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE s_carrname,
             daily_data TYPE tt_daily_summary,
           END OF ty_carrier_daily_agg.
    TYPES tt_carrier_daily_agg TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_daily_agg WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_daily_aggregation
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE tt_sflight
        it_scarr   TYPE tt_scarr
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_daily_agg) TYPE tt_carrier_daily_agg.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_reduce_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_daily_aggregation.
    rt_carrier_daily_agg = VALUE #( 
      FOR carrier IN it_scarr
        ( carrid   = carrier-carrid
          carrname = carrier-carrname
          daily_data = VALUE #( 
            FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflight BY fldate WHERE ( carrid = carrier-carrid )
            GROUP SIZE total_flights
            (
              fldate        = flight-fldate
              total_flights = total_flights
              total_seats   = REDUCE i( INIT sum_seats = 0
                                        FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                        NEXT sum_seats = sum_seats + member-seatsocc )
            )
          )
        )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` mit `INTO TABLE` für die Gruppendaten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             flights     TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    METHODS get_grouped_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_nested IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) INTO DATA(ls_group_key).
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_group_key-carrid
                      connid = ls_group_key-connid
                      flights = VALUE #( FOR GROUP ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_group_key ( ls_group_flight ) ) ) TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    LOOP AT lt_result INTO DATA(ls_group).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Flights table in group should not be empty' act = ls_group-flights ).
      LOOP AT ls_group-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Connid mismatch' act = ls_flight-connid exp = ls_group-connid ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

IN GROUP ...` um die Elemente einer Gruppe direkt in einer geschachtelten internen Tabelle zu sammeln. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und kompakte Art, Gruppierungen zu verarbeiten.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flügen nach Fluggesellschaft (Carrid) und berechnen Sie die Summe der belegten Sitzplätze (Seatsocc) für jede Gruppe. Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` für die Aggregation innerhalb der Gruppe.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` und `REDUCE` im `VALUE`-Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carr_seats,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carr_seats.
    METHODS get_carrier_seats
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carr_seats) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carr_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_group_by_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_seats.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      APPEND VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                      total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                              FOR GROUP ls_group_flight IN GROUP ls_flight ( sum = sum + ls_group_flight-seatsocc ) ) ) TO rt_carr_seats.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_greater_equal( msg = 'Total seats should be non-negative' act = ls_carr_seat-total_seats exp = 0 ).

GROUP BY ...` mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator. `REDUCE` ermöglicht es, eine Aggregation (hier die Summe der belegten Sitze) über die Elemente einer Gruppe in einer einzigen, kompakten Anweisung durchzuführen. Dies ist ein sehr funktionaler und moderner Ansatz zur Datenaggregation.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die grundlegende Ausnahmebehandlung, indem Sie eine Division durch Null abfangen und eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurückgeben.

CLASS zcl_exception_div_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING iv_numerator   TYPE i
                iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_div_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    DATA: lv_quotient TYPE p DECIMALS 2.

    TRY.
        lv_quotient = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Result: { lv_quotient }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        rv_result = |Error: Division by zero or arithmetic overflow. { lx_arith_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should catch division by zero error' act = lv_result exp = 'Division by zero' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_division.

Die vordefinierte Ausnahme `cx_sy_arithmetic_error` fängt arithmetische Fehler wie die Division durch Null ab. Der `INTO`-Zusatz ermöglicht den Zugriff auf das Ausnahmeobjekt, um detailliertere Informationen zu erhalten.
keywords: TRY CATCH, Exception, Division by Zero, cx_sy_arithmetic_error

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme, die ausgelöst wird, wenn ein Eingabeparameter einen ungültigen Wert hat. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine spezifische Fehlermeldung aus.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse, die von `cx_static_check` erbt.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_parameter DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL
        parameter TYPE string OPTIONAL.
    DATA parameter TYPE string READ-ONLY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_parameter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    me->parameter = parameter.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = zcx_invalid_parameter.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_exception_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_value
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING zcx_invalid_parameter.
    METHODS call_process_value
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_custom_exception_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_value.
    IF iv_value <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_parameter
        EXPORTING
          parameter = 'iv_value'.
    ENDIF.
    rv_message = |Value { iv_value } processed successfully.|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD call_process_value.
    TRY.
        rv_status = process_value( iv_value = iv_value ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_parameter INTO DATA(lx_invalid_param).
        rv_status = |Error: Invalid parameter '{ lx_invalid_param->parameter }'. { lx_invalid_param->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_parameter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_custom_exception_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_process_value( iv_value = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should catch custom exception' act = lv_result exp = 'Invalid parameter' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_parameter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_custom_exception_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->call_process_value( iv_value = 10 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should process valid parameter' act = lv_result exp = 'Value 10 processed successfully.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Erstellung und Verwendung einer benutzerdefinierten Ausnahme (`zcx_invalid_parameter`), die von `cx_static_check` erbt. Statische Ausnahmen müssen deklariert (`RAISING`) und abgefangen werden. Dies ermöglicht eine präzise Fehlerbehandlung und verbessert die Lesbarkeit des Codes, indem spezifische Fehlerzustände klar benannt werden.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des `CLEANUP`-Blocks in der Ausnahmebehandlung, um eine Ressource (z.B. einen Status-Flag) freizugeben, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme auftritt oder nicht.
hint: Implementieren Sie Logik im `CLEANUP`-Block, die immer ausgeführt wird, bevor der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_exception_cleanup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA: mv_resource_locked TYPE abap_bool READ-ONLY.
    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS lock_resource.
    METHODS unlock_resource.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_cleanup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD lock_resource.
    mv_resource_locked = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD unlock_resource.
    mv_resource_locked = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_data.
    lock_resource( ).
    TRY.
        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        ENDIF.
        rv_status = 'Data processed successfully.'.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        rv_status = |Error during data processing: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
      CLEANUP.
        unlock_resource( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_cleanup_on_error FOR TESTING. METHODS test_cleanup_on_success FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_cleanup_on_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_cleanup( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Resource should be unlocked initially' act = lo_cut->mv_resource_locked exp = abap_false ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->process_data( iv_trigger_error = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Should report error' act = lv_status exp = 'Error' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Resource should be unlocked after error' act = lo_cut->mv_resource_locked exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_cleanup_on_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_exception_cleanup( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Resource should be unlocked initially' act = lo_cut->mv_resource_locked exp = abap_false ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->process_data( iv_trigger_error = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Should report success' act = lv_status exp = 'Data processed successfully.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Resource should be unlocked after success' act = lo_cut->mv_resource_locked exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `CLEANUP`-Block in einem `TRY...CATCH...ENDTRY`-Konstrukt wird immer ausgeführt, bevor der `TRY`-Block verlassen wird, unabhängig davon, ob eine Ausnahme aufgetreten ist oder nicht. Dies ist ideal, um Ressourcen freizugeben (z.B. Datenbank-Locks, Dateihandles), um Dateninkonsistenzen oder Ressourcenlecks zu vermeiden.
keywords: TRY CATCH, CLEANUP, Exception, Resource Management

      RETURNING VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE sflights
      RAISING zcx_flight_not_found.
    METHODS get_flight_info
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
                iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id

CLASS zcl_flight_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_flight_details.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @rs_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_flight_not_found
        EXPORTING
          carrid = iv_carrid
          connid = iv_connid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_info.
    TRY.
        DATA(ls_flight) = find_flight_details( iv_carrid = iv_carrid iv_connid = iv_connid ).
        rv_info = |Flight { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } found. Departure: { ls_flight-fldate }|.

        rv_info = |Error: Flight { lx_not_found->carrid } { lx_not_found->connid } not found. { lx_not_found->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other).
        rv_info = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_other->get_text( ) }|.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie das Abfangen mehrerer Ausnahmetypen in einem `CATCH`-Block und die Verwendung von `INTO` zur Analyse der Ausnahmeobjekte, um spezifische Fehlermeldungen zu generieren.
hint: Listen Sie mehrere Ausnahmeklassen im `CATCH`-Block auf und verwenden Sie `INTO` um auf das Ausnahmeobjekt zuzugreifen und dessen Typ zu prüfen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_multi_catch_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING iv_operation_type TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_arithmetic_error RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    METHODS trigger_invalid_value_error RAISING cx_sy_dyn_literal_length.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_multi_catch_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_arithmetic_error.
    DATA(lv_result) = 10 / 0.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD trigger_invalid_value_error.
    DATA(lv_string) TYPE string VALUE 'TooLongString'.
    DATA(lv_char10) TYPE c LENGTH 5.
    lv_char10 = lv_string.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD perform_operation.
    TRY.
        CASE iv_operation_type.
          WHEN 'ARITHMETIC'.
            trigger_arithmetic_error( ).
          WHEN 'INVALID_VALUE'.
            trigger_invalid_value_error( ).
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_message = 'Operation successful.'.
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error cx_sy_dyn_literal_length INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        CASE TYPE OF lx_exception.
          WHEN TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
            rv_message = |Caught arithmetic error: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
          WHEN TYPE cx_sy_dyn_literal_length.
            rv_message = |Caught invalid value error: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
          WHEN OTHERS.
            rv_message = |Caught unexpected error: { lx_exception->get_text( ) }|.
        ENDCASE.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_exception).
        rv_message = |Caught a general exception: { lx_other_exception->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Funktion, die eine `cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds` Ausnahme auslöst, wenn ein ungültiger Index für den Zugriff auf eine interne Tabelle verwendet wird. Fangen Sie diese Ausnahme ab und geben Sie eine informative Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... INDEX ...` mit einem ungültigen Index, um die Ausnahme zu provozieren, und fangen Sie `cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds` ab.

CLASS zcl_exception_index_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_table_entry
      IMPORTING iv_index TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_entry) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_index_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_table_entry.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string VALUE `('A', 'B', 'C')`.
    DATA: lv_value TYPE string.

    TRY.
        READ TABLE lt_data INDEX iv_index INTO lv_value.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_entry = |Entry at index { iv_index }: { lv_value }|.
        ELSE.
          " This path should ideally not be reached if exception is raised for out of bounds
          rv_entry = |Index { iv_index } not found (sy-subrc).|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_range_out_of_bounds INTO DATA(lx_range_error).
        rv_entry = |Error: Index { iv_index } is out of bounds. { lx_range_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verkettung von Ausnahmen (Exception Chaining), indem Sie eine niedrigere Ausnahme abfangen und eine neue, höherwertige Ausnahme auslösen, die die ursprüngliche Ausnahme als 'previous' enthält.
hint: Fangen Sie eine Standardausnahme ab und lösen Sie eine benutzerdefinierte Ausnahme aus, wobei Sie die abgefangene Ausnahme im `PREVIOUS`-Parameter übergeben.
solution:
CLASS zcx_higher_level_error DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_t100_message.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        textid LIKE if_t100_message=>t100key OPTIONAL
        previous LIKE cx_root=>previous OPTIONAL.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_higher_level_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CALL METHOD super->constructor
      EXPORTING
        previous = previous.
    IF textid IS INITIAL.
      if_t100_message~t100key = zcx_higher_level_error.
    ELSE.
      if_t100_message~t100key = textid.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_chaining DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_critical_data
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string
      RAISING zcx_higher_level_error.
    METHODS execute_process
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_log) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS perform_low_level_op
      IMPORTING iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_exception_chaining IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_low_level_op.
    IF iv_value = 0.
      DATA(lv_dummy) = 10 / iv_value.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD process_critical_data.
    TRY.
        perform_low_level_op( iv_value = iv_value ).
        rv_status = 'Critical data processed.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith_error).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_higher_level_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_arith_error.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD execute_process.
    TRY.
        rv_log = process_critical_data( iv_value = iv_value ).
      CATCH zcx_higher_level_error INTO DATA(lx_higher_level).
        rv_log = |Higher level error: { lx_higher_level->get_text( ) }|.
        IF lx_higher_level->previous IS BOUND.
          rv_log = rv_log && | (Caused by: { lx_higher_level->previous->get_text( ) })|.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other).
        rv_log = |Unexpected error: { lx_other->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

Eine abgefangene Ausnahme kann als 'previous'-Ausnahme in einer neu ausgelösten, höherwertigen Ausnahme gespeichert werden. Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme aller Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle sflights unter Verwendung von REDUCE.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit dem ADD Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug in sflights die Gesamtkapazität (Sitze + Business-Sitze + First-Class-Sitze) berechnet.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Expression mit dem ADD-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_capacity,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid        TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate        TYPE s_date,
             total_capacity TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_capacity.
    TYPES tt_flight_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_capacity WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_total_capacity
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_total_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsmax, seatsbmax, seatsfmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid        = flight-carrid
        connid        = flight-connid
        fldate        = flight-fldate
        total_capacity = flight-seatsmax + flight-seatsbmax + flight-seatsfmax ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_total_capacity FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_total_capacity.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_with_cap) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_total_capacity( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_flights_with_cap ).

    READ TABLE lt_flights_with_cap INTO DATA(ls_flight_cap) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflights.
      SELECT SINGLE seatsmax, seatsbmax, seatsfmax
        FROM sflights
        INTO @ls_sflight
        WHERE carrid = @ls_flight_cap-carrid
          AND connid = @ls_flight_cap-connid
          AND fldate = @ls_flight_cap-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lv_expected_cap) = ls_sflight-seatsmax + ls_sflight-seatsbmax + ls_sflight-seatsfmax.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          msg = 'Calculated total capacity mismatch'
          act = ls_flight_cap-total_capacity
          exp = lv_expected_cap
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `FOR`-Expression in Kombination mit `VALUE` ermöglicht die deklarative Transformation einer internen Tabelle in eine neue Struktur, wobei Berechnungen wie die Addition der Kapazitäten direkt im Ausdruck erfolgen können.
keywords: FOR, VALUE, ADD, Internal Tables, Transformation

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Flugpreise für alle Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FILTER und REDUCE mit dem ADD-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_cond_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_by_min_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_cond_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_min_capacity.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency, seatsmax, seatsbmax, seatsfmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR flight IN FILTER #( lt_sflights USING KEY primary_key
                               WHERE ( seatsmax + seatsbmax + seatsfmax ) > iv_min_capacity )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + flight-price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS export_flights_to_excel

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtsumme der Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle sflights unter Verwendung von REDUCE und GROUP BY.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE in Kombination mit FOR GROUPS und dem ADD-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_group_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_price_sum,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             total_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_carrier_price_sum.
    TYPES tt_carrier_price_sum TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_price_sum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_sums) TYPE tt_carrier_price_sum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_group_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_carrier_sums = VALUE #( 
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) 
      ( carrid    = flight-carrid
        total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_p = 0 FOR member IN GROUP ( NEXT sum_p = sum_p + member-price ) ) ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_group_sum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Result table should not be empty' act = lt_sums ).

    " Example: Check sum for 'LH' if data is known
    READ TABLE lt_sums INTO DATA(ls_lh_sum) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " This would require knowing the exact sum for LH from sflights, or mocking.
      " For demonstration, we just assert it's not zero if LH flights exist.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Total price for LH should not be initial' act = ls_lh_sum-total_price exp = 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    " This test would require mocking sflights to return an empty table.
    " For now, we assume sflights always has data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Cannot test empty table without mocking' act = abap_true exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Exportieren Sie sflights-Daten nach Excel, aber nur mit einer dynamisch ausgewählten Liste von Spalten. (Hinweis: Der tatsächliche Export erfordert eine GUI-Umgebung und wird hier nur simuliert.)
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR für die dynamische Spaltenauswahl und cl_salv_ex_util.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_all,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             planetype TYPE s_planety,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seats,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seats,
           END OF ty_sflight_all.
    TYPES tt_sflight_all TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_all WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_dynamic_columns
      IMPORTING
        it_columns TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_dynamic_data) TYPE REF TO data. " Return dynamic data for testing
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_alv_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_columns.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight_all.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_sflight> TYPE ty_sflight_all,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    DATA lt_dynamic_table TYPE REF TO data.
    DATA lr_struct_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr.
    DATA lt_components TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table.

    LOOP AT it_columns INTO DATA(lv_column_name).
      TRY.
          DATA(ls_component) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights[ 1 ] ) )->get_component( lv_column_name ).
          APPEND ls_component TO lt_components.
        CATCH cx_sy_struct_descr_error.
          " Handle unknown column, e.g., skip or raise error
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_components IS NOT INITIAL.
      lr_struct_descr = cl_abap_structdescr=>create( lt_components ).
      CREATE DATA lt_dynamic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF (lr_struct_descr->get_relative_name( )).
      ASSIGN lt_dynamic_table->* TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_table>).

      LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
        APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_dynamic_table> ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_dynamic_line>).
        LOOP AT lt_components INTO ls_component.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_sflight> TO <fs_component>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            ASSIGN COMPONENT ls_component-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_dynamic_line> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_target_component>).
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              <fs_target_component> = <fs_component>.
            ENDIF.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.

    rt_dynamic_data = lt_dynamic_table.

    " In a real scenario, you would call the export method here.
    " DATA(lo_salv_ex_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory( ).
    " lo_salv_ex_util->to_excel(
    "   EXPORTING
    "     i_t_data = <fs_dynamic_table>
    "     i_filename = 'dynamic_flights.xlsx'
    " ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_columns FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_column FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_columns FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_columns.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_alv_export( ).
    DATA lt_columns TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'CARRID' TO lt_columns.
    APPEND 'FLDATE' TO lt_columns.
    APPEND 'PRICE' TO lt_columns.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->export_dynamic_columns( lt_columns ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic data should not be initial' act = lr_dynamic_data ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    ASSIGN lr_dynamic_data->* TO <fs_table>.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Dynamic table should not be empty' act = <fs_table> ).

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_line> TYPE any.
    READ TABLE <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line> INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_carrid> TYPE s_carr_id.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'CARRID' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_carrid>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'CARRID should be present' act = <fs_carrid> ).

      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_fldate> TYPE s_date.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FLDATE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_fldate>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'FLDATE should be present' act = <fs_fldate> ).

      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_price> TYPE s_price.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PRICE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_price>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'PRICE should be present' act = <fs_price> ).

      FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_planetype> TYPE s_planety.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 'PLANETYPE' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_planetype>.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'PLANETYPE should NOT be present' act = <fs_planetype> ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_column.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_alv_export( ).
    DATA lt_columns TYPE string_table.
    APPEND 'NON_EXISTENT_COLUMN' TO lt_columns.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->export_dynamic_columns( lt_columns ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic data should be initial for invalid columns' act = lr_dynamic_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_columns.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_alv_export( ).
    DATA lt_columns TYPE string_table.

    DATA(lr_dynamic_data) = lo_cut->export_dynamic_columns( lt_columns ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Dynamic data should be initial for empty column list' act = lr_dynamic_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie man dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit ausgewählten Spalten zur Laufzeit erstellt, was für flexible ALV-Exporte nützlich ist. Es verwendet RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr`) und Field-Symbols, um die Struktur der Zieltabelle basierend auf einer Liste von Spaltennamen zu definieren und die Daten entsprechend zu füllen. Die `cl_salv_ex_util`-Klasse würde dann diese dynamisch erstellte Tabelle für den Export verwenden.
keywords: RTTI, Dynamic Programming, cl_salv_ex_util, Internal Tables, Field-Symbols

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazitäten (seatsmax) für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle sflights und addiere einen festen Zuschlag.
hint: Verwenden Sie REDUCE mit dem ADD-Operator und fügen Sie einen konstanten Wert hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_add DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity_with_surcharge
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_surcharge TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity_add IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity_with_surcharge.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum_cap = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_cap = sum_cap + flight-seatsmax
    ) + iv_surcharge. " ADD operator for surcharge
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_capacity_add( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->get_total_capacity_with_surcharge( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_surcharge = 100 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( msg = 'Total capacity with surcharge should not be initial for LH' act = lv_result exp = 0 ).
    " A more robust test would involve knowing the exact sum of seatsmax for LH.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_flights_surcharge.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Es zeigt, wie der `ADD`-Operator sowohl innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks als auch danach für weitere Berechnungen verwendet werden kann, um ein Endergebnis zu erzielen.
keywords: REDUCE, ADD, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Surcharge

Instructions: Bereiten Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten für den Export vor, wobei ein neues Feld 'TOTAL_OCCUPANCY' die Summe der belegten Sitze (seatsocc, seatsbocc, seatsfocc) enthält. Verwenden Sie cl_salv_ex_util für den Export. (Hinweis: Der tatsächliche Export erfordert eine GUI-Umgebung und wird hier nur simuliert.)
hint: Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Expression mit dem ADD-Operator, um das neue Feld zu berechnen, und cl_salv_ex_util.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_occupancy_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy_export,
             carrid        TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid        TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate        TYPE s_date,
             total_occupancy TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy_export.
    TYPES tt_flight_occupancy_export TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy_export WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS export_occupancy_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_exported_data) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy_export. " Return prepared data for testing
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_occupancy_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_occupancy_data.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsbocc, seatsfocc
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_exported_data = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      ( carrid        = flight-carrid
        connid        = flight-connid
        fldate        = flight-fldate
        total_occupancy = flight-seatsocc + flight-seatsbocc + flight-seatsfocc ) " ADD operator
    ).

    " In a real scenario, you would call the export method here.
    " DATA(lo_salv_ex_util) = cl_salv_ex_util=>factory( ).
    " lo_salv_ex_util->to_excel(
    "   EXPORTING
    "     i_t_data = rt_exported_data
    "     i_filename = 'flight_occupancy.xlsx'
    " ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_occupancy_calculation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_occupancy_calculation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_occupancy_export( ).
    DATA(lt_occupancy_data) = lo_cut->export_occupancy_data( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Occupancy data should not be empty' act = lt_occupancy_data ).

    READ TABLE lt_occupancy_data INTO DATA(ls_occupancy) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA ls_sflight TYPE sflights.
      SELECT SINGLE seatsocc, seatsbocc, seatsfocc
        FROM sflights
        INTO @ls_sflight
        WHERE carrid = @ls_occupancy-carrid
          AND connid = @ls_occupancy-connid
          AND fldate = @ls_occupancy-fldate.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        DATA(lv_expected_occupancy) = ls_sflight-seatsocc + ls_sflight-seatsbocc + ls_sflight-seatsfocc.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
          msg = 'Calculated total occupancy mismatch'
          act = ls_occupancy-total_occupancy
          exp = lv_expected_occupancy
        ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_sflights.
    " This test would require mocking sflights to return an empty table.
    " For now, we assume sflights always has data.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( msg = 'Cannot test empty sflights without mocking' act = abap_true exp = abap_true ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Vorbereitung von Daten für den ALV-Export, indem ein neues Feld `TOTAL_OCCUPANCY` mithilfe einer `FOR`-Expression und des `ADD`-Operators berechnet wird. Die `cl_salv_ex_util`-Klasse würde dann diese angereicherte Tabelle für den Export verwenden. Der Unit-Test validiert die korrekte Berechnung des neuen Feldes.
keywords: FOR, ADD, cl_salv_ex_util, Internal Tables, Data Transformation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Standardtabelle mit Flugdaten, indem Sie `VALUE #` und eine `FOR`-Schleife verwenden, um Einträge zu generieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie `VALUE #( FOR ... )` für die Tabellenkonstruktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_populate_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_sample_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_populate_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_sample_flights.
    rt_flights = VALUE #( FOR i = 1 UP TO 3
                           ( carrid = 'LH'
                             connid = CONV sflight-connid( 100 + i )
                             fldate = sy-datum + i
                             price  = 100.00 + ( i * 10 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_sample_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_sample_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_populate_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_sample_flights( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH'
                                        msg = 'Expected carrier LH' ).

explanation: Der `VALUE #` Operator in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte und deklarative Initialisierung und Befüllung von internen Tabellen. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Lesbarkeit.

Instructions: Filtern Sie eine Standardtabelle von Flugdaten, um nur Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft anzuzeigen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FILTER #` mit einer Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_filter_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_filter_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_filter_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_stt_filter_flights=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights( it_all_flights = lt_all_flights iv_carrid = 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2
                                        msg = 'Expected 2 filtered flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH'
                                        msg = 'First filtered flight should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-connid exp = '003'
                                        msg = 'Second filtered flight should be connid 003' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER #` Operator bietet eine deklarative und sehr lesbare Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zu filtern. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und oft performanter als eine explizite `LOOP AT ... WHERE` Schleife mit `APPEND`.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, FILTER, Internal Tables, Table Filter

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie in einer Standardtabelle von Flugdaten den Preis für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft um einen Prozentsatz.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `CORRESPONDING` für die Aktualisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_update_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_prices
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_percent TYPE decfloat16.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_update_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_prices.
    ct_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN ct_flights
                           WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
                           ( <fs_flight> WITH price = <fs_flight>-price * ( 1 + iv_percent / 100 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flight_prices FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_update_flights( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_stt_update_flights=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 )
    ).

    lo_cut->update_flight_prices( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights
                                  IMPORTING iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_percent = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price exp = 110.00
                                        msg = 'LH 001 price should be 110.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 2 ]-price exp = 200.00
                                        msg = 'UA 002 price should remain 200.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-price exp = 165.00
                                        msg = 'LH 003 price should be 165.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination aus `VALUE #` mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und der `WITH` Klausel ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Modifikation von Tabelleneinträgen. Anstatt eine explizite Schleife zu schreiben und `MODIFY TABLE` zu verwenden, wird hier eine neue Tabelle basierend auf der alten erstellt, wobei die gewünschten Einträge angepasst werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich für funktionale Programmieransätze.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, FOR, VALUE, UPDATE, Internal Tables, Table Modification

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen einzelnen Flug aus einer Standardtabelle anhand der Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie Tabellenausdrücke `itab[ key_field = value ]`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_read_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_details
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid  TYPE sflight-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_read_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_details.
    rs_flight = it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ].
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_existing_flight FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_non_existing_flight FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_read_flight( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_stt_read_flight=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(ls_flight) = lo_cut->get_flight_details( it_flights = lt_flights
                                                  iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '001' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-price exp = 100
                                        msg = 'Expected price 100 for LH 001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_non_existing_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_read_flight( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_stt_read_flight=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 )
    ).

    " Expecting an exception for non-existing line
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises( act = NEW zcl_stt_read_flight( )->get_flight_details(
                                                  it_flights = lt_flights
                                                  iv_carrid = 'XX' iv_connid = '999' )
                                        exp_class = 'CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenausdrücke (`itab[ key_field = value ]`) sind die moderne und prägnante Art, auf einzelne Zeilen in internen Tabellen zuzugreifen. Sie ersetzen die ältere `READ TABLE` Anweisung für den Zugriff über Schlüssel und werfen eine Ausnahme (`CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND`), wenn der Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, was eine klare Fehlerbehandlung ermöglicht.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, Table Expression, READ TABLE, Internal Tables

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in einer Standardtabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE #` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_reduce_passengers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             passmax  TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_reduce_passengers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR <fs_flight> IN it_flights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + <fs_flight>-passmax ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_passengers FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_reduce_passengers( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_stt_reduce_passengers=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' passmax = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' passmax = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' passmax = 120 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 470
                                        msg = 'Expected total passengers 470' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_reduce_passengers( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_stt_reduce_passengers=>tt_flights( ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = 0
                                        msg = 'Expected total passengers 0 for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE #` Operator ermöglicht eine funktionale und deklarative Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen. Er initialisiert einen Akkumulator (`sum`) und iteriert über die Tabelle, um den Akkumulator in jedem Schritt zu aktualisieren. Dies ist eine moderne Alternative zu expliziten `LOOP AT` Schleifen für Aggregationsaufgaben.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie in der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` den Preis für einen bestimmten Flug.
hint: Nutzen Sie `UPDATE ... FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_upd_sflights_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             mandt  TYPE sflight-mandt,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
        iv_new_price  TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS create_test_data IMPORTING is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key.
    METHODS delete_test_data IMPORTING is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_upd_sflights_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    ls_sflight-mandt  = is_flight_key-mandt.
    ls_sflight-carrid = is_flight_key-carrid.
    ls_sflight-connid = is_flight_key-connid.
    ls_sflight-fldate = is_flight_key-fldate.
    ls_sflight-price  = iv_new_price.

    UPDATE sflight FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_test_data.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    ls_sflight-mandt  = is_flight_key-mandt.
    ls_sflight-carrid = is_flight_key-carrid.
    ls_sflight-connid = is_flight_key-connid.
    ls_sflight-fldate = is_flight_key-fldate.
    ls_sflight-price  = 100.00.
    ls_sflight-currency = 'EUR'.
    INSERT sflight FROM ls_sflight.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_test_data.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE mandt = is_flight_key-mandt
                         AND carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
                         AND connid = is_flight_key-connid
                         AND fldate = is_flight_key-fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_single_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_single_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_upd_sflights_single( ).
    DATA(ls_flight_key) = VALUE zcl_upd_sflights_single=>ty_flight_key(
      mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'LH' connid = '007' fldate = sy-datum + 1 ).

    " Setup: Create test data
    lo_cut->create_test_data( ls_flight_key ).

    " Test: Update price
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->update_flight_price( is_flight_key = ls_flight_key iv_new_price = 199.99 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_success msg = 'Update should be successful' ).

    " Verification: Read from DB and check
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflight INTO ls_sflight
      WHERE mandt = ls_flight_key-mandt
        AND carrid = ls_flight_key-carrid
        AND connid = ls_flight_key-connid
        AND fldate = ls_flight_key-fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-price exp = 199.99
                                        msg = 'Price should be updated to 199.99' ).

    " Cleanup: Delete test data
    lo_cut->delete_test_data( ls_flight_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UPDATE dbtab FROM CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF wa` Anweisung ist die moderne und empfohlene Methode, um einzelne Zeilen in einer Datenbanktabelle zu aktualisieren. Sie verwendet die Felder der Workarea, die den Schlüsselfeldern der Datenbanktabelle entsprechen, um den zu aktualisierenden Datensatz zu finden, und aktualisiert dann alle anderen passenden Felder. Dies ist sicherer und weniger fehleranfällig als die manuelle Angabe von `SET` Klauseln.
keywords: UPDATE, DATABASE TABLE, SFLIGHTS, CORRESPONDING, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie in der Datenbanktabelle `sflights` den Preis für mehrere Flüge basierend auf einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_upd_sflights_mass DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_update,
             mandt  TYPE sflight-mandt,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_update.
    TYPES tt_flight_updates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_update WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS mass_update_flight_prices
      IMPORTING
        it_flight_updates TYPE tt_flight_updates
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_rows_updated) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS create_test_data IMPORTING it_flight_updates TYPE tt_flight_updates.
    METHODS delete_test_data IMPORTING it_flight_updates TYPE tt_flight_updates.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_upd_sflights_mass IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD mass_update_flight_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflight_updates TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Map the input table to the SFLIGHT structure
    lt_sflight_updates = CORRESPONDING #( it_flight_updates MAPPING price = price ).

    UPDATE sflight FROM TABLE lt_sflight_updates.
    rv_rows_updated = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_test_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    lt_sflight = VALUE #( FOR ls_update IN it_flight_updates
                           ( mandt = ls_update-mandt
                             carrid = ls_update-carrid
                             connid = ls_update-connid
                             fldate = ls_update-fldate
                             price = 100.00
                             currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM TABLE lt_sflight ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD delete_test_data.
    DATA: lt_sflight_keys TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    lt_sflight_keys = CORRESPONDING #( it_flight_updates ).
    DELETE sflight FROM TABLE lt_sflight_keys.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mass_update_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mass_update_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_upd_sflights_mass( ).
    DATA(lt_updates) = VALUE zcl_upd_sflights_mass=>tt_flight_updates(
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'LH' connid = '008' fldate = sy-datum + 2 price = 250.00 )
      ( mandt = sy-mandt carrid = 'UA' connid = '009' fldate = sy-datum + 3 price = 350.00 )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_rows_updated exp = 2

    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_sflight-price exp = 250.00

Die interne Tabelle (`itab`) muss dabei die Schlüsselfelder und die zu aktualisierenden Felder enthalten. Instructions: Modifizieren Sie einen Eintrag in einer Standardtabelle an einer bestimmten Position und aktualisieren Sie nur spezifische Felder.
hint: Nutzen Sie `MODIFY TABLE ... INDEX ... TRANSPORTING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_modify_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS modify_flight_by_index
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_index   TYPE i
        iv_new_price TYPE sflight-price
        iv_new_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_modify_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD modify_flight_by_index.
    DATA: ls_flight_update TYPE ty_flight.

    ls_flight_update-price    = iv_new_price.
    ls_flight_update-currency = iv_new_currency.

    MODIFY TABLE ct_flights FROM ls_flight_update INDEX iv_index TRANSPORTING price currency.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_success = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TRANSPORTING ...` Anweisung ist eine präzise Methode, um einen bestimmten Eintrag in einer internen Tabelle anhand seines Index zu aktualisieren und dabei nur ausgewählte Felder zu ändern. Dies ist effizienter als das Aktualisieren des gesamten Datensatzes, wenn nur wenige Felder betroffen sind, und vermeidet unbeabsichtigte Änderungen an anderen Feldern.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue Standardtabelle, die nur Flüge enthält, die eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllen, und passen Sie dabei ein Feld an.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` mit `COND #`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_cond_for_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_special_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflight-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_special_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_cond_for_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_special_flights.
    rt_special_flights = VALUE #( FOR <fs_flight> IN it_all_flights
                                  WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                                  ( <fs_flight> WITH status = COND string( WHEN <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH' THEN 'Preferred' ELSE 'Standard' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_special_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_matching_flights FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_special_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_cond_for_table( ).
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE zcl_stt_cond_for_table=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = 250 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_special ) exp = 2
                                        msg = 'Expected 2 special flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_special[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'UA'
                                        msg = 'First special flight should be UA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_special[ 1 ]-status exp = 'Standard'
                                        msg = 'UA flight status should be Standard' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_special[ 2 ]-status exp = 'Preferred'
                                        msg = 'LH flight status should be Preferred' ).

  METHOD test_no_matching_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_cond_for_table( ).

explanation: Diese Lösung demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `VALUE #` mit `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` für die selektive Iteration und den `WITH` Zusatz für die Modifikation von Feldern während der Konstruktion einer neuen Tabelle. Zusätzlich wird der `COND #` Operator verwendet, um eine bedingte Zuweisung für das Feld `status` vorzunehmen. Dies ermöglicht eine sehr kompakte, deklarative und ausdrucksstarke Transformation von Tabellendaten.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, FOR, COND, VALUE, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, Table Transformation

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flüge in eine Standardtabelle ein, wobei Sie sicherstellen, dass keine Duplikate basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer hinzugefügt werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... INTO TABLE ...` mit `LINES OF` und `EXCEPT`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_insert_unique DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS add_unique_flights
      CHANGING
        ct_existing_flights TYPE tt_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_new_flights      TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_added_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_insert_unique IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_unique_flights.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( ct_existing_flights ).

    INSERT LINES OF it_new_flights INTO TABLE ct_existing_flights EXCEPT DUPLICATE KEYS.

    rv_added_count = lines( ct_existing_flights ) - lv_initial_lines.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_add_unique_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_with_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_add_empty_new_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_unique_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_insert_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_existing) = VALUE zcl_stt_insert_unique=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_new) = VALUE zcl_stt_insert_unique=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_added) = lo_cut->add_unique_flights( CHANGING ct_existing_flights = lt_existing
                                                 IMPORTING it_new_flights = lt_new ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_added exp = 2
                                        msg = 'Expected 2 new flights added' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_existing ) exp = 3
                                        msg = 'Expected total 3 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_stt_line_exists=>check_flight_exists( it_flights = lt_existing iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '002' )
                                       msg = 'UA 002 should exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_with_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_insert_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_existing) = VALUE zcl_stt_insert_unique=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_new) = VALUE zcl_stt_insert_unique=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum + 1 price = 110 ) " Duplicate
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_added) = lo_cut->add_unique_flights( CHANGING ct_existing_flights = lt_existing
                                                 IMPORTING it_new_flights = lt_new ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_added exp = 1
                                        msg = 'Expected 1 new flight added (duplicate ignored)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_existing ) exp = 2
                                        msg = 'Expected total 2 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = zcl_stt_line_exists=>check_flight_exists( it_flights = lt_existing iv_carrid = 'UA' iv_connid = '002' )
                                       msg = 'UA 002 should exist' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_existing[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' ]-price exp = 100
                                        msg = 'Original LH 001 price should remain' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_add_empty_new_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_insert_unique( ).
    DATA(lt_existing) = VALUE zcl_stt_insert_unique=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_new) = VALUE zcl_stt_insert_unique=>tt_flights( ).

    DATA(lv_added) = lo_cut->add_unique_flights( CHANGING ct_existing_flights = lt_existing
                                                 IMPORTING it_new_flights = lt_new ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_added exp = 0
                                        msg = 'Expected 0 new flights added for empty input' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_existing ) exp = 1
                                        msg = 'Expected total 1 flight' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT LINES OF itab INTO TABLE itab EXCEPT DUPLICATE KEYS` Anweisung ist die moderne und effiziente Methode, um mehrere Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle einzufügen, wobei Duplikate (basierend auf dem Tabellenschlüssel der Zieltabelle) automatisch ignoriert werden. Dies ist besonders nützlich, um Datenmengen zusammenzuführen und dabei die Integrität der Zieltabelle zu wahren.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, INSERT, LINES OF, EXCEPT DUPLICATE KEYS, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie eine Standardtabelle mit Daten aus einer anderen Tabelle, wobei nur übereinstimmende Einträge aktualisiert und nur spezifische Felder übertragen werden sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE TABLE ... FROM TABLE ... TRANSPORTING ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_update_from_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS update_flights_from_source
      CHANGING
        ct_target_flights TYPE tt_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_update_from_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flights_from_source.
    UPDATE TABLE ct_target_flights FROM TABLE it_source_flights TRANSPORTING price currency.
    rv_updated_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum ]-price exp = 110

                                        msg = 'UA 002 price should not change' ).

  METHOD test_update_non_existing_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_update_from_table( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_stt_update_from_table=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' )

                                        msg = 'Expected 0 flights updated for non-matching entries' ).

  METHOD test_update_partial_match.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_update_from_table( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = VALUE zcl_stt_update_from_table=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 currency = 'USD' )

                                        msg = 'Target table size should remain 2' ).

explanation: Die `UPDATE TABLE itab1 FROM TABLE itab2 TRANSPORTING f1 f2 ...` Anweisung ist eine leistungsstarke Methode, um eine interne Tabelle (`itab1`) mit Daten aus einer anderen internen Tabelle (`itab2`) zu aktualisieren. Die Aktualisierung erfolgt basierend auf den Schlüsseln der Zieltabelle, und mit der `TRANSPORTING` Klausel können Sie explizit angeben, welche Felder aktualisiert werden sollen. Dies ist eine effiziente und deklarative Art der Tabellenintegration.

Instructions: Löschen Sie alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus einer Standardtabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE FROM TABLE ... WHERE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_delete_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS delete_flights_by_carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_delete_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD delete_flights_by_carrid.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( ct_flights ).

    DELETE ct_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    rv_deleted_count = lv_initial_lines - lines( ct_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
