Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Einträge in einer Standardtabelle, die einer Bedingung entsprechen, durch neue Einträge aus einer Quelltabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REPLACE TABLE ... FROM TABLE ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_replace_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid fldate.

    METHODS replace_flights_by_carrid
      CHANGING
        ct_target_flights TYPE tt_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid         TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_replaced_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_replace_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_flights_by_carrid.
    DATA(lt_flights_to_replace) = FILTER #( it_source_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid ).

    REPLACE TABLE ct_target_flights FROM TABLE lt_flights_to_replace.

    rv_replaced_count = sy-dbcnt.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

explanation: Die `REPLACE TABLE itab1 FROM TABLE itab2` Anweisung ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle (`itab1`) durch Zeilen aus einer Quelltabelle (`itab2`) zu ersetzen oder hinzuzufügen. Wenn ein Eintrag in `itab1` mit einem Eintrag in `itab2` (basierend auf dem Tabellenschlüssel) übereinstimmt, wird er ersetzt. Andernfalls wird der Eintrag aus `itab2` zu `itab1` hinzugefügt. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Operation für die Synchronisierung von Tabellen.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, REPLACE TABLE, FROM TABLE, Internal Tables, Data Manipulation

CLASS zcl_stt_sort_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Obwohl es keine brandneue Syntax ist, ist sie ein grundlegender Bestandteil der effizienten Tabellenmanipulation und wird hier im Kontext moderner ABAP-Praktiken gezeigt.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie doppelte Einträge aus einer Standardtabelle basierend auf Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer, wobei der erste gefundene Eintrag beibehalten wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM itab COMPARING f1 f2 ...`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_stt_delete_duplicates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_duplicates
      CHANGING
        ct_flights TYPE tt_flights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_deleted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_stt_delete_duplicates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lv_initial_lines) = lines( ct_flights ).

    " First, sort the table by the fields to compare for duplicates
    SORT ct_flights BY carrid connid.

    " Then, delete adjacent duplicates
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM ct_flights COMPARING carrid connid.

    rv_deleted_count = lv_initial_lines - lines( ct_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_stt_delete_duplicates=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum + 1 price = 110 ) " Duplicate
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' fldate = sy-datum price = 150 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum + 2 price = 210 ) " Duplicate
    ).

    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->remove_duplicates( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 2
                                        msg = 'Expected 2 duplicates deleted' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 3
                                        msg = 'Expected 3 unique flights remaining' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH'
                                        msg = 'First unique flight carrid should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-connid exp = '001'
                                        msg = 'First unique flight connid should be 001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-price exp = 100
                                        msg = 'Original price for LH 001 should be kept' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_stt_delete_duplicates=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '001' fldate = sy-datum price = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '002' fldate = sy-datum price = 200 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->remove_duplicates( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 0
                                        msg = 'Expected 0 duplicates deleted' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 2
                                        msg = 'Expected 2 flights remaining' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_stt_delete_duplicates( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_stt_delete_duplicates=>tt_flights( ).

    DATA(lv_deleted) = lo_cut->remove_duplicates( CHANGING ct_flights = lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_deleted exp = 0
                                        msg = 'Expected 0 duplicates deleted for empty table' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights
                                        msg = 'Empty table should remain empty' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM itab COMPARING f1 f2 ...` Anweisung ist die klassische und effiziente Methode, um Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle zu entfernen. Es ist wichtig, die Tabelle vorher nach den Vergleichsfeldern zu sortieren, da die Anweisung nur direkt aufeinanderfolgende Duplikate löscht. Dies ist eine bewährte Methode zur Datenbereinigung in internen Tabellen.
keywords: STANDARD TABLE, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, SORT, Internal Tables, Data Cleansing

CLASS zcl_flight_connid_extractor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_connid.

CLASS zcl_flight_connid_extractor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_connids.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( 
                                     cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT' AND 
                                     seatsfree > 100 
                                   ) (
                                     flight

explanation: Die WHERE-Klausel innerhalb einer FOR-Expression ermöglicht eine deklarative und effiziente Filterung von internen Tabellen. Dies ist wesentlich kürzer und oft performanter als eine explizite LOOP-Anweisung mit IF-Bedingungen.
keywords: FOR, WHERE, Internal Tables, Filter

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise (PRICE) für Flüge, die von 'NEW YORK' abfliegen, aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FOR mit dem REDUCE-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_price_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_price_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum TYPE sflights-price VALUE 0
                                FOR flight IN it_sflights WHERE ( cityfrom = 'NEW YORK' )
                                NEXT sum = sum + flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_calculate_total_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_total_price.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'. <fs_flight>-price = '100.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'FRANKFURT'. <fs_flight>-price = '200.00'.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-cityfrom = 'NEW YORK'. <fs_flight>-price = '150.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_price_reducer( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total exp = '250.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der REDUCE-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen in einer einzigen, deklarativen Anweisung. In Kombination mit FOR und WHERE können komplexe Aggregationen sehr elegant und effizient ausgedrückt werden.
keywords: FOR, REDUCE, Aggregation, Internal Tables, Math

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus SFLIGHTS nach Fluggesellschaft (CARRID) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Speichern Sie das Ergebnis in einer neuen internen Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine FOR-Expression mit GROUP BY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid    TYPE sflights-carrid,
             flight_nr TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES tt_flight_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_counts) TYPE tt_flight_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    rt_grouped_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = flight-carrid ) 
                                 ( carrid = flight-carrid
                                   flight_nr = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

explanation: Die GROUP BY-Klausel innerhalb einer FOR-Expression ermöglicht eine leistungsstarke und deklarative Gruppierung von Daten in internen Tabellen. Dies ersetzt komplexe LOOP-AT-Anweisungen mit COLLECT oder SORT und LOOP.
keywords: FOR, GROUP BY, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Grouping

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die ein CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT-Control in einem übergebenen Container instanziiert und einen vordefinierten Text setzen kann. Die Klasse soll eine Methode zum Erstellen des Controls und eine zum Setzen des Textes bereitstellen.

CLASS zcl_textedit_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_textedit_manager IMPLEMENTATION.

Durch die Übergabe eines Parent-Containers im Konstruktor wird die Wiederverwendbarkeit erhöht. Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die einen CL_GUI_BUTTON in einem Container erstellt und einen Event-Handler für den BUTTON_CLICK-Event implementiert. Der Event-Handler soll eine interne Variable der Klasse setzen, die den Klick-Status anzeigt.
hint: Implementieren Sie ein Event-Handler-Interface für CL_GUI_BUTTON und registrieren Sie den Handler mit SET HANDLER.
solution:
CLASS zcl_button_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    EVENTS button_clicked EXPORTING VALUE(e_button_id) TYPE string.

    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container
                                  iv_button_text      TYPE string
                                  iv_button_id        TYPE string.

    METHODS get_click_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_clicked) TYPE abap_bool.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_button TYPE REF TO cl_gui_button.
    DATA mv_button_id TYPE string.
    DATA mv_clicked TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    METHODS handle_button_click FOR EVENT button_click OF cl_gui_button
      IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_button_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_button_id = iv_button_id.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_button
      EXPORTING
        parent = io_parent_container
        text   = iv_button_text.

    SET HANDLER handle_button_click FOR mo_button.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_button_click.
    mv_clicked = abap_true.
    RAISE EVENT button_clicked EXPORTING e_button_id = mv_button_id.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_click_status.
    rv_clicked = mv_clicked.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_button_event_handling FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_button_event_handling.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'TEST_CONTAINER'.

    DATA(lo_button_manager) = NEW zcl_button_handler( io_parent_container = lo_container
                                                      iv_button_text      = 'Click Me'
                                                      iv_button_id        = 'BTN_01' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_button_manager->get_click_status( ) exp = abap_false ).

    " Simulate button click by directly calling the event handler method
    CALL METHOD lo_button_manager->handle_button_click
      EXPORTING
        sender = lo_button_manager->mo_button.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_button_manager->get_click_status( ) exp = abap_true ).

    CALL METHOD lo_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die ereignisgesteuerte Programmierung mit GUI-Controls. Die Klasse kapselt den Button und seinen Event-Handler. Durch SET HANDLER wird die Methode handle_button_click als Reaktion auf den BUTTON_CLICK-Event registriert. Im Unit-Test wird der Event-Handler direkt aufgerufen, um die Logik zu testen, da eine echte GUI-Interaktion im Unit-Test-Framework nicht möglich ist.
keywords: CL_GUI_BUTTON, Events, Object Orientation, GUI, SET HANDLER

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus SFLIGHTS, die für jeden Flug den Status 'Langstrecke' setzt, wenn die Flugdauer (FLTIME) über 5 Stunden (300 Minuten) liegt, ansonsten 'Kurzstrecke'.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Expression in Kombination mit dem COND-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fltime   TYPE sflights-fltime,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights (
                                     carrid = flight-carrid,
                                     connid = flight-connid,
                                     fltime = flight-fltime,
                                     status = COND string( WHEN flight-fltime > 300 THEN 'Langstrecke' ELSE 'Kurzstrecke' )
                                   ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_statuses FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_statuses.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fltime = 350. " Long
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'. <fs_flight>-fltime = 180. " Short
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0020'. <fs_flight>-fltime = 300. " Short (not > 300)

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_cond( ).
    DATA(lt_statuses) = lo_cut->get_flight_statuses( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_statuses ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_statuses[ connid = '0400' ]-status exp = 'Langstrecke' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_statuses[ connid = '0010' ]-status exp = 'Kurzstrecke' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_statuses[ connid = '0020' ]-status exp = 'Kurzstrecke' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der COND-Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und lesbare bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. In Kombination mit FOR-Expressions können so neue Tabellen mit berechneten Feldern basierend auf Bedingungen erstellt werden, ohne explizite IF-Anweisungen.
keywords: FOR, COND, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle aus SFLIGHTS, die für jeden Flug den Status 'Sehr Lang', 'Lang', 'Mittel' oder 'Kurz' basierend auf der Flugdauer (FLTIME) setzt (z.B. >8h, >5h, >2h, <=2h).
hint: Verwenden Sie eine FOR-Expression in Kombination mit dem SWITCH-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_status_switch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status_ext,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fltime   TYPE sflights-fltime,
             status   TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status_ext.
    TYPES tt_flight_status_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status_ext WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses_ext
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE tt_flight_status_ext.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_status_switch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses_ext.
    rt_flight_statuses = VALUE #( FOR flight IN it_sflights (
                                     carrid = flight-carrid,
                                     connid = flight-connid,
                                     fltime = flight-fltime,
                                     status = SWITCH string( WHEN flight-fltime > 480 THEN 'Sehr Lang' " > 8h
                                                            WHEN flight-fltime > 300 THEN 'Lang'      " > 5h
                                                            WHEN flight-fltime > 120 THEN 'Mittel'    " > 2h
                                                            ELSE 'Kurz' )
                                   ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_statuses_ext FOR TESTING.

  METHOD test_flight_statuses_ext.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'. <fs_flight>-fltime = 500. " Lang
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'AA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0010'. <fs_flight>-fltime = 90.  " Kurz
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'UA'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0020'. <fs_flight>-fltime = 150. " Mittel
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_flight>.
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'DL'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0030'. <fs_flight>-fltime = 600. " Sehr Lang

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_status_switch( ).
    DATA(lt_statuses) = lo_cut->get_flight_statuses_ext( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_statuses ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_statuses[ connid = '0400' ]-status exp = 'Lang' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_statuses[ connid = '0010' ]-status exp = 'Kurz' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_statuses[ connid = '0020' ]-status exp = 'Mittel' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_statuses[ connid = '0030' ]-status exp = 'Sehr Lang' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der SWITCH-Operator bietet eine elegante Möglichkeit, mehrere bedingte Zuweisungen in einer einzigen Expression zu handhaben, ähnlich einer CASE-Anweisung. In Kombination mit FOR-Expressions führt dies zu sehr prägnantem und effizientem Code für die Datenmanipulation.
keywords: FOR, SWITCH, Conditional Logic, Internal Tables

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die einen CL_GUI_ALV_GRID in einem übergebenen Container instanziiert und Daten aus SFLIGHTS anzeigt. Die Klasse soll eine Methode zum Anzeigen der Daten bereitstellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_GUI_ALV_GRID und die Methode SET_TABLE_FOR_FIRST_DISPLAY.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_grid_display DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
    METHODS display_sflights IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    DATA mo_parent_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_grid_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mo_parent_container = io_parent_container.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_alv_grid
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = mo_parent_container.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD display_sflights.
    IF mo_alv_grid IS BOUND.
      CALL METHOD mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display
        EXPORTING
          i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
          is_variant       = VALUE #( report = sy-repid )
        CHANGING
          it_outtab        = it_sflights.
      mo_alv_grid->frontend_update( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_alv_grid_creation FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_alv_grid_display FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_grid_creation.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'TEST_CONTAINER'.

    DATA(lo_alv_manager) = NEW zcl_alv_grid_display( lo_container ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_alv_manager->mo_alv_grid ).

    CALL METHOD lo_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_alv_grid_display.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'TEST_CONTAINER'.

    DATA(lo_alv_manager) = NEW zcl_alv_grid_display( lo_container ).

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

    " The actual display cannot be fully tested in unit test, but we can check if the method is called
    " and if the internal table is passed.
    " For a real test, one might use test doubles/mocks for cl_gui_alv_grid.
    " Here, we just ensure the method call doesn't dump and the object is bound.
    TRY.
        lo_alv_manager->display_sflights( lt_sflights ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_bound( lo_alv_manager->mo_alv_grid ).
      CATCH cx_root.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Exception during ALV display' ).
    ENDTRY.

    CALL METHOD lo_container->free.
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Diese Klasse kapselt die Logik zur Anzeige von Daten in einem CL_GUI_ALV_GRID. Die Methode SET_TABLE_FOR_FIRST_DISPLAY ist der Standardweg, um Daten an das ALV zu übergeben. Der Unit-Test konzentriert sich auf die Instanziierung des ALV-Objekts und den Aufruf der Anzeigemethode, da die visuelle Darstellung nicht direkt im Unit-Test überprüft werden kann.
keywords: CL_GUI_ALV_GRID, CL_GUI_CONTAINER, GUI, ALV, Object Orientation

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob in der Tabelle SFLIGHTS ein Flug mit der Flugnummer 'LH400' existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie die Funktion LINE_EXISTS.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_checker DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    METHODS check_flight_exists
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid
        iv_connid   TYPE sflights-connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_checker IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_flight_exists.
    rv_exists = xsdbool( LINE_EXISTS( it_sflights[ carrid = iv_carrid connid = iv_connid ] ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

  METHOD test_flight_not_exists.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
    <fs_flight>-carrid = 'LH'. <fs_flight>-connid = '0400'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_checker( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_exists exp = abap_false ).

ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Funktion LINE_EXISTS ermöglicht eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Überprüfung, ob eine Zeile mit bestimmten Schlüsseln in einer internen Tabelle existiert. Dies ist performanter als ein LOOP mit IF-Bedingung, insbesondere bei großen Tabellen mit definiertem Sekundärschlüssel.
keywords: LINE_EXISTS, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen String, der die Fluggesellschaft und die Flugnummer aus einem SFLIGHTS-Eintrag in einem lesbaren Format kombiniert, z.B. 'Flug LH 0400'.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates.
solution:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine ABAP-Klasse, die eine Methode mit optionalen Parametern hat. Die Methode soll eine Begrüßung zurückgeben, die sich an den übergebenen Parametern orientiert (z.B. 'Hallo Herr Mustermann' oder 'Hallo Frau Müller').
hint: Nutzen Sie optionale Parameter mit DEFAULT-Werten und String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_greeting_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_greeting
      IMPORTING
        iv_name    TYPE string
        iv_gender  TYPE c LENGTH 1 OPTIONAL " 'M' for Male, 'F' for Female
        iv_title   TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_greeting) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_greeting_generator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_greeting.
    DATA(lv_salutation) = COND string(
                               WHEN iv_gender = 'M' THEN 'Herr'
                               WHEN iv_gender = 'F' THEN 'Frau'
                               ELSE '' ).

    rv_greeting = |Hallo { lv_salutation } { iv_title } { iv_name }|.
    " Remove multiple spaces if title or salutation are empty
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX '\s+' IN rv_greeting WITH ' '.
    rv_greeting = |{ rv_greeting ALPHA = OUT }|.
    " Trim leading/trailing spaces
    SHIFT rv_greeting LEFT DELETING LEADING SPACE.
    SHIFT rv_greeting RIGHT DELETING TRAILING SPACE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Sortieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) aufsteigend und anschließend nach Flugnummer (`connid`) absteigend.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `SORT` Anweisung mit der `BY` Klausel und den Optionen `ASCENDING` und `DESCENDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_modern_sort_001 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS sort_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sorted_flights) TYPE tt_sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_modern_sort_001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_flights.
    rt_sorted_flights = it_flights.
    SORT rt_sorted_flights BY carrid ASCENDING connid DESCENDING.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '002' fldate = '20230102' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '003' fldate = '20230103' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' fldate = '20230104' )

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_flights[2]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Second carrid should be AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_flights[2]-connid exp = '001' msg = 'Second connid for AA should be 001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_flights[3]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Third carrid should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_flights[3]-connid exp = '003' msg = 'Third connid for LH should be 003' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_sorted_flights[4]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'Fourth carrid should be LH' ).

keywords: SORT, Internal Tables, ASCENDING, DESCENDING

Instructions: Filtern Sie aus der Tabelle `sflights` alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft ('LH') und transformieren Sie die relevanten Daten (Flugnummer, Abflugdatum, Sitzplatzbelegung) in eine neue interne Tabelle, die für eine einfache Darstellung im `cl_gui_ecl_2dviewer` geeignet wäre. Die neue Tabelle soll nur diese drei Felder enthalten.
hint: Nutzen Sie Tabellenausdrücke (`FILTER`) und Konstruktorausdrücke (`VALUE` mit `FOR`) zur Datenaufbereitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_modern_view_001 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_viewer_data,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_viewer_data.
    TYPES: tt_viewer_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_viewer_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS prepare_flight_data
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_viewer_data) TYPE tt_viewer_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_modern_view_001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD prepare_flight_data.
    rt_viewer_data = VALUE tt_viewer_data(
      FOR flight IN FILTER tt_sflight( it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( connid = flight-connid,
        fldate = flight-fldate,
        seatsocc = flight-seatsocc )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

             connid TYPE sflight-connid,

    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_summary_text) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_abap_modern_view_003 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_top_carrier_summary.
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = REDUCE tt_flight_counts(
      INIT counts = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF struct_count WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid
      FOR flight IN it_all_flights
      LET current_count = counts[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid ]-count ?? 0 IN
      counts = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF struct_count(
        counts
        ( carrid = flight-carrid count = current_count + 1 )
      )
    ).

    DATA(ls_top_carrier) = REDUCE struct_count(
      INIT top_carrier = VALUE struct_count( carrid = '' count = 0 )
      FOR carrier_count IN lt_flight_counts
      WHERE carrier_count-count > top_carrier-count
      ( carrier_count )
    ).

    IF ls_top_carrier-carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_summary_text = |Top Fluggesellschaft: { ls_top_carrier-carrid } mit { ls_top_carrier-count } Flügen.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_summary_text = 'Keine Flugdaten verfügbar.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Sitzplatzbelegung (`seatsocc`) aller Flüge in `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft ('LH').
hint: Nutzen Sie den `REDUCE` Operator, um die Summe der belegten Sitze und die Anzahl der Flüge zu ermitteln.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_modern_math_001 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_occupancy) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_modern_math_001 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_occupancy.
    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE struct_agg(
      INIT agg = VALUE struct_agg( total_seats = 0 num_flights = 0 )
      FOR flight IN it_all_flights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      NEXT agg = VALUE struct_agg(
        total_seats = agg-total_seats + flight-seatsocc
        num_flights = agg-num_flights + 1
      )
    ).

    IF ls_aggregation-num_flights > 0.
      rv_average_occupancy = ls_aggregation-total_seats / ls_aggregation-num_flights.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_occupancy = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

TYPES: BEGIN OF struct_agg,
         total_seats TYPE i,
         num_flights TYPE i,
       END OF struct_agg.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie die Flüge aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und ermitteln Sie für jede Gruppe die Anzahl der Flüge und die Summe der belegten Sitze (`seatsocc`).
hint: Nutzen Sie den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck in einem `FOR` Loop innerhalb eines `VALUE` Konstruktors.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abap_modern_tabl_005 DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
             total_seats TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_summary.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_carrier_summaries
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_summaries) TYPE tt_carrier_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abap_modern_tabl_005 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_summaries.
    rt_carrier_summaries = VALUE tt_carrier_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN it_all_flights BY flight-carrid
      GROUP SIZE DATA(lv_count)
      ( carrid       = flight-carrid,
        flight_count = lv_count,
        total_seats  = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0 FOR member IN GROUP flight NEXT s = s + member-seatsocc ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Greifen Sie dynamisch auf eine Zeile einer internen Tabelle zu, basierend auf einem Index. Verarbeiten Sie den Inhalt der Zeile unterschiedlich, je nachdem, ob es sich um die erste, letzte oder eine andere Zeile handelt.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN itab[ index ] TO <fs_row>` und eine `CASE` Anweisung mit `WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_table_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_item,
           ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_table_row
      IMPORTING
        it_items      TYPE ty_t_items
        iv_index      TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_table_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table_row.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row> TYPE ty_s_item.

    ASSIGN it_items[ iv_index ] TO <fs_row>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_items ).
      CASE iv_index.
        WHEN 1.
          rv_result = |First row: { <fs_row>-text }|.
        WHEN lv_table_size.
          rv_result = |Last row: { <fs_row>-text }|.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          rv_result = |Middle row: { <fs_row>-text }|.
      ENDCASE.
    ELSE.
      rv_result = 'ROW_NOT_FOUND'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Operation aus, die potenziell eine Ausnahme auslösen kann. Fangen Sie alle möglichen Ausnahmen generisch ab und geben Sie eine Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root)` als moderne Entsprechung zu `WHEN OTHERS` für Ausnahmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_generic_exception DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_generic_exception IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_numbers.
    TRY.
        DATA(lv_division_result) = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
        rv_result = |Result: { lv_division_result }|.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide). " Spezifischer Catch für Division durch Null
        rv_result = |Error: Division by zero - { lx_zerodivide->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root). " Generischer Catch für alle anderen Ausnahmen
        rv_result = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_successful_division FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_division_by_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_successful_division.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_exception( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Result: 5' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_generic_exception( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_numbers( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 0 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Division by zero' in = lv_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `TRY...CATCH` Anweisung ist der moderne Weg zur Fehlerbehandlung in ABAP. Durch die Kombination eines spezifischen `CATCH` (z.B. `cx_sy_zerodivide`) mit einem generischen `CATCH cx_root` wird sichergestellt, dass alle potenziellen Fehler abgefangen und behandelt werden. `CATCH cx_root` ist die moderne Entsprechung zu `WHEN OTHERS` für Ausnahmen.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, cx_root, Exception Handling, Error Handling, WHEN OTHERS (conceptually)

Instructions: Iterieren Sie über eine interne Tabelle und verarbeiten Sie jede Zeile. Verwenden Sie `ASSIGNING` für effizienten Zugriff und eine `CASE` Anweisung, um verschiedene Aktionen basierend auf einem Feldwert auszuführen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT itab ASSIGNING <fs_line>` und `CASE <fs_line>-field WHEN ... WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_loop_assign_case DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             type TYPE c LENGTH 1,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_data,
           ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS process_data
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_t_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_loop_assign_case IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE ty_s_data.

    LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING <fs_data>.
      CASE <fs_data>-type.
        WHEN 'A'.
          APPEND |Type A: { <fs_data>-value }| TO rt_results.
        WHEN 'B'.
          APPEND |Type B: { <fs_data>-value }| TO rt_results.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          APPEND |Unknown Type: { <fs_data>-value }| TO rt_results.
      ENDCASE.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_dyn_data_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_access_data.
    DATA: lr_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.

      CATCH cx_sy_type_descr_error INTO DATA(lx_type_error).
        rv_result = |Error describing type: { lx_type_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result = |An unexpected error occurred: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`. Iterieren Sie über die Ergebnisse und kategorisieren Sie Flüge basierend auf ihrem Status (z.B. 'X' für bestätigt, ' ' für offen, 'C' für storniert). Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `CASE WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `SELECT` in eine interne Tabelle, dann `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `CASE sflights-status WHEN ... WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_status,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             status_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_flight_status,
           ty_t_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_statuses
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_statuses) TYPE ty_t_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_statuses.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_sflight> TYPE sflights.

    IF iv_carrid IS SUPPLIED AND iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid.
    ELSE.
      SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.
    ENDIF.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
      DATA(ls_flight_status) = VALUE ty_s_flight_status(
        carrid = <fs_sflight>-carrid
        connid = <fs_sflight>-connid
        fldate = <fs_sflight>-fldate
      ).

      CASE <fs_sflight>-status.
        WHEN 'X'.
          ls_flight_status-status_text = 'Confirmed'.
        WHEN ' '.
          ls_flight_status-status_text = 'Open'.
        WHEN 'C'.
          ls_flight_status-status_text = 'Cancelled'.
        WHEN OTHERS.
          ls_flight_status-status_text = |Unknown Status: { <fs_sflight>-status }|.
      ENDCASE.
      APPEND ls_flight_status TO rt_flight_statuses.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie dynamisch den Typ eines übergebenen Datenobjekts und führen Sie basierend auf dem Typ unterschiedliche Aktionen aus. Verwenden Sie `ASSIGN` mit `CASTING` und `CASE WHEN OTHERS` für verschiedene Typen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` und `ASSIGN ... CASTING` sowie `CASE` auf den Typnamen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_generic_data
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_generic_data.
    DATA: lr_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_result = 'Invalid data reference'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lr_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ).
    DATA(lv_type_name) = lr_type_descr->get_name( ).

    CASE lv_type_name.
      WHEN 'STRING'.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_string> TYPE string.
        ASSIGN <fs_data> TO <fs_string> CASTING.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_result = |String data: '{ <fs_string> }'|.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'Casting to string failed'.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN 'I'.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_int> TYPE i.
        ASSIGN <fs_data> TO <fs_int> CASTING.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_result = |Integer data: { <fs_int> }|.
        ELSE.
          rv_result = 'Casting to integer failed'.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_result = |Unsupported type: { lv_type_name }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle und füllen Sie diese mit Daten. Greifen Sie anschließend dynamisch auf die Zeilen und Komponenten zu.

solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_and_fill_itab
      IMPORTING
        iv_line_type_name TYPE string
        iv_num_rows       TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result)  TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_itab_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_fill_itab.
    DATA: lr_line_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_typedescr,
          lr_table_type_descr TYPE REF TO cl_abap_tabledescr.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE,
                   <fs_line>  TYPE any,
                   <fs_comp>  TYPE any.

    TRY.
        lr_line_type_descr = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_line_type_name ).
        lr_table_type_descr = cl_abap_tabledescr=>create( p_line_type = lr_line_type_descr ).

        CREATE DATA DATA(lr_table) TYPE HANDLE lr_table_type_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_table->* TO <fs_table>.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rv_result = 'Failed to assign table field symbol'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        CREATE DATA DATA(lr_line) TYPE HANDLE lr_line_type_descr.
        ASSIGN lr_line->* TO <fs_line>.

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          rv_result = 'Failed to assign line field symbol'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        DO iv_num_rows TIMES.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_comp> = |Value { sy-index }|.
          ENDIF.
          INSERT <fs_line> INTO TABLE <fs_table>.
        ENDDO.

        rv_result = |Dynamic table created with { lines( <fs_table> ) } rows. First value: |.
        READ TABLE <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line> INDEX 1.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_result = rv_result && |{ <fs_comp> }|.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_result = |Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_discounted_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_original_price TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_discounted_price) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_discount_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_discounted_price.
    DATA(lv_discount_rate) TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2.

    CASE iv_original_price.
      WHEN 0 TO 99.99.
        lv_discount_rate = '0.00'. " Kein Rabatt
      WHEN 100.00 TO 499.99.
        lv_discount_rate = '0.05'. " 5% Rabatt
      WHEN 500.00 TO 999.99.
        lv_discount_rate = '0.10'. " 10% Rabatt
      WHEN OTHERS.
        lv_discount_rate = '0.15'. " 15% Rabatt für alle anderen (>= 1000)
    ENDCASE.

    rv_discounted_price = iv_original_price * ( 1 - lv_discount_rate ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Befehlen, die als String übergeben werden. Jeder Befehl hat ein Präfix, das seine Art bestimmt. Verwenden Sie `FIND` und `CASE WHEN OTHERS`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FIND` um das Präfix zu identifizieren und `CASE` mit `WHEN OTHERS` für unbekannte Befehle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_command_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_command_string
      IMPORTING
        iv_commands TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_command_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_command_string.
    DATA(lt_command_lines) = VALUE string_table( ).
    SPLIT iv_commands AT cl_abap_char_utilities=>cr_lf INTO TABLE lt_command_lines.

    LOOP AT lt_command_lines INTO DATA(lv_command_line).
      DATA(lv_result) = ''.
      IF lv_command_line IS INITIAL.
        CONTINUE.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_command_line CS 'ADD:'.
        lv_result = |Processed ADD: { lv_command_line+4 }|.
      ELSE IF lv_command_line CS 'DEL:'.
        lv_result = |Processed DEL: { lv_command_line+4 }|.
      ELSE.
        lv_result = |Unknown command: { lv_command_line }|.
      ENDIF.
      APPEND lv_result TO rt_results.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_cut->process_command_string( lv_commands ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_results ) exp = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_results[ 2 ] exp = 'Processed DEL: Item B' ).

Für komplexere Muster wäre `FIND REGEX` oder `CASE TYPE OF` mit `ASSIGN` und `CASTING` in Kombination mit RTTI eine Option. Die `ELSE` Bedingung dient hier als `WHEN OTHERS` für unbekannte Befehle.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_execute.
    DATA: lo_dynamic_object TYPE REF TO zif_dynamic_action.

    TRY.

Instructions: Verarbeiten Sie eine Liste von Werten, die unterschiedliche Datentypen repräsentieren können. Konvertieren Sie diese in einen String und behandeln Sie unbekannte Typen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN` mit `CASTING` und `CASE TYPE OF` oder `cl_abap_typedescr` mit `CASE WHEN OTHERS`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_data_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS convert_to_string
      IMPORTING
        ir_data TYPE REF TO data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_string_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_to_string.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_data> TYPE any.
    ASSIGN ir_data->* TO <fs_data>.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      rv_string_value = 'Invalid data reference'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lr_type_descr) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data> ).
    DATA(lv_type_kind) = lr_type_descr->type_kind.

    CASE lv_type_kind.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_char.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_char> TYPE csequence.
        ASSIGN <fs_data> TO <fs_char> CASTING.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_string_value = |{ <fs_char> }|.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_num.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_num> TYPE numeric.
        ASSIGN <fs_data> TO <fs_num> CASTING.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_string_value = |{ <fs_num> }|.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_int.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_int> TYPE i.
        ASSIGN <fs_data> TO <fs_int> CASTING.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_string_value = |{ <fs_int> }|.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN cl_abap_typedescr=>typekind_packed.
        FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_packed> TYPE p.
        ASSIGN <fs_data> TO <fs_packed> CASTING.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          rv_string_value = |{ <fs_packed> }|.
        ENDIF.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rv_string_value = |Unsupported type kind: { lv_type_kind }|.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Massenaktualisierung auf einer internen Tabelle durch. Wenn ein Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, soll eine Standardaktion ausgeführt werden. Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `MODIFY TABLE` mit `WHEN OTHERS` (implizit durch `IF sy-subrc <> 0`).
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING` und `READ TABLE ... TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS` gefolgt von `IF sy-subrc <> 0` für die 'WHEN OTHERS'-Logik.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_mass_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_item,
             id    TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_s_item,
           ty_t_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_item WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS update_items
      IMPORTING
        it_updates TYPE ty_t_items
      CHANGING
        ct_target_items TYPE ty_t_items
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_log) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_mass_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_items.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_target_item> TYPE ty_s_item.

    LOOP AT it_updates INTO DATA(ls_update).
      READ TABLE ct_target_items ASSIGNING <fs_target_item> WITH KEY id = ls_update-id.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Item found, update it
        <fs_target_item>-value = ls_update-value.
        APPEND |Updated item { ls_update-id } with value '{ ls_update-value }'| TO rt_log.
      ELSE.
        " Item not found, perform default action (e.g., add new item or log)
        INSERT ls_update INTO TABLE ct_target_items.
        APPEND |Added new item { ls_update-id } with value '{ ls_update-value }' (not found in original)| TO rt_log.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_initial_items ) exp = 3 ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine effiziente Massenaktualisierung einer internen Tabelle. `LOOP AT ... INTO` wird für die Aktualisierungen verwendet, während `READ TABLE ... ASSIGNING` den direkten Zugriff auf die zu aktualisierende Zeile ermöglicht. Die `IF sy-subrc = 0` Prüfung dient als 'WHEN' für gefundene Einträge, und der `ELSE`-Zweig als 'WHEN OTHERS' für nicht gefundene Einträge, wo eine Standardaktion (Hinzufügen) ausgeführt wird.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Funktion, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur basierend auf einem dynamischen Feldnamen setzt. Behandeln Sie den Fall, dass das Feld nicht existiert.
hint: Nutzen Sie `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO <fs>` und `IF sy-subrc <> 0`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_setter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_field_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_field_name TYPE string
        iv_new_value  TYPE string
      CHANGING
        cs_structure  TYPE any
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_setter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN COMPONENT iv_field_name OF STRUCTURE cs_structure TO <fs_field>.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      TRY.
          <fs_field> = iv_new_value.
          rv_success = abap_true.
        CATCH cx_sy_conversion_error INTO DATA(lx_conv_error).
          " Conversion error, e.g., trying to put string into integer field
          rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDTRY.
    ELSE.
      " Field not found (WHEN OTHERS case for component assignment)
      rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugdatum. Berechnen Sie für jede Gruppe die Gesamtzahl der freien Sitze. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und `WHEN OTHERS` (implizit durch die Gruppenverarbeitung).
hint: Nutzen Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` und aggregieren Sie die Daten innerhalb der Gruppe.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_flight_summary,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             fldate      TYPE sflight-fldate,
             total_free_seats TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_s_flight_summary,
           ty_t_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_s_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_grouped_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_t_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_grouped_flight_summary.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid fldate = ls_flight-fldate ) ASCENDING
      ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_group_key>).

      DATA(ls_summary) = VALUE ty_s_flight_summary(
        carrid = <fs_group_key>-carrid
        fldate = <fs_group_key>-fldate
      ).

      LOOP AT GROUP <fs_group_key> INTO DATA(ls_group_member).
        ls_summary-total_free_seats = ls_summary-total_free_seats + ( ls_group_member-seatsmax - ls_group_member-seatsocc ).
      ENDLOOP.
      APPEND ls_summary TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein Tortendiagramm, das die prozentuale Verteilung der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft aus `SFLIGHTS` anzeigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_chart_engine` mit `co_type_pie` und berechnen Sie die Prozentsätze.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chart_pie_chart DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_flight_distribution.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_pie_chart IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_flight_distribution.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_data_table,
          ls_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_data.

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight_counts).

    DATA(lv_total_flights) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0 FOR ls_fc IN lt_flight_counts NEXT sum = sum + ls_fc-flight_count ).

    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_flight_count).
      ls_chart_data-name = ls_flight_count-carrid.
      ls_chart_data-value = ( ls_flight_count-flight_count / lv_total_flights ) * 100.
      APPEND ls_chart_data TO lt_chart_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
        lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_pie ).
        lo_chart_engine->set_chart_data( lt_chart_data ).
        lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Flugverteilung pro Fluggesellschaft (%)' ).
        lo_chart_engine->display( ).
      CATCH cx_gui_chart_engine_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.

CLASS zcl_chart_custom_colors DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_chart_with_colors.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chart_custom_colors IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_chart_with_colors.
    DATA: lt_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_data_table,
          ls_chart_data TYPE cl_gui_chart_engine=>chart_data.

    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflights
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flight_counts).

    DATA(lv_color_index) = 0.
    DATA(lt_colors) = VALUE cl_gui_chart_engine=>color_table(
      ( color = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_color_blue )
      ( color = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_color_green )
      ( color = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_color_red )
      ( color = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_color_yellow )
      ( color = cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_color_orange )
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_chart_engine) = NEW cl_gui_chart_engine( ).
        lo_chart_engine->set_chart_type( cl_gui_chart_engine=>co_type_bar ).
        lo_chart_engine->set_chart_title( 'Fluganzahl mit benutzerdefinierten Farben' ).

        LOOP AT lt_flight_counts INTO DATA(ls_flight_count).
          ls_chart_data-name = ls_flight_count-carrid.
          ls_chart_data-value = ls_flight_count-flight_count.
          ls_chart_data-series = ls_flight_count-carrid. " Each carrid is its own series for color assignment
          APPEND ls_chart_data TO lt_chart_data.

          lv_color_index = lv_color_index + 1.
          IF lv_color_index > lines( lt_colors ).
            lv_color_index = 1.
          ENDIF.
          lo_chart_engine->set_series_color( iv_series_name = ls_flight_count-carrid iv_color = lt_colors[ lv_color_index ]-color ).
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_chart_engine->set_chart_data( lt_chart_data ).
        lo_chart_engine->display( ).
      CATCH cx_gui_chart_engine_error INTO DATA(lx_error).
        MESSAGE lx_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_multi DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_gui_event_handler.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS create_and_start_timer
      IMPORTING
        iv_interval TYPE i
        iv_id       TYPE string.
    METHODS stop_all_timers.
    METHODS get_timer_message IMPORTING iv_id TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_timer_data,
             id     TYPE string,
             timer  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer,
             message TYPE string,
           END OF ty_timer_data.
    TYPES tt_timer_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_timer_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mt_timers TYPE tt_timer_data.

    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_multi IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    " No specific constructor logic needed for this example
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_and_start_timer.
    DATA(ls_timer_data) = VALUE ty_timer_data( id = iv_id ).
    CREATE OBJECT ls_timer_data-timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR ls_timer_data-timer.
    ls_timer_data-timer->interval = iv_interval.
    INSERT ls_timer_data INTO TABLE mt_timers.
    ls_timer_data-timer->run( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_all_timers.
    LOOP AT mt_timers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_timer>).
      <fs_timer>-timer->stop( ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    " Identify which timer fired the event
    READ TABLE mt_timers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_timer>)
      WITH KEY timer = sender.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      <fs_timer>-message = |Timer '{ <fs_timer>-id }' finished after { <fs_timer>-timer->interval } seconds!|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_timer_message.
    READ TABLE mt_timers INTO DATA(ls_timer_data) WITH KEY id = iv_id.
    IF sy_subrc = 0.
      rv_message = ls_timer_data-message.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_multiple_timers.
    DATA(lo_multi_timer) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_multi( ).

    lo_multi_timer->create_and_start_timer( iv_interval = 1 iv_id = 'TimerA' ).
    lo_multi_timer->create_and_start_timer( iv_interval = 2 iv_id = 'TimerB' ).

    DATA(lo_timer_a) = CAST cl_gui_timer( lo_multi_timer->mt_timers[ id = 'TimerA' ]-timer ).
    DATA(lo_timer_b) = CAST cl_gui_timer( lo_multi_timer->mt_timers[ id = 'TimerB' ]-timer ).

    lo_multi_timer->handle_timer_finished( sender = lo_timer_a ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 'Timer ''TimerA'' finished after 1 seconds!'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_multi_timer->get_timer_message( 'TimerB' ) ).

    lo_multi_timer->handle_timer_finished( sender = lo_timer_b ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 'Timer ''TimerB'' finished after 2 seconds!'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_polling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_gui_event_handler.
    METHODS constructor.
    METHODS start_polling_timer IMPORTING iv_interval TYPE i.
    METHODS stop_polling_timer.
    METHODS set_simulated_status IMPORTING iv_status TYPE string.
    METHODS get_polling_status RETURNING VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
    METHODS is_timer_running RETURNING VALUE(rv_running) TYPE abap_bool.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_timer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_timer.
    DATA mv_simulated_status TYPE string.
    DATA mv_is_running TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS handle_timer_finished FOR EVENT finished OF cl_gui_timer.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_timer_polling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_timer.
    SET HANDLER handle_timer_finished FOR mo_timer.
    mv_simulated_status = 'IN_PROGRESS'.
    mv_is_running = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD start_polling_timer.
    mo_timer->interval = iv_interval.
    mo_timer->run( ).
    mv_is_running = abap_true.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD stop_polling_timer.
    mo_timer->stop( ).
    mv_is_running = abap_false.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_simulated_status.
    mv_simulated_status = iv_status.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_polling_status.
    rv_status = mv_simulated_status.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_timer_finished.
    IF mv_simulated_status = 'FERTIG'.
      stop_polling_timer( ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_timer_running.
    rv_running = mv_is_running.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_polling_and_stop.
    DATA(lo_poller) = NEW zcl_gui_timer_polling( ).
    lo_poller->start_polling_timer( 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lo_poller->is_timer_running( ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_poller->get_polling_status( ) exp = 'IN_PROGRESS' ).

    lo_poller->handle_timer_finished( ).

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine Liste von HTTP-Statuscodes in eine interne Tabelle von Strukturen umwandelt, die den Code und seinen zugehörigen Text enthalten. Filtern Sie dabei nur die Statuscodes, die keine Informations- oder Erfolgsmeldungen sind (d.h. 3xx, 4xx, 5xx).
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR`-Operator mit `COND` und `cl_rest_status_code`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rest_status_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_status_info,
             code TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_status_info.
    TYPES tt_status_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_status_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_and_filter_status
      IMPORTING
        it_status_codes TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_status_info) TYPE tt_status_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rest_status_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_and_filter_status.
    rt_status_info = VALUE tt_status_info(
      FOR status_code IN it_status_codes
      WHERE ( NOT cl_rest_status_code=>is_informational( status_code ) AND
              NOT cl_rest_status_code=>is_success( status_code ) )
      ( code = status_code,
        text = cl_rest_status_code=>get_status_text( status_code ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rest_status_transform( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY (
      ( 100 ) ( 200 ) ( 301 ) ( 400 ) ( 503 ) ( 204 )
    ).
    DATA(lt_expected) = VALUE zcl_rest_status_transform=>tt_status_info (
      ( code = 301 text = 'Moved Permanently' )
      ( code = 400 text = 'Bad Request' )
      ( code = 503 text = 'Service Unavailable' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->transform_and_filter_status( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result exp = lt_expected ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_only_success_codes.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rest_status_transform( ).

    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_result ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie ein Ereignis, das mit einer bestimmten Wahrscheinlichkeit (z.B. 30%) eintritt.
hint: Vergleichen Sie die generierte Zufallszahl mit der Wahrscheinlichkeit.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_float_prob DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS simulate_event
      IMPORTING
        iv_probability TYPE f " e.g., 0.3 for 30%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_event_happened) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_float_prob IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD simulate_event.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_float=>create( ).
    DATA(lv_random_value) = lo_random->get_next( ).
    IF lv_random_value < iv_probability.
      rv_event_happened = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_event_happened = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_simulate_event FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_simulate_event.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_float_prob( ).
    " Test with 0% probability - should always be false
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->simulate_event( 0.0 ) exp = abap_false ).
    " Test with 100% probability - should always be true (or very close to it)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->simulate_event( 1.0 ) exp = abap_true ).
    " For intermediate probabilities, we can only test the range, not specific outcomes
    DATA(lv_true_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_iterations) = 1000.
    DATA(lv_probability) = 0.5.
    LOOP FROM 1 TO lv_iterations.
      IF lo_cut->simulate_event( lv_probability ) = abap_true.
        lv_true_count = lv_true_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    " Assert that the count is within a reasonable range (e.g., 40-60% for 50%)
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ( lv_true_count >= ( lv_iterations * 0.4 ) AND lv_true_count <= ( lv_iterations * 0.6 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie die Daten der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` in einem einfachen ALV Grid an.

CLASS zcl_alv_basic_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_basic_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' " This container must exist on a screen
    ).
    DATA(lo_alv_grid) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
            is_variant       = VALUE #( report = sy-repid handle = '0001' ) " Dummy variant
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = lt_sflights

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Ereignisbehandlung für einen Doppelklick auf eine Zeile im ALV Grid, um die Details der ausgewählten Flugverbindung anzuzeigen.
hint: Registrieren Sie ein lokales Event-Handler-Objekt für das `double_click`-Ereignis.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_event.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv_grid TYPE REF TO cl_gui_alv_grid.
    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_alv_grid
      IMPORTING
        e_row
        e_column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_event.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER'
    ).
    mo_alv_grid = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(
      EXPORTING
        i_parent = lo_container
    ).

    SET HANDLER me->handle_double_click FOR mo_alv_grid.

    TRY.
        mo_alv_grid->set_table_for_first_display(
          EXPORTING
            i_structure_name = 'SFLIGHTS'
            is_variant       = VALUE #( report = sy-repid handle = '0003' )
          CHANGING
            it_outtab        = lt_sflights
        ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.
    DATA: lv_index TYPE i.

    " Get selected row index
    mo_alv_grid->get_selected_rows(
      IMPORTING
        et_index_rows = DATA(lt_selected_rows)
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_selected_rows INDEX 1 INTO lv_index.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      " Get data of the selected row (assuming lt_sflights is accessible,
      " in a real scenario, it would be a member attribute or passed)
      " For this example, we'll simulate fetching the data.
      " In a real application, you'd read from the internal table bound to the ALV.
      SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO ls_sflight
        WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '19950228'. " Dummy data for example
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        MESSAGE i000(00) WITH 'Flight details:' ls_sflight-carrid ls_sflight-connid ls_sflight-fldate.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_handler_registration.
    " Event handling registration itself cannot be directly tested for functionality
    " without a running UI. We can only test that the SET HANDLER statement executes.
    DATA(lo_container) = NEW cl_gui_custom_container(
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'DUMMY_CONTAINER_EVENT'
    ).
    DATA(lo_alv_grid) = NEW cl_gui_alv_grid(

    SET HANDLER lo_cut->handle_double_click FOR lo_alv_grid.

Instructions: Lese alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft und deklariere die interne Tabelle inline. Verwende `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF` für die Zuweisung.
hint: Nutze `SELECT ... INTO TABLE @DATA(...)` und `CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_open_sql_inline DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_open_sql_inline IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_by_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights_raw).

    " Using CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF for assignment to a structured table type
    rt_flights = CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights_raw ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Filtere eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) nach Flügen, deren Preis über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegt.
hint: Nutze den `FILTER` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_flights_by_price
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_min_price   TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_flights_by_price.
    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER #( it_all_flights WHERE price > iv_min_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_flights.
    DATA(lt_test_flights) = VALUE zcl_itab_filter=>tt_flights(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251209' price = '100.00' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251209' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251209' price = '150.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_flights_by_price( it_all_flights = lt_test_flights iv_min_price = '120.00' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 msg = 'Should return 2 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' msg = 'First filtered flight carrier should be LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' msg = 'Second filtered flight carrier should be UA' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER` Operator ist eine deklarative und performante Möglichkeit, interne Tabellen zu filtern, ohne explizite Schleifen zu verwenden. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights`.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc, " Occupied seats
           END OF ty_flight.
    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_flights
        iv_carrid      TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
