Instructions: Finde das früheste Datum in einer Tabelle von Strukturen, die ein Datumsfeld enthalten. Gib '00000000' zurück, wenn die Tabelle leer ist.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator, um das Minimum zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_min_date_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data,
           ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_min_date
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_data_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_min_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_min_date_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_min_date.
    rv_min_date = REDUCE d(
      INIT min_date = '99991231' " Start with a date far in the future
      FOR <fs_data> IN it_data
      NEXT min_date = COND d(
        WHEN <fs_data>-date < min_date THEN <fs_data>-date
        ELSE min_date )
    ).

    IF rv_min_date = '99991231'. " If no dates were found, return initial date
      rv_min_date = '00000000'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_get_min_date FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_single_entry FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_min_date.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_min_date_finder=>ty_data_tab,
          lo_cut  TYPE REF TO zcl_min_date_finder.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_min_date_finder( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 date = '20230115' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 date = '20220520' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 3 date = '20241101' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lv_min_date) = lo_cut->get_min_date( lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min_date exp = '20220520' msg = 'Incorrect minimum date' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_min_date_finder=>ty_data_tab,
          lo_cut  TYPE REF TO zcl_min_date_finder.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_min_date_finder( ).

    DATA(lv_min_date) = lo_cut->get_min_date( lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min_date exp = '00000000' msg = 'Should return initial date for empty table' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_single_entry.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_min_date_finder=>ty_data_tab,
          lo_cut  TYPE REF TO zcl_min_date_finder.

    lo_cut = NEW zcl_min_date_finder( ).

    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 date = '20230707' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lv_min_date) = lo_cut->get_min_date( lt_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_min_date exp = '20230707' msg = 'Incorrect minimum date for single entry' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle. Hier wird er verwendet, um das kleinste Datum zu finden, indem er iterativ das aktuelle Minimum mit dem Datum des nächsten Tabelleneintrags vergleicht. `COND` sorgt für die bedingte Zuweisung innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
keywords: REDUCE, Date, Internal Tables, Minimum, COND

Instructions: Berechne das Alter einer Person in vollen Jahren basierend auf ihrem Geburtsdatum und einem Referenzdatum (z.B. dem heutigen Datum).
hint: Verwende Datumsarithmetik und die Funktion `n_days_between` oder direkte Datumsvergleiche.
solution:
CLASS zcl_age_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_age
      IMPORTING
        iv_birth_date TYPE d
        iv_ref_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_age) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_age_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_age.
    rv_age = iv_ref_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).

    IF iv_ref_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) OR
       ( iv_ref_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND iv_ref_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) ) OR
       ( iv_ref_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND iv_ref_date(2) = iv_birth_date(2) AND iv_ref_date(2) < iv_birth_date(2) ).
      " If birthday hasn't occurred yet this year
      IF iv_ref_date+4(2) < iv_birth_date+4(2) OR
         ( iv_ref_date+4(2) = iv_birth_date+4(2) AND iv_ref_date+6(2) < iv_birth_date+6(2) ).
        rv_age = rv_age - 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    " A more robust way using date objects (ABAP 7.50+ for direct date arithmetic)
    " For 7.40, direct string slicing and comparison is common.
    " IF iv_ref_date < iv_birth_date. " Handle future birth dates
    "   rv_age = 0.
    "   RETURN.
    " ENDIF.
    " DATA(lv_years) = iv_ref_date(4) - iv_birth_date(4).
    " IF iv_ref_date+4(4) < iv_birth_date+4(4). " Check if month/day of birth has passed
    "   lv_years = lv_years - 1.
    " ENDIF.
    " rv_age = lv_years.

    " Alternative using cl_abap_tstmp (more complex for simple age, but good for general date diff)
    " DATA(lv_timestamp_birth) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date( iv_birth_date ).
    " DATA(lv_timestamp_ref) = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date( iv_ref_date ).
    " DATA(lv_diff_seconds) = cl_abap_tstmp=>diff( iv_tstmp1 = lv_timestamp_ref iv_tstmp2 = lv_timestamp_birth ).
    " rv_age = lv_diff_seconds / ( 365.25 * 24 * 3600 ). " Approximate, needs refinement for exact years

    " The most straightforward way for exact years (ABAP 7.50+)
    DATA(lv_age_date) = iv_birth_date.
    DO.
      lv_age_date = lv_age_date + 365.
      IF lv_age_date > iv_ref_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.
      rv_age = rv_age + 1.
    ENDDO.
    " This simple loop is not entirely accurate for leap years and month boundaries.
    " A more precise calculation for 7.40:
    rv_age = 0.
    IF iv_ref_date >= iv_birth_date.

        rv_age = rv_age - 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Gruppiere eine interne Tabelle von Verkaufsdaten nach Monat und Jahr und zähle die Anzahl der Verkäufe pro Gruppe. Gib das Ergebnis in einer neuen Tabelle zurück.
hint: Verwende `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit einem Gruppenschlüssel, der Monat und Jahr des Datums enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sales_by_month DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sale_data,
             sale_id TYPE i,
             sale_date TYPE d,
             amount  TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sale_data,
           ty_sale_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sale_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales_summary,
             year  TYPE n LENGTH 4,
             month TYPE n LENGTH 2,
             count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sales_summary,
           ty_sales_summary_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS summarize_sales_by_month
      IMPORTING
        it_sales_data TYPE ty_sale_data_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE ty_sales_summary_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sales_by_month IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD summarize_sales_by_month.
    LOOP AT it_sales_data INTO DATA(ls_sale)
         GROUP BY ( year  = ls_sale-sale_date(4)
                    month = ls_sale-sale_date+4(2)
                    count = GROUP SIZE ) INTO DATA(ls_group).

      APPEND VALUE #( year  = ls_group-year
                      month = ls_group-month
                      count = ls_group-count ) TO rt_summary.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den ersten Tag des nächsten Monats ausgehend von einem gegebenen Datum.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_tstmp=>add_months` und Datumsarithmetik, um zum Monatsanfang zu springen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_utilities DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_first_day_of_next_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_first_day) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_utilities IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_day_of_next_month.
    DATA: lv_timestamp TYPE timestampl.

    " Convert input date to timestamp
    lv_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>create_timestamp_from_date( iv_date ).

    " Add one month to the timestamp
    lv_timestamp = cl_abap_tstmp=>add_months( iv_tstmp = lv_timestamp iv_months = 1 ).

    " Extract date from the new timestamp
    cl_abap_tstmp=>get_date_from_timestamp( EXPORTING iv_tstmp = lv_timestamp IMPORTING ev_date = rv_first_day ).

    " Set day to '01' to get the first day of that month
    rv_first_day+6(2) = '01'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde das späteste Datum in einer Tabelle von Strukturen, die ein Datumsfeld enthalten. Gib '00000000' zurück, wenn die Tabelle leer ist.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator, um das Maximum zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_max_date_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             date TYPE d,
           END OF ty_data,
           ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_max_date
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_data_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_date) TYPE d.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_max_date_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_max_date.
    rv_max_date = REDUCE d(
      INIT max_date = '00000000' " Start with initial date
      FOR <fs_data> IN it_data
      NEXT max_date = COND d(
        WHEN <fs_data>-date > max_date THEN <fs_data>-date
        ELSE max_date )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gegeben eine Tabelle mit Einträgen, die einen Schlüssel und ein Datum enthalten, ermittle für jeden Schlüssel den Eintrag mit dem spätesten Datum. Wenn mehrere Einträge das gleiche späteste Datum haben, behalte alle davon.
hint: Sortiere die Tabelle absteigend nach Datum und verwende `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` mit `COMPARING` auf den Schlüssel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_latest_entry_per_key DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_entry,
             key  TYPE string,
             date TYPE d,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_entry,
           ty_entry_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_entry WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_latest_entries
      IMPORTING
        it_source_data TYPE ty_entry_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_latest_entries) TYPE ty_entry_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_latest_entry_per_key IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_latest_entries.
    DATA(lt_sorted_data) = it_source_data.

    " Sort descending by date, then by key (stable sort)
    SORT lt_sorted_data BY key ASCENDING date DESCENDING.

    " Use REDUCE to find the latest entries, handling duplicates with same latest date
    rt_latest_entries = REDUCE zcl_latest_entry_per_key=>ty_entry_tab(
      INIT result = VALUE #( )
           current_key = ''
           max_date = '00000000'
      FOR <fs_entry> IN lt_sorted_data
      NEXT
        IF <fs_entry>-key <> current_key.
          " New key, reset max_date and add current entry
          current_key = <fs_entry>-key.
          max_date = <fs_entry>-date.
          APPEND <fs_entry> TO result.
        ELSEIF <fs_entry>-date = max_date.
          " Same key, same max_date, add this entry too
          APPEND <fs_entry> TO result.
        ENDIF
    ).

    " If the requirement was strictly one entry per key, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES would be used after sorting.
    " Example for strictly one entry per key:
    " SORT lt_source_data BY key ASCENDING date DESCENDING.
    " DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_source_data COMPARING key.
    " rt_latest_entries = lt_source_data.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Arbeitstage (Montag bis Freitag) zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten (inklusive Start- und Enddatum).
hint: Iteriere durch die Tage und verwende die eingebaute Funktion `get_weekday`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_working_days_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_working_days
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE d
        iv_end_date   TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_working_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_working_days_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_working_days.
    IF iv_start_date > iv_end_date.
      rv_working_days = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_current_date) = iv_start_date.
    DO.
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_weekday( lv_current_date ).
      " Weekday 1 = Monday, 7 = Sunday
      IF lv_weekday >= 1 AND lv_weekday <= 5.
        rv_working_days = rv_working_days + 1.
      ENDIF.

      IF lv_current_date = iv_end_date.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_range_generator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_date_range_generator IMPLEMENTATION.

  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Bestimme, ob ein gegebenes Datum in der Zukunft, Vergangenheit oder genau heute liegt, basierend auf dem aktuellen Systemdatum.
hint: Nutze `cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date` und `SWITCH` für die bedingte Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_comparison DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_date_relation TYPE c LENGTH 10.
    CONSTANTS: BEGIN OF gc_date_relation,
                 future   TYPE ty_date_relation VALUE 'FUTURE',
                 past     TYPE ty_date_relation VALUE 'PAST',
                 today    TYPE ty_date_relation VALUE 'TODAY',
               END OF gc_date_relation.

    METHODS get_date_relation
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_relation) TYPE ty_date_relation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_comparison IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_date_relation.
    DATA(lv_system_date) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).

    rv_relation = SWITCH ty_date_relation(
      WHEN iv_date > lv_system_date THEN gc_date_relation-future
      WHEN iv_date < lv_system_date THEN gc_date_relation-past
      ELSE gc_date_relation-today
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Anzahl der Tage zwischen zwei Daten (Start- und Enddatum exklusive).
hint: Nutze die eingebaute Funktion `n_days_between`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_date_difference DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_days_between_exclusive
      IMPORTING
        iv_date1 TYPE d
        iv_date2 TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_days) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_difference IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_days_between_exclusive.
    IF iv_date1 = iv_date2.
      rv_days = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_days = n_days_between( iv_date1 = iv_date1 iv_date2 = iv_date2 ).

    " n_days_between returns absolute difference, so we need to adjust for exclusive
    IF rv_days > 0.
      rv_days = rv_days - 1.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Finde den Eintrag in einer Tabelle, der das Datum enthält, das dem aktuellen Systemdatum am nächsten liegt (kann in der Vergangenheit oder Zukunft liegen).
hint: Nutze `REDUCE` und `n_days_between` in Kombination mit `cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_closest_date_finder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             date TYPE d,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           ty_data_tab TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_closest_date_entry
      IMPORTING
        it_data TYPE ty_data_tab
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_closest_entry) TYPE ty_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_closest_date_finder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_closest_date_entry.
    DATA(lv_system_date) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_system_date( ).

    rs_closest_entry = REDUCE zcl_closest_date_finder=>ty_data(
      INIT closest_entry = VALUE #( )
           min_diff = 99999999 " Large initial difference
      FOR <fs_data> IN it_data
      NEXT
        DATA(current_diff) = ABS( n_days_between( iv_date1 = <fs_data>-date iv_date2 = lv_system_date ) ).
        IF current_diff < min_diff.
          min_diff = current_diff.
          closest_entry = <fs_data>.
        ENDIF
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_list_attachments DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING

CLASS zcl_gos_list_attachments IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_gos_attachments.
    DATA: lo_gos_manager TYPE REF TO cl_gos_manager,
          lt_objects     TYPE gos_object_list.

    TRY.
        lo_gos_manager = NEW cl_gos_manager(
          iv_object_type = iv_object_type
          iv_object_key  = iv_object_key
        ).

        " Get list of all attached objects
        lo_gos_manager->get_list_of_objects(
          EXPORTING
            is_object = VALUE sibfbori( objtype = iv_object_type objkey = iv_object_key )
          IMPORTING
            et_object = lt_objects
        ).

        " Filter for documents and map to custom structure using modern ABAP
        rt_attachments = VALUE #( FOR ls_object IN lt_objects
                                  WHERE ( objtype = 'MESSAGE' OR objtype = 'NOTE' OR objtype = 'URL' ) " Filter for common GOS types
                                  ( object_id    = ls_object-objid
                                    object_name  = ls_object-objname
                                    object_descr = ls_object-objdescr ) ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches Textdokument aus dem Inhalt einer internen Tabelle (`sflights` Daten) und hängen Sie es über GOS an ein Business-Objekt an.
hint: Konvertieren Sie die Tabelle in einen String (z.B. mit `REDUCE`), verwenden Sie `cl_bds_document_set` zum Erstellen des Dokuments und verknüpfen Sie es mit dem Business-Objekt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gos_attach_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS attach_sflights_as_doc
      IMPORTING
        iv_object_type TYPE sibftypeid DEFAULT 'BUS2000116'
        iv_object_key  TYPE sibfkey    DEFAULT '0000000003'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gos_attach_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD attach_sflights_as_doc.
    DATA: lt_sflights    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight,
          lv_document_content TYPE string,
          lv_document_title TYPE so_obj_des.

    TRY.
        " 1. Read sflights data using modern ABAP
        SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.
        IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
          MESSAGE 'No SFLIGHT data found for demo.' TYPE 'E'.
          rv_success = abap_false.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " 2. Convert internal table to a single string using modern ABAP (REDUCE)
        lv_document_content = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                             FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflights
                                             NEXT s = s && |{ ls_sflight-carrid } { ls_sflight-connid } { ls_sflight-fldate } { ls_sflight-price } EUR\n| ).

        lv_document_title = |SFLIGHT Data { cl_abap_tstmp=>utclong_to_timestamp( cl_abap_tstmp=>get_utclong( ) ) }|.

        " 3. Attach document using BDS (used by GOS for attachments)
        DATA(lo_bds_document_set) = NEW cl_bds_document_set( ).
        lo_bds_document_set->create_with_table(
          EXPORTING
            i_object_key    = iv_object_key
            i_object_type   = iv_object_type
            i_document_type = 'RAW' " Raw text document
            i_description   = lv_document_title
            i_file_name     = 'sflights_data.txt'
            i_content_text  = VALUE bds_cont_text( ( lv_document_content ) )
          EXCEPTIONS
            OTHERS          = 1
        ).

        IF sy-subrc <> 0.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_bds_error.
        ENDIF.

        rv_success = abap_true.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_compress_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_sflights_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_compress_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_sflights_table.
    DATA: lv_xml_string TYPE string,
          lv_xstring_data TYPE xstring.

    TRY.
        " 1. Read sflights data using modern ABAP
        SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights) UP TO 10 ROWS.
        IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
          MESSAGE 'No SFLIGHT data found for demo.' TYPE 'E'.
          RETURN.
        ENDIF.

        " 2. Serialize internal table to XML string using CALL TRANSFORMATION
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE sflight = lt_sflights
          RESULT XML lv_xml_string.

        " 3. Convert string to xstring (required for GZIP) using cl_abap_conv_codepage
        cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out(
          EXPORTING
            encoding = 'UTF-8'
            endian   = 'L'
          RECEIVING
            conv      = DATA(lo_conv_out)
        )->convert(
          EXPORTING
            data   = lv_xml_string
          IMPORTING
            buffer = lv_xstring_data
        ).

        " 4. Compress the xstring data
        cl_abap_gzip=>compress(
          EXPORTING
            gzip_in  = lv_xstring_data
          IMPORTING
            gzip_out = rv_compressed_xstring
        ).

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Anschließend werden sie mittels `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` in ein XML-Format serialisiert. Die resultierende String-Repräsentation wird dann mit `cl_abap_conv_codepage` in ein `XSTRING` umgewandelt, bevor `cl_abap_gzip=>compress` die eigentliche Kompression durchführt. Dies ist ein gängiges Muster für die Speicherung oder Übertragung strukturierter Daten.

Instructions: Dekomprimieren Sie zuvor komprimierte `sflights`-Daten und deserialisieren Sie sie zurück in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_gzip` zur Dekompression, `cl_abap_conv_codepage` zur Umwandlung von `XSTRING` in `STRING` und `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` zur Deserialisierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_decompress_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS decompress_sflights_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_sflights) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_decompress_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD decompress_sflights_table.
    DATA: lv_decompressed_xstring TYPE xstring,
          lv_xml_string TYPE string.

    TRY.
        " 1. Decompress the xstring data
        cl_abap_gzip=>decompress(
          EXPORTING
            gzip_in  = iv_compressed_xstring
          IMPORTING
            gzip_out = lv_decompressed_xstring
        ).

        " 2. Convert xstring to string
        cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_in(
          EXPORTING
            encoding = 'UTF-8'
            endian   = 'L'
          RECEIVING
            conv     = DATA(lo_conv_in)
        )->convert(
          EXPORTING
            buffer = lv_decompressed_xstring
          IMPORTING
            data   = lv_xml_string
        ).

        " 3. Deserialize XML string back to internal table
        CALL TRANSFORMATION id
          SOURCE XML lv_xml_string
          RESULT sflight = rt_sflights.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Zuerst wird das `XSTRING` mit `cl_abap_gzip=>decompress` dekomprimiert. Anschließend wird das resultierende `XSTRING` mit `cl_abap_conv_codepage` in einen `STRING` umgewandelt und schließlich mit `CALL TRANSFORMATION ID` zurück in die interne Tabelle deserialisiert. Die Inline-Deklaration von Variablen (`DATA(...)`) trägt zur Code-Klarheit bei.

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Kompression eines Strings und fangen Sie mögliche Ausnahmen ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` Blöcke, um Ausnahmen vom Typ `cx_abap_gzip_error` oder `cx_root` abzufangen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_text_in TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_compressed_xstring) TYPE xstring
      RAISING
        cx_abap_gzip_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_with_error_handling.
    TRY.
        cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text(
          EXPORTING
            text_in  = iv_text_in
          IMPORTING
            gzip_out = rv_compressed_xstring
        ).
      CATCH cx_abap_gzip_error INTO DATA(lx_gzip_error).
        " Specific GZIP error
        MESSAGE lx_gzip_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION lx_gzip_error. " Re-raise for caller to handle
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_general_error).
        " General ABAP error
        MESSAGE lx_general_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_gzip_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_general_error
            text     = 'General error during GZIP compression'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_string) = 'Short string'.

    TRY.
        lv_compressed = lo_cut->compress_with_error_handling( lv_dummy_string ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_compressed ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die robuste Fehlerbehandlung bei der GZIP-Kompression. Es verwendet `TRY...CATCH`-Blöcke, um spezifische `cx_abap_gzip_error`-Ausnahmen sowie generische `cx_root`-Ausnahmen abzufangen. Die Methode `RAISING cx_abap_gzip_error` in der Methodendefinition signalisiert dem Aufrufer, dass diese Ausnahme auftreten kann, was eine moderne Praxis für die API-Gestaltung ist.

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Kompression und Dekompression eines großen Textes (z.B. 1000 Zeilen) und messen Sie die dafür benötigte Zeit.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` und String-Templates zur Generierung des großen Textes, `cl_abap_gzip` für die Kompression/Dekompression und `GET RUN TIME` zur Zeitmessung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gzip_large_data_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_performance_result,
             original_size_bytes TYPE i,
             compressed_size_bytes TYPE i,
             compression_time_us TYPE i,
             decompression_time_us TYPE i,
             success TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_performance_result.

    METHODS compress_decompress_large_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_num_lines TYPE i DEFAULT 1000
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_result) TYPE REF TO ty_performance_result.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gzip_large_data_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_decompress_large_text.
    DATA: lv_original_text      TYPE string,
          lv_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring,
          lv_decompressed_text  TYPE string,
          lv_start_time         TYPE i,
          lv_end_time           TYPE i.

    CREATE DATA rs_result.
    rs_result->success = abap_false.

    TRY.
        " 1. Generate large text using modern ABAP (REDUCE and String Templates)
        lv_original_text = REDUCE string( INIT s = ``
                                           FOR i = 1 UP TO iv_num_lines
                                           NEXT s = s && |Line { i }: This is a sample line of text to simulate a large document. It contains various characters and words to make the compression effective.\n| ).

        " Calculate original size in bytes (UTF-8)
        rs_result->original_size_bytes = xstrlen( cl_abap_conv_codepage=>create_out( encoding = 'UTF-8' )->convert( lv_original_text ) ).

        " 2. Compress and measure time
        GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_start_time.
        cl_abap_gzip=>compress_text(
          EXPORTING
            text_in  = lv_original_text
          IMPORTING
            gzip_out = lv_compressed_xstring
        ).
        GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_end_time.
        rs_result->compression_time_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.
        rs_result->compressed_size_bytes = xstrlen( lv_compressed_xstring ).

        " 3. Decompress and measure time
        GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_start_time.
        cl_abap_gzip=>decompress_text(
          EXPORTING
            gzip_in  = lv_compressed_xstring
          IMPORTING
            text_out = lv_decompressed_text
        ).
        GET RUN TIME FIELD lv_end_time.
        rs_result->decompression_time_us = lv_end_time - lv_start_time.

        IF lv_original_text = lv_decompressed_text.
          rs_result->success = abap_true.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        MESSAGE lx_exception->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_large_text_compression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_large_text_compression.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_gzip_large_data_demo( ).
    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->compress_decompress_large_text( iv_num_lines = 100 ). " Use fewer lines for quick test

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_result->success
      exp = abap_true
      msg = 'Large text compression and decompression should be successful'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_result->original_size_bytes
      msg = 'Original size should be calculated'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_result->compressed_size_bytes
      msg = 'Compressed size should be calculated'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ls_result->compressed_size_bytes < ls_result->original_size_bytes
      msg = 'Compressed size should be smaller than original size'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kompression und Dekompression großer Textmengen und misst die Performance. Die Generierung des großen Textes erfolgt effizient mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates. Die Zeitmessung mit `GET RUN TIME` ist entscheidend für Performance-Analysen. Es zeigt, wie `cl_abap_gzip` auch bei großen Datenmengen effektiv eingesetzt werden kann, um Speicherplatz zu sparen oder die Übertragungszeit zu reduzieren.
keywords: GZIP, Performance, Large Data, Time Measurement, cl_abap_gzip, REDUCE, GET RUN TIME

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie den Preis eines spezifischen Fluges in der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS`.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `UPDATE` Anweisung mit `SET` und `WHERE` Klauseln. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Sie `COMMIT WORK` oder `ROLLBACK WORK` in Ihrem Test verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_single DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_flight_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_single IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_price.
    UPDATE sflights SET price = iv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_price FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_price.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0017'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '20251209'.
    DATA(lv_old_price) = '100.00'.
    DATA(lv_new_price) = '150.00'.

    " Setup: Insert test data
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
                          price = lv_old_price currency = 'EUR' ).
    INSERT sflights FROM ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      UPDATE sflights FROM ls_sflight.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_single( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_price( iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                  iv_connid = lv_connid
                                  iv_fldate = lv_fldate
                                  iv_new_price = lv_new_price ).

    SELECT SINGLE price FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_actual_price)
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid
        AND connid = lv_connid
        AND fldate = lv_fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_actual_price exp = lv_new_price
                                        msg = 'Price should be updated' ).

    " Teardown: Clean up test data
    DELETE sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die grundlegende `UPDATE` Anweisung, um einen einzelnen Datensatz in einer Datenbanktabelle zu ändern. Die Verwendung von `WHERE` stellt sicher, dass nur der spezifische Datensatz aktualisiert wird. Im Unit Test wird die Transaktion mit `COMMIT WORK` abgeschlossen und die Testdaten werden nach dem Test wieder gelöscht.
keywords: UPDATE, Database, SFLIGHTS, COMMIT WORK

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie die Preise mehrerer Flüge basierend auf Daten in einer internen Tabelle.

CLASS zcl_db_update_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,

           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

        it_flight_prices TYPE tt_flight_price.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_prices FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_prices.
    DATA: lt_sflights_initial TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_flight_updates TYPE zcl_db_update_itab=>tt_flight_price.

    " Setup: Insert test data
    lt_sflights_initial = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251209' price = '200.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251210' price = '210.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251209' price = '100.00' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Data for update
    lt_flight_updates = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251209' price = '250.00' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251209' price = '120.00' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_itab( ).
    lo_cut->update_flight_prices( it_flight_prices = lt_flight_updates ).

    DATA(lt_sflights_after) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_after
      WHERE ( carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400' AND fldate = '20251209' )
         OR ( carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0017' AND fldate = '20251209' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_after INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251209'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh-price exp = '250.00' msg = 'LH flight price should be updated' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_after INTO DATA(ls_flight_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251209'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_aa-price exp = '120.00' msg = 'AA flight price should be updated' ).

    " Teardown: Clean up test data
    DELETE sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `UPDATE ... FROM TABLE @itab` Anweisung ist die effizienteste Methode, um mehrere Datensätze in einer Datenbanktabelle zu aktualisieren. Sie vermeidet Schleifen über einzelne `UPDATE`-Anweisungen und reduziert die Datenbanklast, da die Operation als ein einziger Datenbankaufruf ausgeführt wird.

CLASS zcl_db_update_timestamp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id

CLASS zcl_db_update_timestamp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_with_timestamp.
    DATA(lv_current_timestamp) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->current_utc( )->value( ).
    " For demonstration, we update PRICE with a derived value from timestamp.
    " In a real scenario, 'LAST_CHANGE_TSTMP' field would be updated directly.
    DATA(lv_price_from_timestamp) TYPE s_price.
    lv_price_from_timestamp = lv_current_timestamp+10(5).

    UPDATE sflights SET price = lv_price_from_timestamp
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

                          price = lv_initial_price currency = 'EUR' ).

                                          iv_fldate = lv_fldate ).

CLASS zcl_xco_timestamp_diff DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen zukünftigen Zeitstempel, indem Sie eine bestimmte Dauer (z.B. 2 Stunden und 30 Minuten) zu einem Startzeitstempel hinzufügen.
hint: Nutzen Sie `XCO_CP_TIME=>TIMESTAMP->ADD_DURATION( )` und `XCO_CP_TIME=>DURATION->FROM_SECONDS( )`.

CLASS zcl_xco_add_duration DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS add_duration_to_timestamp
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_timestamp TYPE timestampl
        iv_hours           TYPE i
        iv_minutes         TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_future_timestamp_str) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_add_duration IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_duration_to_timestamp.
    DATA(lo_start_ts) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->from_abap_timestamp( iv_start_timestamp ).
    DATA(lv_total_seconds) = ( iv_hours * 3600 ) + ( iv_minutes * 60 ).
    DATA(lo_duration) = xco_cp_time=>duration->from_seconds( lv_total_seconds ).
    DATA(lo_future_ts) = lo_start_ts->add_duration( lo_duration ).
    rv_future_timestamp_str = lo_future_ts->format( xco_cp_time=>timestamp_format->iso_8601_long )->value( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_expected_future_ts) = '20251209123000.0000000Z'. " 12:30:00 UTC (2h 30m later)

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_add_duration( ).
    DATA(lv_future_ts_str) = lo_cut->add_duration_to_timestamp( iv_start_timestamp = lv_start_ts

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_update.
    DATA: lt_sflights_initial TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'SQ'.
    DATA(lv_threshold) = '200.00'.
    DATA(lv_increase) = '25.00'.

    " Setup: Insert test data
    lt_sflights_initial = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20251209' price = '150.00' currency = 'SGD' ) " Should be updated
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20251209' price = '250.00' currency = 'SGD' ) " Should NOT be updated
      ( carrid = 'LH'     connid = '0400' fldate = '20251209' price = '180.00' currency = 'EUR' ) " Different airline, should NOT be updated
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_conditional( ).
    lo_cut->update_prices_conditionally( iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                         iv_price_threshold = lv_threshold
                                         iv_price_increase = lv_increase ).

    DATA(lt_sflights_after) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_after
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid OR carrid = 'LH'.

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_after INTO DATA(ls_flight_sq1) WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_sq1-price exp = '175.00' msg = 'SQ 0001 price should be updated' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_after INTO DATA(ls_flight_sq2) WITH KEY carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_sq2-price exp = '250.00' msg = 'SQ 0002 price should NOT be updated' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_after INTO DATA(ls_flight_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight_lh-price exp = '180.00' msg = 'LH 0400 price should NOT be updated' ).

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei Zeitstempel, um festzustellen, welcher früher oder später ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Vergleichsoperatoren (`<`, `>`, `=`, `<=`, `>=`) direkt auf `XCO` Zeitstempel-Objekten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_compare_timestamps DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_timestamp1_earlier
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_earlier) TYPE abap_bool.

    METHODS is_timestamp_equal
      IMPORTING
        iv_timestamp1 TYPE timestampl
        iv_timestamp2 TYPE timestampl
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_compare_timestamps IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_timestamp1_earlier.
    DATA(lo_ts1) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->from_abap_timestamp( iv_timestamp1 ).
    DATA(lo_ts2) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->from_abap_timestamp( iv_timestamp2 ).
    IF lo_ts1 < lo_ts2.
      rv_is_earlier = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_earlier = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD is_timestamp_equal.
    DATA(lo_ts1) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->from_abap_timestamp( iv_timestamp1 ).
    DATA(lo_ts2) = xco_cp_time=>timestamp->from_abap_timestamp( iv_timestamp2 ).
    IF lo_ts1 = lo_ts2.
      rv_is_equal = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_equal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_compare_timestamps FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_compare_timestamps.
    DATA(lv_ts_early) = '20251209100000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_ts_late)  = '20251209110000.0000000'.
    DATA(lv_ts_same)  = '20251209100000.0000000'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_compare_timestamps( ).

    " Test is_timestamp1_earlier
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp1_earlier( iv_timestamp1 = lv_ts_early iv_timestamp2 = lv_ts_late )
                                       msg = 'Early timestamp should be earlier than late' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp1_earlier( iv_timestamp1 = lv_ts_late iv_timestamp2 = lv_ts_early )
                                        msg = 'Late timestamp should not be earlier than early' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp1_earlier( iv_timestamp1 = lv_ts_early iv_timestamp2 = lv_ts_same )
                                        msg = 'Same timestamp should not be earlier than itself' ).

    " Test is_timestamp_equal
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_equal( iv_timestamp1 = lv_ts_early iv_timestamp2 = lv_ts_same )
                                       msg = 'Same timestamps should be equal' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->is_timestamp_equal( iv_timestamp1 = lv_ts_early iv_timestamp2 = lv_ts_late )
                                        msg = 'Different timestamps should not be equal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `XCO CP: Time API` ermöglicht den direkten Vergleich von Zeitstempel-Objekten mit den Standard-Vergleichsoperatoren (`<`, `>`, `=`, etc.). Instructions: Versuchen Sie, einen Datensatz in `SFLIGHTS` zu aktualisieren, der nicht existiert, und fangen Sie den Fehler ab, um eine entsprechende Meldung zurückzugeben.
hint: Verwenden Sie `UPDATE ... SET ... WHERE ...` und prüfen Sie `sy-subrc` oder verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für Datenbankausnahmen (obwohl `UPDATE` selbst keine Ausnahme wirft, kann man den Erfolg über `sy-subrc` prüfen).
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_error_handle DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_non_existent_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
        iv_new_price TYPE s_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_error_handle IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_non_existent_flight.
    UPDATE sflights SET price = iv_new_price
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND connid = iv_connid
        AND fldate = iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_message = |Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } { iv_fldate } updated successfully.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_message = |Error: Flight { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } { iv_fldate } not found or could not be updated.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_non_existent FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_update_existent FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_non_existent.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'. " Non-existent airline
    DATA(lv_connid) = '9999'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '20251209'.
    DATA(lv_new_price) = '100.00'.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_error_handle( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->update_non_existent_flight( iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                                            iv_connid = lv_connid
                                                            iv_fldate = lv_fldate
                                                            iv_new_price = lv_new_price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'Error' act = lv_message
                                          msg = 'Should return an error message for non-existent flight' ).
    ROLLBACK WORK. " Ensure no accidental changes
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_update_existent.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflights.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'UA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0001'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = '20251209'.
    DATA(lv_old_price) = '200.00'.
    DATA(lv_new_price) = '220.00'.

    " Setup: Insert test data
    ls_sflight = VALUE #( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate
                          price = lv_old_price currency = 'USD' ).
    INSERT sflights FROM ls_sflight.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      UPDATE sflights FROM ls_sflight.
    ENDIF.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_error_handle( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->update_non_existent_flight( iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                                            iv_connid = lv_connid
                                                            iv_fldate = lv_fldate
                                                            iv_new_price = lv_new_price ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = 'updated successfully' act = lv_message
                                          msg = 'Should return a success message for existent flight' ).

    " Teardown: Clean up test data
    DELETE sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl die `UPDATE`-Anweisung selbst keine Ausnahmen wirft, ist es gute Praxis, den Rückgabewert `sy-subrc` zu prüfen, um den Erfolg der Datenbankoperation zu bewerten. `sy-subrc = 0` bedeutet Erfolg, während andere Werte auf einen Fehler (z.B. Datensatz nicht gefunden) hinweisen. Die Verwendung von String-Templates (`|...|`) ermöglicht eine einfache und lesbare Erstellung von Fehlermeldungen.
keywords: UPDATE, Error Handling, sy-subrc, Database, SFLIGHTS, String Templates

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `UPDATE` Operation auf `SFLIGHTS` durch, die den Preis basierend auf einer komplexeren Logik (z.B. Erhöhung um 10% für Flüge über einem bestimmten Preis) direkt in der `SET`-Klausel verwendet, um die Anzahl der Datenbankzugriffe zu minimieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie arithmetische Ausdrücke direkt in der `SET`-Klausel der `UPDATE`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_update_expression DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS update_price_with_expression
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_min_price TYPE s_price
        iv_percentage_increase TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_update_expression IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_price_with_expression.
    DATA(lv_factor) = 1 + ( iv_percentage_increase / 100 ).

    UPDATE sflights SET price = price * @lv_factor
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
        AND price > iv_min_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_update_with_expression FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_with_expression.
    DATA: lt_sflights_initial TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'BA'.
    DATA(lv_min_price) = '300.00'.
    DATA(lv_percentage) = '10.0'.

    " Setup: Insert test data
    lt_sflights_initial = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = '20251209' price = '250.00' currency = 'GBP' ) " Below min_price, no update
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = '20251209' price = '350.00' currency = 'GBP' ) " Above min_price, update to 385.00
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0003' fldate = '20251209' price = '400.00' currency = 'GBP' ) " Above min_price, update to 440.00
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial ACCEPTING DUPLICATE KEYS.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_update_expression( ).
    lo_cut->update_price_with_expression( iv_carrid = lv_carrid
                                          iv_min_price = lv_min_price
                                          iv_percentage_increase = lv_percentage ).

    DATA(lt_sflights_after) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights_after
      WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_after INTO DATA(ls_flight1) WITH KEY connid = '0001'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight1-price exp = '250.00' msg = 'Flight 0001 price should not change' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_after INTO DATA(ls_flight2) WITH KEY connid = '0002'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight2-price exp = '385.00' msg = 'Flight 0002 price should be 350 * 1.1' ).

    READ TABLE lt_sflights_after INTO DATA(ls_flight3) WITH KEY connid = '0003'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight3-price exp = '440.00' msg = 'Flight 0003 price should be 400 * 1.1' ).

    " Teardown: Clean up test data
    DELETE sflights FROM TABLE lt_sflights_initial.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Ab ABAP 7.55 können arithmetische Ausdrücke direkt in der `SET`-Klausel der `UPDATE`-Anweisung verwendet werden. Dies ermöglicht es, komplexe Berechnungen direkt auf der Datenbank auszuführen, ohne die Daten zuerst in den Anwendungsserver laden zu müssen. Dies verbessert die Performance erheblich, insbesondere bei großen Datenmengen, da die Anzahl der Datenbankzugriffe und der Datentransfer minimiert werden.
keywords: UPDATE, Expressions, Arithmetic, Database, Performance, SFLIGHTS

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein gegebenes Datum ein gültiges Datum ist, und ob es in der Zukunft liegt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `XCO_CP_TIME=>DATE->FROM_ABAP_DATE( )` und die Methoden `IS_VALID( )` und `IS_IN_THE_FUTURE( )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xco_date_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate_future_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_date TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_valid_future) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xco_date_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_future_date.
    DATA(lo_date) = xco_cp_time=>date->from_abap_date( iv_date ).
    IF lo_date->is_valid( )->value( ) AND lo_date->is_in_the_future( )->value( ).
      rv_is_valid_future = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid_future = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:

    METHODS test_invalid_date FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_past_date FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_future_date.
    DATA(lv_future_date) = sy-datum + 10. " 10 days in the future
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_date_validation( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lo_cut->validate_future_date( lv_future_date )
                                       msg = 'Future date should be valid and in the future' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_date.
    DATA(lv_invalid_date) = '20250230'. " Invalid date
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_date_validation( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->validate_future_date( lv_invalid_date )
                                        msg = 'Invalid date should not be valid' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_past_date.
    DATA(lv_past_date) = sy-datum - 10. " 10 days in the past
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_xco_date_validation( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( act = lo_cut->validate_future_date( lv_past_date )
                                        msg = 'Past date should not be in the future' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `XCO CP: Time API` bietet nützliche Validierungsmethoden für Datums- und Zeitobjekte. `is_valid( )` prüft, ob ein Datum syntaktisch und semantisch korrekt ist (z.B. kein 30. Februar). `is_in_the_future( )` prüft, ob das Datum nach dem aktuellen Systemdatum liegt. Diese Methoden vereinfachen die Datenvalidierung erheblich und machen manuelle Prüfungen überflüssig.
keywords: XCO, Date, Validation, Future Date, is_valid, is_in_the_future

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen einfachen ALV-Bericht mit Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und passen Sie die Spaltenüberschrift einer Spalte dynamisch über die ALV-Metadaten an.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_salv_table` zur Anzeige und greifen Sie über `get_columns()` und `get_column()` auf die Metadaten zu, um die Überschrift zu ändern.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_col_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_with_custom_header.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_col_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_with_custom_header.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_data      = lt_sflights ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
        lo_column->set_long_text( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).
        lo_column->set_medium_text( 'Flugges.' ).
        lo_column->set_short_text( 'FLG' ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_alv_display FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_alv_display.
    " Dieser Test kann die visuelle Ausgabe eines ALV nicht direkt prüfen.
    " Stattdessen wird geprüft, ob die ALV-Instanz erfolgreich erstellt

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen ALV-Bericht und setzen Sie die Spaltenreihenfolge dynamisch, indem Sie die ALV-Metadaten manipulieren. Verschieben Sie beispielsweise 'CONNID' vor 'CARRID'.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_table` und die Methoden `set_sequence` der Spaltenobjekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_col_order DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_reordered.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_col_order IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_reordered.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.

    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_data      = lt_sflights ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).

        " Get current column order to adjust
        DATA(lt_column_list) = lo_columns->get_column_list( ).

        " Find CARRID and CONNID
        DATA(lv_carrid_idx) = 0.
        DATA(lv_connid_idx) = 0.
        LOOP AT lt_column_list INTO DATA(ls_column_name).
          IF ls_column_name = 'CARRID'.
            lv_carrid_idx = sy-tabix.
          ELSEIF ls_column_name = 'CONNID'.
            lv_connid_idx = sy-tabix.
          ENDIF.
        ENDLOOP.

        IF lv_carrid_idx > 0 AND lv_connid_idx > 0.
          " Swap positions: CONNID gets CARRID's old position, CARRID gets CONNID's old position
          lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' )->set_sequence( lv_carrid_idx ).
          lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' )->set_sequence( lv_connid_idx ).
        ENDIF.

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_column_reorder FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_column_reorder.
    TRY.
        DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
        SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 1 ROWS.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( t_data = lt_sflights ).
        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).

        DATA(lv_old_carrid_seq) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' )->get_sequence( ).
        DATA(lv_old_connid_seq) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' )->get_sequence( ).

        lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' )->set_sequence( lv_old_carrid_seq ).
        lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' )->set_sequence( lv_old_connid_seq ).

        DATA(lv_new_carrid_seq) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' )->get_sequence( ).
        DATA(lv_new_connid_seq) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' )->get_sequence( ).

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_carrid_seq exp = lv_old_connid_seq ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_new_connid_seq exp = lv_old_carrid_seq ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'ALV-Erstellung oder Spaltenreihenfolge fehlgeschlagen.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die dynamische Anpassung der Spaltenreihenfolge ist ein fortgeschrittenes Feature der ALV-Metadaten. Durch `get_column_list` erhält man die aktuelle Reihenfolge, und mit `set_sequence` kann man die Positionen einzelner Spalten ändern. Dies ermöglicht eine flexible Anpassung der Anzeige an Benutzerbedürfnisse. Inline-Deklarationen und die Verwendung von `LOOP AT ... INTO DATA` sind moderne ABAP-Syntaxelemente.

        DATA(lt_agg_rules) = lo_aggregations->get_aggregation_rules( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_agg_rules ) exp = 2 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_agg_rules[ 1 ]-columnname exp = 'CARRID' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_agg_rules[ 1 ]-group ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_agg_rules[ 2 ]-columnname exp = 'PRICE' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lt_agg_rules[ 2 ]-subtotal ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'ALV-Erstellung oder Zwischensummen fehlgeschlagen.' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von Gruppierung und Zwischensummen ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature für analytische Berichte. Durch zwei Aufrufe von `add_aggregation` auf dem `cl_salv_aggregations`-Objekt können sowohl die Gruppierung (`group = abap_true`) als auch die Zwischensummen (`subtotal = abap_true`) konfiguriert werden. Dies zeigt die Fähigkeit des modernen ALV, komplexe Datenpräsentationen zu erstellen.
keywords: ALV, cl_salv_table, cl_salv_aggregations, Zwischensummen, Gruppierung, SFLIGHTS

CLASS zcl_alv_excel_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_export,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,

CLASS zcl_alv_excel_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_sflights_to_excel.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.

        rv_success = abap_true.

Instructions: Erzeuge dynamisch einen Feldkatalog für ein ALV-Grid basierend auf der Struktur von `sflights` unter Verwendung von `FOR` und `VALUE` Ausdrücken.
hint: Nutze `cl_salv_table=>factory` und `FOR`/`VALUE` für den Feldkatalog.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_dynamic_fcat.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_fcat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_dynamic_fcat.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Dynamically get structure description
    DATA(lo_struct_descr) = cl_abap_structdescr=>describe_by_data( lt_sflights ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    " Build field catalog using FOR and VALUE
    DATA(lt_field_catalog) = VALUE salv_t_field_catalog(
      FOR <fs_comp> IN lt_components
      (
        fieldname = <fs_comp>-name,
        seltext_l = <fs_comp>-name, " Use component name as long text for simplicity
        col_pos   = sy-tabix
      )
    ).

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
            container_name = 'ALV_CONTAINER' " Placeholder, usually a custom container
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        lo_columns->set_column_position( lt_field_catalog ). " Apply dynamic field catalog

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Summe der Preise aller Flüge in `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks und zeige das Ergebnis an.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE`-Ausdruck, um die Aggregation durchzuführen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_reduce_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Aggregate total price using REDUCE expression
    rv_total_price = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT sum_price = 0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).

    " Optionally display in a simple ALV or message
    " For this example, we just return the value.
    " If displaying in ALV, one would create a single-row ALV with the result.
    " For demonstration, we focus on REDUCE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_reducer) = NEW zcl_alv_reduce_data( ).
    DATA(lv_total_price_lh) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).
    " Assuming some flights for LH exist and have prices.
    " This is a weak assertion, ideally we'd have mock data or a known sum.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_total_price_lh
      msg = 'Total price for LH should not be initial if flights exist.'
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_price_aa) = lo_reducer->calculate_total_price( 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_total_price_aa

    ).

    " Test with a non-existent airline, should be 0

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Ausdruck ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Weise. Er ersetzt explizite Schleifen und temporäre Variablen für Aggregationen und verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Wartbarkeit des Codes erheblich.

Instructions: Setze die Ausrichtung eines Splitter-Containers (`cl_gui_splitter_container`) basierend auf einer Bedingung (`COND`-Ausdruck).
hint: Nutze den `COND`-Ausdruck, um den Wert für die Ausrichtung zu bestimmen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_gui_cond_property DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_splitter_container
      IMPORTING iv_horizontal TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_gui_cond_property IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_splitter_container.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container,
          lo_splitter  TYPE REF TO cl_gui_splitter_container.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container EXPORTING container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'. " Assuming a custom container exists on screen

    TRY.
        CREATE OBJECT lo_splitter
          EXPORTING
            parent = lo_container
            rows   = 2
            columns = 1.

        " Set orientation using COND expression
        lo_splitter->set_orientation(
          orientation = COND i(
            WHEN iv_horizontal = abap_true THEN cl_gui_splitter_container=>orientation_horizontal
            ELSE cl_gui_splitter_container=>orientation_vertical
          )
        ).

        " Get sub-containers (not directly related to COND, but for completeness)
        DATA(lo_top_left) = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 1 column = 1 ).
        DATA(lo_bottom_right) = lo_splitter->get_container( row = 2 column = 1 ).

        " Add some content (e.g., textedit) to see the effect
        DATA(lo_textedit_top) = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = lo_top_left ).
        lo_textedit_top->set_text_as_stream( 'Top/Left Content' ).

        DATA(lo_textedit_bottom) = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = lo_bottom_right ).
        lo_textedit_bottom->set_text_as_stream( 'Bottom/Right Content' ).

        CALL METHOD cl_gui_cfw=>flush. " Refresh GUI
      CATCH cx_gui_exception.
        " Handle GUI errors
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Passe das Layout eines `cl_salv_table` ALV-Grids an, indem du Methodenaufrufe verkettetest, um die Sichtbarkeit von Spalten und die Sortierung zu konfigurieren.
hint: Nutze die Möglichkeit, Methodenaufrufe direkt aneinanderzureihen.

CLASS zcl_alv_method_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_chained.

CLASS zcl_alv_method_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_chained.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 20 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights
        ).

        " Method chaining for layout customization
        lo_salv_table->get_columns( )->get_column( 'CARRID' )->set_short_text( 'Airline' )->set_medium_text( 'Airline ID' )->set_long_text( 'Airline Identification' )->set_output_length( 10 ).
        lo_salv_table->get_columns( )->get_column( 'CONNID' )->set_visible( abap_false ). " Hide column
        lo_salv_table->get_columns( )->get_column( 'FLDATE' )->set_key( abap_true ). " Set as key field

        " Add sorting using chaining
        DATA(lo_sorts) = lo_salv_table->get_sorts( ).
        lo_sorts->add_sort( columnname = 'CARRID' position = 1 sortorder = if_salv_c_sort=>sort_order_ascending ).
        lo_sorts->add_sort( columnname = 'FLDATE' position = 2 sortorder = if_salv_c_sort=>sort_order_descending ).

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.

Instructions: Extrahiere die angezeigten Daten aus einem `cl_salv_table` ALV-Grid unter Verwendung von `cl_salv_ex_util=>get_data_from_alv` und verarbeite sie mit einer Tabellenexpression.
hint: Nutze `cl_salv_ex_util=>get_data_from_alv` und eine Tabellenexpression.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_get_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_alv_sflight_keys
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_sflight_keys) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_get_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_alv_sflight_keys.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights
        ).
        lo_salv_table->display( ).

        " Get data from ALV using cl_salv_ex_util
        DATA(lt_alv_data) = cl_salv_ex_util=>get_data_from_alv(
                                  i_salv_table = lo_salv_table
                                ).

        " Process with table expression (e.g., extract keys)
        rt_sflight_keys = VALUE tt_sflight_key(
          FOR <fs_row> IN lt_alv_data
          ( carrid = <fs_row>-carrid, connid = <fs_row>-connid )
        ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg cx_salv_ex_util_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_columns DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_sflights_custom_cols
      IMPORTING it_fieldnames TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_columns IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_custom_cols.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 10 ROWS.

    IF lt_sflights IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory(
          EXPORTING
            r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
          IMPORTING
            r_salv_table = DATA(lo_salv_table)
          CHANGING
            t_table = lt_sflights
        ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_salv_table->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lt_all_fcat) = cl_salv_ex_util=>get_field_catalog(
                                  i_data = lt_sflights
                                ).

        " Hide all columns first
        LOOP AT lt_all_fcat INTO DATA(ls_fcat_entry).
          lo_columns->get_column( ls_fcat_entry-fieldname )->set_visible( abap_false ).
        ENDLOOP.

        " Show only selected columns
        LOOP AT it_fieldnames INTO DATA(lv_fieldname).
          TRY.
              lo_columns->get_column( lv_fieldname )->set_visible( abap_true ).
            CATCH cx_salv_not_found.
              " Column not found, ignore or log
          ENDTRY.
        ENDLOOP.

        lo_salv_table->display( ).
      CATCH cx_salv_msg.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid_upper TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid       TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_summary.
    TYPES tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS get_transformed_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_transformed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_summary = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                          ( carrid_upper = to_upper( flight-carrid )
                            connid       = flight-connid ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in `sflights`.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_passengers RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT seatsocc FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                             FOR flight IN lt_sflights
                             NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_chainable_processor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    DATA mv_value TYPE i READ-ONLY.
    METHODS add IMPORTING iv_add TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_processor.
    METHODS multiply IMPORTING iv_mult TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_processor.
    METHODS init IMPORTING iv_initial_value TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chainable_processor.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chainable_processor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD init.
    mv_value = iv_initial_value.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add.
    mv_value = mv_value + iv_add.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD multiply.
    mv_value = mv_value * iv_mult.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_sflights_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_count TYPE i,

CLASS zcl_avg_occupancy DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der Flugpreise einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS` ohne `SELECT` Statement, sondern mit funktionalen Operatoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_itab_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_price_from_itab
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_itab_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_from_itab.
    IF it_sflights IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).

    rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( it_sflights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_avg_price_reduce FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_avg_price_reduce_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
    <fs_sflight>-price = 100.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-price = 200.
    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-price = 300.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_avg_price_from_itab( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average price should be 200' act = lv_avg_price exp = 200.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_avg_price_reduce_empty.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_avg_itab_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_avg_price) = lo_cut->get_avg_price_from_itab( lt_sflights ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Average price of empty table should be 0' act = lv_avg_price exp = 0.0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in internen Tabellen in einer einzigen Anweisung. Hier wird die Summe der Preise berechnet und anschließend durch die Anzahl der Zeilen geteilt, um den Durchschnitt zu erhalten.

CLASS zcl_avg_filter_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_price_filtered
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
        iv_carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_filter_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_filtered.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = FILTER sflight_table FROM it_sflights WHERE carrid = iv_carrid.

    IF lt_filtered_flights IS INITIAL.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE f(
      INIT sum = 0.0
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_filtered_flights
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price
    ).

    rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lines( lt_filtered_flights ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION.

    METHODS test_avg_price_filtered_empty_input FOR TESTING.

    APPEND INITIAL LINE TO lt_sflights ASSIGNING <fs_sflight>.
    <fs_sflight>-carrid = 'AA'.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Durchschnitt der Flugpreise einer internen Tabelle von `SFLIGHTS` unter Verwendung einer `FOR`-Schleife und manueller Summation.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `FOR`-Schleife, um die Preise zu summieren, und teilen Sie dann durch die Anzahl der Zeilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_avg_for_loop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_avg_price_for_loop
      IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_avg_price) TYPE f.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_avg_for_loop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_price_for_loop.
    DATA(lv_total_price) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count) = 0.

    FOR <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights.
      lv_total_price = lv_total_price + <fs_sflight>-price.
      lv_count = lv_count + 1.
    ENDFOR.

    IF lv_count > 0.
      rv_avg_price = lv_total_price / lv_count.
    ELSE.
      rv_avg_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie dynamisch eine interne Tabelle mit zwei Spalten (`FIELD1`, `FIELD2`) und füllen Sie diese mit einigen Werten, wobei Sie `FIELD-SYMBOLS` für den Zugriff verwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CREATE DATA` mit Typbeschreibung und `ASSIGN` für den Zugriff auf die dynamischen Objekte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_itab DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_dynamic_line,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
           END OF ty_dynamic_line.
    TYPES tt_dynamic_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS create_and_populate_dynamic_itab
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_dynamic_table) TYPE tt_dynamic_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_itab IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_populate_dynamic_itab.
    DATA: lr_data TYPE REF TO data.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE STANDARD TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_line>  TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp1> TYPE any.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp2> TYPE any.

    CREATE DATA lr_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_dynamic_line WITH EMPTY KEY.
    ASSIGN lr_data->* TO <fs_table>.

    DO 3 TIMES.
      APPEND INITIAL LINE TO <fs_table> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD1' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp1>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_comp1> = |Value { sy-index }|.
        ENDIF.

        ASSIGN COMPONENT 'FIELD2' OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_comp2>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          <fs_comp2> = sy-index * 10.
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    rt_dynamic_table = <fs_table>.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
