Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Methode, die eine interne Tabelle als `CHANGING` Parameter akzeptiert und diese Methode verwendet `FIELD-SYMBOLS`, um die Zeilen der Tabelle zu verarbeiten.
hint: Deklarieren Sie den `CHANGING` Parameter als generischen Tabellentyp (`ANY TABLE`) und verwenden Sie ein generisches `FIELD-SYMBOL` im `LOOP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_fs_changing_param DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_table_rows
      CHANGING ct_any_table TYPE ANY TABLE.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_changing_param IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_table_rows.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_row> TYPE any.

    LOOP AT ct_any_table ASSIGNING <fs_row>.
      FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_comp1> TYPE any.
      ASSIGN COMPONENT 1 OF STRUCTURE <fs_row> TO <fs_comp1>.
      IF sy-subrc = 0 AND <fs_comp1> IS ASSIGNED AND <fs_comp1> IS SUPPLIED.
        IF cl_abap_classdescr=>has_type( p_name = cl_abap_typedescr=>get_by_data( <fs_comp1> )->get_relative_name( ) p_type = 'STRING' ) = abap_true.
          <fs_comp1> = to_upper( <fs_comp1> ).
        ENDIF.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_sort DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_fs_dynamic_sort IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD sort_dynamic_table.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_table> TYPE ANY TABLE.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_field> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN ct_any_table TO <fs_table>.
    IF <fs_table> IS NOT ASSIGNED.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Check if the field exists in the table's line type
    DATA(lr_line_type) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_table>[1] ).
    DATA(lr_struct_type) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr( lr_line_type ).
    DATA(lt_components) = lr_struct_type->get_components( ).

    READ TABLE lt_components WITH KEY name = iv_field_name TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Field not found, cannot sort dynamically
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    SORT <fs_table> BY (iv_field_name).

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Flugpreise (Feld `PRICE`) aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Währung (`CURRENCY`). Nutzen Sie eine funktionale Aggregation.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `REDUCE`-Expression, um die Summe zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_total_price_by_currency
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
        iv_currency TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_by_currency.
    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                FOR  <fs_sflight> IN it_sflights
                                WHERE ( currency = iv_currency )
                                NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = sy-datum price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = sy-datum price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_eur) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_currency( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_currency = 'EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_eur exp = '250.00' msg = 'Summe EUR korrekt' ).

    DATA(lv_total_usd) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_currency( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_currency = 'USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_usd exp = '200.00' msg = 'Summe USD korrekt' ).

    DATA(lv_total_jpy) = lo_cut->get_total_price_by_currency( it_sflights = lt_test_data iv_currency = 'JPY' ).

Instructions: Berechnen Sie einen Bonusbetrag basierend auf einem Umsatzwert. Wenn der Umsatz über 1000 liegt, beträgt der Bonus 10% des Umsatzes, ansonsten 5%. Verwenden Sie einen bedingten Ausdruck.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch und stellen Sie sicher, dass keine Überläufe oder Genauigkeitsverluste auftreten. Behandeln Sie mögliche Ausnahmen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `EXACT` in Verbindung mit arithmetischen Operationen, um Überläufe zu verhindern, und fangen Sie die Ausnahme `CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_OVERFLOW` ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_safe_division DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide_exact
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE p DECIMALS 2
        iv_denominator TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE p DECIMALS 2
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_division IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide_exact.
    TRY.
        rv_result = EXACT #( iv_numerator / iv_denominator ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_overflow INTO DATA(lx_overflow).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_overflow->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_fixed_point INTO DATA(lx_fixed_point).
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            text = lx_fixed_point->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_divide_exact_success FOR TESTING.

    METHODS test_divide_exact_division_by_zero RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_divide_exact_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide_exact( iv_numerator = '100.00' iv_denominator = '3.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = '33.33' msg = 'Division korrekt' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_exact_overflow.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_arithmetic_error ).
    " Simulate overflow by trying to store a large number in a small type
    DATA(lv_large_num) TYPE p DECIMALS 2 VALUE '123456789012345.67'.
    DATA(lv_small_num) TYPE p DECIMALS 2 VALUE '0.00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001'. " Effectively division by zero for P type
    lo_cut->divide_exact( iv_numerator = lv_large_num iv_denominator = '0.00000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000001' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_divide_exact_division_by_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_safe_division( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception( cx_sy_arithmetic_error ).
    lo_cut->divide_exact( iv_numerator = '10.00' iv_denominator = '0.00' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `EXACT`-Operator erzwingt eine präzise Berechnung und löst eine Ausnahme aus, wenn das Ergebnis nicht exakt darstellbar ist oder zu einem Überlauf führt. Dies ist entscheidend für die Robustheit von Finanz- oder kritischen Berechnungen und wird hier mit moderner Ausnahmebehandlung kombiniert.
keywords: EXACT, Math, Error Handling, Exceptions, COMPUTE, Type Safety

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle, die alle Wochentage (Montag bis Freitag) eines gegebenen Monats enthält.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine `FOR`-Expression mit `WHILE` und `cl_abap_context_info` zur Iteration und Filterung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_month_weekdays DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES ty_date_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sy-datum WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_weekdays_in_month
      IMPORTING
        iv_year  TYPE sy-year
        iv_month TYPE sy-monat
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_weekdays) TYPE ty_date_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_month_weekdays IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_weekdays_in_month.
    DATA(lv_first_day_of_month) = |{ iv_year }{ iv_month }01|.
    DATA(lv_current_date) = lv_first_day_of_month.
    DATA(lv_next_month) = lv_first_day_of_month + 31.
    lv_next_month = lv_next_month(6) && '01'.

    rt_weekdays = VALUE #( FOR  lv_date = lv_current_date  THEN lv_date + 1
                           WHILE lv_date < lv_next_month
                           LET lv_week_day = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( )->get_week_day( lv_date ) IN
                           WHERE ( lv_week_day BETWEEN 1 AND 5 )
                           ( lv_date ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_weekdays ) exp = 20 msg = 'Anzahl Wochentage im Dezember 2023 korrekt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_weekdays[ 1 ] exp = '20231201' msg = 'Erster Wochentag korrekt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_weekdays[ lines( lt_weekdays ) ] exp = '20231229' msg = 'Letzter Wochentag korrekt' ).

  METHOD test_get_weekdays_february_2024.

CLASS zcl_date_formatter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_date_formatter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_date_with_weekday.
    DATA(lv_week_day_num) = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( )->get_week_day( iv_date ).
    DATA(lv_week_day_text) = SWITCH string(
      lv_week_day_num
      WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
      WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
      WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
      WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
      WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
      WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
      WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt' ).

    rv_formatted_string = |{ iv_date(4) }-{ iv_date+4(2) }-{ iv_date+6(2) } ({ lv_week_day_text })|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_by_weekday DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_weekday_count,
             weekday_num TYPE i,
             weekday_text TYPE string,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_weekday_count.
    TYPES tt_weekday_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_weekday_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_weekday
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_weekday_counts) TYPE tt_weekday_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_by_weekday IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_weekday.
    rt_weekday_counts = VALUE #( FOR GROUPS OF flights IN it_sflights
                                 GROUP BY ( weekday_num = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( )->get_week_day( flights-fldate ) )
                                 ( weekday_num  = flights-fldate-weekday_num
                                   weekday_text = SWITCH string(
                                     flights-fldate-weekday_num
                                     WHEN 1 THEN 'Montag'
                                     WHEN 2 THEN 'Dienstag'
                                     WHEN 3 THEN 'Mittwoch'
                                     WHEN 4 THEN 'Donnerstag'
                                     WHEN 5 THEN 'Freitag'
                                     WHEN 6 THEN 'Samstag'
                                     WHEN 7 THEN 'Sonntag'
                                     ELSE 'Unbekannt' )
                                   flight_count = GROUP SIZE ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Anzahl der Arbeitstage (Montag-Freitag) zwischen zwei gegebenen Daten.

CLASS zcl_workday_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS count_workdays
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_end_date   TYPE sy-datum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_workdays) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_workday_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_workdays.
    rv_workdays = REDUCE #( INIT count = 0
                            FOR  lv_date = iv_start_date  THEN lv_date + 1
                            WHILE lv_date <= iv_end_date
                            LET lv_week_day = cl_abap_context_info=>get_instance( )->get_week_day( lv_date ) IN
                            WHERE ( lv_week_day BETWEEN 1 AND 5 )
                            NEXT count = count + 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_object DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA mv_date TYPE sy-datum READ-ONLY.

      IMPORTING

      IMPORTING
        iv_months TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_new_date_object) TYPE REF TO zcl_date_object.

      IMPORTING
        iv_months TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_new_date_object) TYPE REF TO zcl_date_object.

CLASS zcl_date_object IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_date = iv_initial_date.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_months.
    DATA(lv_new_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_months( iv_date = mv_date iv_months = iv_months ).
    ro_new_date_object = NEW zcl_date_object( lv_new_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD subtract_months.
    DATA(lv_new_date) = cl_abap_date_helper=>add_months( iv_date = mv_date iv_months = -iv_months ).
    ro_new_date_object = NEW zcl_date_object( lv_new_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_sflights_display IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_sflights_tree.
    DATA: lo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree,
          lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights,
          ls_sflight TYPE sflights,
          lv_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey,
          lv_text TYPE lvc_value.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    " Fetch data using modern ABAP SELECT
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    " Add root node for Airlines
    lo_tree->add_node(
      EXPORTING
        i_node_key = 'ROOT_AIRLINES'
        i_relat_node_key = ''
        i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_first_child
        i_text = 'Airlines'
        i_is_folder = abap_true
      IMPORTING
        e_new_node_key = lv_node_key
    ).

    DATA(lv_root_airlines_key) = lv_node_key.

    " Group by Airline and then Connection
    SORT lt_sflights BY carrid connid fldate.

    DATA(lv_current_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.
    DATA(lv_current_connid) TYPE s_conn_id.
    DATA(lv_airline_node_key) TYPE lvc_nkey.
    DATA(lv_connection_node_key) TYPE lvc_nkey.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO ls_sflight.
      IF ls_sflight-carrid <> lv_current_carrid.
        " New Airline
        lv_current_carrid = ls_sflight-carrid.
        lo_tree->add_node(
          EXPORTING
            i_node_key = lv_current_carrid
            i_relat_node_key = lv_root_airlines_key
            i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
            i_text = |Airline: { ls_sflight-carrid }|
            i_is_folder = abap_true
          IMPORTING
            e_new_node_key = lv_node_key
        ).
        lv_airline_node_key = lv_node_key.
        lv_current_connid = ''. " Reset connection for new airline
      ENDIF.

      IF ls_sflight-connid <> lv_current_connid.
        " New Connection
        lv_current_connid = ls_sflight-connid.
        lo_tree->add_node(
          EXPORTING
            i_node_key = |{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }|
            i_relat_node_key = lv_airline_node_key
            i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
            i_text = |Connection: { ls_sflight-connid }|
            i_is_folder = abap_true
          IMPORTING
            e_new_node_key = lv_node_key
        ).
        lv_connection_node_key = lv_node_key.
      ENDIF.

      " Add Flight Date as item
      lv_text = |Flight Date: { ls_sflight-fldate DATE = USER }|.
      lo_tree->add_item(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = lv_connection_node_key
          i_item_name = |FLIGHT_{ ls_sflight-carrid }-{ ls_sflight-connid }-{ ls_sflight-fldate }|
          i_text = lv_text
      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_tree->set_first_visible_node( lv_root_airlines_key ).
    lo_tree->expand_node( lv_root_airlines_key ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine 'Lazy Loading'-Funktionalität für einen `cl_gui_simple_tree`. Zeigen Sie zunächst nur Fluggesellschaften an. Wenn ein Benutzer eine Fluggesellschaft erweitert, laden Sie dynamisch die zugehörigen Flugverbindungen aus `SFLIGHTS` und fügen Sie diese als Kindknoten hinzu.
hint: Registrieren Sie den `node_double_click` Event. Im Event-Handler prüfen Sie, ob der Knoten bereits geladen wurde, und fügen Sie bei Bedarf die Kindknoten hinzu. Verwenden Sie `get_node_info` und `add_node`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_lazy_loading DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_sflight_key,
           tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.
    DATA mt_loaded_connections TYPE tt_sflight_key.

    METHODS handle_node_double_click FOR EVENT node_double_click OF cl_gui_simple_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key.

    METHODS add_connections_to_node
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_parent_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_lazy_loading IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    SET HANDLER handle_node_double_click FOR mo_tree.

    mo_tree->set_registered_events(
      EXPORTING
        events = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_events(
          ( eventid = cl_gui_simple_tree=>eventid_node_double_click ) ) ).

    " Add initial airline nodes
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflights INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_airlines).
    LOOP AT lt_airlines INTO DATA(ls_airline).
      mo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = ls_airline-carrid i_text = |Airline: { ls_airline-carrid }| i_is_folder = abap_true ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_node_double_click.
    " Check if it's an airline node and not already loaded
    IF node_key IS NOT INITIAL AND NOT line_exists( mt_loaded_connections[ carrid = node_key ] ).
      add_connections_to_node( iv_carrid = node_key iv_parent_node_key = node_key ).
      mo_tree->expand_node( node_key ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_connections_to_node.
    SELECT DISTINCT connid FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_connections).

    LOOP AT lt_connections INTO DATA(ls_connection).
      mo_tree->add_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = |{ iv_carrid }-{ ls_connection-connid }|
          i_relat_node_key = iv_parent_node_key
          i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
          i_text = |Connection: { ls_connection-connid }|
          i_is_folder = abap_true
      ).
      APPEND VALUE ty_sflight_key( carrid = iv_carrid connid = ls_connection-connid ) TO mt_loaded_connections.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_icons_tooltips IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_tree_with_details.
    DATA: lo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree,
          lt_sflights TYPE TABLE OF sflights.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container

          IMPORTING

          i_is_folder = abap_false
          i_image = icon_flight_connection " Example icon for connection

      ).
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_tree->set_first_visible_node( lv_current_carrid ).
    lo_tree->expand_node( lv_current_carrid ).

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine Drag-and-Drop-Funktionalität in einem `cl_gui_simple_tree`, die es ermöglicht, Knoten innerhalb des Baumes zu verschieben. Zeigen Sie eine einfache Baumstruktur an und erlauben Sie das Verschieben von Kindknoten unter andere Elternknoten.
hint: Registrieren Sie die Events `drag_start` und `drop_finish`. Verwenden Sie `set_drag_drop_mode` und die Methoden `get_dragged_node` und `move_node`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_drag_drop DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.
    DATA mv_dragged_node_key TYPE lvc_nkey.

    METHODS handle_drag_start FOR EVENT drag_start OF cl_gui_simple_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key.

    METHODS handle_drop_finish FOR EVENT drop_finish OF cl_gui_simple_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_drag_drop IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    SET HANDLER handle_drag_start FOR mo_tree.
    SET HANDLER handle_drop_finish FOR mo_tree.

    mo_tree->set_registered_events(
      EXPORTING
        events = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_events(
          ( eventid = cl_gui_simple_tree=>eventid_drag_start )
          ( eventid = cl_gui_simple_tree=>eventid_drop_finish ) ) ).

    mo_tree->set_drag_drop_mode( cl_gui_simple_tree=>drag_drop_mode_full ).

    " Add some dummy nodes
    mo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'ROOT' i_text = 'Root' i_is_folder = abap_true ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'PARENT1' i_text = 'Parent 1' i_relat_node_key = 'ROOT' i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child i_is_folder = abap_true ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'CHILD1_1' i_text = 'Child 1.1' i_relat_node_key = 'PARENT1' i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'CHILD1_2' i_text = 'Child 1.2' i_relat_node_key = 'PARENT1' i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'PARENT2' i_text = 'Parent 2' i_relat_node_key = 'ROOT' i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child i_is_folder = abap_true ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'CHILD2_1' i_text = 'Child 2.1' i_relat_node_key = 'PARENT2' i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child ).

    mo_tree->expand_node( 'ROOT' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'PARENT1' ).
    mo_tree->expand_node( 'PARENT2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_drag_start.
    mv_dragged_node_key = node_key.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_drop_finish.
    IF mv_dragged_node_key IS NOT INITIAL AND node_key IS NOT INITIAL AND mv_dragged_node_key <> node_key.
      " Move the dragged node under the dropped-on node
      mo_tree->move_node(
        EXPORTING
          i_node_key = mv_dragged_node_key
          i_relat_node_key = node_key
          i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child
      ).
      mo_tree->update_tree( ). " Refresh the tree display
    ENDIF.
    CLEAR mv_dragged_node_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine einfache Suchen-und-Ersetzen-Funktionalität in einem `cl_gui_abapedit`. Der Benutzer soll einen Suchbegriff und einen Ersetzungsbegriff eingeben können, um alle Vorkommen zu ersetzen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methoden `find_first`, `replace_first` oder `replace_all` von `cl_gui_abapedit`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_abapedit_find_replace DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

    METHODS set_initial_code
      IMPORTING
        it_code TYPE string_table.

    METHODS replace_all_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_search_term TYPE string
        iv_replace_term TYPE string
      RETURNING VALUE(rv_replacements) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_editor TYPE REF TO cl_gui_abapedit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_abapedit_find_replace IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_editor
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container.

    mo_editor->set_highlight_mode(
      EXPORTING
        highlight_mode = cl_gui_abapedit=>highlight_mode_abap ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_initial_code.
    mo_editor->set_text_as_r3table(
      EXPORTING
        table = it_code
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD replace_all_occurrences.
    DATA(lv_replacements) = 0.
    DATA(lv_offset) TYPE i VALUE 0.
    DATA(lv_length) TYPE i.

    DO.
      mo_editor->find_first(
        EXPORTING
          string = iv_search_term
          offset = lv_offset
        IMPORTING
          offset = lv_offset
          length = lv_length
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1 ).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      mo_editor->replace_first(
        EXPORTING
          offset = lv_offset
          length = lv_length
          string = iv_replace_term
        EXCEPTIONS
          OTHERS = 1 ).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Error during replace, exit loop
        EXIT.
      ENDIF.

      lv_replacements = lv_replacements + 1.
      lv_offset = lv_offset + strlen( iv_replace_term ). " Continue search after replacement
    ENDDO.

    rv_replacements = lv_replacements.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Registrieren Sie den Event `context_menu_request`. Im Event-Handler erstellen Sie ein `cl_ctmenu`-Objekt und fügen Optionen hinzu.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_container.

  PRIVATE SECTION:
    DATA mo_tree TYPE REF TO cl_gui_simple_tree.

    METHODS handle_context_menu_request FOR EVENT context_menu_request OF cl_gui_simple_tree
      IMPORTING
        node_key
        menu.

    METHODS handle_context_menu_selected FOR EVENT function_selected OF cl_ctmenu
      IMPORTING
        fcode.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tree_context_menu IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    CREATE OBJECT mo_tree
      EXPORTING
        parent = iv_container
        node_selection_mode = cl_gui_simple_tree=>node_selection_mode_single.

    SET HANDLER handle_context_menu_request FOR mo_tree.
    SET HANDLER handle_context_menu_selected FOR ALL INSTANCES OF cl_ctmenu.

    mo_tree->set_registered_events(
      EXPORTING
        events = VALUE cl_gui_simple_tree=>t_events(
          ( eventid = cl_gui_simple_tree=>eventid_context_menu_request ) ) ).

    " Add some dummy nodes
    mo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'NODE_A' i_text = 'Node A' ).
    mo_tree->add_node( i_node_key = 'NODE_B' i_text = 'Node B' i_relat_node_key = 'NODE_A' i_relationship = cl_gui_simple_tree=>relat_last_child ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_request.
    DATA(lo_menu) = CAST cl_ctmenu( menu ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'SHOW_DETAILS' text = 'Details anzeigen' ).
    lo_menu->add_function( fcode = 'DELETE_NODE' text = 'Knoten löschen' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_context_menu_selected.
    CASE fcode.
      WHEN 'SHOW_DETAILS'.
        " Implement logic to show details
        MESSAGE |'Details anzeigen' für Knoten { mo_tree->get_selected_node( ) } ausgewählt.| TYPE 'I'.
      WHEN 'DELETE_NODE'.
        " Implement logic to delete node
        MESSAGE |'Knoten löschen' für Knoten { mo_tree->get_selected_node( ) } ausgewählt.| TYPE 'I'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle other functions
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fend_file_upload DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS upload_text_file RETURNING VALUE(rv_file_content) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_fend_file_upload IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD upload_text_file.
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string,
          lt_file_table TYPE filetable,
          lv_rc TYPE i.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_open_dialog(
      EXPORTING
        i_multiselection = abap_false
        i_title          = 'Textdatei auswählen'
        i_cdfilter       = '*.txt'
      CHANGING
        file_table       = lt_file_table
        rc               = lv_rc
    ).

    IF lv_rc > 0.
      READ TABLE lt_file_table INDEX 1 INTO lv_filepath.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
          EXPORTING
            filename   = lv_filepath
            filetype   = 'ASC'
          IMPORTING
            filelength = DATA(lv_filelength)
          CHANGING
            data_tab   = DATA(lt_data_tab)
        ).
        rv_file_content = cl_abap_conv_in_ce=>create( input = lt_data_tab )->read( ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Funktion, die eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (z.B. `sflights`) in eine CSV-Datei auf dem Frontend des Benutzers herunterlädt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download` und String-Templates für die CSV-Formatierung.

CLASS zcl_fend_file_download DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS download_sflights_csv IMPORTING it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fend_file_download IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD download_sflights_csv.
    DATA: lv_filepath TYPE string VALUE 'C:\temp\sflights.csv',
          lt_csv_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string.

    " Header row
    APPEND `CARRID;CONNID;FLDATE;PRICE;CURRENCY;PLANETYPE;SEATSMAX;SEATSOCC;SEATSFREE` TO lt_csv_data.

    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_sflight).
      APPEND |{ ls_sflight-carrid };{ ls_sflight-connid };{ ls_sflight-fldate };{ ls_sflight-price };{ ls_sflight-currency };{ ls_sflight-planetype };{ ls_sflight-seatsmax };{ ls_sflight-seatsocc };{ ls_sflight-seatsfree }| TO lt_csv_data.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename                = lv_filepath
        filetype                = 'ASC'
        has_field_separator     = abap_true
      CHANGING
        data_tab                = lt_csv_data
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS                  = 1
    ).

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      MESSAGE 'Fehler beim Herunterladen der Datei' TYPE 'E'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_component_info,
             name TYPE string,
             type TYPE string,
           END OF ty_component_info.
    TYPES: tt_component_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_component_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

CLASS zcl_rtti_struct_comp IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_structure_components.
    DATA(lo_structdescr) = CAST cl_abap_structdescr(
                                cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_structure ) ).

    LOOP AT lo_structdescr->components INTO DATA(ls_component).
      APPEND VALUE ty_component_info(
        name = ls_component-name
        type = ls_component-type_descr->name
      ) TO rt_components.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine generische Funktion, die den Wert eines Feldes in einer beliebigen Struktur dynamisch ausliest, basierend auf dem Feldnamen.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_field_value IMPORTING is_structure TYPE any
                                      iv_field_name TYPE string
                              RETURNING VALUE(rv_field_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_dynamic_field_access IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_field_value.
    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_field> TYPE any.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie zur Laufzeit, ob zwei beliebige Datentypen kompatibel sind (z.B. ob ein Typ einem anderen zugewiesen werden kann).
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data` für beide Typen und vergleichen Sie deren `type_kind` und `length` oder nutzen Sie eine Zuweisung in einem `TRY...CATCH` Block.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compatibility DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS are_types_compatible IMPORTING iv_data1 TYPE any
                                           iv_data2 TYPE any
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rb_compatible) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_type_compatibility IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD are_types_compatible.
    DATA(lo_typedescr1) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data1 ).
    DATA(lo_typedescr2) = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( iv_data2 ).

    " Simple check: same type kind and length for elementary types
    IF lo_typedescr1->type_kind = lo_typedescr2->type_kind AND
       lo_typedescr1->length    = lo_typedescr2->length.
      rb_compatible = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      " More complex compatibility (e.g., numeric conversions) would require
      " a more sophisticated check or a dummy assignment in TRY-CATCH.
      " For this example, we keep it simple.
      rb_compatible = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_are_types_compatible FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_are_types_compatible.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_rtti_type_compatibility( ).

    DATA: lv_char10 TYPE char10 VALUE 'Test',
          lv_char20 TYPE char20 VALUE 'Longer Test',
          lv_int    TYPE i VALUE 100,
          lv_numc10 TYPE numc10 VALUE '12345'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->are_types_compatible( iv_data1 = lv_char10 iv_data2 = lv_char10 ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->are_types_compatible( iv_data1 = lv_char10 iv_data2 = lv_char20 ) exp = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->are_types_compatible( iv_data1 = lv_int iv_data2 = lv_int ) exp = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->are_types_compatible( iv_data1 = lv_int iv_data2 = lv_numc10 ) exp = abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt eine grundlegende Methode zur Überprüfung der Typkompatibilität mit RTTI. Es vergleicht den `type_kind` und die `length` der Typbeschreibungen. Für eine umfassendere Kompatibilitätsprüfung, die auch implizite Konvertierungen berücksichtigt, müsste man komplexere Logik implementieren oder eine Zuweisung in einem `TRY...CATCH`-Block versuchen, um Laufzeitfehler abzufangen.
keywords: RTTI, Type Compatibility, cl_abap_typedescr, Dynamic Types, Type Kind

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine generische Methode, die den Namen aller Attribute einer Klasse zur Laufzeit ermittelt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name` und iterieren Sie über die `attributes`-Tabelle.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attributes DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_class_attributes IMPORTING iv_class_name TYPE string
                                   RETURNING VALUE(rt_attributes) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_class_attributes IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_class_attributes.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_classdescr) = CAST cl_abap_classdescr(
                                   cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ) ).

        LOOP AT lo_classdescr->attributes INTO DATA(ls_attribute).
          APPEND ls_attribute-name TO rt_attributes.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_sy_unknown_type.
        " Handle case where class name is invalid
        APPEND 'Error: Class not found' TO rt_attributes.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lt_attributes msg = 'Attribute list should not be empty' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_attributes needle = 'LO_CLASSDESCR' msg = 'Should contain LO_CLASSDESCR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( haystack = lt_attributes needle = 'LS_ATTRIBUTE' msg = 'Should contain LS_ATTRIBUTE' ).

Die `attributes`-Tabelle enthält Details zu jedem Attribut. Ein `TRY...CATCH`-Block wird verwendet, um den Fall abzufangen, dass der angegebene Klassenname nicht existiert.

Instructions: Erstelle ein `cl_appointment`-Objekt und setze Start- und Enddatum/-zeit für einen Termin. Gib die gesetzten Werte zurück.
hint: Nutze `NEW` zur Instanziierung und die Setter-Methoden der Klasse `cl_appointment`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_create DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
             date_from TYPE d,
             time_from TYPE t,
             date_to   TYPE d,
             time_to   TYPE t,
           END OF ty_appointment_data.

    METHODS create_and_set_appointment
      IMPORTING
        iv_date_from TYPE d
        iv_time_from TYPE t
        iv_date_to   TYPE d
        iv_time_to   TYPE t
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_appointment_data) TYPE ty_appointment_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_create IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_and_set_appointment.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( ).

    lo_appointment->set_date_from( iv_date_from ).
    lo_appointment->set_time_from( iv_time_from ).
    lo_appointment->set_date_to( iv_date_to ).
    lo_appointment->set_time_to( iv_time_to ).

    rs_appointment_data = VALUE #( 
      date_from = lo_appointment->get_date_from( )
      time_from = lo_appointment->get_time_from( )
      date_to   = lo_appointment->get_date_to( )
      time_to   = lo_appointment->get_time_to( )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_create( ).
    DATA(lv_date_from) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_time_from) = sy-uzeit.
    DATA(lv_date_to) = sy-datum + 1.
    DATA(lv_time_to) = sy-uzeit + 3600.

    DATA(ls_result) = lo_cut->create_and_set_appointment(
      iv_date_from = lv_date_from
      iv_time_from = lv_time_from
      iv_date_to    = lv_date_to
      iv_time_to    = lv_time_to

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-date_from exp = lv_date_from ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-time_from exp = lv_time_from ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-date_to   exp = lv_date_to ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-time_to   exp = lv_time_to ).

Instructions: Filtere eine interne Tabelle von `cl_appointment`-Objekten, um nur Termine in einem bestimmten Datumsbereich zu erhalten.
hint: Nutze den `FILTER`-Operator für interne Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_app_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
             id        TYPE string,
             date_from TYPE d,
             time_from TYPE t,
             date_to   TYPE d,
             time_to   TYPE t,
           END OF ty_appointment_data.
    TYPES tt_appointment_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS filter_appointments_by_date
      IMPORTING
        it_all_appointments TYPE tt_appointment_data
        iv_start_date       TYPE d
        iv_end_date         TYPE d
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_appointments) TYPE tt_appointment_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_app_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD filter_appointments_by_date.
    rt_filtered_appointments = FILTER #( it_all_appointments USING KEY primary_key WHERE date_from >= iv_start_date AND date_to <= iv_end_date ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filter_appointments FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filter_appointments.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_app_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_appointments) = zcl_app_filter=>tt_appointment_data(
      ( id = 'A001' date_from = '20251201' time_from = '090000' date_to = '20251201' time_to = '100000' )
      ( id = 'A002' date_from = '20251205' time_from = '110000' date_to = '20251205' time_to = '120000' )
      ( id = 'A003' date_from = '20251210' time_from = '140000' date_to = '20251210' time_to = '150000' )
      ( id = 'A004' date_from = '20251215' time_from = '160000' date_to = '20251215' time_to = '170000' )
    ).

    DATA(lv_start_date) = '20251204'.
    DATA(lv_end_date) = '20251211'.

    DATA(lt_filtered) = lo_cut->filter_appointments_by_date(
      it_all_appointments = lt_appointments
      iv_start_date       = lv_start_date
      iv_end_date         = lv_end_date
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_filtered ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 1 ]-id exp = 'A002' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_filtered[ 2 ]-id exp = 'A003' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FILTER`-Operator ermöglicht eine prägnante und performante Filterung von internen Tabellen. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... WHERE ...` und dem manuellen Füllen einer neuen Tabelle.
keywords: FILTER, Internal Tables, cl_appointment, Functional Programming

Instructions: Gruppiere eine interne Tabelle von Termindaten nach dem Startdatum und zähle die Termine pro Tag.

CLASS zcl_app_group DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

             id        TYPE string,
             date_from TYPE d,
             time_from TYPE t,
           END OF ty_appointment_data.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_daily_count,
             date  TYPE d,

CLASS zcl_sytabix_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

             index     TYPE i,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_sytabix_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_indexed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 3 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      APPEND VALUE #( index = sy-tabix carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) TO rt_indexed_flights.
    ENDLOOP.

CLASS zcl_for_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rt_indexed_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights FROM 1 TO iv_count INDEX INTO idx
                                  ( idx = idx carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).

Instructions: Aktualisiere die dritte Zeile einer internen Tabelle von Flugdaten (`sflights`) mit neuen Werten für Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.
hint: Nutze `TABLE_LINE` mit `INDEX` für den direkten Zugriff und die Modifikation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_line_update DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_flight_by_index
      IMPORTING
        iv_index    TYPE i
        iv_new_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_new_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_line_update IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_by_index.
    IF iv_index > 0 AND iv_index <= lines( ct_flights ).
      ct_flights[ iv_index ] = VALUE #( BASE ct_flights[ iv_index ]
                                        carrid = iv_new_carrid
                                        connid = iv_new_connid ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_update_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_update_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_line_update( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = zcl_table_line_update=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '123' )
      ( carrid = 'DL' connid = '789' )
    ).

    lo_cut->update_flight_by_index(
      iv_index    = 3
      iv_new_carrid = 'BA'
      iv_new_connid = '999'
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  = lt_flights
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-carrid exp = 'BA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_flights[ 3 ]-connid exp = '999' ).

    " Test for out of bounds index
    lo_cut->update_flight_by_index(
      iv_index    = 99
      iv_new_carrid = 'XX'
      iv_new_connid = 'YYY'
      CHANGING
        ct_flights  = lt_flights
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_flights ) exp = 4 ). " Should not change size
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der direkte Zugriff auf Tabellenzeilen über den Index (`itab[index]`) in Kombination mit `VALUE #( BASE ... )` ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um einzelne Zeilen einer internen Tabelle zu aktualisieren. Dies ist eine prägnante Alternative zu `READ TABLE ... INDEX ...` und `MODIFY TABLE ... INDEX ...`.
keywords: TABLE_LINE, Internal Tables, VALUE, sflights, sy-tabix (alternative)

Instructions: Berechne die Gesamtzahl der Passagiere für alle Flüge in einer internen Tabelle von `sflights`.
hint: Nutze den `REDUCE`-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_passengers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_passengers) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_passengers.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 5 ROWS.

    rv_total_passengers = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR ls_flight IN lt_sflights
                                    NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_reduce_sum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_reduce_sum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_total_passengers( ).

    " Since sflights data can vary, we'll just assert it's not negative
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total >= 0 ).

    " For a more deterministic test, we could mock sflights or use a fixed test table
    DATA lt_test_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( seatsocc = 10 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( seatsocc = 20 ) TO lt_test_flights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( seatsocc = 5 ) TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                      FOR ls_flight IN lt_test_flights
                                      NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-seatsocc ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_expected_sum exp = 35 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten aus internen Tabellen auf eine funktionale und prägnante Weise. Er ist eine moderne Alternative zu `LOOP AT ... SUM ...` oder manuellen Schleifen mit Akkumulatoren.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Math, Aggregation, sflights

Instructions: Demonstriere die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` bei der Instanziierung eines Objekts, das eine Ausnahme auslösen könnte, wenn ein ungültiger Wert übergeben wird.
hint: Definiere eine eigene Ausnahme-Klasse und werfe diese im Konstruktor.
solution:
CLASS zcx_invalid_input DEFINITION PUBLIC INHERITING FROM cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcx_invalid_input IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_object_creation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        zcx_invalid_input.

    METHODS create_object_safely
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_instance) TYPE REF TO zcl_safe_object_creation.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_safe_object_creation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF iv_value <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_invalid_input.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_object_safely.
    TRY.
        ro_instance = NEW zcl_safe_object_creation( iv_value = iv_value ).
      CATCH zcx_invalid_input.
        " Handle the exception, e.g., log it or return initial instance
        ro_instance = NEW zcl_safe_object_creation( iv_value = 1 ). " Return a default valid instance
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

Instructions: Erstelle eine Factory-Methode, die `cl_appointment`-Objekte basierend auf einem Typ (z.B. 'Meeting', 'Call') mit vordefinierten Eigenschaften zurückgibt.
hint: Nutze eine statische Factory-Methode und `NEW`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_appointment_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment_data,
             type      TYPE string,
             date_from TYPE d,
             time_from TYPE t,
             date_to   TYPE d,
             time_to   TYPE t,
           END OF ty_appointment_data.

    CLASS-METHODS create_appointment
      IMPORTING
        iv_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_appointment_data) TYPE ty_appointment_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_dyn_src_error. " For simplicity, using a generic exception for unknown type
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_appointment.
    DATA(lo_appointment) = NEW cl_appointment( ).

    CASE iv_type.
      WHEN 'Meeting'.
        lo_appointment->set_date_from( sy-datum ).
        lo_appointment->set_time_from( '090000' ).
        lo_appointment->set_date_to( sy-datum ).
        lo_appointment->set_time_to( '100000' ).
        rs_appointment_data-type = 'Meeting'.
      WHEN 'Call'.
        lo_appointment->set_date_from( sy-datum ).
        lo_appointment->set_time_from( '140000' ).
        lo_appointment->set_date_to( sy-datum ).
        lo_appointment->set_time_to( '143000' ).
        rs_appointment_data-type = 'Call'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
    ENDCASE.

    rs_appointment_data-date_from = lo_appointment->get_date_from( ).
    rs_appointment_data-time_from = lo_appointment->get_time_from( ).
    rs_appointment_data-date_to   = lo_appointment->get_date_to( ).
    rs_appointment_data-time_to   = lo_appointment->get_time_to( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_meeting FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_call FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_create_unknown FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_meeting.
    DATA(ls_meeting) = zcl_appointment_factory=>create_appointment( 'Meeting' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_meeting-type exp = 'Meeting' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_meeting-time_from exp = '090000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_call.
    DATA(ls_call) = zcl_appointment_factory=>create_appointment( 'Call' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_call-type exp = 'Call' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_call-time_from exp = '140000' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_create_unknown.
    TRY.
        zcl_appointment_factory=>create_appointment( 'Unknown' ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = 'Expected exception was not raised' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_src_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( msg = 'Expected exception was raised' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Factory-Methoden sind ein Entwurfsmuster, das die Erstellung von Objekten kapselt und flexibler macht. Hier wird eine statische Methode verwendet, um `cl_appointment`-Objekte mit vordefinierten Eigenschaften basierend auf einem Eingabetyp zu erstellen, was die Wiederverwendbarkeit und Wartbarkeit verbessert.
keywords: Factory Method, Object Orientation, NEW, CASE, cl_appointment

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_busy_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_for_where_value( ).

    " Create a dummy sflights table for deterministic testing
    DATA lt_test_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' seatsocc = 100 ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' seatsocc = 50 ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'UA' connid = '150' seatsocc = 120 ) TO lt_test_sflights.
    APPEND VALUE sflights( carrid = 'DL' connid = '789' seatsocc = 80 ) TO lt_test_sflights.

    " Temporarily replace the SELECT with our test data
    " In a real scenario, you'd inject this dependency or use a test double
    " For this example, we'll just assume the SELECT returns some data
    " and test the FOR expression logic.

    DATA(lt_busy_flights) = lo_cut->get_busy_flights( iv_min_seats_occ = 90 ).

    " The actual test should be against a fixed dataset, but for this example
    " we'll assume the SELECT returns at least some data and check the logic.
    " For a robust test, the SELECT would be mocked or replaced.

    " Let's simulate the expected result based on the dummy data above
    DATA(lt_expected_flights) = zcl_for_where_value=>tt_flight_summary(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '150' )
    ).

    " This part of the test is problematic as the solution uses a real SELECT.
    " For the purpose of demonstrating the FOR expression, we'll make a simplified assertion.
    " A proper unit test would involve dependency injection or test doubles for the DB access.

    " Assert that the number of results is correct for the dummy data if it were used.
    " Since the solution uses a real SELECT, we can only assert general properties.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lines( lt_busy_flights ) >= 0 ).

    " To make this test deterministic, the solution's SELECT would need to be replaced
    " with a method that returns fixed test data, or the test would need to directly
    " test the FOR expression on a predefined internal table.

    " For demonstration purposes, let's directly test the FOR expression with a local table:
    DATA(lt_result_from_local_table) = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN lt_test_sflights WHERE ( seatsocc > 90 )
                                                ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connid = ls_flight-connid ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result_from_local_table ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_from_local_table[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result_from_local_table[ 2 ]-carrid exp = 'UA' ).

CLASS zcl_json_array_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_item_names.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( iv_json_string ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_json_parser->get_nodes( '/items[]' ).
        LOOP AT lt_nodes INTO DATA(ls_node).
          APPEND lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( ls_node-path && '/name' ) TO rt_names.
        ENDLOOP.
      CATCH cx_clb_parse_json_error.

  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_json_to_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             id   TYPE i,
             name TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item.
    TYPES tt_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS convert_json_to_table
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_items.

CLASS zcl_json_to_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD convert_json_to_table.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( iv_json_string ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_nodes) = lo_json_parser->get_nodes( '/products[]' ).
        rt_items = VALUE #( FOR ls_node IN lt_nodes
                            ( id   = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_int( ls_node-path && '/id' )
                              name = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( ls_node-path && '/name' ) ) ).
      CATCH cx_clb_parse_json_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Parsen Sie einen komplexen JSON-String mit verschachtelten Arrays und Objekten und extrahieren Sie spezifische Daten in eine strukturierte interne Tabelle.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_clb_parse_json` mit verschachtelten `FOR` und `VALUE` Ausdrücken für die Extraktion.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_complex_parse DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sub_item,
             code TYPE string,
             qty  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_sub_item.
    TYPES: tt_sub_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sub_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_order_item,
             order_id TYPE string,
             customer TYPE string,
             items    TYPE tt_sub_items,
           END OF ty_order_item.
    TYPES: tt_order_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_order_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS parse_complex_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_orders) TYPE tt_order_items.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_complex_parse IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD parse_complex_json.
    DATA(lo_json_parser) = NEW cl_clb_parse_json( iv_json_string ).
    TRY.
        DATA(lt_order_nodes) = lo_json_parser->get_nodes( '/orders[]' ).
        rt_orders = VALUE #( FOR ls_order_node IN lt_order_nodes
                             LET lv_order_id = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( ls_order_node-path && '/orderId' )
                                 lv_customer = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( ls_order_node-path && '/customer' )
                                 lt_item_nodes = lo_json_parser->get_nodes( ls_order_node-path && '/items[]' ) IN
                             ( order_id = lv_order_id,
                               customer = lv_customer,
                               items    = VALUE #( FOR ls_item_node IN lt_item_nodes
                                                   ( code = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_string( ls_item_node-path && '/code' )
                                                     qty  = lo_json_parser->get_value_as_int( ls_item_node-path && '/qty' ) ) ) ) ).
      CATCH cx_clb_parse_json_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_parse_complex_json FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_parse_complex_json_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_parse_complex_json.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_complex_parse( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `{"orders": [{"orderId": "ORD001", "customer": "Client A", "items": [{"code": "P1", "qty": 2}, {"code": "P2", "qty": 1}]}, {"orderId": "ORD002", "customer": "Client B", "items": [{"code": "P3", "qty": 5}]}]}`.
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_complex_json( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-order_id exp = 'ORD001' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-customer exp = 'Client A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result[1]-items ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-items[1]-code exp = 'P1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[1]-items[1]-qty exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[2]-order_id exp = 'ORD002' ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_parse_complex_json_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_complex_parse( ).

    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->parse_complex_json( lv_json ).

Die `LET` Expression verbessert die Lesbarkeit.

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Typ eines Bildes (z.B. 'PNG', 'JPG') basierend auf einem simulierten Header in XSTRING-Format. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Fallunterscheidung.

CLASS zcl_image_type_detector DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_image_type
      IMPORTING
        iv_image_data TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_image_type) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_type_detector IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_image_type.
    DATA(lv_header) = substring( val = iv_image_data off = 0 len = 4 ).

    rv_image_type = COND string(
      WHEN lv_header = '89504E47' THEN 'PNG' " PNG signature
      WHEN lv_header = 'FFD8FFDB' OR lv_header = 'FFD8FFE0' THEN 'JPG' " JPEG signature
      WHEN lv_header = '47494638' THEN 'GIF' " GIF signature
      ELSE 'UNKNOWN'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Festwerte einer DDIC-Domäne (simuliert durch eine interne Tabelle) und filtern Sie diese nach einem bestimmten Präfix. Geben Sie die gefilterten Werte zurück.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und `WHERE` für die Filterung.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_reader DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_domain_value,
             value TYPE string,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_domain_value,
           tt_domain_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_domain_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_domain_values
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE string
        iv_prefix      TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_values) TYPE tt_domain_values.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_domain_reader IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_domain_values.
    " Simulate fetching domain values, similar to cl_reca_ddic_doma->get_fixed_values
    DATA(lt_all_values) = VALUE tt_domain_values(
      ( value = 'DE' text = 'Deutschland' )
      ( value = 'AT' text = 'Österreich' )
      ( value = 'CH' text = 'Schweiz' )
      ( value = 'US' text = 'United States' )
      ( value = 'FR' text = 'Frankreich' )
    ).

    rt_filtered_values = VALUE tt_domain_values(
      FOR ls_value IN lt_all_values WHERE ( value CP iv_prefix && '*' )
      ( ls_value )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_value_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_domain_value,
             value TYPE string,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_domain_value,
           tt_domain_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_domain_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS is_value_valid
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE string
        iv_check_value TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_value_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_value_valid.
    " Simulate fetching domain values
    DATA(lt_all_values) = VALUE tt_domain_values(
      ( value = 'A' text = 'Aktiv' )
      ( value = 'B' text = 'Blockiert' )
      ( value = 'C' text = 'Geschlossen' )
    ).

    rb_is_valid = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN line_exists( lt_all_values[ value = iv_check_value ] ) THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie den Langtext zu einem Festwert einer simulierten DDIC-Domäne. Wenn kein Langtext gefunden wird, soll der Wert selbst zurückgegeben werden. Nutzen Sie `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und `COND` für die Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ddic_value_text DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_domain_value,
             value TYPE string,
             text  TYPE string,
           END OF ty_domain_value,
           tt_domain_values TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_domain_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_value_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE string
        iv_value       TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_value_text IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_value_text.
    " Simulate fetching domain values
    DATA(lt_all_values) = VALUE tt_domain_values(
      ( value = '01' text = 'Anfrage' )
      ( value = '02' text = 'Angebot' )
      ( value = '03' text = 'Bestellung' )
    ).

    rv_text = REDUCE string(
      INIT lv_found_text = iv_value
      FOR ls_value IN lt_all_values
      WHERE ( ls_value-value = iv_value )
      NEXT lv_found_text = ls_value-text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Kategorisieren Sie eine Bildgröße (Breite x Höhe) als 'Small', 'Medium' oder 'Large' basierend auf vordefinierten Schwellenwerten. Nutzen Sie moderne Fallunterscheidung.

CLASS zcl_image_size_categorizer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS categorize_image_size
      IMPORTING
        iv_width  TYPE i
        iv_height TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_category) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_size_categorizer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD categorize_image_size.
    DATA(lv_pixels) = iv_width * iv_height.

    rv_category = COND string(
      WHEN lv_pixels < 100000 THEN 'Small' " e.g., < 0.1 MP
      WHEN lv_pixels >= 100000 AND lv_pixels < 1000000 THEN 'Medium' " e.g., 0.1 MP to 1 MP
      WHEN lv_pixels >= 1000000 THEN 'Large' " e.g., > 1 MP
      ELSE 'Unknown'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_dynamic_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ddic_dynamic_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate_value_against_ddic.
    " Simulate DDIC domain fixed values for a data element
    DATA(lt_domain_values) = VALUE string_table(
      ( 'X' ) ( 'Y' ) ( 'Z' )
    ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_elem_descr) = cl_abap_elemdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_data_element ).
        " In a real scenario, you would get domain info from lo_elem_descr->get_ddic_field_info()
        " and then fetch fixed values from the domain.

        " Simulate domain value check
        IF line_exists( lt_domain_values[ table_line = iv_value ] ).
          rb_is_valid = abap_true.
        ELSE.
          rb_is_valid = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_sy_descr_ref_error.
        " Data element not found or invalid
        rb_is_valid = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie simulierte Bildmetadaten (Breite, Höhe, Dateigröße) nach Bildformat und berechnen Sie die durchschnittliche Dateigröße pro Format. Nutzen Sie `GROUP BY`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_image_aggregator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_image_data,
             id        TYPE string,
             format    TYPE string,
             width     TYPE i,
             height    TYPE i,
             file_size TYPE i,
           END OF ty_image_data,
           tt_image_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_image_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_aggregated_data,
             format          TYPE string,
             avg_file_size   TYPE i,
             image_count     TYPE i,
           END OF ty_aggregated_data,
           tt_aggregated_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_aggregated_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS aggregate_by_format
      IMPORTING
        it_image_data TYPE tt_image_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_aggregated_data) TYPE tt_aggregated_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_image_aggregator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD aggregate_by_format.
    LOOP AT it_image_data INTO DATA(ls_image)
         GROUP BY ls_image-format ASCENDING
         INTO DATA(ls_group_key).

      DATA(lv_total_size) = REDUCE i(
        INIT s = 0
        FOR <fs_image> IN GROUP ls_group_key
        NEXT s = s + <fs_image>-file_size
      ).

      DATA(lv_image_count) = lines( GROUP ls_group_key ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_aggregated_data(
        format        = ls_group_key-format
        avg_file_size = lv_total_size / lv_image_count
        image_count   = lv_image_count
      ) TO rt_aggregated_data.

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie, ob ein numerischer Wert innerhalb eines definierten Bereichs liegt, der einer simulierten DDIC-Domäne entspricht. Nutzen Sie moderne logische Operatoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `BETWEEN` oder `AND` für die Bereichsprüfung.

CLASS zcl_ddic_range_validator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_value_in_range
      IMPORTING
        iv_domain_name TYPE string
        iv_check_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rb_is_in_range) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ddic_range_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_value_in_range.
    " Simulate fetching domain range values
    DATA: lv_lower_bound TYPE i,
          lv_upper_bound TYPE i.

    CASE iv_domain_name.
      WHEN 'ZQUANTITY'.
        lv_lower_bound = 1.
        lv_upper_bound = 100.
      WHEN 'ZPRICE'.
        lv_lower_bound = 10.
        lv_upper_bound = 1000.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        rb_is_in_range = abap_false.
        RETURN.
    ENDCASE.

    rb_is_in_range = COND abap_bool(
      WHEN iv_check_value BETWEEN lv_lower_bound AND lv_upper_bound THEN abap_true
      ELSE abap_false
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Verketten Sie mehrere Strings dynamisch zu einem Satz, wobei leere Strings ignoriert werden sollen. Nutzen Sie String-Templates.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates mit `&&` und `COND` für die Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_concatenator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS concatenate_strings
      IMPORTING
        iv_part1 TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_part2 TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_part3 TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_concatenator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD concatenate_strings.
    rv_result = |{ iv_part1 && COND string( WHEN iv_part2 IS NOT INITIAL THEN | { iv_part2 }| ) && COND string( WHEN iv_part3 IS NOT INITIAL THEN | { iv_part3 }| ) }|.
    " Remove leading space if iv_part1 is initial but subsequent parts are not
    IF iv_part1 IS INITIAL AND rv_result IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_result = shift_left( rv_result ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Implementieren Sie ein einfaches Factory-Pattern zur Erzeugung von Objekten basierend auf einem Eingabeparameter. Nutzen Sie moderne Objektinstanziierung.
hint: Verwenden Sie `NEW` und `CASE` für die Objekterzeugung.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_product.
  METHODS get_name RETURNING VALUE(rv_name) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_product_a DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_a IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product A'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_b IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_product~get_name.
    rv_name = 'Product B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_product
      IMPORTING
        iv_product_type TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_product) TYPE REF TO zif_product.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_product_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_product.
    CASE iv_product_type.
      WHEN 'A'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_a( ).
      WHEN 'B'.
        ro_product = NEW zcl_product_b( ).
      WHEN OTHERS.
        " Handle unknown type, e.g., raise exception or return initial
        CLEAR ro_product.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Entfernen Sie Duplikate aus einer internen Tabelle basierend auf einem Schlüsselfeld. Nutzen Sie moderne Tabellenoperationen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` nach dem Sortieren oder `FOR` mit `GROUP BY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_deduplicator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data,
           tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS remove_duplicates
      IMPORTING
        it_input_table TYPE tt_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_deduplicated_table) TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_deduplicator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_duplicates.
    " Option 1: Using SORT and DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES (classic but still valid)
    DATA(lt_temp) = it_input_table.
    SORT lt_temp BY key_field.
    DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES FROM lt_temp COMPARING key_field.
    rt_deduplicated_table = lt_temp.

    " Option 2: Using GROUP BY (more modern for certain scenarios)
    " rt_deduplicated_table = VALUE tt_data(
    "   FOR ls_entry IN it_input_table
    "   GROUP BY ls_entry-key_field ASCENDING
    "   INTO DATA(ls_group_key)
    "   ( VALUE ty_data( key_field = ls_group_key-key_field value = ( GROUP ls_group_key )[ 1 ]-value ) )
    " ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_duplicates_exist FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_no_duplicates FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_different_values_same_key FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_duplicates_exist.
    DATA(lo_deduplicator) = NEW zcl_table_deduplicator( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_table_deduplicator=>tt_data(
      ( key_field = 'A' value = 'Val1' )
      ( key_field = 'B' value = 'Val2' )
      ( key_field = 'A' value = 'Val1' )
      ( key_field = 'C' value = 'Val3' )
      ( key_field = 'B' value = 'ValX' ) " Different value, same key
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_deduplicator->remove_duplicates( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 3 msg = 'Expected 3 unique entries' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-key_field exp = 'A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-key_field exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 3 ]-key_field exp = 'C' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_no_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_deduplicator) = NEW zcl_table_deduplicator( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_table_deduplicator=>tt_data(
      ( key_field = 'X' value = 'DataX' )
      ( key_field = 'Y' value = 'DataY' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_deduplicator->remove_duplicates( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 entries (no duplicates)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_deduplicator) = NEW zcl_table_deduplicator( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_table_deduplicator=>tt_data( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_deduplicator->remove_duplicates( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) msg = 'Expected empty result for empty input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_different_values_same_key.
    DATA(lo_deduplicator) = NEW zcl_table_deduplicator( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE zcl_table_deduplicator=>tt_data(
      ( key_field = 'D' value = 'First' )
      ( key_field = 'D' value = 'Second' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_deduplicator->remove_duplicates( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = 1 msg = 'Expected 1 entry after deduplication by key_field' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-value exp = 'First' msg = 'Expected first value to be kept' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Obwohl `DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES` eine ältere Anweisung ist, ist sie in Kombination mit `SORT` immer noch die performanteste und gängigste Methode zur Entfernung von Duplikaten in internen Tabellen, wenn alle Felder verglichen werden sollen oder ein spezifischer Schlüssel. Die Alternative mit `GROUP BY` ist moderner und flexibler, wenn man steuern möchte, welche Felder nach der Gruppierung erhalten bleiben sollen (z.B. das erste Element jeder Gruppe). Beide Optionen demonstrieren effiziente Tabellenverarbeitung.
keywords: Internal Tables, Duplicates, DELETE ADJACENT DUPLICATES, SORT, GROUP BY

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie alle Vorkommen eines Substrings in einem gegebenen String durch einen neuen Substring. Nutzen Sie moderne String-Funktionen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die eingebaute Funktion `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_string_replacer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_all_occurrences
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
        iv_old_substring TYPE string
        iv_new_substring TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_string_replacer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_all_occurrences.
    rv_result_string = replace( val = iv_input_string
                                 occ = 0 " All occurrences
                                 sub = iv_old_substring
                                 with = iv_new_substring ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_replacer->replace_all_occurrences(

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die eingebaute String-Funktion `replace()` ist die moderne und effiziente Methode, um Substrings in ABAP zu ersetzen. Der Parameter `occ = 0` ist entscheidend, um alle Vorkommen zu ersetzen, was in älteren Versionen oft eine Schleife oder komplexere Logik erforderte. Diese Funktion ist sehr performant und macht den Code für String-Manipulationen deutlich lesbarer und kürzer.
keywords: String Processing, REPLACE, String Function, Substring

Instructions: Transformieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (simuliert `sflights`) in eine neue Tabelle, die nur ausgewählte Felder enthält und ein Feld umbenennt. Nutzen Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` mit `VALUE` und der `CORRESPONDING`-Funktion oder expliziter Feldzuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_transformer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_raw,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_curcode,
           END OF ty_sflight_raw,
           tt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             ticket_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS transform_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_raw_flights TYPE tt_sflight_raw
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_transformer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD transform_flights.
    rt_flight_summary = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR ls_raw IN it_raw_flights
      ( airline_id   = ls_raw-carrid
        flight_num   = ls_raw-connid
        flight_date  = ls_raw-fldate
        ticket_price = ls_raw-price )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

  METHOD test_transformation.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251209' price = '123.45' currency = 'EUR' )

    ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( lt_raw_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_summary ) exp = 2 msg = 'Expected 2 entries in summary table' ).

    DATA(ls_first_flight) = lt_summary[ 1 ].

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-flight_num exp = '0400' msg = 'Flight number incorrect' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_first_flight-ticket_price exp = '123.45' msg = 'Ticket price incorrect' ).

    DATA(lt_summary) = lo_transformer->transform_flights( lt_raw_data ).

CLASS zcl_itab_line_exists DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_s_data,
             key_field TYPE string,
             value_field TYPE string,

CLASS zcl_itab_line_exists IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_line_exists.
    CONSTANTS lc_search_key TYPE string VALUE 'SEARCH_VALUE'.
    rb_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_data[ key_field = lc_search_key ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_method_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
