CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    CONSTANTS lc_prefix TYPE string VALUE '_method_'.
    DATA(lv_full_method_name) = lc_prefix && iv_method_name.

    TRY.
        CALL METHOD me->(lv_full_method_name) RECEIVING rv_result = rv_result.
      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_meth_call_error.
        rv_result = 'Error: Method not found or callable'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_a.
    rv_text = 'Result from Method A'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _method_b.
    rv_text = 'Result from Method B'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_SYST=>SET_..._FOR_TESTING` und `CL_ABAP_SYST=>RESET_FOR_TESTING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_syst_mocking_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_user_date_info,
             uname TYPE syuname,
             datum TYPE sydate,
           END OF ty_user_date_info.

      RETURNING

  METHOD get_user_and_date.
    DATA(lo_syst) = cl_abap_syst=>get_instance( ).

unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_mocking_syst FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_mocking_syst.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_syst_mocking_demo( ).
    DATA(lv_mock_uname) = 'MOCKUSER'.
    DATA(lv_mock_datum) = '20240101'.

    " Set SYST values for testing
    cl_abap_syst=>set_uname_for_testing( i_uname = lv_mock_uname ).
    cl_abap_syst=>set_datum_for_testing( i_datum = lv_mock_datum ).

    " Call the method under test
    DATA(ls_info) = lo_cut->get_user_and_date( ).

    " Assert against the mocked values
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-uname exp = lv_mock_uname msg = 'Mocked username should match' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_info-datum exp = lv_mock_datum msg = 'Mocked date should match' ).

    " Reset SYST values after testing
    cl_abap_syst=>reset_for_testing( ).

    " Verify that SYST values are reset (optional, but good practice)
    DATA(ls_info_after_reset) = lo_cut->get_user_and_date( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_info_after_reset-uname exp = lv_mock_uname msg = 'Username should be different after reset' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals( act = ls_info_after_reset-datum exp = lv_mock_datum msg = 'Date should be different after reset' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die fortgeschrittene Nutzung von `CL_ABAP_SYST` zur Simulation von Systemfeldern in Unit-Tests. Durch `SET_..._FOR_TESTING` können Entwickler deterministische Tests schreiben, die nicht von den aktuellen Systemwerten abhängen. `RESET_FOR_TESTING` ist entscheidend, um den Systemzustand nach dem Test wiederherzustellen.
keywords: CL_ABAP_SYST, SYST, Mocking, Unit Test, Testbarkeit, Determinismus

Instructions: Berechne die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft mit `REDUCE`. Verwende dabei eine interne Tabelle mit Beispieldaten.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit einem `FOR` Ausdruck, um die Einträge zu filtern und zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_total_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflight-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Für Demonstrationszwecke werden Beispieldaten verwendet.
    " In einem realen Szenario würden diese Daten aus der Datenbank gelesen.
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' price = '250.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '300.00' ) 
    ).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum TYPE sflight-price = 0 
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) 
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_num_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) TYPE sflight-price VALUE '500.00'. " 100 + 150 + 250
    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->calculate_total_price( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

explanation: `REDUCE` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten einer internen Tabelle in einer einzigen Anweisung, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht als traditionelle `LOOP`s. Der `FOR` Ausdruck filtert die Einträge direkt.
keywords: NUMBER, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Führe eine präzise Berechnung mit Dezimalzahlen durch, die über die Genauigkeit von `P` oder `F` hinausgeht, unter Verwendung von `DECFLOAT34`.
hint: Deklariere Variablen als `DECFLOAT34` und nutze arithmetische Ausdrücke, um Rundungsfehler zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_decfloat DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_precise_value
      IMPORTING
        iv_dividend TYPE decfloat34
        iv_divisor  TYPE decfloat34
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_decfloat IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_precise_value.
    " Beispiel: (10 / 3) * 3 sollte genau 10 ergeben. 
    " Gleitkommazahlen (F) können hier Rundungsfehler einführen.
    " DECFLOAT behandelt dies mit hoher Präzision.
    rv_result = ( iv_dividend / iv_divisor ) * iv_divisor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfe, ob ein bestimmtes Bit in einer Ganzzahl gesetzt ist, unter Verwendung des bitweisen `BIT-AND` Operators.
hint: Verwende `BIT-AND` mit einer Maske, die das zu prüfende Bit repräsentiert.
solution:
CLASS zcl_bin_bit_and DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_bit_set
      IMPORTING
        iv_number TYPE i
        iv_bit_pos TYPE i " 0-indexed bit position (e.g., 0 for 1, 1 for 2, 2 for 4)
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_is_set) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_bin_bit_and IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_bit_set.
    DATA(lv_mask) TYPE i.
    lv_mask = 1 BIT-SHIFTED LEFT BY iv_bit_pos. " Erstelle eine Maske für das spezifische Bit

    IF ( iv_number BIT-AND lv_mask ) = lv_mask.
      rv_is_set = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_set = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_bit_set FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_bit_not_set FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_bit_zero FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_bit_set.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_bit_and( ).
    " Zahl 5 ist binär 101. Bit 0 (Wert 1) und Bit 2 (Wert 4) sind gesetzt.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_number = 5 iv_bit_pos = 0 ),
      exp = abap_true,
      msg = 'Bit 0 sollte in 5 gesetzt sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_number = 5 iv_bit_pos = 2 ),
      exp = abap_true,
      msg = 'Bit 2 sollte in 5 gesetzt sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_bit_not_set.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_bit_and( ).
    " Zahl 5 ist binär 101. Bit 1 (Wert 2) ist nicht gesetzt.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_number = 5 iv_bit_pos = 1 ),
      exp = abap_false,
      msg = 'Bit 1 sollte in 5 nicht gesetzt sein'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_number = 8 iv_bit_pos = 2 ), " 8 ist 1000, Bit 2 (Wert 4) ist nicht gesetzt
      exp = abap_false,
      msg = 'Bit 2 sollte in 8 nicht gesetzt sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_bit_zero.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_bit_and( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lo_cut->is_bit_set( iv_number = 0 iv_bit_pos = 0 ),
      exp = abap_false,
      msg = 'Bit 0 sollte in 0 nicht gesetzt sein'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bit-Operationen wie `BIT-AND` sind effizient, um einzelne Bits in einer Ganzzahl zu manipulieren oder zu überprüfen. Dies ist nützlich für Flags oder Statusinformationen, die in einem einzigen numerischen Feld gespeichert sind.
keywords: BINARY, BIT-AND, Bitwise Operations, Integer, Flags

CLASS zcl_bin_bit_xor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD toggle_bit.
    DATA(lv_mask) TYPE i.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_bit_xor( ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_bin_bit_xor( ).

Instructions: Berechne den Durchschnitt der Flugpreise für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` um die Summe und die Anzahl der Elemente zu ermitteln, und berechne dann den Durchschnitt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_average_price
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_average_price) TYPE decfloat34.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_average_price.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE tt_sflight.

    " Für Demonstrationszwecke werden Beispieldaten verwendet.
    lt_sflights = VALUE #( 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20250102' price = '150.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '200.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20250103' price = '250.00' ) 
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0018' fldate = '20250102' price = '300.00' ) 
    ).

    DATA(ls_aggregation) = REDUCE #( 
      INIT sum TYPE decfloat34 = 0 
           count TYPE i = 0 
      FOR <fs_sflight> IN lt_sflights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid ) 
      NEXT sum = sum + <fs_sflight>-price, 
           count = count + 1 
    ).

    IF ls_aggregation-count > 0.
      rv_average_price = ls_aggregation-sum / ls_aggregation-count.
    ELSE.
      rv_average_price = 0.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Maximalwert aus einer Liste von Zahlen unter Verwendung von `REDUCE`.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` mit einer `MAX`-Logik im `NEXT`-Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_num_reduce_max DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES tt_numbers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS find_max_number
      IMPORTING
        it_numbers TYPE tt_numbers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_max_number) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_num_reduce_max IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_max_number.
    IF it_numbers IS INITIAL.
      rv_max_number = 0. " Oder eine andere geeignete Standardbehandlung
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    rv_max_number = REDUCE #( 
      INIT max_val TYPE i = it_numbers[ 1 ] " Initialisiere mit dem ersten Wert
      FOR <fs_num> IN it_numbers 
      NEXT max_val = COND #( WHEN <fs_num> > max_val THEN <fs_num> ELSE max_val ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches XLSX-Dokument mit Flugdaten aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS. Das Dokument soll die Spalten CARRID, CONNID, FLDATE und PRICE enthalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_xlsx_document` zum Erstellen des Dokuments und `add_sheet` sowie `set_cell_value` zum Füllen der Zellen. Nutzen Sie moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenbeschaffung.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_create_sflights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_create_sflights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_document.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lv_row           TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_column        TYPE i VALUE 1.

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx_document.
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'SFLIGHTS Data' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column     ip_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 1 ip_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 2 ip_value = 'FLDATE' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 3 ip_value = 'PRICE' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_sflight>).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column     ip_value = <fs_sflight>-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 1 ip_value = <fs_sflight>-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 2 ip_value = <fs_sflight>-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 3 ip_value = <fs_sflight>-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).

    " In a real scenario, you would save lv_xstring to a file or send it via HTTP
    " For this example, we just ensure it doesn't dump.
    IF lv_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Simulate saving to a file (requires GUI_DOWNLOAD or similar in a report)
      " cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download( EXPORTING filename = iv_filename filetype = 'BIN' CHANGING data_xstr = lv_xstring EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1 ).
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_excel_row,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_excel_row,
           tt_excel_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_document
      IMPORTING
        iv_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_excel_data
      RAISING
        cx_xlsx_document_error.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_read_data IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_document.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lv_max_row       TYPE i,
          lv_row_idx       TYPE i,
          lv_cell_value    TYPE string.

    lo_xlsx_document = cl_xlsx_document=>create_from_binary( iv_xstring ).
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->get_sheet_by_index( 1 ). " First sheet

    lv_max_row = lo_worksheet->get_max_row( ).

    LOOP AT cl_abap_int_tools=>get_range( low = 1 high = lv_max_row ) INTO lv_row_idx.
      lv_cell_value = lo_worksheet->get_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row_idx ip_column = 1 ). " Assuming first column
      APPEND VALUE ty_excel_row( value = lv_cell_value ) TO rt_data.
    ENDLOOP.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XLSX-Dokument mit zwei Blättern. Das erste Blatt enthält eine Liste von Fluggesellschaften aus SFLIGHTS, das zweite Blatt eine Zusammenfassung der Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft. Formatieren Sie die Kopfzeilen auf beiden Blättern fett.
hint: Nutzen Sie `add_sheet` für mehrere Blätter und `set_cell_style` mit `cl_xlsx_cell_style` für die Formatierung. Aggregieren Sie Daten mit modernen ABAP-Features.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_multi_sheet_doc IMPORTING iv_filename TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_multi_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_multi_sheet_doc.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet1    TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lo_worksheet2    TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lo_cell_style    TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_cell_style.

    " Get flight data
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate FROM sflights UP TO 20 ROWS )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    " Aggregate flight counts per carrier
    DATA(lt_flight_counts) = VALUE tt_flight_count(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid, count = GROUP SIZE )
    ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx_document.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_cell_style.
    lo_cell_style->set_font_bold( abap_true ).

    " Sheet 1: Flight List
    lo_worksheet1 = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'Flight List' ).
    lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier' ip_cell_style = lo_cell_style ).
    lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Connection' ip_cell_style = lo_cell_style ).
    lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = 'Flight Date' ip_cell_style = lo_cell_style ).

    DATA(lv_row1) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = <fs_flight>-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = <fs_flight>-connid ).
      lo_worksheet1->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row1 ip_column = 3 ip_value = <fs_flight>-fldate ).
      lv_row1 = lv_row1 + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Sheet 2: Flight Summary
    lo_worksheet2 = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'Flight Summary' ).
    lo_worksheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 1 ip_value = 'Carrier' ip_cell_style = lo_cell_style ).
    lo_worksheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = 1 ip_column = 2 ip_value = 'Flight Count' ip_cell_style = lo_cell_style ).

    DATA(lv_row2) = 2.
    LOOP AT lt_flight_counts ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_count>).
      lo_worksheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row2 ip_column = 1 ip_value = <fs_count>-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet2->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row2 ip_column = 2 ip_value = <fs_count>-count ).
      lv_row2 = lv_row2 + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).

    IF lv_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Simulate saving
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nutzen Sie RTTI (`cl_abap_structdescr=>get_ddic_type_by_name`, `get_components`) um die Struktur der internen Tabelle zur Laufzeit zu ermitteln und die Spalten dynamisch zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_export DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS export_dynamic_table
      IMPORTING
        it_data    TYPE STANDARD TABLE
        iv_filename TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_xlsx_document_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_dynamic_export IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD export_dynamic_table.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lo_struct_descr  TYPE REF TO cl_abap_structdescr,
          lt_components    TYPE cl_abap_structdescr=>component_table,
          lv_row           TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_column        TYPE i VALUE 1.

    FIELD-SYMBOLS: <fs_data>     TYPE any TABLE,
                   <fs_line>     TYPE any,
                   <fs_component> TYPE any.

    ASSIGN it_data TO <fs_data>.
    IF <fs_data> IS INITIAL.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    lo_struct_descr ?= cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( <fs_data>[ 1 ] ).
    lt_components = lo_struct_descr->get_components( ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx_document.
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'Dynamic Data' ).

    " Write header row dynamically
    LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_component_descr>).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column ip_value = <fs_component_descr>-name ).
      lv_column = lv_column + 1.
    ENDLOOP.
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Write data rows dynamically
    LOOP AT <fs_data> ASSIGNING <fs_line>.
      lv_column = 1.
      LOOP AT lt_components ASSIGNING <fs_component_descr>.
        ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_component_descr>-name OF STRUCTURE <fs_line> TO <fs_component>.
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column ip_value = CONV string( <fs_component> ) ).
        ENDIF.
        lv_column = lv_column + 1.
      ENDLOOP.
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).
    IF lv_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Simulate saving
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

DATA: go_custom_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
      go_textedit         TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.

  SET PF-STATUS 'MAIN100'.
  SET TITLEBAR 'TITLE100'.

      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTAINER'.

    " Set selection from character 10 to 20
    go_textedit->set_selection_coords(
      EXPORTING

        to_pos   = 20
    ).
  ENDIF.

*&      Module  USER_COMMAND_0100  INPUT

            lv_to_pos   TYPE i,
            lv_selected_text TYPE string.

      go_textedit->get_selection_coords(
        IMPORTING
          from_pos = lv_from_pos
          to_pos   = lv_to_pos
      ).

      go_textedit->get_selected_text(
        IMPORTING
          text = lv_selected_text
      ).

      MESSAGE i~'Ausgewählter Text: "&1" (von &2 bis &3)' WITH lv_selected_text lv_from_pos lv_to_pos DISPLAY LIKE 'S'.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XLSX-Dokument und fügen Sie eine Spalte mit berechneten Werten hinzu, z.B. den doppelten Preis aus SFLIGHTS. Verwenden Sie dabei moderne ABAP-Syntax für die Datenmanipulation.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_xlsx_document` und `REDUCE` oder `FOR` für die Berechnung der neuen Spalte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_calculated_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_doc_with_calc_col IMPORTING iv_filename TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_calculated_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_doc_with_calc_col.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lv_row           TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_column        TYPE i VALUE 1.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_calc,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
             price  TYPE s_price,
             double_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_sflight_calc,
           tt_sflight_calc TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_calc WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA(lt_sflights_raw) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    DATA(lt_sflights_calculated) = VALUE tt_sflight_calc(
      FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflights_raw
      ( carrid = ls_raw-carrid,
        connid = ls_raw-connid,
        fldate = ls_raw-fldate,
        price  = ls_raw-price,
        double_price = ls_raw-price * 2 )
    ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx_document.
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'SFLIGHTS with Calc' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column     ip_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 1 ip_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 2 ip_value = 'FLDATE' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 3 ip_value = 'PRICE' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 4 ip_value = 'DOUBLE PRICE' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights_calculated ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_sflight>).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column     ip_value = <fs_sflight>-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 1 ip_value = <fs_sflight>-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 2 ip_value = <fs_sflight>-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 3 ip_value = <fs_sflight>-price ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 4 ip_value = <fs_sflight>-double_price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).
    IF lv_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Simulate saving
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XLSX-Dokument mit bedingter Formatierung. Markieren Sie alle Flugpreise in SFLIGHTS, die über einem bestimmten Schwellenwert liegen, mit einer roten Hintergrundfarbe.

solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_conditional_format DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_conditional_format IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_doc_cond_format.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lo_cond_format   TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_conditional_format,
          lo_cell_style    TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_cell_style,
          lv_row           TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_column        TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_threshold     TYPE s_price VALUE 500.

    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price FROM sflights UP TO 10 ROWS )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx_document.
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'SFLIGHTS Cond. Format' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column     ip_value = 'CARRID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 1 ip_value = 'CONNID' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 2 ip_value = 'FLDATE' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 3 ip_value = 'PRICE' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_sflights ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_sflight>).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column     ip_value = <fs_sflight>-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 1 ip_value = <fs_sflight>-connid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 2 ip_value = <fs_sflight>-fldate ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 3 ip_value = <fs_sflight>-price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Apply conditional formatting to the price column (column 4)
    CREATE OBJECT lo_cond_format.
    lo_cond_format->set_type( cl_xlsx_conditional_format=>c_type_cellis ).
    lo_cond_format->set_operator( cl_xlsx_conditional_format=>c_operator_greaterthan ).
    lo_cond_format->set_formula1( |{ lv_threshold }| ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_cell_style.
    lo_cell_style->set_fill_background_color( 'FFFF0000' ). " Red color
    lo_cond_format->set_style( lo_cell_style ).

    lo_worksheet->add_conditional_format(
      ip_from_row = 2
      ip_from_col = 4
      ip_to_row   = lv_row - 1
      ip_to_col   = 4
      ip_cond_format = lo_cond_format
    ).

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).
    IF lv_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Simulate saving
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein XLSX-Dokument mit einem Diagramm, das die Flugpreise pro Fluggesellschaft aus SFLIGHTS visualisiert. Das Diagramm soll ein einfaches Balkendiagramm sein.
hint: Die direkte Diagrammerstellung mit `cl_xlsx_document` ist komplex und erfordert tiefergehende Kenntnisse der OpenXML-Struktur. Für dieses Beispiel wird eine vereinfachte Darstellung oder ein Hinweis auf externe Tools gegeben, da `cl_xlsx_document` keine direkte API für Diagramme bietet. Stattdessen wird ein Beispiel für die Vorbereitung der Daten für ein Diagramm gegeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_xlsx_chart_data_prep DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_chart_data_doc IMPORTING iv_filename TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_xlsx_chart_data_prep IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_chart_data_doc.
    DATA: lo_xlsx_document TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_document,
          lo_worksheet     TYPE REF TO cl_xlsx_worksheet,
          lv_row           TYPE i VALUE 1,
          lv_column        TYPE i VALUE 1.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_flight_summary,
           tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Aggregate average price per carrier
    DATA(lt_sflights_raw) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      FOR ls_sflight IN ( SELECT carrid, price FROM sflights UP TO 50 ROWS )
      ( ls_sflight )
    ).

    DATA(lt_flight_summary) = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights_raw BY ls_flight-carrid ASCENDING
      GROUP BY carrid = ls_flight-carrid
      ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid,
        avg_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                     FOR ls_group_member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                     NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_group_member-price ) / GROUP SIZE )
    ).

    CREATE OBJECT lo_xlsx_document.
    lo_worksheet = lo_xlsx_document->add_sheet( 'Chart Data' ).

    " Add header row
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column     ip_value = 'Carrier' ).
    lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 1 ip_value = 'Average Price' ).
    lv_row = lv_row + 1.

    " Add data rows
    LOOP AT lt_flight_summary ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOLS(<fs_summary>).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column     ip_value = <fs_summary>-carrid ).
      lo_worksheet->set_cell_value( ip_row = lv_row ip_column = lv_column + 1 ip_value = <fs_summary>-avg_price ).
      lv_row = lv_row + 1.
    ENDLOOP.

    " Note: Direct chart creation is not supported by cl_xlsx_document API.
    " This example prepares the data in a format suitable for manual chart creation in Excel.

    DATA(lv_xstring) = lo_xlsx_document->save_document_to_xstring( ).
    IF lv_xstring IS NOT INITIAL.
      " Simulate saving
    ENDIF.

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die verbleibenden freien Sitze für jeden Flug in der Tabelle `sflights`, indem Sie die belegten Sitze (OCCUPANCY) von der maximalen Kapazität (MAX_SEATS) subtrahieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine `LOOP AT` Schleife mit `FIELD-SYMBOLS` und die `SUBTRACT`-Anweisung oder einen arithmetischen Ausdruck.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_seats,
             carrid    TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid    TYPE s_conn_id,
             max_seats TYPE s_max_seats,
             occupancy TYPE s_seatsocc,
             free_seats TYPE s_max_seats,
           END OF ty_flight_seats.
    TYPES: tt_flight_seats TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_seats WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_free_seats
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_seats) TYPE tt_flight_seats.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_free_seats.
    rt_flight_seats = CORRESPONDING #( it_sflights MAPPING carrid = carrid connid = connid max_seats = max_seats occupancy = seatsocc ).

    LOOP AT rt_flight_seats ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_flight>).
      <fs_flight>-free_seats = <fs_flight>-max_seats - <fs_flight>-occupancy.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'. ls_flight-connid = '0017'. ls_flight-max_seats = 180. ls_flight-seatsocc = 180. APPEND ls_flight TO lt_test_flights.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_seats( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->calculate_free_seats( lt_test_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 1 ]-free_seats exp = 50 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_result[ 2 ]-free_seats exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `CORRESPONDING` für die Initialisierung und `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` für die Bearbeitung von Tabellenzeilen ist eine moderne und performante Methode. Die Subtraktion selbst erfolgt direkt im Feld-Symbol, was sehr effizient ist.
keywords: SUBTRACT, Internal Tables, LOOP, FIELD-SYMBOLS, CORRESPONDING

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie von einer Gesamtmenge (z.B. Gesamtumsatz) die Umsätze für bestimmte Fluggesellschaften, die in einer separaten Tabelle übergeben werden. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine funktionale Reduktion.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE`-Operator, um die Summe der zu subtrahierenden Werte zu berechnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sales,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_sales.
    TYPES: tt_sales TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sales WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS subtract_carrier_sales
      IMPORTING
        iv_total_sales TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
        it_all_sales   TYPE tt_sales
        it_exclude_carriers TYPE STRING_TABLE
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_net_sales) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD subtract_carrier_sales.
    DATA(lv_excluded_sales) = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0
                                         FOR ls_sale IN it_all_sales
                                         WHERE ( carrid IN it_exclude_carriers )
                                         NEXT sum = sum + ls_sale-amount ).
    rv_net_sales = iv_total_sales - lv_excluded_sales.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ls_sale-carrid = 'LH'. ls_sale-amount = '100.00'. APPEND ls_sale TO lt_all_sales.
    ls_sale-carrid = 'AA'. ls_sale-amount = '200.00'. APPEND ls_sale TO lt_all_sales.
    ls_sale-carrid = 'UA'. ls_sale-amount = '50.00'. APPEND ls_sale TO lt_all_sales.

    APPEND 'LH' TO lt_exclude.
    APPEND 'UA' TO lt_exclude.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_subtract_reduce( ).
    DATA(lv_net_sales) = lo_cut->subtract_carrier_sales( iv_total_sales = '500.00'
                                                         it_all_sales = lt_all_sales
                                                         it_exclude_carriers = lt_exclude ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_net_sales exp = '350.00' ). " 500 - (100 + 50) = 350
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator ermöglicht die Aggregation von Werten in einer internen Tabelle auf funktionale Weise. In Kombination mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung kann man gezielt Werte summieren, die dann subtrahiert werden. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und ausdrucksstarke Art, komplexe Aggregationen und Subtraktionen durchzuführen.
keywords: SUBTRACT, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Functional, Aggregation

Instructions: Verwalten Sie eine Liste von Flugobjekten. Implementieren Sie eine Methode, die ein Flugobjekt aus der Liste entfernt, basierend auf seiner Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer.
hint: Verwenden Sie `DELETE TABLE` mit einer `WHERE`-Bedingung auf einer Tabelle von Referenzen oder `FILTER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_manager DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_flight_key.

    CLASS zcl_flight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        DATA: carrid TYPE s_carr_id READ-ONLY,
              connid TYPE s_conn_id READ-ONLY.
        METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        me->carrid = iv_carrid.
        me->connid = iv_connid.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    TYPES tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    DATA mt_flights TYPE tt_flights.

    METHODS add_flight IMPORTING io_flight TYPE REF TO zcl_flight.
    METHODS remove_flight IMPORTING is_key TYPE ty_flight_key.
    METHODS get_flights RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_manager IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_flight.
    APPEND io_flight TO mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD remove_flight.
    DELETE mt_flights WHERE table_line->carrid = is_key-carrid
                       AND table_line->connid = is_key-connid.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flights.
    rt_flights = mt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_remove_flight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_remove_flight.
    DATA(lo_manager) = NEW zcl_flight_manager( ).
    DATA(lo_flight1) = NEW zcl_flight_manager=>zcl_flight( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).
    DATA(lo_flight2) = NEW zcl_flight_manager=>zcl_flight( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).

    lo_manager->add_flight( lo_flight1 ).
    lo_manager->add_flight( lo_flight2 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_manager->get_flights( ) ) exp = 2 ).

    DATA(ls_key) TYPE zcl_flight_manager=>ty_flight_key.
    ls_key-carrid = 'LH'. ls_key-connid = '0400'.
    lo_manager->remove_flight( ls_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_manager->get_flights( ) ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_manager->get_flights( )[ 1 ]->carrid exp = 'AA' ).

    ls_key-carrid = 'UA'. ls_key-connid = '0001'. " Non-existent
    lo_manager->remove_flight( ls_key ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lo_manager->get_flights( ) ) exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die `WHERE`-Bedingung kann auf Attribute der referenzierten Objekte zugreifen (`table_line->attribute`), was eine sehr flexible und objektorientierte Art der Datenmanipulation darstellt.
keywords: DELETE, Object Orientation, Internal Tables, References

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie einen Bonusbetrag von einem Gesamtbetrag, aber nur, wenn der Gesamtbetrag einen bestimmten Schwellenwert überschreitet. Andernfalls soll der Bonus nicht subtrahiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen konditionalen Ausdruck (`COND` oder `SWITCH`) oder eine einfache `IF`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_conditional_subtract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_net_amount
      IMPORTING
        iv_total_amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
        iv_bonus_amount TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
        iv_threshold    TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_net_amount) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_conditional_subtract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_net_amount.
    rv_net_amount = COND #( WHEN iv_total_amount > iv_threshold
                            THEN iv_total_amount - iv_bonus_amount
                            ELSE iv_total_amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_conditional_subtract FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_conditional_subtract.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_conditional_subtract( ).

    " Fall 1: Betrag über Schwellenwert
    DATA(lv_result1) = lo_cut->calculate_net_amount( iv_total_amount = '1000.00'
                                                    iv_bonus_amount = '100.00'
                                                    iv_threshold     = '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result1 exp = '900.00' ).

    " Fall 2: Betrag unter Schwellenwert
    DATA(lv_result2) = lo_cut->calculate_net_amount( iv_total_amount = '400.00'
                                                    iv_bonus_amount = '100.00'
                                                    iv_threshold     = '500.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result2 exp = '400.00' ).

    " Fall 3: Betrag gleich Schwellenwert

Instructions: Entfernen Sie alle Flüge aus einer Tabelle, die in einer 'Blacklist' von Fluggesellschaften enthalten sind, und geben Sie die verbleibenden Flüge zurück. Nutzen Sie hierfür eine funktionale Methode mit `FOR` und `COND`.

CLASS zcl_delete_blacklist DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        it_blacklist_carriers TYPE STRING_TABLE

CLASS zcl_delete_blacklist IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD remove_blacklisted_flights.
    rt_filtered_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_sflights
                                   WHERE ( NOT ( ls_flight-carrid IN it_blacklist_carriers ) )

ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Subtrahieren Sie einen prozentualen Rabatt von einem gegebenen Preis. Der Rabatt soll nur angewendet werden, wenn er positiv ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie arithmetische Ausdrücke und eine konditionale Zuweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_subtract_percentage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS apply_discount
      IMPORTING
        iv_price    TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2
        iv_discount TYPE p LENGTH 5 DECIMALS 2 " e.g., 10.00 for 10%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_net_price) TYPE p LENGTH 16 DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_subtract_percentage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD apply_discount.
    rv_net_price = COND #( WHEN iv_discount > 0
                            THEN iv_price - ( iv_price * iv_discount / 100 )
                            ELSE iv_price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Senden Sie einen POST-Request mit einem JSON-Payload an einen Endpunkt (z.B. JSONPlaceholder /posts) und parsen Sie die JSON-Antwort. Erstellen Sie den JSON-Payload dynamisch.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_HTTP_CLIENT für den POST-Request und CL_ABAP_JSON_SERIALIZER/CL_ABAP_JSON_DESERIALIZER für die JSON-Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_post_json DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_data,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_post_data.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_post_response,
             id     TYPE i,
             title  TYPE string,
             body   TYPE string,
             userid TYPE i,
           END OF ty_post_response.
    METHODS perform_post_request
      IMPORTING
        is_data TYPE ty_post_data
        iv_url  TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_post_response
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_post_json IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_post_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_request TYPE string,
          lv_json_response TYPE string.

    " Serialize data to JSON
    cl_abap_json_serializer=>serialize(
      EXPORTING
        data        = is_data
        pretty_name = abap_false
      RECEIVING
        json        = lv_json_request
    ).

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        iv_url = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        eo_client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_post ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
      name  = 'Content-Type'
      value = 'application/json; charset=utf-8'
    ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_cdata( lv_json_request ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    lo_http_client->close( ).

    " Deserialize JSON response
    cl_abap_json_deserializer=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        json        = lv_json_response
      RECEIVING
        data        = rs_response
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP-GET-Request an eine ungültige URL aus und fangen Sie die erwarteten Ausnahmen ab. Geben Sie eine entsprechende Fehlermeldung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie TRY...CATCH-Blöcke für Ausnahmen wie CX_HTTP_DEST_STATE_ERROR oder CX_HTTP_CONN_FAILURE.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_faulty_get_request
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_faulty_get_request.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    TRY.
        cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
          EXPORTING
            iv_url = iv_url
          IMPORTING
            eo_client = lo_http_client
        ).
        lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
        lo_http_client->send( ).
        lo_http_client->receive( ).
        lo_http_client->close( ).
        rv_error_message = 'Request erfolgreich (unerwartet für ungültige URL)'.
      CATCH cx_http_dest_state_error INTO DATA(lx_dest_error).
        rv_error_message = |HTTP Destination State Error: { lx_dest_error->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_http_conn_failure INTO DATA(lx_conn_failure).
        rv_error_message = |HTTP Connection Failure: { lx_conn_failure->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        rv_error_message = |General HTTP Error: { lx_static_check->get_text( ) }|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_error_message = |Unexpected Error: { lx_root->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_invalid_url FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_valid_url_no_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_invalid_url.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_error) = lo_cut->perform_faulty_get_request( `http://invalid.url.example.com` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = lv_error
      msg = 'Error message should not be initial for invalid URL'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lv_error
      exp = 'Request erfolgreich (unerwartet für ungültige URL)'
      msg = 'Should report an error for invalid URL'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_valid_url_no_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lv_error) = lo_cut->perform_faulty_get_request( `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1` ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_error
      exp = 'Request erfolgreich (unerwartet für ungültige URL)'
      msg = 'Should report success for a valid URL'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `TRY...CATCH` ist entscheidend für robuste Anwendungen. Spezifische Ausnahmen wie `CX_HTTP_DEST_STATE_ERROR` und `CX_HTTP_CONN_FAILURE` ermöglichen eine präzise Fehlerbehandlung bei Netzwerk- oder Konfigurationsproblemen.
keywords: Error Handling, HTTP, CL_HTTP_CLIENT, TRY...CATCH, Exceptions

Instructions: Führen Sie einen GET-Request an eine API aus, die eine Liste von Objekten zurückgibt (z.B. JSONPlaceholder /todos). Extrahieren Sie die 'title' und 'completed' Felder in eine interne Tabelle, indem Sie den VALUE-Operator und eine FOR-Schleife verwenden.
hint: Nutzen Sie CL_HTTP_CLIENT, CL_ABAP_JSON_DESERIALIZER und den VALUE-Operator mit einer FOR-Schleife, um die interne Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_value_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_todo_item_raw,
             userid    TYPE i,
             id        TYPE i,
             title     TYPE string,
             completed TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_todo_item_raw.
    TYPES: tt_todo_items_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_todo_item_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_todo_summary,
             title     TYPE string,
             completed TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_todo_summary.
    TYPES: tt_todo_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_todo_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_todo_summaries
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_todo_summary
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_value_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_todo_summaries.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_json_response TYPE string,
          lt_raw_todos TYPE tt_todo_items_raw.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        iv_url = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        eo_client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
    lo_http_client->send( ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive( ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lv_json_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    lo_http_client->close( ).

    " Deserialize JSON response into raw table
    cl_abap_json_deserializer=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP-GET-Request in einem separaten Hintergrund-Task aus, um die Hauptverarbeitung nicht zu blockieren. Geben Sie an, ob der Task erfolgreich gestartet wurde.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CALL FUNCTION ... STARTING NEW TASK` und einen Callback-Funktionsbaustein für das Ergebnis. Für dieses Beispiel wird die Antwort nicht im Callback verarbeitet, sondern nur der Start des Tasks demonstriert.

FUNCTION z_http_async_get_callback.
*"----------------------------------------------------------------------
*"*"Local Interface:
*"  IMPORTING
*"     VALUE(P_TASK) TYPE  BTC_TASK
*"     VALUE(P_URL) TYPE  STRING
*"----------------------------------------------------------------------
* This is a dummy callback function module.
* In a real scenario, you would process the result here.
ENDFUNCTION.

FUNCTION z_http_async_get_task.
*"----------------------------------------------------------------------
*"*"Local Interface:
*"  IMPORTING
*"     VALUE(IV_URL) TYPE  STRING
*"----------------------------------------------------------------------
  DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.
  TRY.
      cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
        EXPORTING
          iv_url = iv_url
        IMPORTING
          eo_client = lo_http_client
      ).
      lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
      lo_http_client->send( ).
      lo_http_client->receive( ).
      lo_http_client->close( ).
      " In a real scenario, you would store the result or trigger a follow-up.
    CATCH cx_static_check.
      " Handle exceptions in background task, e.g., log them.
  ENDTRY.
ENDFUNCTION.

CLASS zcl_http_async_request DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS trigger_async_get
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_task_started) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_async_request IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD trigger_async_get.
    CALL FUNCTION 'Z_HTTP_ASYNC_GET_TASK' STARTING NEW TASK 'HTTP_ASYNC_TASK'
      PERFORMING z_http_async_get_callback ON END OF TASK
      EXPORTING
        iv_url = iv_url.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_task_started = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_task_started = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 10 zufälligen Ganzzahlen innerhalb eines bestimmten Bereichs (z.B. 1 bis 100).

  METHOD test_generate_random_integers.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_int_list( ).
    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->generate_random_integers( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 100 iv_count = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_numbers )
      exp = 10

    DATA(lv_first_num) = lt_numbers[ 1 ].

      lv_all_same = abap_false.
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_all_same

      msg = 'Numbers should not all be identical (high probability)'
    ).

Instructions: Mischen Sie die Zeilen einer internen Tabelle (z.B. Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT) zufällig.
hint: Generieren Sie für jede Zeile einen zufälligen Sortierschlüssel und sortieren Sie die Tabelle danach.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_shuffler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_shuffled,
             random_key TYPE i,
             carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate     TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_shuffled.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_shuffled TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_shuffled WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS shuffle_sflight_table
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_shuffled_table) TYPE tt_sflight_shuffled.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_shuffler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD shuffle_sflight_table.
    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = 1000000 " A sufficiently large range for random keys
    ).

    rt_shuffled_table = VALUE #( FOR ls_sflight IN it_sflight
                                 ( random_key = lo_random->get_next(
                                   ) " Generate a random key for each row
                                   carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
                                   connid = ls_sflight-connid
                                   fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).

    SORT rt_shuffled_table BY random_key.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_shuffle_sflight FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_shuffle_sflight.
    DATA: lt_sflight_original TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_original UP TO 10 ROWS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_sflight_original ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_table_shuffler( ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_1) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflight_table( lt_sflight_original ).
    DATA(lt_shuffled_2) = lo_cut->shuffle_sflight_table( lt_sflight_original ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_shuffled_1 )
      exp = lines( lt_sflight_original )
      msg = 'Shuffled table should have same number of entries'
    ).

    " Check if content is the same (ignoring order)
    DATA(lt_original_sorted) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_sflight_shuffled(
      FOR ls_sflight IN lt_sflight_original
      ( carrid = ls_sflight-carrid
        connid = ls_sflight-connid
        fldate = ls_sflight-fldate ) ).
    SORT lt_original_sorted BY carrid connid fldate.

    DATA(lt_shuffled_1_content) = VALUE zcl_table_shuffler=>tt_sflight_shuffled(
      FOR ls_shuffled IN lt_shuffled_1
      ( carrid = ls_shuffled-carrid
        connid = ls_shuffled-connid
        fldate = ls_shuffled-fldate ) ).
    SORT lt_shuffled_1_content BY carrid connid fldate.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_shuffled_1_content
      exp = lt_original_sorted
      msg = 'Shuffled table should contain the same elements'
    ).

    " High probability that two shuffles are different
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_equals(
      act = lt_shuffled_1
      exp = lt_shuffled_2
      msg = 'Two shuffled tables should be different (high probability)'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Zuweisung eines zufälligen Schlüssels zu jeder Zeile einer internen Tabelle und das anschließende Sortieren nach diesem Schlüssel kann die Reihenfolge der Zeilen effektiv gemischt werden. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck wird hier verwendet, um die neue Tabelle mit den Zufallsschlüsseln zu erstellen.
keywords: Random, Shuffle, Internal Tables, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, SORT

Instructions: Wählen Sie zufällig eine einzelne Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle (z.B. Flugdaten aus SFLIGHT) aus.
hint: Generieren Sie einen zufälligen Index innerhalb der Grenzen der Tabelle und verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... INDEX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_table_selection DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_random_sflight_entry
      IMPORTING
        it_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_random_entry) TYPE sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_random_table_selection IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_random_sflight_entry.
    DATA(lv_table_size) = lines( it_sflight ).

    IF lv_table_size = 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Table is empty, cannot select random entry.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = lv_table_size
    ).

    DATA(lv_random_index) = lo_random->get_next( ).

    READ TABLE it_sflight INDEX lv_random_index INTO rs_random_entry.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " This should theoretically not happen if random_index is within bounds
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_table_line_not_found
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Internal error: Random index not found in table.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_selection FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_selection.
    DATA: lt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_data UP TO 10 ROWS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_sflight_data ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_selection( ).
    DATA(ls_selected_entry) = lo_cut->get_random_sflight_entry( lt_sflight_data ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_selected_entry-carrid
      msg = 'Selected entry should not be initial'
    ).

    " Verify the selected entry exists in the original table
    READ TABLE lt_sflight_data WITH KEY carrid = ls_selected_entry-carrid
                                     connid = ls_selected_entry-connid
                                     fldate = ls_selected_entry-fldate
                                     TRANSPORTING NO FIELDS.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_subrc(
      act = sy-subrc
      exp = 0
      msg = 'Selected entry must exist in the original table'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA: lt_empty_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_table_selection( ).

    TRY.
        lo_cut->get_random_sflight_entry( lt_empty_table ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_TABLE_LINE_NOT_FOUND for empty table' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_table_line_not_found.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught exception for empty table' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Um eine zufällige Zeile aus einer internen Tabelle auszuwählen, wird zunächst die Anzahl der Zeilen ermittelt. Anschließend wird mit `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` ein zufälliger Index innerhalb dieses Bereichs generiert. `READ TABLE ... INDEX` ermöglicht dann den direkten Zugriff auf die entsprechende Zeile.
keywords: Random, Selection, Internal Tables, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, READ TABLE

Instructions: Führen Sie einen HTTP-GET-Request mit einem API-Schlüssel im Header durch. Der API-Schlüssel soll nicht direkt im Code hinterlegt sein, sondern aus einer sicheren Quelle (z.B. Umgebungsvariable oder Konfiguration) stammen (hier simuliert).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` und `set_header_field`. Für die Simulation des sicheren Zugriffs kann eine Konstante oder ein Parameter verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_auth_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_http_response,
             status_code TYPE i,
             response_body TYPE string,
           END OF ty_http_response.
    METHODS perform_get_with_api_key
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
        iv_api_key TYPE string " In real scenario, this would come from secure config
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_response) TYPE ty_http_response
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_auth_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_get_with_api_key.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        iv_url = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        eo_client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
    lo_http_client->request->set_header_field(
      name  = 'X-API-Key'
      value = iv_api_key
    ).

    lo_http_client->send(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive(
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    rs_response-status_code = lo_http_client->response->get_status( ).
    rs_response-response_body = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).

    lo_http_client->close( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_with_api_key FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_with_api_key.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_http_auth_header( ).
    DATA(lv_dummy_api_key) = 'your_secure_api_key_here'. " In a real test, mock the HTTP call
    DATA(lv_test_url) = `https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/todos/1`. " This API does not require API key, so we just test header setting

    DATA(ls_response) = lo_cut->perform_get_with_api_key(
      iv_url     = lv_test_url
      iv_api_key = lv_dummy_api_key
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = ls_response-status_code
      exp = 200
      msg = 'HTTP Status Code should be 200'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
      act = ls_response-response_body
      msg = 'Response body should not be initial'
    ).
    " Note: Actual verification of API key usage would require a mock HTTP server
    " or a service that validates the key. This test primarily checks the code flow.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Das Setzen von HTTP-Headern mit `set_header_field` ist Standard für die Übertragung von Authentifizierungsinformationen wie API-Schlüsseln. Es ist entscheidend, solche Schlüssel nicht hart im Code zu hinterlegen, sondern aus sicheren Quellen zu laden.
keywords: HTTP, API Key, Security, CL_HTTP_CLIENT, Header

Instructions: Teilen Sie eine Liste von Elementen (z.B. Fluggesellschaften aus SFLIGHT) zufällig in N Gruppen auf, wobei jede Gruppe ungefähr gleich groß sein soll.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` zum Mischen der Liste und den `GROUP BY` Ausdruck, um die Elemente in Gruppen zu unterteilen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_random_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_item,
             group_id TYPE i,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,

        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

CLASS zcl_random_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_carriers_randomly.
    IF iv_num_groups <= 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Number of groups must be positive.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA: lt_all_carriers TYPE SORTED TABLE OF sflight-carrid WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    SELECT DISTINCT carrid FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_all_carriers.

    DATA(lv_total_items) = lines( lt_all_carriers ).
    IF lv_total_items = 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = 1
      high = 1000000
    ).

    " Shuffle carriers by assigning random keys and sorting
    DATA(lt_shuffled_carriers) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_item WITH EMPTY KEY (
      FOR ls_carrid IN lt_all_carriers
      ( group_id = lo_random->get_next( ) " Use group_id temporarily for random key
        carrid = ls_carrid ) ).
    SORT lt_shuffled_carriers BY group_id.

    " Assign actual group IDs sequentially after shuffling
    DATA(lv_current_group) = 1.
    DATA(lv_items_per_group) = CEIL( lv_total_items / iv_num_groups ).
    DATA(lv_item_counter) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_shuffled_carriers ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_carrier>).
      <fs_carrier>-group_id = lv_current_group.
      lv_item_counter = lv_item_counter + 1.
      IF lv_item_counter >= lv_items_per_group AND lv_current_group < iv_num_groups.
        lv_current_group = lv_current_group + 1.
        lv_item_counter = 0.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_grouped_carriers = lt_shuffled_carriers.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_random_grouping FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
    METHODS test_zero_groups FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_more_groups_than_items FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_random_grouping.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouping( ).
    DATA(lv_num_groups) = 3.
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_carriers_randomly( lv_num_groups ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_grouped ).

    " Check if all group IDs are within expected range
    DATA(lv_max_group_id) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_item).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( ls_item-group_id >= 1 AND ls_item-group_id <= lv_num_groups )
        msg = |Group ID { ls_item-group_id } out of range|
      ).
      IF ls_item-group_id > lv_max_group_id.
        lv_max_group_id = ls_item-group_id.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_max_group_id
      exp = lv_num_groups
      msg = 'All groups should be used'
    ).

    " Check group sizes (approximate equality)
    DATA(lt_group_counts) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH EMPTY KEY (
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_item IN lt_grouped GROUP BY ls_item-group_id
      ( lines( GROUP ls_item ) ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_group_counts )
      exp = lv_num_groups
      msg = 'Should have the specified number of groups'
    ).

    DATA(lv_total_items) = lines( lt_grouped ).
    DATA(lv_expected_min_size) = FLOOR( lv_total_items / lv_num_groups ).
    DATA(lv_expected_max_size) = CEIL( lv_total_items / lv_num_groups ).

    LOOP AT lt_group_counts INTO DATA(lv_group_size).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( lv_group_size >= lv_expected_min_size AND lv_group_size <= lv_expected_max_size )
        msg = |Group size { lv_group_size } is outside expected range { lv_expected_min_size }-{ lv_expected_max_size }|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_zero_groups.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouping( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->group_carriers_randomly( 0 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR for zero groups' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'Correctly caught exception for zero groups' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_more_groups_than_items.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_random_grouping( ).
    DATA(lv_num_groups) = 1000. " More groups than available distinct carriers
    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_carriers_randomly( lv_num_groups ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_grouped ).
    DATA(lt_distinct_groups) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line (
      FOR ls_item IN lt_grouped ( ls_item-group_id ) ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( lt_distinct_groups ) <= lv_num_groups )
      msg = 'Number of actual groups should not exceed requested groups'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die zufällige Gruppierung wird durch zwei Schritte erreicht: Zuerst wird die Liste der Elemente mit Hilfe von `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` gemischt, indem jeder Zeile ein zufälliger Sortierschlüssel zugewiesen wird. Anschließend werden die Elemente sequenziell den Gruppen zugewiesen, um eine möglichst gleichmäßige Verteilung zu gewährleisten. Der `FOR`-Ausdruck wird hier für die Initialisierung und Transformation der Tabellen verwendet.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen GET-Request an eine API durch, die XML-Daten zurückgibt. Parsen Sie die XML-Antwort und extrahieren Sie spezifische Informationen in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_HTTP_CLIENT` für den Request und `CL_ABAP_XML_DESERIALIZER` für die XML-Verarbeitung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_http_xml_parser DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_xml_item,
             id    TYPE string,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_xml_item.
    TYPES: tt_xml_items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_xml_item WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_and_parse_xml
      IMPORTING
        iv_url TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_items) TYPE tt_xml_items
      RAISING
        cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_http_xml_parser IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_and_parse_xml.
    DATA: lo_http_client TYPE REF TO if_http_client,
          lv_xml_response TYPE string.

    " Placeholder for a simple XML structure to deserialize
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_xml_root,
             items TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_xml_item WITH EMPTY KEY,
           END OF ty_xml_root.
    DATA: ls_xml_root TYPE ty_xml_root.

    cl_http_client=>create_by_url(
      EXPORTING
        iv_url = iv_url
      IMPORTING
        eo_client = lo_http_client
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->request->set_method( if_http_request=>co_method_get ).
    lo_http_client->send( ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lo_http_client->receive( ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.

    lv_xml_response = lo_http_client->response->get_cdata( ).
    lo_http_client->close( ).

    " Deserialize XML response
    cl_abap_xml_deserializer=>deserialize(
      EXPORTING
        ix_xml_xstream = cl_abap_codepage=>convert_to(
                           iv_string = lv_xml_response
                           iv_codepage = 'UTF-8'
                         )
      RECEIVING
        og_data        = ls_xml_root
    ).

    rt_items = ls_xml_root-items.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine Liste von 5 eindeutigen zufälligen Ganzzahlen innerhalb eines Bereichs (z.B. 1 bis 20).
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT` und eine interne Tabelle mit `UNIQUE KEY` oder `FILTER` und `REDUCE` um Duplikate zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_unique_random_numbers DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS generate_unique_random_integers
      IMPORTING
        iv_min    TYPE i
        iv_max    TYPE i
        iv_count  TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_unique_numbers) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_unique_random_numbers IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD generate_unique_random_integers.
    IF iv_count <= 0 OR iv_min > iv_max OR ( iv_max - iv_min + 1 ) < iv_count.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Invalid input for generating unique random numbers.'.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lo_random) = cl_abap_random_int=>create(
      low  = iv_min
      high = iv_max
    ).

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      DATA(lv_new_number) = lo_random->get_next( ).
      INSERT lv_new_number INTO TABLE rt_unique_numbers.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        " Number already exists, try again (simple retry, for large counts/small range, this can be inefficient)
        " For better performance with many unique numbers, consider shuffling a range.
        sy-index = sy-index - 1. " Decrement loop counter to retry
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

    DATA(lt_numbers) = lo_cut->generate_unique_random_integers(
      iv_min = 1 iv_max = 20 iv_count = 5
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_numbers )

    DATA(lv_unique_count) = lines( lt_numbers ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ( lv_number >= 1 AND lv_number <= 20 )
        msg = |Number { lv_number } is out of range (1-20)|
      ).

  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_input.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_numbers( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->generate_unique_random_integers( iv_min = 10 iv_max = 5 iv_count = 3 ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected CX_SY_ARITHMETIC_ERROR for invalid range' ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error.

    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_range_too_small.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_unique_random_numbers( ).
    TRY.
        lo_cut->generate_unique_random_integers( iv_min = 1 iv_max = 3 iv_count = 5 ).

explanation: Die Generierung eindeutiger Zufallszahlen erfordert eine Strategie, um Duplikate zu vermeiden. Hier wird eine Schleife verwendet, die so lange neue Zufallszahlen generiert und in eine interne Tabelle mit `UNIQUE KEY` einfügt, bis die gewünschte Anzahl erreicht ist. Bei einem Duplikat wird der Versuch wiederholt. Für größere Mengen ist eine Methode, bei der ein Bereich gemischt und dann die ersten N Elemente entnommen werden, effizienter.
keywords: Random, Unique, CL_ABAP_RANDOM_INT, Internal Tables, UNIQUE KEY

Instructions: Führen Sie eine Division durch, die potenziell zu einer Division durch Null führen kann, und fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie den TRY...CATCH-Block und fangen Sie die Ausnahme CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_div_by_zero DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS divide
      IMPORTING
        iv_numerator   TYPE i
        iv_denominator TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_div_by_zero IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD divide.
    TRY.
        rv_result = iv_numerator / iv_denominator.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide.
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Division durch Null
        MESSAGE 'Division durch Null ist nicht erlaubt.' TYPE 'E'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_arithmetic_error=>cx_sy_zerodivide.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_division_by_zero RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_division_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_div_by_zero( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->divide( iv_numerator = 10 iv_denominator = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 5 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_div_by_zero( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(

explanation: TRY...CATCH ist der Standardmechanismus in ABAP, um Ausnahmen abzufangen und darauf zu reagieren. Hier wird die vordefinierte Ausnahme CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE abgefangen, die bei einer Division durch Null auftritt.

Instructions: Lesen Sie einen Eintrag aus einer internen Tabelle, der möglicherweise nicht existiert, und fangen Sie die entsprechende Ausnahme ab.
hint: Verwenden Sie den TRY...CATCH-Block und fangen Sie die Ausnahme CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_read_error DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES: ty_t_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_flight
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid TYPE sflight-connid
        it_flights TYPE ty_t_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_read_error IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_flight.
    TRY.
        rs_flight = it_flights[ carrid = iv_carrid AND connid = iv_connid ].
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        " Fehlerbehandlung: Eintrag nicht gefunden
        MESSAGE 'Flug nicht gefunden.' TYPE 'E'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_itab_error=>cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_success.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE zcl_itab_read_error=>ty_t_sflight,
          ls_flight  TYPE zcl_itab_read_error=>ty_sflight.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'AA' connid = '001' ).
    APPEND ls_flight TO lt_flights.
    ls_flight = VALUE #( carrid = 'LH' connid = '400' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_result-carrid exp = 'LH' ).

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung des CLEANUP-Blocks, um Ressourcen freizugeben, auch wenn eine Ausnahme auftritt.
hint: Der CLEANUP-Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme im TRY-Block auftritt, bevor der CATCH-Block erreicht wird.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS perform_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_trigger_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cleanup_demo IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD perform_operation.
    DATA: lv_resource_open TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_false.

    TRY.
        " Ressource öffnen
        lv_resource_open = abap_true.
        rv_status = 'Ressource geöffnet.'.

        IF iv_trigger_error = abap_true.
          " Eine Ausnahme auslösen (z.B. Division durch Null)
          DATA(lv_dummy) = 1 / 0.
        ENDIF.

        rv_status = 'Operation erfolgreich.'.

      CLEANUP.
        " Dieser Block wird immer ausgeführt, wenn eine Ausnahme auftritt
        IF lv_resource_open = abap_true.
          " Ressource schließen
          rv_status = rv_status && ' Ressource im CLEANUP geschlossen.'.
          lv_resource_open = abap_false.
        ENDIF.

        " Fehlerbehandlung
        rv_status = rv_status && ' Ausnahme abgefangen.'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error. " Ausnahme weiterleiten
    ENDTRY.

      " Ressource schließen, falls keine Ausnahme aufgetreten ist
      rv_status = rv_status && ' Ressource normal geschlossen.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
