Instructions: Verwenden Sie verschachtelte TRY...CATCH-Blöcke, um Ausnahmen auf verschiedenen Ebenen abzufangen und zu behandeln.
hint: Ein innerer CATCH-Block fängt Ausnahmen ab, die im inneren TRY-Block auftreten. Ein äußerer CATCH-Block fängt Ausnahmen ab, die vom inneren Block nicht behandelt wurden oder dort erneut ausgelöst wurden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_try_catch DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS outer_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS inner_operation
      IMPORTING
        iv_value TYPE i
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_try_catch IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD outer_operation.
    TRY.
        rv_message = 'Äußere Operation gestartet.'.
        inner_operation( iv_value ).
        rv_message = rv_message && ' Innere Operation erfolgreich.'.
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        rv_message = rv_message && ' Äußere Operation: Arithmetische Ausnahme abgefangen: ' && lx_arith->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        rv_message = rv_message && ' Äußere Operation: Allgemeine Ausnahme abgefangen: ' && lx_root->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD inner_operation.
    TRY.
        IF iv_value = 0.
          " Simulate a division by zero
          DATA(lv_result) = 1 / iv_value. " This will cause CX_SY_ZERODIVIDE
        ELSE.
          " No error
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_zerodivide INTO DATA(lx_zerodivide).
        " Inner handling, then re-raise a more general arithmetic error
        MESSAGE 'Inner: Division durch Null!' TYPE 'I'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_arithmetic_error
          EXPORTING
            previous = lx_zerodivide.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'Äußere Operation: Arithmetische Ausnahme abgefangen:' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_message exp = 'Division durch Null' ).

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_fallback DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_simulate_cache_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.

      IMPORTING
        iv_simulate_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING

    METHODS _read_from_db
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_data) TYPE string.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_fallback IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_data.
    TRY.
        rv_data = _read_from_cache( iv_simulate_cache_error ).
        rv_data = rv_data && ' (aus Cache)'.
      CATCH zcx_esh_cache_error.
        rv_data = _read_from_db( ).
        rv_data = rv_data && ' (aus DB - Fallback)'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _read_from_cache.
    " Simulation einer ESH-Cache-Prüfung (z.B. mit cl_esh_ca_check S_ESH_ENG_CACHE)
    IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_esh_cache_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_esh_cache_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_data = 'Daten aus ESH Cache'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _read_from_db.
    " Simulation des Lesens aus einer Datenbanktabelle (z.B. SFLIGHTS)
    rv_data = 'Daten aus Datenbank'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    ENDTRY.

    IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_dynamic_err DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

      IMPORTING
        iv_cache_id TYPE string
        iv_param    TYPE string
        iv_simulate_error TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_error_info) TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS zcl_esh_cache_dynamic_err IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_cache_dynamic.
    TRY.
        _perform_dynamic_check( iv_cache_id = iv_cache_id
                                iv_param    = iv_param
                                iv_simulate_error = iv_simulate_error ).
        rv_error_info = 'Cache-Prüfung für ' && iv_cache_id && ' erfolgreich.'.
      CATCH zcx_esh_cache_error INTO DATA(lx_esh_error).
        rv_error_info = |Fehler bei Cache-Prüfung für { iv_cache_id } mit Parameter { iv_param }:
                         { lx_esh_error->get_text( ) } (ID: { lx_esh_error->if_t100_message~t100key-msgid } { lx_esh_error->if_t100_message~t100key-msgno })|.
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other_error).
        rv_error_info = |Unerwarteter Fehler bei Cache-Prüfung für { iv_cache_id } mit Parameter { iv_param }:
                         { lx_other_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _perform_dynamic_check.
    " Simulation einer ESH-Cache-Prüfung mit dynamischen Parametern
    " (z.B. unter Verwendung von cl_esh_ca_check S_ESH_ENG_CACHE)
    IF iv_simulate_error = abap_true.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_esh_cache_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = VALUE scx_t100key( msgid = 'ZMSG' msgno = '001' attr1 = iv_cache_id attr2 = iv_param ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

        type = 'CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER'
    ).
    lo_cut->convert_string_to_int( 'ABC' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Bei der Umwandlung von Datentypen können Fehler auftreten, wenn der Inhalt nicht dem Zieltyp entspricht. Die Ausnahme CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER wird ausgelöst, wenn eine Zeichenkette keine gültige Zahl darstellt. TRY...CATCH ermöglicht es, solche Fehler abzufangen und angemessen darauf zu reagieren.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, CX_SY_CONVERSION_NO_NUMBER, Data Conversion, Exception Handling

Instructions: Fangen Sie eine Ausnahme ab, die beim Versuch auftritt, auf ein nicht initialisiertes Objekt zuzugreifen (Dereferenzierung eines NULL-Referenzzeigers).
hint: Verwenden Sie den TRY...CATCH-Block und fangen Sie die Ausnahme CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_null_ref DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS access_object
      IMPORTING
        io_object TYPE REF TO object OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_null_ref IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD access_object.
    TRY.
        IF io_object IS BOUND.
          " Simulieren Sie den Zugriff auf eine Methode des Objekts
          rv_message = 'Objekt erfolgreich zugegriffen.'.
        ELSE.
          " Wenn io_object initial ist, wird der Zugriff eine Ausnahme auslösen.
          " Hier simulieren wir es explizit, um den CATCH-Block zu testen.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        ENDIF.
      CATCH cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
        MESSAGE 'Fehler: Objektreferenz ist initial.' TYPE 'E'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_ref_is_initial.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_access_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_access_null_ref RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_access_success.
    DATA: lo_dummy_object TYPE REF TO object.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_dummy_object.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_null_ref( ).
    DATA(lv_message) = lo_cut->access_object( lo_dummy_object ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_message exp = 'Objekt erfolgreich zugegriffen.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_access_null_ref.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_null_ref( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        type = 'CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL'
    ).
    lo_cut->access_object( ). " io_object bleibt initial
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der Zugriff auf ein Objekt über eine Referenz, die nicht auf ein gültiges Objekt zeigt (NULL-Referenz), führt zu einer Laufzeitfehler. Die Ausnahme CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL fängt diesen Zustand ab und ermöglicht eine kontrollierte Reaktion, anstatt das Programm abstürzen zu lassen.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, CX_SY_REF_IS_INITIAL, Object Reference, NULL Pointer, Exception Handling

Instructions: Verwenden Sie den TRY...CATCH-Block, um eine Ausnahme abzufangen, die durch einen ungültigen Indexzugriff auf eine interne Tabelle mit FOR-Ausdrücken ausgelöst wird.
hint: Kombinieren Sie FOR-Ausdrücke mit einem CATCH-Block für CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_for_itab_index DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             id   TYPE i,
             text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: ty_t_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_text_by_id
      IMPORTING
        iv_id      TYPE i
        it_data    TYPE ty_t_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_for_itab_index IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_text_by_id.
    TRY.
        rv_text = VALUE #( it_data[ id = iv_id ]-text OPTIONAL ). " OPTIONAL verhindert Dump, aber wir wollen den CATCH-Block testen
        " Um den CATCH-Block zu testen, entfernen wir OPTIONAL und lassen die Ausnahme zu.
        rv_text = it_data[ id = iv_id ]-text.
      CATCH cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
        MESSAGE 'Eintrag mit ID nicht gefunden.' TYPE 'E'.
        RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_error
          EXPORTING
            textid = cx_sy_itab_error=>cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_for_itab_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_for_itab_error RAISING cx_static_check FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_for_itab_success.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_err_for_itab_index=>ty_t_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Text 1' ) TO lt_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 2 text = 'Text 2' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_for_itab_index( ).
    DATA(lv_text) = lo_cut->get_text_by_id( iv_id = 2 it_data = lt_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_text exp = 'Text 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_for_itab_error.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE zcl_err_for_itab_index=>ty_t_data.
    APPEND VALUE #( id = 1 text = 'Text 1' ) TO lt_data.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_for_itab_index( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>expect_exception(
      EXPORTING
        type = 'CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND'
    ).
    lo_cut->get_text_by_id( iv_id = 99 it_data = lt_data ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie FOR-Ausdrücke und der direkte Zugriff auf interne Tabellen mit Schlüsseln sind sehr effizient. Wenn jedoch ein Eintrag nicht gefunden wird, wird die Ausnahme CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND ausgelöst. Der TRY...CATCH-Block ist hier unerlässlich, um solche Fehler elegant abzufangen und zu behandeln, anstatt einen Programmabbruch zu riskieren.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, FOR, Internal Table, CX_SY_ITAB_LINE_NOT_FOUND, Exception Handling

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie die Verwendung von TRY...CATCH in einer funktionalen Methode, die eine Kette von Operationen ausführt, die fehlschlagen könnten.
hint: Kapseln Sie die gesamte Logik der funktionalen Methode in einem TRY-Block und fangen Sie alle relevanten Ausnahmen ab.
solution:
CLASS zcl_err_functional_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_chain
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_root.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS _step1
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING
        zcx_custom_error.
    METHODS _step2
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string
      RAISING
        cx_sy_arithmetic_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_err_functional_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_chain.
    DATA: lv_temp TYPE string.
    TRY.
        lv_temp = _step1( iv_input ).
        rv_output = _step2( lv_temp ).
      CATCH zcx_custom_error INTO DATA(lx_custom).
        rv_output = 'Fehler in Schritt 1: ' && lx_custom->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_sy_arithmetic_error INTO DATA(lx_arith).
        rv_output = 'Fehler in Schritt 2: ' && lx_arith->get_text( ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_other).
        rv_output = 'Unerwarteter Fehler: ' && lx_other->get_text( ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _step1.
    IF iv_input IS INITIAL.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE zcx_custom_error
        EXPORTING
          textid = zcx_custom_error=>default_text.
    ENDIF.
    rv_output = iv_input && '_processed1'.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD _step2.
    IF iv_input = 'ERROR_processed1'.
      DATA(lv_dummy) = 1 / 0. " Simulate arithmetic error
    ENDIF.
    rv_output = iv_input && '_processed2'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_chain_success FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_chain_step1_error FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_chain_step2_error FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_chain_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_functional_chain( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_chain( 'ValidInput' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'ValidInput_processed1_processed2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_chain_step1_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_functional_chain( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_chain( '' ). " Empty input for step 1 error
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Fehler in Schritt 1:' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_chain_step2_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_err_functional_chain( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->process_chain( 'ERROR' ). " Specific input for step 2 error
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( act = lv_result exp = 'Fehler in Schritt 2:' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: In komplexen funktionalen Methoden, die mehrere Schritte oder Aufrufe beinhalten, ist es wichtig, eine zentrale Fehlerbehandlung zu implementieren. Ein umfassender TRY...CATCH-Block kann alle potenziellen Ausnahmen abfangen und eine konsistente Fehlerantwort liefern, ohne die interne Logik der einzelnen Schritte zu überladen.
keywords: TRY, CATCH, Functional Programming, Chained Operations, Exception Handling

Instructions: Verbinden Sie eine Liste von Wörtern zu einem Satz, getrennt durch Leerzeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `JOIN` Operator innerhalb von String-Templates.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_join_words DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS join_words IMPORTING it_words TYPE string_table RETURNING VALUE(rv_sentence) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_join_words IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_words.
    rv_sentence = |{ it_words SEPARATED BY ' ' }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_join_words FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_words.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_join_words( ).
    DATA(lt_words) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Hello' ) ( 'World' ) ( 'ABAP' ) ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = lo_cut->join_words( lt_words ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_sentence exp = 'Hello World ABAP' ).

explanation: Der `JOIN` Operator innerhalb von String-Templates (`|...|`) ermöglicht das einfache Verbinden von Elementen einer internen Tabelle mit einem angegebenen Trennzeichen. Dies ist eine sehr lesbare und effiziente Methode im modernen ABAP.
keywords: JOIN, String Templates, Internal Tables, String Processing

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen Satz in einzelne Wörter auf, basierend auf Leerzeichen als Trennzeichen.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `SPLIT` Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_sentence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_sentence IMPORTING iv_sentence TYPE string RETURNING VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_sentence IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_sentence.
    SPLIT iv_sentence AT ' ' INTO TABLE rt_words.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_split_sentence FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_sentence.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_split_sentence( ).
    DATA(lv_sentence) = 'Hello World ABAP'.
    DATA(lt_words) = lo_cut->split_sentence( lv_sentence ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_words ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words[1] exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words[2] exp = 'World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words[3] exp = 'ABAP' ).

explanation: Die `SPLIT` Anweisung ist die klassische Methode, um Strings anhand eines Trennzeichens in eine interne Tabelle aufzuteilen. Sie ist seit langem verfügbar, aber in Kombination mit modernen internen Tabellen und Inline-Deklarationen immer noch effizient und lesbar.
keywords: SPLIT, String Processing, Internal Tables

Instructions: Führen Sie einen LEFT OUTER JOIN zwischen zwei internen Tabellen durch, um Flugdaten mit Währungsinformationen zu kombinieren. Nutzen Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT als Basis.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR ... IN ... JOIN` Ausdruck für interne Tabellen.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_currency_text,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             text     TYPE string,
           END OF ty_currency_text.
    TYPES: tt_currency_text TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_currency_text WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_joined_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             currency_text TYPE string,
           END OF ty_joined_data.
    TYPES: tt_joined_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_joined_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_it_join_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS join_flight_data
          IMPORTING
            it_flights   TYPE tt_sflight_data
            it_currencies TYPE tt_currency_text
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_joined) TYPE tt_joined_data.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_it_join_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD join_flight_data.
        rt_joined = VALUE #( 
          FOR flights IN it_flights
          LEFT OUTER JOIN currencies IN it_currencies
            ON flights~currency = currencies~currency
          ( 
            carrid        = flights~carrid
            connid        = flights~connid
            fldate        = flights~fldate
            price         = flights~price
            currency      = flights~currency
            currency_text = COND string( WHEN currencies IS NOT INITIAL THEN currencies~text ELSE 'N/A' )
          )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_join_flight_data FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_flight_data.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_join_sflight( ).

    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE tt_sflight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20250103' price = '300.00' currency = 'JPY' ) 
    ).

    DATA(lt_currencies) = VALUE tt_currency_text(
      ( currency = 'EUR' text = 'Euro' )
      ( currency = 'USD' text = 'US Dollar' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->join_flight_data(
      it_flights = lt_flights
      it_currencies = lt_currencies
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_joined ) exp = 3 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[1]-currency_text exp = 'Euro' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[2]-currency_text exp = 'US Dollar' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[3]-currency_text exp = 'N/A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `FOR ... IN ... JOIN` Ausdruck ermöglicht SQL-ähnliche Joins direkt auf internen Tabellen. Dies ist eine sehr mächtige und moderne Funktion, die die Datenverarbeitung in ABAP erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert, indem sie explizite Schleifen und `READ TABLE` Anweisungen ersetzt. `COND` wird verwendet, um bedingt einen Wert zuzuweisen, falls kein Join-Partner gefunden wurde.
keywords: JOIN, Internal Tables, FOR, COND, SQL-like, Data Processing

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String, der durch verschiedene Trennzeichen (z.B. Komma, Semikolon oder Leerzeichen) getrennt ist, in einzelne Bestandteile auf.
hint: Normalisieren Sie die Trennzeichen mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX` und `CONDENSE`, bevor Sie `SPLIT` verwenden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_multi_delim DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_multi_delimiter
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_parts) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_multi_delim IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_multi_delimiter.
    DATA(lv_normalized_input) = iv_input.
    REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX `[,;]+` IN lv_normalized_input WITH ` `.
    CONDENSE lv_normalized_input.

    SPLIT lv_normalized_input AT ' ' INTO TABLE rt_parts.

    DELETE rt_parts WHERE table_line IS INITIAL.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_split_multi_delimiter FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_multi_delimiter.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_split_multi_delim( ).

    DATA(lv_input1) = 'Apple,Banana;Cherry Orange'.
    DATA(lt_parts1) = lo_cut->split_multi_delimiter( lv_input1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_parts1 ) exp = 4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_parts1[1] exp = 'Apple' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_parts1[2] exp = 'Banana' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_parts1[3] exp = 'Cherry' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_parts1[4] exp = 'Orange' ).

    DATA(lv_input2) = ',First;Second  Third,'.
    DATA(lt_parts2) = lo_cut->split_multi_delimiter( lv_input2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_parts2 ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_parts2[1] exp = 'First' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_parts2[2] exp = 'Second' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_parts2[3] exp = 'Third' ).

    DATA(lv_input3) = 'SingleWord'.
    DATA(lt_parts3) = lo_cut->split_multi_delimiter( lv_input3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_parts3 ) exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_parts3[1] exp = 'SingleWord' ).

    DATA(lv_input4) = '   '.
    DATA(lt_parts4) = lo_cut->split_multi_delimiter( lv_input4 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_parts4 ) exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Direkte `SPLIT` Anweisungen unterstützen nur ein einzelnes Trennzeichen. Für mehrere Trennzeichen ist es im modernen ABAP üblich, zuerst die verschiedenen Trennzeichen durch ein einheitliches zu ersetzen (hier mit `REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX`) und dann den String zu `CONDENSE`n, um Mehrfach-Trennzeichen zu entfernen, bevor die finale `SPLIT` Operation durchgeführt wird. Dies ist effizienter als manuelle Schleifen und Substring-Operationen.
keywords: SPLIT, REGEX, REPLACE, CONDENSE, String Processing

Instructions: Verbinden Sie die Werte spezifischer Felder einer internen Tabelle dynamisch zu einem String. Die zu verbindenden Felder sollen als Liste übergeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT` und `FIELD-SYMBOLS` in Kombination mit `ASSIGN COMPONENT` und String-Templates.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE string,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_data.
    TYPES: tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_dyn_join_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS join_dynamic_fields
          IMPORTING
            it_data      TYPE tt_data
            it_field_names TYPE string_table
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_joined_strings) TYPE string_table.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_dyn_join_fields IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD join_dynamic_fields.
        LOOP AT it_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_data>).
          DATA(lv_current_line_joined) = VALUE string( ).
          LOOP AT it_field_names ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_name>).
            ASSIGN COMPONENT <fs_field_name> OF STRUCTURE <fs_data> TO FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_field_value>).
            IF sy-subrc = 0.
              IF lv_current_line_joined IS INITIAL.
                lv_current_line_joined = <fs_field_value>.
              ELSE.
                lv_current_line_joined = |{ lv_current_line_joined } { <fs_field_value> }|.
              ENDIF.
            ENDIF.
          ENDLOOP.
          APPEND lv_current_line_joined TO rt_joined_strings.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_join_dynamic_fields FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_join_dynamic_fields.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_join_fields( ).

    DATA(lt_data) = VALUE tt_data(
      ( field1 = 'A' field2 = 'B' field3 = 'C' )
      ( field1 = 'X' field2 = 'Y' field3 = 'Z' )
    ).
    DATA(lt_field_names) = VALUE string_table( ( 'FIELD1' ) ( 'FIELD3' ) ).

    DATA(lt_joined) = lo_cut->join_dynamic_fields(
      it_data = lt_data
      it_field_names = lt_field_names
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_joined ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[1] exp = 'A C' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[2] exp = 'X Z' ).

    CLEAR lt_field_names.
    APPEND 'FIELD2' TO lt_field_names.
    lt_joined = lo_cut->join_dynamic_fields(
      it_data = lt_data
      it_field_names = lt_field_names
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_joined ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[1] exp = 'B' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_joined[2] exp = 'Y' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Feldzugriffsmöglichkeit in ABAP mittels `ASSIGN COMPONENT ... OF STRUCTURE ... TO FIELD-SYMBOL`. In Kombination mit `LOOP AT ... ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL` und String-Templates (`|...|`) kann man flexibel und modern Daten aus internen Tabellen basierend auf einer Liste von Feldnamen extrahieren und verbinden. Dies ist besonders nützlich für generische Berichte oder Schnittstellen.
keywords: JOIN, Dynamic Programming, FIELD-SYMBOLS, ASSIGN COMPONENT, String Templates, Internal Tables

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen durch Kommas getrennten String in eine interne Tabelle von Strings auf und weisen Sie die Teile den Komponenten einer Struktur zu.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` in eine interne Tabelle und dann manuelle Zuweisung zu den Strukturkomponenten.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_person,
             first_name TYPE string,
             last_name  TYPE string,

    CLASS zcl_str_split_to_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

    CLASS zcl_str_split_to_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD split_to_structure.
        DATA(lt_parts) = VALUE string_table( ).

        IF lines( lt_parts ) >= 3.
          rs_person-first_name = lt_parts[1].
          rs_person-last_name  = lt_parts[2].
          rs_person-city       = lt_parts[3].
        END IF.

Instructions: Aggregieren Sie die Flugnummern (connid) aller Flüge eines bestimmten Carriers zu einem einzigen, durch Kommas getrennten String. Nutzen Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT als Basis.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator in Kombination mit String-Templates und `JOIN`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_reduce_join_connid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_connids_for_carrier
          IMPORTING
            it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key
            iv_carrid  TYPE sflight-carrid
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_connids_string) TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_reduce_join_connid IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_connids_for_carrier.
        rv_connids_string = REDUCE string(
          INIT s = ''
          FOR flights IN it_flights WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
          NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN flights~connid ELSE |{ s },{ flights~connid }| )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' )
      ( carrid = 'UA' connid = '0010' )

    DATA(lv_connids_lh) = lo_cut->get_connids_for_carrier(

explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug im modernen ABAP, um eine interne Tabelle zu einem einzelnen Wert zu aggregieren. Hier wird er verwendet, um die `connid`s für einen bestimmten `carrid` zu sammeln und mit einem Komma zu verbinden. Die `COND` Expression innerhalb des `NEXT` Ausdrucks sorgt dafür, dass das erste Element ohne führendes Komma hinzugefügt wird. Dies ist eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Aggregation.
keywords: REDUCE, JOIN, Internal Tables, Aggregation, String Templates, COND

Instructions: Nehmen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Strings, wobei jeder String durch ein Semikolon getrennte Werte enthält. Teilen Sie jeden String auf und erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle von Strukturen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` in Kombination mit `SPLIT` und `VALUE`.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item_data,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
             qty  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_item_data.
    TYPES: tt_item_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_item_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_split_map_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS split_and_map
          IMPORTING
            it_input_strings TYPE string_table
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_mapped_data) TYPE tt_item_data.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_split_map_for IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD split_and_map.
        rt_mapped_data = VALUE #( 
          FOR lv_input_string IN it_input_strings
            LET lt_parts = VALUE string_table( ) IN
            ( 
              SPLIT lv_input_string AT ';' INTO TABLE lt_parts.
              id   = lt_parts[1]
              name = lt_parts[2]
              qty  = CONV i( lt_parts[3] )
            )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Hier wird jeder String der Eingabetabelle aufgeteilt (`SPLIT`) und die resultierenden Teile direkt den Komponenten einer neuen Struktur zugewiesen, die dann die neue interne Tabelle bildet. `LET` wird verwendet, um lokale Variablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks zu definieren, was die Lesbarkeit verbessert.

Instructions: Verbinden Sie zwei Strings mit einem Trennzeichen, aber nur, wenn beide Strings nicht leer sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates mit einer `COND` Expression oder dem `&&` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_join_conditionally DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS join_if_not_empty
      IMPORTING
        iv_string1 TYPE string
        iv_string2 TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_join_conditionally IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD join_if_not_empty.
    DATA(lv_delimiter) = COND string( WHEN iv_delimiter IS INITIAL THEN ' ' ELSE iv_delimiter ).

    IF iv_string1 IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_string2 IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_result = |{ iv_string1 }{ lv_delimiter }{ iv_string2 }|.
    ELSE IF iv_string1 IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_result = iv_string1.
    ELSE IF iv_string2 IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_result = iv_string2.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_join_conditionally( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->join_if_not_empty( iv_string1 = 'Hello' iv_string2 = 'World' ) exp = 'Hello World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->join_if_not_empty( iv_string1 = 'First' iv_string2 = 'Second' iv_delimiter = '-' ) exp = 'First-Second' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->join_if_not_empty( iv_string1 = 'OnlyOne' iv_string2 = '' ) exp = 'OnlyOne' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->join_if_not_empty( iv_string1 = '' iv_string2 = 'OnlyTwo' ) exp = 'OnlyTwo' ).

explanation: String-Templates (`|...|`) sind die moderne Art, Strings in ABAP zu verketten. In diesem Beispiel wird eine bedingte Logik verwendet, um zu prüfen, ob beide Strings nicht leer sind, bevor sie mit einem Trennzeichen verbunden werden. Dies vermeidet unnötige Trennzeichen bei leeren Eingaben und ist flexibler als der einfache `&&` Operator.
keywords: JOIN, String Templates, COND, String Processing, Conditional Logic

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in zwei Teile an der ersten gefundenen Stelle eines bestimmten Trennzeichens. Wenn das Trennzeichen nicht gefunden wird, soll der gesamte String als erster Teil zurückgegeben werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Funktion `FIND` in Kombination mit `SUBSTRING` oder `SPLIT` mit `MAXIMUM 1 OCCURRENCE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_split_first_occurrence DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_at_first
      IMPORTING
        iv_input     TYPE string
        iv_delimiter TYPE string
      EXPORTING
        ev_part1     TYPE string
        ev_part2     TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_split_first_occurrence IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_at_first.
    DATA(lv_offset) = find( val = iv_input sub = iv_delimiter ).

    IF lv_offset >= 0.
      ev_part1 = substring( val = iv_input off = 0 len = lv_offset ).
      ev_part2 = substring( val = iv_input off = lv_offset + strlen( iv_delimiter ) ).
    ELSE.
      ev_part1 = iv_input.
      ev_part2 = ''.ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_split_at_first FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_at_first.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_split_first_occurrence( ).
    DATA: lv_part1 TYPE string, lv_part2 TYPE string.

    lo_cut->split_at_first( iv_input = 'Apple-Banana-Cherry' iv_delimiter = '-' EXPORTING ev_part1 = lv_part1 ev_part2 = lv_part2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_part1 exp = 'Apple' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_part2 exp = 'Banana-Cherry' ).

    lo_cut->split_at_first( iv_input = 'SingleWord' iv_delimiter = '-' EXPORTING ev_part1 = lv_part1 ev_part2 = lv_part2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_part1 exp = 'SingleWord' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_part2 exp = '' ).

    lo_cut->split_at_first( iv_input = 'First::Second' iv_delimiter = '::' EXPORTING ev_part1 = lv_part1 ev_part2 = lv_part2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_part1 exp = 'First' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_part2 exp = 'Second' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die String-Funktion `FIND` liefert die Position des ersten Vorkommens eines Substrings. In Kombination mit `SUBSTRING` kann der Originalstring präzise in zwei Teile geteilt werden. Dies ist eine moderne und effiziente Methode, um Strings zu manipulieren, ohne auf ältere `OFFSET`- oder `LENGTH`-Operationen zurückgreifen zu müssen.

Instructions: Führen Sie einen INNER JOIN zwischen zwei internen Tabellen durch, um nur die Flüge zu erhalten, die sowohl in der Flugtabelle (SFLIGHT) als auch in einer separaten Tabelle für 'Premium-Flüge' existieren. Nutzen Sie die Tabelle SFLIGHT als Basis.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `FOR ... IN ... JOIN` Ausdruck für interne Tabellen mit einem impliziten INNER JOIN.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_premium_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_premium_flight_key.
    TYPES: tt_premium_flight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_premium_flight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_it_inner_join DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS get_premium_flights
          IMPORTING
            it_all_flights    TYPE tt_sflight_key
            it_premium_keys   TYPE tt_premium_flight_key
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_premium_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_it_inner_join IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD get_premium_flights.
        rt_premium_flights = VALUE #( 
          FOR flights IN it_all_flights
          INNER JOIN premium_keys IN it_premium_keys
            ON flights~carrid = premium_keys~carrid
           AND flights~connid = premium_keys~connid
          ( flights )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String in eine Liste von Wörtern auf, wobei alle nicht-alphanumerischen Zeichen als Trennzeichen dienen sollen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `SPLIT` in Kombination mit `CL_ABAP_REGEX` für eine präzise Regex-basierte Aufteilung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_regex_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS split_by_non_alphanum
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_words) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_split IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD split_by_non_alphanum.
    DATA(lo_regex) = NEW cl_abap_regex( pattern = `\W+` ). 
    DATA(lo_matcher) = lo_regex->create_matcher( text = iv_input ).
    DATA(lt_matches) = lo_matcher->get_matches( ).

    DATA(lv_last_offset) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_matches ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_match>).
      DATA(lv_word) = iv_input+lv_last_offset(<fs_match>-offset - lv_last_offset).
      IF lv_word IS NOT INITIAL.
        APPEND lv_word TO rt_words.
      ENDIF.
      lv_last_offset = <fs_match>-offset + <fs_match>-length.
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA(lv_remaining_part) = iv_input+lv_last_offset.
    IF lv_remaining_part IS NOT INITIAL.
      APPEND lv_remaining_part TO rt_words.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_split_by_non_alphanum FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_split_by_non_alphanum.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_str_regex_split( ).

    DATA(lv_input1) = 'Hello, World! This is a test.'.
    DATA(lt_words1) = lo_cut->split_by_non_alphanum( lv_input1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_words1 ) exp = 6 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words1[1] exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words1[2] exp = 'World' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words1[6] exp = 'test' ).

    DATA(lv_input2) = '123-abc_DEF'.
    DATA(lt_words2) = lo_cut->split_by_non_alphanum( lv_input2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_words2 ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words2[1] exp = '123' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words2[2] exp = 'abc' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words2[3] exp = 'DEF' ).

    DATA(lv_input3) = '  leading and trailing  '.
    DATA(lt_words3) = lo_cut->split_by_non_alphanum( lv_input3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_words3 ) exp = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_words3[1] exp = 'leading' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Für komplexe Aufteilungsregeln, die über einfache Trennzeichen hinausgehen, ist die Klasse `CL_ABAP_REGEX` das Werkzeug der Wahl. Hier wird ein regulärer Ausdruck (`\W+` für ein oder mehrere nicht-alphanumerische Zeichen) verwendet, um die Trennzeichen zu finden. Anschließend werden die Substrings zwischen diesen Trennzeichen extrahiert. Dies ist die flexibelste und mächtigste Methode für Regex-basierte String-Aufteilung in ABAP.
keywords: SPLIT, REGEX, CL_ABAP_REGEX, String Processing, Advanced

Instructions: Verbinden Sie die Elemente einer internen Tabelle von Strukturen zu einem String, wobei jedes Element als JSON-Objekt formatiert und durch Kommas getrennt ist.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN` mit String-Templates und `cl_abap_json_serializer` oder manueller JSON-Formatierung.

TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_product,
             id   TYPE string,
             name TYPE string,
             price TYPE decfloat16,
           END OF ty_product.
    TYPES: tt_product TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_product WITH EMPTY KEY.

      PUBLIC SECTION.

          IMPORTING
            it_products TYPE tt_product
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rv_json_string) TYPE string.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_json_join IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD serialize_products_to_json.
        DATA(lt_json_parts) = VALUE string_table(
          FOR product IN it_products
          ( |{{"id":"{ product-id }","name":"{ product-name }","price":{ product-price } }}| )
        ).
        rv_json_string = |[{ lt_json_parts SEPARATED BY ',' }]|.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

  PRIVATE SECTION. METHODS test_serialize_products_to_json FOR TESTING.

Instructions: Teilen Sie einen String, der URL-Parameter enthält (z.B. 'key1=value1&key2=value2'), in eine interne Tabelle von Schlüssel-Wert-Paaren auf.

solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_url_param,
             key   TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_url_param.
    TYPES: tt_url_param TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_url_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_url_param_split DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS parse_url_params
          IMPORTING
            iv_url_params TYPE string
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_params) TYPE tt_url_param.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_url_param_split IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD parse_url_params.
        rt_params = VALUE #( 
          FOR lv_param_pair IN ( SPLIT iv_url_params AT '&' ) 
            LET lt_key_value = VALUE string_table( ) IN
            ( 
              SPLIT lv_param_pair AT '=' INTO TABLE lt_key_value.
              key   = lt_key_value[1]
              value = COND string( WHEN lines( lt_key_value ) > 1 THEN lt_key_value[2] ELSE '' ) 
            )
        ).
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdaten (SFLIGHT) nach Fluggesellschaft (carrid) und verbinden Sie für jede Gruppe die Flugnummern (connid) zu einem durch Kommas getrennten String.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` in Kombination mit `REDUCE` und String-Templates.
solution:
TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight_data.
    TYPES: tt_sflight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_connids,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connids TYPE string,
           END OF ty_grouped_connids.
    TYPES: tt_grouped_connids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_connids WITH EMPTY KEY.

    CLASS zcl_group_join_connids DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        METHODS group_and_join_connids
          IMPORTING
            it_flights TYPE tt_sflight_data
          RETURNING
            VALUE(rt_grouped) TYPE tt_grouped_connids.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS zcl_group_join_connids IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD group_and_join_connids.
        LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
          DATA(lv_connids_string) = REDUCE string(
            INIT s = ''
            FOR <fs_group_member> IN GROUP ls_flight
            NEXT s = COND string( WHEN s IS INITIAL THEN <fs_group_member>-connid ELSE |{ s },{ <fs_group_member>-connid }| )
          ).
          APPEND VALUE ty_grouped_connids( carrid = ls_flight-carrid connids = lv_connids_string ) TO rt_grouped.
        ENDLOOP.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den Gesamtumsatz aller Flüge in der `sflights`-Tabelle, nachdem ein variabler Rabatt angewendet wurde, der auf dem Flugpreis basiert. Nutze `REDUCE` und `CALCULATE`. Die Klasse soll `if_oo_adt_classrun` implementieren.
hint: Verwende `REDUCE` für die Aggregation und `CALCULATE` für die dynamische Rabattberechnung innerhalb des `REDUCE`-Ausdrucks.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cal_total_revenue DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS calculate_total_revenue
      IMPORTING
        iv_discount_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2 OPTIONAL " e.g., 0.10 for 10%
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_revenue) TYPE s_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_total_revenue IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_total_revenue_no_discount) = calculate_total_revenue( ).
    out->write( |Total Revenue (no discount): { lv_total_revenue_no_discount }| ).

    DATA(lv_total_revenue_with_discount) = calculate_total_revenue( iv_discount_rate = '0.05' ).
    out->write( |Total Revenue (5% discount): { lv_total_revenue_with_discount }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD calculate_total_revenue.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rv_total_revenue = REDUCE s_price(
      INIT total_price = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT total_price = CALCULATE( total_price + ( flight-price * ( 1 - iv_discount_rate ) ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_calculate_revenue.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cal_total_revenue( ).

    " Test without discount
    DATA(lv_total_no_discount) = lo_cut->calculate_total_revenue( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_total_no_discount ).

    " Test with 10% discount
    DATA(lv_total_with_discount) = lo_cut->calculate_total_revenue( iv_discount_rate = '0.10' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lv_total_with_discount ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_total_with_discount < lv_total_no_discount ).

    " Test with 100% discount (should be 0)
    DATA(lv_total_full_discount) = lo_cut->calculate_total_revenue( iv_discount_rate = '1.00' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_total_full_discount exp = 0 ).
  ENDMETHOD.

CLASS zcl_cls_flight_transform DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_and_transformed_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cls_flight_transform IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_transformed_flights) = get_filtered_and_transformed_flights( 'LH' ).
    out->write( |Transformed Lufthansa Flights ({ lines( lt_transformed_flights ) }):| ).
    LOOP AT lt_transformed_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      out->write( |  { ls_flight-carrid } | { ls_flight-connid } | { ls_flight-fldate } | { ls_flight-price } { ls_flight-currency }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_filtered_and_transformed_flights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      WHERE ( carrid = iv_carrid )
      ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
        connid   = to_upper( flight-connid ), " Transform connid to uppercase
        fldate   = flight-fldate,
        price    = flight-price,
        currency = flight-currency ) 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fil_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

CLASS zcl_fil_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_min_seatsb) = 20.
    DATA(lt_filtered_flights) = get_flights_by_capacity_and_date( lv_min_seatsb ).
    out->write( |Flights with at least { lv_min_seatsb } Business Class seats and future date ({ lines( lt_filtered_flights ) }):| ).

      out->write( |  { ls_flight-carrid } | { ls_flight-connid } | { ls_flight-fldate } | Seats Business: { ls_flight-seatsb }| ).
    ENDLOOP.

    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    rt_flights = FILTER #( 
      lt_sflights
      USING KEY primary_key
      WHERE seatsb >= iv_min_seatsb AND fldate > sy-datum

CLASS zcl_str_flight_summary DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_flight_summary
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id

CLASS zcl_str_flight_summary IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_summary) = get_flight_summary( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' iv_fldate = '20251224' ).
    out->write( |Flight Summary: { lv_summary }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    DATA ls_flight TYPE sflights.
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights
      INTO @ls_flight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
        AND connid = @iv_connid
        AND fldate = @iv_fldate.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      rv_summary = |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate DATE = USER } | &
                   |von { ls_flight-cityfrom } nach { ls_flight-cityto }. | &
                   |Preis: { ls_flight-price CURRENCY = ls_flight-currency } { ls_flight-currency }.|.
    ELSE.
      rv_summary = |Flug { iv_carrid } { iv_connid } am { iv_fldate DATE = USER } nicht gefunden.|.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_oo_flight_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        iv_base_price TYPE s_price.
    METHODS add_tax
      IMPORTING
        iv_tax_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_flight_calculator.
    METHODS apply_discount
      IMPORTING
        iv_discount_rate TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_oo_flight_calculator.
    METHODS get_final_price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_price) TYPE s_price.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_current_price TYPE s_price.

CLASS zcl_oo_flight_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_final_price) = NEW zcl_oo_flight_calculator( iv_base_price = 1000 )
      ->add_tax( iv_tax_rate = '0.19' )
      ->apply_discount( iv_discount_rate = '0.05' )
      ->get_final_price( ).
    out->write( |Final Price after tax and discount: { lv_final_price }| ).

    DATA(lv_price_only_tax) = NEW zcl_oo_flight_calculator( iv_base_price = 500 )
      ->add_tax( iv_tax_rate = '0.10' )
      ->get_final_price( ).
    out->write( |Price with only 10% tax: { lv_price_only_tax }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD constructor.
    mv_current_price = iv_base_price.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD add_tax.
    mv_current_price = mv_current_price * ( 1 + iv_tax_rate ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD apply_discount.
    mv_current_price = mv_current_price * ( 1 - iv_discount_rate ).
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_final_price.
    rv_final_price = mv_current_price.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechne den durchschnittlichen Flugpreis pro Fluggesellschaft aus der `sflights`-Tabelle. Wenn eine Fluggesellschaft keine Flüge hat, soll der Durchschnitt 0 sein. hint: `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` ermöglicht die Aggregation von Daten. `CALCULATE` kann für die Division verwendet werden, um Fehler bei Division durch Null zu vermeiden.

CLASS zcl_cal_avg_flight_price DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_avg_price,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             avg_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_avg_price.
    TYPES tt_avg_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_avg_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_average_prices_by_carrier
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_prices) TYPE tt_avg_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cal_avg_flight_price IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lt_avg_prices) = get_average_prices_by_carrier( ).
    out->write( |Average Flight Prices by Carrier:| ).
    LOOP AT lt_avg_prices INTO DATA(ls_avg).
      out->write( |  { ls_avg-carrid }: { ls_avg-avg_price }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_average_prices_by_carrier.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      DATA(lv_total_price) = REDUCE s_price(
        INIT sum_price = 0
        FOR grouped_flight IN GROUP ls_flight
        NEXT sum_price = sum_price + grouped_flight-price
      ).
      DATA(lv_count) = lines( GROUP ls_flight ).

      DATA(lv_avg_price) = CALCULATE( COND s_price(
        WHEN lv_count > 0 THEN lv_total_price / lv_count
        ELSE 0
      ) ).

      APPEND VALUE ty_avg_price( carrid = ls_flight-carrid avg_price = lv_avg_price ) TO rt_avg_prices.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_extract DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS extract_flight_numbers
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_numbers) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_regex_extract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_text1) = `Flüge: LH 0400, AA 123, UA 7890. Weitere Flüge: BA 456.`.
    DATA(lt_numbers1) = extract_flight_numbers( lv_text1 ).
    out->write( |Extracted from '{ lv_text1 }': { REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR n IN lt_numbers1 NEXT s = s && |{ n } | ) }| ).

    DATA(lv_text2) = `Keine Flüge hier.`.
    DATA(lt_numbers2) = extract_flight_numbers( lv_text2 ).
    out->write( |Extracted from '{ lv_text2 }': { REDUCE string( INIT s = '' FOR n IN lt_numbers2 NEXT s = s && |{ n } | ) }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD extract_flight_numbers.
    " Regex to find 3 or 4 digits, possibly preceded by a carrier ID (2 chars)
    " Example: LH 0400, AA123, 7890
    DATA(lv_regex_pattern) = `[A-Z]{2}\s*\d{3,4}|\b\d{3,4}\b`.
    DATA lt_match_results TYPE match_result_tab.

    FIND ALL OCCURRENCES OF REGEX lv_regex_pattern
      IN iv_text
      RESULTS lt_match_results.

    rt_flight_numbers = VALUE #( FOR match IN lt_match_results ( match-submatch ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Test with multiple flight numbers and carriers
    DATA(lv_text1) = `Flüge: LH 0400, AA 123, UA 7890. Weitere Flüge: BA 456.`.
    DATA(lt_expected1) = VALUE string_table( ( 'LH 0400' ) ( 'AA 123' ) ( 'UA 7890' ) ( 'BA 456' ) ).
    DATA(lt_actual1) = lo_cut->extract_flight_numbers( lv_text1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_actual1 exp = lt_expected1 ).

Instructions: Berechne das Datum, das X Tage in der Zukunft liegt, ausgehend von einem Startdatum. Nutze die moderne Datumsarithmetik. Die Klasse soll `if_oo_adt_classrun` implementieren.

solution:
CLASS zcl_date_calc_future DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    METHODS get_future_date
      IMPORTING
        iv_start_date TYPE sy-datum
        iv_days_to_add TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_future_date) TYPE sy-datum.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_date_calc_future IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA(lv_today) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_future_date) = get_future_date( iv_start_date = lv_today iv_days_to_add = 30 ).
    out->write( |Today: { lv_today DATE = USER }, 30 days in future: { lv_future_date DATE = USER }| ).

    DATA(lv_past_date) = get_future_date( iv_start_date = lv_today iv_days_to_add = -7 ).
    out->write( |Today: { lv_today DATE = USER }, 7 days in past: { lv_past_date DATE = USER }| ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_future_date.
    rv_future_date = iv_start_date + iv_days_to_add.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füge Daten aus einer Quelltabelle in eine Zieltabelle ein, wobei nur bestimmte Felder übernommen und gegebenenfalls umbenannt werden. Nutze den `CORRESPONDING` Operator. Die Klasse soll `if_oo_adt_classrun` implementieren.
hint: Der `CORRESPONDING` Operator ist ideal für die Zuweisung von Feldern mit gleichen Namen oder für die Feldzuordnung mit `MAPPING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_corresponding DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES if_oo_adt_classrun.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             price    TYPE s_price,
             currency TYPE s_currcode,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_source.
    TYPES tt_source TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_target,
             airline_id TYPE s_carr_id,
             flight_num TYPE s_conn_id,
             flight_date TYPE s_date,
             ticket_price TYPE s_price,
           END OF ty_target.
    TYPES tt_target TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_flights_to_target
      IMPORTING
        it_source_flights TYPE tt_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target_flights) TYPE tt_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_corresponding IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD if_oo_adt_classrun~main.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    SELECT * FROM sflights UP TO 5 ROWS INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

    DATA(lt_target_flights) = map_flights_to_target( CORRESPONDING #( lt_sflights ) ).

    out->write( |Mapped Flights ({ lines( lt_target_flights ) }):| ).
    LOOP AT lt_target_flights INTO DATA(ls_target).
      out->write( |  Airline: { ls_target-airline_id }, Flight: { ls_target-flight_num }, Date: { ls_target-flight_date }, Price: { ls_target-ticket_price }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD map_flights_to_target.
    rt_target_flights = CORRESPONDING #( 
      it_source_flights MAPPING airline_id = carrid 
                        MAPPING flight_num = connid 
                        MAPPING flight_date = fldate 
                        MAPPING ticket_price = price 
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_source_data) = VALUE zcl_itab_corresponding=>tt_source(

      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '1234' fldate = '20250102' price = 750 currency = 'USD' seatsmax = 150 )
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target1-flight_date exp = '20250101' ).

CLASS zcl_gos_create_note IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA: ls_object TYPE borident.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Gesamtzahl der belegten Business-Class-Sitze für eine bestimmte Flugverbindung aus der Tabelle `sflights` unter Verwendung des `REDUCE`-Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` zum Summieren der `SEATSCC`-Werte.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sfl_reduce_seats DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_total_business_seats
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_seats) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sfl_reduce_seats IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_total_business_seats.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatscc
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rv_total_seats = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                FOR flight IN lt_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatscc ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lv_total_seats) = lo_cut->calculate_total_business_seats( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid = '0400' ).

    " Assuming 'LH' '0400' has some entries in SFLIGHT with SEATSCC
    " For a robust test, you might need to insert test data or mock the SELECT.

Instructions: Konstruieren Sie eine dynamische `WHERE`-Klausel für die Tabelle `sflights` basierend auf optionalen Eingabeparametern. Nutzen Sie hierfür String-Templates und den `COND`-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie String-Templates für dynamisches SQL und `COND` für die bedingte Logik innerhalb des Strings.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sfl_dynamic_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate TYPE s_date,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_dynamic
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id OPTIONAL
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sfl_dynamic_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_dynamic.
    DATA(lv_where_clause) = |
      { COND string( WHEN iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL THEN |CARRID = '{ iv_carrid }'| ELSE '' ) }
      { COND string( WHEN iv_carrid IS NOT INITIAL AND iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL THEN ' AND ' ELSE '' ) }
      { COND string( WHEN iv_connid IS NOT INITIAL THEN |CONNID = '{ iv_connid }'| ELSE '' ) }
    |.

    IF lv_where_clause IS NOT INITIAL.
      lv_where_clause = |WHERE { lv_where_clause }|.
    ENDIF.

    DATA(lv_select_statement) = |
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        { lv_where_clause }
        INTO TABLE @rt_flights
    |.

    TRY.
        EXEC SQL.
          { lv_select_statement }
        ENDEXEC.
      CATCH cx_sy_native_sql_error INTO DATA(lx_sql_error).
        MESSAGE lx_sql_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_where FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_where.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sfl_dynamic_where( ).

    " Test with CARRIER only
    DATA(lt_flights_carrid) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( iv_carrid = 'AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_flights_carrid ) > 0 msg = 'Should find flights for AA' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights_carrid[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Incorrect carrier ID' ).

    " Test with CARRIER and CONNECTION
    DATA(lt_flights_both) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( iv_carrid = 'AA' iv_connid = '0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_flights_both ) > 0 msg = 'Should find flights for AA 0017' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights_both[ 1 ]-carrid exp = 'AA' msg = 'Incorrect carrier ID' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lt_flights_both[ 1 ]-connid exp = '0017' msg = 'Incorrect connection ID' ).

    " Test with no parameters
    DATA(lt_flights_all) = lo_cut->get_flights_dynamic( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_flights_all ) > 0 msg = 'Should find all flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates ermöglichen die einfache und lesbare Konstruktion dynamischer SQL-Anweisungen. Der `COND`-Operator erlaubt die bedingte Einfügung von Teilen der `WHERE`-Klausel, was den Code kompakter und wartbarer macht als verschachtelte `IF`-Anweisungen.
keywords: String Templates, COND, Open SQL, Dynamic Programming, sflights

Instructions: Rufen Sie eine Methode der `cl_hcmfab_employee_api` auf und behandeln Sie potenzielle Ausnahmen mit `TRY...CATCH`. Protokollieren Sie die Fehlermeldung im Fehlerfall.

solution:
CLASS zcl_hcm_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS call_employee_api_safe
      IMPORTING
        iv_employee_id TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hcm_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD call_employee_api_safe.
    DATA: lo_employee_api TYPE REF TO cl_hcmfab_employee_api.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_employee_api.

    TRY.
        " Simulate a call that might fail, e.g., get_employee_details
        " In a real scenario: lo_employee_api->get_employee_details( iv_employee_id = iv_employee_id ... ).
        IF iv_employee_id = 'ERROR'.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_hcmfab_employee_api_error
            EXPORTING
              textid = cx_hcmfab_employee_api_error=>employee_not_found.
        ENDIF.
        rv_success = abap_true.
      CATCH cx_hcmfab_employee_api_error INTO DATA(lx_hcm_error).
        " Log the error message
        MESSAGE lx_hcm_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      CATCH cx_static_check INTO DATA(lx_static_check).
        MESSAGE lx_static_check->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' DISPLAY LIKE 'I'.
        rv_success = abap_false.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle mit Flugdaten, wobei ein Statusfeld basierend auf der Anzahl der freien Sitze gesetzt wird. Nutzen Sie hierfür den `COND`-Operator innerhalb eines `FOR`-Ausdrucks.
hint: Verwenden Sie `COND string( WHEN ... THEN ... ELSE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sfl_cond_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_status,
             carrid      TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid      TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate      TYPE s_date,
             free_seats  TYPE i,
             status      TYPE string,
           END OF ty_flight_status.
    TYPES tt_flight_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_status
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_status) TYPE tt_flight_status.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sfl_cond_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_status.
    DATA: lt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights.

    rt_flight_status = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_flights
                                  LET lv_free_seats = flight-seatsmax - flight-seatsocc IN
                                  ( carrid     = flight-carrid,
                                    connid     = flight-connid,
                                    fldate     = flight-fldate,
                                    free_seats = lv_free_seats,
                                    status     = COND string( WHEN lv_free_seats > 10 THEN 'Available'
                                                               WHEN lv_free_seats > 0  THEN 'Limited'
                                                               ELSE 'Full' ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_flight_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sfl_cond_status( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_flights_with_status( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( lt_result ) > 0 msg = 'Should find flights' ).

    " Find a flight that should be 'Full' (assuming some flights are full)
    DATA(ls_full_flight) = VALUE #( lt_result[ status = 'Full' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_full_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_full_flight-status exp = 'Full' msg = 'Status should be Full' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_full_flight-free_seats <= 0 msg = 'Full flight should have 0 or less free seats' ).
    ENDIF.

    " Find a flight that should be 'Available' (assuming some flights are available)
    DATA(ls_available_flight) = VALUE #( lt_result[ status = 'Available' ] OPTIONAL ).
    IF ls_available_flight IS NOT INITIAL.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_available_flight-status exp = 'Available' msg = 'Status should be Available' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_available_flight-free_seats > 10 msg = 'Available flight should have > 10 free seats' ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `COND`-Operator ermöglicht die bedingte Zuweisung von Werten auf eine sehr kompakte Weise, ähnlich einem Ternary-Operator in anderen Sprachen. In Kombination mit `FOR` und `LET` wird die Transformation von Tabellen mit komplexer Logik sehr lesbar.
keywords: COND, FOR, LET, Internal Tables, Conditional Logic, sflights

             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,

             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsocc TYPE s_seatsocc,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_raw.
    TYPES tt_flight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_raw WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_objects
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_objects) TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO if_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

INTERFACE if_flight_data.
  METHODS get_carrid RETURNING VALUE(rv_carrid) TYPE s_carr_id.
  METHODS get_connid RETURNING VALUE(rv_connid) TYPE s_conn_id.
  METHODS get_fldate RETURNING VALUE(rv_fldate) TYPE s_date.
  METHODS get_occupancy_rate RETURNING VALUE(rv_rate) TYPE p LENGTH 3 DECIMALS 1.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_sfl_flight_objects IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_objects.
    DATA: lt_flights_raw TYPE tt_flight_raw.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, seatsocc, seatsmax
      FROM sflight
      INTO TABLE @lt_flights_raw.

    CLASS lcl_flight DEFINITION FINAL.
      PUBLIC SECTION.
        INTERFACES if_flight_data.
        METHODS constructor
          IMPORTING
            is_flight TYPE ty_flight_raw.
      PRIVATE SECTION.
        DATA ms_flight TYPE ty_flight_raw.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS lcl_flight IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD constructor.
        ms_flight = is_flight.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD if_flight_data~get_carrid.
        rv_carrid = ms_flight-carrid.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD if_flight_data~get_connid.
        rv_connid = ms_flight-connid.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD if_flight_data~get_fldate.
        rv_fldate = ms_flight-fldate.
      ENDMETHOD.
      METHOD if_flight_data~get_occupancy_rate.
        IF ms_flight-seatsmax > 0.
          rv_rate = ( ms_flight-seatsocc * 100 ) / ms_flight-seatsmax.
        ELSE.
          rv_rate = 0.
        ENDIF.
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.

    rt_flight_objects = VALUE #( FOR flight IN lt_flights_raw
                                   ( NEW lcl_flight( flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_sum_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connection,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             connid TYPE s_conn_id,
           END OF ty_connection.
    TYPES: tt_connections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connection WITH EMPTY KEY.

      IMPORTING
        it_connections TYPE tt_connections
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_sum_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_connections IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid, seatsmax
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_connections
        WHERE carrid = it_connections-carrid
          AND connid = it_connections-connid
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT sum = 0
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      NEXT sum = sum + flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_join_scarr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_id,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier_id.
    TYPES: tt_carrier_ids TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_id WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_with_name,
             carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
             carrname TYPE scarr-carrname,
             connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
             fldate   TYPE s_date,
             seatsmax TYPE s_seatsmax,
           END OF ty_flight_with_name.
    TYPES: tt_flights_with_name TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_with_name WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_with_carrier_name
      IMPORTING
        it_carrier_ids TYPE tt_carrier_ids
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flights_with_name.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_join_scarr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_with_carrier_name.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_scarr    TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF scarr WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carrier_ids IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT *
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_carrier_ids
        WHERE carrid = it_carrier_ids-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.

      IF lt_sflights IS NOT INITIAL.
        SELECT carrid, carrname
          FROM scarr
          FOR ALL ENTRIES IN lt_sflights
          WHERE carrid = lt_sflights-carrid
          INTO TABLE @lt_scarr.
      ENDIF.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flights = VALUE #( 
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      LET carrier_name = lt_scarr[ KEY primary_key COMPONENTS carrid = flight-carrid ]-carrname IN
      ( carrid   = flight-carrid,
        carrname = carrier_name,
        connid   = flight-connid,
        fldate   = flight-fldate,
        seatsmax = flight-seatsmax )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_count_flights DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
           END OF ty_carrier.
    TYPES: tt_carriers TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_count,
             carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
             count  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_count.
    TYPES: tt_flight_counts TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS count_flights_by_carriers
      IMPORTING
        it_carriers TYPE tt_carriers
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_counts) TYPE tt_flight_counts.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_fae_count_flights IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD count_flights_by_carriers.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    IF it_carriers IS NOT INITIAL.
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflights
        FOR ALL ENTRIES IN it_carriers
        WHERE carrid = it_carriers-carrid
        INTO TABLE @lt_sflights.
    ENDIF.

    rt_flight_counts = REDUCE zcl_fae_count_flights=>tt_flight_counts(
      INIT result = VALUE zcl_fae_count_flights=>tt_flight_counts( )
      FOR flight IN lt_sflights
      GROUP BY flight-carrid INTO DATA(group_key)
      LET count = lines( group_key ) IN
      NEXT result = VALUE #( BASE result ( carrid = group_key-carrid count = count ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie den Endbetrag nach X Jahren bei Zinseszins, gegeben einen Startbetrag, Zinssatz und die Anzahl der Jahre.

CLASS zcl_mul_compound_interest DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_compound_interest
      IMPORTING
        iv_principal TYPE p DECIMALS 2
        iv_rate      TYPE f " e.g., 0.05 for 5%
        iv_years     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_final_amount) TYPE p DECIMALS 2.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mul_compound_interest IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_compound_interest.
    rv_final_amount = iv_principal.
    DO iv_years TIMES.
      rv_final_amount = rv_final_amount * ( 1 + iv_rate ).
    ENDDO.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Fläche für eine Liste von Rechtecken, wobei jedes Rechteck eine Länge und Breite hat.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen `FOR`-Loop mit dem `VALUE`-Operator und Multiplikation.

CLASS zcl_mul_rectangle_area DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_rectangle,
             length TYPE i,
             width  TYPE i,
           END OF ty_rectangle.
    TYPES: tt_rectangles TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_rectangle WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_rectangle_area,
             length TYPE i,
             width  TYPE i,
             area   TYPE i,
           END OF ty_rectangle_area.
    TYPES: tt_rectangle_areas TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_rectangle_area WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_areas
      IMPORTING
        it_rectangles TYPE tt_rectangles
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_areas) TYPE tt_rectangle_areas.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_mul_rectangle_area IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_areas.
    rt_areas = VALUE #( 
      FOR rect IN it_rectangles
      ( length = rect-length,
        width  = rect-width,
        area   = rect-length * rect-width )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_mapper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Dauer aller Termine, die länger als eine Stunde dauern, unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` um eine einzelne Summe aus einer internen Tabelle zu aggregieren.

CLASS zcl_appointment_reducer DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment,
             id        TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             duration_minutes TYPE i,
           END OF ty_appointment.
    TYPES tt_appointments TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_appointment WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_long_appointment_duration
      IMPORTING
        it_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_duration) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_reducer IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_long_appointment_duration.
    rv_total_duration = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                  FOR ls_app IN it_appointments
                                  WHERE ( duration_minutes > 60 )
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_app-duration_minutes ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( id = 1 description = 'Short Meeting' duration_minutes = 30 )
      ( id = 2 description = 'Long Meeting 1' duration_minutes = 90 )
      ( id = 3 description = 'Short Call' duration_minutes = 45 )
      ( id = 4 description = 'Long Meeting 2' duration_minutes = 120 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_total) = lo_cut->calculate_long_appointment_duration( lt_appointments ).

keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, Constructor Expression

CLASS zcl_alink_error_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS create_alink_connection

        iv_object_type TYPE string
        iv_object_id   TYPE string

        VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.

    CLASS cl_dummy_alink_connection DEFINITION.
