          IMPORTING
            i_object_type TYPE string
            i_object_id   TYPE string
          RAISING
            cx_sy_create_error.
    ENDCLASS.

    CLASS cl_dummy_alink_connection IMPLEMENTATION.
      METHOD create_connection.
        IF i_object_type IS INITIAL OR i_object_id IS INITIAL.
          RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_create_error EXPORTING textid = cx_sy_create_error=>default text = 'Ungültige ALink Parameter'.
        ENDIF.
        " Simulierte Logik für Verbindungserstellung
      ENDMETHOD.
    ENDCLASS.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alink_error_handler IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_appointment_adder DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_appointment,
             id        TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             date      TYPE d,
           END OF ty_appointment.

    METHODS add_new_appointments

        it_base_appointments TYPE tt_appointments
        it_appointments_to_add TYPE tt_appointments
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_appointments) TYPE tt_appointments.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_appointment_adder IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_new_appointments.
    rt_combined_appointments = VALUE #( BASE it_base_appointments
                                        FOR ls_new IN it_appointments_to_add
                                        ( ls_new ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      ( id = 1 description = 'Existing A' date = '20251201' )

      ( id = 2 description = 'New B' date = '20251210' )
      ( id = 3 description = 'New C' date = '20251215' )

explanation: Der `VALUE` Operator mit der `BASE` Option und einer `FOR` Schleife ist eine sehr effiziente und lesbare Methode, um Elemente zu einer bestehenden internen Tabelle hinzuzufügen oder sie zu erweitern, ohne explizite `APPEND` Anweisungen.
keywords: VALUE, BASE, FOR, Internal Tables, Constructor Expression

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flüge aus der Tabelle 'SFLIGHTS' nach Fluggesellschaft und zählen Sie die Flüge pro Gruppe, unter Verwendung des `GROUP BY` Ausdrucks für interne Tabellen.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY ...` für die Gruppierung von internen Tabellen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflight_grouper DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_grouped_flights,
             carrid      TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_grouped_flights.
    TYPES tt_grouped_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_grouped_flights WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_grouped_flights) TYPE tt_grouped_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_grouper IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier.
    DATA: ls_grouped_flight TYPE ty_grouped_flights.

    LOOP AT it_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight) GROUP BY ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_grouped_flight-carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      ls_grouped_flight-flight_count = GROUP SIZE.
      APPEND ls_grouped_flight TO rt_grouped_flights.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sflight_grouper( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = VALUE zcl_sflight_grouper=>tt_flight_data(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0401' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0010' fldate = '20251201' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0402' fldate = '20251202' )
    ).

    DATA(lt_grouped) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier( lt_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_grouped ) exp = 2 ).

    READ TABLE lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_lh) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh-flight_count exp = 3 ).

    READ TABLE lt_grouped INTO DATA(ls_aa) WITH KEY carrid = 'AA'.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_aa-flight_count exp = 1 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Ausdruck ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion, die es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen direkt im ABAP-Code zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. `GROUP SIZE` liefert dabei die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe.
keywords: GROUP BY, Internal Tables, LOOP, Aggregation

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hashed Table, die UUIDs als eindeutigen Schlüssel verwendet, und fügen Sie Daten hinzu.
hint: Definieren Sie den Tabellentyp mit `HASHED TABLE` und `UNIQUE KEY`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_data,
        id   TYPE sysuuid_x16,
        text TYPE string,
      END OF ty_data,
      tt_data TYPE HASHED TABLE OF ty_data WITH UNIQUE KEY id.

    METHODS add_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.

    METHODS get_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_id TYPE sysuuid_x16
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_data TYPE tt_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_uuid_hashed_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_data.
    rs_data-id = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ).
    rs_data-text = iv_text.
    INSERT rs_data INTO TABLE mt_data.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_data.
    READ TABLE mt_data INTO rs_data INDEX 1 USING KEY id = iv_id. " Modern syntax for READ TABLE with KEY
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_hashed_table FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_get_data_not_found FOR TESTING RAISING cx_sy_itab_line_not_found.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_hashed_table.
    DATA(lo_hashed_table) = NEW zcl_uuid_hashed_table( ).
    DATA(ls_data1) = lo_hashed_table->add_data( 'First entry' ).
    DATA(ls_data2) = lo_hashed_table->add_data( 'Second entry' ).

    DATA(ls_retrieved_data) = lo_hashed_table->get_data( ls_data1-id ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_retrieved_data-text exp = 'First entry' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_retrieved_data-id exp = ls_data1-id ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_data_not_found.
    DATA(lo_hashed_table) = NEW zcl_uuid_hashed_table( ).
    DATA(lv_non_existent_uuid) = cl_system_uuid=>create_uuid_x16( ). " A new UUID not in table
    lo_hashed_table->get_data( lv_non_existent_uuid ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Expected exception cx_sy_itab_line_not_found was not raised.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Verwendung von `HASHED TABLE` mit `UNIQUE KEY` auf dem `sysuuid_x16`-Feld ermöglicht einen sehr performanten Zugriff auf Datensätze über die UUID. Die moderne `READ TABLE ... USING KEY` Syntax ist prägnanter und effizienter als ältere `WITH KEY` Varianten.
keywords: UUID, Hashed Table, Internal Tables, UNIQUE KEY, CL_SYSTEM_UUID

hint: Definieren Sie eine neue Struktur, die die Felder von SFLIGHTS und ein `sysuuid_x16`-Feld enthält.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_with_uuid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        uuid TYPE sysuuid_x16,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
        fldate TYPE s_date,
        " Add other relevant SFLIGHTS fields as needed
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_with_uuid
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
        iv_connid TYPE s_conn_id
        iv_fldate TYPE s_date
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_flight) TYPE ty_flight_data
      RAISING
        cx_sy_read_error. " Or a more specific exception

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_with_uuid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_with_uuid.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid AND connid = @iv_connid AND fldate = @iv_fldate
      INTO @DATA(ls_sflight).

Instructions: Serialisieren Sie Daten aus einer internen Tabelle (z.B. Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS) in ein XML-Format.
hint: Iterieren Sie über die interne Tabelle und erstellen Sie für jeden Eintrag ein XML-Element mit Kind-Elementen für die Felder.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sflights_to_xml DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS serialize_sflights_to_xml
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_xml_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflights_to_xml IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights_to_xml.
    DATA(lo_writer) = cl_sec_sxml_writer=>create_writer( ).

    lo_writer->open_element( 'Flights' ).
    LOOP AT it_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Flight' ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Carrid' value = ls_flight-carrid ).
      lo_writer->write_attribute( name = 'Connid' value = ls_flight-connid ).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'FlightDate' ).
      lo_writer->write_value( CONV string( ls_flight-fldate ) ). " Convert date to string
      lo_writer->close_element( ).
      lo_writer->open_element( 'Price' ).
      lo_writer->write_value( CONV string( ls_flight-price ) ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ).
      lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flight
    ENDLOOP.
    lo_writer->close_element( ). " Close Flights

    rv_xml_string = lo_writer->get_xml_as_string( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflights_xml FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflights_xml.
    DATA: lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights WITH EMPTY KEY.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20251209' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.
    INSERT VALUE sflights( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20251209' price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' ) INTO TABLE lt_sflights.

    DATA(lo_serializer) = NEW zcl_sflights_to_xml( ).
    DATA(lv_xml) = lo_serializer->serialize_sflights_to_xml( lt_sflights ).

    DATA(lv_expected_xml_part1) = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?><Flights><Flight Carrid="LH" Connid="0400"><FlightDate>20251209</FlightDate><Price>100.00</Price></Flight>'.
    DATA(lv_expected_xml_part2) = '<Flight Carrid="AA" Connid="0017"><FlightDate>20251209</FlightDate><Price>200.00</Price></Flight></Flights>'.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = lv_expected_xml_part1 act = lv_xml ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( substring = lv_expected_xml_part2 act = lv_xml ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Iteration über eine interne Tabelle und die dynamische Erstellung von XML-Elementen und Attributen mit `CL_SEC_SXML_WRITER` ist eine flexible Methode zur Serialisierung komplexer Datenstrukturen. Die Verwendung von `CONV string(...)` ist ein modernes Feature zur Typkonvertierung.
keywords: XML, Serialization, SFLIGHTS, Internal Tables, CL_SEC_SXML_WRITER

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von zwei verschiedenen Fluggesellschaften (z.B. 'LH' und 'AA') aus der Tabelle SFLIGHTS in einer einzigen internen Tabelle, wobei alle Zeilen beibehalten werden sollen, auch Duplikate.
hint: Nutzen Sie den Open SQL Operator UNION ALL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_all DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_union_all
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_all IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_union_all.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_all FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_all.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_all( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_union_all( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden.'
      fail_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_fail_level_error ).

    " Überprüfen, ob sowohl LH als auch AA enthalten sind
    DATA(lv_count_lh) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_aa) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_count_lh = lv_count_lh + 1.
      ELSEIF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_count_aa = lv_count_aa + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_count_lh > 0 )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge von LH enthalten sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lv_count_aa > 0 )
      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge von AA enthalten sein.' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der UNION ALL Operator in Open SQL ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse mehrerer SELECT-Anweisungen zu kombinieren, wobei alle Zeilen, einschließlich Duplikate, beibehalten werden. Dies ist effizienter als das manuelle Zusammenführen und Anhängen von internen Tabellen.
keywords: UNION ALL, Open SQL, SELECT, Datenbankzugriff

solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_distinct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_key.
    TYPES tt_flight_key TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_flight_key WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid connid.

    METHODS get_unique_flight_keys
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flight_keys) TYPE tt_flight_key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_distinct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_unique_flight_keys.
    " UNION ist standardmäßig DISTINCT
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid < '0500'
      UNION
    SELECT carrid, connid
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid < '0500'
      INTO TABLE @rt_flight_keys.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_distinct FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_distinct.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_distinct( ).
    DATA(lt_flight_keys) = lo_cut->get_unique_flight_keys( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_flight_keys )
      msg = 'Es sollten eindeutige Flugschlüssel gefunden werden.'
      fail_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_fail_level_error ).

    " Überprüfen, ob die Tabelle eindeutige Einträge enthält (implizit durch SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY)
    " und ob die Anzahl der Zeilen plausibel ist.
    " Da die Testdaten variieren können, prüfen wir nur auf Nicht-Leerheit und den Typ.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( lt_flight_keys ) > 0 )
      msg = 'Die Ergebnistabelle sollte nicht leer sein.' ).

    " Manuelle Überprüfung auf Duplikate (obwohl SORTED TABLE WITH UNIQUE KEY dies sicherstellt)
    DATA(lv_prev_carrid) TYPE sflight-carrid.
    DATA(lv_prev_connid) TYPE sflight-connid.
    LOOP AT lt_flight_keys INTO DATA(ls_key).
      IF ls_key-carrid = lv_prev_carrid AND ls_key-connid = lv_prev_connid.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'Duplikat gefunden, obwohl UNION DISTINCT verwendet wurde.' ).
      ENDIF.
      lv_prev_carrid = ls_key-carrid.
      lv_prev_connid = ls_key-connid.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der UNION Operator (ohne ALL) in Open SQL kombiniert die Ergebnisse mehrerer SELECT-Anweisungen und entfernt automatisch Duplikate. Dies ist nützlich, wenn nur eindeutige Datensätze benötigt werden, ohne eine zusätzliche DISTINCT-Klausel oder manuelle Duplikatsprüfung.
keywords: UNION, DISTINCT, Open SQL, Eindeutige Daten

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten aus SFLIGHTS: einmal alle Flüge von 'LH' mit einer bestimmten Flugnummer (z.B. '0400') und einmal alle Flüge von 'AA' mit einem bestimmten Datum (z.B. '20251209').
hint: Verwenden Sie separate WHERE-Klauseln für jede SELECT-Anweisung innerhalb des UNION-Statements.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_where DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_info,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_info.
    TYPES tt_flight_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING iv_date TYPE sflight-fldate DEFAULT '20251209'
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_flight_info.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_where IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'
      UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND fldate = @iv_date
      INTO TABLE @rt_flights.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_union FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_union.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_where( ).
    DATA(lv_test_date) = sy-datum. " Use current date for testing

    " Insert test data if SFLIGHTS is empty or doesn't contain specific entries
    " (This is a simplified test, in a real scenario, test data setup would be more robust)
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = sy-datum price = '100' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '200' ) ).
    INSERT sflight FROM @( VALUE sflight( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '300' ) ). " Not expected in result

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_date = lv_test_date ).

    " Check if at least one flight from LH 0400 and one from AA on test date exists
    DATA(lv_found_lh_0400) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_found_aa_date) = abap_false.

    LOOP AT lt_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'LH' AND ls_flight-connid = '0400'.
        lv_found_lh_0400 = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
      IF ls_flight-carrid = 'AA' AND ls_flight-fldate = lv_test_date.
        lv_found_aa_date = abap_true.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_found_lh_0400
      msg = 'Flug LH 0400 sollte gefunden werden.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_found_aa_date
      msg = 'Flug AA am Testdatum sollte gefunden werden.' ).

    " Clean up test data (optional, but good practice)
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0400'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'AA' AND connid = '0001'.
    DELETE FROM sflight WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0001'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Möglichkeit, unterschiedliche WHERE-Klauseln für jede SELECT-Anweisung innerhalb eines UNION-Statements zu verwenden, erlaubt das flexible Kombinieren von Daten, die verschiedenen Kriterien entsprechen. Dies ist eine leistungsstarke Funktion für komplexe Datenabfragen.
keywords: UNION, WHERE, Open SQL, Filterung

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft für 'LH' und 'AA' separat und kombinieren Sie diese Ergebnisse in einer einzigen internen Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie COUNT(*) und GROUP BY in jeder SELECT-Anweisung vor dem UNION.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_agg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_carrier_count,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_carrier_count.
    TYPES tt_carrier_count TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_count WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_aggregated_flight_counts
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_counts) TYPE tt_carrier_count.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_agg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_aggregated_flight_counts.
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
      GROUP BY carrid
      UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, COUNT(*) AS flight_count
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'
      GROUP BY carrid
      INTO TABLE @rt_counts.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_aggregation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_aggregation.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_agg( ).
    DATA(lt_counts) = lo_cut->get_aggregated_flight_counts( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_counts )
      msg = 'Es sollten Aggregationsergebnisse gefunden werden.'
      fail_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_fail_level_error ).

    " Überprüfen, ob genau zwei Einträge (für LH und AA) vorhanden sind
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_counts )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten genau zwei Einträge (LH, AA) vorhanden sein.' ).

    " Überprüfen, ob die Fluggesellschaften korrekt sind
    DATA(lv_found_lh) = abap_false.
    DATA(lv_found_aa) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_counts INTO DATA(ls_count).
      IF ls_count-carrid = 'LH'.
        lv_found_lh = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_count-flight_count > 0 ).
      ELSEIF ls_count-carrid = 'AA'.
        lv_found_aa = abap_true.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( ls_count-flight_count > 0 ).
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_lh ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_found_aa ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Kombination von UNION mit Aggregatfunktionen wie COUNT und GROUP BY ermöglicht es, zusammengefasste Daten aus verschiedenen Teilmengen einer Tabelle zu erhalten. Dies ist besonders nützlich für Berichte und Analysen, die Daten aus unterschiedlichen Perspektiven aggregieren müssen.
keywords: UNION ALL, COUNT, GROUP BY, Open SQL, Aggregation

Instructions: Führen Sie einen UNION ALL über zwei SELECT-Anweisungen auf SFLIGHTS durch. Die Zielstruktur soll zusätzliche Felder enthalten, die nicht in den SELECT-Listen vorkommen. Nutzen Sie CORRESPONDING FIELDS, um nur passende Felder zu füllen.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_corr_fields DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,

CLASS zcl_sql_union_corr_fields IMPLEMENTATION.

    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight

      UNION ALL
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, price, currency
      FROM sflight
      WHERE carrid = 'AA'

  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_union_corr_fields FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_union_corr_fields.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_sql_union_corr_fields( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_flights_corr_fields( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(

      msg = 'Es sollten Flüge gefunden werden.'

    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klausel INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE in Kombination mit UNION ALL ermöglicht es, die Ergebnisse einer UNION-Abfrage in eine interne Tabelle zu schreiben, deren Struktur mehr Felder als die SELECT-Liste enthält. Nur die namensgleichen Felder werden gefüllt, was die Flexibilität bei der Datenaufnahme erhöht.
keywords: UNION ALL, CORRESPONDING FIELDS, Open SQL, Datenstruktur

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein einfaches ALV-Grid mit Daten aus SFLIGHTS und ändern Sie dynamisch die Spaltenüberschrift für 'CARRID' und 'CONNID' über das ALV-Objektmodell.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_header DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_dynamic_header IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_dynamic_headers.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_r_data    = lt_sflight ).

        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).

        DATA(lo_column_carrid) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CARRID' ).
        lo_column_carrid->set_long_text( 'Fluggesellschaft' ).

        DATA(lo_column_connid) = lo_columns->get_column( 'CONNID' ).
        lo_column_connid->set_long_text( 'Flugnummer' ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_headers FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_headers.
    " This test can only verify the method call, not the visual ALV output.
    " For ALV tests, typically a dummy container or mocking is used.
    " Here, we just ensure the method runs without immediate exceptions.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_alv_dynamic_header( ).

    " To avoid GUI-related errors in unit tests, we can try to run it in a background task
    " or mock the GUI container. For simplicity, we'll just call it and catch exceptions.
    TRY.
        lo_cut->display_alv_with_dynamic_headers( ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( abap_true

        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail(

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_root).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail(
          msg = |Unerwarteter Fehler aufgetreten: { lx_root->get_text( ) }| ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV-Grid, das Flugdaten anzeigt. Fügen Sie eine neue, berechnete Spalte 'FLIGHT_ID' hinzu, die aus 'CARRID' und 'CONNID' zusammengesetzt ist, bevor Sie das ALV anzeigen.
hint: Erweitern Sie die interne Tabelle mit der neuen Spalte und füllen Sie diese, bevor Sie `cl_salv_table=>factory` aufrufen. Nutzen Sie String-Templates für die Zusammensetzung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_custom_column DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_with_calculated_column.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_custom_column IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_calculated_column.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_extended,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
             flight_id TYPE string, " Neue berechnete Spalte
           END OF ty_flight_extended.
    DATA: lt_sflight_raw TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.
    DATA: lt_sflight_ext TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_extended WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight_raw UP TO 10 ROWS.

    " Füllen der erweiterten Tabelle mit berechneter Spalte
    lt_sflight_ext = VALUE #( FOR ls_raw IN lt_sflight_raw
                               ( carrid   = ls_raw-carrid,
                                 connid   = ls_raw-connid,
                                 fldate   = ls_raw-fldate,
                                 price    = ls_raw-price,
                                 currency = ls_raw-currency,
                                 flight_id = |{ ls_raw-carrid }-{ ls_raw-connid }| ) ).

    TRY.
        DATA(lo_alv) = cl_salv_table=>factory( r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                                t_r_data    = lt_sflight_ext ).

        " Optional: Überschrift für die neue Spalte setzen
        DATA(lo_columns) = lo_alv->get_columns( ).
        DATA(lo_column_flight_id) = lo_columns->get_column( 'FLIGHT_ID' ).
        lo_column_flight_id->set_long_text( 'Flug-ID' ).

        lo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

Instructions: Führen Sie eine UNION ALL-Abfrage auf SFLIGHTS durch, um Flüge von 'LH' und 'AA' zu erhalten. Filtern Sie anschließend die Ergebnisse mit einem `FOR`-Ausdruck, um nur Flüge mit einem Preis über 200 zu behalten.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE ...` nach der UNION-Abfrage.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_price,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
             price  TYPE sflight-price,
           END OF ty_flight_price.
    TYPES tt_flight_price TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_price WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_union_flights
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE tt_flight_price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_union_flights.
    DATA(lt_raw_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_price( ( SELECT carrid, connid, price
                                                      FROM sflight
                                                      WHERE carrid = 'LH'
                                                      UNION ALL
                                                    SELECT carrid, connid, price
                                                      FROM sflight
                                                      WHERE carrid = 'AA' ) ).

Instructions: Kombinieren Sie Flugdaten von 'LH' und 'AA' mittels UNION ALL. Transformieren Sie anschließend die Ergebnisse mit dem `REDUCE`-Operator, um eine Map zu erstellen, die für jede Fluggesellschaft die Gesamtanzahl der Flüge enthält.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer Hash-Tabelle als Akkumulator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sql_union_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.
    TYPES ty_carrier_count_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF i WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.

    METHODS get_flight_counts_by_carrier
      RETURNING VALUE(rt_carrier_counts) TYPE ty_carrier_count_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sql_union_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_counts_by_carrier.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE tt_flight_data( ( SELECT carrid, connid
                                                     FROM sflight
                                                     WHERE carrid = 'LH'
                                                     UNION ALL
                                                   SELECT carrid, connid
                                                     FROM sflight
                                                     WHERE carrid = 'AA' ) ).

    rt_carrier_counts = REDUCE ty_carrier_count_map(
      INIT counts = VALUE ty_carrier_count_map( )
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_all_flights
      LET lv_current_count = counts[ ls_flight-carrid ] OPTIONAL
      IN
        counts = VALUE ty_carrier_count_map(
          BASE counts
          ( key = ls_flight-carrid value = lv_current_count + 1 ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      act = lines( lt_carrier_counts )
      msg = 'Es sollten Zählergebnisse gefunden werden.'
      fail_level = cl_abap_unit_assert=>co_fail_level_error ).

    " Überprüfen, ob Einträge für LH und AA vorhanden sind und Zähler > 0
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lt_carrier_counts[ 'LH' ] > 0 )
      msg = 'Anzahl Flüge für LH sollte > 0 sein.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lt_carrier_counts[ 'AA' ] > 0 )
      msg = 'Anzahl Flüge für AA sollte > 0 sein.' ).

    " Überprüfen der Gesamtanzahl der Einträge in der Map
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_carrier_counts )
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Es sollten genau zwei Einträge in der Map sein (LH, AA).' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE`-Operator (ABAP 7.40+) ist ideal, um eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren oder in eine andere Struktur zu transformieren. Hier wird er verwendet, um die Ergebnisse einer `UNION ALL`-Abfrage zu verarbeiten und eine Hash-Tabelle zu erstellen, die die Anzahl der Flüge pro Fluggesellschaft speichert. Instructions: Erstellen Sie ein ALV-Grid und implementieren Sie ein Event-Handler für den Doppelklick auf eine Zeile. Zeigen Sie bei einem Doppelklick die Flugnummer der ausgewählten Zeile in einer Meldung an.
hint: Nutzen Sie `cl_salv_events_list->if_salv_events_list~on_double_click` und `SET HANDLER`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_alv_double_click DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_alv_with_double_click.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_alv TYPE REF TO cl_salv_table.
    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT if_salv_events_list~on_double_click OF cl_salv_table
      IMPORTING r_salv_at_functions.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_alv_double_click IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_alv_with_double_click.
    DATA: lt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    SELECT * FROM sflight INTO TABLE @lt_sflight UP TO 10 ROWS.

    TRY.
        cl_salv_table=>factory( EXPORTING r_container = cl_gui_container=>default_screen
                                 IMPORTING r_salv_table = mo_alv
                                 CHANGING  t_r_data     = lt_sflight ).

        SET HANDLER handle_double_click FOR mo_alv->get_event_handler( ).

        mo_alv->display( ).

      CATCH cx_salv_msg INTO DATA(lx_salv_msg).
        MESSAGE lx_salv_msg->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE sflight.
    DATA: lv_row_index TYPE i.

    lv_row_index = r_salv_at_functions->get_row( ).

    READ TABLE mo_alv->get_data_ref( )->* INDEX lv_row_index INTO ls_sflight.

    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      MESSAGE |Doppelklick auf Flugnummer: { ls_sflight-connid }| TYPE 'I'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_insert_duplicate FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_single( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AA'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0001'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    " Ensure record does not exist before test
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight_record(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_success
      msg = 'Insert should be successful'
    ).

    " Verify insertion
    SELECT SINGLE * FROM sflights INTO @DATA(ls_flight)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND connid = @lv_connid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = ls_flight
      msg = 'Inserted record should exist'
      cond = xsdbool( ls_flight IS NOT INITIAL )
    ).

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_duplicate.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_single( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_connid) = '0400'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    " Ensure record exists for duplicate test
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid fldate = lv_fldate ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_flight_record(
      iv_carrid = lv_carrid
      iv_connid = lv_connid
      iv_fldate = lv_fldate
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lv_success
      msg = 'Insert of duplicate record should fail'
    ).

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid = lv_connid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT INTO ... VALUES` Syntax ermöglicht das Einfügen eines einzelnen Datensatzes mit einer kompakten Wertzuweisung. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen für die Struktur innerhalb des `VALUES` Ausdrucks und der `COND` Operator für die Rückgabe des Erfolgsstatus sind moderne ABAP-Praktiken.

      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid2 fldate = lv_fldate price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'AIRBUS A380' seatsmax = 500 seatsocc = 250 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_multiple_flights( lt_new_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = lv_success
      msg = 'Multiple inserts should be successful'
    ).

    " Verify insertion
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_count)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Two records should have been inserted'
    ).

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_multiple_with_duplicates.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_multi( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'DL'.
    DATA(lv_connid1) = '0001'.
    DATA(lv_connid2) = '0002'.
    DATA(lv_fldate) = sy-datum.

    " Ensure one record exists for duplicate test
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid1 fldate = lv_fldate ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_new_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid1 fldate = lv_fldate price = '200.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'AIRBUS A380' seatsmax = 500 seatsocc = 200 ) " Duplicate
      ( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid2 fldate = lv_fldate price = '250.00' currency = 'USD' planetype = 'AIRBUS A380' seatsmax = 500 seatsocc = 250 )
    ).

    DATA(lv_success) = lo_cut->insert_multiple_flights( lt_new_flights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
      act = lv_success
      msg = 'Insert with duplicates should fail (sy-subrc <> 0)'
    ).

    " Verify only one new record was inserted (the non-duplicate one)
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_count)
      WHERE carrid = @lv_carrid AND fldate = @lv_fldate.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_count
      exp = 2
      msg = 'Only the non-duplicate record should have been inserted'
    ).

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND fldate = lv_fldate.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `INSERT ... FROM TABLE` Syntax ist die effizienteste Methode, um mehrere Datensätze aus einer internen Tabelle in eine Datenbanktabelle einzufügen. Dies ist besonders performant, da die Daten in einem Paket an die Datenbank übergeben werden. Der `VALUE` Operator wird hier zur Initialisierung der internen Tabelle im Test verwendet.
keywords: INSERT, FROM TABLE, Open SQL, sflights, Internal Tables, VALUE

Instructions: Fügen Sie neue Flugdatensätze in die Tabelle `sflights` ein, indem Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `sbook` selektieren und transformieren. Stellen Sie sicher, dass nur Datensätze eingefügt werden, die noch nicht existieren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `INSERT ... SELECT ...` mit einer vorherigen Prüfung auf Existenz oder einer `WHERE NOT EXISTS` Klausel, um Duplikate zu vermeiden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_insert_select DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS insert_flights_from_bookings
      IMPORTING
        iv_max_entries TYPE i DEFAULT 10
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_inserted_count) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_insert_select IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD insert_flights_from_bookings.
    " Define a temporary internal table to hold the data to be inserted
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflights-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflights-price,
             currency TYPE sflights-currency,
             planetype TYPE sflights-planetype,
             seatsmax TYPE sflights-seatsmax,
             seatsocc TYPE sflights-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    DATA: lt_flights_to_insert TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    " Select data from sbook and transform it for sflights
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate,
           '150.00' AS price, " Default price
           'EUR'    AS currency,
           'A320'   AS planetype,
           200      AS seatsmax,
           50       AS seatsocc
      FROM sbook
      UP TO @iv_max_entries ROWS
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_bookings).

    " Filter out bookings that already exist in sflights to avoid duplicates
    " This is a simplified approach; a more robust check might involve a JOIN or EXISTS
    LOOP AT lt_bookings INTO DATA(ls_booking).
      SELECT SINGLE carrid FROM sflights
        WHERE carrid = @ls_booking-carrid
          AND connid = @ls_booking-connid
          AND fldate = @ls_booking-fldate
        INTO @DATA(lv_dummy).
      IF sy-subrc <> 0. " Record does not exist
        APPEND VALUE ty_flight_data(
          carrid    = ls_booking-carrid
          connid    = ls_booking-connid
          fldate    = ls_booking-fldate
          price     = '150.00'
          currency  = 'EUR'
          planetype = 'A320'
          seatsmax  = 200
          seatsocc  = 50
        ) TO lt_flights_to_insert.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    IF lt_flights_to_insert IS NOT INITIAL.
      INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @lt_flights_to_insert.
      rv_inserted_count = sy-dbcnt.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_insert_from_select FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_insert_from_select_no_new_entries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_insert_from_select.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_select( ).
    DATA(lv_initial_count) = 0.
    DATA(lv_inserted_count) = 0.

    " Get initial count of sflights
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @lv_initial_count.

    " Insert new flights from bookings
    lv_inserted_count = lo_cut->insert_flights_from_bookings( iv_max_entries = 5 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lv_inserted_count
      msg = 'Should insert at least one new flight'
      cond = xsdbool( lv_inserted_count > 0 )
    ).

    " Verify total count increased
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflights INTO @DATA(lv_final_count).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_final_count
      exp = lv_initial_count + lv_inserted_count
      msg = 'Total flight count should increase by inserted count'
    ).

    " Clean up inserted records (this is tricky without knowing the exact keys,
    " so we'll just delete all records that match the pattern of inserted ones)
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE planetype = 'A320' AND price = '150.00'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_insert_from_select_no_new_entries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_insert_select( ).
    DATA(lv_inserted_count) = 0.

    " First, insert some records to ensure duplicates exist
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE sflights_tab(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '150.00' currency = 'EUR' planetype = 'A320' seatsmax = 200 seatsocc = 50 )
    ).
    INSERT sflights FROM TABLE @lt_initial_flights.
    COMMIT WORK.

    " Try to insert again, expecting no new entries
    lv_inserted_count = lo_cut->insert_flights_from_bookings( iv_max_entries = 1 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_inserted_count
      exp = 0
      msg = 'No new flights should be inserted if duplicates exist'
    ).

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'LH' AND connid = '0001' AND fldate = sy-datum.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert das Einfügen von Datensätzen in `sflights` basierend auf einer Selektion aus `sbook`. Um Duplikate zu vermeiden, wird eine Schleife mit einer `SELECT SINGLE` Prüfung verwendet. Die Transformation der Daten erfolgt manuell, da `INSERT ... SELECT` keine direkte `CORRESPONDING FIELDS` Unterstützung bietet, wenn die Feldnamen nicht übereinstimmen. Die Verwendung von `UP TO ... ROWS` und Inline-Deklarationen sind moderne Open SQL-Features.
keywords: INSERT, SELECT, Open SQL, sflights, sbook, UP TO, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe aller Flugpreise aus der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) unter Verwendung des `REDUCE` Operators.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REDUCE` um eine interne Tabelle zu aggregieren. Denken Sie daran, die Preise korrekt zu konvertieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_price_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflights-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_price) TYPE sflights-price.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_reduce_sum IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_price_for_carrier.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rv_total_price = REDUCE #( INIT sum = 0.00
                                FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
                                  NEXT sum = sum + ls_flight-price ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sum_prices FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_sum_prices_no_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sum_prices.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'LH'.
    DATA(lv_expected_sum) = 0.00.

    " Ensure test data exists and calculate expected sum
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid IN ('0001', '0002').
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0001' fldate = sy-datum price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid connid = '0002' fldate = sy-datum price = '250.50' currency = 'EUR' ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    lv_expected_sum = 100.00 + 250.50.

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_sum
      exp = lv_expected_sum
      msg = 'Sum of prices should match expected value'
    ).

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid AND connid IN ('0001', '0002').
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_sum_prices_no_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_reduce_sum( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'XX'. " Non-existent carrier

    DATA(lv_actual_sum) = lo_cut->get_total_price_for_carrier( lv_carrid ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_sum
      exp = 0.00
      msg = 'Sum of prices should be 0 for non-existent carrier'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der `REDUCE` Operator ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für die Aggregation von Daten in internen Tabellen. Er ermöglicht es, eine Tabelle auf einen einzelnen Wert zu reduzieren, indem er über die Elemente iteriert und eine Akkumulatorvariable aktualisiert. Dies führt zu sehr kompaktem und funktionalem Code.
keywords: REDUCE, Internal Tables, sflights, Aggregation, Functional Programming

Instructions: Weisen Sie einer Variablen einen Wert basierend auf einer Bedingung zu. Wenn der Flugpreis über 500 liegt, soll der Status 'Teuer' sein, sonst 'Normal'. Verwenden Sie den `COND` Operator.
hint: Der `COND` Operator ist eine Kurzform für bedingte Zuweisungen und kann direkt in Ausdrücken verwendet werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cond_operator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_flight_price_status
      IMPORTING
        iv_price TYPE sflights-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cond_operator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_price_status.
    rv_status = COND string(
      WHEN iv_price > 500 THEN 'Teuer'
      ELSE 'Normal'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_price_status( '500.01' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_status
      exp = 'Teuer'
      msg = 'Status should be Teuer for price > 500'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_normal_flight.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cond_operator( ).
    DATA(lv_status) = lo_cut->get_flight_price_status( '499.99' ).

    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Der `COND` Operator ermöglicht eine kompakte und ausdrucksstarke bedingte Zuweisung von Werten. Anstatt einer `IF...ENDIF` Struktur kann der Wert direkt basierend auf einer oder mehreren Bedingungen zugewiesen werden, was den Code kürzer und lesbarer macht, insbesondere bei einfachen Verzweigungen.
keywords: COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Demonstrieren Sie Method Chaining, indem Sie eine Kette von Methodenaufrufen auf einem Objekt ausführen, das mit dem `NEW` Operator instanziiert wurde.
hint: Stellen Sie sicher, dass die Methoden, die Teil der Kette sein sollen, eine Referenz auf das eigene Objekt (`ME`) zurückgeben.
solution:
CLASS zcl_method_chain DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS set_value1
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain.

    METHODS set_value2
      IMPORTING
        iv_val TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_method_chain.

    METHODS get_sum
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sum) TYPE i.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_value1 TYPE i.
    DATA mv_value2 TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_method_chain IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD set_value1.
    mv_value1 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_value2.
    mv_value2 = iv_val.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_sum.
    rv_sum = mv_value1 + mv_value2.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lv_result) = NEW zcl_method_chain( )->set_value1( 10 )->set_value2( 20 )->get_sum( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 30

explanation: Method Chaining ermöglicht es, mehrere Methodenaufrufe auf einem Objekt in einer einzigen Anweisung zu verketten. Dies wird erreicht, indem jede Methode, die Teil der Kette sein soll, eine Referenz auf das aktuelle Objekt (`ME`) zurückgibt. In Kombination mit dem `NEW` Operator für die Inline-Instanziierung führt dies zu sehr flüssigem und lesbarem Code, der an funktionale Programmierstile erinnert.
keywords: Object Orientation, Method Chaining, NEW, Functional Programming

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Differenz in Sekunden zwischen zwei Zeitstempeln unter Verwendung der Klasse `cl_abap_tstmp`.

Instructions: Gruppieren Sie Flugdatensätze aus `sflights` nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und Flugnummer (`connid`) und zählen Sie die Anzahl der Flüge pro Gruppe. Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`.
hint: Nutzen Sie die `GROUP BY` Klausel im `LOOP AT` Statement, um Daten zu aggregieren und zu gruppieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_itab_group_by DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_group,
             carrid    TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid    TYPE sflights-connid,
             flight_count TYPE i,
           END OF ty_flight_group.
    TYPES: tt_flight_groups TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_group WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS group_flights_by_carrier_connid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flight_groups) TYPE tt_flight_groups.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_group_by IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD group_flights_by_carrier_connid.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
      FROM sflights
      UP TO 100 ROWS " Limit for example
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_all_flights).

    LOOP AT lt_all_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight)
         GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                    connid = ls_flight-connid
                    group_key = GROUP ) " group_key is mandatory for group loop
         INTO DATA(ls_group).

      APPEND VALUE ty_flight_group(
        carrid = ls_group-carrid
        connid = ls_group-connid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
      ) TO rt_flight_groups.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_group_flights FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_group_flights_empty FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_group_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    DATA(lv_carrid) = 'AZ'.
    DATA(lv_connid1) = '0001'.
    DATA(lv_connid2) = '0002'.
    DATA(lv_fldate1) = sy-datum.
    DATA(lv_fldate2) = sy-datum + 1.

    " Ensure test data exists
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid1 fldate = lv_fldate1 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid1 fldate = lv_fldate2 ) ).
    INSERT sflights FROM @( VALUE sflights( carrid = lv_carrid connid = lv_connid2 fldate = lv_fldate1 ) ).
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_groups) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier_connid( ).

    DATA(lv_count_0001) = 0.
    DATA(lv_count_0002) = 0.

    LOOP AT lt_groups INTO DATA(ls_group).
      IF ls_group-carrid = lv_carrid AND ls_group-connid = lv_connid1.
        lv_count_0001 = ls_group-flight_count.
      ELSEIF ls_group-carrid = lv_carrid AND ls_group-connid = lv_connid2.
        lv_count_0002 = ls_group-flight_count.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_0001 exp = 2 msg = 'Group 0001 should have 2 flights' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_count_0002 exp = 1 msg = 'Group 0002 should have 1 flight' ).

    " Clean up
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = lv_carrid.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_group_flights_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_itab_group_by( ).
    " Ensure no flights for a specific carrier
    DELETE FROM sflights WHERE carrid = 'XY'.
    COMMIT WORK.

    DATA(lt_groups) = lo_cut->group_flights_by_carrier_connid( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial(
      act = lines( lt_groups )
      msg = 'Should return an empty table if no flights are found'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` Syntax ist ein leistungsstarkes Feature, um interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Es ermöglicht die Definition von Gruppierungsschlüsseln und den Zugriff auf Gruppeninformationen wie `GROUP SIZE`, was zu sehr effizientem und lesbarem Code für komplexe Datenanalysen führt.
keywords: Internal Tables, GROUP BY, LOOP AT, Aggregation

CLASS zcl_ci_query_ci_attrs DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

CLASS zcl_ci_query_ci_attrs IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_ci_check_attributes.

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, indem Sie eine bestehende Tabelle filtern und gleichzeitig die Struktur der Zeilen transformieren. Verwenden Sie `FOR ... IN ... WHERE` und `VALUE`.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_where_value DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_original_flight,
             carrid TYPE sflights-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflights-connid,
             fldate TYPE sflights-fldate,
             price  TYPE sflights-price,
           END OF ty_original_flight.
    TYPES: tt_original_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_original_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_simplified_flight,
             carrier_id TYPE sflights-carrid,
             flight_num TYPE sflights-connid,
             display_price TYPE string,
           END OF ty_simplified_flight.
    TYPES: tt_simplified_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_simplified_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_simplified_expensive_flights
      IMPORTING
        it_all_flights TYPE tt_original_flights
        iv_min_price   TYPE sflights-price
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_simplified_flights) TYPE tt_simplified_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_itab_for_where_value IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_simplified_expensive_flights.
    rt_simplified_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_all_flights
                                     WHERE ( price > iv_min_price )
                                     ( carrier_id = ls_flight-carrid,
                                       flight_num = ls_flight-connid,
                                       display_price = |{ ls_flight-price } EUR| ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Generieren Sie eine interne Tabelle mit den ersten 5 Arbeitstagen (Montag-Freitag) des nächsten Monats und formatieren Sie diese für die `cl_gui_calendar` Methode `SET_SPECIAL_DATES`.
hint: Nutzen Sie `FOR` Schleifen und `cl_abap_date_helper` zur Datumsberechnung. Die Struktur für `SET_SPECIAL_DATES` ist `CAL_SPECIAL_DATE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_calendar_special_dates DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_cal_special_date,
        date TYPE sy-datum,
        color TYPE i,
        text TYPE string,
      END OF ty_cal_special_date,
      tt_cal_special_date TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_cal_special_date WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_next_month_workdays
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_special_dates) TYPE tt_cal_special_date.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_calendar_special_dates IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_next_month_workdays.
    DATA(lv_next_month_first_day) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_first_day_of_month(
                                      iv_date = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_next_month( sy-datum ) ).
    DATA(lv_current_date) = lv_next_month_first_day.
    DATA(lv_workdays_count) = 0.

    rt_special_dates = VALUE #(
      FOR i = 1 THEN i + 1 WHILE lv_workdays_count < 5
      LET
        lv_weekday = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( lv_current_date )
      IN
        ( COND #(
            WHEN lv_weekday BETWEEN 1 AND 5 THEN
              ( LET lv_workdays_count = lv_workdays_count + 1 IN
                VALUE ty_cal_special_date( date = lv_current_date color = 6 text = |Workday { lv_workdays_count }| ) )
            ELSE
              THROW cx_abap_dummy( ) ) " Skip non-workdays
      )
      ( lv_current_date = lv_current_date + 1 ) " Increment date for next iteration
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_next_month_workdays FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_next_month_workdays.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_calendar_special_dates( ).
    DATA(lt_special_dates) = lo_cut->get_next_month_workdays( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_special_dates )
      exp = 5
      msg = 'Should return exactly 5 special dates (workdays).'
    ).

    " Verify dates are in the next month and are weekdays
    DATA(lv_next_month) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_next_month( sy-datum ).
    LOOP AT lt_special_dates INTO DATA(ls_date).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_month( ls_date-date )
        exp = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_month( lv_next_month )
        msg = 'Date should be in the next month.'
      ).
      DATA(lv_weekday) = cl_abap_date_helper=>get_weekday( ls_date-date ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = lv_weekday BETWEEN 1 AND 5
        msg = 'Date should be a weekday.'
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt eine `FOR`-Expression, um eine interne Tabelle dynamisch zu füllen. Die `WHILE`-Bedingung und die `LET`-Expression innerhalb der `FOR`-Schleife ermöglichen eine kompakte Generierung von Daten. `COND #(...)` wird verwendet, um nur Arbeitstage zu berücksichtigen, und `THROW cx_abap_dummy` dient dazu, Nicht-Arbeitstage zu überspringen, ohne die Schleife zu unterbrechen. `cl_abap_date_helper` bietet moderne Funktionen zur Datumsmanipulation. String Templates (`|...|`) werden für die Textgenerierung verwendet.
keywords: LOOP AT, FOR, VALUE, COND, LET, Date/Time, Internal Tables, cl_abap_date_helper, String Templates

Instructions: Lesen Sie alle Flüge aus der Tabelle `sflights` und gruppieren Sie diese nach Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`). Ermitteln Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die Anzahl der Flüge und den Gesamtpreis aller Flüge.
hint: Verwenden Sie `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY` mit `REDUCE` für die Aggregation.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_grouping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        flight_count TYPE i,
        total_price TYPE s_price,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summary
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_grouping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summary.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    rt_summary = VALUE #(
      FOR GROUPS OF ls_flight IN lt_sflights GROUP BY ( carrid = ls_flight-carrid )
      (
        carrid = ls_flight-carrid
        flight_count = GROUP SIZE
        total_price = REDUCE s_price( INIT sum_price = 0
                                      FOR ls_member IN GROUP ls_flight
                                      NEXT sum_price = sum_price + ls_member-price )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_flight_summary FOR TESTING.
    METHODS get_expected_summary RETURNING VALUE(rt_summary) TYPE zcl_flight_grouping=>tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_expected_summary.
    SELECT carrid, price
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_sflights).

    DATA(lt_grouped_data) = VALUE HASHED TABLE OF zcl_flight_grouping=>ty_flight_summary
                            WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      READ TABLE lt_grouped_data INTO DATA(ls_grouped_entry) WITH KEY carrid = ls_flight-carrid.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        ls_grouped_entry-flight_count = ls_grouped_entry-flight_count + 1.
        ls_grouped_entry-total_price = ls_grouped_entry-total_price + ls_flight-price.
        MODIFY TABLE lt_grouped_data FROM ls_grouped_entry.
      ELSE.
        ls_grouped_entry = VALUE #( carrid = ls_flight-carrid
                                    flight_count = 1
                                    total_price = ls_flight-price ).
        INSERT ls_grouped_entry INTO TABLE lt_grouped_data.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    SORT lt_grouped_data BY carrid.
    rt_summary = CORRESPONDING #(
      SOURCE lt_grouped_data
      MAPPING
        carrid = carrid
        flight_count = flight_count
        total_price = total_price
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_flight_summary.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_grouping( ).
    DATA(lt_actual_summary) = lo_cut->get_flight_summary( ).

    DATA(lt_expected_summary) = get_expected_summary( ).

    SORT lt_actual_summary BY carrid.
    SORT lt_expected_summary BY carrid.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_actual_summary )
      exp = lines( lt_expected_summary )
      msg = 'Number of grouped entries should match.'
    ).

    LOOP AT lt_actual_summary INTO DATA(ls_actual).
      READ TABLE lt_expected_summary INTO DATA(ls_expected) WITH KEY carrid = ls_actual-carrid.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_actual-flight_count
        exp = ls_expected-flight_count
        msg = |Flight count for { ls_actual-carrid } should match.|
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
        act = ls_actual-total_price
        exp = ls_expected-total_price
        msg = |Total price for { ls_actual-carrid } should match.|
      ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke `LOOP AT ... GROUP BY`-Syntax, die es ermöglicht, interne Tabellen direkt zu gruppieren und Aggregationen durchzuführen. Innerhalb der Gruppen wird `REDUCE` verwendet, um den Gesamtpreis zu summieren, was eine sehr kompakte und funktionale Art der Datenverarbeitung darstellt. `GROUP SIZE` liefert die Anzahl der Elemente in der aktuellen Gruppe. Die `SELECT`-Anweisung nutzt die moderne Inline-Deklaration `@DATA(...)`.
keywords: LOOP AT GROUP BY, REDUCE, Internal Tables, Aggregation, sflights, SELECT, Inline Declaration

CLASS zcl_flight_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.

        cityto   TYPE s_to_city,
      END OF ty_flight,
      tt_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_filtered_flights

CLASS zcl_flight_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    SELECT carrid, connid, fldate, cityfrom, cityto

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Sitzplatzkapazität (`seatsmax`) aller Flüge in der Tabelle `sflights` für eine bestimmte Fluggesellschaft.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE` mit einer `FOR` Schleife über die gefilterten Flüge.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_capacity DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_total_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE s_carr_id
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_total_capacity) TYPE i.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_capacity IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_total_capacity.
    SELECT carrid, seatsmax
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @iv_carrid
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rv_total_capacity = REDUCE i(
      INIT total = 0
      FOR ls_flight IN lt_flights
      NEXT total = total + ls_flight-seatsmax
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      FROM sflights

      INTO @DATA(lv_expected_capacity_1).

Instructions: Finden Sie einen bestimmten Flug in `sflights` anhand der Fluggesellschaft (`carrid`) und der Flugnummer (`connid`) und geben Sie dessen Abflugort (`cityfrom`) zurück. Wenn der Flug nicht gefunden wird, geben Sie einen leeren String zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine Tabellenexpression mit `OPTIONAL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_flight_lookup DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_key,
        carrid TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid TYPE s_conn_id,
      END OF ty_flight_key,
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
        carrid   TYPE s_carr_id,
        connid   TYPE s_conn_id,
        cityfrom TYPE s_from_cit,
      END OF ty_flight_data,
      tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_city_from
      IMPORTING
        is_flight_key TYPE ty_flight_key
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_city_from) TYPE s_from_cit.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_flight_lookup IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_city_from.
    SELECT carrid, connid, cityfrom
      FROM sflights
      INTO TABLE @DATA(lt_flights).

    rv_city_from = VALUE #(
      lt_flights[ OPTIONAL
                  carrid = is_flight_key-carrid
                  connid = is_flight_key-connid ]-cityfrom
      DEFAULT ''
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_get_city_from FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_get_city_from.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_flight_lookup( ).
    DATA(ls_test_key) = VALUE zcl_flight_lookup=>ty_flight_key(
      carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' ).

    " Test case 1: Existing flight
    DATA(lv_actual_city) = lo_cut->get_city_from( ls_test_key ).

    SELECT SINGLE cityfrom
      FROM sflights
      WHERE carrid = @ls_test_key-carrid AND connid = @ls_test_key-connid
      INTO @DATA(lv_expected_city).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_city
      exp = lv_expected_city
      msg = 'City from should match for existing flight.'
    ).

    " Test case 2: Non-existing flight
    ls_test_key = VALUE zcl_flight_lookup=>ty_flight_key(
      carrid = 'XX' connid = '9999' ).
    lv_actual_city = lo_cut->get_city_from( ls_test_key ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_city
      exp = ''
      msg = 'City from should be empty for non-existing flight.'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Tabellenexpressionen (`itab[ key ]`) bieten einen direkten und prägnanten Zugriff auf Zeilen einer internen Tabelle. Die Ergänzung `OPTIONAL` verhindert einen Laufzeitfehler, wenn der Schlüssel nicht gefunden wird, und ermöglicht die Definition eines `DEFAULT`-Wertes. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und sichere Art, auf Tabellenzeilen zuzugreifen, ohne explizite `READ TABLE` Anweisungen und `sy-subrc` Prüfungen.
keywords: LOOP AT, Table Expression, OPTIONAL, DEFAULT, Internal Tables, sflights, Inline Declaration
