Instructions: Berechne den SHA256-Hashwert eines gegebenen Strings.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_abap_message_digest` mit dem Algorithmus `SHA256`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_sha256_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_sha256
      IMPORTING
        iv_input_string TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sha256_hash) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sha256_calculator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha256.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_hash) = lo_digest->calculate_hash_for_string( iv_input_string ).
    rv_sha256_hash = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_xstring_hash ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sha256_calculation FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sha256_calculation.
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_sha256_calculator( ).
    DATA(lv_input) = 'Hello World'.
    DATA(lo_digest_calc) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_hash) = lo_digest_calc->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_input ).
    DATA(lv_expected_hash) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_xstring_hash ).

    DATA(lv_actual_hash) = lo_calculator->calculate_sha256( lv_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_hash,
      exp = lv_expected_hash,
      msg = 'SHA256 hash should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Klasse `cl_abap_message_digest` bietet eine einfache und sichere Möglichkeit, kryptografische Hashwerte zu berechnen. Die Methode `create` instanziiert die Klasse mit dem gewünschten Algorithmus, und `calculate_hash_for_string` berechnet den Hashwert für einen String. Die Konvertierung von XSTRING zu STRING erfolgt über `cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce`.
keywords: HASH, SHA256, SECURITY, CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST, STRING

Instructions: Berechne einen SHA256-Hashwert über den gesamten Inhalt einer internen Tabelle von Strings.
hint: Verwenden Sie `REDUCE`, um die Strings zu konkatenieren, und dann `cl_abap_message_digest`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_table_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS calculate_table_sha256
      IMPORTING
        it_input_table TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_sha256_hash) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_table_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_table_sha256.
    DATA(lv_concatenated_string) = REDUCE string(
      INIT s = ``
      FOR <fs> IN it_input_table
      NEXT s = s && <fs>
    ).

    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_hash) = lo_digest->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_concatenated_string ).
    rv_sha256_hash = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_xstring_hash ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_table_sha256 FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_table_sha256.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = NEW zcl_table_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'Line 1' ) ( 'Line 2' ) ( 'Line 3' ) ).
    DATA(lv_test_string) = 'Line 1Line 2Line 3'.
    DATA(lo_digest_calc) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha256 ).
    DATA(lv_xstring_hash) = lo_digest_calc->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_test_string ).
    DATA(lv_expected_sha256) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_xstring_hash ).

    DATA(lv_actual_hash) = lo_hasher->calculate_table_sha256( lt_input ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_actual_hash,
      exp = lv_expected_sha256,
      msg = 'SHA256 hash of internal table should match'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `REDUCE`-Anweisung ist ein leistungsstarkes funktionales Programmierkonstrukt in ABAP 7.40+, das hier verwendet wird, um alle Strings der internen Tabelle effizient zu einem einzigen String zu konkatenieren. Dieser konkatenierte String wird dann gehasht. Dies ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, Aggregationen durchzuführen.
keywords: HASH, SHA256, REDUCE, INTERNAL TABLES, FUNCTIONAL PROGRAMMING, CL_ABAP_MESSAGE_DIGEST

Instructions: Vergleiche zwei gegebene Hashwerte und gib zurück, ob sie übereinstimmen.
hint: Ein einfacher String-Vergleich ist ausreichend, da die Hashwerte bereits als Strings vorliegen. Verwenden Sie `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_hash_comparator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_hashes
      IMPORTING
        iv_hash1 TYPE string
        iv_hash2 TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_comparator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_hashes.
    rv_are_equal = COND abap_bool( WHEN iv_hash1 = iv_hash2 THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Filtern Sie alle aktiven Enterprise Search (ESH) Konnektoren aus einer Liste von Konnektoren.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_esh_ca_check` und die `FILTER`-Anweisung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_active_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connector_status,
             connector_id TYPE string,
             status_code  TYPE cl_esh_ca_check=>ty_status_code,
             status_text  TYPE cl_esh_ca_check=>ty_status_text,
           END OF ty_connector_status.
    TYPES: tt_connector_status TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connector_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_active_connectors
      IMPORTING
        it_connector_ids TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_active_connectors) TYPE tt_connector_status
      RAISING
        cx_esh_ca_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_active_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_active_connectors.
    DATA(lo_cache_checker) = cl_esh_ca_check=>create( ).
    DATA lt_all_statuses TYPE tt_connector_status.

    LOOP AT it_connector_ids INTO DATA(lv_connector_id).
      TRY.
          DATA(ls_status) = lo_cache_checker->get_cache_status( lv_connector_id ).
          APPEND VALUE ty_connector_status(
            connector_id = lv_connector_id
            status_code  = ls_status-status_code
            status_text  = ls_status-status_text
          ) TO lt_all_statuses.
        CATCH cx_esh_ca_error.
          " Ignore connectors that cause an error for this example
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_active_connectors = FILTER #( lt_all_statuses WHERE status_code = cl_esh_ca_check=>status_active ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Überprüfen Sie den Cache-Status einer dynamisch übergebenen Liste von ESH-Konnektoren und geben Sie eine Zusammenfassung zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `FOR` und `COND` für die Zusammenfassung der Status.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_dynamic_check DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_connector_result,
             connector_id TYPE string,
             status_text  TYPE string,
             is_active    TYPE abap_bool,
           END OF ty_connector_result.
    TYPES: tt_connector_results TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_connector_result WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS check_dynamic_connectors
      IMPORTING
        it_connector_ids TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_results) TYPE tt_connector_results.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_dynamic_check IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD check_dynamic_connectors.
    DATA(lo_cache_checker) = cl_esh_ca_check=>create( ).

    rt_results = VALUE tt_connector_results(
      FOR lv_conn_id IN it_connector_ids
      LET ls_status = VALUE cl_esh_ca_check=>ty_cache_status( )
          lv_error_text = '' IN
      (
        TRY.
            ls_status = lo_cache_checker->get_cache_status( lv_conn_id ).
          CATCH cx_esh_ca_error INTO DATA(lx_esh_error).
            lv_error_text = lx_esh_error->get_text( ).
        ENDTRY.
        connector_id = lv_conn_id,
        status_text  = COND string( WHEN lv_error_text IS NOT INITIAL THEN lv_error_text ELSE ls_status-status_text ),
        is_active    = COND abap_bool( WHEN ls_status-status_code = cl_esh_ca_check=>status_active THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_check FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_mixed_connectors FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_check.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_esh_dynamic_check( ).
    DATA(lt_connectors) = VALUE string_table( ( 'DUMMY_CONNECTOR_ACTIVE' ) ( 'DUMMY_CONNECTOR_INACTIVE' ) ).

    " Mocking cl_esh_ca_check for isolated testing is recommended.
    " Assume 'DUMMY_CONNECTOR_ACTIVE' is active, 'DUMMY_CONNECTOR_INACTIVE' is inactive.
    DATA(lt_results) = lo_checker->check_dynamic_connectors( lt_connectors ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_results ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Should return results for all input connectors'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_results INTO DATA(ls_active_result) WITH KEY connector_id = 'DUMMY_CONNECTOR_ACTIVE'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
        act = ls_active_result-is_active,
        msg = 'DUMMY_CONNECTOR_ACTIVE should be active'
      ).
    ENDIF.

    READ TABLE lt_results INTO DATA(ls_inactive_result) WITH KEY connector_id = 'DUMMY_CONNECTOR_INACTIVE'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
        act = ls_inactive_result-is_active,
        msg = 'DUMMY_CONNECTOR_INACTIVE should be inactive'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_mixed_connectors.
    DATA(lo_checker) = NEW zcl_esh_dynamic_check( ).
    DATA(lt_connectors) = VALUE string_table( ( 'DUMMY_CONNECTOR_ACTIVE' ) ( 'NON_EXISTENT_CONNECTOR' ) ).

    DATA(lt_results) = lo_checker->check_dynamic_connectors( lt_connectors ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_results ),
      exp = 2,
      msg = 'Should return results for all input connectors, including errors'
    ).

    READ TABLE lt_results INTO DATA(ls_error_result) WITH KEY connector_id = 'NON_EXISTENT_CONNECTOR'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial(
        act = find( val = ls_error_result-status_text sub = 'Error' ),
        msg = 'Status text for non-existent connector should indicate an error'
      ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false(
        act = ls_error_result-is_active,
        msg = 'Non-existent connector should not be active'
      ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel kombiniert mehrere moderne ABAP-Features: `FOR` zur Iteration und Transformation, `LET` zur Definition lokaler Variablen innerhalb des Ausdrucks, `TRY...CATCH` zur Inline-Fehlerbehandlung und `COND` zur bedingten Zuweisung von Werten. Dies führt zu einer sehr kompakten und ausdrucksstarken Lösung für die dynamische Verarbeitung von ESH-Konnektoren.
keywords: ESH, CACHE, DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING, FOR, LET, COND, TRY CATCH, CL_ESH_CA_CHECK

Instructions: Berechne den SHA1-Hashwert einer Liste von Strings und gib die Hashes in einer internen Tabelle zurück.

CLASS zcl_sha1_list_hasher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_hashed_string,
             original_string TYPE string,
             sha1_hash       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_hashed_string.
    TYPES: tt_hashed_strings TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_hashed_string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS calculate_sha1_for_list
      IMPORTING
        it_input_strings TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_hashed_list) TYPE tt_hashed_strings.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sha1_list_hasher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD calculate_sha1_for_list.
    DATA(lo_digest) = cl_abap_message_digest=>create( cl_abap_message_digest=>alg_sha1 ).

    rt_hashed_list = VALUE tt_hashed_strings(
      FOR lv_string IN it_input_strings
      LET lv_xstring_hash = lo_digest->calculate_hash_for_string( lv_string ) IN
      ( original_string = lv_string,
        sha1_hash       = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_xstring_hash ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sha1_list_calculation.
    DATA(lo_hasher) = NEW zcl_sha1_list_hasher( ).
    DATA(lt_input) = VALUE string_table( ( 'String One' ) ( 'String Two' ) ( ' ' ) ).

CLASS zcl_hash_factory DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS create_hash_generator
      IMPORTING
        iv_algorithm_name TYPE string " e.g., 'SHA256', 'MD5'
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_generator) TYPE REF TO zif_hash_generator
      RAISING
        cx_abap_message_digest_error.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_hash_factory IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_hash_generator.
    ro_generator = SWITCH #( iv_algorithm_name
      WHEN 'SHA256' THEN NEW zcl_sha256_generator( )
      WHEN 'MD5'    THEN NEW zcl_md5_generator( )
      ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_message_digest_error
             EXPORTING
               textid = cx_abap_message_digest_error=>invalid_algorithm
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie alle ESH-Konnektoren, die sich in einem Fehlerstatus befinden, und geben Sie deren IDs zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `cl_esh_ca_check` und `FILTER` mit der Statusprüfung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_esh_error_connectors DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_error_connectors
      IMPORTING
        it_all_connector_ids TYPE string_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_error_connector_ids) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_esh_error_connectors IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_connectors.
    DATA(lo_cache_checker) = cl_esh_ca_check=>create( ).
    DATA lt_all_statuses TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF cl_esh_ca_check=>ty_cache_status WITH EMPTY KEY.

    LOOP AT it_all_connector_ids INTO DATA(lv_connector_id).
      TRY.
          DATA(ls_status) = lo_cache_checker->get_cache_status( lv_connector_id ).
          APPEND ls_status TO lt_all_statuses.
        CATCH cx_esh_ca_error.
          " If get_cache_status raises an error, consider it an error status for this example
          APPEND VALUE cl_esh_ca_check=>ty_cache_status(
            connector_id = lv_connector_id
            status_code  = cl_esh_ca_check=>status_error
            status_text  = 'Error during status retrieval'
          ) TO lt_all_statuses.
      ENDTRY.
    ENDLOOP.

    rt_error_connector_ids = VALUE string_table(
      FOR ls_status IN FILTER #( lt_all_statuses WHERE status_code = cl_esh_ca_check=>status_error )
      ( ls_status-connector_id )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Mocking cl_esh_ca_check is crucial here to simulate error statuses.
    " For this test, we assume 'ERROR_CONN' and 'ANOTHER_ERROR_CONN' will result in error status.
    DATA(lt_actual_error_ids) = lo_finder->get_error_connectors( lt_test_connectors ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

      msg = 'ERROR_CONN should be in the list'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(

explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die `FILTER`-Anweisung (ABAP 7.40+) in Kombination mit einer `FOR`-Schleife und `TRY...CATCH` zur robusten Ermittlung von ESH-Konnektoren in einem Fehlerstatus. Die `VALUE`-Anweisung mit `FOR` projiziert dann nur die IDs der fehlerhaften Konnektoren.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Datenbank-Cursor für die Tabelle `SFLIGHT`, lesen Sie die ersten 5 Zeilen und schließen Sie den Cursor. Geben Sie die gelesenen Zeilen zurück.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` und `CLOSE CURSOR`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_cursor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
           END OF ty_sflight.
    TYPES tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_first_n_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_count TYPE i DEFAULT 5
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_db.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_cursor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_first_n_flights.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid, fldate
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY carrid, connid, fldate.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_db
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Failed to open cursor'.
    ENDIF.

    DO iv_count TIMES.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
      ELSE.
        EXIT. " No more rows or error
      ENDIF.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    lt_flights = lo_cut->get_first_n_flights( 10 ).

      act = ( lines( lt_flights ) <= 10 AND lines( lt_flights ) > 0 )

Dies ist effizient für sehr große Tabellen. Moderne ABAP-Syntax wie Inline-Deklarationen und `TRY...CATCH` für Fehlerbehandlung wird verwendet.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` in Paketen von 3 Zeilen, aber nur die ersten 10 Zeilen insgesamt. Sammeln Sie alle gelesenen Zeilen in einer internen Tabelle.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit `PACKAGE SIZE` und einer Schleifenbedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_package DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_total_count TYPE i DEFAULT 10
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 3
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_db.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_package IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key.
    DATA: lv_fetched_count TYPE i VALUE 0.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY carrid, connid.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_db
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Failed to open cursor'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package_flights PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT. " No more rows or error
      ENDIF.

      LOOP AT lt_package_flights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
        IF lv_fetched_count < iv_total_count.
          APPEND ls_flight TO rt_all_flights.
          lv_fetched_count = lv_fetched_count + 1.
        ELSE.
          EXIT. " Reached total count
        ENDIF.
      ENDLOOP.

      IF lv_fetched_count >= iv_total_count.
        EXIT. " Reached total count
      ENDIF.

    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einer internen Tabelle den Wert des Feldes `currency` auf 'EUR' für alle Einträge, bei denen `carrid` 'LH' ist.
hint: Nutzen Sie den `FOR` Operator mit `VALUE` und `COND`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_replace_for DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_flight_data.
    TYPES tt_flight_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS update_currency_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_data
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_new_curr TYPE sflight-currency
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flight_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_replace_for IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_currency_for_carrier.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrier
                                            THEN VALUE ty_flight_data( ls_flight EXCEPT currency )
                                                     currency = iv_new_curr
                                            ELSE ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' currency = 'USD' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' currency = 'GBP' )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_replace_for( ).
    DATA(lt_updated_flights) = lo_cut->update_currency_for_carrier(
      it_flights = lt_initial_flights
      iv_carrier = 'LH'
      iv_new_curr = 'EUR' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_updated_flights[ 1 ]-currency
      exp = 'EUR'
      msg = 'LH 0400 currency should be EUR' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_updated_flights[ 2 ]-currency
      exp = 'USD'
      msg = 'AA 0017 currency should remain USD' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_updated_flights[ 3 ]-currency
      exp = 'EUR'
      msg = 'LH 0017 currency should be EUR' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Dies ist eine sehr moderne und funktionale Art, Daten in internen Tabellen zu manipulieren, die zu kürzerem und lesbarerem Code führt als traditionelle `LOOP`-Anweisungen mit `MODIFY`.

Instructions: Aktualisieren Sie Felder einer internen Tabelle mit Werten aus einer anderen Struktur, wobei nur übereinstimmende Feldnamen berücksichtigt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie `REPLACE CORRESPONDING`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_replace_corr DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             planetype TYPE sflight-planetype,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_detail.
    TYPES tt_flight_detail TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY.

    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_update_data,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
             new_field TYPE string, " Additional field not in target
           END OF ty_update_data.

    METHODS update_flight_occupancy
      IMPORTING
        it_original_flights TYPE tt_flight_detail
        it_update_data      TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_update_data WITH EMPTY KEY
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flight_detail.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_replace_corr IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD update_flight_occupancy.
    rt_updated_flights = it_original_flights.

    LOOP AT it_update_data INTO DATA(ls_update).
      " Find the line to update
      READ TABLE rt_updated_flights WITH KEY carrid = ls_update-carrid
                                        connid = ls_update-connid
                                        INTO DATA(ls_target_line).
      IF sy-subrc = 0.
        " Replace corresponding fields
        REPLACE CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF ls_target_line FROM ls_update.
        MODIFY TABLE rt_updated_flights FROM ls_target_line INDEX sy-tabix.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_replace_corresponding FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    DATA(lt_original) = VALUE zcl_it_replace_corr=>tt_flight_detail(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250101' planetype = 'A320' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250102' planetype = 'B747' seatsocc = 250 )
    ).

    DATA(lt_update) = VALUE STANDARD TABLE OF zcl_it_replace_corr=>ty_update_data WITH EMPTY KEY(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 120 new_field = 'Test' )
      ( carrid = 'BA' connid = '5000' seatsocc = 50  new_field = 'New' ) " Non-existent
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_replace_corr( ).
    DATA(lt_updated) = lo_cut->update_flight_occupancy(
      it_original_flights = lt_original
      it_update_data      = lt_update ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 120
      msg = 'Seats occupied for LH 0400 should be updated' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      msg = 'Planetype for LH 0400 should remain unchanged' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      msg = 'Table size should remain 2' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie mehrere verschiedene Teilstrings in einem Text in einer einzigen funktionalen Operation. Ersetzen Sie 'A' durch 'X' und 'B' durch 'Y'.
hint: Verwenden Sie den `REDUCE` Operator mit `REPLACE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_reduce DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_replace_map,
             old_sub TYPE string,
             new_sub TYPE string,
           END OF ty_replace_map.
    TYPES tt_replace_map TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_replace_map WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS replace_multiple
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
        it_repl_map TYPE tt_replace_map
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_reduce IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_multiple.
    rv_result = REDUCE string( INIT s = iv_text
                                FOR ls_map IN it_repl_map
                                  NEXT s = REPLACE( val = s
                                                    occ = 0
                                                    sub = ls_map-old_sub
                                                    with = ls_map-new_sub ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    DATA(lt_repl_map) = VALUE zcl_str_replace_reduce=>tt_replace_map(
      ( old_sub = 'A' new_sub = 'X' )
      ( old_sub = 'B' new_sub = 'Y' )
      ( old_sub = 'C' new_sub = 'Z' )

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->replace_multiple(
      iv_text = 'ABCABC'

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lv_result
      exp = 'Hello World'
      msg = 'Should not replace if no matches' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

In diesem Beispiel wird er verwendet, um eine Kette von `REPLACE`-Operationen auf einen String anzuwenden, was zu einem sehr kompakten und ausdrucksstarken Code führt, der mehrere Ersetzungen in einem Schritt durchführt.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine `FETCH NEXT` Operation durch und behandeln Sie mögliche Datenbankfehler, z.B. wenn der Cursor nicht geöffnet werden kann.
hint: Verwenden Sie `TRY...CATCH` für `CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_error_handling DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_with_error_handling
      IMPORTING
        iv_invalid_table TYPE abap_bool DEFAULT abap_false
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_db.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_error_handling IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_with_error_handling.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    DATA: lv_table_name TYPE string.

    IF iv_invalid_table = abap_true.
      lv_table_name = 'INVALID_TABLE_NAME'.
    ELSE.
      lv_table_name = 'SFLIGHT'.
    ENDIF.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          (lv_table_name) SELECT carrid, connid FROM (lv_table_name) ORDER BY carrid, connid.

        DO 1 TIMES. " Try to fetch one row
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        " Log error or handle it appropriately
        MESSAGE lx_db_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_open_sql_db.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fetch_success FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
    METHODS test_fetch_error FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fetch_success.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_fetch_error_handling( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->fetch_with_error_handling( iv_invalid_table = abap_false ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 )
      msg = 'Should fetch at least one flight successfully' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_fetch_error.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_fetch_error_handling( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_raises(
      act = NEW cx_sy_open_sql_db( )
      exp_class = 'CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB'
      act_code = lo_cut->fetch_with_error_handling( iv_invalid_table = abap_true )
      msg = 'Should raise CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB for invalid table' ).

ENDCLASS.

Dieses Beispiel zeigt, wie `CX_SY_OPEN_SQL_DB` abgefangen werden kann, um Fehler beim Öffnen eines Cursors oder beim `FETCH NEXT` zu behandeln. Die dynamische Angabe des Tabellennamens demonstriert zudem Flexibilität.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie einen Teilstring nur, wenn eine bestimmte Bedingung erfüllt ist. Ersetzen Sie 'ERROR' durch 'WARNING', aber nur, wenn der String auch 'CRITICAL' enthält.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `REPLACE` mit dem `COND` Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_str_replace_cond DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_conditionally
      IMPORTING
        iv_text     TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_str_replace_cond IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_conditionally.
    rv_result = COND string(
      WHEN iv_text CS 'CRITICAL'
      THEN REPLACE( val = iv_text occ = 0 sub = 'ERROR' with = 'WARNING' )
      ELSE iv_text
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

Instructions: Öffnen Sie einen Cursor und lesen Sie Daten, wobei die `WHERE`-Klausel dynamisch zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Lesen Sie die ersten 2 Zeilen aus `SFLIGHT` mit einer dynamischen `WHERE`-Klausel für `CARRID`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR WITH SOURCE` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` mit dynamischem SQL.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS fetch_dynamic_where
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_db.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD fetch_dynamic_where.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: ls_sflight TYPE ty_sflight_key.
    DATA: lv_dynamic_where TYPE string.

    lv_dynamic_where = |CARRID = '{ iv_carrier }'|.

    TRY.
        OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
          SELECT carrid, connid
            FROM sflight
            WHERE (lv_dynamic_where)
            ORDER BY carrid, connid.

        DO 2 TIMES. " Fetch first 2 rows
          FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO ls_sflight.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            APPEND ls_sflight TO rt_flights.
          ELSE.
            EXIT.
          ENDIF.
        ENDDO.

        CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.

      CATCH cx_sy_open_sql_db INTO DATA(lx_db_error).
        MESSAGE lx_db_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E' RAISING cx_sy_open_sql_db.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fetch_dynamic_where.

    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->fetch_dynamic_where( 'LH' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(

      exp = 2

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_flights[ 1 ]-carrid
      exp = 'LH'
      msg = 'First flight should be for LH' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_fetch_dynamic_where_no_data.

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )

      msg = 'Should fetch 0 flights for non-existent carrier' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dynamisches SQL mit `OPEN CURSOR WITH SOURCE` und `WHERE (lv_dynamic_where)` ermöglicht es, die Abfragebedingungen zur Laufzeit flexibel anzupassen. Dies ist ein mächtiges Werkzeug für Szenarien, in denen die Filterkriterien nicht statisch im Code definiert werden können. String-Templates (`|...|`) werden für die einfache Konstruktion der dynamischen `WHERE`-Klausel verwendet.

Instructions: Ersetzen Sie in einer internen Tabelle nur die Zeilen, die einem bestimmten Filterkriterium entsprechen, durch neue Werte. Erhöhen Sie `seatsocc` um 10 für alle Flüge mit `carrid = 'LH'`.
hint: Kombinieren Sie `FILTER` mit `FOR` und `VALUE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_it_replace_filter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_flight_occupancy,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             seatsocc TYPE sflight-seatsocc,
           END OF ty_flight_occupancy.
    TYPES tt_flight_occupancy TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_occupancy WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS increase_occupancy_for_carrier
      IMPORTING
        it_flights TYPE tt_flight_occupancy
        iv_carrier TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_increase TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_updated_flights) TYPE tt_flight_occupancy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_it_replace_filter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD increase_occupancy_for_carrier.
    rt_updated_flights = VALUE #( FOR ls_flight IN it_flights
                                  ( COND #( WHEN ls_flight-carrid = iv_carrier
                                            THEN VALUE ty_flight_occupancy( ls_flight EXCEPT seatsocc )
                                                     seatsocc = ls_flight-seatsocc + iv_increase
                                            ELSE ls_flight ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_increase_occupancy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_increase_occupancy.
    DATA(lt_initial_flights) = VALUE zcl_it_replace_filter=>tt_flight_occupancy(
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' seatsocc = 100 )
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 200 )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0017' seatsocc = 150 )
    ).

    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_it_replace_filter( ).
    DATA(lt_updated_flights) = lo_cut->increase_occupancy_for_carrier(
      it_flights = lt_initial_flights
      iv_carrier = 'LH'
      iv_increase = 10 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_updated_flights[ 1 ]-seatsocc
      exp = 110
      msg = 'LH 0400 seatsocc should be 110' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_updated_flights[ 2 ]-seatsocc
      exp = 200
      msg = 'AA 0017 seatsocc should remain 200' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lt_updated_flights[ 3 ]-seatsocc
      exp = 160
      msg = 'LH 0017 seatsocc should be 160' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die leistungsstarke Kombination von `FOR`, `VALUE` und `COND` zur selektiven Transformation von internen Tabellen. Es ist eine moderne und funktionale Alternative zu traditionellen `LOOP`- und `MODIFY`-Anweisungen, die den Code erheblich vereinfacht und die Lesbarkeit verbessert, indem die Logik der Transformation direkt in der Zuweisung ausgedrückt wird.
keywords: REPLACE, FILTER, FOR, VALUE, Internal Tables, Functional Programming

CLASS zcl_str_replace_first DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS replace_first

        iv_text     TYPE string

        iv_new_sub  TYPE string

CLASS zcl_str_replace_first IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD replace_first.
    rv_result = iv_text.
    REPLACE FIRST OCCURRENCE OF SUBSTRING iv_old_sub IN rv_result WITH iv_new_sub.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Lesen Sie Daten aus der Tabelle `SFLIGHT` in Paketen und verwenden Sie `FETCH NEXT CURSOR` in einer `WHILE` Schleife, bis keine weiteren Daten verfügbar sind.
hint: Verwenden Sie `OPEN CURSOR`, `FETCH NEXT CURSOR INTO TABLE ... PACKAGE SIZE` und eine `WHILE` Schleife.
solution:
CLASS zcl_db_fetch_while DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight_key,
             carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid TYPE sflight-connid,
           END OF ty_sflight_key.
    TYPES tt_sflight_key TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight_key WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_all_flights_in_packages
      IMPORTING
        iv_package_size TYPE i DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_all_flights) TYPE tt_sflight_key
      RAISING
        cx_sy_open_sql_db.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_db_fetch_while IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_all_flights_in_packages.
    DATA: lv_cursor TYPE cursor.
    DATA: lt_package_flights TYPE tt_sflight_key.

    OPEN CURSOR WITH HOLD lv_cursor FOR
      SELECT carrid, connid
        FROM sflight
        ORDER BY carrid, connid.

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_sy_open_sql_db
        EXPORTING
          text = 'Failed to open cursor'.
    ENDIF.

    DO.
      FETCH NEXT CURSOR lv_cursor INTO TABLE lt_package_flights PACKAGE SIZE iv_package_size.
      IF sy-subrc <> 0.
        EXIT. " No more rows or error
      ENDIF.
      APPEND LINES OF lt_package_flights TO rt_all_flights.
    ENDDO.

    CLOSE CURSOR lv_cursor.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_fetch_all_in_packages FOR TESTING RAISING cx_static_check.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_fetch_all_in_packages.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_db_fetch_while( ).
    DATA(lt_flights) = lo_cut->get_all_flights_in_packages( 50 ).

    " Get total count from SFLIGHT directly for comparison
    SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sflight INTO DATA(lv_total_sflight_count).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals(
      act = lines( lt_flights )
      exp = lv_total_sflight_count
      msg = 'Should fetch all flights from SFLIGHT' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true(
      act = ( lines( lt_flights ) > 0 )
      msg = 'Should fetch more than 0 flights' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die vollständige Iteration über eine Datenbanktabelle mittels `OPEN CURSOR` und `FETCH NEXT CURSOR INTO TABLE ... PACKAGE SIZE` in einer `DO`-Schleife. Dies ist die Standardmethode, um sehr große Datensätze in verwaltbaren Paketen zu verarbeiten, bis alle Zeilen gelesen wurden, und ist effizient im Umgang mit Systemressourcen.
keywords: FETCH NEXT, OPEN CURSOR, PACKAGE SIZE, Database Access, Iteration, WHILE

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die für jeden Flug aus SFlight die Passagierkapazität und die Anzahl der freien Plätze berechnet. Nutzen Sie geschachtelte FOR-Ausdrücke mit GROUP BY.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR GROUPS-Ausdrücke mit VALUE und einem inneren REDUCE-Ausdruck, um die Daten zu aggregieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_for_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_summary,
        carrid     TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid     TYPE sflight-connid,
        total_capa TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
        free_seats TYPE i,
      END OF ty_flight_summary,
      tt_flight_summary TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_summary WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_flight_summaries
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_summaries) TYPE tt_flight_summary.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_for_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs> IN sflight ( <fs> ) ).

    rt_summaries = VALUE tt_flight_summary(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight BY flight-carrid, flight-connid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid, connid = flight-connid
      LET occupied_seats = REDUCE i( INIT s = 0
                                     FOR booking IN sbook WHERE ( carrid = flight-carrid AND connid = flight-connid )
                                     NEXT s = s + booking-passengers ) IN
      ( carrid     = flight-carrid,
        connid     = flight-connid,
        total_capa = flight-seatsmax,
        free_seats = flight-seatsmax - occupied_seats )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_flight_summaries FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_flight_summaries.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_for_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_summaries) = lo_cut->get_flight_summaries( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_summaries ) IS NOT INITIAL ).
    " Check a specific entry if possible, or just the structure
    READ TABLE lt_summaries INTO DATA(ls_summary) INDEX 1.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_summary-total_capa > 0 ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_summary-free_seats >= 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Verwendet einen äußeren FOR GROUPS-Ausdruck, um über Flüge zu iterieren und nach Fluggesellschaft und Flugnummer zu gruppieren. Ein innerer REDUCE-Ausdruck (innerhalb eines LET-Ausdrucks) aggregiert die belegten Sitze pro Flug. Dies demonstriert effiziente, deklarative Datenverarbeitung mit geschachtelten Ausdrücken und der GROUP BY-Funktionalität (ABAP 7.50+).
keywords: NESTING, FOR GROUPS, VALUE, REDUCE, Internal Tables, SFlight

Instructions: Bestimmen Sie den Status eines Auftrags basierend auf mehreren Bedingungen (z.B. 'Neu', 'In Bearbeitung', 'Abgeschlossen', 'Fehler'). Nutzen Sie geschachtelte COND-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie COND mit THEN und ELSE, wobei ELSE selbst ein weiterer COND-Ausdruck sein kann.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_cond_status DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_order_data,
        status_code TYPE c LENGTH 1,
        is_urgent   TYPE abap_bool,
        has_errors  TYPE abap_bool,
      END OF ty_order_data.

    METHODS get_order_display_status
      IMPORTING
        is_order TYPE ty_order_data
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_display_status) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_cond_status IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_order_display_status.
    rv_display_status = COND string(
      WHEN is_order-has_errors = abap_true THEN 'Fehlerhaft'
      WHEN is_order-status_code = 'A' THEN
        COND string(
          WHEN is_order-is_urgent = abap_true THEN 'Neu (Dringend)'
          ELSE 'Neu'
        )
      WHEN is_order-status_code = 'B' THEN 'In Bearbeitung'
      WHEN is_order-status_code = 'C' THEN 'Abgeschlossen'
      ELSE 'Unbekannt'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_order_status FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_order_status.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_cond_status( ).
    DATA: ls_order TYPE zcl_nested_cond_status=>ty_order_data.

    ls_order = VALUE #( status_code = 'A' is_urgent = abap_false has_errors = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_order_display_status( ls_order ) exp = 'Neu' ).

    ls_order = VALUE #( status_code = 'A' is_urgent = abap_true has_errors = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_order_display_status( ls_order ) exp = 'Neu (Dringend)' ).

    ls_order = VALUE #( status_code = 'B' is_urgent = abap_false has_errors = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_order_display_status( ls_order ) exp = 'In Bearbeitung' ).

    ls_order = VALUE #( status_code = 'C' is_urgent = abap_false has_errors = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_order_display_status( ls_order ) exp = 'Abgeschlossen' ).

    ls_order = VALUE #( status_code = 'X' is_urgent = abap_false has_errors = abap_false ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_order_display_status( ls_order ) exp = 'Unbekannt' ).

    ls_order = VALUE #( status_code = 'A' is_urgent = abap_true has_errors = abap_true ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_order_display_status( ls_order ) exp = 'Fehlerhaft' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der COND-Ausdruck ermöglicht die deklarative Zuweisung von Werten basierend auf Bedingungen. Durch das Schachteln von COND-Ausdrücken können komplexe Entscheidungsbäume elegant und lesbar abgebildet werden, ohne IF-ELSE-Blöcke.
keywords: NESTING, COND, Conditional Logic, Expressions

Instructions: Berechnen Sie die Summe der Passagierkapazitäten pro Fluggesellschaft aus der Tabelle SFlight, aber nur für Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten. Nutzen Sie geschachtelte REDUCE-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen äußeren FOR GROUPS-Ausdruck für die Aggregation pro Fluggesellschaft und einen inneren REDUCE-Ausdruck für die Bedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_reduce_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_capacity,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        total_capacity TYPE i,
      END OF ty_carrier_capacity,
      tt_carrier_capacity TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_capacity WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_capacities
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_capacities) TYPE tt_carrier_capacity.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_reduce_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_capacities.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs> IN sflight ( <fs> ) ).

    rt_capacities = VALUE tt_carrier_capacity(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        total_capacity = REDUCE i( INIT sum = 0
                                    FOR member IN GROUP flight
                                    WHERE ( member-seatsmax > iv_min_capacity )
                                    NEXT sum = sum + member-seatsmax ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_carrier_capacities FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_carrier_capacities.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_reduce_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_capacities) = lo_cut->get_carrier_capacities( iv_min_capacity = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_capacities ) IS NOT INITIAL ).
    " Example check: Assuming LH has flights with >200 capacity
    READ TABLE lt_capacities INTO DATA(ls_lh_capa) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_capa-total_capacity > 0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt die GROUP BY-Funktionalität in einem FOR-Ausdruck (ABAP 7.50+) in Kombination mit einem REDUCE-Ausdruck. Der äußere FOR gruppiert Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft, und der innere REDUCE aggregiert die Kapazitäten der Flüge innerhalb jeder Gruppe, die die Mindestkapazität überschreiten. Dies ist eine sehr leistungsstarke und deklarative Art der Datenaggregation.
keywords: NESTING, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, Internal Tables, SFlight, Aggregation

Instructions: Filtern Sie die Flüge aus SFlight, die von einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft durchgeführt werden und deren Flugnummern mit einer bestimmten Ziffer beginnen. Nutzen Sie geschachtelte FILTER-Ausdrücke.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen äußeren FILTER für die Fluggesellschaft und einen inneren FILTER für die Flugnummernbedingung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_filter_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_filtered_flights
      IMPORTING
        iv_carrid TYPE sflight-carrid
        iv_connid_prefix TYPE c LENGTH 1
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_filtered_flights) TYPE sflight_tab.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_filter_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lt_all_flights) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs> IN sflight ( <fs> ) ).

    rt_filtered_flights = FILTER sflight_tab(
      lt_all_flights
      WHERE carrid = iv_carrid
      ( FILTER #( " Inner filter applied to the result of the outer filter
          <fs>
          WHERE ( connid CP |{ iv_connid_prefix }*| )
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_filtered_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_filtered_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_filter_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_flights_lh_0) = lo_cut->get_filtered_flights( iv_carrid = 'LH' iv_connid_prefix = '0' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_flights_lh_0 ) IS NOT INITIAL ).
    " Check if all filtered flights match the criteria
    LOOP AT lt_flights_lh_0 INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_flight-carrid exp = 'LH' ).
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight-connid CP '0*' ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von geschachtelten FILTER-Ausdrücken. Der äußere FILTER wählt Flüge einer bestimmten Fluggesellschaft aus, und der innere FILTER (hier als Teil der WHERE-Klausel des äußeren Filters, was eine Art Schachtelung darstellt) wendet eine weitere Bedingung auf die Flugnummer an. Dies ermöglicht eine präzise und deklarative Filterung von Daten.
keywords: NESTING, FILTER, Internal Tables, SFlight, Expressions

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Klasse, die ein CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT-Control kapselt und eine Methode zum Anhängen von Text bereitstellt. Nutzen Sie ein Interface für die Kapselung und Mocking im Unit Test (simuliert).
hint: Definieren Sie ein Interface für das Textedit-Control und implementieren Sie es in einer Wrapper-Klasse. Im Unit Test kann ein Mock-Objekt des Interfaces verwendet werden.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_text_editor.
  METHODS append_text IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string.
  METHODS get_text RETURNING VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_my_text_editor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_text_editor.

    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit OPTIONAL. " For dependency injection

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mv_current_text TYPE string. " Fallback for non-GUI environment
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_my_text_editor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit = io_textedit.
    ELSE.
      " In a real GUI scenario, this would instantiate CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT
      " For this example, we simulate the text storage.
      " mo_textedit = NEW cl_gui_textedit( parent = cl_gui_container=>screen0 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_text_editor~append_text.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit->insert_text_as_stream(
        text = iv_text
        position = cl_gui_textedit=>insert_at_end
      ).
    ELSE.
      " Simulate for non-GUI environment
      mv_current_text = mv_current_text && iv_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_text_editor~get_text.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = rv_text ).
    ELSE.
      " Simulate for non-GUI environment
      rv_text = mv_current_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS lcl_mock_textedit DEFINITION FOR TESTING.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_text_editor.
    DATA mv_mock_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS lcl_mock_textedit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_text_editor~append_text.
    mv_mock_text = mv_mock_text && iv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_text_editor~get_text.
    rv_text = mv_mock_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_append_text FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_append_text.
    DATA(lo_mock_textedit) = NEW lcl_mock_textedit( ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_my_text_editor( ). " No real CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT, uses internal simulation

    " Test with internal simulation
    lo_cut->zif_text_editor~append_text( 'First line.' ).
    lo_cut->zif_text_editor~append_text( ' Second line.' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->zif_text_editor~get_text( ) exp = 'First line. Second line.' ).

    " For a real CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT, mocking would be more complex,
    " requiring a test double framework or manual mock for CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT.
    " The example focuses on the wrapper and interface concept.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Kapselung eines GUI-Controls (CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT) hinter einem Interface. Dies ermöglicht Dependency Injection und erleichtert das Testen der Geschäftslogik, die das Control verwendet, indem ein Mock-Objekt des Interfaces im Unit Test eingesetzt wird. Dies ist ein modernes OO-Designprinzip.
keywords: CL_GUI_CONTROL, Object Orientation, Interface, Dependency Injection, Mocking

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine geschachtelte Datenstruktur, die Informationen über eine Person und deren Adresse enthält, und initialisieren Sie diese mit dem VALUE-Operator.
hint: Verwenden Sie den VALUE-Operator, um sowohl die äußere als auch die innere Struktur in einem Schritt zu initialisieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_value_struct DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_address,
        street TYPE string,
        city   TYPE string,
        zip    TYPE string,
      END OF ty_address,
      BEGIN OF ty_person,
        name    TYPE string,
        age     TYPE i,
        address TYPE ty_address,
      END OF ty_person.

    METHODS create_person_with_address
      IMPORTING
        iv_name   TYPE string
        iv_age    TYPE i
        iv_street TYPE string
        iv_city   TYPE string
        iv_zip    TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_person) TYPE ty_person.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_value_struct IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD create_person_with_address.
    rs_person = VALUE #( 
      name = iv_name
      age  = iv_age
      address = VALUE #( 
        street = iv_street
        city   = iv_city
        zip    = iv_zip
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_create_person FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_create_person.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_value_struct( ).
    DATA(ls_person) = lo_cut->create_person_with_address(
      iv_name   = 'Max Mustermann'
      iv_age    = 30
      iv_street = 'Musterweg 1'
      iv_city   = 'Musterstadt'
      iv_zip    = '12345'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person-name exp = 'Max Mustermann' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person-age exp = 30 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person-address-street exp = 'Musterweg 1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person-address-city exp = 'Musterstadt' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_person-address-zip exp = '12345' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Der VALUE-Operator ermöglicht die kompakte und lesbare Initialisierung von Datenstrukturen, einschließlich geschachtelter Strukturen. Dies reduziert Boilerplate-Code und verbessert die Wartbarkeit.
keywords: NESTING, VALUE, Data Structures, Expressions

Instructions: Rufen Sie dynamisch eine Methode einer Klasse auf, deren Name zur Laufzeit bestimmt wird. Nutzen Sie RTTI-Klassen wie CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR und CL_ABAP_METHdescr, um Methodeninformationen zu erhalten und dynamisch aufzurufen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute_dynamic_method
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name  TYPE string
        iv_method_name TYPE string
        iv_param_value TYPE string OPTIONAL
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_result) TYPE string.

    METHODS dummy_method_1
      IMPORTING
        iv_input TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.

    METHODS dummy_method_2
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_output) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dynamic_method_call IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute_dynamic_method.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lo_method_descr) = lo_class_descr->get_method_type( iv_method_name ).

        DATA(lo_class_instance) = NEW (iv_class_name).

        DATA(lt_parameters) = lo_method_descr->get_parameters( ).
        DATA(lt_actual_params) = VALUE abap_parmbind_tab(
          FOR ls_param IN lt_parameters
          WHERE ( ls_param-parameter_kind = lo_method_descr->parameter_kind-importing
                  AND ls_param-name = 'IV_INPUT' ) " Assuming a specific parameter name for simplicity
          ( name = ls_param-name, value = NEW cl_abap_datadescr=>get_string( )->create_data( ) )
        ).

        IF iv_param_value IS SUPPLIED AND lt_actual_params IS NOT INITIAL.
          FIELD-SYMBOLS <fs_param_value> TYPE any.
          ASSIGN lt_actual_params[ 1 ]-value->* TO <fs_param_value>.
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            <fs_param_value> = iv_param_value.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

        CALL METHOD (lo_class_instance)->(iv_method_name)
          PARAMETER-TABLE lt_actual_params
          RECEIVING
            result = rv_result.

      CATCH cx_sy_dyn_call_error cx_sy_class_not_found cx_sy_struct_creation.
        rv_result = 'Error: Dynamic call failed or class/method not found.'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method_1.
    rv_output = |Hello from Dummy Method 1 with input: { iv_input }|.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method_2.
    rv_output = 'Hello from Dummy Method 2 (no input)' .
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_1 FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_dynamic_call_2 FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_call_1.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_METHOD_CALL'
      iv_method_name = 'DUMMY_METHOD_1'
      iv_param_value = 'Test Input'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from Dummy Method 1 with input: Test Input' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_dynamic_call_2.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dynamic_method_call( ).
    DATA(lv_result) = lo_cut->execute_dynamic_method(
      iv_class_name  = 'ZCL_DYNAMIC_METHOD_CALL'
      iv_method_name = 'DUMMY_METHOD_2'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_result exp = 'Hello from Dummy Method 2 (no input)' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert den dynamischen Methodenaufruf unter Verwendung von RTTI (Run-Time Type Information). CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR und CL_ABAP_METHdescr werden verwendet, um zur Laufzeit Informationen über Klassen und Methoden zu erhalten. Die Parameter werden dynamisch über eine Parameter-Tabelle übergeben. Dies ist ein fortgeschrittenes Konzept der dynamischen Programmierung und kann als 'Nesting' von RTTI-Aufrufen und dynamischen Operationen betrachtet werden.
keywords: NESTING, RTTI, Dynamic Programming, CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR, CALL METHOD

Instructions: Erstellen Sie einen formatierten String, der geschachtelte Ausdrücke verwendet, um Daten aus einer Struktur zu präsentieren.
hint: Nutzen Sie String-Templates mit geschweiften Klammern für Ausdrücke und verschachtelte Ausdrücke.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_string_template DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_product,
        id    TYPE string,
        name  TYPE string,
        price TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_product.

    METHODS format_product_info
      IMPORTING
        is_product TYPE ty_product
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_formatted_string) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_string_template IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD format_product_info.
    rv_formatted_string = |Produkt: { is_product-name } (ID: { is_product-id }), Preis: { is_product-price } EUR. Status: { 
      COND string(
        WHEN is_product-price > 100 THEN 'Premium'
        ELSE 'Standard'
      ) 
    }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_format_product FOR TESTING.
  ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_format_product.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_string_template( ).
    DATA: ls_product_premium TYPE zcl_nested_string_template=>ty_product,
          ls_product_standard TYPE zcl_nested_string_template=>ty_product.

    ls_product_premium = VALUE #( id = 'P001' name = 'Laptop' price = '1200.50' ).
    ls_product_standard = VALUE #( id = 'P002' name = 'Mouse' price = '25.99' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( 
      act = lo_cut->format_product_info( ls_product_premium )
      exp = 'Produkt: Laptop (ID: P001), Preis: 1200.50 EUR. Status: Premium'
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( 
      act = lo_cut->format_product_info( ls_product_standard )
      exp = 'Produkt: Mouse (ID: P002), Preis: 25.99 EUR. Status: Standard'
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: String-Templates ermöglichen die einfache und lesbare Formatierung von Strings. Durch das Einbetten von Ausdrücken (hier ein COND-Ausdruck) direkt in das Template können komplexe Logiken kompakt dargestellt werden. Dies ist ein Beispiel für 'Nesting' von Ausdrücken innerhalb eines String-Templates.
keywords: NESTING, String Templates, COND, Expressions, String Processing

Instructions: Simulieren Sie die Verkettung von Methodenaufrufen (Method Chaining) auf einem CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT-Control, um mehrere Eigenschaften in einem Schritt zu setzen.
hint: Entwickeln Sie eine Wrapper-Klasse, die Methoden für das Setzen von Eigenschaften bereitstellt und 'ME' zurückgibt, um Chaining zu ermöglichen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_chained_textedit DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor
      IMPORTING
        io_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit OPTIONAL. " For dependency injection

    METHODS set_text
      IMPORTING
        iv_text TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_textedit.

    METHODS set_editable
      IMPORTING
        iv_editable TYPE abap_bool
      RETURNING
        VALUE(ro_me) TYPE REF TO zcl_chained_textedit.

    METHODS get_current_text
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_text) TYPE string.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_textedit TYPE REF TO cl_gui_textedit.
    DATA mv_simulated_text TYPE string.
    DATA mv_simulated_editable TYPE abap_bool VALUE abap_true.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_chained_textedit IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    IF io_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit = io_textedit.
    ELSE.
      " Simulate for non-GUI environment
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_text.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit->set_text_as_stream( iv_text ).
    ELSE.
      mv_simulated_text = iv_text.
    ENDIF.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD set_editable.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit->set_readonly_mode( iv_editable = COND #( WHEN iv_editable = abap_true THEN 0 ELSE 1 ) ).
    ELSE.
      mv_simulated_editable = iv_editable.
    ENDIF.
    ro_me = me.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_current_text.
    IF mo_textedit IS BOUND.
      mo_textedit->get_text_as_stream( IMPORTING text = rv_text ).
    ELSE.
      rv_text = mv_simulated_text.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_method_chaining FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_method_chaining.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_chained_textedit( ).

    lo_cut->set_text( 'Initial Text' )->set_editable( abap_false ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lo_cut->get_current_text( ) exp = 'Initial Text' ).
    " Cannot directly assert editable state without mocking CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT more deeply.
    " The test primarily verifies the chaining syntax and internal state change.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Method Chaining (Methodenverkettung) ist ein modernes OO-Muster, bei dem Methoden einer Klasse das Objekt selbst (ME) zurückgeben, um weitere Methodenaufrufe direkt anzuhängen. Dies verbessert die Lesbarkeit und Kompaktheit des Codes, insbesondere beim Konfigurieren von Objekten wie CL_GUI_TEXTEDIT. Hier wird es durch eine Wrapper-Klasse simuliert.
keywords: CL_GUI_CONTROL, Object Orientation, Method Chaining, ME

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine interne Tabelle von Fluggesellschaften, die für jede Fluggesellschaft eine geschachtelte Tabelle mit den Flugnummern enthält, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten. Nutzen Sie FOR GROUPS und VALUE.
hint: Verwenden Sie einen äußeren FOR GROUPS-Ausdruck und einen inneren VALUE-Ausdruck mit einem FILTER, um die geschachtelte Tabelle zu füllen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_itab_for_groups DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_flight_detail,
        connid TYPE sflight-connid,
        seatsmax TYPE sflight-seatsmax,
      END OF ty_flight_detail,
      tt_flight_details TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_flight_detail WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_flights,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        flights TYPE tt_flight_details,
      END OF ty_carrier_flights,
      tt_carrier_flights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_flights WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_carrier_flights_by_capacity
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_carrier_flights) TYPE tt_carrier_flights.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_itab_for_groups IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_carrier_flights_by_capacity.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs> IN sflight ( <fs> ) ).

    rt_carrier_flights = VALUE tt_carrier_flights(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        flights = VALUE tt_flight_details(
          FOR member IN GROUP flight
          WHERE ( member-seatsmax > iv_min_capacity )
          ( connid = member-connid, seatsmax = member-seatsmax )
        ) )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_nested_flights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_nested_flights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_itab_for_groups( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->get_carrier_flights_by_capacity( iv_min_capacity = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_result ) IS NOT INITIAL ).

    READ TABLE lt_result INTO DATA(ls_carrier) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lines( ls_carrier-flights ) > 0 ).
      LOOP AT ls_carrier-flights INTO DATA(ls_flight_detail).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_flight_detail-seatsmax > 200 ).
      ENDLOOP.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung einer geschachtelten internen Tabelle unter Verwendung von FOR GROUPS (ABAP 7.50+) und dem VALUE-Operator. Der äußere FOR GROUPS gruppiert Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft, und der innere VALUE-Ausdruck mit einem weiteren FOR-Ausdruck füllt die geschachtelte Tabelle mit den relevanten Flugdetails. Dies ist eine sehr moderne und deklarative Art, komplexe Datenstrukturen zu transformieren.
keywords: NESTING, FOR GROUPS, VALUE, Internal Tables, SFlight, Data Transformation

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie dynamisch alle öffentlichen Methoden einer Klasse und deren Parameter. Nutzen Sie geschachtelte RTTI-Aufrufe.
hint: Verwenden Sie CL_ABAP_CLASSDESCR, um Methoden zu erhalten, und iterieren Sie dann über CL_ABAP_METHdescr, um Parameterdetails zu extrahieren.
solution:
CLASS zcl_rtti_nested_methods DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_param_info,
        name TYPE string,
        kind TYPE string,
        type TYPE string,
      END OF ty_param_info,
      tt_param_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_param_info WITH EMPTY KEY,
      BEGIN OF ty_method_info,
        name TYPE string,
        parameters TYPE tt_param_info,
      END OF ty_method_info,
      tt_method_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_method_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_public_method_info
      IMPORTING
        iv_class_name TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_method_info) TYPE tt_method_info.

    METHODS dummy_method_a.
    METHODS dummy_method_b IMPORTING iv_val TYPE i RETURNING VALUE(rv_res) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_rtti_nested_methods IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_public_method_info.
    TRY.
        DATA(lo_class_descr) = cl_abap_classdescr=>describe_by_name( iv_class_name ).
        DATA(lt_methods) = lo_class_descr->get_methods( ).

        rt_method_info = VALUE tt_method_info(
          FOR ls_method IN lt_methods
          WHERE ( ls_method-visibility = lo_class_descr->visibility-public )
          ( name = ls_method-name,
            parameters = VALUE tt_param_info(
              FOR ls_param IN lo_class_descr->get_method_type( ls_method-name )->get_parameters( )
              ( name = ls_param-name,
                kind = COND string(
                         WHEN ls_param-parameter_kind = lo_class_descr->parameter_kind-importing THEN 'Importing'
                         WHEN ls_param-parameter_kind = lo_class_descr->parameter_kind-exporting THEN 'Exporting'
                         WHEN ls_param-parameter_kind = lo_class_descr->parameter_kind-changing THEN 'Changing'
                         WHEN ls_param-parameter_kind = lo_class_descr->parameter_kind-returning THEN 'Returning'
                         ELSE 'Unknown' )
                type = ls_param-type_descr->get_name( )
              )
            )
          )
        ).

      CATCH cx_sy_class_not_found cx_sy_dyn_call_error.
        " Handle error
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method_a.
    " Just a dummy method
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dummy_method_b.

Instructions: Berechnen Sie für jede Fluggesellschaft die durchschnittliche Passagierkapazität aller Flüge, die eine bestimmte Mindestkapazität überschreiten, und runden Sie das Ergebnis. Nutzen Sie geschachtelte Ausdrücke mit REDUCE und GROUP BY.
hint: Verwenden Sie FOR GROUPS für die Gruppierung und einen REDUCE-Ausdruck, der sowohl die Summe als auch die Anzahl der Elemente für die Durchschnittsberechnung ermittelt.
solution:
CLASS zcl_nested_reduce_avg DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_carrier_avg_capa,
        carrid TYPE sflight-carrid,
        average_capacity TYPE decfloat16,
      END OF ty_carrier_avg_capa,
      tt_carrier_avg_capa TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_carrier_avg_capa WITH UNIQUE KEY carrid.

    METHODS get_avg_capacities
      IMPORTING
        iv_min_capacity TYPE sflight-seatsmax DEFAULT 100
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_avg_capacities) TYPE tt_carrier_avg_capa.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_nested_reduce_avg IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_avg_capacities.
    DATA(lt_sflight) = VALUE sflight_tab( FOR <fs> IN sflight ( <fs> ) ).

    rt_avg_capacities = VALUE tt_carrier_avg_capa(
      FOR GROUPS OF flight IN lt_sflight BY flight-carrid
      GROUP BY carrid = flight-carrid
      LET result = REDUCE struct(
                     INIT s = VALUE #( sum = 0 count = 0 )
                     FOR member IN GROUP flight
                     WHERE ( member-seatsmax > iv_min_capacity )
                     NEXT s = VALUE #( sum = s-sum + member-seatsmax
                                       count = s-count + 1 ) )
      IN
      ( carrid = flight-carrid,
        average_capacity = COND decfloat16(
                             WHEN result-count > 0 THEN round( val = result-sum / result-count dec = 0 )
                             ELSE 0 )
      )
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_avg_capacities FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_avg_capacities.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_nested_reduce_avg( ).
    DATA(lt_avg_capacities) = lo_cut->get_avg_capacities( iv_min_capacity = 200 ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_avg_capacities ) IS NOT INITIAL ).

    READ TABLE lt_avg_capacities INTO DATA(ls_lh_avg) WITH KEY carrid = 'LH'.
    IF sy-subrc = 0.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = ls_lh_avg-average_capacity > 0 ).
      " Assuming some known average for LH flights > 200 capacity, e.g., 300
      " cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_lh_avg-average_capacity exp = 300 ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert eine komplexe Datenaggregation mit geschachtelten Ausdrücken. Ein äußerer FOR GROUPS-Ausdruck gruppiert Flüge nach Fluggesellschaft. Ein innerer REDUCE-Ausdruck berechnet die Summe und die Anzahl der Passagierkapazitäten für Flüge, die eine Mindestkapazität überschreiten. Anschließend wird der Durchschnitt berechnet und gerundet. Die Verwendung von LET und COND innerhalb der Ausdrücke macht den Code sehr deklarativ und effizient.
keywords: NESTING, REDUCE, FOR GROUPS, COND, Internal Tables, SFlight, Aggregation, Math

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine Hierarchie von Klassen, die eine geschachtelte Struktur von Objekten darstellt (z.B. ein 'Dokument' mit 'Abschnitten', die wiederum 'Absätze' enthalten). Nutzen Sie moderne OO-Konzepte.
hint: Verwenden Sie Komposition (Objekte als Attribute) und Interfaces für die Definition der Hierarchie.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_document_element.
  METHODS get_content RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE string.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_paragraph DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document_element.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_text TYPE string.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_text TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_paragraph IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_text = iv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_document_element~get_content.
    rv_content = mv_text.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_section DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document_element.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_title TYPE string.
    METHODS add_element IMPORTING io_element TYPE REF TO zif_document_element.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_title TYPE string.
    DATA mt_elements TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zif_document_element WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_section IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_title = iv_title.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD add_element.
    APPEND io_element TO mt_elements.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_document_element~get_content.
    rv_content = |## { mv_title }\n|.
    LOOP AT mt_elements INTO DATA(lo_element).
      rv_content = rv_content && lo_element->get_content( ) && |\n|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_document_element.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_title TYPE string.
    METHODS add_section IMPORTING io_section TYPE REF TO zcl_section.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_title TYPE string.
    DATA mt_sections TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_section WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_document IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_title = iv_title.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD add_section.
    APPEND io_section TO mt_sections.
  ENDMETHOD.
  METHOD zif_document_element~get_content.
    rv_content = |# { mv_title }\n|.
    LOOP AT mt_sections INTO DATA(lo_section).
      rv_content = rv_content && lo_section->zif_document_element~get_content( ) && |\n|.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

    METHODS test_document_hierarchy FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_document_hierarchy.
    DATA(lo_doc) = NEW zcl_document( 'Mein Bericht' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Erstellung einer geschachtelten Objektstruktur (Komposition) unter Verwendung von Interfaces und modernen ABAP OO-Konzepten. Ein Dokument enthält Abschnitte, die wiederum Absätze enthalten. Jedes Element implementiert ein gemeinsames Interface, was Polymorphie ermöglicht. Instructions: Iterieren Sie über die Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` und geben Sie nur jede dritte Zeile aus, zusammen mit ihrer Zeilennummer.
hint: Nutzen Sie `sy-tabix` innerhalb einer `LOOP` Schleife und den Modulo-Operator.
solution:
CLASS zcl_tabix_nth_row DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_sflights IMPORTING iv_modulo TYPE i DEFAULT 3 RETURNING VALUE(rt_output) TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tabix_nth_row IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_sflights.
    DATA lt_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.

    LOOP AT lt_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix MOD iv_modulo = 0.
        APPEND |Flug { ls_flight-carrid } { ls_flight-connid } am { ls_flight-fldate } (Zeile: { sy-tabix })| TO rt_output.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_process_sflights FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_process_sflights.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_tabix_nth_row( ).
    DATA(lt_result) = lo_cut->process_sflights( iv_modulo = 2 ).
    DATA lt_all_sflights TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflights.
    SELECT * FROM sflights INTO TABLE @lt_all_sflights UP TO 100 ROWS.
    DATA(lv_expected_count) = 0.
    LOOP AT lt_all_sflights INTO DATA(ls_flight).
      IF sy-tabix MOD 2 = 0.
        lv_expected_count = lv_expected_count + 1.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_result ) exp = lv_expected_count ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt die Verwendung von `sy-tabix` in einer `LOOP`-Schleife, um bedingte Logik basierend auf der Zeilennummer auszuführen. Die Inline-Deklaration `DATA(ls_flight)` und String-Templates (`|...|`) sind moderne ABAP-Features.
keywords: sy-tabix, LOOP, MOD, String Templates, Inline Declaration

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine neue interne Tabelle, die die ersten 5 Zeilen der Tabelle `SFLIGHTS` enthält, wobei jede Zeile zusätzlich ihre ursprüngliche Zeilennummer aus `SFLIGHTS` als neues Feld `original_index` enthält. Nutzen Sie dabei moderne Schleifenkonstrukte.
