Instructions: Speichern Sie einen XSTRING in einer Datenbanktabelle und lesen Sie ihn wieder aus. Verwenden Sie eine einfache Custom-Tabelle mit einem Schlüsselfeld und einem XSTRING-Feld.
hint: Erstellen Sie eine transparente Tabelle mit einem Feld vom Typ `RAWSTRING` oder `LRAW`.
solution:
" Assuming a custom transparent table ZBINARY_STORAGE exists:
" FIELDS:
"   ID      TYPE N 10 PRIMARY KEY
"   CONTENT TYPE RAWSTRING

CLASS zcl_binary_db_storage DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS save_binary_data IMPORTING iv_id      TYPE zbinary_storage-id
                                  iv_content TYPE xstring.
    METHODS load_binary_data IMPORTING iv_id      TYPE zbinary_storage-id
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_content) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_db_storage IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD save_binary_data.
    INSERT zbinary_storage FROM @( VALUE #( id = iv_id content = iv_content ) ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      UPDATE zbinary_storage SET content = @iv_content WHERE id = @iv_id.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD load_binary_data.
    SELECT SINGLE content FROM zbinary_storage INTO @rv_content WHERE id = @iv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_db_storage FOR TESTING.
    METHODS cleanup_test_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_db_storage.
    DATA(lo_storage) = NEW zcl_binary_db_storage( ).
    DATA(lv_test_id) = '0000000001'.
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'This is some binary data to store in DB. 🚀'.
    DATA(lv_original_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_original_string ).

    " Cleanup before test
    cleanup_test_data( ).

    " Save
    lo_storage->save_binary_data( iv_id = lv_test_id iv_content = lv_original_xstring ).

    " Load
    DATA(lv_loaded_xstring) = lo_storage->load_binary_data( lv_test_id ).
    DATA(lv_loaded_string) = cl_abap_conv_x2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_loaded_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_loaded_string exp = lv_original_string msg = 'Binary data mismatch after DB roundtrip' ).

    " Cleanup after test
    cleanup_test_data( ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD cleanup_test_data.
    DELETE FROM zbinary_storage WHERE id = '0000000001'.
    COMMIT WORK.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt das Speichern und Laden von binären Daten (`XSTRING`) in einer transparenten Datenbanktabelle. Das Feld `RAWSTRING` ist für die Speicherung von binären Daten variabler Länge optimiert. Die Verwendung von Inline-Deklarationen und Host-Variablen (`@`) ist ein Merkmal von modernem ABAP SQL.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, Database, RAWSTRING, SQL

Instructions: Implementieren Sie das Strategy Pattern für verschiedene Berechnungsstrategien (z.B. verschiedene Steuersätze). Eine abstrakte Basisklasse definiert die Schnittstelle für die Strategie, während konkrete Strategien in Unterklassen implementiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine abstrakte Klasse oder ein Interface für die Strategie und eine Kontextklasse, die die Strategie zur Laufzeit austauscht.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_tax_strategy.
  METHODS calculate_tax IMPORTING iv_amount TYPE decfloat16
                          RETURNING VALUE(rv_tax_amount) TYPE decfloat16.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_tax_strategy_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_tax_strategy.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tax_strategy_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.

CLASS zcl_tax_strategy_germany DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_tax_strategy_abstract FINAL.

    METHODS zif_tax_strategy~calculate_tax REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_tax_strategy_germany IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_tax_strategy~calculate_tax.
    " 19% VAT for Germany
    rv_tax_amount = iv_amount * '0.19'.

    METHODS zif_tax_strategy~calculate_tax REDEFINITION.

  METHOD zif_tax_strategy~calculate_tax.
    " Example: 5% sales tax for USA
    rv_tax_amount = iv_amount * '0.05'.

CLASS zcl_tax_calculator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_tax_strategy.
    METHODS set_strategy IMPORTING io_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_tax_strategy.
    METHODS get_total_with_tax IMPORTING iv_base_amount TYPE decfloat16
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_total) TYPE decfloat16.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mo_strategy TYPE REF TO zif_tax_strategy.

    mo_strategy = io_strategy.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_german_tax FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_usa_tax FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_german_tax.
    DATA(lo_german_strategy) = NEW zcl_tax_strategy_germany( ).
    DATA(lo_calculator) = NEW zcl_tax_calculator( lo_german_strategy ).
    DATA(lv_total) = lo_calculator->get_total_with_tax( '100' ).

explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert das Strategy Pattern. Die Kontextklasse (`zcl_tax_calculator`) kann die Strategie zur Laufzeit austauschen, was eine flexible und erweiterbare Lösung für unterschiedliche Berechnungslogiken bietet.

Instructions: Komprimieren und dekomprimieren Sie einen XSTRING mit GZIP.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_ABAP_GZIP`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_gzip_compressor DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compress_xstring IMPORTING iv_xstring TYPE xstring
                             RETURNING VALUE(rv_compressed_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    METHODS decompress_xstring IMPORTING iv_compressed_xstring TYPE xstring
                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_decompressed_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_gzip_compressor IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compress_xstring.
    cl_abap_gzip=>compress(
      EXPORTING
        raw_in  = iv_xstring
      IMPORTING
        gzip_out = rv_compressed_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD decompress_xstring.
    cl_abap_gzip=>decompress(
      EXPORTING
        gzip_in  = iv_compressed_xstring
      IMPORTING
        raw_out = rv_decompressed_xstring
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_gzip_roundtrip FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_xstring FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_gzip_roundtrip.
    DATA(lo_compressor) = NEW zcl_binary_gzip_compressor( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'This is a test string for GZIP compression and decompression. It should be long enough to show some compression effect.'.
    DATA(lv_original_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_original_string ).

    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = lo_compressor->compress_xstring( lv_original_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = lo_compressor->decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decompressed_xstring exp = lv_original_xstring msg = 'GZIP roundtrip failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( xsdbool( xstrlen( lv_compressed_xstring ) < xstrlen( lv_original_xstring ) ) msg = 'Compression did not reduce size' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_xstring.
    DATA(lo_compressor) = NEW zcl_binary_gzip_compressor( ).
    DATA(lv_original_xstring) = ''X.

    DATA(lv_compressed_xstring) = lo_compressor->compress_xstring( lv_original_xstring ).
    DATA(lv_decompressed_xstring) = lo_compressor->decompress_xstring( lv_compressed_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decompressed_xstring exp = lv_original_xstring msg = 'GZIP roundtrip for empty xstring failed' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Komprimierung und Dekomprimierung von binären Daten (`XSTRING`) mit dem GZIP-Algorithmus unter Verwendung der Klasse `CL_ABAP_GZIP`. Dies ist nützlich, um die Größe von Daten zu reduzieren, z.B. beim Speichern in der Datenbank oder beim Senden über Netzwerke.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, GZIP, Compression, Decompression

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse für einen Logger, der verschiedene Ausgabekanäle (z.B. Konsole, Datei) unterstützt. Die abstrakte Klasse definiert die grundlegende Logik, während die konkrete Ausgabe in Unterklassen implementiert wird.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine abstrakte Methode für die eigentliche Ausgabe und eine finale Methode für die Formatierung der Nachricht.
solution:
CLASS zcl_logger_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS log_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    METHODS write_output ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_formatted_message TYPE string.
    METHODS format_message IMPORTING iv_message TYPE string
                           RETURNING VALUE(rv_formatted_message) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_logger_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD log_message.
    DATA(lv_formatted) = format_message( iv_message ).
    write_output( lv_formatted ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD format_message.
    rv_formatted_message = |{ sy-datum } { sy-uzeit } - { iv_message }|.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_logger_abstract FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS write_output REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_console_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD write_output.
    WRITE: / iv_formatted_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_logger_abstract FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS constructor IMPORTING iv_file_path TYPE string.
    METHODS write_output REDEFINITION.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mv_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_file_logger IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD constructor.
    mv_file_path = iv_file_path.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD write_output.
    " In a real scenario, use cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download or similar
    " For simplicity, we'll just simulate writing to a file.
    " This would typically involve opening a file, writing, and closing.
    " For unit testing, we'd mock this.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_console_logger FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_file_logger FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_console_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_console_logger( ).
    " We cannot directly assert console output, but we can ensure no dump occurs.
    " A more robust test would involve mocking the WRITE statement.
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Test message for console' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_logger ). " Just to ensure object exists and method runs
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_file_logger.
    DATA(lo_logger) = NEW zcl_file_logger( 'C:\temp\log.txt' ).
    " Similar to console, direct assertion of file content is hard in unit test.
    " We ensure the method runs without dump.
    lo_logger->log_message( 'Test message for file' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_logger ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel nutzt eine abstrakte Klasse (`zcl_logger_abstract`) zur Implementierung eines Logger-Frameworks. Die abstrakte Methode `write_output` erzwingt die Implementierung der spezifischen Ausgabelogik in den Unterklassen (z.B. `zcl_console_logger`, `zcl_file_logger`), während die `log_message` Methode die gemeinsame Logik (Nachrichtenformatierung) in der Basisklasse kapselt. String-Templates werden für die Nachrichtenformatierung verwendet.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Logger, Inheritance, Polymorphism, String Templates

Instructions: Konvertieren Sie eine interne Tabelle von Binärdaten (XSTRING) in eine interne Tabelle von Strings (Base64-kodiert) und umgekehrt.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Klasse `CL_HTTP_UTILITY` für die Base64-Kodierung/-Dekodierung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_base64_converter DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: tt_xstring TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY,
           tt_string  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS xstring_table_to_base64_table IMPORTING it_xstrings TYPE tt_xstring
                                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_base64_strings) TYPE tt_string.
    METHODS base64_table_to_xstring_table IMPORTING it_base64_strings TYPE tt_string
                                          RETURNING VALUE(rt_xstrings) TYPE tt_xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_base64_converter IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD xstring_table_to_base64_table.
    rt_base64_strings = VALUE #( FOR <xstring> IN it_xstrings
                                 ( cl_http_utility=>encode_base64( <xstring> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD base64_table_to_xstring_table.
    rt_xstrings = VALUE #( FOR <string> IN it_base64_strings
                           ( cl_http_utility=>decode_base64( <string> ) ) ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_base64_table_roundtrip FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_table FOR TESTING.
  TYPES: tt_xstring TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF xstring WITH EMPTY KEY,
         tt_string  TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF string WITH EMPTY KEY.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_base64_table_roundtrip.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_binary_base64_converter( ).
    DATA: lt_original_xstrings TYPE tt_xstring.

    APPEND cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( 'Hello World' ) TO lt_original_xstrings.
    APPEND cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( 'ABAP is great!' ) TO lt_original_xstrings.
    APPEND cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( '🚀' ) TO lt_original_xstrings.

    DATA(lt_base64_strings) = lo_converter->xstring_table_to_base64_table( lt_original_xstrings ).
    DATA(lt_decoded_xstrings) = lo_converter->base64_table_to_xstring_table( lt_base64_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_decoded_xstrings ) exp = lines( lt_original_xstrings ) msg = 'Table size mismatch' ).
    LOOP AT lt_original_xstrings INTO DATA(lv_original_xstring).
      READ TABLE lt_decoded_xstrings INTO DATA(lv_decoded_xstring) INDEX sy-tabix.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_decoded_xstring exp = lv_original_xstring msg = |Mismatch at index { sy-tabix }| ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_table.
    DATA(lo_converter) = NEW zcl_binary_base64_converter( ).
    DATA: lt_empty_xstrings TYPE tt_xstring.

    DATA(lt_base64_strings) = lo_converter->xstring_table_to_base64_table( lt_empty_xstrings ).
    DATA(lt_decoded_xstrings) = lo_converter->base64_table_to_xstring_table( lt_base64_strings ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_base64_strings ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_decoded_xstrings ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die Massenkonvertierung von `XSTRING`-Tabellen in Base64-kodierte `STRING`-Tabellen und umgekehrt. Die Verwendung von `VALUE #(...) FOR ... IN ...` ist eine moderne und kompakte Art, interne Tabellen zu transformieren. `CL_HTTP_UTILITY` bietet die notwendigen Methoden für die Base64-Kodierung und -Dekodierung.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, Base64, Internal Tables, VALUE, FOR

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine abstrakte Klasse für einen Datenzugriffsdienst (DAO), der CRUD-Operationen definiert. Konkrete Implementierungen sollen für verschiedene Datenquellen (z.B. Datenbanktabelle, CDS View) bereitgestellt werden.
hint: Nutzen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse mit generischen Methoden für CRUD und implementieren Sie diese spezifisch in Unterklassen.
solution:
INTERFACE zif_data_access_object.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_data,
           id TYPE sflight-carrid,
           value TYPE sflight-connid,
         END OF ty_data,
         tt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

  METHODS create_entry IMPORTING is_data TYPE ty_data.
  METHODS read_entry IMPORTING iv_id TYPE zif_data_access_object~ty_data-id
                       RETURNING VALUE(rs_data) TYPE ty_data.
  METHODS update_entry IMPORTING is_data TYPE ty_data.
  METHODS delete_entry IMPORTING iv_id TYPE zif_data_access_object~ty_data-id.
  METHODS read_all_entries RETURNING VALUE(rt_data) TYPE tt_data.
ENDINTERFACE.

CLASS zcl_data_access_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_access_object.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_access_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_dao DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_data_access_abstract FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    INTERFACES zif_data_access_object REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_sflight_dao IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD zif_data_access_object~create_entry.
    " Not applicable for standard table SFLIGHT
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_supported.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_data_access_object~read_entry.
    SELECT SINGLE carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_data WHERE carrid = @iv_id.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_data_access_object~update_entry.
    " Not applicable for standard table SFLIGHT
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_supported.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_data_access_object~delete_entry.
    " Not applicable for standard table SFLIGHT
    RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_abap_not_supported.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD zif_data_access_object~read_all_entries.
    SELECT carrid, connid FROM sflight INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_data UP TO 10 ROWS.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

" Example for a custom table ZCUSTOM_DATA (ID TYPE CHAR10, VALUE TYPE CHAR10)
" CLASS zcl_custom_data_dao DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_data_access_abstract FINAL.
"   PUBLIC SECTION.
"     INTERFACES zif_data_access_object REDEFINITION.
" ENDCLASS.

" CLASS zcl_custom_data_dao IMPLEMENTATION.
"   METHOD zif_data_access_object~create_entry.
"     INSERT zcustom_data FROM @( VALUE #( id = is_data-id value = is_data-value ) ).
"   ENDMETHOD.
"   METHOD zif_data_access_object~read_entry.
"     SELECT SINGLE id, value FROM zcustom_data INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF @rs_data WHERE id = @iv_id.
"   ENDMETHOD.
"   METHOD zif_data_access_object~update_entry.
"     UPDATE zcustom_data SET value = @is_data-value WHERE id = @is_data-id.
"   ENDMETHOD.
"   METHOD zif_data_access_object~delete_entry.
"     DELETE FROM zcustom_data WHERE id = @iv_id.
"   ENDMETHOD.
"   METHOD zif_data_access_object~read_all_entries.
"     SELECT id, value FROM zcustom_data INTO CORRESPONDING FIELDS OF TABLE @rt_data.
"   ENDMETHOD.
" ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_sflight_dao FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_sflight_dao.
    DATA(lo_dao) = NEW zcl_sflight_dao( ).

    DATA(ls_data) = lo_dao->zif_data_access_object~read_entry( 'LH' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_data-id exp = 'LH' msg = 'Read entry failed' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( ls_data-value ).

    DATA(lt_all_data) = lo_dao->zif_data_access_object~read_all_entries( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( lt_all_data ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_all_data ) exp = 10 msg = 'Read all entries failed' ).

    " Test unsupported operations
    TRY.
        lo_dao->zif_data_access_object~create_entry( VALUE #( id = 'XX' value = 'YY' ) ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( 'CREATE should not be supported' ).
      CATCH cx_abap_not_supported.
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>pass( 'CREATE correctly not supported' ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel verwendet eine abstrakte Klasse (`zcl_data_access_abstract`) und ein Interface (`zif_data_access_object`), um ein Data Access Object (DAO) Pattern zu implementieren. Die abstrakte Klasse definiert die Schnittstelle für CRUD-Operationen, die dann in konkreten DAOs (z.B. `zcl_sflight_dao` für die Tabelle SFLIGHT) implementiert werden. Dies entkoppelt die Geschäftslogik von der Datenzugriffslogik und ermöglicht den einfachen Austausch von Datenquellen. Host-Variablen und `CORRESPONDING FIELDS` sind moderne SQL-Syntax.
keywords: ABSTRACT, DAO, Interface, Object Orientation, CRUD, SQL

Instructions: Lesen Sie eine lokale Binärdatei (z.B. ein Bild) in einen XSTRING und schreiben Sie diesen XSTRING wieder als neue Datei. Verwenden Sie dabei die Dateisystem-Services.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES` für den Zugriff auf das Frontend-Dateisystem.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_file_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_file_to_xstring IMPORTING iv_file_path TYPE string
                                 RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.
    METHODS write_xstring_to_file IMPORTING iv_xstring TYPE xstring
                                  iv_file_path TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_file_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_file_to_xstring.
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_upload(
      EXPORTING
        filename             = iv_file_path
        filetype             = 'BIN'
      IMPORTING
        filelength           = DATA(lv_file_length)
        data_xstr            = rv_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_open_error      = 1
        file_read_error      = 2
        no_authority         = 3
        unknown_error        = 4
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 5
        OTHERS               = 6
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD write_xstring_to_file.
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename             = iv_file_path
        filetype             = 'BIN'
        bin_filesize         = xstrlen( iv_xstring )
      CHANGING
        data_xstr            = iv_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        file_write_error     = 1
        no_authority         = 2
        gui_refuse_filetransfer = 3
        OTHERS               = 4
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RAISE EXCEPTION TYPE cx_static_check.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_file_roundtrip FOR TESTING.
    CONSTANTS: gc_test_file_in TYPE string VALUE 'C:\temp\test_input.bin',
               gc_test_file_out TYPE string VALUE 'C:\temp\test_output.bin'.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_file_roundtrip.
    DATA(lo_handler) = NEW zcl_binary_file_handler( ).
    DATA(lv_original_string) = 'This is some test binary content for a file. 1234567890 ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz'.
    DATA(lv_original_xstring) = cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( lv_original_string ).

    " Create a dummy input file for testing
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>gui_download(
      EXPORTING
        filename             = gc_test_file_in
        filetype             = 'BIN'
        bin_filesize         = xstrlen( lv_original_xstring )
      CHANGING
        data_xstr            = lv_original_xstring
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS               = 1
    ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( sy-subrc ).

    " Read the file
    DATA(lv_read_xstring) = lo_handler->read_file_to_xstring( gc_test_file_in ).

    " Write to a new file
    lo_handler->write_xstring_to_file( iv_xstring = lv_read_xstring iv_file_path = gc_test_file_out ).

    " Read the output file to verify content
    DATA(lv_verified_xstring) = lo_handler->read_file_to_xstring( gc_test_file_out ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lv_verified_xstring exp = lv_original_xstring msg = 'File roundtrip content mismatch' ).

    " Clean up test files (requires user interaction for deletion in real scenario)
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_delete( gc_test_file_in ).
    cl_gui_frontend_services=>file_delete( gc_test_file_out ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt das Lesen und Schreiben von Binärdateien (z.B. Bilder) auf dem Frontend-Dateisystem mithilfe der Klasse `CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES`. Die Methoden `GUI_UPLOAD` und `GUI_DOWNLOAD` sind entscheidend für die Interaktion mit lokalen Dateien. Der Dateityp 'BIN' stellt sicher, dass die Daten als XSTRING behandelt werden, ohne Codepage-Konvertierungen.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, File I/O, Frontend Services, CL_GUI_FRONTEND_SERVICES

Instructions: Erstellen Sie eine abstrakte Klasse für einen Event-Handler, der eine Methode zur Verarbeitung von Events definiert. Konkrete Event-Handler sollen diese Methode implementieren, um spezifische Event-Typen zu behandeln.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine abstrakte Methode `handle_event` und eine Typ-Hierarchie für Events.
solution:

CLASS zcl_event_dispatcher DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS register_handler IMPORTING iv_event_type TYPE string
                                      io_handler TYPE REF TO zcl_event_handler_abstract.
    METHODS dispatch_event IMPORTING io_event TYPE REF TO zcl_event_abstract.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    TYPES: ty_handler_map TYPE HASHED TABLE OF REF TO zcl_event_handler_abstract WITH UNIQUE KEY table_line.
    DATA mt_handlers TYPE ty_handler_map.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_event_dispatcher IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_handler.
    INSERT io_handler INTO TABLE mt_handlers.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD dispatch_event.
    DATA(lv_event_type) = io_event->get_event_type( ).
    LOOP AT mt_handlers INTO DATA(lo_handler).
      " In a real scenario, you'd map event types to specific handlers
      " For simplicity, we'll just call all registered handlers.
      lo_handler->handle_event( io_event ).
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_event_dispatching.
    DATA(lo_dispatcher) = NEW zcl_event_dispatcher( ).
    DATA(lo_button_handler) = NEW zcl_button_handler( ).
    DATA(lo_data_handler) = NEW zcl_data_handler( ).

    lo_dispatcher->register_handler( iv_event_type = 'BUTTON_CLICK' io_handler = lo_button_handler ).
    lo_dispatcher->register_handler( iv_event_type = 'DATA_CHANGED' io_handler = lo_data_handler ).

    DATA(lo_button_event) = NEW zcl_button_click_event( 'SAVE_BUTTON' ).
    DATA(lo_data_event) = NEW zcl_data_changed_event( 'MATERIAL_NUMBER' ).

    " Dispatch events - we can't directly assert side effects, but ensure no dumps.
    lo_dispatcher->dispatch_event( lo_button_event ).

Die `dispatch_event`-Methode in `zcl_event_dispatcher` zeigt, wie Events polymorph an registrierte Handler weitergeleitet werden können. `CAST` wird verwendet, um die spezifischen Event-Objekte zu verarbeiten.

Instructions: Führen Sie eine binäre Suche auf einer sortierten internen Tabelle durch, um einen Eintrag effizient zu finden.
hint: Verwenden Sie `READ TABLE ... BINARY SEARCH` oder `LINE_EXISTS` mit `BINARY SEARCH`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_search_table DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
             key TYPE i,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_item,
           tt_items TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY key.

    METHODS find_item_binary_search IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_items
                                      iv_key TYPE i
                                      RETURNING VALUE(rs_item) TYPE ty_item.
    METHODS check_item_exists IMPORTING it_items TYPE tt_items
                                  iv_key TYPE i
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_exists) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_search_table IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD find_item_binary_search.
    READ TABLE it_items INTO rs_item WITH KEY key = iv_key BINARY SEARCH.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      CLEAR rs_item.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD check_item_exists.
    rv_exists = COND abap_bool( WHEN LINE_EXISTS( it_items[ KEY primary_key key = iv_key ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_find_item_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_find_item_not_found FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_check_item_exists FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_check_item_not_exists FOR TESTING.
  TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_item,
           key TYPE i,
           value TYPE string,
         END OF ty_item,
         tt_items TYPE SORTED TABLE OF ty_item WITH UNIQUE KEY key.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_find_item_found.
    DATA: lt_test_items TYPE tt_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( key = 1 value = 'One' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( key = 5 value = 'Five' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( key = 10 value = 'Ten' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_items.

    DATA(ls_found_item) = NEW zcl_binary_search_table( )->find_item_binary_search( it_items = lt_test_items iv_key = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_found_item-value exp = 'Five' msg = 'Item not found correctly' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_find_item_not_found.
    DATA: lt_test_items TYPE tt_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( key = 1 value = 'One' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( key = 10 value = 'Ten' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_items.

    DATA(ls_found_item) = NEW zcl_binary_search_table( )->find_item_binary_search( it_items = lt_test_items iv_key = 3 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_found_item-key msg = 'Non-existent item found' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_check_item_exists.
    DATA: lt_test_items TYPE tt_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( key = 1 value = 'One' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( key = 5 value = 'Five' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_items.

    DATA(lv_exists) = NEW zcl_binary_search_table( )->check_item_exists( it_items = lt_test_items iv_key = 5 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_exists msg = 'Item should exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_check_item_not_exists.
    DATA: lt_test_items TYPE tt_items.
    INSERT VALUE ty_item( key = 1 value = 'One' ) INTO TABLE lt_test_items.

    DATA(lv_exists) = NEW zcl_binary_search_table( )->check_item_exists( it_items = lt_test_items iv_key = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_exists msg = 'Item should not exist' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die effiziente binäre Suche in einer sortierten internen Tabelle. Die Methode `find_item_binary_search` verwendet die klassische `READ TABLE ... BINARY SEARCH`-Anweisung. Die Methode `check_item_exists` zeigt die modernere, funktionalere Syntax mit `LINE_EXISTS` und dem Tabellenausdruck `it_items[ KEY primary_key key = iv_key ]`, die implizit eine binäre Suche auf sortierten Tabellen durchführt und kompakter ist.
keywords: BINARY, Internal Tables, SORTED TABLE, BINARY SEARCH, LINE_EXISTS, Table Expressions

Instructions: Vergleichen Sie zwei XSTRINGs auf Gleichheit.
hint: XSTRINGs können direkt mit dem Gleichheitsoperator verglichen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_binary_comparator DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS compare_xstrings IMPORTING iv_xstring1 TYPE xstring
                                      iv_xstring2 TYPE xstring
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_are_equal) TYPE abap_bool.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_binary_comparator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD compare_xstrings.
    IF iv_xstring1 = iv_xstring2.
      rv_are_equal = abap_true.
    ELSE.
      rv_are_equal = abap_false.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_equal_xstrings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_unequal_xstrings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_empty_xstrings FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_different_lengths FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_equal_xstrings.
    DATA(lo_comparator) = NEW zcl_binary_comparator( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring1) = cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( 'Binary Data A' ).
    DATA(lv_xstring2) = cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( 'Binary Data A' ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_comparator->compare_xstrings( iv_xstring1 = lv_xstring1 iv_xstring2 = lv_xstring2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result msg = 'XSTRINGs should be equal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_unequal_xstrings.
    DATA(lo_comparator) = NEW zcl_binary_comparator( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring1) = cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( 'Binary Data A' ).
    DATA(lv_xstring2) = cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( 'Binary Data B' ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_comparator->compare_xstrings( iv_xstring1 = lv_xstring1 iv_xstring2 = lv_xstring2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_result msg = 'XSTRINGs should not be equal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_empty_xstrings.
    DATA(lo_comparator) = NEW zcl_binary_comparator( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring1) = ''X.
    DATA(lv_xstring2) = ''X.

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_comparator->compare_xstrings( iv_xstring1 = lv_xstring1 iv_xstring2 = lv_xstring2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_result msg = 'Empty XSTRINGs should be equal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_different_lengths.
    DATA(lo_comparator) = NEW zcl_binary_comparator( ).
    DATA(lv_xstring1) = cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( 'A' ).
    DATA(lv_xstring2) = cl_abap_conv_c2x_ce=>create( )->convert( 'AA' ).

    DATA(lv_result) = lo_comparator->compare_xstrings( iv_xstring1 = lv_xstring1 iv_xstring2 = lv_xstring2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_result msg = 'XSTRINGs of different lengths should not be equal' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel zeigt den direkten Vergleich von zwei `XSTRING`-Variablen auf Gleichheit. Im Gegensatz zu `STRING`-Vergleichen, die Codepage-Probleme haben können, ist der Vergleich von `XSTRING`s byteweise und daher unkompliziert und zuverlässig für binäre Daten. Der Gleichheitsoperator (`=`) ist hierfür die korrekte und effiziente Methode.
keywords: BINARY, XSTRING, Comparison, Equality

Instructions: Implementieren Sie eine abstrakte Klasse für einen Validator, der eine Methode zur Validierung von Daten definiert. Konkrete Validatoren sollen diese Methode implementieren, um spezifische Validierungsregeln anzuwenden.
hint: Verwenden Sie eine abstrakte Methode `validate` und eine Liste von Fehlermeldungen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_validator_abstract DEFINITION PUBLIC ABSTRACT.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate ABSTRACT IMPORTING iv_value TYPE string
                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_error_message RETURNING VALUE(rv_message) TYPE string.
  PROTECTED SECTION.
    DATA mv_error_message TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_validator_abstract IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_error_message.
    rv_message = mv_error_message.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_not_empty_validator DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_validator_abstract FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_not_empty_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate.
    IF iv_value IS NOT INITIAL.
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      mv_error_message = ''.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      mv_error_message = 'Value must not be empty.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_validator DEFINITION INHERITING FROM zcl_validator_abstract FINAL.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS validate REDEFINITION.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_numeric_validator IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD validate.
    IF iv_value CO '0123456789'. " Check if string contains only digits
      rv_is_valid = abap_true.
      mv_error_message = ''.
    ELSE.
      rv_is_valid = abap_false.
      mv_error_message = 'Value must be numeric.'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor_with_validation DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS process_data IMPORTING iv_input TYPE string
                                  it_validators TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_validator_abstract WITH EMPTY KEY
                                  RETURNING VALUE(rv_success) TYPE abap_bool.
    METHODS get_all_errors RETURNING VALUE(rt_errors) TYPE string_table.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    DATA mt_errors TYPE string_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_data_processor_with_validation IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD process_data.
    CLEAR mt_errors.
    rv_success = abap_true.

    LOOP AT it_validators INTO DATA(lo_validator).
      IF lo_validator->validate( iv_input ) = abap_false.
        APPEND lo_validator->get_error_message( ) TO mt_errors.
        rv_success = abap_false.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD get_all_errors.
    rt_errors = mt_errors.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_valid_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_invalid_data FOR TESTING.
    METHODS test_multiple_validators FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_valid_data.
    DATA: lt_validators TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_validator_abstract WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND NEW zcl_not_empty_validator( ) TO lt_validators.
    APPEND NEW zcl_numeric_validator( ) TO lt_validators.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor_with_validation( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_processor->process_data( iv_input = '12345' it_validators = lt_validators ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( lv_success msg = 'Valid data should pass validation' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lo_processor->get_all_errors( ) msg = 'No errors expected for valid data' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_invalid_data.
    DATA: lt_validators TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_validator_abstract WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND NEW zcl_not_empty_validator( ) TO lt_validators.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor_with_validation( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_processor->process_data( iv_input = '' it_validators = lt_validators ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success msg = 'Empty data should fail validation' ).
    DATA(lt_errors) = lo_processor->get_all_errors( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors ) exp = 1 msg = 'One error expected' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 1 ] exp = 'Value must not be empty.' msg = 'Incorrect error message' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_multiple_validators.
    DATA: lt_validators TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF REF TO zcl_validator_abstract WITH EMPTY KEY.
    APPEND NEW zcl_not_empty_validator( ) TO lt_validators.
    APPEND NEW zcl_numeric_validator( ) TO lt_validators.

    DATA(lo_processor) = NEW zcl_data_processor_with_validation( ).
    DATA(lv_success) = lo_processor->process_data( iv_input = 'ABC' it_validators = lt_validators ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_false( lv_success msg = 'Non-numeric data should fail validation' ).
    DATA(lt_errors) = lo_processor->get_all_errors( ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_errors ) exp = 1 msg = 'One error expected (numeric)' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_errors[ 1 ] exp = 'Value must be numeric.' msg = 'Incorrect error message for numeric validator' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel implementiert ein flexibles Validierungssystem unter Verwendung einer abstrakten Basisklasse (`zcl_validator_abstract`). Jede konkrete Validierungsregel (z.B. `zcl_not_empty_validator`, `zcl_numeric_validator`) erbt von dieser abstrakten Klasse und implementiert die `validate`-Methode. Der `zcl_data_processor_with_validation` kann eine Liste von Validatoren polymorph verarbeiten, was eine erweiterbare und wartbare Lösung für komplexe Validierungsanforderungen darstellt.
keywords: ABSTRACT, Validator, Object Orientation, Polymorphism, Inheritance

Instructions: Serialisiere eine interne Tabelle von Flugdaten (SFLIGHTS) in ein JSON-Format.
hint: Verwende `/ui2/cl_json=>serialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,
      END OF ty_sflight,
      tt_sflight TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_sflight WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS serialize_sflights
      IMPORTING
        it_sflights TYPE tt_sflight
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_json) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights.
    TRY.
        rv_json = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = it_sflights pretty_print = abap_true ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json=>cx_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Handle error, e.g., log it or raise a custom exception
        rv_json = |Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_serialize FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_serialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_serialize_sflight( ).
    DATA(lt_sflights) = VALUE zcl_json_serialize_sflight=>tt_sflight(
      ( carrid = 'AA' connid = '0017' fldate = '20250101' price = '100.00' currency = 'EUR' )
      ( carrid = 'LH' connid = '0400' fldate = '20250102' price = '250.50' currency = 'USD' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_json) = lo_cut->serialize_sflights( lt_sflights ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'JSON sollte nicht leer sein' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON sollte AA enthalten' substring = 'AA' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON sollte 0017 enthalten' substring = '0017' act = lv_json ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'JSON sollte 100.00 enthalten' substring = '100.00' act = lv_json ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `serialize` der Klasse `/ui2/cl_json` ermöglicht die einfache Umwandlung von ABAP-Datenstrukturen (hier eine interne Tabelle) in einen JSON-String. Die Option `pretty_print = abap_true` sorgt für eine lesbare Formatierung.
keywords: JSON, Serialize, Internal Table, SFLIGHTS, /ui2/cl_json

hint: Verwende `/ui2/cl_json=>deserialize`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_sflight DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:

        carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
        connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
        fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
        price    TYPE sflight-price,
        currency TYPE sflight-currency,

CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_sflight IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_sflights.
    TRY.
        /ui2/cl_json=>deserialize( EXPORTING json = iv_json CHANGING data = rt_sflights ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json=>cx_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        " Handle error
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_deserialize FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_deserialize_sflight( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `[{"CARRID":"AA","CONNID":"0017","FLDATE":"20250101","PRICE":"100.00","CURRENCY":"EUR"},{"CARRID":"LH","CONNID":"0400","FLDATE":"20250102","PRICE":"250.50","CURRENCY":"USD"}]`.
    DATA(lt_sflights) = lo_cut->deserialize_sflights( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Tabelle sollte 2 Einträge haben' act = lines( lt_sflights ) exp = 2 ).

  ENDMETHOD.

explanation: Die Methode `deserialize` von `/ui2/cl_json` wandelt einen JSON-String in eine passende ABAP-Datenstruktur um. Die Zielstruktur (hier `rt_sflights`) muss dabei dem JSON-Format entsprechen.
keywords: JSON, Deserialize, Internal Table, /ui2/cl_json

Instructions: Serialisiere eine ABAP-Struktur, die eine Kopfzeile und eine interne Tabelle als Positionen enthält, in ein JSON-Format.
hint: `/ui2/cl_json` kann verschachtelte Strukturen direkt verarbeiten.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_serialize_nested DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES:
      BEGIN OF ty_item,
        item_id   TYPE i,
        description TYPE string,
        quantity  TYPE i,

Instructions: Lese Daten aus der ersten Tabelle einer XLSX-Datei und speichere sie in einer internen Tabelle. Es wird davon ausgegangen, dass die erste Zeile Header-Informationen enthält.
hint: Verwende `cl_openxml_helper=>get_instance` und `read_excel_data`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_read_excel DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_excel_row,
             col1 TYPE string,
             col2 TYPE string,
             col3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_excel_row,
           tt_excel_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_excel_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_first_sheet
      IMPORTING
        iv_excel_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_excel_data) TYPE tt_excel_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_read_excel IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_first_sheet.
    DATA: lo_excel_reader TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper,
          lt_raw_data     TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_excel_data.

    TRY.
        lo_excel_reader = cl_openxml_helper=>get_instance( iv_excel_xstring ).
        lt_raw_data = lo_excel_reader->read_excel_data( iv_sheet_name = lo_excel_reader->get_sheet_names( )[ 1 ] ).

        " Skip header row and map to target structure
        LOOP AT lt_raw_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_raw_row>).
          IF sy-tabix = 1. " Skip header
            CONTINUE.
          ENDIF.
          APPEND VALUE ty_excel_row(
            col1 = <fs_raw_row>-cells[ 1 ]-value
            col2 = <fs_raw_row>-cells[ 2 ]-value
            col3 = <fs_raw_row>-cells[ 3 ]-value
          ) TO rt_excel_data.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_openxml_format_error cx_openxml_not_found_error INTO DATA(lx_openxml_error).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

hint: Nach dem Lesen der Daten kann auf einzelne Zellen über Index oder Spaltenname zugegriffen werden.
solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_read_cell DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS read_specific_cell
      IMPORTING
        iv_excel_xstring TYPE xstring
        iv_sheet_name    TYPE string OPTIONAL
        iv_row_index     TYPE i
        iv_col_index     TYPE i
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_cell_value) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_read_cell IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_specific_cell.
    DATA: lo_excel_reader TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper,
          lt_raw_data     TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_excel_data,
          lv_actual_sheet TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_excel_reader = cl_openxml_helper=>get_instance( iv_excel_xstring ).

        IF iv_sheet_name IS INITIAL.
          lv_actual_sheet = lo_excel_reader->get_sheet_names( )[ 1 ].
        ELSE.
          lv_actual_sheet = iv_sheet_name.
        ENDIF.

        lt_raw_data = lo_excel_reader->read_excel_data( iv_sheet_name = lv_actual_sheet ).

        READ TABLE lt_raw_data INDEX iv_row_index INTO DATA(ls_row).
        IF sy-subrc = 0.
          READ TABLE ls_row-cells INDEX iv_col_index INTO DATA(ls_cell).
          IF sy-subrc = 0.
            rv_cell_value = ls_cell-value.
          ENDIF.
        ENDIF.

      CATCH cx_openxml_format_error cx_openxml_not_found_error INTO DATA(lx_openxml_error).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_exclude DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_sflight,
             carrid   TYPE sflight-carrid,
             connid   TYPE sflight-connid,
             fldate   TYPE sflight-fldate,
             price    TYPE sflight-price,
             currency TYPE sflight-currency,
           END OF ty_sflight,

CLASS zcl_json_serialize_exclude IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD serialize_sflights_exclude.
    DATA: lt_exclude_fields TYPE /ui2/cl_json=>tt_exclude_names.

    APPEND 'CURRENCY' TO lt_exclude_fields.

    TRY.
        rv_json = /ui2/cl_json=>serialize( data = it_sflights pretty_print = abap_true exclude_fields = lt_exclude_fields ).
      CATCH /ui2/cl_json=>cx_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        rv_json = |Error: { lx_json_error->get_text( ) }|.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Deserialisiere einen JSON-String, der dynamische Feldnamen enthalten könnte, in eine interne Tabelle von Name-Value-Paaren.
hint: Verwende `deserialize` mit einer generischen Struktur wie `STRING_TABLE` oder `ABAP_NAMEVALUE_TABLE`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_dynamic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_name_value,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_name_value,
           tt_name_value TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_name_value WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS deserialize_dynamic_json
      IMPORTING
        iv_json TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_name_values) TYPE tt_name_value.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_json_deserialize_dynamic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD deserialize_dynamic_json.
    DATA: lo_json_parser TYPE REF TO /ui2/cl_json_parser,
          lv_name        TYPE string,
          lv_value       TYPE string.

    TRY.
        lo_json_parser = NEW /ui2/cl_json_parser( iv_json ).
        lo_json_parser->parse( ).

        lo_json_parser->get_root( )->get_members( ).

        LOOP AT lo_json_parser->get_root( )->get_members( ) ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_member>).
          lv_name = <fs_member>-name.
          lv_value = <fs_member>-value->get_string( ).
          APPEND VALUE ty_name_value( name = lv_name value = lv_value ) TO rt_name_values.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH /ui2/cl_json=>cx_json_error INTO DATA(lx_json_error).
        MESSAGE lx_json_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.

ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_deserialize_dynamic.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_json_deserialize_dynamic( ).
    DATA(lv_json) = `{"DynamicField1":"ValueA","AnotherField":"ValueB"}`.
    DATA(lt_name_values) = lo_cut->deserialize_dynamic_json( lv_json ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl der Name-Value-Paare stimmt nicht überein' act = lines( lt_name_values ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_name_values WITH KEY name = 'DynamicField1' INTO DATA(ls_nv1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Wert von DynamicField1 stimmt nicht überein' act = ls_nv1-value exp = 'ValueA' ).
    READ TABLE lt_name_values WITH KEY name = 'AnotherField' INTO DATA(ls_nv2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Wert von AnotherField stimmt nicht überein' act = ls_nv2-value exp = 'ValueB' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Füge ein neues Tabellenblatt zu einer bestehenden XLSX-Datei hinzu und schreibe Daten hinein.

solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_add_sheet DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_new_sheet_data,
             col_a TYPE string,
             col_b TYPE string,
           END OF ty_new_sheet_data,
           tt_new_sheet_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_new_sheet_data WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS add_sheet_to_excel
      IMPORTING
        iv_existing_excel_xstring TYPE xstring
        it_new_sheet_data         TYPE tt_new_sheet_data
        iv_new_sheet_name         TYPE string
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rv_updated_excel_xstring) TYPE xstring.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_add_sheet IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD add_sheet_to_excel.
    DATA: lo_excel_writer TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper.

    TRY.
        lo_excel_writer = cl_openxml_helper=>get_instance( ).
        rv_updated_excel_xstring = lo_excel_writer->create_excel_from_table(
          it_table         = it_new_sheet_data
          iv_sheet_name    = iv_new_sheet_name
          iv_excel_xstring = iv_existing_excel_xstring " Add to existing Excel
        ).
      CATCH cx_openxml_format_error cx_openxml_not_found_error INTO DATA(lx_openxml_error).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_add_sheet.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_openxml_add_sheet( ).
    DATA(lv_initial_excel) = create_initial_excel( ).

    DATA(lt_new_data) = VALUE zcl_openxml_add_sheet=>tt_new_sheet_data(
      ( col_a = 'New Data 1' col_b = 'Value X' )
      ( col_a = 'New Data 2' col_b = 'Value Y' )
    ).
    DATA(lv_updated_excel) = lo_cut->add_sheet_to_excel(
      iv_existing_excel_xstring = lv_initial_excel
      it_new_sheet_data         = lt_new_data
      iv_new_sheet_name         = 'AddedSheet'
    ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( msg = 'Aktualisiertes Excel XSTRING sollte nicht leer sein' act = lv_updated_excel ).

    " Verify by reading sheet names from the updated Excel
    DATA(lo_reader) = cl_openxml_helper=>get_instance( lv_updated_excel ).
    DATA(lt_sheet_names) = lo_reader->get_sheet_names( ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl der Tabellenblätter stimmt nicht überein' act = lines( lt_sheet_names ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_contains( msg = 'Sollte das neue Tabellenblatt enthalten' substring = 'AddedSheet' act = lt_sheet_names ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_initial_excel.
    DATA: lt_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lo_excel_writer TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper.

    lt_data = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'Initial' connid = 'Sheet' fldate = '20250101' )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_excel_writer = cl_openxml_helper=>get_instance( ).
        rv_xstring = lo_excel_writer->create_excel_from_table( it_table = lt_data iv_sheet_name = 'InitialSheet' ).
      CATCH cx_openxml_format_error cx_openxml_not_found_error INTO DATA(lx_openxml_error).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.

Dies ermöglicht die dynamische Erweiterung von Excel-Dokumenten.

Instructions: Lese alle Daten aus allen Tabellenblättern einer XLSX-Datei und kombiniere sie in einer einzigen internen Tabelle.
hint: Iteriere über die Tabellenblattnamen und rufe `read_excel_data` für jedes Blatt auf.
solution:
CLASS zcl_openxml_read_all_sheets DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_combined_row,
             sheet_name TYPE string,
             col1       TYPE string,
             col2       TYPE string,
           END OF ty_combined_row,
           tt_combined_data TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_combined_row WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS read_all_sheets_data
      IMPORTING
        iv_excel_xstring TYPE xstring
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_combined_data) TYPE tt_combined_data.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_openxml_read_all_sheets IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD read_all_sheets_data.
    DATA: lo_excel_reader TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper,
          lt_sheet_names  TYPE string_table,
          lt_raw_data     TYPE cl_openxml_helper=>tt_excel_data.

    TRY.
        lo_excel_reader = cl_openxml_helper=>get_instance( iv_excel_xstring ).
        lt_sheet_names = lo_excel_reader->get_sheet_names( ).

        LOOP AT lt_sheet_names INTO DATA(lv_sheet_name).
          lt_raw_data = lo_excel_reader->read_excel_data( iv_sheet_name = lv_sheet_name ).

          LOOP AT lt_raw_data ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<fs_raw_row>).
            IF sy-tabix = 1. " Skip header row
              CONTINUE.
            ENDIF.
            APPEND VALUE ty_combined_row(
              sheet_name = lv_sheet_name
              col1       = <fs_raw_row>-cells[ 1 ]-value
              col2       = <fs_raw_row>-cells[ 2 ]-value
            ) TO rt_combined_data.
          ENDLOOP.
        ENDLOOP.

      CATCH cx_openxml_format_error cx_openxml_not_found_error INTO DATA(lx_openxml_error).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_read_all_sheets FOR TESTING.
    METHODS create_dummy_excel_multi_sheet RETURNING VALUE(rv_xstring) TYPE xstring.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_read_all_sheets.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_openxml_read_all_sheets( ).
    DATA(lv_excel_xstring) = create_dummy_excel_multi_sheet( ).
    DATA(lt_combined_data) = lo_cut->read_all_sheets_data( lv_excel_xstring ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Anzahl der kombinierten Datenzeilen stimmt nicht überein' act = lines( lt_combined_data ) exp = 2 ).
    READ TABLE lt_combined_data INDEX 1 INTO DATA(ls_row1).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erste Zeile Blattname stimmt nicht überein' act = ls_row1-sheet_name exp = 'Sheet1' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Erste Zeile Col1 stimmt nicht überein' act = ls_row1-col1 exp = 'Data1A' ).
    READ TABLE lt_combined_data INDEX 2 INTO DATA(ls_row2).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Zweite Zeile Blattname stimmt nicht überein' act = ls_row2-sheet_name exp = 'Sheet2' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( msg = 'Zweite Zeile Col1 stimmt nicht überein' act = ls_row2-col1 exp = 'Data2A' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD create_dummy_excel_multi_sheet.
    DATA: lt_data1 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lt_data2 TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF sflight WITH EMPTY KEY,
          lo_excel_writer TYPE REF TO cl_openxml_helper.

    lt_data1 = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'Header1A' connid = 'Header1B' fldate = '20250101' ) " Header
      ( carrid = 'Data1A' connid = 'Data1B' fldate = '20250101' )
    ).
    lt_data2 = VALUE #(
      ( carrid = 'Header2A' connid = 'Header2B' fldate = '20250102' ) " Header
      ( carrid = 'Data2A' connid = 'Data2B' fldate = '20250102' )
    ).

    TRY.
        lo_excel_writer = cl_openxml_helper=>get_instance( ).
        rv_xstring = lo_excel_writer->create_excel_from_table( it_table = lt_data1 iv_sheet_name = 'Sheet1' ).
        rv_xstring = lo_excel_writer->create_excel_from_table( it_table = lt_data2 iv_sheet_name = 'Sheet2' iv_excel_xstring = rv_xstring ).
      CATCH cx_openxml_format_error cx_openxml_not_found_error INTO DATA(lx_openxml_error).
        MESSAGE lx_openxml_error->get_text( ) TYPE 'E'.
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Durch die Kombination von `get_sheet_names` und einer Schleife über die Tabellenblätter kann `read_excel_data` für jedes Blatt aufgerufen werden. Die gelesenen Daten können dann in einer einzigen internen Tabelle gesammelt werden, was eine konsolidierte Verarbeitung ermöglicht.
keywords: OpenXML, XLSX, Read All Sheets, cl_openxml_helper

CLASS zcl_ui5_get_theme_list DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_theme_info,
             theme_name TYPE /ui5/theme_name,
             description TYPE string,
           END OF ty_theme_info.
    TYPES tt_theme_info TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_theme_info WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_available_themes RETURNING VALUE(rt_theme_list) TYPE tt_theme_info.

CLASS zcl_ui5_get_theme_list IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_available_themes.
    DATA(lt_raw_themes) = /ui5/cl_theme_util=>get_theme_list( ).

                               theme_name = theme-theme_name

CLASS zcl_ui5_check_theme_valid DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS is_theme_valid IMPORTING iv_theme_name TYPE /ui5/theme_name
                               RETURNING VALUE(rv_is_valid) TYPE abap_bool.

CLASS zcl_ui5_check_theme_valid IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD is_theme_valid.
    DATA(lt_themes) = /ui5/cl_theme_util=>get_theme_list( ).

    " Using a table expression with LINE_EXISTS for modern check
    rv_is_valid = COND #( WHEN line_exists( lt_themes[ theme_name = iv_theme_name ] ) THEN abap_true ELSE abap_false ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Ermitteln Sie spezifische Parameter (z.B. Farben) für einen gegebenen UI5-Theme, die als JSON-String zurückgegeben werden, und parsen Sie diese in eine interne Tabelle.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `GET_THEME_PARAMETERS` der Klasse `/UI5/CL_THEME_UTIL`. Nutzen Sie String-Funktionen und einen `REDUCE`-Ausdruck für das Parsen des JSON-Strings (vereinfacht).
solution:
CLASS zcl_ui5_get_theme_params DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_theme_param,
             name  TYPE string,
             value TYPE string,
           END OF ty_theme_param.
    TYPES tt_theme_params TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_theme_param WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS get_theme_parameters IMPORTING iv_theme_name TYPE /ui5/theme_name
                                     RETURNING VALUE(rt_params) TYPE tt_theme_params.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ui5_get_theme_params IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_theme_parameters.
    DATA(lv_json_params) = /ui5/cl_theme_util=>get_theme_parameters( iv_theme_name ).

    " Vereinfachtes Parsen eines JSON-Strings in eine Tabelle von Name-Wert-Paaren.
    " In einem realen Szenario wäre ein robuster JSON-Parser (z.B. CL_ABAP_JSON) erforderlich.
    IF lv_json_params IS NOT INITIAL.
      DATA(lv_clean_json) = REPLACE( val = lv_json_params old = `{" ` new = `` ).
      lv_clean_json = REPLACE( val = lv_clean_json old = `"}` new = `` ).
      lv_clean_json = REPLACE( val = lv_clean_json old = `"` new = `` ).

      rt_params = VALUE #( FOR <part> IN ( SPLIT lv_clean_json AT ',' ) 
                               LET lv_name  = substring_before( val = <part> sep = ':' )
                                   lv_value = substring_after(  val = <part> sep = ':' ) IN
                               ( name = lv_name value = lv_value ) ).
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    " Da statische Methoden in ABAP Unit nicht einfach gemockt werden können,
    " testen wir hier die Parsing-Logik mit einem bekannten Input.
    " Ein realer Test würde Test-Doubles für /ui5/cl_theme_util erfordern.
    DATA(lt_params) = lo_cut->get_theme_parameters( 'sap_fiori_3' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = lines( lt_params ) msg = 'Theme-Parameter sollten nicht leer sein' ).
    DATA(lv_brand_color_exists) = abap_false.
    LOOP AT lt_params INTO DATA(ls_param) WHERE name = 'sapBrandColor'.
      lv_brand_color_exists = abap_true.
      cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_not_initial( act = ls_param-value msg = 'Brand Color Wert sollte nicht initial sein' ).
      EXIT.
    ENDLOOP.
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = lv_brand_color_exists msg = 'Parameter sapBrandColor sollte existieren' ).
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD test_get_theme_params_empty.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ui5_get_theme_params( ).
    DATA(lt_params) = lo_cut->get_theme_parameters( 'UNKNOWN_THEME' ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( act = lines( lt_params ) msg = 'Parameter für unbekannten Theme sollten leer sein' ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Die Lösung demonstriert eine vereinfachte JSON-Verarbeitung mittels String-Operationen (`REPLACE`, `SPLIT`, `SUBSTRING_BEFORE`, `SUBSTRING_AFTER`) und einem `VALUE #( FOR ... )`-Ausdruck, um die Parameter in eine interne Tabelle zu überführen. Dies zeigt moderne ABAP-String- und Tabellenverarbeitung. Für komplexere JSON-Strukturen wäre `CL_ABAP_JSON` die bevorzugte Wahl.

Instructions: Zeigen Sie ein einfaches 2D-Bild (z.B. aus einer URL) in einem ECL Viewer in der SAP GUI an. Beachten Sie, dass dies eine GUI-Interaktion erfordert und in einem echten Szenario ein Dynpro mit einem Custom Control benötigt.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_GUI_CUSTOM_CONTAINER` und `CL_GUI_ECL_VIEWERBOX` mit der Methode `LOAD_MODEL`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_display_image DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS display_image IMPORTING iv_image_url TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_display_image IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD display_image.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_ecl_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox.

    " Erstellen eines Custom Containers auf einem Dynpro (z.B. 100)
    " Dieses Beispiel geht von einem Dynpro mit einem Custom Control namens 'CUSTOM_CONTROL' aus.
    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Erstellen des ECL Viewers innerhalb des Containers
    CREATE OBJECT lo_ecl_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Laden des Bildmodells
    lo_ecl_viewer->load_model(
      EXPORTING
        i_url = iv_image_url
        i_model_type = 'IMAGE' " Modelltyp als Bild angeben
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDIF.

    " Um dies tatsächlich zu sehen, müsste ein Dynpro aufgerufen werden (z.B. CALL SCREEN 100).
    " Dieses Beispiel konzentriert sich auf die Backend-Logik.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

    METHODS test_display_image FOR TESTING.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.

    " Dieser Test kann nur überprüfen, ob die Instanziierung und Methodenaufrufe
    " nicht sofort zu einem Dump führen. Eine visuelle Anzeige kann nicht überprüft werden.
    " Für GUI-Steuerelemente sind Integrationstests mit einer laufenden GUI erforderlich.

Instructions: Registrieren Sie ein Ereignis für den ECL Viewer, z.B. ein 'Double-Click'-Ereignis, um auf Benutzerinteraktionen zu reagieren. Dies erfordert die Implementierung eines Event-Handlers.
hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `SET_REGISTERED_EVENTS` und implementieren Sie einen lokalen Event-Handler.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_event_handler DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS register_double_click_event.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS handle_double_click FOR EVENT double_click OF cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox
      IMPORTING sender.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_event_handler IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD register_double_click_event.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_ecl_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_ecl_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Registrieren des Double-Click-Ereignisses
    DATA(lt_events) = VALUE cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox=>tt_events(
      ( eventid = cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox=>event_double_click )
    ).

    lo_ecl_viewer->set_registered_events(
      EXPORTING
        events = lt_events
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDIF.

    " Event-Handler registrieren
    SET HANDLER handle_double_click FOR lo_ecl_viewer.

    " Um das Ereignis auszulösen, müsste der Viewer in der GUI angezeigt werden
    " und der Benutzer müsste darauf doppelklicken.
  ENDMETHOD.

  METHOD handle_double_click.
    " Hier wird die Logik für den Doppelklick implementiert
    " Z.B. eine Meldung ausgeben oder weitere Aktionen ausführen
    MESSAGE 'Doppelklick im ECL Viewer erkannt!' TYPE 'I'.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).

hint: Verwenden Sie die Methode `SAVE_AS_IMAGE` der Klasse `CL_GUI_ECL_VIEWERBOX`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_save_image DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS save_viewer_content_as_image IMPORTING iv_filepath TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_save_image IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD save_viewer_content_as_image.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_ecl_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_ecl_viewer
      EXPORTING
        parent = lo_container
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    " Speichern des Viewer-Inhalts als Bild
    lo_ecl_viewer->save_as_image(
      EXPORTING
        i_filepath = iv_filepath " Z.B. 'C:\temp\ecl_screenshot.png'
      EXCEPTIONS
        OTHERS = 1
    ).
    IF sy_subrc <> 0.
      " Fehlerbehandlung
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION.
    METHODS test_save_image FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_save_image.
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_ecl_save_image( ).
    " Für Unit-Tests auf dem Backend kann das Speichern einer Datei auf dem Frontend
    " nicht direkt überprüft werden. Wir testen nur den Methodenaufruf.
    DATA(lv_test_filepath) = 'C:\temp\test_ecl_image.png'.

    TRY.
        lo_cut->save_viewer_content_as_image( lv_test_filepath ).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_true( act = abap_true msg = 'Speichern als Bild sollte nicht zu einem Dump führen' ).
      CATCH cx_root INTO DATA(lx_exception).
        cl_abap_unit_assert=>fail( msg = lx_exception->get_text( ) ).
    ENDTRY.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die Methode `SAVE_AS_IMAGE` des `CL_GUI_ECL_VIEWERBOX` ermöglicht das Speichern des aktuell angezeigten Inhalts als Bilddatei auf dem Frontend des Benutzers. Dies ist nützlich für Dokumentationszwecke oder zum Exportieren von Visualisierungen.

Instructions: Rufen Sie die aktuell im ECL Viewer angezeigte Modell-ID ab.

solution:
CLASS zcl_ecl_get_model_id DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS get_current_model_id RETURNING VALUE(rv_model_id) TYPE string.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_ecl_get_model_id IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD get_current_model_id.
    DATA: lo_container TYPE REF TO cl_gui_custom_container,
          lo_ecl_viewer TYPE REF TO cl_gui_ecl_viewerbox.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_container
      EXPORTING
        container_name = 'CUSTOM_CONTROL'
      EXCEPTIONS

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

    CREATE OBJECT lo_ecl_viewer

    IF sy-subrc <> 0.

Instructions: Kopieren Sie Felder gleichen Namens von einer Quellstruktur in eine Zielstruktur. Die Zielstruktur soll dabei initialisiert werden.
hint: Verwenden Sie die `CORRESPONDING` Anweisung mit `BASE ( VALUE ... )`.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_basic DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source,
           BEGIN OF ty_target,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field4 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target.
    METHODS map_structure
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_basic IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_structure.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( VALUE ty_target( ) ) FROM is_source ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_structure FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_structure.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_cor_basic=>ty_source( field1 = 'Hello' field2 = 123 field3 = 'World' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_basic( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_structure( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'Hello' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field2 exp = 123 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-field4 ). " field4 sollte initial sein, da es nicht in der Quelle existiert
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING` Anweisung kopiert Felder mit identischen Namen von der Quell- zur Zielstruktur. `BASE ( VALUE ty_target( ) )` stellt sicher, dass die Zielstruktur initialisiert wird, bevor die Werte zugewiesen werden, was eine saubere Zuweisung ermöglicht.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Structure Mapping, Data Transformation, BASE

Instructions: Mappen Sie eine interne Tabelle auf eine andere, wobei einige Feldnamen unterschiedlich sind. Verwenden Sie die `MAPPING` Klausel.
hint: Nutzen Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit der `MAPPING` Klausel, um Felder explizit zuzuordnen.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_table_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source_line,
             id     TYPE i,
             text_val TYPE string,
             amount TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
           END OF ty_source_line,
           ty_source_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_source_line WITH EMPTY KEY,
           BEGIN OF ty_target_line,
             item_id TYPE i,
             description TYPE string,
             value TYPE p LENGTH 8 DECIMALS 2,
             status TYPE c LENGTH 1,
           END OF ty_target_line,
           ty_target_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_target_line WITH EMPTY KEY.
    METHODS map_tables
      IMPORTING
        it_source TYPE ty_source_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rt_target) TYPE ty_target_table.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_table_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_tables.
    rt_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( VALUE ty_target_table( ) )
                                 FROM it_source
                                 MAPPING item_id = id
                                         description = text_val
                                         value = amount ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_tables FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_tables.
    DATA(lt_source) = VALUE zcl_cor_table_mapping=>ty_source_table(
      ( id = 1 text_val = 'Item A' amount = '10.50' )
      ( id = 2 text_val = 'Item B' amount = '20.00' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_table_mapping( ).
    DATA(lt_target) = lo_cut->map_tables( lt_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lines( lt_target ) exp = 2 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-item_id exp = 1 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-description exp = 'Item A' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = lt_target[ 1 ]-value exp = '10.50' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( lt_target[ 1 ]-status ). " status sollte initial sein
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Die `CORRESPONDING` Anweisung kann mit der `MAPPING` Klausel verwendet werden, um Felder mit unterschiedlichen Namen explizit zuzuordnen. Dies ist besonders nützlich beim Umwandeln von Daten zwischen Tabellen mit ähnlichem, aber nicht identischem Aufbau.
keywords: CORRESPONDING, Internal Table, Mapping, MAPPING

Instructions: Führen Sie eine dynamische Feldzuordnung zwischen zwei Strukturen basierend auf einer Mapping-Tabelle durch. Nutzen Sie `CL_ABAP_CORRESPONDING`.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CL_ABAP_CORRESPONDING` und die Typen `SABP_DYN_MAP_MAPPING_TAB` für die dynamische Zuordnung.
solution:
CLASS zcl_dyn_field_mapping DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field_a TYPE string,
             field_b TYPE i,
             field_c TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source,
           BEGIN OF ty_target,
             target_a TYPE string,
             target_b TYPE i,
             target_d TYPE string,
           END OF ty_target,
           BEGIN OF ty_mapping_line,
             source_field TYPE string,
             target_field TYPE string,
           END OF ty_mapping_line,
           ty_mapping_table TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF ty_mapping_line WITH EMPTY KEY.

    METHODS map_dynamically
      IMPORTING
        is_source      TYPE ty_source
        it_mapping     TYPE ty_mapping_table
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_dyn_field_mapping IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_dynamically.
    DATA(lo_corresponding) = NEW cl_abap_corresponding( ).
    DATA(lt_dyn_mapping) = VALUE sabp_dyn_map_mapping_tab( ).

    LOOP AT it_mapping INTO DATA(ls_map).
      APPEND VALUE sabp_dyn_map_mapping_line(
        source_name = ls_map-source_field
        target_name = ls_map-target_field
      ) TO lt_dyn_mapping.
    ENDLOOP.

    lo_corresponding->add_mapping(
      source_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( is_source )
      target_type = cl_abap_typedescr=>describe_by_data( rs_target )
      mapping     = lt_dyn_mapping
    ).

    lo_corresponding->execute(
      EXPORTING
        source = is_source
      CHANGING
        target = rs_target
    ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_dynamic_mapping FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_dynamic_mapping.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_dyn_field_mapping=>ty_source( field_a = 'Dynamic' field_b = 456 field_c = 'Test' ).
    DATA(lt_mapping) = VALUE zcl_dyn_field_mapping=>ty_mapping_table(
      ( source_field = 'FIELD_A' target_field = 'TARGET_A' )
      ( source_field = 'FIELD_B' target_field = 'TARGET_B' )
    ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_dyn_field_mapping( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_dynamically( is_source = ls_source it_mapping = lt_mapping ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_a exp = 'Dynamic' ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-target_b exp = 456 ).
    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_initial( ls_target-target_d ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
explanation: Dieses Beispiel demonstriert die dynamische Feldzuordnung mithilfe der Klasse `CL_ABAP_CORRESPONDING` und der Typ `SABP_DYN_MAP_MAPPING_TAB`. Dies ermöglicht es, die Zuordnungsregeln zur Laufzeit zu definieren, was in flexiblen Szenarien sehr mächtig ist.
keywords: CL_ABAP_CORRESPONDING, SABP_DYN_MAP, Dynamic Mapping, RTTI

Instructions: Kopieren Sie alle Felder von einer Struktur in eine andere, außer bestimmten Feldern.
hint: Verwenden Sie `CORRESPONDING` mit der `EXCEPT` Klausel.
solution:
CLASS zcl_cor_except DEFINITION PUBLIC FINAL CREATE PUBLIC.
  PUBLIC SECTION:
    TYPES: BEGIN OF ty_source,
             field1 TYPE string,
             field2 TYPE i,
             field3 TYPE string,
           END OF ty_source,

             field1 TYPE string,

             field3 TYPE string,

           END OF ty_target.
    METHODS map_except
      IMPORTING
        is_source TYPE ty_source
      RETURNING
        VALUE(rs_target) TYPE ty_target.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_cor_except IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD map_except.
    rs_target = CORRESPONDING #( BASE ( VALUE ty_target( field4 = 'Initial Value' ) )
                                 FROM is_source
                                 EXCEPT field2 ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS ltcl_test DEFINITION FOR TESTING RISK LEVEL HARMLESS DURATION SHORT.
  PRIVATE SECTION:
    METHODS test_map_except FOR TESTING.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS ltcl_test IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD test_map_except.
    DATA(ls_source) = VALUE zcl_cor_except=>ty_source( field1 = 'A' field2 = 100 field3 = 'C' ).
    DATA(lo_cut) = NEW zcl_cor_except( ).
    DATA(ls_target) = lo_cut->map_except( ls_source ).

    cl_abap_unit_assert=>assert_equals( act = ls_target-field1 exp = 'A' ).
